`AGENTS.md`:

```md
# Copy APP agent entry

macOS is being added alongside the existing iOS workflows. For a Mac App target,
read `skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md`, `docs/macos-support.md` and `docs/macos-implementation-plan.md`; use the separate
`copyapp mac` commands and explicit ChatComputer environment identity. Do not route
a Mac target through iOS-only skills or invent a USB UDID. Preserve iOS commands,
v1 historical evidence and their validators. The current Mac implementation is
development work: do not claim complete behavior reconstruction, VM acceptance,
physical-Mac compatibility or deep function analysis from foundation tests alone.

This repository implements analysis and independent rebuild jobs across standard iOS, enhanced jailbroken iOS and macOS. The historical enhanced iPhone jobs are:

1. **Analyze an installed app.** Identify the exact USB device and Bundle ID, collect the app package, UI and sandbox evidence, decrypt encrypted Mach-O files when the verified device path supports it, inspect selected functions, run targeted UI/Frida experiments, and deliver a cited deep report plus `feature-spec.json`.
2. **Rebuild selected behavior.** Use that specification to create an independent, runnable iOS app, install and launch it on the requested real devices, compare the same flows, and report verified coverage and remaining differences.

The main branch also has an explicit ordinary/inactive-jailbreak route. Read `docs/ios-standard-mode.md` and `docs/ios-device-support-acceptance.md` before using `--mode standard|auto|enhanced`. Standard mode uses development-signed XCTest, exact USB screenshots and a separately typed UI behavior report; it does not require an original IPA, FairPlay credential, SSH, Frida or iOS MCP. Do not apply the historical deep-function/sandbox requirements below to a UI-only deliverable, or present a UI report as deep-function completion when the user requested that scope. Enhanced collection must bind its saved device/system and App version/build to the current UI case, and uses the existing explicit investigation/report commands for function reasoning. Ordinary-mode package inputs are independent host evidence, not proof of loaded phone code. Preserve all historical v1 and Mac contracts. An inactive jailbreak sample does not establish pristine-device compatibility; open acceptance gates in the ledger remain open.

For agent-led first use or environment setup, read `skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md`. It bootstraps the Mac, identifies the exact USB phone and App, and routes to the requested survey, analysis or rebuild scope. The copyable prompts in the README explicitly load this repository skill; they do not require a provider-specific extension.

For first FairPlay account preparation, use the separate `copyapp credential-retrieve` command described in `docs/ios-fairplay-credentials.md`, with exact `--udid`, installed `--bundle` and a new `--credential-ref`. It builds pinned native helpers, verifies USB/SSH/native identity and SINF decoding, and saves only outside the evidence case after remote cleanup. RootHide mobile SSH passed on the named iOS 17 phone; do not impose root SSH as a blanket prerequisite or infer arbitrary-jailbreak support. Credentials stay in the ignored private store, never in case hashes or reports. Standard UI workflows do not invoke credential retrieval automatically.

Before rebuilding, use `docs/coverage-targets.md` to inventory known user-visible capabilities and set a milestone appropriate to the App's complexity. Keep the target, verified known coverage and selected-flow pass rate separate. A percentage requires an explicit known-capability denominator; otherwise report named scope. Record deferred, blocked and unknown behavior, and never describe a selected-flow pass rate as whole-App parity.
For agent-led development, use `docs/fidelity.md` to freeze a bounded quality milestone with `copyapp fidelity-plan --task <IOS_AGENT_TASK_OR_MAC_PLAN>`: default grade 80/100, maximum three implementation/check cycles including the first, unless the user chooses otherwise. This is a reviewed selected-scope grade, not objective similarity or capability coverage. Complete core flow assertions and full screenshot review; record every difference and its blocking impact. Use `fidelity-check` after each cycle, including supported failed build/install/check attempts, and pass `--previous` for later cycles. Stop at `target_met` or `iteration_limit`; at the limit disclose the unmet target and deliver current runnable artifacts and gaps. Work through the stages directly in the current agent session for this bounded path. Historical strict delivery, standalone `copy` and `agent-run --verify-rebuild` remain strict; do not claim those parents completed merely because a fidelity milestone passed.
After the reviewed report and `rebuild-plan` exist, use `copyapp coverage-plan` to freeze that inventory and target. After a verified `agent-delivery`, use `copyapp coverage-delivery` with one explicit review decision per capability. Run `copyapp verify` on both cases. The reviewer owns the completeness and semantics of the inventory; the CLI checks source links, flow gates and arithmetic.

For a user request to “copy this App” without preselected UI flows, follow `skills/copyapp-copy/SKILL.md` first. It directs the current coding agent to discover representative flows and pass them through `copyapp discover-check` before analysis and implementation.

Treat a request such as “分析这个 App” or “Copy this app” as authorization to carry out the corresponding job. Work from the connected device and current files; only request missing device/target details when they cannot be discovered. Do not stop after `copyapp analyze`: its `analysis.md` is a collection index. Complete the function interpretation and `copyapp report` step described in `skills/copyapp-analyze/SKILL.md`. For the rebuild phase, follow `skills/copyapp-rebuild/SKILL.md`. For an initial device inventory, follow `skills/copyapp-survey/SKILL.md`.

For each representative UI flow, prefer one `copyapp flow-capture` case when the final screen needs structural analysis. It runs the bounded playbook and captures the resulting UIKit/accessibility view without launching the App again. Keep original and rebuilt runs separate, then use `copyapp compare-playbooks` on their child `playbook/` directories. Cite the composite case in the report so the screenshot and view tree share one verified device, App, backend, and short observation window.
When a flow also needs runtime code evidence, pass one or more `--method 'ClassName::selector:'` arguments to `flow-capture`; add `--binary` and its matching `--objc-index` to hook the acquired App's original entry as well as the current Objective-C IMP. The trace child records counts for each tap step and preserves the exact hook source. Treat those counts as temporal observations, and validate the imported composite case against the original binary hash.
Pass a completed traced flow to `copyapp candidates --flow` for step attributed static method addresses. By default, `copyapp native-queue` records bounded ARM64 assembly for candidate entries and follows only unique local direct call/branch targets; inspect its stops before writing functional conclusions. Use `copyapp ghidra-queue` for optional decompiled function evidence. None of these queues alone generates a semantic interpretation.
For pseudocode without REA, use `--provider ghidra-direct --ghidra-dir <GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR> --java-home <JDK_HOME>` with `investigate-flow`, `investigate-app`, `prepare-analysis`, or `prepare-app`. It ranks verified runtime/static candidates, follows unique direct local calls from the validated native queue, runs Copy APP's packaged Ghidra script, and includes pseudocode with each function's origin in the agent review task. The entry function limit does not include those bounded native followers. For an existing candidate case, use `copyapp ghidra-queue` and pass `--native <NATIVE_QUEUE>` when available; for one explicitly chosen address, use `copyapp ghidra-function`. If a large binary times out, use `--ghidra-disable-analyzer 'Objective-C Message Analyzer'` on the investigation/preparation commands, or `--disable-analyzer` on the standalone commands, then review the recorded analysis profile. A timed-out Ghidra import is rejected even if its post-script wrote pseudocode. These paths require external Ghidra/JDK but no REA CLI. Import the result into `copyapp report` with `--evidence`; verify the binary hash and address chain before interpreting it. The default provider remains `none` to avoid spending decompiler time unless requested or useful for the task.
When a direct local call chain stops at an indirect `blr`, use `copyapp ghidra-indirect --udid <UDID> --investigation <CASE> --objc-index <INDEX> --ghidra-dir <DIR> --java-home <DIR> --out <NEW_CASE>` to discover bounded sites from the verified native queue, replay the saved playbook with register capture, and decompile observed app-image callbacks. Its `queue/` child can be imported by `copyapp report`. For an explicitly selected site, `flow-capture` followed by `ghidra-queue --branch-flow <FLOW_CAPTURE> --native <NATIVE_QUEUE>` remains available. Review the same-step runtime hit and instruction binding. A temporal hit identifies code executed in the observation window; it does not by itself prove that the callback caused the visible UI change.
If `ghidra-indirect` saved a complete branch replay but Ghidra failed, use the same arguments and output with `--resume`. It verifies and reuses the phone trace and archives the failed Ghidra queue. If the phone replay itself failed, start a new case after reviewing App state; do not assume an interrupted tap is safe to repeat.
For a verified `analyze` case and one bounded playbook, `copyapp investigate-flow` runs method scouting and UI capture, plus trace and candidate binding when a method is selected. The available providers are `none`, `ghidra-direct`, and `hopper-direct`. By default, available static candidates also receive bounded ARM64 disassembly from Xcode llvm-objdump; missing Xcode records unavailable assembly and does not block the UI/Frida investigation. Read its `review-brief.md` and all linked raw evidence, then write the deep findings and feature specification; in the default no-REA mode, ambiguous method scouting still collects UI evidence and marks method tracing as unavailable. Resume also reuses verified complete stages after a later failure. The previous scout is retained when a reviewed method is chosen.
For a default no-REA flow with a labelled tap and ambiguous static scout, the investigator first captures an entry UIKit tree and may select the unique action method on the visible button's runtime class. A failed or ambiguous entry scan falls back to UI-only evidence. Treat this as candidate selection; inspect the later Frida trace for actual method hits before making code claims. The XR DeepSeek automatic selection case is `cases/deepseek-no-rea-auto-method-investigation-20261015`.
For several selected flows in one app, run `copyapp investigate-app` with repeated `--script`; it saves one verifiable parent case and resumes without repeating completed flows. `copyapp report --evidence ID=<APP_INVESTIGATION_DIR>` can import the complete set.
After `copyapp draft-analysis`, follow its `TASK.md` to review each linked UI, trace, native assembly and optional decompiler artifact, then produce supported findings, a concrete feature specification and a separately verified deep report. The generated task and fact draft only establish input readiness.
For a verified `analyze` case and selected playbooks, `copyapp prepare-analysis --udid <UDID> --analysis <CASE> --script <PLAYBOOK> ... --out <CASE>` joins `investigate-app` and `draft-analysis` behind one resumable entry. Read `<CASE>/draft/TASK.md` after its status becomes `needs_semantic_review`; this is a handoff to the current coding agent, not a finished deep report. Use `--resume` after a failed investigation. It archives a verified failed flow capture under `attempts/` before retrying that flow and reuses complete flows without another device run. Existing complete investigations may be supplied with `--investigation` to regenerate the handoff without touching the device.
For a specific database in the indexed app data container, use `copyapp sandbox-file` against a verified analysis case, then `copyapp sqlite-schema` on the saved file and cite only the structure case in the report. The raw file stays in ignored local `cases/`; copying live SQLite and WAL files sequentially is not an atomic database snapshot.
For a captured preference plist, use `copyapp plist-schema` and cite its verified key/type structure. Its report omits values; the raw captured plist may contain private data and remains local.
When the analysis case does not yet exist and selected original App playbooks are ready, use `copyapp prepare-app --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> --script <PLAYBOOK> ... --out <CASE>`. It requires no REA by default, preflights Ghidra when `ghidra-direct` is selected, then joins `analyze` and `prepare-analysis`; `--decrypt` requests full-package recovery for an encrypted App. On success, review `<CASE>/preparation/draft/TASK.md` and continue to a sourced deep report. The parent case and its children must pass `copyapp verify`; `--resume` reuses complete source-verified stages without repeating device work.
For a report produced from that task, retain `source_script_sha256` on each reviewed specification flow and run `copyapp analysis-delivery --task <DRAFT> --report <REPORT> --out <DELIVERY>`. It checks flow coverage and source identity; inspect the underlying function reasoning yourself because hashes do not prove semantic correctness.
`copyapp report --evidence ID=<INVESTIGATION_DIR>` validates and imports that complete case, including its flow, candidate, available native assembly and optional REA source chain. Cite the composite ID for conclusions that join these stages.
Before implementing a rebuild from a verified deep report, run `copyapp rebuild-plan --report <REPORT_CASE> --out <PLAN_CASE>` to derive cited original/clone playbook pairs. Inspect any flow marked missing or ambiguous; the generated clone scripts change only the Bundle ID and do not implement the app. Once the independent app launches, use the plan's `rebuild-check` inputs for same-device validation.
Generate `copyapp agent-task --report <REPORT_CASE> --plan <PLAN_CASE> --udid <UDID> --project <SOURCE_DIR> --out <TASK_CASE>` and use its verified `TASK.md` as the evidence-linked coding brief. Treat `ready_for_agent` as input readiness only. Continue through source implementation, package/build, real-device installation and `rebuild-check`; retain any remaining visual or behavioral gaps in the final report.
For a single resumable handoff, use `copyapp prepare-rebuild --report <REPORT_CASE> --udid <UDID> --project <SOURCE_DIR> --out <PREPARATION_CASE>`; select a subset with repeated `--flow` and resume the same source and settings with `--resume`. It writes `plan/` and `task/TASK.md`, verifies source identity, and retains damaged child attempts. A task marked `needs_evidence` requires original UI evidence before implementation.
After installing a clone, `copyapp rebuild-task-check --task <TASK_CASE> --out <REBUILD_CHECK_CASE>` runs the verified task's selected pairs on its pinned device, without copying the generated long comparison command. Supply `--udid` only if the task left the device open; use `--resume` to continue an interrupted check. Inspect the finished case and its saved screenshots.
When only selected report flows are requested, `agent-task` uses `selected_flows_ready` and records the omitted flow IDs. `agent-run` accepts that reviewed selection and prompts the coding agent to disclose the omitted scope. `agent-delivery` may cite a device check containing additional flows, but counts and reports only those selected in the task; it lists the extra checked and omitted flows separately.
When already operating inside Codex or Claude Code, carry out the analysis or rebuild task yourself. The optional `copyapp agent-run` command launches one of those CLIs from a standalone shell and records its process output; avoid nested agent launches from an active coding-agent session. A successful agent process exit is not proof of a deep report or rebuilt App.
For a standalone, selected-flow run from the installed App through final device delivery, use `copyapp copy --udid <UDID> --bundle <ORIGINAL_BUNDLE> --script <PLAYBOOK> ... --project <NEW_PROJECT> --rebuilt-bundle <NEW_BUNDLE> --out <CASE>`. It defaults to full-package recovery, network metadata and no REA. The parent case accepts success only when the analysis Agent has a source-linked formal report and the rebuild Agent has a source-linked install, selected-flow behavior assertions, complete visual review and no major difference. `--resume` reuses verified completed stages but does not automatically replay a failed Agent run. This command invokes an external coding-agent CLI; inside an active Codex or Claude Code session, perform its stages directly rather than calling it recursively.
When a standalone user has no preselected playbooks, `copyapp copy --auto-discover` can ask an external Agent to observe the specified App, write and replay 3–12 bounded flows, then use only accepted scripts in the same workflow. Keep the external `codex` or `claude` provider in an independent terminal. A failed discovery Agent run is retained and not replayed automatically on resume.
Inside an active coding-agent session, `copyapp copy --agent-provider current --auto-discover` maintains one parent workflow without launching another Agent. It first writes `discovery-agent/TASK.md` and pauses; discover flows yourself, run `discover-check` into the specified nested discovery case, then resume. For already accepted flows use `--discovery <CASE>`. Complete its analysis and rebuild handoff tasks yourself; save a formal report plus `analysis-delivery`, then installation, paired device comparison, full visual review and `agent-delivery` without `--run`, resuming the same case after each phase. The default English [workflow guide](docs/copy-workflow.md) has a [Chinese version](docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md).
When a completed `discover-check` case exists, use `copyapp copy --discovery <DISCOVERY_CASE>` in place of repeated `--script`. The workflow pins that case's manifest hash and requires the same device, Bundle ID and UI backend; all downstream scripts are the replayed copies inside the discovery case.
For a standalone semantic-review run, use `agent-run --verify-analysis` to require the agent's formal report at `<RUN>/reviewed-report` and automatically create a source-linked `<RUN>/analysis-delivery` case. Inspect that verified delivery and its findings; a passing source check still cannot certify function semantics. This option does not apply to implementation tasks.
For a standalone implementation run, `agent-run --verify-rebuild` fixes the install, rebuild-check, visual-review and final-delivery paths under `<RUN>`. It returns success only after a verified delivery has behavior assertions for every selected flow, complete screenshot review and no major visual difference. Minor differences remain recorded. Do not launch a nested Agent from an active Agent session; implement and verify the same steps directly.
For a development-signed rebuild on iOS 17, use `copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> --ipa <SIGNED_IPA> --out <INSTALL_CASE>` and verify that case; the default TrollStore path remains for other builds. An install case proves neither launch nor UI equivalence. After building, installing and checking the App, create `copyapp agent-delivery --task <TASK_CASE> --install <INSTALL_CASE>/install.json --check <REBUILD_CHECK_CASE> --out <DELIVERY_CASE>`. It binds the source tree and installed IPA to exact device, build and selected flow evidence. Its scope and visual-review fields, not the Agent CLI exit code, determine what has actually been verified.
Inspect every saved screenshot pair and record explicit judgments with `copyapp visual-review --check <REBUILD_CHECK_CASE> --judgments <JSON> --reviewer <NAME> --out <VISUAL_REVIEW_CASE>`. Pass that case to `agent-delivery --visual-review <VISUAL_REVIEW_CASE>`. Record visible differences, even if pixel metrics pass. The reviewer label is self-declared; the verifier establishes image identity and review coverage, not the truth of the subjective judgment.

For new copy jobs, default to ignored `output/<bundle>-<UTC>-<unique-id>/`, with sibling `project/` and `evidence/` directories. `copyapp copy` creates this layout when paths are omitted; `--output-dir` overrides the job root and explicit `--project` plus `--out` retains legacy paths. Resume must pin the previous job path. For agent-led Mac jobs, use the same layout explicitly with the separate Mac commands, which still require `--out`; there is no `mac copy` command. Keep existing `examples/` and `cases/` in place. Raw job evidence may stay in ignored `output/`; credentials remain only in their existing ignored credential stores.

Use `.venv/bin/copyapp` from the repository root. Specify `--udid` and `--bundle` for device operations. Keep screenshots, extracted App data, IPA snapshots and traces in ignored local `cases/` or `output/`, and device credentials in their existing ignored local stores; report files may link to those local cases. Run `copyapp verify` on every collected or composed case. A matching hash proves file consistency, not the correctness of an interpretation. Preserve failed and partial evidence; mark claims as observed, inferred or unknown. Decompiler pseudocode is generated evidence, not original source. Direct Hopper is available through `hopper-function`, `hopper-queue`, and the `hopper-direct` analysis provider; it needs an installed Hopper GUI in a normal macOS user session. The REA runtime is not required.
For a new device, run `copyapp onboard` and select `--stage analyze` or `--stage rebuild` when needed to identify the exact USB phone and get ordered setup repairs. `analyze`, `prepare-app`, and `copy` now own exact-device SSH forwards; UI playbooks own short-lived UI forwards. Keep `copyapp tunnel --udid <UDID>` open only for the one-time host-key check or interactive use. After a successful exact-device SSH doctor/onboard probe, the CLI records the pinned port and key paths in ignored `cases/ssh/profiles.json`; later commands with `--udid` reuse that route unless explicit SSH flags override it. This does not remove the initial fingerprint check. Never copy a private SSH key or pairing token into a task, report or tracked file.
When one App build has separately verified reports from different collection times, `copyapp report-portfolio --report <REPORT_A> --report <REPORT_B> --out <CASE>` may create one readable report. It requires the exact same device identity, App version/build and decrypted main binary hash, rewrites only source-local evidence links, and rechecks both formal reports and analyses on verification. State explicitly that the merged report does not make different-time sandbox and runtime observations simultaneous. It is a presentation and provenance layer; use the formal deep report's `feature-spec.json` for rebuild planning.

Do not infer arbitrary-device compatibility from named-device tests. The current iPhone XR/iOS 16.1.1, iPhone 14/iOS 17.3.1 and iPhone 11/iOS 26.0.1 results, their limits and the published-version boundary are summarized in [current status](docs/current-status.md). In particular, XR's optional DVT file listing can fail while SSH acquisition works; the v0.1.1 iOS 17 iCTRL session-lifetime fault is fixed in v0.1.2 with named-iPhone-14 regression evidence, while reboot and other-device validation of the changed cleanup remain open; iOS 26 iOS MCP can return a black frame after fresh launch. Use per-device SSH host-key files and ports when several phones are connected. Preserve a host-key mismatch and recheck the target rather than replacing a trusted key. For a new host or phone, follow [setup](docs/setup.md); for current workflow stages, follow [the guide](docs/copy-workflow.md).

```

`CONTRIBUTING.md`:

```md
# Contributing to Copy APP

**Language:** English | [简体中文](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)

Thanks for helping make iOS app analysis more reproducible. Copy APP joins phone observations, native analysis, a reviewed report and an independently built app. Contributions should improve one of those links while keeping its evidence traceable.

## Good first contributions

- Fix a reproducible setup, USB tunnel or UI backend issue.
- Add a bounded playbook or a parser test with a synthetic fixture.
- Improve error messages and onboarding guidance for a real failure.
- Translate a README overview or correct an existing translation.
- Add an optional analyzer without making it mandatory for the default workflow.

## Development workflow

1. Read [README.md](README.md), [the workflow guide](docs/copy-workflow.md) and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Open a focused issue for a design change that affects case schemas or device privileges.
2. Reproduce the issue with an exact command and a new output case. Record the device model, iOS version, jailbreak, Xcode and relevant tool versions. When no device is needed, use a synthetic fixture.
3. Make the smallest change that preserves case provenance and the meaning of existing verification gates. Keep optional tools optional.
4. Run `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/copyapp-pycache .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests`. For a generated case, run `.venv/bin/copyapp verify <CASE>`. If a change touches device control, report the real device and selected flows you tested; say which versions remain untested.
5. Submit a PR describing the behavior changed, evidence, tests and limitations. Link the relevant docs. Do not present an Agent exit, successful build or hash check alone as functional equivalence.

## Repository map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `copyapp/` | Mac CLI, acquisition, analysis, orchestration and verification. |
| `device/ios-mcp/` | Rootless phone UI service. |
| `vendor/ictrl/` | Attributed optional iCTRL source and build. |
| `skills/` | Coding-agent workflows and handoffs. |
| `examples/rebuild/` | Independent example implementations and experimental probes. |
| `rebuild/` | Suggested local output path for a new, unreviewed rebuild. |
| `tests/` and `fixture/` | Automated checks and known-source fixtures. |
| `examples/report-inputs/` | Historical pilot JSON inputs; not current device reports. |
| `docs/` | Current setup, architecture, workflow, support limits, release note and localized README overviews. |
| `cases/` | Local evidence and credentials; ignored by Git. |

Do not commit raw IPAs, device screenshots, sandbox exports, pairing records, credentials or account data. Use synthetic fixtures or sanitized summaries in reviews. Preserve upstream licenses, NOTICE files and provenance when adapting code.

Contributions to Copy APP's project-owned code and documentation must be available under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Submit only material you have the right to contribute under that license. Third-party material keeps its original license and attribution.

## Translation notes

English `README.md` and Chinese `README.zh-CN.md` summarize setup and link to the full guides. Other localized README pages should accurately describe the named iOS 16, 17 and 26 selected-flow results, retain links to the current setup and contribution guides, and avoid general device or whole-app compatibility claims. Translation-only changes do not require a connected phone; check links, code blocks and technical names.

```

`CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# 为 Copy APP 贡献

**语言：** [English](CONTRIBUTING.md) | 简体中文

Copy APP 将手机观测、原生代码分析、审阅报告和独立构建的 App 连接起来。贡献应改善其中一个环节，并让结论仍能追溯到证据。

## 适合开始的任务

- 修复可复现的安装、USB 转发或界面后端问题。
- 添加有界的界面脚本，或用合成夹具补充解析器测试。
- 针对实际失败改善报错与引导步骤。
- 翻译 README 概览或修正现有译文。
- 增加可选分析器，同时保持默认流程无需安装它。

## 开发流程

1. 阅读 [README](README.zh-CN.md)、[流程指南](docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)及 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。若设计变动影响案例格式或设备权限，先用聚焦的 issue 讨论。
2. 用明确命令和新的输出案例复现问题，记录设备型号、iOS、越狱、Xcode 与相关工具版本。无需真机时使用合成夹具。
3. 保持改动聚焦，保留案例来源关系及已有校验门槛的语义；可选工具不应变成默认必需项。
4. 运行 `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/copyapp-pycache .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests`。生成案例后运行 `.venv/bin/copyapp verify <CASE>`。设备控制改动需写明实测手机、流程及尚未测试的版本。
5. PR 说明行为变化、证据、测试和限制。Agent 正常退出、编译成功或哈希相符，单独都不能证明功能等价。

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `copyapp/` | Mac CLI、采集、分析、编排与校验。 |
| `device/ios-mcp/` | 手机端 rootless 界面服务。 |
| `vendor/ictrl/` | 保留来源和署名的可选 iCTRL 源码。 |
| `skills/` | Coding Agent 流程与交接。 |
| `examples/rebuild/` | 独立实现的示例工程和实验探针。 |
| `rebuild/` | 新复刻工程建议使用的本地输出路径；不代表已审阅示例。 |
| `tests/` 和 `fixture/` | 自动测试与源码已知夹具。 |
| `examples/report-inputs/` | 历史试点 JSON 输入，不是当前设备报告。 |
| `docs/` | 当前安装、架构、工作流、支持边界、正式发布说明与 README 翻译。 |
| `cases/` | 本地证据与凭据，Git 默认忽略。 |

不要提交原始 IPA、设备截图、沙盒导出、配对记录、密钥或账号数据。评审时使用合成夹具或去敏摘要。改造上游源码时保留许可证、NOTICE 和来源记录。

提交给 Copy APP 自有代码和文档的贡献须可按 [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) 发布。请只提交你有权按该许可证贡献的材料；第三方材料仍保留其原始许可和署名。

英文 `README.md` 和简体中文 `README.zh-CN.md` 概述安装并链接完整指南。其余语言 README 应准确描述 iOS 16、17、26 指定设备上的选定流程结果，保留当前安装和贡献指南链接，避免泛化到所有设备或整 App 等价。纯翻译改动无需连接手机，但要检查链接、命令及技术名词。

`PLAN.en.md`:

```md
# Copy APP plan

[English](PLAN.en.md) · [简体中文](PLAN.md) · [Current status](docs/current-status.md)

## Product contract

Add macOS alongside the existing iOS support according to the
[implementation and acceptance plan](docs/macos-implementation-plan.md).
This is development-branch work, not a claim that published v0.1.2 supports Mac apps.

Copy APP has two jobs on a jailbroken iPhone: **Analyze** an installed app into a reviewed, source-linked report and feature specification; then **Rebuild** a selected set of behavior as an independent, runnable iOS app and compare it with the original on the same device. A coding agent performs interpretation and implementation. The CLI collects and verifies evidence, controls the device, and records gaps. The [workflow](docs/copy-workflow.md), [architecture](docs/architecture.md) and [coverage method](docs/coverage-targets.md) are the operational specifications.

A report should cover app identity, permissions, package and embedded libraries, UI/navigation, resources, sandbox/data model, network and system integrations, native class/function evidence, selected runtime behavior, implementation hypotheses and unknowns. Material claims cite the device, app build and source case. Decompiled pseudocode is not original source. Server-only behavior cannot be inferred from client code.

The rebuild milestone is selected after a known-capability inventory. A simple app may target its entire known inventory; a complex app should deliver a useful first slice and report deferred, blocked and unknown behavior. A selected-flow pass count must never be called whole-app coverage.

## Current baseline

- **Published:** v0.1.2 includes the iOS 17 session fix and agent-led first-use entry; distinguish earlier named-device results from new regression evidence. v0.1.0 remains the first-release archive.
- **iOS 16:** iPhone XR/Dopamine rootless has selected report-to-rebuild paths. SSH acquisition works despite an optional DVT file-listing failure.
- **iOS 17:** iPhone 14/Relaxin RootHide has current-code Calculator acquisition, four original/independent-app iOS MCP checks, five reviewed image pairs and a five-hit original Frida trace. The v0.1.1 iCTRL session issue is fixed in v0.1.2: two runs of four original/rebuilt final assertions and exit cleanup passed.
- **iOS 26:** iPhone 11/Relaxin RootHide has selected Calculator and Clock deliveries. iOS MCP black-frame rejection and bounded recovery passed observed runs.
- **Host:** 346 v0.1.2 local tests and isolated-wheel installation passed; `1499222` retains the earlier fresh GitHub macOS bootstrap/test record. A second physical Mac's first phone onboarding is deferred.

These are named-device, selected-flow results. See [current status](docs/current-status.md) for limits. Raw cases remain ignored local evidence, not release assets.

## Next gates

1. Retain the named-device iOS 17 session-fix regression evidence, then check the changed cleanup on other named phones. Do not replay an uncertain action without checking device state.
2. Keep XR's repeated optional DVT file-listing failure documented; revisit it when a new device or developer-service change makes this route necessary. SSH acquisition remains the working route.
3. Check reboot/rejailbreak durability and longer-running backend reliability on the supported devices.
4. When work on a second physical Mac resumes, follow the setup guide from first USB trust through SSH pinning, UI control, acquisition and a signed or TrollStore rebuild.
5. Expand the named-app and device evidence before another release. Review its diff and bilingual notes, test the release commit, and publish a single tag and GitHub Release only for that completed scope.

Longer-term work includes unfamiliar-app autonomous discovery, more complete selected-app behavior, persistence/backend boundaries and stronger visual fidelity. Do not promise an arbitrary complete clone before those checks exist.

# Copy APP 当前计划

[English](PLAN.en.md) · 简体中文 · [当前状态](docs/current-status.zh-CN.md)

## 产品约定

Copy APP 在越狱 iPhone 上完成两项工作：先**分析**已安装 App，产出审阅过、带来源引用的报告和功能规格；再把选定行为**复刻**为独立可运行的 iOS App，在同一手机上与原版对照。Coding Agent 负责解释与实现，CLI 负责采集和校验证据、控制设备、记录缺口。具体操作见[工作流](docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)、[架构](docs/architecture.zh-CN.md)与[覆盖目标](docs/coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)。

报告应覆盖 App 身份、权限、安装包与动态库、界面及导航、资源、沙盒与数据模型、网络及系统集成、原生类和函数证据、选定运行行为、实现推断与未知项。重要结论引用设备、App 构建和来源案例。反编译伪代码不等于原作者源码；不能仅从客户端推断服务端内部逻辑。

复刻目标在盘点已知能力后选定。简单 App 可以覆盖全部已知能力；复杂 App 应先交付有用的一部分，并列明延期、阻塞与未知行为。选定流程的通过数不能当成整 App 覆盖率。

# Copy APP

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README_ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](docs/readme/README_tr.md) · [Русский](docs/readme/README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](docs/readme/README_vi.md) · [ไทย](docs/readme/README_th.md) · [Deutsch](docs/readme/README_de.md) · [Español](docs/readme/README_es.md) · [Français](docs/readme/README_fr.md) · [Українська](docs/readme/README_uk.md) · [Polski](docs/readme/README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](docs/readme/README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](docs/readme/README_ar.md) · [فارسی](docs/readme/README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](docs/readme/README_id.md) · [Italiano](docs/readme/README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](docs/readme/README_el.md)

[Project website](https://xnu.app/copyapp/) · [Illustrated overview (简体中文)](docs/articles/copyapp-overview.zh-CN.md) · [Documentation](docs/README.md) · [Reverse-engineering tools](docs/reverse-engineering-tools.md) · [Latest release](docs/releases/v0.2.0.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE)

Copy APP helps Codex or Claude Code **analyze installed apps and build independent, runnable implementations of selected behavior** on **non-jailbroken iOS, jailbroken iOS and macOS**. Conclusions, source and comparisons stay linked to inspectable evidence. The three routes are available in the latest `main` checkout. The latest tagged release is **v0.2.0**, which predates the standard iPhone route. [v0.1.2](docs/releases/v0.1.2.md) is the previous iOS-only release.

**First time?** [Choose one of three routes and copy the agent task](#start-here). The agent checks dependencies and installs the local tools; you complete the required device/system confirmations.

**Choose the access your task needs:** standard mode works from visible UI; enhanced mode adds evidence available on a supported jailbroken phone; Mac apps use a separate ChatComputer workflow.

| Route | What it provides | Requirements / guide |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Non-jailbroken iOS · standard** | UI flows, accessibility observations, USB screenshots, reviewed behavior reports and independently signed rebuilds | Mac, USB iPhone, Xcode / Developer Mode and development signing; [standard mode](docs/ios-standard-mode.md) |
| **Jailbroken iOS · enhanced** | UI workflows plus package/sandbox acquisition, optional Frida tracing and supported device decryption | Exact-device SSH and compatible device services; [iOS setup](docs/setup.md) |
| **Mac apps** | App-package / AX evidence, UI replay, independent `.app` builds and selected-flow comparisons | Apple Silicon Mac and a dedicated ChatComputer virtual Mac; [Mac setup](docs/macos-support.md) |

Standard mode needs no original IPA, FairPlay credential, SSH or Frida. Its named iOS 26 test used an inactive jailbreak; iOS 17 also passed an explicit standard-mode regression. A never-jailbroken-device test was waived, so that separate compatibility result is not claimed. See the [iOS acceptance ledger](docs/ios-device-support-acceptance.md).

Optional [IPA download and offline recovery](docs/ios-standard-mode.md#standard-iphone-mode) are separate from phone UI collection. First [credential preparation](docs/ios-fairplay-credentials.md) uses a supported jailbroken phone and a license matching the IPA account; once retained locally, the matching credential permits offline recovery without a connected phone. Real Remoboard main/extension recovery and matching-device code comparison passed.

Mac behavior reports do not imply deep native function analysis or arbitrary-Mac compatibility. See [Mac setup and AI task](docs/macos-support.md) and the [acceptance ledger](docs/macos-implementation-plan.md).

Source examples: [Stocks AppKit demo](examples/macos/Stocks/) (illustrative offline data), [independent editor](examples/macos/IndependentEditor/), [owned fixture](examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/) and [iOS examples](examples/rebuild/).

## Architecture at a glance

![Copy APP architecture: agent, local toolkit, standard iPhone, jailbroken iPhone and macOS routes, and reviewed deliverables](docs/assets/readme-architecture.svg)

One Mac coordinates the coding agent, evidence and build. Choose standard UI collection on a USB iPhone, enhanced collection on a supported jailbroken iPhone, or a dedicated virtual Mac through ChatComputer. Each route keeps its own prerequisites and verified identity. See the [detailed architecture and evidence model](docs/architecture.md).

<a id="start-here"></a>

## Quick start: choose a route and paste one task

1. Open **Codex or Claude Code with local command execution on your Mac**.
2. Choose your target below and replace **APP NAME** in its task.
3. Paste the task. The agent checks dependencies, installs the repository CLI and follows the matching skill. You handle the device trust and system permissions it identifies.

Keep a source checkout: it includes the skills, device components and examples as well as the CLI. **No provider-specific extension is required.**

| Target | You prepare | The agent sets up and checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-jailbroken iOS | A Mac with Xcode, an unlocked USB iPhone with the target App installed, Developer Mode and development signing | Python 3.9+, CLI, exact phone/App identity, development-signed iCTRL / XCTest and USB installation |
| Jailbroken iOS | A Mac, an unlocked jailbroken iPhone connected by USB, and the target App on that phone | Python 3.9+, repository CLI, exact phone/App identity, then the required SSH/UI/runtime tools and signing route |
| macOS | A host meeting ChatComputer's requirements; initialize its virtual Mac and approve required permissions; make the target App available in that guest | Python 3.9+, repository CLI, Swift/macOS SDK, ChatComputer, guest collector and exact environment/App identity |

### Non-jailbroken iOS

Use standard mode for visible behavior and an independent signed implementation. Copy:

```text
Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp to observe and independently rebuild selected behavior of “APP NAME” on my USB-connected non-jailbroken iPhone.
Use the latest main checkout. Read AGENTS.md, skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md and docs/ios-standard-mode.md first. Prepare the CLI with sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh if needed.
Identify the exact USB phone and App. Use --mode standard; check Xcode, Developer Mode, device trust and development signing. Prepare the signed iCTRL XCTest runner and install over USB.
Discover representative UI flows, review screenshots and accessibility evidence, and deliver a reviewed UI behavior report. Standard collection needs no IPA or FairPlay credential. Implement an independent App with its own Bundle ID, sign and install it over USB, then compare the same flows and review every screenshot pair in the current agent session.
Use a unique output/ job with project/ and evidence/. Follow docs/fidelity.md: default grade 80/100, at most three implementation/check cycles including the first. Deliver source, runnable artifacts, verified scope and remaining differences. Keep native function and private sandbox claims outside the UI-only report.
```

For setup only, append **“Stop after a verified standard-mode capability check; list signing or runner setup still needed.”** For analysis only, append **“Deliver the reviewed UI behavior report; do not rebuild.”** See [standard-mode setup and commands](docs/ios-standard-mode.md).

### Jailbroken iOS

Connect and unlock the phone. Its Bundle ID can be discovered by the agent. Copy:

```text
Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp to analyze and independently rebuild selected behavior of “APP NAME” on my USB-connected jailbroken iPhone.
Clone into a new directory if needed, or reuse my existing checkout. Read AGENTS.md and skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md first.
Check Python 3.9+ and run sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh if the repository CLI is missing. Identify the exact phone and App; complete the initial USB check, then configure only the analysis/rebuild prerequisites this device needs. Use --mode enhanced for UI-first collection with enhancement, and the explicit investigation/report commands for deeper function reasoning.
Work in the current agent session through a reviewed report, independent implementation, installation and same-device comparison. Ask me for the specific device-side trust, permission or signing action when needed.
Use a unique output/ job with project/ and evidence/. Follow docs/fidelity.md: default grade 80/100, at most three implementation/check cycles including the first. Stop at the target or cycle limit and deliver source, runnable artifacts, verified scope and remaining differences.
```

For a setup check only, append **“Stop after a verified USB survey, identify the phone and App, and list remaining prerequisites; do not analyze or rebuild yet.”** For analysis only, append **“Deliver the reviewed report; do not rebuild.”**

First-use actions can include **Trust This Computer**, the documented SSH fingerprint check, phone permissions and signing access. Installing the host CLI does not jailbreak the phone or install its services. See [iOS setup](docs/setup.md).

### macOS with ChatComputer

As checked on **2026-10-22**, [ChatComputer's official requirements](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer#install) are **Apple Silicon, macOS 27, 16 GB or more RAM and about 70 GB of free disk space**. Python 3.9+ and a working Swift/macOS SDK are needed for Copy APP; Xcode-project builds need full Xcode. The agent checks these before proceeding.

ChatComputer can be installed with `brew install --cask chatcomputer/tap/chatcomputer`, or by moving the official release's `ChatComputer.app` into Applications. The [Mac installation guide](docs/macos-support.md#install-and-first-use) covers both paths, CLI availability and guest permissions. You can let the agent carry out the installation:

```text
Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp and ChatComputer to analyze and independently rebuild selected behavior of the macOS App “APP NAME”.
Clone into a new directory if needed, or reuse my existing checkout. Read AGENTS.md, skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md and docs/macos-support.md first.
Check the host against ChatComputer's current requirements, Python 3.9+ and the Swift/macOS SDK. If needed, prepare the repository CLI with sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh and install ChatComputer from its official distribution.
Guide me through guest initialization and required system permissions. Use .venv/bin/copyapp mac doctor, deploy the bounded collector and register the exact guest. Confirm the target App is installed inside that virtual Mac; identify its exact build before analysis.
Use the current agent session for flow discovery, report review and implementation. Install the independent App separately, compare the same flows and review every screenshot. Preserve iOS support; do not start another agent or ChatComputer's model loop.
Use a unique output/ job with project/ and evidence/. Follow docs/fidelity.md: default grade 80/100, at most three implementation/check cycles including the first. Stop at the target or cycle limit and deliver source, runnable artifacts, verified scope and remaining differences.
```

**The target App must be available inside the virtual Mac.** The first run includes guest initialization and screen-recording/accessibility permissions for ChatComputer and the collector. A working current agent supplies the model; this workflow does not require starting ChatComputer's built-in chat model.

For a setup check only, append **“Stop after verified environment registration and one target-App screenshot/AX observation; do not analyze or rebuild yet.”** For analysis only, append **“Deliver the reviewed behavior report; do not rebuild.”** A passing doctor checks transport and screenshots, not complete setup or App acceptance.

[Detailed Mac setup](docs/macos-support.md) · [iOS first-run tasks](docs/first-run-agent.md) · [Example source](examples/README.md)

### Shared defaults

Agent-led default: **80/100 reviewed fidelity grade, three cycles**. Ask for 70
for a quick prototype or 90 for finer detail. Core selected behavior must pass;
remaining visual differences stay explicit. This grade is separate from objective
image similarity and known-capability coverage. The [bounded workflow](docs/fidelity.md)
uses `fidelity-plan --fidelity 80 --max-iterations 3`; historical strict delivery
and standalone parent workflows retain their existing rules.

## Reverse-engineering tools

**Ghidra and Hopper are directly integrated decompilers.** They are optional; the default analysis provider is `none`.

| Tool | Used for | Entry / prerequisite |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Ghidra** | Selected-function pseudocode and bounded call/reference facts | `ghidra-function`, `ghidra-queue`, `ghidra-indirect` / `ghidra-direct`; external Ghidra + matching JDK |
| **Hopper** | Selected-function pseudocode and candidate queues | `hopper-function`, `hopper-queue` / `hopper-direct`; licensed local app + macOS GUI session |
| **Frida** | Runtime method hits and bounded register observations | `trace`, `experiment`, `flow-capture --method`; compatible host/device services |
| **LLVM / Xcode** | Bounded ARM64 disassembly and direct-call followers | `native-disasm`, `native-queue`; `llvm-objdump` |
| **Built-in Mach-O / Objective-C** | Packages, load commands, classes, selectors and method addresses | `ipa`, `objc`; Mac package index via `mac inspect` / `mac acquire` |
| **ipadecrypt / recovery** | Recover encrypted analysis binaries on verified iOS routes | `decrypt-package`, `analyze --decrypt`; device-specific setup |

The native investigation/report integration primarily serves the existing **iOS workflow**. macOS currently uses App-package, AX and UI evidence; an equivalent Mac native-function chain is not implemented. **REA is not required.** IDA Pro, Binary Ninja and radare2 do not currently have direct adapters.

[Tool setup, provider choices and agent prompts](docs/reverse-engineering-tools.md) · [Direct Hopper](docs/rea-hopper-integration.md)

## What the workflow delivers

1. **Analyze:** identify the exact target environment and app build; inspect its package and supported data evidence, then observe selected flows. iOS adds optional native/runtime investigation; macOS uses bounded App/AX observations. Review a cited report with implementation hypotheses and explicit unknowns.
2. **Rebuild:** choose a milestone from a known-capability inventory; implement an independent iOS or macOS app; build and install its IPA or `.app`; compare the same selected flows in the pinned phone or virtual Mac and review every screenshot pair. Report measured coverage and gaps.

A small app may justify a broad first milestone. A complex app needs a named slice of behavior; a percentage is meaningful only with an explicit known-capability denominator. A passing selected-flow check does not establish whole-app equivalence. See [coverage targets](docs/coverage-targets.md).

The Mac runs orchestration and builds. OpenSSH acquires files, iOS MCP provides jailbroken UI observation and control, iCTRL / XCTest provides standard-mode UI control and is also available to enhanced workflows, and Frida provides bounded runtime evidence. Ghidra and Hopper are optional native-analysis tools. **REA is not required.** The [architecture guide](docs/architecture.md) explains the trust and evidence boundaries.

The [example projects](examples/README.md) live under `examples/rebuild/` (iOS) and `examples/macos/` (Mac). New jobs default to `output/`; the legacy `rebuild/<NEW_PROJECT>` workspace remains supported.

### A running macOS example

![Actual independent AppKit Stocks example on macOS, showing a local watchlist, AAPL detail and an offline chart](docs/assets/macos/stocks-demo.jpg)

The [Stocks source example](examples/macos/Stocks/) implements symbol search, chart-period selection and local watchlists. This is an actual window capture of the independently built app on the host Mac, with illustrative offline values; it is not Apple's Stocks or a live market feed. Build instructions are included with the source. Recorded guest comparisons and remaining visual/behavior gaps are separate in the [acceptance ledger](docs/macos-implementation-plan.md).

## Tested iOS support

These are named-device, selected-flow results, not a compatibility promise for every iOS device or app. The [new standard/enhanced acceptance ledger](docs/ios-device-support-acceptance.md) adds inactive-jailbreak iOS 26 standard UI delivery, an iOS 17 standard regression, enhanced RootHide recovery and offline FairPlay checks. [Current evidence and limitations](docs/current-status.md) records the v0.1.2 scope and remaining gaps.

| Phone | Jailbreak and verified scope | Open limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone XR · iOS 16.1.1 | Dopamine rootless; SSH, Frida, iOS MCP and iCTRL; selected Notes, Calculator, Translate and Clock analysis/rebuild paths | Optional developer file listing can return `ConnectionTerminatedError`; the SSH package/sandbox route works. |
| iPhone 14 · iOS 17.3.1 | Relaxin/RootHide; original Calculator acquisition, Frida trace and four original/independent-app arithmetic checks through iOS MCP | v0.1.2 fixes the v0.1.1 iCTRL session-lifetime fault; two runs of four paired flows passed. Reboot durability and the changed cleanup on other devices remain untested. |
| iPhone 11 · iOS 26.0.1 | Relaxin/RootHide; original Calculator and Clock analysis, signed independent apps and selected paired arithmetic/Stopwatch checks | iOS MCP can return a black frame after fresh launch; bounded Home/relaunch recovery passed observed runs. |

Current limitations include incomplete app coverage, modest visual differences, unverified reboot/rejailbreak durability, and no end-to-end onboarding test on a second physical Mac. Raw IPAs, complete case screenshots, sandbox contents and credentials stay in Git-ignored local `cases/` or job `output/` (credentials keep their existing local stores) and are never release assets; the few Calculator images in the docs were selected separately for publication.

## Manual installation and first survey

These commands are for readers using the CLI directly; an agent executes them for you. The first USB survey needs Python 3.9+, an unlocked USB-connected iPhone, and **Trust This Computer** accepted. This stage needs no phone tweak, SSH, Frida or Xcode signing.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp apps --udid <UDID> --all
```

Open the target app on the phone, confirm its exact Bundle ID, then collect and verify:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp survey --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --ui-backend usb --out cases/first-survey
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-survey
```

Read `cases/first-survey/report.md` and use a new output directory for each retry. Deep analysis also needs OpenSSH, an exact-device SSH route, the Copy APP iOS MCP tweak and a compatible Frida service; add iCTRL as needed. Standard UI collection and rebuilding require Xcode, a signed XCTest runner and development signing; start with `onboard --mode standard` and the [standard guide](docs/ios-standard-mode.md). Enhanced rebuilding uses the verified signing or TrollStore route. Use `onboard --stage analyze` and `doctor --udid <UDID>` to check readiness, then follow the [full setup guide](docs/setup.md) and [Analyze → Rebuild workflow](docs/copy-workflow.md).

## Run the full Analyze → Rebuild workflow

From an active Codex or Claude Code session, use `standard` for a non-jailbroken phone, `enhanced` for supported jailbreak collection, or `auto` to select from probed capabilities:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --mode standard \
  --udid <UDID> --bundle <ORIGINAL_BUNDLE_ID> \
  --auto-discover --agent-provider current \
  --rebuilt-bundle <NEW_BUNDLE_ID>
```

New jobs default to `output/<bundle>-<UTC>-<unique-id>/` in the workspace, with
`project/` for independent source and `evidence/` for reports, captures and checks.
Use `--output-dir output/my-job` to choose a job directory. The existing explicit
`--project <SOURCE> --out <CASE>` form remains supported. Paths must stay inside
the selected workspace (`--workspace <DIR>`); the root `output/` is Git-ignored.
Existing examples and cases stay in place. On resume, pin the printed
`--output-dir` (or legacy `--out` and `--project`) and retain all other settings;
`--resume` never guesses the latest job.

The command pauses for reviewed discovery scripts, a reviewed UI behavior report, and an independent implementation. Enhanced function investigation remains explicit; this UI report does not certify native functions. Resume with the printed output path and the same settings plus `--resume` after each verified handoff. `current` uses the agent already in this session; it does not launch a nested agent. The explicit-mode workflow uses `--agent-provider current`. Historical unflagged strict workflows retain their separate `codex` / `claude` CLI providers. Existing flows can be supplied with `--discovery <CASE>` or repeated `--script <FILE>` instead of `--auto-discover`. The [workflow guide](docs/copy-workflow.md) documents the gates and commands.

## Philosophy and contribution

Keep raw observations separate from interpretation. Tie material claims to a device, app build and verifiable source. Record failed attempts and uncertainty. Compare original and rebuilt apps from equivalent states, and report the behavior actually checked. Keep upstream credits and licenses with vendored components. Contributions that improve setup, bounded analysis, reproducible device checks, accessibility, or translations are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

[项目网站](https://xnu.app/copyapp/) · [图文介绍](docs/articles/copyapp-overview.zh-CN.md) · [文档目录](docs/README.zh-CN.md) · [逆向工具](docs/reverse-engineering-tools.zh-CN.md) · [最新版本](docs/releases/v0.2.0.zh-CN.md) · [参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md) · [Apache-2.0 许可证](LICENSE)

Copy APP 帮助 Codex 或 Claude Code **分析已安装 App，并独立实现选定行为**，支持 **非越狱 iOS、越狱 iOS 和 Mac App 三种方案**。结论、源码与对照结果保留可复查的证据来源。三种入口已合入最新 `main`；最新标签版本 **v0.2.0** 早于普通 iPhone 模式，使用新模式请检出主分支。[v0.1.2](docs/releases/v0.1.2.zh-CN.md) 为上一版仅支持 iOS 的版本。

**第一次使用？** [选择一种方案，复制任务给 Agent](#从这里开始)。依赖检查和本地工具安装交给 Agent，设备信任与系统授权按提示完成。

**按需要选择：**非越狱方案从界面行为入手；越狱方案可进一步获取安装包、沙盒和运行时证据；Mac App 使用独立的 ChatComputer 流程。

| 方案 | 可以做什么 | 准备条件／指南 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **非越狱 iOS · standard** | 界面流程、辅助功能观察、USB 截图、行为报告，以及独立签名 App 的重建与对照 | Mac、USB iPhone、Xcode、开发者模式和开发签名；[普通模式](docs/ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md) |
| **越狱 iOS · enhanced** | 界面流程，以及安装包／沙盒采集、可选 Frida 跟踪和受支持的设备解密 | 准确设备的 SSH 与兼容服务；[越狱环境配置](docs/setup.zh-CN.md) |
| **Mac App** | App 包／AX 证据、界面重放、独立 `.app` 构建与选定流程对照 | Apple Silicon Mac、ChatComputer 独立虚拟 Mac；[Mac 配置](docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md) |

普通模式无需原版 IPA、FairPlay 凭据、SSH 或 Frida。已测 iOS 26 样本是越狱未激活的手机，iOS 17 也通过了显式普通模式回归；用户免除了单独的从未越狱设备测试，该项不记为实测结果。详见[iOS 验收账本](docs/ios-device-support-acceptance.md)。

可选的 [IPA 下载和离线解密](docs/ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md)与手机 UI 采集分别使用。首次[准备凭据](docs/ios-fairplay-credentials.md)需要受支持的越狱手机，且授权账号要与 IPA 一致；保存匹配凭据后，后续解密无需连接手机。真实 Remoboard 主程序、扩展的离线恢复及设备代码比较已通过。

Mac 行为报告不代表深层函数分析或任意 Mac 兼容。详见 [Mac 安装与 AI 任务](docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md)和[验收账本](docs/macos-implementation-plan.md)。

源码示例：[Stocks AppKit 示例](examples/macos/Stocks/)（明确标注的离线数据）、[独立编辑器](examples/macos/IndependentEditor/)、[自有样例](examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/)及 [iOS 示例](examples/rebuild/)。

## 架构一览

![Copy APP 架构：Agent、本地工具链、普通 iPhone、越狱 iPhone 与 Mac 三条路线，以及经过审阅的交付](docs/assets/readme-architecture.svg)

Mac 协调 Coding Agent、证据与构建；目标可以是通过 USB 连接的普通 iPhone、受支持的越狱 iPhone，或 ChatComputer 中的独立虚拟 Mac。三条路线保留各自的依赖、证据范围和准确环境身份。组件边界和证据关系见[详细架构说明](docs/architecture.zh-CN.md)。

## 快速上手：选方案，复制一个任务

1. 在 Mac 上打开**能执行本地命令的 Codex 或 Claude Code**。
2. 选择下面的使用方案，把任务中的 **App 名称**换成自己的目标。
3. 复制任务给 Agent。它检查依赖、安装仓库 CLI，并读取对应 Skill；你按提示完成设备信任和系统授权。

保留源码检出：CLI、Skill、设备组件和示例都在仓库里。**无需安装某个专属 Agent 扩展。**

| 目标 | 你需要准备 | Agent 安装与检查 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 非越狱 iOS | 装有 Xcode 的 Mac、USB 连接并解锁的 iPhone、已安装的目标 App、开发者模式和开发签名 | Python 3.9+、CLI、准确手机／App 身份、开发签名的 iCTRL／XCTest 和 USB 安装 |
| 越狱 iOS | Mac、USB 连接并解锁的越狱 iPhone，目标 App 已装在手机上 | Python 3.9+、仓库 CLI、准确手机／App，再按设备配置 SSH、界面／运行时工具和签名路线 |
| macOS | 满足 ChatComputer 要求的宿主 Mac；完成虚拟 Mac 初始化和必要授权；目标 App 在客体中可用 | Python 3.9+、仓库 CLI、Swift／macOS SDK、ChatComputer、客体采集器和准确环境／App 身份 |

### 非越狱 iOS

用普通模式观察界面行为，再实现独立签名的 App。复制：

```text
请使用 https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp，观察并独立复刻 USB 连接的非越狱 iPhone 上「App 名称」的选定行为。
使用最新 main 检出。先阅读 AGENTS.md、skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md 和 docs/ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md；需要时执行 sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh 安装 CLI。
识别准确的 USB 手机和 App，使用 --mode standard，检查 Xcode、开发者模式、设备信任和开发签名，准备签名的 iCTRL XCTest runner 并通过 USB 安装。
发现代表性界面流程，审阅截图和辅助功能证据，交付审阅后的 UI 行为报告；普通采集无需 IPA 或 FairPlay 凭据。以独立 Bundle ID 实现 App，开发签名后通过 USB 安装，在当前 Agent 会话对照同机流程并逐张审阅截图。
在 output/ 下建立唯一任务目录，分开 project/ 和 evidence/。按 docs/fidelity.md 执行：默认 80 分，最多三轮实现／检查，首轮计入；交付源码、可运行产物、已验证范围与剩余差异。UI 报告不作原生函数或私有沙盒结论。
```

只检查安装，加**“完成经校验的普通模式能力检查，列出还缺的签名或 runner 配置后停止。”** 只想分析，加**“交付审阅后的 UI 行为报告，先不复刻。”** 具体命令见[普通模式指南](docs/ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md)。

### 越狱 iOS

连接并解锁手机。不知道 Bundle ID 也没关系，Agent 会识别。复制：

```text
请使用 https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp，分析并独立复刻 USB 连接的越狱 iPhone 上「App 名称」的选定行为。
需要时克隆到新目录，或复用已有检出。先阅读 AGENTS.md 和 skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md。
检查 Python 3.9+；仓库 CLI 未安装时执行 sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh。识别准确的手机和 App，先完成 USB 首次检查，再按这台设备配置分析／复刻需要的依赖。增强 UI 采集使用 --mode enhanced，深入函数推理继续使用显式调查与报告命令。
在当前 Agent 会话完成报告审阅、独立实现、安装与同机对照。需要手机信任、系统授权或签名条件时，告诉我具体操作。
在 output/ 下建立唯一任务目录，分开 project/ 和 evidence/。按 docs/fidelity.md 执行：默认 80 分，最多三轮实现／检查，首轮计入；达标或轮数耗尽就停止，交付源码、可运行产物、已验证范围与剩余差异。
```

只检查安装，可在任务末尾加：**“完成经校验的 USB survey，告诉我准确手机、App 和剩余依赖后停止，先不分析或复刻。”** 只想分析，则加**“交付审阅后的报告，先不复刻。”**

首次使用可能需要你在手机上确认**信任此电脑**、核对 SSH 指纹、授予权限，以及提供签名条件。宿主 CLI 安装不会替手机越狱或自动装好手机服务。详见 [iOS 安装指南](docs/setup.zh-CN.md)。

### macOS 与 ChatComputer

截至 **2026-10-22**，[ChatComputer 官方要求](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer#install)为 **Apple Silicon、macOS 27、至少 16GB 内存和约 70GB 可用空间**。Copy APP 另需 Python 3.9+ 和可用的 Swift／macOS SDK；构建 Xcode 工程需要完整 Xcode。Agent 会先检查这些条件。

ChatComputer 可通过 `brew install --cask chatcomputer/tap/chatcomputer` 安装，也可从官方 Release 下载并把 `ChatComputer.app` 放入“应用程序”。[Mac 安装步骤](docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md#安装与首次使用)说明两种方式、命令可用性和客体授权。可以直接让 Agent 完成安装：

```text
请使用 https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp 和 ChatComputer，分析并独立复刻 macOS 上「App 名称」的选定行为。
需要时克隆到新目录，或复用已有检出。先阅读 AGENTS.md、skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md 和 docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md。
检查宿主是否满足 ChatComputer 当前要求，以及 Python 3.9+、Swift／macOS SDK。需要时运行 sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh 安装仓库 CLI，并从官方渠道安装 ChatComputer。
引导我完成虚拟 Mac 初始化及必要系统授权。执行 .venv/bin/copyapp mac doctor，部署有界采集器并登记准确客体；确认目标 App 已安装在虚拟 Mac 中，识别准确构建后再分析。
在当前 Agent 会话完成流程发现、报告审阅和实现。新 App 分开安装，对照相同流程并逐张审阅截图。保留 iOS 支持，不启动另一个 Agent 或 ChatComputer 内置模型循环。
在 output/ 下建立唯一任务目录，分开 project/ 和 evidence/。按 docs/fidelity.md 执行：默认 80 分，最多三轮实现／检查，首轮计入；达标或轮数耗尽就停止，交付源码、可运行产物、已验证范围与剩余差异。
```

**目标 App 要在虚拟 Mac 内可用。** 首次运行需完成客体初始化，以及 ChatComputer／采集器所需的录屏、辅助功能等授权。当前 Agent 已有自己的模型配置，这条工作流不要求再启动 ChatComputer 内置聊天模型。

只想检查安装，可在任务末尾加：**“完成经校验的环境登记和一次目标 App 截图／AX 观察后停止，先不分析或复刻。”** 只想分析，改成**“交付审阅后的行为报告，先不复刻。”** doctor 通过只代表传输和截图可用，不代表完整配置或 App 已验收。

[完整 Mac 安装指南](docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md) · [iOS 首次运行任务](docs/first-run-agent.zh-CN.md) · [源码示例](examples/README.md)

### 三种方案的默认设置

Agent 默认 **80 分、最多三轮**；快速原型可选 70，精细复刻可选 90。核心选定行为须通过，
其余视觉差异明确保留，不再无限打磨。该分数与客观图像相似度、已知能力覆盖率分开。
[有界复刻流程](docs/fidelity.md)使用 `fidelity-plan --fidelity 80 --max-iterations 3`；
旧严格交付和独立父工作流仍保留原验收语义。

## 支持的反编译与逆向工具

**已直接接入 Ghidra 和 Hopper 两种反编译器。** 二者按需启用，默认分析 provider 为 `none`。

| 工具 | 用途 | 入口／依赖 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Ghidra** | 指定函数伪代码、有界调用关系与指令引用 | `ghidra-function`、`ghidra-queue`、`ghidra-indirect`／`ghidra-direct`；外部 Ghidra + 匹配 JDK |
| **Hopper** | 指定函数伪代码与候选队列 | `hopper-function`、`hopper-queue`／`hopper-direct`；本机许可与 macOS 图形会话 |
| **Frida** | 方法命中、选定入口与有界寄存器运行观察 | `trace`、`experiment`、`flow-capture --method`；匹配的宿主／手机服务 |
| **LLVM／Xcode** | 有界 ARM64 反汇编与直接调用跟随 | `native-disasm`、`native-queue`；`llvm-objdump` |
| **内置 Mach-O／Objective-C** | 安装包、加载命令、类、selector 和方法地址 | `ipa`、`objc`；Mac 包另用 `mac inspect`／`mac acquire` |
| **ipadecrypt／恢复流程** | 在已验证 iOS 路线上恢复加密分析副本 | `decrypt-package`、`analyze --decrypt`；按设备准备环境 |

原生调查与报告接入主要服务现有 **iOS 工作流**。macOS 当前以 App 包、AX 和界面证据为主，尚未接成等价的原生函数链。**不依赖 REA 运行**；IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、radare2 暂无直接适配器。

[安装条件、provider 选择与 Agent 任务](docs/reverse-engineering-tools.zh-CN.md) · [Hopper 直连](docs/rea-hopper-integration.zh-CN.md)

## 两项交付

1. **分析：**固定环境和 App 版本，观察选定界面与操作，审阅带证据来源和未知项的报告。普通 iOS 交付 UI 行为报告；越狱 iOS 可增加安装包、沙盒和运行时调查；Mac 使用 App 包、AX 与界面证据。
2. **复刻：**依据已知能力清单选定阶段目标；实现独立 iOS 或 macOS App，构建并安装 IPA 或 `.app`；在指定手机或虚拟 Mac 对照相同流程，逐图审阅并报告实际覆盖与差异。

简单 App 可以设较完整的阶段目标。复杂 App 应先选定有用的功能范围；只有明确已知能力的分母，百分比才有意义。选定流程通过不代表整 App 等价。详见[覆盖目标方法](docs/coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)。

Mac 负责编排和构建。OpenSSH 采集文件，iOS MCP 提供越狱环境下的界面观察与控制，iCTRL／XCTest 提供普通模式界面控制，也可用于增强流程，Frida 用于有界运行时取证。Ghidra 和 Hopper 是可选的本机代码分析工具，**不依赖 REA 运行**。详见[架构说明](docs/architecture.zh-CN.md)。

[示例工程](examples/README.md)分别位于 `examples/rebuild/`（iOS）和 `examples/macos/`（Mac）。新任务默认写入 `output/`，原有 `rebuild/<NEW_PROJECT>` 工作目录仍受支持。

[Stocks 源码示例](examples/macos/Stocks/)实现股票搜索、图表周期切换和本地自选列表。上图是独立构建后在宿主 Mac 上的实际窗口截图，数值为离线演示数据；不是 Apple 原版 Stocks，也不提供实时行情。源码目录附构建步骤，历史客体对照结果与剩余视觉／行为差异另见[验收账本](docs/macos-implementation-plan.md)。

## iOS 实测范围

以下结论只适用于指定手机和选定流程，不保证任意设备或 App 兼容。新增的[普通／增强模式验收账本](docs/ios-device-support-acceptance.md)记录越狱未激活 iOS 26 的普通模式交付、iOS 17 普通模式回归、RootHide 增强恢复和离线 FairPlay 实测。[当前状态](docs/current-status.zh-CN.md)记录 v0.1.2 的范围及剩余问题。

| 手机 | 越狱方式与已测范围 | 当前限制 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone XR · iOS 16.1.1 | Dopamine rootless；SSH、Frida、iOS MCP 与 iCTRL；Notes、Calculator、Translate 和 Clock 的选定分析／复刻路径 | 可选的开发者文件列表可能报 `ConnectionTerminatedError`；SSH 包／沙盒采集可用。 |
| iPhone 14 · iOS 17.3.1 | Relaxin/RootHide；原版 Calculator 采集、Frida 跟踪，以及经 iOS MCP 完成四条原版／独立 App 运算对照 | v0.1.2 修复 v0.1.1 的 iCTRL 会话故障，两轮各四条成对流程通过；重启及其他设备上的新清理逻辑仍待复验。 |
| iPhone 11 · iOS 26.0.1 | Relaxin/RootHide；Calculator、Clock 原版分析、签名独立 App 和选定运算／秒表成对检查 | iOS MCP 新启动后可能得到黑帧；已观察的故障经有界返回主屏／重启恢复。 |

尚未证明整 App 功能覆盖、无视觉差异、重新越狱后的长期稳定，或第二台实体 Mac 的全新配置。原始 IPA、完整案例截图、沙盒内容和凭据只保存在被 Git 忽略的本地目录（案例为 `cases/` 或任务 `output/`，凭据沿用原存储），不作为发布附件；文档中的少量 Calculator 示意画面经过单独筛选。

## 手动安装与首次采集

以下是给手动使用 CLI 的读者准备的入口。通过 Agent 使用时，它会执行这些步骤。第一次 USB 采集需要 Python 3.9+、已解锁并连接的 iPhone，以及手机上的“信任此电脑”；这个阶段无需 tweak、SSH、Frida 或 Xcode 签名。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp apps --udid <UDID> --all
```

在手机上打开目标 App，确认准确的 Bundle ID，再采集并校验：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp survey --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --ui-backend usb --out cases/first-survey
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-survey
```

阅读 `cases/first-survey/report.md`，每次重试使用新的输出目录。完整分析还需 OpenSSH、精确设备 SSH 路由、Copy APP iOS MCP tweak 和兼容的 Frida 服务；iCTRL 按需加入。普通模式 UI 采集及重建需要 Xcode、签名的 XCTest runner 和开发签名；从 `onboard --mode standard` 与[普通模式指南](docs/ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md)开始。增强重建使用已验证的签名或 TrollStore 路线。用 `onboard --stage analyze` 和 `doctor --udid <UDID>` 检查就绪情况，按[完整安装指南](docs/setup.zh-CN.md)及[分析到复刻工作流](docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)继续。

## 运行完整分析到复刻流程

在当前 Codex 或 Claude Code 会话中执行：普通手机用 `standard`，受支持的越狱增强采集用 `enhanced`，也可用 `auto` 根据探测结果选择：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --mode standard \
  --udid <UDID> --bundle <ORIGINAL_BUNDLE_ID> \
  --auto-discover --agent-provider current \
  --rebuilt-bundle <NEW_BUNDLE_ID>
```

新任务默认写入工作区的 `output/<Bundle ID>-<UTC 时间>-<唯一编号>/`：
`project/` 放独立源码，`evidence/` 放报告、截图及检查结果。
可用 `--output-dir output/my-job` 自定义任务目录，也保留原有的
`--project <源码目录> --out <案例目录>`。路径须位于所选工作区内
（可用 `--workspace <目录>`）；仓库根目录的 `output/` 已被 Git 忽略，现有示例和案例不移动。
续跑时固定命令打印的 `--output-dir`（或原有 `--out`、`--project`），
其余设置保持相同，再加 `--resume`；不会自动猜测最近一次任务。

命令会在流程发现、审阅后的 UI 行为报告和独立实现三个环节暂停，等待当前 Agent 完成并校验交付；每次用原参数加 `--resume` 续跑。`current` 不会启动嵌套 Agent。显式模式流程使用 `--agent-provider current`；未加模式的历史严格流程保留 `codex`／`claude` 独立 CLI 入口。若已有流程，可用 `--discovery <CASE>` 或重复的 `--script <FILE>` 替代 `--auto-discover`。命令与门槛见[工作流指南](docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)。

## 项目理念与贡献

把原始观察与解释分开。重要结论绑定设备、App 构建和可校验来源；保留失败尝试和未知项。原版与复刻版应从可比状态对照，只报告真正测过的行为。保留所用上游项目的署名和许可证。欢迎改进安装体验、有界分析、可重现真机检查、无障碍支持和翻译；见[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)。
