`copyapp/compare_playbooks.py`:

```py
"""Build an inspectable, same-device comparison of two UI playbook runs."""

import io
import json
import math
import shutil
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Tuple

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat

from copyapp.ocr_file import verify_ocr_source
from copyapp.playbook import _exact_labels
from copyapp.verify import checked_path, sha256_file, verify_case
from copyapp.gestures import GESTURE_ACTIONS, gesture_params
from copyapp.text_actions import TYPE_ACTION, type_params


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _load_run(root: Path, require_comparable: bool = True) -> Tuple[dict, dict]:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        if not verify_case(root):
            raise ValueError(f"playbook evidence failed SHA-256 verification: {root}")
    manifest = _read_json(root / "manifest.json")
    plan = _read_json(root / "playbook.json")
    if (manifest.get("schema_version") != 1 or plan.get("schema_version") != 1 or
            manifest.get("status") != "complete" or
            manifest.get("bundle_id") != plan.get("bundle_id") or
            not manifest.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") or
            not manifest.get("ui_backend") or
            (require_comparable and not plan.get("scenario_id")) or
            manifest.get("scenario_id") != plan.get("scenario_id")):
        raise ValueError(f"playbook run identity or completion is invalid: {root}")
    steps = manifest.get("steps")
    planned = plan.get("steps")
    if (not isinstance(steps, list) or not isinstance(planned, list) or
            len(steps) != len(planned) or not steps):
        raise ValueError(f"playbook steps are incomplete: {root}")
    for index, (observed, requested) in enumerate(zip(steps, planned), 1):
        expected_frontmost = (requested.get("bundle_id") if
                              requested.get("action") == "expect_foreground" else
                              manifest["bundle_id"])
        if (observed.get("index") != index or
                observed.get("action") != requested.get("action") or
                observed.get("frontmost") != expected_frontmost or
                (requested.get("action") == "expect_foreground" and
                 observed.get("expected_frontmost") != expected_frontmost)):
            raise ValueError(f"playbook step identity mismatch at {index}: {root}")
        if requested.get("action") in GESTURE_ACTIONS:
            screen = manifest.get("screen") or {}
            gesture = gesture_params(requested, screen.get("width"), screen.get("height"))
            if observed.get("gesture") != gesture or not isinstance(observed.get("result"), dict):
                raise ValueError(f"gesture evidence mismatch at {index}: {root}")
        if requested.get("action") == TYPE_ACTION:
            if (observed.get("typed_text") != type_params(requested) or
                    not isinstance(observed.get("result"), dict)):
                raise ValueError(f"text evidence mismatch at {index}: {root}")
        region = requested.get("region_points") if requested.get("action") == "tap_label" else None
        if region is not None:
            match = (observed.get("result") or {}).get("match")
            if (not isinstance(region, list) or len(region) != 4 or
                    any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                        for value in region) or
                    not isinstance(match, dict) or
                    type(match.get("x")) not in (int, float) or
                    type(match.get("y")) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isfinite(match["x"]) or not math.isfinite(match["y"]) or
                    not region[0] <= match["x"] <= region[2] or
                    not region[1] <= match["y"] <= region[3]):
                raise ValueError(f"bounded label tap does not match saved region at {index}: {root}")
        if observed["action"] == "observe" and observed.get("observation_source") == "screenshot_ocr":
            image_relative = observed.get("observation_image_path")
            ocr_relative = observed.get("observation_ocr_path")
            if not isinstance(image_relative, str) or not isinstance(ocr_relative, str):
                raise ValueError(f"observation OCR evidence is missing at {index}: {root}")
            image_path = checked_path(root, image_relative)
            ocr_path = checked_path(root, ocr_relative)
            listed = {entry.get("path") for entry in manifest.get("evidence", [])}
            if (sha256_file(image_path) != observed.get("observation_image_sha256") or
                    sha256_file(ocr_path) != observed.get("observation_ocr_sha256") or
                    not {image_relative, ocr_relative} <= listed):
                raise ValueError(f"observation OCR evidence mismatch at {index}: {root}")
            ocr_record = _read_json(ocr_path)
            if not verify_ocr_source(ocr_record, image_path):
                raise ValueError(f"observation OCR source mismatch at {index}: {root}")
            ocr_text = "\n".join(str(entry.get("text") or "") for entry in
                                 ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict))
            expected = requested.get("contains", [])
            if isinstance(expected, str):
                expected = [expected]
            if (not isinstance(expected, list) or
                    any(not isinstance(value, str) or value not in ocr_text for value in expected)):
                raise ValueError(f"observation OCR content mismatch at {index}: {root}")
        if observed["action"] == "observe" and requested.get("exact_labels"):
            labels = requested["exact_labels"]
            if isinstance(labels, str):
                labels = [labels]
            relative = observed.get("evidence_path")
            listed = {entry.get("path") for entry in manifest.get("evidence", [])}
            if (not isinstance(labels, list) or any(not isinstance(label, str) or not label
                    for label in labels) or not isinstance(relative, str) or relative not in listed or
                    observed.get("exact_label_source") != "accessibility" or
                    observed.get("missing_exact_labels") != []):
                raise ValueError(f"exact observation evidence is incomplete at {index}: {root}")
            observation = _read_json(checked_path(root, relative))
            if any(label not in _exact_labels(observation, manifest["ui_backend"])
                   for label in labels):
                raise ValueError(f"exact observation labels do not match evidence at {index}: {root}")
        if observed["action"] == "screenshot":
            stability = observed.get("stability")
            ready = requested.get("ready_contains")
            if (require_comparable and
                (requested.get("stable") is not True or
                 not isinstance(ready, str) or not ready)) or \
                    (requested.get("stable") is True and
                     (not isinstance(stability, dict) or stability.get("stable") is not True)) or \
                    (ready is not None and
                     (not isinstance(ready, str) or not ready or
                      observed.get("ready_contains") != ready or
                      observed.get("ready_found") is not True)):
                raise ValueError(f"screenshot readiness was not verified at {index}: {root}")
            relative = observed.get("evidence_path")
            if (not isinstance(relative, str) or
                    not relative.endswith(".jpg") or
                    sha256_file(checked_path(root, relative)) != observed.get("sha256")):
                raise ValueError(f"screenshot identity mismatch at {index}: {root}")
            if observed.get("ready_source") == "screenshot_ocr":
                ocr_relative = observed.get("ready_ocr_path")
                if not isinstance(ocr_relative, str):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot OCR evidence is missing at {index}: {root}")
                ocr_path = checked_path(root, ocr_relative)
                if (sha256_file(ocr_path) != observed.get("ready_ocr_sha256") or
                        ocr_relative not in {entry.get("path") for entry in manifest.get("evidence", [])}):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot OCR evidence mismatch at {index}: {root}")
                ocr_record = _read_json(ocr_path)
                if not verify_ocr_source(ocr_record, checked_path(root, relative)):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot OCR source mismatch at {index}: {root}")
                ocr_text = "\n".join(str(entry.get("text") or "") for entry in
                                     ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict))
                if ready not in ocr_text:
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot OCR content mismatch at {index}: {root}")
            image_labels = requested.get("ready_ocr_labels")
            if image_labels is not None:
                ocr_relative = observed.get("ready_ocr_labels_path")
                if (not isinstance(image_labels, list) or not image_labels or
                        any(not isinstance(label, str) or not label.strip()
                            for label in image_labels) or
                        observed.get("ready_ocr_labels") != image_labels or
                        observed.get("missing_ready_ocr_labels") != [] or
                        not isinstance(ocr_relative, str) or
                        ocr_relative not in {entry.get("path") for entry in manifest.get("evidence", [])}):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot visual labels evidence is incomplete at {index}: {root}")
                ocr_path = checked_path(root, ocr_relative)
                if sha256_file(ocr_path) != observed.get("ready_ocr_labels_sha256"):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot visual labels evidence mismatch at {index}: {root}")
                ocr_record = _read_json(ocr_path)
                if not verify_ocr_source(ocr_record, checked_path(root, relative)):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot visual labels source mismatch at {index}: {root}")
                painted = {str(entry.get("text") or "").strip() for entry in
                           ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict)}
                if any(label not in painted for label in image_labels):
                    raise ValueError(f"screenshot visual labels do not match image OCR at {index}: {root}")
    return manifest, plan


def _image_pair(first: Path, second: Path, output: Path, stem: str,
                artifacts: Dict[str, dict]) -> dict:
    with Image.open(first) as opened_first, Image.open(second) as opened_second:
        original = opened_first.convert("RGB")
        rebuilt = opened_second.convert("RGB")
    if (original.size != rebuilt.size or original.width * original.height > 5_000_000):
        raise ValueError(f"screenshots differ in size or exceed image limit: {stem}")
    side = Image.new("RGB", (original.width * 2, original.height))
    side.paste(original, (0, 0))
    side.paste(rebuilt, (original.width, 0))
    difference = ImageChops.difference(original, rebuilt)
    mean = sum(ImageStat.Stat(difference).mean) / 3 / 255
    comparison = output / "comparison"
    comparison.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths = {}
    for name, image in (("side_by_side", side), ("pixel_difference", difference)):
        path = comparison / f"{stem}-{name}.png"
        image.save(path)
        key = str(path.relative_to(output))
        artifacts[key] = {"path": key, "sha256": sha256_file(path)}
        paths[name] = key
    return {"width": original.width, "height": original.height,
            "mean_absolute_rgb": round(mean, 5), **paths}


def _pulse_check(check: dict, screenshots: Dict[int, Path]) -> dict:
    roi = check.get("roi")
    steps = check.get("steps")
    channel = check.get("channel")
    minimum = check.get("minimum_channel")
    ratio = check.get("dominance_ratio")
    rise = check.get("min_rise")
    return_delta = check.get("max_return_delta")
    if (check.get("kind") != "color_pulse" or
            not isinstance(check.get("id"), str) or not check["id"] or
            not isinstance(roi, list) or len(roi) != 4 or
            any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in roi) or
            roi[0] >= roi[2] or roi[1] >= roi[3] or
            not isinstance(steps, list) or len(steps) != 3 or
            any(type(value) is not int or value not in screenshots for value in steps) or
            steps != sorted(set(steps)) or channel not in ("red", "green", "blue") or
            type(minimum) is not int or not 0 <= minimum <= 255 or
            type(ratio) not in (int, float) or not 1 <= ratio <= 10 or
            type(rise) is not int or rise < 1 or
            type(return_delta) is not int or return_delta < 0):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid color pulse check: {check.get('id')}")
    selected = {"red": 0, "green": 1, "blue": 2}[channel]
    counts = []
    for step in steps:
        with Image.open(screenshots[step]) as opened:
            image = opened.convert("RGB")
        if roi[2] > image.width or roi[3] > image.height:
            raise ValueError(f"color pulse ROI exceeds screenshot at step {step}")
        pixels = image.crop(tuple(roi)).getdata()
        count = sum(1 for pixel in pixels if pixel[selected] >= minimum and
                    all(pixel[selected] >= pixel[other] * ratio
                        for other in range(3) if other != selected))
        counts.append(count)
    passed = (counts[1] - counts[0] >= rise and
              abs(counts[2] - counts[0]) <= return_delta)
    return {"id": check["id"], "steps": steps, "counts": counts,
            "min_rise": rise, "max_return_delta": return_delta, "passed": passed}


def _color_match_check(check: dict, originals: Dict[int, Path],
                       rebuilt: Dict[int, Path]) -> dict:
    roi = check.get("roi")
    steps = check.get("steps")
    channel = check.get("channel")
    minimum = check.get("minimum_channel")
    ratio = check.get("dominance_ratio")
    tolerance = check.get("max_count_delta")
    if (check.get("kind") != "color_match" or
            not isinstance(check.get("id"), str) or not check["id"] or
            not isinstance(roi, list) or len(roi) != 4 or
            any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in roi) or
            roi[0] >= roi[2] or roi[1] >= roi[3] or
            not isinstance(steps, list) or not 1 <= len(steps) <= 64 or
            any(type(value) is not int or value not in originals or value not in rebuilt
                for value in steps) or steps != sorted(set(steps)) or
            channel not in ("red", "green", "blue") or
            type(minimum) is not int or not 0 <= minimum <= 255 or
            type(ratio) not in (int, float) or not 1 <= ratio <= 10 or
            type(tolerance) is not int or tolerance < 0):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid color match check: {check.get('id')}")
    selected = {"red": 0, "green": 1, "blue": 2}[channel]
    counts = []
    for images in (originals, rebuilt):
        side_counts = []
        for step in steps:
            with Image.open(images[step]) as opened:
                image = opened.convert("RGB")
            if roi[2] > image.width or roi[3] > image.height:
                raise ValueError(f"color match ROI exceeds screenshot at step {step}")
            count = sum(1 for pixel in image.crop(tuple(roi)).getdata()
                        if pixel[selected] >= minimum and
                        all(pixel[selected] >= pixel[other] * ratio
                            for other in range(3) if other != selected))
            side_counts.append(count)
        counts.append(side_counts)
    passed = all(abs(first - second) <= tolerance
                 for first, second in zip(counts[0], counts[1]))
    return {"id": check["id"], "kind": "color_match", "steps": steps,
            "max_count_delta": tolerance,
            "original": {"counts": counts[0], "passed": passed},
            "rebuilt": {"counts": counts[1], "passed": passed}}


def compare_playbooks(original_root: Path, rebuilt_root: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    """Pair completed runs; retain images and observations without auto-grading fidelity."""
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"comparison output is not empty: {output}")
    original_root = original_root.resolve(strict=True)
    rebuilt_root = rebuilt_root.resolve(strict=True)
    original, original_plan = _load_run(original_root)
    rebuilt, rebuilt_plan = _load_run(rebuilt_root)
    if (original_root == rebuilt_root or
            original["bundle_id"] == rebuilt["bundle_id"] or
            original["device_id_sha256_prefix"] != rebuilt["device_id_sha256_prefix"] or
            original["ui_backend"] != rebuilt["ui_backend"] or
            original["scenario_id"] != rebuilt["scenario_id"] or
            original.get("screen") != rebuilt.get("screen")):
        raise ValueError("playbook runs must be different apps in the same scenario, device and backend")
    first_steps, second_steps = original_plan["steps"], rebuilt_plan["steps"]
    if ([step["action"] for step in first_steps] !=
            [step["action"] for step in second_steps]):
        raise ValueError("playbook action sequence differs")
    checks = original_plan.get("visual_checks", [])
    if (checks != rebuilt_plan.get("visual_checks", []) or
            not isinstance(checks, list)):
        raise ValueError("playbook visual checks differ")
    for index, (first, second) in enumerate(zip(first_steps, second_steps), 1):
        if first["action"] == "tap_label" and (
                first.get("label"), first.get("region_points")) != (
                second.get("label"), second.get("region_points")):
            raise ValueError(f"tap labels or regions differ at step {index}")
        if first["action"] == "tap" and (first.get("x"), first.get("y")) != (
                second.get("x"), second.get("y")):
            raise ValueError(f"tap coordinates differ at step {index}")
        if first["action"] in GESTURE_ACTIONS and (
                gesture_params(first) != gesture_params(second) or
                first.get("wait_ms", 0) != second.get("wait_ms", 0)):
            raise ValueError(f"gesture parameters differ at step {index}")
        if first["action"] == TYPE_ACTION and (
                type_params(first) != type_params(second) or
                first.get("wait_ms", 0) != second.get("wait_ms", 0)):
            raise ValueError(f"typed text differs at step {index}")
        if (first["action"] == "expect_foreground" and
                first.get("bundle_id") != second.get("bundle_id")):
            raise ValueError(f"expected handoff app differs at step {index}")
        if first["action"] == "observe" and (
                first.get("contains", []), first.get("exact_labels", [])) != (
                second.get("contains", []), second.get("exact_labels", [])):
            raise ValueError(f"observation conditions differ at step {index}")
        if (first["action"] == "screenshot" and
                first.get("ready_ocr_labels") != second.get("ready_ocr_labels")):
            raise ValueError(f"screenshot visual labels differ at step {index}")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    artifacts: Dict[str, dict] = {}
    for label, root, manifest in (("original", original_root, original),
                                  ("rebuilt", rebuilt_root, rebuilt)):
        target = output / label
        target.mkdir()
        for relative in {"manifest.json", "playbook.json"} | {
                item["path"] for item in manifest.get("evidence", [])}:
            source_path = checked_path(root, relative)
            if not source_path.is_file():
                raise FileNotFoundError(source_path)
            destination = target / relative
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(source_path, destination)
            key = str(destination.relative_to(output))
            artifacts[key] = {"path": key, "sha256": sha256_file(destination)}
    screenshot_pairs = []
    for first, second in zip(original["steps"], rebuilt["steps"]):
        if first["action"] != "screenshot":
            continue
        index = first["index"]
        first_path = output / "original" / first["evidence_path"]
        second_path = output / "rebuilt" / second["evidence_path"]
        visual = _image_pair(first_path, second_path, output,
                             f"step-{index:02d}", artifacts)
        screenshot_pairs.append({"step": index, "visual": visual})
    if not screenshot_pairs:
        raise ValueError("paired playbooks have no screenshots to compare")
    visual_results = []
    for check in checks:
        if not isinstance(check, dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid visual check")
        original_images = {step["index"]: output / "original" / step["evidence_path"]
                           for step in original["steps"] if step["action"] == "screenshot"}
        rebuilt_images = {step["index"]: output / "rebuilt" / step["evidence_path"]
                          for step in rebuilt["steps"] if step["action"] == "screenshot"}
        if check.get("kind") == "color_match":
            visual_results.append(_color_match_check(check, original_images, rebuilt_images))
        else:
            visual_results.append({"id": check.get("id"), "kind": "color_pulse",
                                   "original": _pulse_check(check, original_images),
                                   "rebuilt": _pulse_check(check, rebuilt_images)})
    checks_status = ("unreviewed" if not visual_results else
                     "passed" if all(item["original"]["passed"] and
                                     item["rebuilt"]["passed"] for item in visual_results)
                     else "failed")
    lines = [f"# UI 对照：{original['scenario_id']}", "",
             f"- 设备 ID 哈希前缀：`{original['device_id_sha256_prefix']}`",
             f"- 界面后端：`{original['ui_backend']}`",
             f"- 原版：`{original['bundle_id']}`",
             f"- 复刻版：`{rebuilt['bundle_id']}`",
             "- 两次脚本状态：均完成；动作类型顺序及坐标点击位置已核对。", "",
             "## 步骤结果", "",
             "| 步骤 | 动作 | 原版前台 | 复刻版前台 | 原版耗时 ms | 复刻版耗时 ms |",
             "| ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |"]
    for first, second in zip(original["steps"], rebuilt["steps"]):
        lines.append(f"| {first['index']} | {first['action']} | "
                     f"{first['frontmost']} | {second['frontmost']} | "
                     f"{first.get('duration_ms', '?')} | {second.get('duration_ms', '?')} |")
    lines += ["", "## 画面对照", ""]
    for pair in screenshot_pairs:
        visual = pair["visual"]
        lines += [f"### 步骤 {pair['step']}", "",
                  f"- [左右并排]({visual['side_by_side']}) · "
                  f"[像素差图]({visual['pixel_difference']})",
                  f"- 同尺寸 {visual['width']}×{visual['height']}；"
                  f"平均 RGB 绝对差（0–1）：{visual['mean_absolute_rgb']}", ""]
    if visual_results:
        lines += ["## 指定视觉状态检查", "",
                  "| 信号 | 原版指定步骤计数 | 复刻版指定步骤计数 | 结果 |",
                  "| --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
        for item in visual_results:
            passed = item["original"]["passed"] and item["rebuilt"]["passed"]
            lines.append(f"| {item['id']} | {item['original']['counts']} | "
                         f"{item['rebuilt']['counts']} | {'通过' if passed else '未通过'} |")
        lines += ["", "颜色检查仅比较指定区域的像素计数或脉冲变化；"
                  "仍需人工检查标记形状、动画和交互含义。", ""]
    lines += ["原版和复刻版的原始截图、观察结果与脚本见各自目录。"
              "动态方位、位置、状态栏和拍摄时间会影响像素差；该数值不代表功能通过。"
              "行为、状态与视觉差异仍需结合图片及设备输出审阅。", ""]
    report = output / "report.md"
    report.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    artifacts["report.md"] = {"path": "report.md", "sha256": sha256_file(report)}
    index = {"schema_version": 1, "scenario_id": original["scenario_id"],
             "original_bundle_id": original["bundle_id"],
             "rebuilt_bundle_id": rebuilt["bundle_id"],
             "device_id_sha256_prefix": original["device_id_sha256_prefix"],
             "ui_backend": original["ui_backend"], "screenshots": screenshot_pairs,
             "visual_checks": visual_results, "checks_status": checks_status,
             "artifacts": artifacts}
    (output / "report-index.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return report

```

`copyapp/copy_workflow.py`:

```py
"""One resumable, evidence-gated Analyze → Rebuild handoff."""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Awaitable, Optional

from copyapp.agent_run import run_agent_task
from copyapp.discover_check import accepted_playbooks
from copyapp.discovery_agent import run_discovery_agent
from copyapp.prepare_app import prepare_app
from copyapp.prepare_rebuild import prepare_rebuild
from copyapp.source_root import source_root
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _child(root: Path, name: str) -> Path:
    path = root / name
    if path.is_symlink() or path.resolve() != path:
        raise ValueError(f"workflow child is not a real local directory: {name}")
    return path


def _preparation_ready(root: Path, source: dict) -> bool:
    preparation = _child(root, "preparation")
    try:
        prep = _read(preparation / "manifest.json")
        return (prep.get("status") == "needs_semantic_review" and
                prep.get("bundle_id") == source["bundle_id"] and
                prep.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") == source["device_id_sha256_prefix"] and
                prep.get("scripts") == source["scripts"] and
                prep.get("rebuilt_bundle_id") == source["rebuilt_bundle_id"] and
                prep.get("provider") == source["analysis_provider"] and
                prep.get("ui_backend") == source["ui_backend"] and
                prep.get("investigation_backend") == source["backend"] and
                prep.get("decrypt") == source["decrypt"] and
                prep.get("decrypt_helper") == source["decrypt_helper"] and
                prep.get("ssh_port") == source["ssh_port"] and
                prep.get("ssh_user") == source["ssh_user"] and
                prep.get("ssh_identity") == source["ssh_identity"] and
                prep.get("ssh_known_hosts") == source["ssh_known_hosts"] and
                prep.get("ghidra_dir") == source["ghidra_dir"] and
                prep.get("java_home") == source["java_home"] and
                prep.get("hopper_app") == source.get("hopper_app") and
                prep.get("disabled_analyzer") == source["disabled_analyzer"] and
                prep.get("timeout") == source["analysis_timeout"] and
                bool(prep.get("network_requested")) == source["network"] and
                verify_case(preparation))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _handoff_ready(root: Path, source: dict, report: Path) -> bool:
    rebuilt = _child(root, "rebuild-preparation")
    try:
        handoff = _read(rebuilt / "manifest.json")
        selected = source["flow_ids"]
        if selected is None:
            selected = [flow["id"] for flow in _read(report / "feature-spec.json")["flows"]]
        return (handoff.get("status") in ("ready_for_agent", "selected_flows_ready") and
                handoff.get("report") == str(report) and
                handoff.get("device_udid") == source["device_udid"] and
                handoff.get("project_dir") == source["project_dir"] and
                handoff.get("ui_backend") == source["backend"] and
                handoff.get("selected_flow_ids") == selected and
                verify_case(rebuilt))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _analysis_ready(root: Path, task: Path, provider: str) -> bool:
    run = _child(root, "analysis-agent")
    try:
        if provider == "current":
            report = _child(run, "reviewed-report")
            delivery = _child(run, "analysis-delivery")
            delivered = _read(delivery / "delivery.json")
            return (delivered.get("status") == "source_linked_report_ready_for_review" and
                    delivered.get("task_case") == str(task) and
                    delivered.get("report_case") == str(report) and
                    delivered.get("agent_run") is None and
                    verify_case(report) and verify_case(delivery))
        verification = _read(run / "analysis-verification.json")
        record = _read(run / "run.json")
        delivery = _child(run, "analysis-delivery")
        report = _child(run, "reviewed-report")
        return (verification.get("status") == "source_linked_report_ready_for_review" and
                record.get("task_case") == str(task) and
                record.get("provider") == provider and
                record.get("status") == "agent_exited_unverified" and
                verification.get("report_case") == str(report) and
                verification.get("analysis_delivery_case") == str(delivery) and
                verification.get("analysis_delivery_manifest_sha256") ==
                sha256_file(delivery / "manifest.json") and
                verify_case(run) and verify_case(report) and verify_case(delivery))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _rebuild_ready(root: Path, task: Path, provider: str) -> bool:
    run = _child(root, "rebuild-agent")
    try:
        if provider == "current":
            delivery = _child(run, "agent-delivery")
            delivered = _read(delivery / "delivery.json")
            selected = _read(task / "task.json")["flows"]
            results = delivered.get("flow_results")
            return (delivered.get("task_case") == str(task) and
                    delivered.get("agent_run_case") is None and
                    delivered.get("visual_review_case") is not None and
                    delivered.get("asserted_flow_count") == len(selected) and
                    delivered.get("visual_unreviewed_flow_count") == 0 and
                    delivered.get("visual_major_difference_flow_count") == 0 and
                    isinstance(results, list) and len(results) == len(selected) and
                    all(isinstance(item, dict) and
                        (item.get("script_assertions_status") == "passed" or
                         item.get("final_view_status") == "passed")
                        for item in results) and verify_case(delivery))
        verification = _read(run / "rebuild-verification.json")
        record = _read(run / "run.json")
        delivery = _child(run, "agent-delivery")
        delivered = _read(delivery / "delivery.json")
        selected = _read(task / "task.json")["flows"]
        results = delivered.get("flow_results")
        behavior_passed = (isinstance(results, list) and
                           len(results) == len(selected) and
                           all(isinstance(item, dict) and
                               (item.get("script_assertions_status") == "passed" or
                                item.get("final_view_status") == "passed")
                               for item in results))
        return (verification.get("status") == "selected_flows_verified" and
                record.get("task_case") == str(task) and
                record.get("provider") == provider and
                record.get("status") == "agent_exited_unverified" and
                verification.get("agent_delivery_case") == str(delivery) and
                verification.get("agent_delivery_manifest_sha256") ==
                sha256_file(delivery / "manifest.json") and
                verification.get("selected_flow_count") == len(selected) and
                verification.get("asserted_flow_count") == len(selected) and
                delivered.get("asserted_flow_count") == len(selected) and
                behavior_passed and
                delivered.get("visual_unreviewed_flow_count") == 0 and
                delivered.get("visual_major_difference_flow_count") == 0 and
                verify_case(run) and verify_case(delivery))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _save(root: Path, record: dict) -> Path:
    paths = ("discovery-agent/TASK.md", "discovery-agent/manifest.json",
             "discovery-agent/discovery/manifest.json",
             "preparation/manifest.json", "analysis-agent/manifest.json",
             "analysis-agent/TASK.md", "rebuild-agent/TASK.md",
             "analysis-agent/analysis-verification.json",
             "analysis-agent/reviewed-report/report-index.json",
             "analysis-agent/analysis-delivery/manifest.json",
             "rebuild-preparation/manifest.json", "rebuild-agent/manifest.json",
             "rebuild-agent/rebuild-verification.json",
             "rebuild-agent/agent-delivery/manifest.json")
    record["evidence"] = [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(root / name)}
                          for name in paths if (root / name).is_file()]
    record["updated_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    path = root / "manifest.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def validate_copy_workflow(root: Path, record: dict) -> bool:
    """Recheck every source link before accepting a completed workflow."""
    try:
        if (record.get("schema_version") != 1 or
                record.get("kind") != "copy_workflow" or
                record.get("status") != "complete" or
                not isinstance(record.get("scripts"), list) or
                not 1 <= len(record["scripts"]) <= 12):
            return False
        if record.get("auto_discover"):
            agent = _child(root, "discovery-agent")
            if record.get("agent_provider") == "current":
                if (record.get("discovery_agent_manifest_sha256") is not None or
                        record.get("discovery_case") != str(agent / "discovery") or
                        not (agent / "TASK.md").is_file()):
                    return False
            else:
                agent_record = _read(agent / "manifest.json")
                if (record.get("discovery_agent_manifest_sha256") !=
                        sha256_file(agent / "manifest.json") or
                        agent_record.get("status") != "complete" or
                        agent_record.get("device_udid") != record["device_udid"] or
                        agent_record.get("bundle_id") != record["bundle_id"] or
                        agent_record.get("backend") != record["backend"] or
                        agent_record.get("provider") != record["agent_provider"] or
                        agent_record.get("scripts") != record["scripts"] or
                        not verify_case(agent)):
                    return False
                if record.get("discovery_case") != str(agent / "discovery"):
                    return False
        if record.get("discovery_case") is not None:
            discovery = Path(record["discovery_case"]).resolve(strict=True)
            if (sha256_file(discovery / "manifest.json") !=
                    record.get("discovery_manifest_sha256") or
                    [str(path) for path in accepted_playbooks(
                        discovery, record["device_udid"], record["bundle_id"],
                        record["backend"])] !=
                    [item["path"] for item in record["scripts"]]):
                return False
        preparation = _child(root, "preparation")
        scripts = record["scripts"]
        if (not _preparation_ready(root, record) or
                any(sha256_file(Path(item["path"])) != item["sha256"]
                    for item in scripts)):
            return False
        analysis_task = preparation / "preparation" / "draft"
        if not _analysis_ready(root, analysis_task, record["agent_provider"]):
            return False
        report = _child(root / "analysis-agent", "reviewed-report")
        spec = _read(report / "feature-spec.json")
        if (spec.get("target_bundle_id") != record["bundle_id"] or
                spec.get("rebuilt_bundle_id") != record["rebuilt_bundle_id"]):
            return False
        rebuilt = _child(root, "rebuild-preparation")
        if not _handoff_ready(root, record, report):
            return False
        return _rebuild_ready(root, rebuilt / "task", record["agent_provider"])
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


async def copy_app(udid: str, bundle: str, scripts: list[Path], project: Path,
                   rebuilt_bundle: str, output: Path,
                   survey: Callable[..., Awaitable[int]], *,
                   workspace: Optional[Path] = None, backend: str = "ios-mcp",
                   ui_backend: str = "ios-mcp", analysis_provider: str = "none",
                   agent_provider: str = "codex", decrypt: bool = True,
                   network: bool = True, flow_ids: Optional[list[str]] = None,
                   decrypt_helper: Path = Path("../toolchains/ipadecrypt-helper-arm64"),
                   ssh_port: int = 22222, ssh_user: str = "mobile",
                   ssh_identity: Path = Path("cases/ssh/id_ed25519"),
                   ssh_known_hosts: Path = Path("cases/ssh-known-hosts"),
                   ghidra_dir: Optional[Path] = None, java_home: Optional[Path] = None,
                   disabled_analyzer: Optional[str] = None,
                   analysis_timeout: int = 240, agent_timeout: int = 7200,
                   agent_executable: Optional[Path] = None,
                   discovery_case: Optional[Path] = None,
                   auto_discover: bool = False,
                   resume: bool = False,
                   hopper_app: Optional[Path] = None) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    """Run both stages without accepting a CLI exit as proof of a deliverable.

    Failed Agent runs are not automatically repeated: they may have changed App or
    device state. Start a new workflow case after inspecting their saved output.
    """
    workspace = (workspace or source_root()).resolve(strict=True)
    output = output.resolve()
    project = project.resolve()
    if (not workspace.is_dir() or not output.is_relative_to(workspace) or
            not project.is_relative_to(workspace) or
            project == output or project in output.parents or output in project.parents):
        raise ValueError("workflow output and independent project must be separate workspace paths")
    if (not udid or not bundle or not rebuilt_bundle or bundle == rebuilt_bundle or
            agent_provider not in ("codex", "claude", "current") or
            analysis_provider not in ("none", "ghidra-direct", "hopper-direct") or
            backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl") or
            ui_backend not in ("usb", "ios-mcp") or
            (not 1 <= len(scripts) <= 12 and not (auto_discover and not scripts)) or
            (auto_discover and (scripts or discovery_case is not None))):
        raise ValueError("invalid workflow target, provider or playbook selection")
    if agent_executable is not None:
        agent_executable = agent_executable.resolve(strict=True)
    elif agent_provider != "current" and not shutil.which(agent_provider):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{agent_provider} CLI is not installed")
    if agent_provider == "current" and agent_executable is not None:
        raise ValueError("current-agent mode does not launch an executable")
    if auto_discover:
        agent_root = _child(output, "discovery-agent")
        if not resume and output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
            raise FileExistsError(f"workflow output is not empty: {output}")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if agent_provider == "current":
            agent_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            brief = agent_root / "TASK.md"
            if not brief.exists():
                brief.write_text(
                    "# Current-agent discovery handoff\n\n"
                    f"On device `{udid}`, observe `{bundle}` through `{backend}`. "
                    "Author 3–12 distinct, bounded representative UI playbooks "
                    "under this case's `discovery-agent/candidates/` directory. "
                    "Each must start by observing the actual screen and end with "
                    "a stable, ready screenshot. Validate and replay them with:\n\n"
                    f"`copyapp discover-check --udid {udid} --bundle {bundle} "
                    f"--backend {backend} --script <FLOW> ... "
                    f"--out {agent_root / 'discovery'}`\n\n"
                    "For a failed or interrupted replay, preserve its case "
                    "under `discovery-agent/attempts/`, inspect the device "
                    "state, then use the exact output path above for a new "
                    "attempt. Run "
                    "`copyapp verify` on it, then resume the original "
                    "`copyapp copy` command with `--resume`. Do not start "
                    "another coding-agent process.\n", encoding="utf-8")
            discovery_case = _child(agent_root, "discovery")
            if not (discovery_case / "manifest.json").is_file():
                return brief, False
            scripts = accepted_playbooks(discovery_case, udid, bundle, backend)
        else:
            agent_manifest, ready = run_discovery_agent(
                udid, bundle, backend, agent_root, workspace=workspace,
                provider=agent_provider, timeout_seconds=agent_timeout,
                executable=agent_executable, resume=(agent_root / "manifest.json").is_file())
            if not ready:
                return agent_manifest, False
            discovery_case = agent_root / "discovery"
            scripts = accepted_playbooks(discovery_case, udid, bundle, backend)
    if discovery_case is not None:
        discovery_case = discovery_case.resolve(strict=True)
        nested_discovery = (auto_discover and
                            discovery_case == output / "discovery-agent/discovery")
        if (not discovery_case.is_relative_to(workspace) or
                (not nested_discovery and
                 (output == discovery_case or output in discovery_case.parents or
                  discovery_case in output.parents)) or
                [path.resolve(strict=True) for path in scripts] !=
                accepted_playbooks(discovery_case, udid, bundle, backend)):
            raise ValueError("workflow scripts differ from the verified discovery case")
    script_records = [{"path": str(path.resolve(strict=True)),
                       "sha256": sha256_file(path.resolve(strict=True))}
                      for path in scripts]
    if len({item["sha256"] for item in script_records}) != len(script_records):
        raise ValueError("duplicate playbooks")
    source = {
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "copy_workflow", "bundle_id": bundle,
        "rebuilt_bundle_id": rebuilt_bundle, "device_udid": udid,
        "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
        "scripts": script_records, "project_dir": str(project),
        "workspace": str(workspace), "backend": backend, "ui_backend": ui_backend,
        "analysis_provider": analysis_provider, "agent_provider": agent_provider,
        "decrypt": decrypt, "network": network, "flow_ids": flow_ids,
        "decrypt_helper": str(decrypt_helper.resolve()),
        "ssh_port": ssh_port, "ssh_user": ssh_user,
        "ssh_identity": str(ssh_identity.resolve()),
        "ssh_known_hosts": str(ssh_known_hosts.resolve()),
        "ghidra_dir": str(ghidra_dir.resolve()) if ghidra_dir else None,
        "java_home": str(java_home.resolve()) if java_home else None,
        "hopper_app": str(hopper_app.resolve()) if hopper_app else None,
        "disabled_analyzer": disabled_analyzer,
        "analysis_timeout": analysis_timeout, "agent_timeout": agent_timeout,
        "agent_executable": str(agent_executable.resolve()) if agent_executable else None,
        "auto_discover": auto_discover,
        "discovery_agent_manifest_sha256": (
            sha256_file(output / "discovery-agent/manifest.json")
            if auto_discover and agent_provider != "current" else None),
        "discovery_case": str(discovery_case) if discovery_case else None,
        "discovery_manifest_sha256":
        sha256_file(discovery_case / "manifest.json") if discovery_case else None,
    }
    manifest = output / "manifest.json"
    if resume and manifest.is_file():
        record = _read(manifest)
        if any(record.get(key) != value for key, value in source.items()):
            raise ValueError("resume target, playbooks or settings differ")
        if record.get("status") == "complete":
            return manifest, validate_copy_workflow(output, record) and verify_case(output)
    else:
        if resume and not auto_discover:
            raise ValueError("resume requires an existing Copy APP workflow")
        if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()) and not (
                auto_discover and {item.name for item in output.iterdir()} == {"discovery-agent"}):
            raise FileExistsError(f"workflow output is not empty: {output}")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = dict(source, status="preparing")
        _save(output, record)
    preparation = _child(output, "preparation")
    analysis_run = _child(output, "analysis-agent")
    rebuild = _child(output, "rebuild-preparation")
    rebuild_run = _child(output, "rebuild-agent")
    try:
        if not _preparation_ready(output, record):
            path, ready = await prepare_app(
                udid, bundle, scripts, preparation, survey,
                ui_backend=ui_backend, backend=backend, decrypt=decrypt,
                decrypt_helper=decrypt_helper, ssh_port=ssh_port, ssh_user=ssh_user,
                ssh_identity=ssh_identity, ssh_known_hosts=ssh_known_hosts,
                provider=analysis_provider, ghidra_dir=ghidra_dir, java_home=java_home,
                hopper_app=hopper_app,
                disabled_analyzer=disabled_analyzer, network=network,
                timeout=analysis_timeout, rebuilt_bundle_id=rebuilt_bundle,
                resume=(preparation / "manifest.json").is_file())
            if not ready or not _preparation_ready(output, record):
                record["status"] = "preparation_incomplete"
                return _save(output, record), False
        task = preparation / "preparation" / "draft"
        if not _analysis_ready(output, task, agent_provider):
            if agent_provider == "current":
                analysis_run.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                brief = analysis_run / "TASK.md"
                if not brief.exists():
                    brief.write_text(
                        "# Current-agent analysis handoff\n\n"
                        f"Review [{task / 'TASK.md'}]({task / 'TASK.md'}) and its evidence. "
                        f"Save a formal report at `{analysis_run / 'reviewed-report'}`, "
                        "then run `copyapp analysis-delivery` with this draft task and "
                        f"that report into `{analysis_run / 'analysis-delivery'}`. "
                        "Resume the same `copyapp copy` case after both verify.\n",
                        encoding="utf-8")
                record["status"] = "analysis_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
            if analysis_run.exists() and any(analysis_run.iterdir()):
                record["status"] = "analysis_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
            _, ready = run_agent_task(task, analysis_run, agent_provider,
                                      workspace, agent_timeout, agent_executable,
                                      verify_analysis=True)
            if not ready or not _analysis_ready(output, task, agent_provider):
                record["status"] = "analysis_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
        report = analysis_run / "reviewed-report"
        spec = _read(report / "feature-spec.json")
        if (spec.get("target_bundle_id") != bundle or
                spec.get("rebuilt_bundle_id") != rebuilt_bundle):
            raise ValueError("reviewed report target or rebuilt bundle differs")
        if not _handoff_ready(output, record, report):
            _, ready = prepare_rebuild(report, rebuild, backend, flow_ids, udid,
                                       project, resume=(rebuild / "manifest.json").is_file())
            if not ready or not _handoff_ready(output, record, report):
                record["status"] = "rebuild_task_needs_evidence"
                return _save(output, record), False
        implementation_task = rebuild / "task"
        if not _rebuild_ready(output, implementation_task, agent_provider):
            if agent_provider == "current":
                rebuild_run.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                brief = rebuild_run / "TASK.md"
                if not brief.exists():
                    brief.write_text(
                        "# Current-agent rebuild handoff\n\n"
                        f"Implement [{implementation_task / 'TASK.md'}]"
                        f"({implementation_task / 'TASK.md'}) in `{project}`. "
                        "Install and compare the selected flows on the pinned device. "
                        f"Save installation at `{rebuild_run / 'install'}`, "
                        f"comparison at `{rebuild_run / 'rebuild-check'}`, "
                        f"visual review at `{rebuild_run / 'visual-review'}`, and "
                        f"`copyapp agent-delivery` at `{rebuild_run / 'agent-delivery'}` "
                        "without `--run`. Resume the same `copyapp copy` case after "
                        "all evidence verifies.\n", encoding="utf-8")
                record["status"] = "rebuild_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
            if rebuild_run.exists() and any(rebuild_run.iterdir()):
                record["status"] = "rebuild_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
            _, ready = run_agent_task(implementation_task, rebuild_run,
                                      agent_provider, workspace, agent_timeout,
                                      agent_executable, verify_rebuild=True)
            if not ready or not _rebuild_ready(output, implementation_task,
                                               agent_provider):
                record["status"] = "rebuild_agent_needs_review"
                return _save(output, record), False
        record["status"] = "complete"
        path = _save(output, record)
        if not validate_copy_workflow(output, record) or not verify_case(output):
            raise ValueError("completed workflow failed source verification")
        return path, True
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        record["status"] = "failed"
        record["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:500]}
        return _save(output, record), False

```

`copyapp/coverage.py`:

```py
"""Versioned, source-linked capability targets and reviewed rebuild coverage."""

import io
import json
import re
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


CAPABILITY_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,80}\Z")
SCOPES = {"selected", "deferred", "blocked"}
RESULTS = {"verified", "partial", "failed", "untested"}


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _verified(path: Path) -> None:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        if not verify_case(path):
            raise ValueError(f"source case failed verification: {path}")


def _percent(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> float:
    return round(100 * numerator / denominator, 1)


def _text(value: object, label: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be nonempty text")
    return value.strip()


def _cell(value: object) -> str:
    return " ".join(str(value).split()).replace("|", "\\|")


def _inventory(inventory: dict, report_spec: dict, selected_flows: set[str]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if (inventory.get("schema_version") != 1 or
            inventory.get("target_bundle_id") != report_spec.get("target_bundle_id") or
            inventory.get("rebuilt_bundle_id") != report_spec.get("rebuilt_bundle_id")):
        raise ValueError("inventory schema or App identity differs from the report")
    _text(inventory.get("rationale"), "target rationale")
    unknowns = inventory.get("unknowns")
    if not isinstance(unknowns, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip()
                                             for x in unknowns):
        raise ValueError("unknowns must be a list of nonempty descriptions")
    capabilities = inventory.get("capabilities")
    if not isinstance(capabilities, list) or not 1 <= len(capabilities) <= 200:
        raise ValueError("inventory needs 1–200 capabilities")
    report_flows = {item["id"] for item in report_spec["flows"]}
    identifiers = set()
    owned_flows = set()
    total = selected_weight = 0
    for item in capabilities:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("capability must be an object")
        identifier = item.get("id")
        if (not isinstance(identifier, str) or
                not CAPABILITY_ID.fullmatch(identifier) or identifier in identifiers):
            raise ValueError("capability IDs must be unique and stable")
        identifiers.add(identifier)
        _text(item.get("name"), f"{identifier} name")
        _text(item.get("acceptance"), f"{identifier} acceptance")
        _text(item.get("basis"), f"{identifier} evidence basis")
        weight = item.get("weight")
        if type(weight) is not int or not 1 <= weight <= 5:
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier} weight must be an integer from 1 to 5")
        scope = item.get("scope")
        if scope not in SCOPES:
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier} has invalid scope")
        flows = item.get("flow_ids")
        if (not isinstance(flows, list) or
                any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in flows) or
                len(set(flows)) != len(flows) or
                any(x not in report_flows or x in owned_flows for x in flows)):
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier} has missing, duplicate or shared report flows")
        owned_flows.update(flows)
        if scope == "selected":
            if not flows or not set(flows) <= selected_flows:
                raise ValueError(f"{identifier} selected flows are absent from rebuild plans")
            selected_weight += weight
        elif set(flows) & selected_flows:
            raise ValueError(f"{identifier} is deferred but its flow is selected")
        if scope != "selected":
            _text(item.get("reason"), f"{identifier} defer/block reason")
        total += weight
    if not selected_weight or owned_flows & selected_flows != selected_flows:
        raise ValueError("every selected rebuild flow needs exactly one selected capability")
    return total, selected_weight


def _source_plans(report: Path, plans: list[Path]) -> tuple[list[dict], set[str]]:
    if not plans or len(set(plans)) != len(plans):
        raise ValueError("provide distinct rebuild plan cases")
    report_index_hash = sha256_file(report / "report-index.json")
    selected = set()
    sources = []
    for plan in plans:
        _verified(plan)
        data = _read(plan / "rebuild-plan.json")
        spec_hash = sha256_file(report / "feature-spec.json")
        if (data.get("kind") != "rebuild_plan" or data.get("status") != "complete" or
                data.get("source_report_index_sha256") != report_index_hash or
                data.get("feature_spec_sha256") != spec_hash or
                not isinstance(data.get("flows"), list)):
            raise ValueError(f"rebuild plan is not linked to the reviewed report: {plan}")
        flow_ids = [item.get("flow_id") for item in data["flows"]]
        if (not flow_ids or any(not isinstance(x, str) for x in flow_ids) or
                len(flow_ids) != len(set(flow_ids)) or
                selected.intersection(flow_ids)):
            raise ValueError("rebuild plans contain duplicate selected flows")
        selected.update(flow_ids)
        sources.append({"case": str(plan),
                        "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(plan / "manifest.json"),
                        "rebuild_plan_sha256": sha256_file(plan / "rebuild-plan.json"),
                        "flow_ids": flow_ids})
    return sources, selected


def _plan_inputs(report: Path, plans: list[Path], inventory: dict,
                 previous: Optional[Path]) -> dict:
    _verified(report)
    spec = _read(report / "feature-spec.json")
    sources, selected = _source_plans(report, plans)
    total, target = _inventory(inventory, spec, selected)
    previous_source = None
    revision = 1
    if previous is not None:
        _verified(previous)
        old = _read(previous / "coverage-plan.json")
        if (old.get("kind") != "coverage_plan" or
                old.get("source_report") != str(report) or
                old.get("source_report_index_sha256") !=
                sha256_file(report / "report-index.json")):
            raise ValueError("previous target belongs to a different report")
        _text(inventory.get("revision_reason"), "revision reason")
        earlier = _read(previous / "inventory.json")
        current_by_id = {item["id"]: item for item in inventory["capabilities"]}
        for item in earlier["capabilities"]:
            current = current_by_id.get(item["id"])
            if (current is None or
                    any(current[key] != item[key]
                        for key in ("name", "acceptance", "basis", "weight")) or
                    not set(item["flow_ids"]) <= set(current["flow_ids"])):
                raise ValueError("revision cannot remove or weaken a known capability")
        revision = old["revision"] + 1
        previous_source = {"case": str(previous),
                           "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(previous / "manifest.json")}
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "coverage_plan", "revision": revision,
            "source_report": str(report),
            "source_report_index_sha256": sha256_file(report / "report-index.json"),
            "feature_spec_sha256": sha256_file(report / "feature-spec.json"),
            "rebuild_plans": sources, "previous": previous_source,
            "known_weight": total, "selected_weight": target,
            "target_percent": _percent(target, total)}


def create_coverage_plan(report: Path, plans: list[Path], inventory_path: Path,
                         output: Path, previous: Optional[Path] = None) -> Path:
    """Freeze one target; a later revision keeps the old verified case intact."""
    report = report.resolve(strict=True)
    plans = [path.resolve(strict=True) for path in plans]
    inventory_path = inventory_path.resolve(strict=True)
    previous = previous.resolve(strict=True) if previous else None
    output = output.resolve()
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"coverage plan output is not empty: {output}")
    inventory = _read(inventory_path)
    record = _plan_inputs(report, plans, inventory, previous)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _write(output / "inventory.json", inventory)
    record["inventory_sha256"] = sha256_file(output / "inventory.json")
    record["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    _write(output / "coverage-plan.json", record)
    lines = ["# Rebuild coverage target", "",
             f"- Revision: {record['revision']}; target: {record['target_percent']}% "
             f"of the known-capability weight ({record['selected_weight']}/{record['known_weight']}).",
             f"- Rationale: {inventory['rationale']}",
             "- This denominator is a reviewed known-capability inventory, not a claim that every App feature is known.",
             "", "| Capability | Weight | Scope | Report flows | Reason |",
             "| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |"]
    if previous is not None:
        old = _read(previous / "coverage-plan.json")
        lines[5:5] = [f"- Previous target: {old['target_percent']}% (revision {old['revision']}).",
                       f"- Revision reason: {inventory['revision_reason']}"]
    for item in inventory["capabilities"]:
        lines.append(f"| `{item['id']}` {_cell(item['name'])} | {item['weight']} | "
                     f"{item['scope']} | {', '.join(item['flow_ids']) or '—'} | "
                     f"{_cell(item.get('reason', '—'))} |")
    lines += ["", "Unknown areas: " + ("; ".join(inventory["unknowns"]) or "none declared"),
              "", "The percentage is a target. Use `copyapp coverage-delivery` with verified "
              "device deliveries and explicit per-capability review for achieved coverage.", ""]
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _write(output / "manifest.json", {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "coverage_plan",
        "status": "complete", "evidence": [
            {"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
            for name in ("inventory.json", "coverage-plan.json", "report.md")]})
    return output / "report.md"


def validate_coverage_plan(root: Path) -> bool:
    try:
        record = _read(root / "coverage-plan.json")
        inventory = _read(root / "inventory.json")
        report = Path(record["source_report"]).resolve(strict=True)
        plans = [Path(item["case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                 for item in record["rebuild_plans"]]
        previous = (Path(record["previous"]["case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                    if record.get("previous") else None)
        if root.resolve() in [report, *plans, previous]:
            return False
        expected = _plan_inputs(report, plans, inventory, previous)
        return (all(record.get(key) == value for key, value in expected.items()) and
                record.get("inventory_sha256") == sha256_file(root / "inventory.json"))
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _delivery_inputs(plan: Path, deliveries: list[Path], review: dict) -> dict:
    _verified(plan)
    target = _read(plan / "coverage-plan.json")
    inventory = _read(plan / "inventory.json")
    if not deliveries or len(set(deliveries)) != len(deliveries):
        raise ValueError("provide distinct agent delivery cases")
    plan_hashes = {item["rebuild_plan_sha256"] for item in target["rebuild_plans"]}
    selected_ids = {flow for item in target["rebuild_plans"] for flow in item["flow_ids"]}
    observations = {}
    sources = []
    for delivery in deliveries:
        _verified(delivery)
        data = _read(delivery / "delivery.json")
        task = _read(Path(data["task_case"]) / "task.json")
        if (data.get("kind") != "agent_delivery" or
                data.get("target_bundle_id") != inventory["target_bundle_id"] or
                data.get("rebuilt_bundle_id") != inventory["rebuilt_bundle_id"] or
                task.get("report_index_sha256") != target["source_report_index_sha256"] or
                task.get("rebuild_plan_sha256") not in plan_hashes):
            raise ValueError(f"delivery is not linked to the coverage target: {delivery}")
        for flow in data["flow_results"]:
            identifier = flow["id"]
            if identifier not in selected_ids or identifier in observations:
                raise ValueError("delivery has unknown or duplicate target flows")
            observations[identifier] = {
                "delivery": str(delivery),
                "behavior_passed": (flow.get("script_assertions_status") == "passed" or
                                    flow.get("final_view_status") == "passed"),
                "visual_review": flow.get("visual_review_status", "unreviewed")}
        sources.append({"case": str(delivery),
                        "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(delivery / "manifest.json")})
    if (review.get("schema_version") != 1 or
            not isinstance(review.get("capabilities"), list)):
        raise ValueError("coverage review has invalid schema")
    decisions = {}
    for decision in review["capabilities"]:
        if not isinstance(decision, dict):
            raise ValueError("coverage decision must be an object")
        identifier = decision.get("id")
        if identifier in decisions or decision.get("result") not in RESULTS:
            raise ValueError("coverage review has duplicate IDs or invalid result")
        _text(decision.get("notes"), f"{identifier} review notes")
        decisions[identifier] = decision
    if set(decisions) != {item["id"] for item in inventory["capabilities"]}:
        raise ValueError("review must address every inventoried capability")
    verified_weight = 0
    rows = []
    for item in inventory["capabilities"]:
        result = decisions[item["id"]]["result"]
        flows = item["flow_ids"]
        if item["scope"] != "selected" and result != "untested":
            raise ValueError("deferred or blocked capability cannot be counted as verified")
        checks = [observations.get(flow) for flow in flows]
        machine_ready = bool(checks) and all(
            check is not None and check["behavior_passed"] and
            check["visual_review"] in ("match", "minor_difference")
            for check in checks)
        if result == "verified" and not machine_ready:
            raise ValueError(f"{item['id']} has no complete behavior and visual evidence")
        if result == "verified":
            verified_weight += item["weight"]
        rows.append({"id": item["id"], "scope": item["scope"],
                     "weight": item["weight"], "result": result,
                     "flow_ids": flows, "flow_gate_passed": machine_ready,
                     "notes": decisions[item["id"]]["notes"]})
    selected_weight = target["selected_weight"]
    known_weight = target["known_weight"]
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "coverage_delivery",
            "status": "target_met" if verified_weight == selected_weight else "target_not_met",
            "coverage_plan": str(plan),
            "coverage_plan_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(plan / "manifest.json"),
            "target_revision": target["revision"],
            "previous_target_percent": (
                _read(Path(target["previous"]["case"]) / "coverage-plan.json")["target_percent"]
                if target["previous"] else None),
            "revision_reason": inventory.get("revision_reason") if target["previous"] else None,
            "agent_deliveries": sources,
            "known_weight": known_weight, "selected_weight": selected_weight,
            "verified_weight": verified_weight,
            "target_percent": target["target_percent"],
            "milestone_completion_percent": _percent(verified_weight, selected_weight),
            "verified_known_percent": _percent(verified_weight, known_weight),
            "capabilities": rows, "unknowns": inventory["unknowns"]}


def create_coverage_delivery(plan: Path, deliveries: list[Path], review_path: Path,
                             output: Path) -> Path:
    plan = plan.resolve(strict=True)
    deliveries = [path.resolve(strict=True) for path in deliveries]
    review_path = review_path.resolve(strict=True)
    output = output.resolve()
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"coverage delivery output is not empty: {output}")
    review = _read(review_path)
    record = _delivery_inputs(plan, deliveries, review)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _write(output / "review.json", review)
    record["review_sha256"] = sha256_file(output / "review.json")
    record["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    _write(output / "coverage-delivery.json", record)
    lines = ["# Rebuild coverage delivery", "",
             f"- Target revision {record['target_revision']}: {record['target_percent']}% "
             "of known capability weight.",
             f"- Milestone completion: {record['milestone_completion_percent']}% "
             f"({record['verified_weight']}/{record['selected_weight']} selected weight).",
             f"- Verified known coverage: {record['verified_known_percent']}% "
             f"({record['verified_weight']}/{record['known_weight']} known weight).",
             "- These figures cover the reviewed known inventory and cited device flows; "
             "unknown App behavior is outside the denominator.", "",
             "| Capability | Scope | Result | Flow gate | Review note |",
             "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
    if record["previous_target_percent"] is not None:
        lines[3:3] = [f"- Previous target: {record['previous_target_percent']}%; "
                      f"revision reason: {record['revision_reason']}"]
    for item in record["capabilities"]:
        lines.append(f"| `{item['id']}` | {item['scope']} | {item['result']} | "
                     f"{item['flow_gate_passed']} | {_cell(item['notes'])} |")
    lines += ["", "Unknown areas: " + ("; ".join(record["unknowns"]) or "none declared"),
              "", "Review notes are human judgments. The verifier checks source identity, "
              "arithmetic and selected-flow gates, not unseen App semantics.", ""]
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _write(output / "manifest.json", {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "coverage_delivery",
        "status": record["status"], "evidence": [
            {"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
            for name in ("review.json", "coverage-delivery.json", "report.md")]})
    return output / "report.md"


def validate_coverage_delivery(root: Path) -> bool:
    try:
        record = _read(root / "coverage-delivery.json")
        review = _read(root / "review.json")
        plan = Path(record["coverage_plan"]).resolve(strict=True)
        deliveries = [Path(item["case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                      for item in record["agent_deliveries"]]
        if root.resolve() in [plan, *deliveries]:
            return False
        expected = _delivery_inputs(plan, deliveries, review)
        return (all(record.get(key) == value for key, value in expected.items()) and
                record.get("review_sha256") == sha256_file(root / "review.json"))
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False
```
