`copyapp/fidelity.py`:

```py
"""Bounded, reviewed reconstruction milestones; never a pixel-similarity claim.

These new cases deliberately leave historical strict delivery validators alone.
They reference retained verified cases rather than duplicating large UI archives.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


KINDS = {"fidelity_plan", "fidelity_check"}
WEIGHTS = {"behavior": 40, "layout": 40, "details": 20}


def read(root, name):
    value = json.loads((root / name).read_text())
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("expected an object: " + name)
    return value


def require(root, kinds):
    if read(root, "manifest.json").get("kind") not in kinds or not verify_case(root):
        raise ValueError("expected a verified " + "/".join(sorted(kinds)) + " case")


def reference(root):
    return {"path": str(root.resolve(strict=True)), "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(root / "manifest.json")}


def resolve(ref, kinds):
    if not isinstance(ref, dict) or set(ref) != {"path", "manifest_sha256"}:
        raise ValueError("invalid source reference")
    root = Path(ref["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if sha256_file(root / "manifest.json") != ref["manifest_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("source manifest changed")
    require(root, kinds)
    return root


def contract(task):
    require(task, {"mac_rebuild_plan", "agent_implementation_task"})
    if read(task, "manifest.json")["kind"] == "mac_rebuild_plan":
        data = read(task, "rebuild-plan.json")
        return {"platform": "macos", "report_sha256": data["report_manifest_sha256"],
                "project": data["target"]["project"], "bundle_id": data["target"]["bundle_id"],
                "flow_ids": data["selected_flow_ids"], "capability_ids": data["target_capability_ids"]}
    data = read(task, "task.json")
    if data["status"] not in {"ready_for_agent", "selected_flows_ready"}:
        raise ValueError("resolve task evidence gaps before setting a reconstruction milestone")
    return {"platform": "ios", "report_sha256": data["report_index_sha256"],
            "project": data["project_dir"], "bundle_id": data["rebuilt_bundle_id"],
            "flow_ids": [row["id"] for row in data["flows"]], "device_udid": data["device_udid"]}


def policy(fidelity=80, max_iterations=3):
    if type(fidelity) is not int or not 0 <= fidelity <= 100:
        raise ValueError("fidelity must be an integer from 0 to 100")
    if type(max_iterations) is not int or not 1 <= max_iterations <= 20:
        raise ValueError("max-iterations must be an integer from 1 to 20")
    return {"fidelity": fidelity, "max_iterations": max_iterations,
            "weights": dict(WEIGHTS), "score_kind": "reviewed_selected_scope_grade",
            "core_behavior_required": True, "full_image_review_required": True,
            "whole_app_parity": False}


def plan_data(task, fidelity, max_iterations):
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "fidelity_plan", "task": reference(task),
            "contract": contract(task), "policy": policy(fidelity, max_iterations)}


def brief(data):
    p = data["policy"]
    return ("# Bounded reconstruction milestone\n\n"
            f"Target grade: {p['fidelity']}/100. At most {p['max_iterations']} implementation/check cycles, "
            "including the first cycle. Paired replay repetitions are not additional implementation cycles.\n\n"
            "Work on the frozen selected scope. Core behavior, source/install identity and full-image review "
            "are required at every target. Grade = behavior 40% + layout 40% + details 20%; behavior is "
            "100 only when all selected flow assertions pass. Layout/details are explicit reviewer judgments "
            "with cited image IDs, not measured similarity percentages or known-capability coverage.\n\n"
            "Review every saved screenshot pair once; reuse only exact image hashes already inspected. "
            "Keep every difference, and classify its impact explicitly. A visible major difference may be "
            "non-blocking for this milestone; it must not be relabelled as minor or erased. Broken core "
            "flows, wrong identities, unreviewed images and blocking issues prevent target_met.\n\n"
            "Use fidelity-check with this plan, the verified visual review (Mac) or agent delivery with "
            "visual review (iOS), and the explicit grade review. After the first cycle, pass the previous "
            "fidelity-check. Only continue after continue. Stop after target_met or iteration_limit. "
            "At the limit, deliver the current runnable artifacts and remaining issues as incomplete; "
            "never claim target achievement. No automatic input retries or additional agent processes.\n\n"
            "A new build may use a fresh guest App path while preserving this report, project, Bundle ID "
            "and selected scope. Keep all previous attempts. A changed target/scope needs a new plan. "
            "The iteration chain records submitted cycles; it is not a global process or wall-clock limiter.\n\n"
            "Historical strict delivery, release gates and capability coverage retain their own meanings. "
            "A fidelity milestone does not certify complete App parity, physical-device compatibility "
            "or runtime function semantics. A 100 target additionally requires no recorded image differences.\n")


def save(root, kind, files):
    if root.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("refusing to overwrite fidelity evidence")
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, data in files.items():
        (root / name).write_text(data if isinstance(data, str) else json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "platform": "cross_platform", "kind": kind, "status": "complete",
                "evidence": [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(root / name)} for name in files]}
    (root / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    return root


def create_plan(task, output, fidelity=80, max_iterations=3):
    task = task.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == task or task in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("use a fidelity plan outside its source task")
    data = plan_data(task, fidelity, max_iterations)
    return save(output, "fidelity_plan", {"fidelity-plan.json": data, "TASK.md": brief(data)})


def visual_context(evidence, frozen, *, live_source=False):
    """Bind grades to the actual selected source, installed build and full review."""
    manifest = read(evidence, "manifest.json")
    if manifest.get("status") == "failed" and manifest.get("kind") in {"mac_rebuild_check", "rebuild_check", "mac_build", "mac_install"}:
        # Failed artifacts cannot verify as complete execution. Retain that fact
        # while consuming a cycle; none of their assertions/grades can pass.
        return {"platform": frozen["platform"], "core_behavior_passed": False,
                "source_sha256": None, "pairs": [],
                "guard_issues": ["failed attempt; execution and full-image review incomplete"],
                "failed_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(evidence / "manifest.json")}
    require(evidence, {"mac_visual_review", "agent_delivery"})
    kind = read(evidence, "manifest.json")["kind"]
    if kind == "mac_visual_review":
        from copyapp.macos.build import IGNORED
        from copyapp.macos.package import inventory
        review = read(evidence, "visual-review.json")
        build = evidence / "check/plan/install/build"
        source = read(build, "source-index.json")
        if contract(build / "plan") != frozen:
            raise ValueError("paired build belongs to a different fidelity scope")
        if live_source and inventory(Path(frozen["project"]), exclude=IGNORED) != source["entries"]:
            raise ValueError("current project differs from the paired installed build")
        comparison = read(evidence / "check", "comparison.json")
        core = (comparison["behavior_passed"] == comparison["selected_comparisons"] and
                set(row["flow_id"] for row in comparison["flows"]) == set(frozen["flow_ids"]))
        rows = review["judgments"]
        pairs = [{"id": row["id"], "verdict": row["verdict"]} for row in rows]
        guards = []
        if review["starting_state_issues"]:
            guards.append("starting states not equivalent")
        if review["dimension_mismatches"]:
            guards.append("image dimensions differ")
        return {"platform": "macos", "core_behavior_passed": core,
                "source_sha256": source["sha256"], "pairs": pairs, "guard_issues": guards,
                "install_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(evidence / "check/plan/install/manifest.json")}
    delivery = read(evidence, "delivery.json")
    if contract(Path(delivery["task_case"])) != frozen:
        raise ValueError("iOS delivery belongs to a different fidelity scope")
    if live_source:
        from copyapp.agent_run import _source_tree_hash
        if _source_tree_hash(Path(frozen["project"])) != delivery["source_project_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("current project differs from the delivered source")
    if not delivery["visual_review_case"] or delivery["visual_unreviewed_flow_count"]:
        raise ValueError("complete iOS image review is required")
    review = read(Path(delivery["visual_review_case"]), "review.json")
    selected = set(frozen["flow_ids"])
    pairs = [{"id": row["flow_id"] + ".step-" + str(row["step"]), "verdict": row["verdict"]}
             for row in review["pairs"] if row["flow_id"] in selected]
    return {"platform": "ios", "core_behavior_passed": delivery["asserted_flow_count"] == len(selected),
            "source_sha256": delivery["source_project_sha256"], "pairs": pairs, "guard_issues": [],
            "installed_ipa_sha256": delivery["ipa_snapshot_sha256"]}


def review_template(context):
    ids = [row["id"] for row in context["pairs"]]
    return {"schema_version": 1, "reviewer": "",
            "dimensions": {key: {"score": None, "notes": "", "pair_ids": ids} for key in ("layout", "details")},
            "differences": [{"pair_id": row["id"], "impact": None, "reason": ""}
                            for row in context["pairs"] if row["verdict"] not in {"match", "equivalent"}],
            "blocking_issues": []}


def evaluate(p, context, review, iteration):
    if p != policy(p["fidelity"], p["max_iterations"]):
        raise ValueError("unsupported grading policy")
    if type(iteration) is not int or not 1 <= iteration <= p["max_iterations"]:
        raise ValueError("iteration outside frozen budget")
    if (set(review) != {"schema_version", "reviewer", "dimensions", "differences", "blocking_issues"} or
            type(review["schema_version"]) is not int or review["schema_version"] != 1 or
            not isinstance(review["reviewer"], str) or not review["reviewer"].strip()):
        raise ValueError("explicit grade reviewer required")
    ids = {row["id"] for row in context["pairs"]}
    dims = review["dimensions"]
    if not isinstance(dims, dict) or set(dims) != {"layout", "details"}:
        raise ValueError("review layout and details separately")
    for dim in dims.values():
        if (not isinstance(dim, dict) or set(dim) != {"score", "notes", "pair_ids"} or
                type(dim["score"]) is not int or not 0 <= dim["score"] <= 100 or
                not isinstance(dim["notes"], str) or len(dim["notes"].strip()) < 12 or
                not isinstance(dim["pair_ids"], list) or (ids and not dim["pair_ids"]) or
                any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in dim["pair_ids"]) or
                len(set(dim["pair_ids"])) != len(dim["pair_ids"]) or not set(dim["pair_ids"]).issubset(ids)):
            raise ValueError("each grade needs an integer, concrete notes and unique saved image IDs")
        if not ids and dim["score"] != 0:
            raise ValueError("failed attempts without reviewed images must have zero visual grades")
    differences = review["differences"]
    expected = [row["id"] for row in context["pairs"] if row["verdict"] not in {"match", "equivalent"}]
    if not isinstance(differences, list) or [row.get("pair_id") for row in differences] != expected:
        raise ValueError("acknowledge every recorded image difference in review order")
    for row in differences:
        if (set(row) != {"pair_id", "impact", "reason"} or row["impact"] not in {"blocking", "non_blocking"} or
                not isinstance(row["reason"], str) or len(row["reason"].strip()) < 12):
            raise ValueError("every difference needs an explicit impact and reason")
    blockers = review["blocking_issues"]
    if not isinstance(blockers, list) or any(not isinstance(x, str) or len(x.strip()) < 12 for x in blockers):
        raise ValueError("blocking issues must be concrete strings")
    blockers = list(blockers) + context["guard_issues"]
    if not context["core_behavior_passed"]:
        blockers.append("selected core behavior assertions not all passed")
    if any(row["impact"] == "blocking" for row in differences):
        blockers.append("reviewed image difference blocks this milestone")
    if p["fidelity"] == 100 and differences:
        blockers.append("100 target requires no recorded image differences")
    score = (100 * WEIGHTS["behavior"] if context["core_behavior_passed"] else 0)
    score += sum(dims[key]["score"] * WEIGHTS[key] for key in ("layout", "details"))
    met = not blockers and score >= p["fidelity"] * 100
    return {"grade": score / 100, "target": p["fidelity"], "iteration": iteration,
            "max_iterations": p["max_iterations"], "target_met": met,
            "decision": "target_met" if met else "iteration_limit" if iteration == p["max_iterations"] else "continue",
            "blocking_issues": blockers, "recorded_differences": len(differences),
            "scope": "reviewed_selected_scope_milestone", "similarity_percent": None,
            "known_capability_coverage": None, "strict_delivery_certified": False}


def check_data(plan, evidence, review, previous=None, *, live_source=False):
    require(plan, {"fidelity_plan"})
    frozen = read(plan, "fidelity-plan.json")
    context = visual_context(evidence, frozen["contract"], live_source=live_source)
    iteration = 1
    if previous is not None:
        require(previous, {"fidelity_check"})
        prior = read(previous, "fidelity-check.json")
        if prior["plan"] != reference(plan) or prior["result"]["decision"] != "continue":
            raise ValueError("previous cycle must continue the same frozen plan")
        if prior["evidence"]["manifest_sha256"] == reference(evidence)["manifest_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("do not consume a new cycle by regrading the same evidence")
        iteration = prior["result"]["iteration"] + 1
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "fidelity_check", "plan": reference(plan),
            "evidence": reference(evidence), "previous": reference(previous) if previous else None,
            "context": context, "review": review,
            "result": evaluate(frozen["policy"], context, review, iteration)}


def report(data):
    result = data["result"]
    dims = data["review"]["dimensions"]
    return ("# Reconstruction milestone\n\n"
            f"Decision: **{result['decision']}**. Reviewed grade {result['grade']}/100; target {result['target']}. "
            f"Cycle {result['iteration']}/{result['max_iterations']}.\n\n"
            "Grade reflects explicit selected-scope reviewer judgments, not objective image similarity, "
            "known-capability coverage or strict delivery acceptance.\n\n"
            f"Reviewer: {data['review']['reviewer']}. Layout: {dims['layout']['score']}/100; "
            f"details: {dims['details']['score']}/100; core behavior passed: {data['context']['core_behavior_passed']}.\n\n"
            f"Layout: {dims['layout']['notes']}\n\nDetails: {dims['details']['notes']}\n\n"
            "[Grade, image citations and every difference decision](fidelity-check.json). "
            f"[Frozen task](<{data['plan']['path']}/TASK.md>) · "
            f"[Retained source evidence](<{data['evidence']['path']}>)\n\n"
            f"Recorded image differences: {result['recorded_differences']}.\n\n"
            + "\n".join("- " + x for x in result["blocking_issues"]) + "\n\n"
            + ("Stop implementation. Retain remaining differences and deliver the scoped artifacts.\n" if result["decision"] == "target_met" else
               "Stop at the iteration limit. Deliver current runnable artifacts and gaps as incomplete.\n" if result["decision"] == "iteration_limit" else
               "A further implementation cycle is available; fix observed issues before any new run.\n"))


def create_check(plan, evidence, review_path, output, previous=None):
    plan, evidence = plan.resolve(strict=True), evidence.resolve(strict=True)
    previous = previous.resolve(strict=True) if previous else None
    if any(output.resolve() == path or path in output.resolve().parents for path in (plan, evidence, previous) if path):
        raise ValueError("use a separate new check directory")
    data = check_data(plan, evidence, read(review_path.parent, review_path.name), previous, live_source=True)
    return save(output, "fidelity_check", {"fidelity-check.json": data, "report.md": report(data)})


def verify_fidelity(root):
    from copyapp.verify import checked_path
    try:
        manifest = read(root, "manifest.json")
        kind = manifest["kind"]
        names = {"fidelity-plan.json", "TASK.md"} if kind == "fidelity_plan" else {"fidelity-check.json", "report.md"}
        if (set(manifest) != {"schema_version", "platform", "kind", "status", "evidence"} or
                type(manifest["schema_version"]) is not int or manifest["schema_version"] != 1 or
                manifest["platform"] != "cross_platform" or kind not in KINDS or manifest["status"] != "complete" or
                {row["path"] for row in manifest["evidence"]} != names or len(manifest["evidence"]) != 2):
            return False
        if any((root / row["path"]).is_symlink() or sha256_file(checked_path(root, row["path"])) != row["sha256"]
               for row in manifest["evidence"]):
            return False
        if kind == "fidelity_plan":
            saved = read(root, "fidelity-plan.json")
            task = resolve(saved["task"], {"mac_rebuild_plan", "agent_implementation_task"})
            expected = plan_data(task, saved["policy"]["fidelity"], saved["policy"]["max_iterations"])
            return saved == expected and (root / "TASK.md").read_text() == brief(expected)
        saved = read(root, "fidelity-check.json")
        plan = resolve(saved["plan"], {"fidelity_plan"})
        evidence = Path(saved["evidence"]["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
        if reference(evidence) != saved["evidence"]:
            return False
        # visual_context verifies complete evidence, or explicitly retains a
        # failed attempt which can only continue/stop as incomplete.
        previous = None
        if saved["previous"] is not None:
            # Check decreasing iterations before recursing, including tampered cycles.
            previous = Path(saved["previous"]["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
            if read(previous, "fidelity-check.json")["result"]["iteration"] != saved["result"]["iteration"] - 1:
                return False
            previous = resolve(saved["previous"], {"fidelity_check"})
        expected = check_data(plan, evidence, saved["review"], previous)
        return saved == expected and (root / "report.md").read_text() == report(expected)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, RecursionError):
        return False

```

`copyapp/flow_capture.py`:

```py
"""One bounded UI flow followed by a no-launch runtime view snapshot."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from contextlib import nullcontext, redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple

from copyapp.ictrl import DEFAULT_CLIENT
from copyapp.flow_trace import FlowTrace
from copyapp.network_flow import NetworkObserver, validate_network_trace_files
from copyapp.playbook import run_playbook
from copyapp.trace import parse_method
from copyapp.usb_tunnel import ictrl_tunnel
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case
from copyapp.gestures import GESTURE_ACTIONS
from copyapp.text_actions import TYPE_ACTION
from copyapp.view_tree import capture_view_tree


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _child_files(output: Path) -> list:
    return [{"path": str(path.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha256_file(path)}
            for parent in (output / "playbook", output / "view-tree", output / "trace",
                           output / "network") if parent.is_dir()
            for path in sorted(parent.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()]


class ObserverGroup:
    """Keep independent Frida observers aligned to one playbook action timeline."""

    def __init__(self, observers: list):
        self.observers = observers

    def start(self, udid: str, bundle: str) -> None:
        for observer in self.observers:
            observer.start(udid, bundle)

    def begin_step(self, index: int, action: str) -> None:
        for observer in self.observers:
            observer.begin_step(index, action)

    def end_step(self) -> None:
        # Each observer has its own bounded Frida-message drain. Run those
        # drains together so one action does not get different end windows.
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(self.observers)) as pool:
            futures = [pool.submit(observer.end_step) for observer in self.observers]
            errors = []
            for future in futures:
                try:
                    future.result()
                except Exception as exc:
                    errors.append(exc)
        if errors:
            raise errors[0]

    def finish(self) -> None:
        first = None
        for observer in self.observers:
            try:
                observer.finish()
            except Exception as exc:
                first = first or exc
        if first:
            raise first


def validate_flow_pair(playbook: dict, views: dict, bundle: str,
                       device_prefix: str, backend: str) -> None:
    if (playbook.get("status") != "complete" or views.get("status") != "complete" or
            playbook.get("bundle_id") != bundle or views.get("bundle_id") != bundle or
            playbook.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != device_prefix or
            views.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != device_prefix or
            playbook.get("ui_backend") != backend or views.get("ui_backend") != backend or
            views.get("launch_requested") is not False or
            views.get("frontmost_before") != bundle or views.get("frontmost_after") != bundle):
        raise ValueError("flow and view scan identity or completion differs")
    try:
        finished = datetime.fromisoformat(playbook["finished_at"])
        started = datetime.fromisoformat(views["started_at"])
        gap = (started - finished).total_seconds()
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("flow/view timing metadata is invalid") from exc
    if not 0 <= gap <= 60:
        raise ValueError("view scan did not follow the flow within 60 seconds")


def validate_flow_trace_pair(playbook: dict, trace: dict, bundle: str,
                             device_prefix: str, binary_hashes: Optional[set] = None) -> None:
    actions = [(item["index"], item["action"]) for item in playbook.get("steps", [])
               if item.get("action") in ("tap", "tap_label", *GESTURE_ACTIONS,
                                          TYPE_ACTION)]
    steps = trace.get("steps")
    methods = trace.get("requested_methods")
    if (trace.get("status") != "complete" or trace.get("bundle_id") != bundle or
            trace.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != device_prefix or
            not isinstance(steps, list) or not isinstance(methods, list) or not methods or
            [(item.get("index"), item.get("action")) for item in steps
             if isinstance(item, dict)] != actions or
            len(steps) != len(actions) or
            any(not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("incomplete") or
                item.get("action") not in ("tap", "tap_label", *GESTURE_ACTIONS,
                                           TYPE_ACTION)
                for item in steps)):
        raise ValueError("trace/playbook identity or action steps differ")
    width = len(methods)
    observed_methods = trace.get("methods")
    if (not isinstance(observed_methods, list) or len(observed_methods) != width or
            any(not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("status") != "hooked" or
                (item.get("class"), item.get("selector")) != parse_method(spec)
                for item, spec in zip(observed_methods, methods))):
        raise ValueError("flow trace method identity is invalid")
    for item in [trace] + steps:
        for field in ("call_counts", "static_call_counts"):
            counts = item.get(field)
            if (not isinstance(counts, list) or len(counts) != width or
                    any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in counts)):
                raise ValueError("flow trace counts are invalid")
    for field in ("call_counts", "static_call_counts"):
        if any(sum(step[field][index] for step in steps) > trace[field][index]
               for index in range(width)):
            raise ValueError("flow trace step counts exceed total counts")
    branches = trace.get("branch_requested_offsets", [])
    if branches:
        entries = trace.get("branch_entries")
        totals = trace.get("branch_call_counts")
        static_entries = trace.get("static_entries")
        static_path = (static_entries[0].get("module_path")
                       if isinstance(static_entries, list) and static_entries and
                       isinstance(static_entries[0], dict) else None)
        if (not isinstance(branches, list) or len(branches) > 32 or
                any(not isinstance(offset, str) or not offset.startswith("0x") or
                    not offset[2:] or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in offset[2:])
                    for offset in branches) or
                len(set(branches)) != len(branches) or
                not isinstance(static_path, str) or not static_path or
                not isinstance(entries, list) or len(entries) != len(branches) or
                not isinstance(totals, list) or len(totals) != len(branches) or
                any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in totals) or
                any(not isinstance(entry, dict) or entry.get("index") != index or
                    entry.get("module_offset") != branches[index] or
                    entry.get("module_path") != static_path
                    for index, entry in enumerate(entries))):
            raise ValueError("flow trace branch binding is invalid")
        for step in steps:
            counts = step.get("branch_call_counts")
            if (not isinstance(counts, list) or len(counts) != len(branches) or
                    any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in counts)):
                raise ValueError("flow trace branch counts are invalid")
        if any(sum(step["branch_call_counts"][i] for step in steps) > totals[i]
               for i in range(len(branches))):
            raise ValueError("flow trace branch step counts exceed totals")
    returns = trace.get("branch_return_u32_offsets", [])
    if (not isinstance(returns, list) or any(not isinstance(offset, str) for offset in returns) or
            len(set(returns)) != len(returns) or
            any(offset not in branches for offset in returns)):
        raise ValueError("flow trace return selection differs from branch entries")
    selected_branches = {branches.index(offset) for offset in returns}
    for step in steps:
        if not returns:
            if "branch_return_u32_hits" in step:
                raise ValueError("flow trace has unrequested branch returns")
            continue
        hits = step.get("branch_return_u32_hits")
        if (not isinstance(hits, list) or len(hits) > 256 or
                any(not isinstance(hit, dict) or type(hit.get("index")) is not int or
                    hit["index"] not in selected_branches or
                    type(hit.get("value")) is not int or
                    not 0 <= hit["value"] <= 0xffffffff for hit in hits)):
            raise ValueError("flow trace raw branch returns are invalid")
    registers = trace.get("branch_registers", [])
    if (not isinstance(registers, list) or len(registers) > 32 or
            any(not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("offset") not in branches or
                not isinstance(item.get("register"), str) or
                item["register"] not in {f"x{i}" for i in range(31)}
                for item in registers)):
        raise ValueError("flow trace register selection differs from branch entries")
    selected_registers = {(branches.index(item["offset"]), item["register"])
                          for item in registers}
    if len(selected_registers) != len(registers):
        raise ValueError("flow trace register selection contains duplicates")
    for step in steps:
        if not registers:
            if "branch_register_hits" in step:
                raise ValueError("flow trace has unrequested branch registers")
            continue
        hits = step.get("branch_register_hits")
        if (not isinstance(hits, list) or len(hits) > 256 or
                any(not isinstance(hit, dict) or type(hit.get("index")) is not int or
                    (hit["index"], hit.get("register")) not in selected_registers or
                    hit.get("status") not in ("app_image", "outside_app_image", "unavailable") or
                    (hit["status"] == "app_image" and
                     (not isinstance(hit.get("target_offset"), str) or
                      not hit["target_offset"].startswith("0x") or
                      not hit["target_offset"][2:] or
                      any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in hit["target_offset"][2:]))) or
                    (hit["status"] != "app_image" and "target_offset" in hit)
                    for hit in hits)):
            raise ValueError("flow trace register pointer bindings are invalid")
    selected = trace.get("arg2_u32_methods", [])
    if (not isinstance(selected, list) or any(not isinstance(spec, str) for spec in selected) or
            len(set(selected)) != len(selected) or
            any(spec not in methods for spec in selected)):
        raise ValueError("flow trace argument capture selection is invalid")
    selected_indices = {methods.index(spec) for spec in selected}
    for step in steps:
        if not selected:
            continue
        hits = step.get("arg2_u32_hits")
        if (not isinstance(hits, list) or len(hits) > 256 or
                any(not isinstance(hit, dict) or hit.get("type") not in
                    ("method_hit", "static_hit") or hit.get("index") not in selected_indices or
                    type(hit.get("value")) is not int or
                    not 0 <= hit["value"] <= 0xffffffff for hit in hits)):
            raise ValueError("flow trace raw argument hits are invalid")
        for index in selected_indices:
            for event_type, count_field in (("method_hit", "call_counts"),
                                            ("static_hit", "static_call_counts")):
                captured = sum(hit["type"] == event_type and hit["index"] == index
                               for hit in hits)
                if (captured > step[count_field][index] or
                        (not step.get("arg2_u32_truncated") and
                         captured != step[count_field][index])):
                    raise ValueError("flow trace raw argument count differs from method hits")
    if (binary_hashes is not None and trace.get("static_binary_sha256") and
            trace["static_binary_sha256"] not in binary_hashes):
        raise ValueError("flow trace static entry belongs to another binary")


def capture_flow(udid: str, backend: str, script: Path, output: Path,
                 ictrl_client: Path = DEFAULT_CLIENT, methods: Optional[list[str]] = None,
                 binary: Optional[Path] = None,
                 objc_index: Optional[Path] = None,
                 arg2_u32_methods: Optional[list[str]] = None,
                 branch_offsets: Optional[list[int]] = None,
                 branch_return_u32_offsets: Optional[list[int]] = None,
                 branch_registers: Optional[list[tuple[int, str]]] = None,
                 network: bool = False,
                 port: Optional[int] = None) -> Tuple[Path, bool]:
    if backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl"):
        raise ValueError("unsupported UI backend")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    plan = _read(script)
    bundle = plan.get("bundle_id")
    if not isinstance(bundle, str) or not bundle:
        raise ValueError("flow playbook has no target Bundle ID")
    prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    if not methods and (binary is not None or objc_index is not None):
        raise ValueError("static entry tracing requires --method")
    if not methods and arg2_u32_methods:
        raise ValueError("argument capture requires --method")
    if not methods and branch_offsets:
        raise ValueError("branch tracing requires --method")
    if branch_return_u32_offsets and not branch_offsets:
        raise ValueError("return capture requires --branch-offset")
    if branch_registers and not branch_offsets:
        raise ValueError("register capture requires --branch-offset")
    tracer = FlowTrace(output / "trace", methods, binary, objc_index,
                       arg2_u32_methods, branch_offsets,
                       branch_return_u32_offsets, branch_registers) if methods else None
    network_observer = NetworkObserver(output / "network") if network else None
    observers = [item for item in (tracer, network_observer) if item is not None]
    observer = ObserverGroup(observers) if len(observers) > 1 else (observers[0] if observers else None)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "ui_flow_capture",
              "status": "failed", "bundle_id": bundle,
              "scenario_id": plan.get("scenario_id"), "ui_backend": backend,
              "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
              "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(script),
              "started_at": _now()}
    if tracer is not None:
        record["trace_requested"] = True
    if network_observer is not None:
        record["network_requested"] = True
    stage = "playbook"
    try:
        # Reopening an iCTRL tunnel can foreground its runner. Keep one tunnel
        # across the playbook and immediate no-launch view scan.
        session = (ictrl_tunnel(udid, ictrl_client)
                   if backend == "ictrl" and port is None else nullcontext(port))
        with session as shared_port:
            play_path, play_ok = run_playbook(udid, backend, script, output / "playbook",
                                              port=shared_port, ictrl_client=ictrl_client,
                                              trace_observer=observer)
            record["playbook_status"] = "complete" if play_ok else "failed"
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                if not verify_case(output / "playbook"):
                    raise ValueError("playbook evidence hash mismatch")
            play = _read(play_path)
            if not play_ok:
                raise RuntimeError(f"playbook stopped: {play.get('error')}")
            if tracer is not None:
                stage = "trace"
                with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                    if not verify_case(output / "trace"):
                        raise ValueError("trace evidence hash mismatch")
                trace = _read(output / "trace" / "trace.json")
                if trace.get("status") != "complete":
                    raise RuntimeError(f"trace stopped: {trace.get('error')}")
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, bundle, prefix)
                record["trace_status"] = "complete"
            if network_observer is not None:
                stage = "network"
                network_trace = validate_network_trace_files(output / "network",
                                                             play, bundle, prefix)
                record["network_status"] = "complete"
                record["network_event_count"] = len(network_trace["events"])
            stage = "view_tree"
            tree_path, tree_ok = capture_view_tree(udid, bundle, output / "view-tree",
                                                   backend=backend, port=shared_port,
                                                   ictrl_client=ictrl_client, launch=False)
            record["view_tree_status"] = "complete" if tree_ok else "failed"
            with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                if not verify_case(output / "view-tree"):
                    raise ValueError("view tree evidence hash mismatch")
            views = _read(tree_path)
            if not tree_ok:
                raise RuntimeError(f"view scan stopped: {views.get('error')}")
            validate_flow_pair(play, views, bundle, prefix, backend)
            if sha256_file(output / "playbook" / "playbook.json") != record["source_script_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("saved playbook differs from requested script")
            record["playbook_finished_at"] = play["finished_at"]
            record["view_tree_started_at"] = views["started_at"]
            record["node_count"] = views["node_count"]
            record["window_count"] = views["window_count"]
            record["status"] = "complete"
            stage = "session_cleanup"
    except Exception as exc:
        record["status"] = "failed"
        record["error"] = {"stage": stage, "type": type(exc).__name__,
                           "message": str(exc)[:400]}
    finally:
        record["finished_at"] = _now()
        record["evidence"] = _child_files(output)
        (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                                               encoding="utf-8")
    return output / "manifest.json", record["status"] == "complete"

```

`copyapp/flow_trace.py`:

```py
"""Record bounded Frida method hits during named UI playbook action steps."""

import hashlib
import json
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.experiment import _bounded_cleanup, _static_targets
from copyapp.trace import MAX_METHODS, parse_branch_register, parse_method, trace_script
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


class FlowTrace:
    def __init__(self, output: Path, specs: list[str], binary: Optional[Path] = None,
                 objc_index: Optional[Path] = None,
                 arg2_u32_methods: Optional[list[str]] = None,
                 branch_offsets: Optional[list[int]] = None,
                 branch_return_u32_offsets: Optional[list[int]] = None,
                 branch_registers: Optional[list[tuple[int, str]]] = None):
        methods = [parse_method(spec) for spec in specs]
        if not methods or len(methods) > MAX_METHODS or len(set(methods)) != len(methods):
            raise ValueError("provide 1–32 unique methods")
        if (binary is None) != (objc_index is None):
            raise ValueError("--binary and --objc-index must be provided together")
        branches = branch_offsets or []
        if (branches and binary is None) or len(branches) > 32 or len(set(branches)) != len(branches) or any(
                type(offset) is not int or offset < 0 for offset in branches):
            raise ValueError("branch offsets require unique static app entries")
        returns = branch_return_u32_offsets or []
        if (len(set(returns)) != len(returns) or
                any(type(offset) is not int or offset not in branches for offset in returns)):
            raise ValueError("return capture requires unique selected branch offsets")
        registers = branch_registers or []
        if (len(registers) > 32 or len(set(registers)) != len(registers) or
                any(type(offset) is not int or offset not in branches or
                    parse_branch_register(f"{offset}:{register}") != (offset, register)
                    for offset, register in registers)):
            raise ValueError("register capture requires unique selected branch offsets")
        requested_args = arg2_u32_methods or []
        if len(set(requested_args)) != len(requested_args) or any(
                spec not in specs for spec in requested_args):
            raise ValueError("argument capture requires unique traced methods")
        if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
            raise FileExistsError(f"trace output is not empty: {output}")
        self.output = output
        self.methods = methods
        self.specs = specs
        self.arg2_u32_indices = [specs.index(spec) for spec in requested_args]
        self.branch_offsets = branches
        self.branch_return_u32_offsets = returns
        self.branch_registers = registers
        self.digest, self.static_targets = (
            _static_targets(binary, objc_index, methods) if binary else (None, []))
        self.session = None
        self.script = None
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.active = None
        self.counts = [0] * len(methods)
        self.static_counts = [0] * len(methods)
        self.branch_counts = [0] * len(branches)
        self.steps = []
        self.errors = []
        self.record = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "ui_flow_method_trace",
                       "status": "failed", "requested_methods": specs,
                       "started_at": _now(), "steps": self.steps,
                       "note": "Action-step hits are temporal observations, not proof of causal or exclusive dispatch. Raw argument 2 is saved only for explicitly selected methods; its meaning and type require separate evidence."}
        if requested_args:
            self.record["arg2_u32_methods"] = requested_args
        if branches:
            self.record["branch_requested_offsets"] = [f"0x{offset:x}" for offset in branches]
        if returns:
            self.record["branch_return_u32_offsets"] = [f"0x{offset:x}" for offset in returns]
            self.record["branch_return_limitation"] = (
                "Raw low 32 bits of the function return register. Type and meaning require static or additional runtime evidence; asynchronous callbacks may finish after a tap window.")
        if registers:
            self.record["branch_registers"] = [
                {"offset": f"0x{offset:x}", "register": register}
                for offset, register in registers]
            self.record["branch_register_limitation"] = (
                "The selected register is interpreted as a code pointer only when it maps into the loaded app image. The binding is a runtime module offset, not proof of identical in-memory and acquired file bytes.")
        if self.digest:
            self.record["static_binary_sha256"] = self.digest
            self.record["static_requested_offsets"] = [
                f"0x{target['offset']:x}" for target in self.static_targets]
            self.record["static_binding_limitation"] = (
                "The acquired file hash and loaded module path/offset do not prove identical in-memory code bytes.")

    def start(self, udid: str, bundle: str) -> None:
        self.record["device_id_sha256_prefix"] = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.record["bundle_id"] = bundle
        from copyapp.frida_device import get_usb_device
        device = get_usb_device(udid)
        app = next((item for item in device.enumerate_applications(scope="full")
                    if item.identifier == bundle), None)
        if app is None or not app.pid:
            raise RuntimeError("target app has no running process")
        self.record["pid"] = app.pid
        self.record["process_name"] = app.name
        source = trace_script(self.methods, stream_hits=True,
                              static_targets=self.static_targets,
                              arg2_u32_indices=self.arg2_u32_indices,
                              branch_offsets=self.branch_offsets,
                              branch_return_u32_offsets=self.branch_return_u32_offsets,
                              branch_registers=self.branch_registers)
        self.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.output / "hook.js").write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
        self.session = device.attach(app.pid)
        self.script = self.session.create_script(source)
        self.script.on("message", self._on_message)
        self.script.load()
        baseline = self.script.exports_sync.snapshot()
        observed = baseline["methods"]
        if (len(observed) != len(self.methods) or
                any(item.get("status") != "hooked" for item in observed)):
            raise RuntimeError("one or more requested Objective-C methods were not hooked")
        static_entries = baseline.get("static_entries", [])
        if len(static_entries) != len(self.static_targets):
            raise RuntimeError("one or more static app entries were not hooked")
        branch_entries = baseline.get("branch_entries", [])
        if len(branch_entries) != len(self.branch_offsets):
            raise RuntimeError("one or more branch entries were not hooked")
        self.record["methods"] = observed
        if self.static_targets:
            self.record["static_entries"] = static_entries
        if self.branch_offsets:
            self.record["branch_entries"] = branch_entries
        with self.lock:
            self.counts = [0] * len(self.methods)
            self.static_counts = [0] * len(self.methods)
            self.branch_counts = [0] * len(self.branch_offsets)
        self.record["attached_at"] = _now()

    def _on_message(self, message, _data) -> None:
        if not isinstance(message, dict):
            return
        if message.get("type") == "error":
            with self.lock:
                self.errors.append(str(message.get("description") or "Frida script error")[:240])
            return
        payload = message.get("payload")
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("type") not in (
                "method_hit", "static_hit", "branch_hit", "branch_return_u32",
                "branch_register"):
            return
        index = payload.get("index")
        width = (len(self.branch_offsets) if payload["type"] in
                 ("branch_hit", "branch_return_u32", "branch_register") else len(self.methods))
        if type(index) is not int or not 0 <= index < width:
            return
        with self.lock:
            if payload["type"] == "branch_register":
                register = payload.get("register")
                status = payload.get("status")
                target = payload.get("target_offset")
                if ((self.branch_offsets[index], register) not in self.branch_registers or
                        status not in ("app_image", "outside_app_image", "unavailable") or
                        (status == "app_image" and
                         (not isinstance(target, str) or not target.startswith("0x"))) or
                        (status != "app_image" and target is not None)):
                    self.errors.append("selected branch register has invalid pointer binding")
                elif self.active is not None:
                    hits = self.active["branch_register_hits"]
                    if len(hits) < 256:
                        hit = {"index": index, "register": register, "status": status}
                        if target is not None:
                            hit["target_offset"] = target
                        hits.append(hit)
                    else:
                        self.active["branch_register_truncated"] = True
                return
            if payload["type"] == "branch_return_u32":
                value = payload.get("value")
                if (self.branch_offsets[index] not in self.branch_return_u32_offsets or
                        type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 0xffffffff):
                    self.errors.append("selected branch return lacks valid raw uint32")
                elif self.active is not None:
                    hits = self.active["branch_return_u32_hits"]
                    if len(hits) < 256:
                        hits.append({"index": index, "value": value})
                    else:
                        self.active["branch_return_u32_truncated"] = True
                return
            if payload["type"] == "branch_hit":
                self.branch_counts[index] += 1
                if self.active is not None:
                    self.active["branch_call_counts"][index] += 1
                return
            target = self.static_counts if payload["type"] == "static_hit" else self.counts
            target[index] += 1
            if self.active is not None:
                key = "static_call_counts" if payload["type"] == "static_hit" else "call_counts"
                self.active[key][index] += 1
                if index in self.arg2_u32_indices:
                    value = payload.get("arg2_u32")
                    if type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= 0xffffffff:
                        self.errors.append("selected method hit lacks valid raw argument 2")
                    elif len(self.active["arg2_u32_hits"]) < 256:
                        self.active["arg2_u32_hits"].append({"type": payload["type"],
                                                              "index": index, "value": value})
                    else:
                        self.active["arg2_u32_truncated"] = True

    def begin_step(self, index: int, action: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            if self.active is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("trace step already active")
            self.active = {"index": index, "action": action, "started_at": _now(),
                           "call_counts": [0] * len(self.methods),
                           "static_call_counts": [0] * len(self.methods)}
            if self.arg2_u32_indices:
                self.active["arg2_u32_hits"] = []
            if self.branch_offsets:
                self.active["branch_call_counts"] = [0] * len(self.branch_offsets)
            if self.branch_return_u32_offsets:
                self.active["branch_return_u32_hits"] = []
            if self.branch_registers:
                self.active["branch_register_hits"] = []

    def end_step(self) -> None:
        # Give Frida's asynchronous host messages a short bounded drain window.
        time.sleep(0.2)
        with self.lock:
            if self.active is None:
                raise RuntimeError("no active trace step")
            self.active["finished_at"] = _now()
            self.steps.append(self.active)
            self.active = None

    def finish(self) -> None:
        if self.active is not None:
            with self.lock:
                self.active["incomplete"] = True
                self.steps.append(self.active)
                self.active = None
        with self.lock:
            self.record["call_counts"] = self.counts.copy()
            self.record["static_call_counts"] = self.static_counts.copy()
            if self.branch_offsets:
                self.record["branch_call_counts"] = self.branch_counts.copy()
            errors = self.errors.copy()
        self.record["finished_at"] = _now()
        self.record["status"] = "complete" if self.record.get("attached_at") and not errors else "failed"
        if errors:
            self.record["error"] = {"type": "FridaScriptError", "message": errors[0]}
        self.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = self.output / "trace.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(self.record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        cleanup = []
        if self.script is not None:
            warning = _bounded_cleanup("script unload", self.script.unload)
            if warning:
                cleanup.append(warning)
        if self.session is not None:
            warning = _bounded_cleanup("session detach", self.session.detach)
            if warning:
                cleanup.append(warning)
        if cleanup:
            self.record["cleanup_warnings"] = cleanup
            path.write_text(json.dumps(self.record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        files = [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(self.output / name)}
                 for name in ("hook.js", "trace.json") if (self.output / name).is_file()]
        (self.output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "kind": "ui_flow_method_trace",
            "status": self.record["status"], "bundle_id": self.record.get("bundle_id"),
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.record.get("device_id_sha256_prefix"),
            "evidence": files}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```

```py
"""Select the requested USB phone when Frida sees several connected devices."""

import frida


def get_usb_device(udid: str, timeout: float = 5):
    if not udid:
        raise ValueError("Frida USB selection requires a device UDID")
    from copyapp.frida_sidecar import configured_sidecar, sidecar_device

    if configured_sidecar(udid) is not None:
        return sidecar_device(udid)
    device = frida.get_device(udid, timeout=timeout)
    if device.id != udid or device.type != "usb":
        raise RuntimeError("Frida device is not the requested USB device")
    return device
```

`copyapp/frida_sidecar.py`:

```py
"""Provision and use a version-pinned Frida server on RootHide without replacing its package."""

import atexit
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from copyapp.source_root import source_root


VERSION = "17.23.3"
PACKAGE_SHA256 = "6bf24760fe29fdeb786af71ec689dac333f7dda8aa1fe93ed3dff594bf23531b"
PACKAGE_URL = ("https://github.com/frida/frida/releases/download/" + VERSION +
               "/frida_" + VERSION + "_iphoneos-arm64.deb")
DEVICE_PORT = 27043
REMOTE_DIR = "/rootfs/var/mobile/Media/copyapp-frida-" + VERSION
CONFIG = source_root() / "toolchains" / "frida-sidecars.json"
_forwards: Dict[str, subprocess.Popen] = {}
_devices: Dict[str, Any] = {}


def _sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _read_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if not CONFIG.is_file():
        return {}
    data = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("invalid Frida sidecar configuration")
    return data


def configured_sidecar(udid: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    item = _read_config().get(udid)
    if item is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("version") != VERSION or item.get("device_port") != DEVICE_PORT:
        raise ValueError("invalid Frida sidecar entry for device")
    return item


def _save_config(udid: str, identity: Path, known_hosts: Path) -> None:
    data = _read_config()
    data[udid] = {"version": VERSION, "device_port": DEVICE_PORT,
                  "remote_dir": REMOTE_DIR,
                  "ssh_identity": str(identity.resolve()),
                  "ssh_known_hosts": str(known_hosts.resolve())}
    CONFIG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = CONFIG.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    os.chmod(temp, 0o600)
    temp.replace(CONFIG)


def _port() -> int:
    with socket.socket() as reserved:
        reserved.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return int(reserved.getsockname()[1])


def _pinned_alias(known_hosts: Path) -> str:
    for line in known_hosts.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        for host in line.split()[0].split(","):
            if re.fullmatch(r"\[127\.0\.0\.1\]:\d{1,5}", host):
                return host
    raise ValueError("pinned known-hosts file lacks a 127.0.0.1 USB SSH entry")


def _ssh_args(port: int, identity: Path, known_hosts: Path):
    from copyapp.ssh_acquire import _ssh_argv

    argv = _ssh_argv(port, identity, known_hosts, "mobile")
    argv[-1:-1] = ["-o", "HostKeyAlias=" + _pinned_alias(known_hosts)]
    return argv


def _close_forward(udid: str) -> None:
    process = _forwards.pop(udid, None)
    _devices.pop(udid, None)
    if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
        process.terminate()
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=3)


@atexit.register
def _close_all() -> None:
    for udid in list(_forwards):
        _close_forward(udid)


def _connect(udid: str):
    import frida

    if frida.__version__ != VERSION:
        raise RuntimeError(f"RootHide Frida sidecar needs host frida=={VERSION}; found {frida.__version__}")
    cached = _devices.get(udid)
    if cached is not None and _forwards[udid].poll() is None:
        try:
            cached.enumerate_processes()
            return cached
        except Exception:
            _close_forward(udid)
    host_port = _port()
    process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "pymobiledevice3", "usbmux",
                                "forward", str(host_port), str(DEVICE_PORT), "--serial", udid],
                               stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Frida sidecar USB forward exited")
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", host_port), timeout=0.5):
                    break
            except OSError:
                time.sleep(0.15)
        else:
            raise TimeoutError("Frida sidecar USB forward is not reachable")
        device = frida.get_device_manager().add_remote_device(f"127.0.0.1:{host_port}")
        device.enumerate_processes()
        _forwards[udid] = process
        _devices[udid] = device
        return device
    except Exception:
        process.terminate()
        process.wait(timeout=3)
        raise


def _ssh_run(udid: str, identity: Path, known_hosts: Path, command: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    from copyapp.usb_tunnel import ssh_tunnel

    with ssh_tunnel(udid, _port()) as port:
        result = subprocess.run(_ssh_args(port, identity, known_hosts) + [command],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("RootHide SSH command failed: " + result.stderr[-350:])
    return result


def _start(udid: str, identity: Path, known_hosts: Path) -> None:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    # The SSH namespace uses /rootfs for the real Media directory; the daemon
    # sees the same files at /var/mobile/Media after its RootHide environment is set.
    command = (f'test -x {REMOTE_DIR}/server && '
               f'test -f {REMOTE_DIR}/frida-agent.dylib && '
               f'CRYPTEX_MOUNT_PATH="$(jbroot)" nohup {REMOTE_DIR}/server '
               f'-l 127.0.0.1:{DEVICE_PORT} -C '
               f'> {REMOTE_DIR}/server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &')
    _ssh_run(udid, identity, known_hosts, command)


def sidecar_device(udid: str):
    import frida

    entry = configured_sidecar(udid)
    if entry is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Frida sidecar is not configured for this device")
    if frida.__version__ != VERSION:
        raise RuntimeError(f"RootHide Frida sidecar needs host frida=={VERSION}; found {frida.__version__}")
    try:
        return _connect(udid)
    except Exception:
        _close_forward(udid)
        _start(udid, Path(entry["ssh_identity"]), Path(entry["ssh_known_hosts"]))
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
        last_error: Optional[Exception] = None
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                return _connect(udid)
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
                time.sleep(0.4)
        raise RuntimeError("Frida sidecar did not become available") from last_error


def _package_bytes(path: Optional[Path]) -> bytes:
    if path is not None:
        data = path.read_bytes()
    else:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(PACKAGE_URL, timeout=45) as response:
            data = response.read(30 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
    if len(data) > 30 * 1024 * 1024 or _sha256(data) != PACKAGE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("official Frida package SHA-256 mismatch")
    return data


def _ar_member(archive: bytes, wanted: bytes) -> bytes:
    if not archive.startswith(b"!<arch>\n"):
        raise ValueError("invalid Debian package archive")
    offset = 8
    while offset + 60 <= len(archive):
        header = archive[offset:offset + 60]
        if header[58:60] != b"`\n":
            raise ValueError("invalid Debian archive member")
        name = header[:16].strip().rstrip(b"/")
        size = int(header[48:58].strip())
        start = offset + 60
        end = start + size
        if end > len(archive):
            raise ValueError("truncated Debian archive member")
        if name == wanted:
            return archive[start:end]
        offset = end + (size % 2)
    raise ValueError("Debian package data archive missing")


def _binaries(package: bytes) -> Dict[str, bytes]:
    payload = _ar_member(package, b"data.tar.xz")
    wanted = {"./var/jb/usr/sbin/frida-server": "server",
              "./var/jb/usr/lib/frida-1.0/frida-agent.dylib": "frida-agent.dylib"}
    result: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(payload), mode="r:xz") as archive:
        for member in archive:
            destination = wanted.get(member.name)
            if destination is None:
                continue
            if not member.isfile() or member.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise ValueError("unexpected Frida binary in official package")
            source = archive.extractfile(member)
            if source is None:
                raise ValueError("Frida binary body missing")
            result[destination] = source.read()
    if set(result) != set(wanted.values()):
        raise ValueError("official Frida package lacks server or agent")
    return result


def setup_roothide_sidecar(udid: str, output: Path, identity: Path,
                           known_hosts: Path, package_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Path:
    """Stage an official version-pinned sidecar, then verify the exact USB phone."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    from copyapp.usb_tunnel import ssh_tunnel
    import frida

    if frida.__version__ != VERSION:
        raise RuntimeError(f"install host frida=={VERSION} before setting up this sidecar")
    package = _package_bytes(package_path)
    binaries = _binaries(package)
    marker = _ssh_run(udid, identity, known_hosts,
                      "deviceinfo uniqueid; command -v jbroot; test -d /rootfs/var/mobile/Media")
    marker_lines = marker.stdout.splitlines()
    if len(marker_lines) < 2 or marker_lines[0].strip() != udid or not marker_lines[1].endswith("/jbroot"):
        raise RuntimeError("the named phone did not report the expected RootHide SSH namespace")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
        directory = Path(temporary)
        for name, data in binaries.items():
            (directory / name).write_bytes(data)
        with ssh_tunnel(udid, _port()) as port:
            ssh = _ssh_args(port, identity, known_hosts)
            result = subprocess.run(ssh + [f"mkdir -p {REMOTE_DIR}"],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError("cannot create RootHide sidecar directory: " + result.stderr[-300:])
            scp = ["scp", "-P", str(port), "-i", str(identity),
                   "-o", f"UserKnownHostsFile={known_hosts}",
                   "-o", "HostKeyAlias=" + _pinned_alias(known_hosts),
                   "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes", "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
                   "-o", "IdentitiesOnly=yes"]
            for name in binaries:
                result = subprocess.run(scp + [str(directory / name),
                                                f"mobile@127.0.0.1:{REMOTE_DIR}/{name}.new"],
                                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
                if result.returncode:
                    raise RuntimeError("Frida sidecar transfer failed: " + result.stderr[-300:])
            result = subprocess.run(ssh + [f"chmod 700 {REMOTE_DIR}/server.new; "
                                           f"{REMOTE_DIR}/server.new --version"],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            if result.returncode or result.stdout.strip() != VERSION:
                raise RuntimeError("staged Frida server did not report the pinned version")
            result = subprocess.run(ssh + [f"mv -f {REMOTE_DIR}/frida-agent.dylib.new "
                                           f"{REMOTE_DIR}/frida-agent.dylib && "
                                           f"mv -f {REMOTE_DIR}/server.new {REMOTE_DIR}/server"],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError("cannot activate staged Frida binaries: " + result.stderr[-300:])
    _close_forward(udid)
    try:
        _connect(udid)
    except Exception:
        _start(udid, identity, known_hosts)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 12
    while True:
        try:
            device = _connect(udid)
            break
        except Exception:
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise
            time.sleep(0.4)
    _save_config(udid, identity, known_hosts)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "frida_roothide_sidecar",
              "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
              "version": VERSION, "package_sha256": PACKAGE_SHA256,
              "server_sha256": _sha256(binaries["server"]),
              "agent_sha256": _sha256(binaries["frida-agent.dylib"]),
              "process_count": len(device.enumerate_processes()),
              "remote_port": DEVICE_PORT, "status": "ready"}
    (output / "setup.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "frida_roothide_sidecar",
                "status": "complete", "device_id_sha256_prefix": report["device_id_sha256_prefix"],
                "evidence": [{"id": "setup", "kind": "json", "path": "setup.json",
                              "sha256": hashlib.sha256((output / "setup.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}]}
    (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return output
```
