`copyapp/ios_workflow.py`:

```py
"""Current-agent UI-first workflow; historical strict copy remains independent."""

import hashlib
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.copy_workflow import _rebuild_ready
from copyapp.discover_check import accepted_playbooks
from copyapp.ios_analysis import (_package_inputs, _script_inputs, _validate_enhancement_settings,
                                  _verified, collect_ios_analysis)
from copyapp.ios_capabilities import collect_capabilities
from copyapp.ios_cases import read_json, seal_case, write_json
from copyapp.ios_delivery import behavior_delivery_links
from copyapp.prepare_rebuild import prepare_rebuild
from copyapp.verify import checked_path, compare, sha256_file


def _inputs(udid, bundle, rebuilt_bundle, project, mode, scripts, discovery, auto_discover,
            packages, flow_ids, backend, enhancement_request):
    if (mode not in ("auto", "standard", "enhanced") or bundle == rebuilt_bundle or
            not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid) or
            any(not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", value) for value in (bundle, rebuilt_bundle)) or
            backend not in (None, "ictrl", "ios-mcp") or
            sum((bool(scripts), discovery is not None, auto_discover)) != 1):
        raise ValueError("choose one flow source, an independent Bundle ID and an explicit mode")
    source = [{**item, "source": str(path.resolve(strict=True))}
              for item, path in zip(_script_inputs(scripts, bundle), scripts)] if scripts else []
    if flow_ids is not None and (not 1 <= len(flow_ids) <= 12 or len(set(flow_ids)) != len(flow_ids) or
                                any(not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,80}", item) for item in flow_ids)):
        raise ValueError("provide 1–12 distinct selected flow IDs")
    package_records = _package_inputs(packages, bundle)
    result = {"udid": udid, "bundle_id": bundle, "rebuilt_bundle_id": rebuilt_bundle,
            "project": str(project.resolve()), "requested_mode": mode, "scripts": source,
            "requested_backend": backend,
            "discovery": str(discovery.resolve(strict=True)) if discovery else None,
            "discovery_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(discovery / "manifest.json") if discovery else None,
            "auto_discover": auto_discover, "selected_flow_ids": flow_ids,
            "packages": [{**item, "source": str(path.resolve(strict=True))}
                         for item, path in zip(package_records, packages)]}
    if enhancement_request is not None:
        _validate_enhancement_settings(enhancement_request)
        if mode == "standard":
            raise ValueError("standard workflow cannot request device enhancement")
        result["enhancement_request"] = enhancement_request
    return result


def _plan(root, inputs):
    _verified(root / "capabilities")
    plan = read_json(root / "capabilities/capabilities.json")
    if (plan["device"]["UniqueDeviceID"] != inputs["udid"] or
            plan["requested_mode"] != inputs["requested_mode"]):
        raise ValueError("workflow capabilities belong to another target or mode")
    if inputs["requested_backend"] is not None and inputs["requested_backend"] != plan["ui_backend"]:
        raise ValueError("requested backend is unavailable in the selected mode; choose an explicit compatible route")
    return plan


def _scripts(root, inputs, plan):
    if inputs["scripts"]:
        return [Path(item["source"]) for item in inputs["scripts"]]
    discovery = (root / "discovery-agent/discovery" if inputs["auto_discover"]
                 else Path(inputs["discovery"]))
    if not (discovery / "manifest.json").is_file():
        return []
    if (not inputs["auto_discover"] and sha256_file(discovery / "manifest.json") !=
            inputs["discovery_manifest_sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("accepted discovery source changed")
    record = read_json(discovery / "manifest.json")
    if record.get("execution_mode") != plan["selected_mode"]:
        raise ValueError("discovery must be replayed in the workflow execution mode")
    return accepted_playbooks(discovery, inputs["udid"], inputs["bundle_id"], plan["ui_backend"])


def _collection(root, inputs, scripts, plan):
    source = root / "analysis"
    _verified(source)
    identity = read_json(source / "inputs.json")
    expected = {"udid": inputs["udid"], "bundle_id": inputs["bundle_id"],
                "requested_mode": inputs["requested_mode"],
                "flows": _script_inputs(scripts, inputs["bundle_id"])}
    if inputs["packages"]:
        expected["packages"] = [{key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "source"}
                                for row in inputs["packages"]]
    if "enhancement_request" in inputs:
        expected["enhancement_request"] = inputs["enhancement_request"]
    if identity != expected:
        raise ValueError("workflow analysis inputs changed")
    state = read_json(source / "analysis.json")
    if state["status"] == "complete" and (
            state["selected_mode"] != plan["selected_mode"] or state["ui_backend"] != plan["ui_backend"]):
        raise ValueError("analysis route differs from the frozen workflow route; start a new workflow")
    return state


def _report_ready(root, inputs):
    report = root / "analysis-agent/reviewed-report"
    delivered = root / "analysis-agent/analysis-delivery"
    if not (report / "manifest.json").exists() or not (delivered / "manifest.json").exists():
        return False
    if read_json(delivered / "manifest.json").get("kind") != "ios_behavior_delivery":
        raise ValueError("workflow requires a UI behavior delivery")
    _verified(delivered)
    if read_json(delivered / "delivery.json") != behavior_delivery_links(root / "analysis", report):
        raise ValueError("behavior delivery source differs from this workflow")
    spec = read_json(report / "feature-spec.json")
    analysis = read_json(root / "analysis/analysis.json")
    if (spec["rebuilt_bundle_id"] != inputs["rebuilt_bundle_id"] or
            spec.get("execution_mode") != analysis["selected_mode"]):
        raise ValueError("reviewed rebuild identity or execution mode differs")
    return True


def _handoff_ready(root, inputs, plan):
    prep = root / "rebuild-preparation"
    _verified(prep)
    record = read_json(prep / "manifest.json")
    report = root / "analysis-agent/reviewed-report"
    selected = inputs["selected_flow_ids"] or [item["id"] for item in read_json(report / "feature-spec.json")["flows"]]
    if (record.get("report") != str(report) or record.get("device_udid") != inputs["udid"] or
            record.get("project_dir") != inputs["project"] or
            record.get("ui_backend") != plan["ui_backend"] or record.get("selected_flow_ids") != selected):
        raise ValueError("rebuild preparation belongs to different workflow settings")
    return record.get("status") in ("ready_for_agent", "selected_flows_ready")


def _save(root, inputs, status, error=None):
    state = {"status": status, "scope": "selected_flows", "agent_provider": "current"}
    if error:
        state["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)[:500]}
    write_json(root / "workflow.json", state)
    (root / "report.md").write_text(
        "# UI-first iOS copy workflow\n\n"
        f"App: `{inputs['bundle_id']}`. Status: `{status}`.\n\n"
        "Follow TASK.md and resume this exact case. Completion requires source-linked analysis, "
        "an independently installed rebuild, paired behavior assertions and full visual review with "
        "no major differences. A fidelity milestone alone does not complete this strict parent. "
        "Whole-App parity and function semantics are outside this UI behavior contract.\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return seal_case(root, "ios_copy_workflow", status=status, bundle_id=inputs["bundle_id"],
                     device_id_sha256_prefix=hashlib.sha256(inputs["udid"].encode()).hexdigest()[:16])


def copy_ios(udid: str, bundle: str, scripts: list[Path], project: Path,
             rebuilt_bundle: str, output: Path, mode: str = "standard", *,
             discovery: Optional[Path] = None, auto_discover: bool = False,
             packages: Optional[list[Path]] = None, flow_ids: Optional[list[str]] = None,
             backend: Optional[str] = None,
             resume: bool = False, retry_failed: bool = False, enhanced_collector=None,
             enhancement_request: Optional[dict] = None,
             ssh_port=22222, ssh_identity=Path("cases/ssh/id_ed25519"),
             ssh_known_hosts=Path("cases/ssh-known-hosts")) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    output = output.resolve()
    inputs = _inputs(udid, bundle, rebuilt_bundle, project, mode, scripts, discovery,
                     auto_discover, packages or [], flow_ids, backend, enhancement_request)
    if output == project.resolve() or output in project.resolve().parents or project.resolve() in output.parents:
        raise ValueError("project and evidence must be separate directory trees")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        if not resume or read_json(output / "inputs.json") != inputs:
            raise ValueError("resume requires this workflow's exact inputs")
        previous = read_json(output / "manifest.json")
        if previous.get("kind") != "ios_copy_workflow" or not compare(output, previous["evidence"]):
            raise ValueError("saved workflow evidence changed; preserve it and start a new case")
    else:
        if resume:
            raise ValueError("resume requires an existing workflow")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        write_json(output / "inputs.json", inputs)
    status = "failed"
    try:
        if not (output / "capabilities").exists():
            collect_capabilities(udid, output / "capabilities", mode, ssh_port, ssh_identity, ssh_known_hosts)
        plan = _plan(output, inputs)
        discovery_dir = output / "discovery-agent"
        if auto_discover and not (discovery_dir / "TASK.md").exists():
            discovery_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            (discovery_dir / "TASK.md").write_text(
                f"# Discover representative flows\n\nObserve `{bundle}` on exact USB device `{udid}`. "
                "Write 3–12 distinct bounded flows using visible entry assertions, at most eight actions, "
                "a post-action behavior assertion and a stable final screenshot. Review side effects before replay. "
                f"Run `copyapp discover-check --mode {plan['selected_mode']} --backend {plan['ui_backend']} "
                f"--udid {udid} --bundle {bundle} --script <PATH> ... --out {discovery_dir / 'discovery'}` "
                "then resume this workflow. Work in the current agent session; do not launch another coding agent.\n",
                encoding="utf-8")
        (output / "TASK.md").write_text(
            "# Continue the UI-first workflow\n\n"
            "1. Complete discovery-agent/TASK.md if present.\n"
            "2. Review analysis/TASK.md, every screenshot and raw accessibility observation. Write reviewed findings "
            "and feature-spec (with all source script hashes, bounded scope, unknowns and independent Bundle ID). "
            f"Use execution_mode `{plan['selected_mode']}` and rebuilt Bundle ID `{rebuilt_bundle}`. "
            "Run `copyapp report --case <THIS>/analysis --findings <JSON> --feature-spec <JSON> "
            "--out <THIS>/analysis-agent/reviewed-report`, then `copyapp analysis-delivery --task <THIS>/analysis "
            "--report <THIS>/analysis-agent/reviewed-report --out <THIS>/analysis-agent/analysis-delivery`. Resume.\n"
            "3. Follow rebuild-preparation/task/TASK.md. Freeze capability coverage and fidelity before implementation "
            "using docs/coverage-targets.md and docs/fidelity.md. Implement in the pinned sibling project, build, "
            "sign, install via USB in standard mode, run rebuild-task-check, inspect all screenshot pairs, create "
            "visual-review and agent-delivery at rebuild-agent/agent-delivery. Use the current session, without --run. "
            "Record every difference and omitted flow. Resume this exact workflow.\n"
            "A bounded fidelity result does not replace the strict delivery gates of this parent.\n",
            encoding="utf-8")
        selected = _scripts(output, inputs, plan)
        if not selected:
            status = "needs_discovery"
        else:
            analysis = output / "analysis"
            if not analysis.exists() or read_json(analysis / "analysis.json")["status"] != "complete":
                collect_ios_analysis(udid, bundle, selected, analysis, mode, analysis.exists(), retry_failed,
                                     ssh_port=ssh_port, ssh_identity=ssh_identity, ssh_known_hosts=ssh_known_hosts,
                                     enhanced_collector=enhanced_collector, package_cases=packages,
                                     enhancement_request=enhancement_request)
            collection = _collection(output, inputs, selected, plan)
            if collection["status"] != "complete":
                status = "collection_failed"
            elif not _report_ready(output, inputs):
                status = "needs_behavior_review"
            else:
                prep = output / "rebuild-preparation"
                prepare_rebuild(output / "analysis-agent/reviewed-report", prep, plan["ui_backend"],
                                flow_ids, udid, project, prep.exists())
                if not _handoff_ready(output, inputs, plan):
                    status = "needs_rebuild_evidence"
                elif _rebuild_ready(output, prep / "task", "current"):
                    status = "complete"
                else:
                    status = "needs_implementation"
        return _save(output, inputs, status), status == "complete"
    except Exception as exc:
        return _save(output, inputs, "failed", exc), False


def validate_ios_workflow(root: Path, manifest: dict) -> bool:
    inputs, state = read_json(root / "inputs.json"), read_json(root / "workflow.json")
    if "enhancement_request" in inputs:
        _validate_enhancement_settings(inputs["enhancement_request"])
        if inputs["requested_mode"] == "standard":
            return False
    if (manifest.get("status") != state["status"] or manifest.get("bundle_id") != inputs["bundle_id"] or
            manifest.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != hashlib.sha256(inputs["udid"].encode()).hexdigest()[:16] or
            state.get("scope") != "selected_flows" or state.get("agent_provider") != "current"):
        return False
    if state["status"] == "failed":
        return isinstance(state.get("error"), dict)
    plan = _plan(root, inputs)
    scripts = _scripts(root, inputs, plan)
    if state["status"] == "needs_discovery":
        return inputs["auto_discover"] and not scripts and (root / "discovery-agent/TASK.md").is_file()
    collection = _collection(root, inputs, scripts, plan)
    if state["status"] == "collection_failed":
        return collection["status"] == "failed"
    if collection["status"] != "complete":
        return False
    if state["status"] == "needs_behavior_review":
        return not _report_ready(root, inputs)
    if not _report_ready(root, inputs):
        return False
    ready = _handoff_ready(root, inputs, plan)
    if state["status"] == "needs_rebuild_evidence":
        return not ready
    if not ready:
        return False
    delivered = _rebuild_ready(root, root / "rebuild-preparation/task", "current")
    return (state["status"] == "complete" and delivered or
            state["status"] == "needs_implementation" and not delivered)
```

`copyapp/ipa.py`:

```py
"""Bounded, read-only index of an IPA and its Mach-O load commands."""

import hashlib
import json
import plistlib
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from zipfile import ZipFile


MAX_BINARY = 250 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ASSET_CATALOG = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ASSET_METADATA = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_CATALOGS = 24
MACHO64_LE = b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe"
FAT32_BE = b"\xca\xfe\xba\xbe"
FAT64_BE = b"\xca\xfe\xba\xbf"
MACHO_MAGICS = {MACHO64_LE, FAT32_BE, FAT64_BE}
ARM64_CPU = 0x0100000C
DYLIB_COMMANDS = {0xC, 0x18, 0x1F, 0x20, 0x23}


def _slice_macho(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    if data[:4] == MACHO64_LE:
        return data
    if data[:4] not in (FAT32_BE, FAT64_BE):
        raise ValueError("not a supported arm64 Mach-O")
    fat64 = data[:4] == FAT64_BE
    if len(data) < 8:
        raise ValueError("short fat header")
    count = struct.unpack_from(">I", data, 4)[0]
    if count > 64:
        raise ValueError("too many fat architectures")
    step = 32 if fat64 else 20
    candidates = []
    for index in range(count):
        pos = 8 + index * step
        if pos + step > len(data):
            raise ValueError("truncated fat architecture table")
        cpu = struct.unpack_from(">I", data, pos)[0]
        offset, size = struct.unpack_from(">QQ" if fat64 else ">II", data, pos + 8)
        if offset + size > len(data):
            raise ValueError("fat slice outside file")
        candidates.append((cpu, offset, size))
    match = next((item for item in candidates if item[0] == ARM64_CPU), None)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError("fat binary has no arm64 slice")
    _, offset, size = match
    return data[offset:offset + size]


def inspect_macho(data: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    body = _slice_macho(data)
    if len(body) < 32 or body[:4] != MACHO64_LE:
        raise ValueError("not a supported 64-bit little-endian Mach-O")
    cpu, subtype, _file_type, ncmds, sizeofcmds = struct.unpack_from("<IIIII", body, 4)
    if ncmds > 10000 or 32 + sizeofcmds > len(body):
        raise ValueError("invalid load-command bounds")
    cursor = 32
    dylibs: List[str] = []
    encryption: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None
    uuid = None
    for _ in range(ncmds):
        if cursor + 8 > 32 + sizeofcmds:
            raise ValueError("truncated load command")
        cmd, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", body, cursor)
        if size < 8 or cursor + size > 32 + sizeofcmds:
            raise ValueError("invalid load-command size")
        base_cmd = cmd & 0x7FFFFFFF
        if base_cmd in DYLIB_COMMANDS and size >= 24:
            name_pos = struct.unpack_from("<I", body, cursor + 8)[0]
            if 24 <= name_pos < size:
                raw = body[cursor + name_pos:cursor + size].split(b"\0", 1)[0]
                dylibs.append(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
        elif base_cmd == 0x2C and size >= 24:  # LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO_64
            cryptoff, cryptsize, cryptid = struct.unpack_from("<III", body, cursor + 8)
            encryption = {"cryptoff": cryptoff, "cryptsize": cryptsize, "cryptid": cryptid}
        elif base_cmd == 0x1B and size >= 24:  # LC_UUID
            uuid = body[cursor + 8:cursor + 24].hex()
        cursor += size
    return {
        "cpu_type": cpu, "cpu_subtype": subtype, "uuid": uuid,
        "linked_libraries": sorted(set(dylibs)),
        "encryption_info": encryption,
        "encryption_status": (
            "command_absent" if encryption is None else
            "cryptid_zero" if encryption["cryptid"] == 0 else "cryptid_nonzero"
        ),
        "encrypted_on_disk": encryption is not None and encryption["cryptid"] != 0,
    }


def _catalog_assets(metadata: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(metadata, list):
        raise ValueError("assetutil metadata is not a list")
    grouped: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for row in metadata:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise ValueError("assetutil metadata contains a non-object row")
        name = row.get("Name")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
            continue  # The catalog header has no asset name.
        entry = grouped.setdefault(name, {"name": name, "types": set(), "renditions": set(),
                                          "idioms": set(), "scales": set(), "pixel_sizes": set(),
                                          "variant_count": 0})
        entry["variant_count"] += 1
        for source, target in (("AssetType", "types"), ("RenditionName", "renditions"),
                               ("Idiom", "idioms")):
            value = row.get(source)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                entry[target].add(value)
        scale = row.get("Scale")
        if isinstance(scale, (int, float)) and not isinstance(scale, bool) and scale > 0:
            entry["scales"].add(scale)
        width, height = row.get("PixelWidth"), row.get("PixelHeight")
        if (isinstance(width, int) and isinstance(height, int) and
                not isinstance(width, bool) and not isinstance(height, bool) and
                0 < width <= 32768 and 0 < height <= 32768):
            entry["pixel_sizes"].add((width, height))
    return [{"name": name, "types": sorted(item["types"]),
             "renditions": sorted(item["renditions"]), "idioms": sorted(item["idioms"]),
             "scales": sorted(item["scales"]),
             "pixel_sizes": [list(size) for size in sorted(item["pixel_sizes"])],
             "variant_count": item["variant_count"]}
            for name, item in sorted(grouped.items())]


def _inspect_asset_catalogs(archive: ZipFile, infos: list, prefix: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    candidates = sorted((item for item in infos if item.filename.startswith(prefix)
                         and item.filename.endswith(".car") and not item.is_dir()),
                        key=lambda item: item.filename)
    available = shutil.which("xcrun") is not None
    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in candidates[:MAX_CATALOGS]:
        result: Dict[str, Any] = {"path": item.filename, "size": item.file_size}
        if item.file_size > MAX_ASSET_CATALOG:
            result["status"] = "skipped: catalog exceeds size limit"
            results.append(result)
            continue
        blob = archive.read(item)
        result["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
        if not available:
            result["status"] = "assetutil unavailable"
            results.append(result)
            continue
        try:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="copyapp-assets-") as temporary:
                car = Path(temporary) / "Assets.car"
                metadata_path = Path(temporary) / "metadata.json"
                car.write_bytes(blob)
                with metadata_path.open("wb") as destination:
                    completed = subprocess.run(["xcrun", "assetutil", "--info", str(car)],
                                               stdout=destination, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                               timeout=45, check=False)
                if completed.returncode:
                    raise ValueError(f"assetutil exit code {completed.returncode}")
                if metadata_path.stat().st_size > MAX_ASSET_METADATA:
                    raise ValueError("assetutil metadata exceeds size limit")
                result["assets"] = _catalog_assets(json.loads(metadata_path.read_text("utf-8")))
                result["asset_count"] = len(result["assets"])
                result["status"] = "indexed"
        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
            result["status"] = f"assetutil failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:240]
        results.append(result)
    if len(candidates) > MAX_CATALOGS:
        results.append({"status": "skipped: catalog count exceeds limit",
                        "remaining_count": len(candidates) - MAX_CATALOGS})
    return results


def analyze_ipa(path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    path = path.resolve(strict=True)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    ipa_digest = digest.hexdigest()
    with ZipFile(path) as archive:
        infos = archive.infolist()
        names = [item.filename for item in infos]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
            raise ValueError("IPA contains duplicate ZIP paths")
        info_path = next((i.filename for i in infos if i.filename.startswith("Payload/")
                          and i.filename.endswith(".app/Info.plist")
                          and i.filename.count("/") == 2), None)
        if info_path is None:
            raise ValueError("IPA has no Payload/*.app/Info.plist")
        if archive.getinfo(info_path).file_size > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise ValueError("Info.plist exceeds size limit")
        plist = plistlib.loads(archive.read(info_path))
        prefix = info_path[:-len("Info.plist")]
        executable = plist.get("CFBundleExecutable")
        if not executable:
            raise ValueError("Info.plist has no CFBundleExecutable")
        candidates = {prefix + executable}
        for info in infos:
            name = info.filename
            if not name.startswith(prefix) or info.is_dir():
                continue
            if name.endswith(".dylib"):
                candidates.add(name)
            # Embedded executables need not match their framework/extension folder.
            # Inspect a bounded magic prefix so every Mach-O is included, even
            # when a nested Info.plist uses a different executable name.
            if info.file_size >= 4:
                with archive.open(info) as stream:
                    if stream.read(4) in MACHO_MAGICS:
                        candidates.add(name)
        names = set(names)
        binaries = []
        for name in sorted(candidates & names):
            size = archive.getinfo(name).file_size
            if size > MAX_BINARY:
                binaries.append({"path": name, "status": "skipped: binary exceeds size limit"})
                continue
            blob = archive.read(name)
            try:
                analysis = inspect_macho(blob)
                binaries.append({"path": name, "size": size,
                                 "sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(), **analysis})
            except ValueError as exc:
                binaries.append({"path": name, "size": size, "status": str(exc)})
        paths = [item.filename for item in infos if item.filename.startswith(prefix)]
        asset_catalogs = _inspect_asset_catalogs(archive, infos, prefix)
        return {
            "schema_version": 1, "source": str(path), "ipa_sha256": ipa_digest,
            "bundle_id": plist.get("CFBundleIdentifier"),
            "version": plist.get("CFBundleShortVersionString"),
            "build": plist.get("CFBundleVersion"),
            "executable": executable, "file_count": len(paths),
            "frameworks": sorted({p.split(".framework/")[0].rsplit("/", 1)[-1] + ".framework"
                                   for p in paths if ".framework/" in p}),
            "extensions": sorted({p.split(".appex/")[0].rsplit("/", 1)[-1] + ".appex"
                                   for p in paths if ".appex/" in p}),
            "binaries": binaries, "asset_catalogs": asset_catalogs,
        }


def write_ipa_report(result: Dict[str, Any], output: Path) -> None:
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (output / "ipa-index.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    lines = [
        f"# IPA 静态索引：{result['bundle_id']}", "",
        f"- 版本：{result['version']}（构建 {result['build']}）",
        f"- IPA SHA-256：`{result['ipa_sha256']}`",
        f"- 包内文件：{result['file_count']}",
        f"- Framework：{', '.join(result['frameworks']) or '未发现'}",
        f"- 扩展：{', '.join(result['extensions']) or '未发现'}", "",
        "## Mach-O 二进制", "",
    ]
    for binary in result["binaries"]:
        lines.extend([f"### `{binary['path']}`", ""])
        if "status" in binary:
            lines.extend([f"- 状态：{binary['status']}", ""])
            continue
        encryption_status = binary.get("encryption_status")
        if encryption_status == "command_absent":
            state = "未发现 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO；本工具未执行脱壳"
        elif encryption_status == "cryptid_zero":
            state = "存在 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO，cryptid=0；本工具未执行脱壳"
        elif encryption_status == "cryptid_nonzero":
            state = "存在 LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO，cryptid 非零；磁盘文件仍标记为加密"
        else:
            state = "未知"
        lines.extend([
            f"- 文件 SHA-256：`{binary['sha256']}`",
            f"- Mach-O UUID：`{binary['uuid']}`",
            f"- 加密命令状态：{state}",
            f"- 链接库：{', '.join(binary['linked_libraries']) or '无可见 LC_LOAD_DYLIB'}", "",
        ])
    lines.extend(["## 资源目录", ""])
    catalogs = result.get("asset_catalogs", [])
    if not catalogs:
        lines.extend(["未发现 Assets.car 资源目录。", ""])
    for catalog in catalogs:
        lines.append(f"### `{catalog.get('path', '额外资源目录')}`")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- 状态：{catalog['status']}")
        if catalog.get("sha256"):
            lines.append(f"- 文件 SHA-256：`{catalog['sha256']}`")
        if catalog.get("status") == "indexed":
            assets = catalog["assets"]
            lines.append(f"- 命名资源：{len(assets)}；完整目录见 `ipa-index.json` 的 `asset_catalogs`。")
            interesting = [item for item in assets if any(word in item["name"].lower()
                           for word in ("login", "auth", "logo", "whale", "icon"))][:80]
            if interesting:
                lines.extend(["", "| 资源名 | 类型 | 变体 |", "| --- | --- | ---: |"])
                for item in interesting:
                    lines.append(f"| `{item['name'].replace('|', '&#124;')}` | "
                                 f"{', '.join(item['types'])} | {item['variant_count']} |")
        lines.append("")
    lines.extend(["## 边界", "", "该索引解析包结构、Mach-O 加载命令及可用时的 Assets.car 命名资源元数据；它不导出图像像素，不证明哪个资源出现在特定界面，也不包含方法体或运行行为。", ""])
    (output / "ipa-report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    evidence = []
    for name in ("ipa-index.json", "ipa-report.md"):
        data = (output / name).read_bytes()
        evidence.append({"path": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
    (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "ipa_static_index",
        "source_ipa": str(Path(result["source"]).resolve()),
        "ipa_sha256": result["ipa_sha256"], "evidence": evidence,
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```

`copyapp/macos/acquire.py`:

```py
"""Acquire a stable guest .app snapshot through the bounded collector."""

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.environment import environment_session
from copyapp.macos.observation import validate_reply
from copyapp.macos.package import index_app


def acquire_app(environment: Path, app_path: str, bundle_id: str, output: Path,
                timeout: float = 60) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    environment = environment.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == environment or environment in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("acquisition must be outside its source environment")
    if not verify_case(environment):
        raise ValueError("source environment is not verified")
    case = Case(output, "mac_app_acquisition")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(environment, case.root / "environment", symlinks=True)
        case.record("environment/manifest.json")
        with environment_session(environment, timeout) as (computer, collector, registered, health):
            case.add("session-health.json", health)
            identity = collector.call("app_identity", {"app_path": app_path, "bundle_id": bundle_id})
            case.add("identity.json", identity)
            facts = identity["response"]["result"]
            exported = collector.call("export_app", {"app_path": facts["app_path"], "bundle_id": bundle_id,
                                                      "binary_sha256": facts["binary_sha256"]})
            case.add("export.json", exported)
            result = exported["response"]["result"]
            relative = result["relative_path"]
            parts = PurePosixPath(relative).parts
            if (len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "exports" or
                    parts[1] != exported["request"]["request_id"] or
                    not parts[2].endswith(".app") or str(PurePosixPath(relative)) != relative):
                raise ValueError("invalid guest package export path")
            source = collector.responses.joinpath(*parts)
            base = collector.root / "outbox"
            if (base.resolve() != base or base not in source.resolve(strict=True).parents or
                    any(path.is_symlink() for path in [source, *source.parents]
                        if path == base or base in path.parents)):
                raise ValueError("guest package export escapes its outbox")
            package = index_app(source, case.root / "package")
            case.record("package/manifest.json")
            index = json.loads((package / "app-index.json").read_text())
            if result["package_sha256"] != index["package_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("exported package differs from the observed guest bundle")
            case.add("acquisition.json", {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "bundle_id": bundle_id,
                                          "scope": "guest_package_snapshot", "guest_app_path": facts["app_path"],
                                          "environment_manifest_sha256": digest(environment / "manifest.json"),
                                          "package_manifest_sha256": digest(package / "manifest.json")})
        case.finish("complete", scope="guest_package_snapshot", bundle_id=bundle_id)
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="guest_package_snapshot", bundle_id=bundle_id)
        raise


def validate_acquisition(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    required = {"environment/manifest.json", "package/manifest.json", "session-health.json",
                "identity.json", "export.json", "acquisition.json"}
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "guest_package_snapshot" or
            not required.issubset(names)):
        return False
    if not verify_case(root / "environment") or not verify_case(root / "package"):
        return False
    environment = json.loads((root / "environment/environment.json").read_text())
    package = json.loads((root / "package/app-index.json").read_text())
    health = json.loads((root / "session-health.json").read_text())
    identity = json.loads((root / "identity.json").read_text())
    exported = json.loads((root / "export.json").read_text())
    record = json.loads((root / "acquisition.json").read_text())
    if not validate_reply(health, environment, "health"):
        return False
    instance = health["response"]["collector_instance"]
    if not validate_reply(identity, environment, "app_identity", instance) or not validate_reply(exported, environment, "export_app", instance):
        return False
    if any(item["request"]["session_id"] != health["request"]["session_id"] for item in (identity, exported)):
        return False
    result = exported["response"]["result"]
    facts = identity["response"]["result"]
    guest = result["source_app"]
    params = exported["request"]["params"]
    common = ("bundle_id", "app_path", "executable_path", "binary_sha256", "info_plist_sha256", "version", "build")
    if any(facts.get(key) != guest.get(key) for key in common):
        return False
    app = package["app"]
    if any(app.get(key) != facts.get(key) for key in ("bundle_id", "binary_sha256", "version", "build")):
        return False
    info = next((row for row in package["entries"] if row["path"] == "Contents/Info.plist"), {})
    return (record.get("schema_version") == 2 and record.get("platform") == "macos" and
            record.get("scope") == "guest_package_snapshot" and
            record.get("bundle_id") == manifest.get("bundle_id") == facts["bundle_id"] and
            record.get("guest_app_path") == facts["app_path"] and
            record.get("environment_manifest_sha256") == digest(root / "environment/manifest.json") and
            record.get("package_manifest_sha256") == digest(root / "package/manifest.json") and
            params.get("binary_sha256") == facts["binary_sha256"] and
            params.get("app_path") == facts["app_path"] and params.get("bundle_id") == facts["bundle_id"] and
            info.get("sha256") == facts.get("info_plist_sha256") and
            result.get("package_sha256") == package.get("package_sha256") and
            result.get("entry_count") == len(package["entries"]) and
            result.get("consistency") == "matching_source_copy_source_inventories")
```

`copyapp/macos/bridge.py`:

```py
"""Run-scoped requests to the bounded guest collector through virtio-fs.

The outbox is outside guest snapshots. Unique request IDs, request hashes and
started markers prevent stale replies and blind re-execution after restore.
This is a guest evidence channel, not an arbitrary command-execution service.
"""

import json
import fcntl
import time
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from copyapp.macos.case import canonical
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import UnknownCompletion


METHODS = frozenset({"health", "app_identity", "observe", "launch_app", "export_app", "package_identity", "install_app", "data_file", "quiesce"})
MAX_REPLY = 8 * 1024 * 1024


def atomic_json(path: Path, value: dict):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name("." + path.name + "." + uuid4().hex)
    with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(canonical(value) + b"\n")
    temporary.replace(path)


class Collector:
    def __init__(self, shared_root: Path, collector_sha256: str, timeout: float = 15):
        if (len(collector_sha256) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in collector_sha256)
                or not 0 < timeout <= 120):
            raise ValueError("invalid collector hash or timeout")
        self.root = shared_root.resolve(strict=True)
        self.hash = collector_sha256
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.session = None
        self.instance = None
        self.last_request = None
        self.last_response = None
        self.closed = False
        parent = self.root / "inbox/copyapp-bridge"
        parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._lock = (parent / ".host.lock").open("a+b")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(self._lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            self.new_session()
        except BaseException:
            self._lock.close()
            raise

    def new_session(self):
        """Rotate the protocol epoch while retaining the exclusive host lock.

        This issues no RPC and reuses no request. A failed/closed client cannot
        rotate; inspect the guest and explicitly establish another client.
        """
        if self.closed or self._lock.closed:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot rotate a closed collector; inspect state first")
        self.session = str(uuid4())
        self.instance = None
        self.last_request, self.last_response = None, None
        self.requests = self.root / "inbox/copyapp-bridge" / self.session
        self.responses = self.root / "outbox/copyapp-bridge" / self.session
        self.requests.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        atomic_json(self.root / "inbox/copyapp-bridge/active.json",
                    {"protocol_version": 2, "session_id": self.session})

    def call(self, method: str, params=None) -> dict:
        if self.closed:
            raise RuntimeError("Collector session is closed; establish a new session")
        self.last_request, self.last_response = None, None
        try:
            return self._call(method, params)
        except BaseException as exc:
            if self.last_request is not None:
                exc.collector_evidence = {"request": self.last_request, "response": self.last_response}
            self.close()
            raise

    def _call(self, method: str, params=None) -> dict:
        if method not in METHODS:
            raise ValueError("unsupported collector method")
        if params is not None and not isinstance(params, dict):
            raise ValueError("collector parameters must be an object")
        if method == "quiesce" and (not isinstance(params, dict) or set(params) != {"seconds"} or
                type(params["seconds"]) is not int or not 1 <= params["seconds"] <= 60):
            raise ValueError("collector quiesce requires integer seconds in [1, 60]")
        request_id = str(uuid4())
        request = {"protocol_version": 2, "session_id": self.session,
                   "request_id": request_id, "collector_sha256": self.hash,
                   "method": method, "params": params or {}}
        if self.instance is not None:
            request["collector_instance"] = self.instance
        import hashlib
        request_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical(request)).hexdigest()
        self.last_request, self.last_response = request, None
        atomic_json(self.requests / (request_id + ".json"), request)
        path = self.responses / (request_id + ".json")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.timeout
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if path.exists():
                base = self.root / "outbox"
                if (path.is_symlink() or base.resolve() != base or
                        base not in path.resolve().parents or
                        any(parent.is_symlink() for parent in path.parents
                            if parent != self.root and self.root in parent.parents) or
                        path.stat().st_size > MAX_REPLY):
                    raise ValueError("invalid collector response file")
                response = json.loads(path.read_text())
                self.last_response = response
                if (response.get("protocol_version") != 2 or
                        response.get("session_id") != self.session or
                        response.get("request_id") != request_id or
                        response.get("request_sha256") != request_hash or
                        response.get("collector_sha256") != self.hash):
                    raise ValueError("collector response source/session mismatch")
                instance = response.get("collector_instance")
                UUID(instance)
                if self.instance is not None and instance != self.instance:
                    raise ValueError("collector restarted; establish a new session")
                self.instance = instance
                if response.get("status") != "complete":
                    if response.get("completion_unknown") is True:
                        raise UnknownCompletion("Collector action outcome is unknown; inspect the guest before replay: " +
                                                str(response.get("error", "no detail"))[:2048])
                    raise RuntimeError(str(response.get("error", "collector request failed")))
                if not isinstance(response.get("result"), dict):
                    raise ValueError("invalid collector result")
                return {"request": request, "response": response}
            time.sleep(0.1)
        # Even read-only observations are not silently repeated. Preserve this
        # request in the inbox for diagnosis, and start a new session after reset.
        raise UnknownCompletion("Collector response timed out; preserve request and inspect guest readiness")

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True
        self._lock.close()

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_):
        self.close()

```

`copyapp/macos/build.py`:

```py
"""Build independent Mac source pinned to a reviewed plan, without launching it."""

import hashlib
import os
import platform
import plistlib
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest, now
from copyapp.macos.package import app_facts, index_app, inventory, snapshot_bundle
from copyapp.macos.report import read, text


IGNORED = (".git", ".build", "DerivedData", "__pycache__", ".DS_Store")
MAX_LOG = 16 << 20


def generated_directories(before: list, after: list, recipe: dict) -> list:
    """Permit only Xcode's newly created empty workspace metadata directories."""
    originals = {row["path"]: row for row in before}
    observed = {row["path"]: row for row in after}
    if any(observed.get(name) != row for name, row in originals.items()):
        raise ValueError("build changed captured source inputs")
    added = [row for row in after if row["path"] not in originals]
    prefix = (recipe.get("xcode_project") or "") + "/project.xcworkspace"
    if added and (recipe["mode"] != "xcode" or len(added) > 128 or
                  any(row["kind"] != "directory" or
                      not (row["path"] == prefix or row["path"].startswith(prefix + "/")) for row in added)):
        raise ValueError("build wrote unexpected files into captured source; inspect before a new attempt")
    return added


def relative(value: str) -> str:
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\0" in value or
            PurePosixPath(value).is_absolute() or ".." in PurePosixPath(value).parts or
            str(PurePosixPath(value)) != value or PurePosixPath(value).parts[0] in IGNORED):
        raise ValueError("build input must be a canonical project-relative path")
    return value


def recipe_for(*, swift_sources=(), info_plist=None, resources=None, xcode_project=None,
               scheme=None, configuration="Debug", signing_identity="-", deployment_target="14.0") -> dict:
    sources = list(swift_sources)
    if bool(sources) == bool(xcode_project):
        raise ValueError("choose Swift source files or an Xcode project")
    text(signing_identity)
    if len(signing_identity) > 256 or "\0" in signing_identity:
        raise ValueError("invalid signing identity")
    if xcode_project:
        if sources or info_plist is not None or resources is not None:
            raise ValueError("Swift bundle inputs cannot be mixed with an Xcode build")
        relative(xcode_project); text(scheme); text(configuration)
        if not xcode_project.endswith(".xcodeproj") or any("\0" in value for value in (scheme, configuration)):
            raise ValueError("invalid Xcode project, scheme or configuration")
        if deployment_target not in {None, "14.0"}:
            raise ValueError("set the Xcode deployment target in the project settings")
    else:
        if (not 1 <= len(sources) <= 256 or len(set(sources)) != len(sources) or scheme is not None or
                configuration not in {"Debug", "Release"} or
                not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]?\.[0-9]{1,2}(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?", deployment_target)):
            raise ValueError("invalid Swift source list or deployment target")
        for source in sources:
            if not relative(source).endswith(".swift"):
                raise ValueError("Swift inputs must have a .swift extension")
        relative(info_plist)
        if resources is not None:
            relative(resources)
    return {"mode": "xcode" if xcode_project else "swift", "swift_sources": sources,
            "info_plist": info_plist, "resources": resources, "xcode_project": xcode_project,
            "scheme": scheme, "configuration": configuration, "signing_identity": signing_identity,
            "deployment_target": None if xcode_project else deployment_target}


def run_command(argv: list, cwd: Path, logs: list, timeout: float, *, sdk_root=None):
    """Retain bounded output and stop only this owned build's process group."""
    log = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(cwd), "started_at": now(), "timed_out": False}
    environment = None
    if sdk_root is not None:
        environment = dict(os.environ, SDKROOT=sdk_root)
        log["environment"] = {"SDKROOT": sdk_root}
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stdout, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as stderr:
        process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                   stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True,
                                   env=environment)
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except BaseException as exc:
            log["timed_out"] = isinstance(exc, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)
            log["interrupted"] = not log["timed_out"]
            try:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            raise
        finally:
            stdout.seek(0); stderr.seek(0)
            out, err = stdout.read(MAX_LOG + 1), stderr.read(MAX_LOG + 1)
            log.update(returncode=process.returncode, finished_at=now(),
                       stdout=out[:MAX_LOG].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                       stderr=err[:MAX_LOG].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                       output_truncated=len(out) > MAX_LOG or len(err) > MAX_LOG)
            logs.append(log)
    if process.returncode or log["output_truncated"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Mac build command failed or exceeded output bound: " + Path(argv[0]).name +
                           "; inspect build-log.json\n" + log["stderr"][-1200:])


def tool(path: str) -> dict:
    # swiftc dispatches by argv[0]; executing its swift-frontend symlink target
    # changes driver behavior. Hash the resolved bytes, execute the driver path.
    driver = Path(path).absolute()
    resolved = driver.resolve(strict=True)
    return {"path": str(driver), "resolved_path": str(resolved), "sha256": digest(resolved)}


def commands(workspace: Path, target: dict, recipe: dict, tools: dict, executable: str) -> list:
    source = workspace / "source"
    app = workspace / "products" / PurePosixPath(target["app_path"]).name
    compiler, signer = tools["compiler"]["path"], tools["codesign"]["path"]
    if recipe["mode"] == "swift":
        build = [compiler, "-sdk", tools["sdk"]["path"], "-parse-as-library", "-swift-version", "5", "-target", "arm64-apple-macos" + recipe["deployment_target"],
                 "-O" if recipe["configuration"] == "Release" else "-Onone",
                 *[str(source / name) for name in recipe["swift_sources"]],
                 "-o", str(app / "Contents/MacOS" / executable)]
    else:
        build = [compiler, "-project", str(source / recipe["xcode_project"]), "-scheme", recipe["scheme"],
                 "-configuration", recipe["configuration"], "-sdk", tools["sdk"]["path"],
                 "-destination", "generic/platform=macOS", "-derivedDataPath", str(workspace / "derived"),
                 "CONFIGURATION_BUILD_DIR=" + str(workspace / "products"), "ARCHS=arm64", "ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES",
                 "CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=" + recipe["signing_identity"], "CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual", "build"]
    result = [[compiler, "--version" if recipe["mode"] == "swift" else "-version"], build]
    if recipe["mode"] == "swift":
        result.append([signer, "--force", "--sign", recipe["signing_identity"], "--identifier", target["bundle_id"], str(app)])
    # Xcode signs its products using the project's entitlements. Do not replace
    # that signature with an ad-hoc main-bundle signature after the build.
    return result + [[signer, "--verify", "--deep", "--strict", str(app)],
                     [signer, "--display", "--verbose=4", str(app)]]


def build_app(plan: Path, output: Path, recipe: dict, timeout: float = 1200) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if platform.system() != "Darwin" or platform.machine() != "arm64":
        raise ValueError("initial Mac build support requires an Apple Silicon macOS host")
    if type(timeout) not in {int, float} or not 0 < timeout <= 1800:
        raise ValueError("build timeout must be bounded to thirty minutes")
    plan = plan.resolve(strict=True)
    if not verify_case(plan) or read(plan, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_rebuild_plan":
        raise ValueError("a verified Mac rebuild plan is required")
    frozen = read(plan, "rebuild-plan.json")
    target = frozen["target"]
    project = Path(target["project"]).resolve(strict=True)
    destination = output.resolve()
    if any(destination == parent or parent in destination.parents for parent in (project, plan)):
        raise ValueError("build case must be outside its source project and plan")
    if plan == project or plan in project.parents:
        raise ValueError("independent source must be outside report/plan evidence")
    expected = recipe_for(**{key: value for key, value in recipe.items() if key != "mode"})
    if recipe != expected:
        raise ValueError("invalid Mac build recipe")
    before = inventory(project, exclude=IGNORED)
    case = Case(output, "mac_build")
    logs = []
    try:
        shutil.copytree(plan, case.root / "plan", symlinks=True)
        case.record("plan/manifest.json")
        snapshot_bundle(project, case.root / "source", before)
        if inventory(case.root / "source") != before or inventory(project, exclude=IGNORED) != before:
            raise ValueError("source changed during snapshot")
        case.add("source-index.json", {"entries": before, "ignored_top_level": list(IGNORED),
                                       "sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(before)).hexdigest()})
        case.add("recipe.json", recipe)
        if recipe["mode"] == "swift":
            if (case.root / "source" / recipe["info_plist"]).stat().st_size > 1 << 20:
                raise ValueError("oversized bundle Info.plist")
            info = plistlib.loads((case.root / "source" / recipe["info_plist"]).read_bytes())
            executable = info.get("CFBundleExecutable")
            if (info.get("CFBundleIdentifier") != target["bundle_id"] or info.get("CFBundlePackageType") != "APPL" or
                    not isinstance(executable, str) or Path(executable).name != executable or executable in {"", ".", ".."}):
                raise ValueError("source Info.plist does not match the independent target")
            product = case.root / "products" / PurePosixPath(target["app_path"]).name
            (product / "Contents/MacOS").mkdir(parents=True)
            shutil.copyfile(case.root / "source" / recipe["info_plist"], product / "Contents/Info.plist")
            if recipe["resources"]:
                resource_root = case.root / "source" / recipe["resources"]
                snapshot_bundle(resource_root, product / "Contents/Resources", inventory(resource_root))
            located = subprocess.run(["xcrun", "--find", "swiftc"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
            compiler = located.stdout.strip()
        else:
            executable = ""  # Xcode chooses the product executable from its project.
            product = case.root / "products" / PurePosixPath(target["app_path"]).name
            project_path = case.root / "source" / recipe["xcode_project"]
            if not project_path.is_dir():
                raise ValueError("Xcode project is missing from source snapshot")
            located = subprocess.run(["xcrun", "--find", "xcodebuild"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
            compiler = located.stdout.strip()
        sdk_probe = subprocess.run(["xcrun", "--sdk", "macosx", "--show-sdk-path"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
        # Swift derives the SDK name/version from this versioned spelling.
        # Keep xcrun's versioned spelling for Swift's SDK-name inference.
        # Direct swiftc also needs SDKROOT for its clang linker invocation;
        # without it this toolchain stamps minos as the linked SDK version.
        sdk = Path(sdk_probe.stdout.strip()).absolute()
        sdk_settings = sdk / "SDKSettings.json"
        if sdk_settings.stat().st_size > 1 << 20:
            raise ValueError("oversized SDK metadata")
        case.add("sdk-settings.json", sdk_settings.read_bytes(), binary=True)
        tools = {"compiler": tool(compiler), "codesign": tool(shutil.which("codesign") or "/usr/bin/codesign"),
                 "sdk": {"path": str(sdk), "settings_sha256": digest(case.root / "sdk-settings.json"),
                         "export_root": True}}
        case.add("tools.json", tools)
        for argv in commands(case.root, target, recipe, tools, executable):
            run_command(argv, case.root / "source", logs, timeout, sdk_root=str(sdk))
        facts = app_facts(product)
        if facts["bundle_id"] != target["bundle_id"]:
            raise ValueError("built product has another Bundle ID")
        generated = generated_directories(before, inventory(case.root / "source"), recipe)
        if inventory(project, exclude=IGNORED) != before:
            raise ValueError("host project changed during build; inspect before a new attempt")
        package = index_app(product, case.root / "package")
        case.record("package/manifest.json")
        case.add("build-log.json", logs)
        case.add("build.json", {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "build_only",
                                "workspace": str(case.root), "project": str(project), "executable": executable,
                                "host": {"system": platform.system(), "version": platform.mac_ver()[0], "architecture": platform.machine()},
                                "plan_manifest_sha256": digest(case.root / "plan/manifest.json"),
                                "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(before)).hexdigest(),
                                "generated_source_directories": generated,
                                "package_manifest_sha256": digest(package / "manifest.json"), "app": facts,
                                "installed": False, "behavior_checked": False})
        case.finish("complete", scope="build_only")
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("built case failed source validation")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        if not (case.root / "build-log.json").exists():
            case.add("build-log.json", logs)
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="build_only")
        raise


def validate_build(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    required = {"build.json", "build-log.json", "plan/manifest.json", "source-index.json", "recipe.json", "tools.json", "sdk-settings.json", "package/manifest.json"}
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "build_only" or
            not required.issubset(names) or not verify_case(root / "plan") or not verify_case(root / "package") or
            read(root / "plan", "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_rebuild_plan" or
            read(root / "package", "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_app_index"):
        return False
    saved = read(root, "build.json")
    source = read(root, "source-index.json")
    recipe = read(root, "recipe.json")
    tools = read(root, "tools.json")
    target = read(root / "plan", "rebuild-plan.json")["target"]
    entries = source["entries"]
    generated = generated_directories(entries, inventory(root / "source"), recipe)
    if (recipe != recipe_for(**{key: value for key, value in recipe.items() if key != "mode"}) or
            source != {"entries": entries, "ignored_top_level": list(IGNORED), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(entries)).hexdigest()} or
            set(tools) != {"compiler", "codesign", "sdk"} or
            set(tools["sdk"]) not in ({"path", "settings_sha256"}, {"path", "settings_sha256", "export_root"}) or
            ("export_root" in tools["sdk"] and tools["sdk"]["export_root"] is not True) or
            not Path(tools["sdk"]["path"]).is_absolute() or
            tools["sdk"]["settings_sha256"] != digest(root / "sdk-settings.json")):
        return False
    for value in (tools["compiler"], tools["codesign"]):
        if (set(value) != {"path", "resolved_path", "sha256"} or not Path(value["path"]).is_absolute() or
                not Path(value["resolved_path"]).is_absolute() or
                not re.fullmatch("[a-f0-9]{64}", value["sha256"])):
            return False
    package = read(root / "package", "app-index.json")
    app = package["app"]
    expected_argv = commands(Path(saved["workspace"]), target, recipe, tools, saved["executable"])
    logs = read(root, "build-log.json")
    # Historical cases omit export_root and retain their original log shape.
    expected_environment = {"SDKROOT": tools["sdk"]["path"]} if tools["sdk"].get("export_root") else None
    if (not isinstance(logs, list) or len(logs) != len(expected_argv) or
            any(log.get("argv") != argv or type(log.get("returncode")) is not int or log["returncode"] != 0 or
                log.get("environment") != expected_environment or
                log.get("cwd") != str(Path(saved["workspace"]) / "source") or
                log.get("timed_out") is not False or log.get("output_truncated") is not False
                for log, argv in zip(logs, expected_argv))):
        return False
    if recipe["mode"] == "swift":
        info = plistlib.loads((root / "source" / recipe["info_plist"]).read_bytes())
        if (info.get("CFBundleIdentifier") != target["bundle_id"] or
                info.get("CFBundleExecutable") != saved["executable"] or
                info.get("CFBundlePackageType") != "APPL"):
            return False
    return (type(saved.get("schema_version")) is int and saved["schema_version"] == 2 and
            saved.get("platform") == "macos" and saved.get("scope") == "build_only" and
            saved.get("project") == target["project"] and Path(saved["workspace"]).is_absolute() and
            saved.get("host", {}).get("system") == "Darwin" and saved["host"].get("architecture") == "arm64" and
            saved.get("source_sha256") == source["sha256"] and saved.get("app") == app and
            saved.get("generated_source_directories") == generated and
            app["bundle_id"] == target["bundle_id"] and
            PurePosixPath(package["snapshot_path"]).name == PurePosixPath(target["app_path"]).name and
            saved.get("plan_manifest_sha256") == digest(root / "plan/manifest.json") and
            saved.get("package_manifest_sha256") == digest(root / "package/manifest.json") and
            saved.get("installed") is False and saved.get("behavior_checked") is False)

```

`copyapp/macos/case.py`:

```py
"""Versioned Mac evidence; this never relaxes the legacy iOS validators."""

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath


KINDS = frozenset({"mac_doctor", "mac_app_index", "mac_collector_build",
                   "mac_collector_deployment", "mac_environment", "mac_observation", "mac_app_acquisition",
                   "mac_playbook", "mac_behavior_report", "mac_rebuild_plan", "mac_build", "mac_install",
                   "mac_check_plan", "mac_rebuild_check", "mac_visual_review", "mac_delivery",
                   "mac_share_request", "mac_share_result", "mac_distribution", "mac_discovery", "mac_data_file", "mac_data_schema",
                   "mac_snapshot_inventory", "mac_snapshot_take", "mac_snapshot_restore", "mac_collector_probe"})


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")


def canonical(value) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                      sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    from copyapp.verify import sha256_file
    return sha256_file(path)


class Case:
    def __init__(self, root: Path, kind: str):
        if kind not in KINDS:
            raise ValueError("unknown Mac case kind")
        if root.exists():
            raise FileExistsError("refusing to overwrite case: " + str(root))
        root.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.root = root.resolve()
        self.manifest = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "kind": kind,
                         "status": "collecting", "started_at": now(), "evidence": []}
        self.finish("collecting")

    def add(self, relative: str, value, *, binary=False):
        from copyapp.verify import checked_path
        path = checked_path(self.root, relative)
        if path.exists() or path.name == "manifest.json":
            raise FileExistsError("refusing to overwrite evidence")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(value if binary else canonical(value) + b"\n")
        self.record(relative)

    def record(self, relative: str):
        from copyapp.verify import checked_path
        path = checked_path(self.root, relative)
        if any(item["path"] == relative for item in self.manifest["evidence"]):
            raise ValueError("duplicate evidence path")
        self.manifest["evidence"].append({"path": relative, "sha256": digest(path)})

    def finish(self, status: str, **fields):
        self.manifest.update(fields)
        self.manifest.update(status=status, updated_at=now())
        temporary = self.root / ".manifest.tmp"
        temporary.write_bytes(canonical(self.manifest) + b"\n")
        temporary.replace(self.root / "manifest.json")


def verify_mac_case(root: Path) -> bool:
    """Check all saved bytes and then the kind-specific identity and contracts."""
    from copyapp.verify import checked_path
    try:
        manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
        if (type(manifest.get("schema_version")) is not int or manifest["schema_version"] != 2 or
                manifest.get("platform") != "macos" or manifest.get("kind") not in KINDS or
                manifest.get("status") not in {"complete", "needs_setup", "failed"}):
            return False
        records = manifest["evidence"]
        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
            return False
        names = set()
        for item in records:
            name = item["path"]
            if (not isinstance(name, str) or name in names or name == "manifest.json" or
                    str(PurePosixPath(name)) != name or
                    not isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str) or len(item["sha256"]) != 64):
                return False
            names.add(name)
            path = checked_path(root, name)
            # File links cannot silently replace a captured regular file.
            if root.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(name).parts).is_symlink() or digest(path) != item["sha256"]:
                return False
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_doctor":
            if "doctor.json" not in names:
                return False
            doctor = json.loads((root / "doctor.json").read_text())
            ready = doctor.get("ready")
            if type(ready) is not bool or doctor.get("platform") != "macos":
                return False
            if (manifest["status"] == "complete") != ready:
                return False
            if ready and (doctor.get("scope") != "chatcomputer_transport" or
                          not {"mcp-status.json", "mcp-screenshot.json", "screen.png"}.issubset(names) or
                          doctor.get("exact_app_identity_ready") is not False):
                return False
            if ready:
                from PIL import Image
                import io
                from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import ChatComputer
                raw = json.loads((root / "mcp-screenshot.json").read_text())
                image, _ = ChatComputer.image(raw)
                if hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest() != digest(root / "screen.png"):
                    return False
                with Image.open(io.BytesIO(image)) as opened:
                    opened.verify()
            return True
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_collector_build":
            from copyapp.macos.setup import validate_build
            return validate_build(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_collector_deployment":
            from copyapp.macos.deploy import validate_deployment
            return validate_deployment(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_environment":
            from copyapp.macos.environment import validate_environment
            return validate_environment(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_observation":
            from copyapp.macos.observation import validate_observation
            return validate_observation(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_app_acquisition":
            from copyapp.macos.acquire import validate_acquisition
            return validate_acquisition(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_playbook":
            from copyapp.macos.playbook import validate_playbook
            return validate_playbook(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_behavior_report":
            from copyapp.macos.report import verify_report
            return verify_report(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_rebuild_plan":
            from copyapp.macos.rebuild import validate_plan
            return validate_plan(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_build":
            from copyapp.macos.build import validate_build
            return validate_build(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_install":
            from copyapp.macos.install import validate_install
            return validate_install(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_check_plan":
            from copyapp.macos.checks import validate_check_plan
            return validate_check_plan(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_rebuild_check":
            from copyapp.macos.checks import validate_check
            return validate_check(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_visual_review":
            from copyapp.macos.visual import validate_visual
            return validate_visual(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_delivery":
            from copyapp.macos.delivery import validate_delivery
            return validate_delivery(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_share_request":
            from copyapp.macos.share import validate_request
            return validate_request(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_share_result":
            from copyapp.macos.share import validate_result
            return validate_result(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_distribution":
            from copyapp.macos.distribution import validate_import
            return validate_import(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_discovery":
            from copyapp.macos.discovery import validate_discovery
            return validate_discovery(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_data_file":
            from copyapp.macos.data import validate_data
            return validate_data(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_data_schema":
            from copyapp.macos.data_schema import validate_schema
            return validate_schema(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_snapshot_inventory":
            from copyapp.macos.snapshots import validate_inventory
            return validate_inventory(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] in {"mac_snapshot_take", "mac_snapshot_restore"}:
            from copyapp.macos.snapshots import validate_operation
            return validate_operation(root, manifest, names)
        if manifest["kind"] == "mac_collector_probe":
            from copyapp.macos.probe import validate_probe
            return validate_probe(root, manifest, names)
        from copyapp.macos.package import validate_index
        return validate_index(root, manifest, names)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        return False
```
