"""Explicit single-file App data capture; never a complete or atomic DB snapshot."""

import re
import shutil
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.environment import environment_session
from copyapp.macos.observation import validate_reply
from copyapp.macos.playbook import output_bytes
from copyapp.macos.report import read


MAX_DATA = 64 << 20
ASSOCIATIONS = {"sandbox": "bundle_named_container_convention",
                "preferences": "bundle_named_preferences_convention",
                "support": "explicit_path_not_proof_of_app_ownership"}


def source_path(location: str, relative: str, bundle: str, library: str) -> str:
    if (not isinstance(bundle, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255}", bundle) or bundle in {".", ".."} or
            location not in ASSOCIATIONS or not isinstance(relative, str) or not relative or relative == "." or
            len(relative.encode("utf-8")) > 4096 or "\0" in relative or "\\" in relative or
            PurePosixPath(relative).is_absolute() or str(PurePosixPath(relative)) != relative or
            any(part in {".", ".."} or len(part.encode("utf-8")) > 255 for part in PurePosixPath(relative).parts) or
            not isinstance(library, str) or not library.startswith("/") or "\0" in library or
            ".." in PurePosixPath(library).parts or str(PurePosixPath(library)) != library or
            PurePosixPath(library).name != "Library"):
        raise ValueError("expected a bounded App data location and canonical relative file path")
    if location == "preferences" and relative != bundle + ".plist":
        raise ValueError("preferences capture requires exactly the selected Bundle ID's plist")
    if location == "support" and len(PurePosixPath(relative).parts) < 2:
        raise ValueError("support capture requires an explicit folder and file")
    roots = {"sandbox": PurePosixPath(library) / "Containers" / bundle / "Data",
             "preferences": PurePosixPath(library) / "Preferences",
             "support": PurePosixPath(library) / "Application Support"}
    return str(roots[location] / relative)


def export_record(source: Path, health: dict, exported: dict) -> dict:
    target = read(source, "acquisition.json")
    package = read(source / "package", "app-index.json")
    environment = read(source / "environment", "environment.json")
    if (not validate_reply(health, environment, "health") or
            "data_file" not in health["response"]["result"].get("capabilities", []) or
            "data_file" not in read(source / "environment/collector-build", "collector-build.json")["self_test"]["methods"] or
            not validate_reply(exported, environment, "data_file", health["response"]["collector_instance"]) or
            exported["request"]["session_id"] != health["request"]["session_id"]):
        raise ValueError("data export has a different guest, collector or session")
    params, result = exported["request"]["params"], exported["response"]["result"]
    app = package["app"]
    facts = result["source_app"]
    expected = {"app_path": target["guest_app_path"], "bundle_id": target["bundle_id"],
                "binary_sha256": app["binary_sha256"], "location": result["location"],
                "relative_path": result["relative_source_path"]}
    if params != expected or any(facts[key] != app[key] for key in ("bundle_id", "binary_sha256", "version", "build")):
        raise ValueError("data export does not identify the acquired App build")
    info = next(row for row in package["entries"] if row["path"] == "Contents/Info.plist")
    expected_path = source_path(params["location"], params["relative_path"], app["bundle_id"], result["guest_library"])
    metadata = result["source_metadata"]
    if (facts["app_path"] != target["guest_app_path"] or facts["info_plist_sha256"] != info["sha256"] or
            result["guest_source_path"] != expected_path or result["association"] != ASSOCIATIONS[params["location"]] or
            result["relative_path"] != "data-files/" + exported["request"]["request_id"] + "/file.bin" or
            type(result["size"]) is not int or not 0 <= result["size"] <= MAX_DATA or
            not isinstance(result["sha256"], str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", result["sha256"]) or
            result.get("consistency") != "two_matching_reads_and_export" or result.get("atomic_database_snapshot") is not False or
            result.get("complete_app_data") is not False or not isinstance(metadata, dict) or
            set(metadata) != {"device", "inode", "size", "mtime_seconds", "mtime_nanoseconds", "ctime_seconds", "ctime_nanoseconds"} or
            any(type(value) is not int for value in metadata.values()) or metadata["size"] != result["size"] or
            min(metadata["device"], metadata["inode"]) < 0 or
            not all(0 <= metadata[key] < 1_000_000_000 for key in ("mtime_nanoseconds", "ctime_nanoseconds"))):
        raise ValueError("data source policy or snapshot consistency is invalid")
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "selected_app_data_file",
            "source_manifest_sha256": digest(source / "manifest.json"), "bundle_id": app["bundle_id"],
            "package_sha256": package["package_sha256"], "environment_manifest_sha256": digest(source / "environment/manifest.json"),
            "guest_source_path": expected_path, "location": params["location"], "relative_path": params["relative_path"],
            "association": result["association"], "sha256": result["sha256"], "size": result["size"],
            "atomic_database_snapshot": False, "complete_app_data": False}


def data_file(acquisition: Path, location: str, relative: str, output: Path, timeout: float = 60) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    acquisition = acquisition.resolve(strict=True)
    if (not verify_case(acquisition) or read(acquisition, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_app_acquisition" or
            output.resolve() == acquisition or acquisition in output.resolve().parents):
        raise ValueError("data capture needs a verified Mac acquisition and a separate new output case")
    target = read(acquisition, "acquisition.json")
    package = read(acquisition / "package", "app-index.json")
    source_path(location, relative, target["bundle_id"], "/placeholder/Library")
    case = Case(output, "mac_data_file")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(acquisition, case.root / "source", symlinks=True)
        case.record("source/manifest.json")
        with environment_session(acquisition / "environment", timeout) as (_, collector, _, health):
            case.add("session-health.json", health)
            if "data_file" not in health["response"]["result"].get("capabilities", []):
                raise ValueError("registered collector build does not support bounded data capture")
            exported = collector.call("data_file", {"app_path": target["guest_app_path"], "bundle_id": target["bundle_id"],
                                                    "binary_sha256": package["app"]["binary_sha256"],
                                                    "location": location, "relative_path": relative})
            case.add("export.json", exported)
            record = export_record(case.root / "source", health, exported)
            path = collector.responses / exported["response"]["result"]["relative_path"]
            if collector.responses.resolve() != collector.responses or (collector.root / "outbox").resolve() != collector.root / "outbox":
                raise ValueError("data export workspace is linked")
            data = output_bytes(path, collector.responses, MAX_DATA)
            case.add("data.bin", data, binary=True)
            if digest(case.root / "data.bin") != record["sha256"] or len(data) != record["size"]:
                raise ValueError("returned data differs from the collector's two-read snapshot")
            case.add("data-file.json", record)
        case.finish("complete", scope="selected_app_data_file", bundle_id=target["bundle_id"])
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("copied data source changed during capture")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        if isinstance(getattr(exc, "collector_evidence", None), dict):
            case.add("failed-collector-request.json", exc.collector_evidence)
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="selected_app_data_file")
        raise


def validate_data(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "selected_app_data_file" or
            not {"source/manifest.json", "session-health.json", "export.json", "data.bin", "data-file.json"}.issubset(names) or
            not verify_case(root / "source") or read(root / "source", "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_app_acquisition"):
        return False
    record = export_record(root / "source", read(root, "session-health.json"), read(root, "export.json"))
    return (read(root, "data-file.json") == record and manifest.get("bundle_id") == record["bundle_id"] and
            (root / "data.bin").stat().st_size == record["size"] and digest(root / "data.bin") == record["sha256"])

`copyapp/macos/data_schema.py`:

```py
"""Recomputed structure from one verified Mac data file, without scalar values/rows."""

import json
import plistlib
import shutil
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from xml.parsers.expat import ExpatError

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.report import read
from copyapp.plist_schema import MAX_PLIST_BYTES, _structure


def sqlite_structure(path: Path) -> dict:
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        if stream.read(16) != b"SQLite format 3\0":
            raise ValueError("selected file has no SQLite 3 header")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="copyapp-mac-sqlite-") as temporary:
        copied = Path(temporary) / "source.sqlite"
        shutil.copyfile(path, copied)
        db = sqlite3.connect(copied.as_uri() + "?mode=ro&immutable=1", uri=True, timeout=1)
        try:
            # Some macOS Python builds omit the extension-loading Python API.
            # Independently deny SQL function execution and database attachment.
            disable_extensions = getattr(db, "enable_load_extension", None)
            if disable_extensions is not None: disable_extensions(False)
            db.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
            db.execute("PRAGMA trusted_schema=OFF")
            trusted = db.execute("PRAGMA trusted_schema").fetchone()
            if trusted != (0,):
                raise ValueError("SQLite runtime does not support disabling trusted schema")
            db.set_authorizer(lambda action, *_: sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY if action in {
                sqlite3.SQLITE_FUNCTION, sqlite3.SQLITE_ATTACH, sqlite3.SQLITE_DETACH} else sqlite3.SQLITE_OK)
            deadline, calls = time.monotonic() + 10, [0]

            def interrupt():
                calls[0] += 1
                return int(calls[0] > 2000 or time.monotonic() > deadline)

            db.set_progress_handler(interrupt, 1000)

            def rows(statement, limit):
                result = db.execute(statement).fetchmany(limit + 1)
                if len(result) > limit:
                    raise ValueError("SQLite structure exceeds its object/column/key bound")
                if any(isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 4096 for row in result for value in row):
                    raise ValueError("SQLite structure contains an oversized name or type")
                return result

            objects = [{"type": kind, "name": name, "table": table} for kind, name, table in rows(
                "SELECT type, name, tbl_name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view','index','trigger') ORDER BY type,name", 512)]
            tables = []
            for obj in objects:
                if obj["type"] != "table": continue
                quoted = '"' + obj["name"].replace('"', '""') + '"'
                columns = rows("PRAGMA table_xinfo(" + quoted + ")", 256)
                foreign = rows("PRAGMA foreign_key_list(" + quoted + ")", 512)
                tables.append({"name": obj["name"], "columns": [
                    {"name": row[1], "type": row[2], "not_null": bool(row[3]),
                     "primary_key_position": row[5], "hidden": row[6]} for row in columns],
                    "foreign_keys": [{"from": row[3], "to": row[4], "referenced_table": row[2]} for row in foreign]})
            return {"user_version": db.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0],
                    "application_id": db.execute("PRAGMA application_id").fetchone()[0],
                    "objects": objects, "tables": tables}
        finally:
            db.close()


def structure(path: Path, kind: str) -> dict:
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or not 0 < path.stat().st_size <= 64 << 20:
        raise ValueError("structure needs a bounded nonempty regular file")
    try:
        if kind == "plist":
            if path.stat().st_size > MAX_PLIST_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("property list exceeds the 4 MiB bound")
            return _structure(plistlib.loads(path.read_bytes()))
        if kind == "sqlite":
            return sqlite_structure(path)
        raise ValueError("choose plist or sqlite structure explicitly")
    except (sqlite3.Error, plistlib.InvalidFileException, ExpatError, RecursionError, OverflowError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("selected file could not be parsed within the structure limits") from exc


def schema_record(source: Path, kind: str) -> dict:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if not verify_case(source) or read(source, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_data_file":
        raise ValueError("a verified single-file Mac data acquisition is required")
    data = read(source, "data-file.json")
    if kind not in {"plist", "sqlite"}:
        raise ValueError("choose plist or sqlite structure explicitly")
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "data_structure_only", "format": kind,
            "source_manifest_sha256": digest(source / "manifest.json"), "source_data_sha256": data["sha256"],
            "bundle_id": data["bundle_id"], "package_sha256": data["package_sha256"],
            "environment_manifest_sha256": data["environment_manifest_sha256"],
            "guest_app_path": read(source / "source", "acquisition.json")["guest_app_path"],
            "guest_source_path": data["guest_source_path"], "association": data["association"],
            "atomic_database_snapshot": False, "complete_app_data": False,
            "scalar_values_exported": False, "rows_exported": False, "sql_bodies_exported": False,
            "wal_included": False, "function_analysis": "not_performed"}


def schema_markdown(record: dict, value: dict) -> str:
    return ("# Mac data structure\n\nFormat: " + record["format"] + ".\n\n"
            "Source association: `" + record["association"] + "`. This does not prove App ownership.\n\n"
            "Only key paths/types or SQLite schema metadata are described. Scalar values,\n"
            "table rows, SQL bodies and defaults are omitted. Names themselves may be private.\n"
            "SQLite inspection uses the saved main file alone; no WAL or SHM is merged.\n"
            "This is neither an atomic database snapshot nor complete App data or function analysis.\n\n"
            "[Source identity](data-schema.json) · [Structure](structure.json)\n\n```json\n" +
            json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n```\n")


def data_schema(source: Path, kind: str, output: Path) -> Path:
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == source or source in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("structure case must be outside its source data case")
    schema_record(source, kind)
    case = Case(output, "mac_data_schema")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(source, case.root / "source", symlinks=True)
        case.record("source/manifest.json")
        record = schema_record(case.root / "source", kind)
        value = structure(case.root / "source/data.bin", kind)
        if digest(case.root / "source/data.bin") != record["source_data_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("data changed during structure extraction")
        case.add("data-schema.json", record)
        case.add("structure.json", value)
        case.add("schema.md", schema_markdown(record, value).encode("utf-8"), binary=True)
        case.finish("complete", scope="data_structure_only", format=kind)
        from copyapp.verify import verify_case
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("structure source revalidation failed")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="data_structure_only", format=kind)
        raise


def validate_schema(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "data_structure_only" or
            not {"source/manifest.json", "data-schema.json", "structure.json", "schema.md"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    record = schema_record(root / "source", manifest["format"])
    value = structure(root / "source/data.bin", record["format"])
    return (read(root, "data-schema.json") == record and read(root, "structure.json") == value and
            (root / "schema.md").read_text() == schema_markdown(record, value))


def report_data_source(root: Path, source_id: str) -> dict:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if not verify_case(root) or read(root, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_data_schema":
        raise ValueError("report data citations require a verified Mac structure case")
    record = read(root, "data-schema.json")
    return {"id": source_id, "manifest_sha256": digest(root / "manifest.json"),
            "structure_sha256": digest(root / "structure.json"), **record}

`copyapp/macos/delivery.py`:

```py
"""Source-linked selected Mac delivery with explicit known-capability decisions."""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.macos.build import IGNORED
from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest, now
from copyapp.macos.checks import require, timestamp
from copyapp.macos.package import inventory
from copyapp.macos.report import read, text


def delivery_record(visual: Path, coverage: dict, source_review: dict) -> dict:
    require(visual, "mac_visual_review")
    review = read(visual, "visual-review.json")
    if any(review[key] for key in ("major_differences", "starting_state_issues", "dimension_mismatches")):
        raise ValueError("delivery requires no major visual difference, equivalent starting states and matching image dimensions")
    check = visual / "check"
    comparison = read(check, "comparison.json")
    install = check / "plan/install"
    build = install / "build"
    frozen = read(build / "plan", "rebuild-plan.json")
    spec = read(build / "plan/report", "feature-spec.json")
    if (not isinstance(coverage, dict) or set(coverage) != {"schema_version", "platform", "reviewer", "capabilities"} or
            type(coverage.get("schema_version")) is not int or coverage["schema_version"] != 2 or coverage.get("platform") != "macos"):
        raise ValueError("invalid Mac capability review")
    text(coverage["reviewer"])
    decisions = coverage["capabilities"]
    capabilities = spec["capabilities"]
    if not isinstance(decisions, list) or [row["id"] for row in decisions] != [row["id"] for row in capabilities]:
        raise ValueError("review each frozen known capability exactly once in inventory order")
    verified, selected, target = [], set(frozen["selected_flow_ids"]), set(frozen["target_capability_ids"])
    for decision, capability in zip(decisions, capabilities):
        if (set(decision) != {"id", "decision", "evidence_flow_ids", "reason"} or
                decision["decision"] not in {"verified", "deferred", "blocked"} or
                not isinstance(decision["evidence_flow_ids"], list)):
            raise ValueError("invalid known-capability decision")
        text(decision["reason"])
        if decision["decision"] == "verified":
            if (decision["id"] not in target or capability["disposition"] != "available" or
                    not capability["flow_ids"] or not set(capability["flow_ids"]).issubset(selected) or
                    decision["evidence_flow_ids"] != sorted(capability["flow_ids"])):
                raise ValueError("verified capabilities need all their selected flow gates and an explicit planned target")
            verified.append(decision["id"])
        elif decision["evidence_flow_ids"]:
            raise ValueError("unverified capabilities must not claim accepted flow evidence")
    if set(verified) != target:
        raise ValueError("the frozen target has not received a verified decision for every selected capability")
    source = read(build, "source-index.json")
    if (set(source_review) != {"project", "source_sha256", "entries", "reviewed_at"} or
            source_review.get("project") != frozen["target"]["project"] or
            source_review.get("source_sha256") != source["sha256"] or
            type(source_review.get("entries")) is not int or source_review["entries"] != len(source["entries"])):
        raise ValueError("current project review differs from built source")
    timestamp(source_review["reviewed_at"])
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "selected_behavior_delivery",
            "visual_review_manifest_sha256": digest(visual / "manifest.json"),
            "install_manifest_sha256": digest(install / "manifest.json"),
            "build_manifest_sha256": digest(build / "manifest.json"), "source_sha256": source["sha256"],
            "original_app": spec["app"], "rebuilt_app": read(build, "build.json")["app"],
            "execution_environment": "chatcomputer_vm", "physical_mac_verified": False,
            "coverage_reviewer": coverage["reviewer"], "known_capability_decisions": decisions,
            "coverage": {**frozen["coverage"], "verified_known_capabilities": len(verified),
                         "verified_known_percent": round(100 * len(verified) / len(capabilities), 2),
                         "selected_flow_pass_rate": comparison["selected_flow_pass_rate"]},
            "selected_flow_ids": frozen["selected_flow_ids"], "omitted_flow_ids": frozen["omitted_flow_ids"],
            "rounds": comparison["rounds"], "selected_comparisons": comparison["selected_comparisons"],
            "visual_review": {key: review[key] for key in ("reviewer", "complete", "major_differences", "minor_differences", "starting_state_issues")},
            "unknowns": spec["unknowns"], "function_analysis": "not_performed",
            "network_expectation_status": "reviewer_declared_not_enforced", "whole_app_parity": False}


def markdown(data: dict, visual: Path) -> str:
    coverage = data["coverage"]
    lines = ["# Selected Mac behavior delivery", "",
             "Original: `" + data["original_app"]["bundle_id"] + "`; independent rebuild: `" + data["rebuilt_app"]["bundle_id"] + "`.", "",
             "Environment: ChatComputer VM. This delivery does not establish physical-Mac compatibility.", "",
             "Target known coverage: " + str(coverage["target_known_capabilities"]) + "/" + str(coverage["known_capabilities"]) +
             " (" + str(coverage["target_percent"]) + "%). Verified known coverage: " + str(coverage["verified_known_capabilities"]) + "/" +
             str(coverage["known_capabilities"]) + " (" + str(coverage["verified_known_percent"]) + "%).", "",
             "Selected-flow checks: " + str(data["selected_comparisons"]) + " comparisons across " + str(data["rounds"]) +
             " rounds; " + str(coverage["selected_flow_pass_rate"]) + "% passed their explicit behavior assertions.", "",
             "The denominator is the reviewed known inventory. The selected-flow pass rate is not whole-App parity.", "",
             "All required full screenshot pairs and starting states have explicit review judgments.",
             "Minor differences remain recorded below. Review labels and capability semantics are self-declared;",
             "verification checks provenance, coverage and arithmetic. Function analysis was not performed.", "",
             "[Source/build](visual/check/plan/install/build/build.json) · [Source snapshot](visual/check/plan/install/build/source/) · " +
             "[Paired check](visual/check/comparison.json) · [Full visual review](visual/review.md)", "",
             "## Known capability decisions", ""]
    for row in data["known_capability_decisions"]:
        lines.append("- " + row["id"] + ": " + row["decision"] + ". " + row["reason"])
    lines.extend(["", "## Recorded visual differences", ""])
    differences = [row for row in read(visual, "visual-review.json")["judgments"] if row["verdict"] != "equivalent"]
    lines.extend(["- " + row["id"] + ": " + row["notes"] for row in differences] or ["No differences were recorded by the reviewer in the selected screenshot pairs."])
    lines.extend(["", "## Omitted and unknown scope", "", "Omitted report flows: " + (", ".join(data["omitted_flow_ids"]) or "none") + ".", ""])
    lines.extend(["- " + item for item in data["unknowns"]])
    lines.extend(["", "Network expectations were declared by the reviewer and were not automatically enforced.", ""])
    return "\n".join(lines)


def delivery(visual: Path, coverage_path: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    visual = visual.resolve(strict=True)
    require(visual, "mac_visual_review")
    if output.resolve() == visual or visual in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("delivery must be outside its visual review")
    coverage = json.loads(coverage_path.read_text())
    build = visual / "check/plan/install/build"
    source = read(build, "source-index.json")
    project = Path(read(build / "plan", "rebuild-plan.json")["target"]["project"])
    entries = inventory(project, exclude=IGNORED)
    if entries != source["entries"]:
        raise ValueError("current project differs from the installed build; review and build a new attempt")
    source_review = {"project": str(project), "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(entries)).hexdigest(),
                     "entries": len(entries), "reviewed_at": now()}
    delivery_record(visual, coverage, source_review)
    case = Case(output, "mac_delivery")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(visual, case.root / "visual", symlinks=True)
        case.record("visual/manifest.json")
        if inventory(project, exclude=IGNORED) != entries:
            raise ValueError("project changed during delivery capture")
        case.add("source-review.json", source_review)
        case.add("coverage-review.json", coverage)
        data = delivery_record(case.root / "visual", coverage, source_review)
        case.add("delivery.json", data)
        case.add("delivery.md", markdown(data, case.root / "visual").encode("utf-8"), binary=True)
        case.finish("complete", scope="selected_behavior_delivery")
        require(case.root, "mac_delivery")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="selected_behavior_delivery")
        raise


def validate_delivery(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "selected_behavior_delivery" or
            not {"visual/manifest.json", "source-review.json", "coverage-review.json", "delivery.json", "delivery.md"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    source_review = read(root, "source-review.json")
    if timestamp(source_review["reviewed_at"]) > timestamp(manifest["updated_at"]):
        return False
    data = delivery_record(root / "visual", read(root, "coverage-review.json"), source_review)
    return canonical(data) == canonical(read(root, "delivery.json")) and (root / "delivery.md").read_text() == markdown(data, root / "visual")

```

`copyapp/macos/deploy.py`:

```py
"""Prepare only the collector's own files for a read-only guest share."""

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest


def collector_launcher(binary_hash: str, request_accessibility: bool) -> str:
    # Only a verifier-produced digest and an explicit boolean become code.
    if type(request_accessibility) is not bool or len(binary_hash) != 64 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in binary_hash):
        raise ValueError("invalid collector launcher identity or permission request")
    return '''#!/bin/zsh
set -eu
[[ -d "/Volumes/My Shared Files/inbox" ]] || { print -u2 "Run this launcher inside the ChatComputer guest"; exit 1; }
[[ "$(/usr/sbin/sysctl -n kern.hv_vmm_present 2>/dev/null || print 0)" == "1" ]] || { print -u2 "This launcher is for a virtual Mac"; exit 1; }
copyapp_source="${0:A:h}/source-build/CopyAppMacCollector.app"
copyapp_install="$HOME/Applications/CopyAppTools/HASH"
if [[ ! -d "$copyapp_install/CopyAppMacCollector.app" ]]; then
    /bin/mkdir -p "$copyapp_install"
    /usr/bin/ditto "$copyapp_source" "$copyapp_install/CopyAppMacCollector.app"
fi
/usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict "$copyapp_install/CopyAppMacCollector.app"
copyapp_actual=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$copyapp_install/CopyAppMacCollector.app/Contents/MacOS/CopyAppMacCollector" | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')
[[ "$copyapp_actual" == "HASH" ]] || { print -u2 "Collector hash mismatch"; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/open "$copyapp_install/CopyAppMacCollector.app" --args --shared-root "/Volumes/My Shared Files"ACCESSIBILITY
'''.replace("HASH", binary_hash).replace("ACCESSIBILITY", " --request-accessibility" if request_accessibility else "")


def prepare_collector(build: Path, output: Path, request_accessibility: bool = False) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    build = build.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == build or build in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("deployment must be outside the build case")
    if not verify_case(build):
        raise ValueError("collector build case is not verified")
    manifest = json.loads((build / "manifest.json").read_text())
    if manifest.get("kind") != "mac_collector_build" or manifest.get("status") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("a complete collector build is required")
    metadata = json.loads((build / "collector-build.json").read_text())
    case = Case(output, "mac_collector_deployment")
    source = case.root / "payload/source-build"
    shutil.copytree(build, source, symlinks=True)
    case.record("payload/source-build/manifest.json")
    binary_hash = metadata["executable_sha256"]
    script = collector_launcher(binary_hash, request_accessibility)
    case.add("payload/Start Collector.command", script.encode(), binary=True)
    (case.root / "payload/Start Collector.command").chmod(0o755)
    case.add("deployment.json", {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos",
                                "build_manifest_sha256": digest(source / "manifest.json"),
                                "collector_sha256": binary_hash,
                                "share_path": "payload", "launcher": "payload/Start Collector.command",
                                "guest_shared_root": "/Volumes/My Shared Files",
                                "request_accessibility": request_accessibility,
                                "status": "prepared_not_installed"})
    case.finish("complete", scope="collector_deployment_preparation")
    return case.root


def validate_deployment(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or
            manifest.get("scope") != "collector_deployment_preparation" or
            not {"deployment.json", "payload/Start Collector.command",
                 "payload/source-build/manifest.json"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    record = json.loads((root / "deployment.json").read_text())
    build = root / "payload/source-build"
    source_manifest = json.loads((build / "manifest.json").read_text())
    metadata = json.loads((build / "collector-build.json").read_text())
    return (record.get("schema_version") == 2 and record.get("platform") == "macos" and
            record.get("status") == "prepared_not_installed" and
            record.get("share_path") == "payload" and
            record.get("launcher") == "payload/Start Collector.command" and
            record.get("guest_shared_root") == "/Volumes/My Shared Files" and
            record.get("build_manifest_sha256") == digest(build / "manifest.json") and
            record.get("collector_sha256") == metadata["executable_sha256"] and
            type(record.get("request_accessibility")) is bool and
            (root / record["launcher"]).read_text() == collector_launcher(metadata["executable_sha256"], record["request_accessibility"]) and
            (root / record["launcher"]).stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o755 and
            source_manifest.get("kind") == "mac_collector_build" and verify_case(build))

`copyapp/macos/discovery.py`:

```py
"""Accept reviewed representative Mac flows without launching another agent."""

import hashlib
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.report import flow_source, identifier, read, text, unique_rows


def discovery_sources(flows: dict) -> tuple:
    if not isinstance(flows, dict) or not 3 <= len(flows) <= 12:
        raise ValueError("discovery needs three to twelve completed representative Mac flows")
    roots, sources, fingerprints = {}, {}, set()
    for flow_id, value in flows.items():
        identifier(flow_id)
        root = Path(value).resolve(strict=True)
        source = flow_source(root, flow_id)
        script = read(root, "playbook.json")
        # Renaming one replay does not make it a different representative flow.
        effective = {key: value for key, value in script.items() if key != "scenario_id"}
        fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(canonical(effective)).hexdigest()
        if fingerprint in fingerprints:
            raise ValueError("discovery contains duplicate effective playbooks")
        fingerprints.add(fingerprint)
        roots[flow_id] = root
        sources[flow_id] = {**source, "guest_app_path": script["app_path"],
                            "effective_script_sha256": fingerprint}
    if len({(row["package_sha256"], row["environment_manifest_sha256"], row["guest_app_path"])
            for row in sources.values()}) != 1:
        raise ValueError("discovery flows must use one exact original App and registered environment")
    return roots, sources


def validate_review(review: dict, sources: dict):
    if (set(review) != {"schema_version", "platform", "scope", "reviewer", "selection_note",
                        "flows", "capabilities", "inventory_note", "unknowns"} or
            type(review.get("schema_version")) is not int or review["schema_version"] != 2 or
            review.get("platform") != "macos" or review.get("scope") != "representative_flow_discovery"):
        raise ValueError("expected a reviewed Mac discovery inventory")
    for field in ("reviewer", "selection_note", "inventory_note"):
        text(review[field])
    if unique_rows(review["flows"], "discovery flows") != set(sources):
        raise ValueError("discovery review must cover exactly the accepted replays")
    for row in review["flows"]:
        if set(row) != {"id", "source_script_sha256", "purpose", "selection_reason"}:
            raise ValueError("each discovered flow needs its source hash, purpose and selection reason")
        text(row["purpose"]); text(row["selection_reason"])
        if row["source_script_sha256"] != sources[row["id"]]["source_script_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("discovery flow review refers to a different saved script")
    unique_rows(review["capabilities"], "discovery capabilities")
    covered = set()
    for row in review["capabilities"]:
        if set(row) != {"id", "title", "flow_ids", "disposition", "reason"}:
            raise ValueError("invalid discovered capability inventory")
        text(row["title"]); text(row["reason"])
        linked = row["flow_ids"]
        if (row["disposition"] not in {"available", "deferred", "blocked"} or
                not isinstance(linked, list) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in linked) or
                len(set(linked)) != len(linked) or not set(linked).issubset(sources) or
                (row["disposition"] == "available" and not linked)):
            raise ValueError("discovered capabilities need explicit disposition and evidence links")
        if row["disposition"] == "available":
            covered.update(linked)
    if covered != set(sources):
        raise ValueError("every discovered flow must support an available known capability")
    unknowns = review["unknowns"]
    if not isinstance(unknowns, list) or not 1 <= len(unknowns) <= 200:
        raise ValueError("record unknown behavior; discovery does not establish whole-App completeness")
    for value in unknowns: text(value)


def record(sources: dict) -> dict:
    first = sources[sorted(sources)[0]]
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "representative_flow_discovery",
            "readiness": "ready_for_behavior_review", "selected_flow_ids": sorted(sources),
            "flow_count": len(sources), "app": first["app"], "guest_app_path": first["guest_app_path"],
            "package_sha256": first["package_sha256"],
            "environment_manifest_sha256": first["environment_manifest_sha256"],
            "review_truth_verified": False, "whole_app_coverage_verified": False,
            "reconstruction_verified": False}


def task(review: dict, sources: dict) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import quote
    lines = ["# Review discovered Mac behavior", "",
             "Readiness: accepted representative flow inputs. No semantic report or reconstruction is complete.", "",
             "Read review.json, sources.json and every linked flow's raw evidence. The discovery",
             "reviewer and selection reasons are self-declared; hashes cannot certify their truth.", "",
             "Continue in the current agent session. Do not launch another coding-agent CLI.", "",
             "Write the formal behavior review with observed/inferred findings and step citations.",
             "Use mac report --discovery <THIS_CASE> --review <REVIEW_JSON> --out <NEW_CASE>.",
             "Retain all discovered capability IDs in the report, including deferred and blocked ones.",
             "Explain changed dispositions and newly found capabilities. Review all recorded unknowns",
             "and carry unresolved ones into the formal report; source checks cannot decide that semantics.", "",
             "## Accepted representative flows", ""]
    by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in review["flows"]}
    for flow_id in sorted(sources):
        row = by_id[flow_id]
        prefix = "flows/" + flow_id
        lines.extend(["- " + flow_id + ": " + row["purpose"],
                      "  " + row["selection_reason"],
                      "  [Saved playbook](" + quote(prefix + "/playbook.json") + ") · " +
                      "[Evidence manifest](" + quote(prefix + "/manifest.json") + ")"])
    lines.extend(["", "## Known inventory", "", review["inventory_note"], ""])
    for row in review["capabilities"]:
        lines.append("- " + row["id"] + ": " + row["title"] + " — " + row["disposition"] + "; " + row["reason"])
    lines.extend(["", "## Recorded unknowns", ""] + ["- " + value for value in review["unknowns"]] + [""])
    return "\n".join(lines)


def discover_check(flows: dict, review_path: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    roots, sources = discovery_sources(flows)
    for root in roots.values():
        if output.resolve() == root or root in output.resolve().parents:
            raise ValueError("discovery must be outside its source flows")
    review = read(review_path.parent, review_path.name)
    validate_review(review, sources)
    case = Case(output, "mac_discovery")
    try:
        for flow_id, root in roots.items():
            shutil.copytree(root, case.root / "flows" / flow_id, symlinks=True)
            case.record("flows/" + flow_id + "/manifest.json")
        case.add("sources.json", [sources[key] for key in sorted(sources)])
        case.add("review.json", review)
        case.add("discovery.json", record(sources))
        case.add("TASK.md", task(review, sources).encode("utf-8"), binary=True)
        case.finish("complete", scope="representative_flow_discovery", readiness="ready_for_behavior_review")
        from copyapp.verify import verify_case
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("copied discovery evidence changed during acceptance")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="representative_flow_discovery")
        raise


def validate_discovery(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "representative_flow_discovery" or
            manifest.get("readiness") != "ready_for_behavior_review" or
            not {"sources.json", "review.json", "discovery.json", "TASK.md"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    saved = read(root, "sources.json")
    if not isinstance(saved, list) or not 3 <= len(saved) <= 12:
        return False
    flows = {}
    for source in saved:
        flow_id = identifier(source["id"])
        if flow_id in flows or "flows/" + flow_id + "/manifest.json" not in names:
            return False
        flows[flow_id] = root / "flows" / flow_id
    _, sources = discovery_sources(flows)
    review = read(root, "review.json")
    validate_review(review, sources)
    return (saved == [sources[key] for key in sorted(sources)] and read(root, "discovery.json") == record(sources) and
            (root / "TASK.md").read_text() == task(review, sources))


def accepted_flows(root: Path) -> dict:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if not verify_case(root) or read(root, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_discovery":
        raise ValueError("a verified representative Mac discovery case is required")
    return {flow_id: root / "flows" / flow_id for flow_id in read(root, "discovery.json")["selected_flow_ids"]}


def report_link(discovery: Path, sources: dict, review: dict) -> dict:
    flows = accepted_flows(discovery)
    if set(flows) != set(sources) or any(flow_source(root, flow_id) != sources[flow_id] for flow_id, root in flows.items()):
        raise ValueError("report must use the discovery's exact accepted replay evidence")
    inventory = {row["id"] for row in read(discovery, "review.json")["capabilities"]}
    if not inventory.issubset(row["id"] for row in review["capabilities"]):
        raise ValueError("formal report cannot silently drop discovered known capabilities")
    return {"discovery_manifest_sha256": digest(discovery / "manifest.json"),
            "accepted_flow_ids": sorted(flows), "discovered_capability_ids": sorted(inventory)}

```

`copyapp/macos/distribution.py`:

```py
"""Static ZIP/DMG import. Applications and package installers are never run."""

import fcntl
import hashlib
import os
import platform
import plistlib
import posixpath
import re
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unicodedata
import zipfile
import zlib
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.package import MAX_BYTES, MAX_ENTRIES, app_facts, index_app, inventory
from copyapp.macos.report import read


def member_path(value: str) -> str:
    if (not isinstance(value, str) or not value or "\0" in value or "\\" in value or
            PurePosixPath(value).is_absolute() or ".." in PurePosixPath(value).parts or
            str(PurePosixPath(value)) != value or value == "." or
            any(len(part.encode("utf-8")) > 255 for part in PurePosixPath(value).parts)):
        raise ValueError("distribution member must be a canonical relative path")
    return value


def zip_model(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> tuple:
    infos, rows, spellings = {}, {}, {}
    total = 0
    members = archive.infolist()
    if not 1 <= len(members) <= MAX_ENTRIES:
        raise ValueError("ZIP entry count exceeds the bound")
    for info in members:
        if "\0" in info.orig_filename or info.flag_bits & 1:
            raise ValueError("encrypted or NUL-containing ZIP members are unsupported")
        name = member_path(info.filename[:-1] if info.is_dir() else info.filename)
        if name in infos:
            raise ValueError("duplicate ZIP member")
        for length in range(1, len(PurePosixPath(name).parts) + 1):
            prefix = "/".join(PurePosixPath(name).parts[:length])
            folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", prefix).casefold()
            if folded in spellings and spellings[folded] != prefix:
                raise ValueError("ZIP case or Unicode-normalization collision")
            spellings[folded] = prefix
        mode = info.external_attr >> 16
        kind = stat.S_IFMT(mode)
        if mode & 0o7000 or kind not in {0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR, stat.S_IFLNK}:
            raise ValueError("special ZIP file modes are unsupported")
        if (kind == stat.S_IFDIR and not info.is_dir()) or (info.is_dir() and kind not in {0, stat.S_IFDIR}):
            raise ValueError("inconsistent ZIP directory type")
        row = {"path": name, "mode": stat.S_IMODE(mode) or (0o755 if info.is_dir() else 0o644)}
        if info.is_dir():
            row["kind"] = "directory"
        elif kind == stat.S_IFLNK:
            if info.file_size > 4096:
                raise ValueError("oversized ZIP symlink")
            target = archive.read(info).decode("utf-8")
            resolved = posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(posixpath.dirname(name), target))
            if not target or "\0" in target or target.startswith("/") or resolved == ".." or resolved.startswith("../"):
                raise ValueError("ZIP symlink escapes its extraction root")
            row.update(kind="symlink", target=target)
        else:
            total += info.file_size
            if total > MAX_BYTES:
                raise ValueError("uncompressed ZIP exceeds the 8 GiB bound")
            row.update(kind="file", size=info.file_size)
        infos[name], rows[name] = info, row
    for name in list(rows):
        for parent in PurePosixPath(name).parents:
            if str(parent) == ".": continue
            prefix = str(parent)
            if prefix in rows and rows[prefix]["kind"] != "directory":
                raise ValueError("ZIP member has a non-directory ancestor")
            rows.setdefault(prefix, {"path": prefix, "kind": "directory", "mode": 0o755})
    if len(rows) > MAX_ENTRIES:
        raise ValueError("ZIP including implicit directories exceeds the entry bound")
    return infos, rows, total


def zip_bytes(archive, info, destination=None) -> str:
    sha, count, deadline = hashlib.sha256(), 0, time.monotonic() + 300
    stream = destination.open("xb") if destination is not None else None
    try:
        with archive.open(info) as source:
            while True:
                chunk = source.read(1 << 20)
                if not chunk: break
                count += len(chunk)
                if count > info.file_size or count > MAX_BYTES or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    raise ValueError("ZIP member exceeded its declared size or reading deadline")
                sha.update(chunk)
                if stream is not None: stream.write(chunk)
        if count != info.file_size:
            raise ValueError("ZIP member size differs from its declaration")
        return sha.hexdigest()
    finally:
        if stream is not None: stream.close()


def extract_zip(source: Path, output: Path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as archive:
        infos, rows, total = zip_model(archive)
        if shutil.disk_usage(output.parent).free < total * 2 + (512 << 20):
            raise ValueError("insufficient space for ZIP extraction and package snapshot")
        output.mkdir()
        directories = sorted((row for row in rows.values() if row["kind"] == "directory"),
                             key=lambda row: len(PurePosixPath(row["path"]).parts))
        for row in directories: (output / row["path"]).mkdir()
        for name, row in rows.items():
            path = output / name
            if row["kind"] == "file":
                zip_bytes(archive, infos[name], path)
                path.chmod(row["mode"])
        for name, row in rows.items():
            if row["kind"] == "symlink": (output / name).symlink_to(row["target"])
        inventory(output)  # Reject dangling or chained escaping links before App selection.
        for row in reversed(directories): (output / row["path"]).chmod(row["mode"])


def candidates(root: Path) -> list:
    result, pending, visited = [], [root], 0
    while pending:
        directory = pending.pop()
        for path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
            visited += 1
            if visited > MAX_ENTRIES:
                raise ValueError("distribution search exceeds the entry bound")
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir() or path.name in {"__MACOSX", ".Trashes", ".Spotlight-V100", ".fseventsd"}:
                continue
            if path.suffix == ".app":
                result.append(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
            else:
                pending.append(path)
    return sorted(result)


def select(root: Path, selection=None) -> str:
    choices = candidates(root)
    if selection is not None:
        member_path(selection)
        if selection not in choices:
            raise ValueError("requested .app is not a distribution candidate: " + ", ".join(choices))
        return selection
    if len(choices) != 1:
        raise ValueError("select one explicit --app-relative candidate: " + ", ".join(choices))
    return choices[0]


def normalized(rows: list) -> list:
    return sorted([{**row, "path": unicodedata.normalize("NFC", row["path"])} for row in rows], key=lambda row: row["path"])


def zip_package(source: Path, selection: str) -> list:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as archive:
        infos, rows, _ = zip_model(archive)
        if selection not in rows or rows[selection]["kind"] != "directory" or not selection.endswith(".app"):
            raise ValueError("selected App is absent from ZIP")
        result = []
        for name, row in rows.items():
            if name.startswith(selection + "/"):
                row = dict(row, path=name[len(selection) + 1:])
                if row["kind"] == "file": row["sha256"] = zip_bytes(archive, infos[name])
                result.append(row)
        return normalized(result)


def native(argv: list, logs: list, timeout=60) -> bytes:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        truncated = len(result.stdout) > 16 << 20 or len(result.stderr) > 16 << 20
        logs.append({"argv": argv, "returncode": result.returncode,
                     "stdout": result.stdout[:16 << 20].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                     "stderr": result.stderr[:16 << 20].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), "output_truncated": truncated})
        if truncated:
            raise RuntimeError("disk-image command output exceeds its bound")
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("disk-image command failed: " + result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[-1000:])
        return result.stdout
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        logs.append({"argv": argv, "returncode": None, "error": "timeout"})
        raise RuntimeError("disk-image operation timed out; inspect the recorded cleanup outcome") from exc


def attached(image: Path) -> list:
    raw = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "info", "-plist"], stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                         capture_output=True, timeout=30, check=True)
    return [entry for entry in plistlib.loads(raw.stdout).get("images", [])
            if Path(entry.get("image-path", "/absent")).resolve() == image.resolve()]


@contextmanager
def mount_image(image: Path, mount: Path, logs: list):
    if platform.system() != "Darwin" or int(platform.mac_ver()[0].split(".")[0]) < 27:
        raise ValueError("DMG import/reverification currently requires macOS 27 or later's diskutil image interface")
    lock_path = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / ("copyapp-image-" + hashlib.sha256(str(image.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest() + ".lock")
    with lock_path.open("a+b") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if attached(image):
            raise ValueError("this exact snapshot is already attached; inspect it instead of reusing an unknown mount")
        info = plistlib.loads(native(["/usr/bin/hdiutil", "imageinfo", "-stdinpass", "-plist", str(image)], logs))
        properties = info.get("Properties", {})
        if properties.get("Encrypted") is not False or properties.get("Software License Agreement") is not False:
            raise ValueError("encrypted or license-interactive DMGs are unsupported; no password or agreement is submitted")
        try:
            raw = native(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "image", "attach", "--stdinpassphrase", "--plist", "--readOnly", "--nobrowse",
                          "--mountPoint", str(mount), "--mountOptions", "noexec,nosuid,nodev", str(image)], logs)
            entities = plistlib.loads(raw)["system-entities"]
            mounts = [entry for entry in entities if "mount-point" in entry]
            if len(mounts) != 1 or Path(mounts[0]["mount-point"]).resolve() != mount.resolve() or not os.path.ismount(mount):
                raise ValueError("image did not produce the single requested owned mount")
            all_mounts = subprocess.check_output(["/sbin/mount"], text=True, timeout=30)
            matching = []
            for line in all_mounts.splitlines():
                parsed = re.fullmatch(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+(?:s[0-9]+)* on (.+) \((.*)\)", line)
                if parsed and Path(parsed[1]).resolve() == mount.resolve():
                    matching.append(line)
            if len(matching) != 1:
                raise ValueError("cannot bind native mount policy to the owned path")
            flags = matching[0].rsplit(" (", 1)[1].rstrip(")").split(", ")
            if not {"read-only", "noexec", "nosuid", "nodev", "nobrowse"}.issubset(flags):
                raise ValueError("native image mount did not retain the requested restrictions")
            logs.append({"mount_policy": matching[0]})
            yield mount
        finally:
            # Reconcile even a timed-out/failed attach by its unique snapshot
            # path. Never guess a disk number or force-eject an unrelated disk.
            primary_failure = sys.exc_info()[0] is not None
            try:
                owned = attached(image)
                if len(owned) > 1:
                    raise RuntimeError("multiple image associations need manual cleanup review")
                if owned:
                    devices = [row["dev-entry"] for row in owned[0].get("system-entities", [])
                               if re.fullmatch(r"/dev/disk[0-9]+", row.get("dev-entry", ""))]
                    if not devices:
                        raise RuntimeError("owned image has no safely identified whole-device cleanup target")
                    target = str(mount) if os.path.ismount(mount) else devices[0]
                    native(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "eject", target], logs)
                if attached(image) or os.path.ismount(mount):
                    raise RuntimeError("owned image cleanup did not complete")
            except BaseException as cleanup:
                logs.append({"cleanup_error": type(cleanup).__name__, "message": str(cleanup)})
                if not primary_failure: raise


def import_app(source: Path, output: Path, selection=None) -> Path:
    if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.suffix.lower() not in {".zip", ".dmg"} or source.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("import requires a bounded regular .zip or .dmg; use mac inspect for a .app")
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    before = source.stat()
    source_hash = digest(source)
    case = Case(output, "mac_distribution")
    kind, logs = source.suffix.lower()[1:], []
    try:
        snapshot = case.root / ("source." + kind)
        shutil.copyfile(source, snapshot)
        case.record(snapshot.name)
        after = source.stat()
        if (digest(snapshot) != source_hash or digest(source) != source_hash or
                (before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)):
            raise ValueError("distribution changed during snapshot")
        if kind == "zip":
            extract_zip(snapshot, case.root / "extracted")
            chosen = select(case.root / "extracted", selection)
            package = index_app(case.root / "extracted" / chosen, case.root / "package")
            if normalized(read(package, "app-index.json")["entries"]) != zip_package(snapshot, chosen):
                raise ValueError("extracted App differs from its ZIP members")
        else:
            with mount_image(snapshot, case.root / "mount", logs) as mounted:
                chosen = select(mounted, selection)
                package = index_app(mounted / chosen, case.root / "package")
        case.record("package/manifest.json")
        case.add("native-log.json", logs)
        index = read(package, "app-index.json")
        case.add("import.json", {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "static_distribution_only", "format": kind,
                                 "source_path": str(source), "source_sha256": source_hash, "selection": chosen,
                                 "package_manifest_sha256": digest(package / "manifest.json"), "package_sha256": index["package_sha256"],
                                 "app": index["app"], "launched": False, "installed": False,
                                 "host_os": platform.mac_ver()[0],
                                 "disk_tools": {path: digest(Path(path)) for path in ("/usr/bin/hdiutil", "/usr/sbin/diskutil")} if kind == "dmg" else {}})
        case.finish("complete", scope="static_distribution_only")
        from copyapp.verify import verify_case
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("distribution provenance failed source revalidation")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        if not (case.root / "native-log.json").exists(): case.add("native-log.json", logs)
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="static_distribution_only")
        raise


def validate_import(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "static_distribution_only" or
            not {"import.json", "native-log.json", "package/manifest.json"}.issubset(names) or
            not verify_case(root / "package") or read(root / "package", "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_app_index"):
        return False
    record, package = read(root, "import.json"), read(root / "package", "app-index.json")
    kind = record["format"]
    if (kind not in {"zip", "dmg"} or "source." + kind not in names or (root / ("source." + kind)).stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES or
            type(record.get("schema_version")) is not int or record["schema_version"] != 2 or record.get("platform") != "macos" or
            record.get("scope") != "static_distribution_only" or record.get("launched") is not False or record.get("installed") is not False or
            record.get("source_sha256") != digest(root / ("source." + kind)) or
            record.get("package_manifest_sha256") != digest(root / "package/manifest.json") or record.get("package_sha256") != package["package_sha256"] or
            canonical(record.get("app")) != canonical(package["app"])):
        return False
    if (not isinstance(record.get("source_path"), str) or not Path(record["source_path"]).is_absolute() or
            not isinstance(record.get("host_os"), str)):
        return False
    member_path(record["selection"])
    if kind == "zip":
        try:
            return (record.get("disk_tools") == {} and read(root, "native-log.json") == [] and
                    zip_package(root / "source.zip", record["selection"]) == normalized(package["entries"]))
        except (zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError, EOFError, NotImplementedError, zlib.error):
            return False
    logs = read(root, "native-log.json")
    tools = record.get("disk_tools")
    if (not isinstance(tools, dict) or set(tools) != {"/usr/bin/hdiutil", "/usr/sbin/diskutil"} or
            any(not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value) for value in tools.values())):
        return False
    if (not isinstance(logs, list) or not logs or not any("mount_policy" in row for row in logs) or
            any(row.get("returncode", 0) != 0 or row.get("output_truncated", False) or "cleanup_error" in row for row in logs)):
        return False
    folder = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="copyapp-dmg-verify-")).resolve()
    verification_log = []
    try:
        with mount_image(root / "source.dmg", folder / "mount", verification_log) as mounted:
            chosen = select(mounted, record["selection"])
            return (normalized(inventory(mounted / chosen)) == normalized(package["entries"]) and
                    canonical(app_facts(mounted / chosen)) == canonical(package["app"]))
    except (RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return False
    finally:
        if os.path.ismount(folder / "mount"):
            # Do not let TemporaryDirectory/rmtree traverse a mount after a
            # cleanup failure, even if the filesystem policy was unexpected.
            (folder / "verification-failure.json").write_bytes(canonical({"source": str(root / "source.dmg"),
                                                                         "native_log": verification_log,
                                                                         "left_mounted": True}))
            print("DMG verification left an owned mount; inspect " + str(folder / "verification-failure.json"), file=sys.stderr)
        else:
            shutil.rmtree(folder)

```

`copyapp/macos/doctor.py`:

```py
"""Record transport readiness without claiming an App or VM has been verified."""

import io
import platform
import plistlib
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import ChatComputer, ChatComputerError


def executable_facts(executable: str) -> dict:
    located = shutil.which(executable)
    if located is None:
        return {"available": False, "requested": executable}
    path = Path(located).resolve(strict=True)
    result = {"available": True, "path": str(path), "sha256": digest(path)}
    info = path.parent.parent / "Info.plist"
    if info.is_file():
        metadata = plistlib.loads(info.read_bytes())
        result.update(bundle_id=metadata.get("CFBundleIdentifier"),
                      version=metadata.get("CFBundleShortVersionString"),
                      build=metadata.get("CFBundleVersion"))
    return result


def doctor(output: Path, executable: str = "chatcomputer", data_dir=None,
           timeout: float = 30) -> tuple:
    case = Case(output, "mac_doctor")
    record = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "chatcomputer_transport",
              "host": {"system": platform.system(), "release": platform.mac_ver()[0],
                       "architecture": platform.machine()},
              "ready": False, "exact_app_identity_ready": False,
              "repairs": [], "probes": {}}
    try:
        record["chatcomputer"] = executable_facts(executable)
        if sys.platform != "darwin":
            raise ChatComputerError("ChatComputer requires a macOS host")
        if not record["chatcomputer"]["available"]:
            raise ChatComputerError("Install ChatComputer from its official distribution, then finish its setup")
        with ChatComputer(executable, timeout, data_dir) as client:
            record["server_info"] = client.server_info
            status = client.call("status")
            case.add("mcp-status.json", status)
            record["probes"]["status"] = {"available": True, "text": client.text(status)}
            # A status prose line alone is insufficient: demand a guest image.
            shot = client.call("screenshot")
            case.add("mcp-screenshot.json", shot)
            data, mime = client.image(shot)
            with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as image:
                width, height = image.size
                image.verify()
            if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
                raise ChatComputerError("invalid guest screenshot size")
            case.add("screen.png", data, binary=True)
            record["probes"]["screenshot"] = {"available": True, "width": width,
                                                  "height": height, "mime_type": mime}
            record["ready"] = True
    except (OSError, ValueError, ChatComputerError) as exc:
        record["repairs"].append(str(exc))
    record["repairs"].append("Exact guest and App identity require the Mac collector; transport readiness is not analysis readiness")
    case.add("doctor.json", record)
    case.finish("complete" if record["ready"] else "needs_setup", scope=record["scope"])
    return case.root, record["ready"]

`copyapp/macos/environment.py`:

```py
"""Register and recheck one exact ChatComputer VM without reading its secrets."""

import json
import shutil
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID

from copyapp.macos.bridge import Collector
from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import ChatComputer
from copyapp.macos.doctor import executable_facts


VM_FILES = ("spec.json", "MachineIdentifier.bin", "HardwareModel.bin")


def vm_identity(vm: Path) -> dict:
    vm = vm.resolve(strict=True)
    spec = json.loads((vm / "spec.json").read_text())
    UUID(spec["id"])
    if spec.get("stage") != "ready":
        raise ValueError("ChatComputer VM has not completed onboarding")
    if not all(type(spec.get(key)) is int and spec[key] > 0
               for key in ("displayWidth", "displayHeight", "cpuCount", "memoryBytes")):
        raise ValueError("invalid VM configuration")
    # These identify the VM and fixed test settings. Live disks, NVRAM, transient
    # state and the secrets file must not be hashed or copied as identity inputs.
    return {"vm_id": spec["id"], "machine_identifier_sha256": digest(vm / "MachineIdentifier.bin"),
            "hardware_model_sha256": digest(vm / "HardwareModel.bin"),
            "display_width": spec["displayWidth"], "display_height": spec["displayHeight"],
            "cpu_count": spec["cpuCount"], "memory_bytes": spec["memoryBytes"],
            "guest_release": spec.get("guestRelease", "27"),
            "restore_build": spec.get("restoreImageBuild")}


def register_environment(vm: Path, build: Path, output: Path,
                         executable: str = "chatcomputer", timeout: float = 30) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    vm = vm.resolve(strict=True)
    build = build.resolve(strict=True)
    destination = output.resolve()
    if any(destination == source or source in destination.parents for source in (vm, build)):
        raise ValueError("environment case must be outside the VM and collector build")
    if not verify_case(build):
        raise ValueError("collector build case is not verified")
    build_manifest = json.loads((build / "manifest.json").read_text())
    if build_manifest.get("kind") != "mac_collector_build" or build_manifest.get("status") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("a completed collector build is required")
    vm_facts = vm_identity(vm)
    tool = executable_facts(executable)
    if not tool.get("available") or tool.get("bundle_id") != "app.chatcomputer.ChatComputer":
        raise ValueError("expected the installed ChatComputer application executable")
    collector_build = json.loads((build / "collector-build.json").read_text())
    case = Case(output, "mac_environment")
    try:
        for name in VM_FILES:
            case.add("vm/" + name, (vm / name).read_bytes(), binary=True)
        # Preserve the complete verified build, allowing later inspection without
        # depending on a mutable external build directory.
        shutil.copytree(build, case.root / "collector-build", symlinks=True)
        case.record("collector-build/manifest.json")
        with ChatComputer(str(tool["path"]), timeout, vm.parent) as computer:
            case.add("mcp-initialize.json", computer.initialization)
            server_info = computer.server_info
            status = computer.call("status")
            case.add("mcp-status.json", status)
            shot = computer.call("screenshot")
            image, mime = computer.image(shot)
            case.add("mcp-screenshot.json", shot)
            case.add("screen.png" if mime == "image/png" else "screen.jpg", image, binary=True)
            with Collector(vm / "Shared", collector_build["executable_sha256"], timeout) as collector:
                health = collector.call("health")
                case.add("collector-health.json", health)
        guest = health["response"]["result"]
        machine = guest.get("guest_machine_id")
        UUID(machine)
        record = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "execution_environment": "chatcomputer_vm",
                  "vm_directory": str(vm), "vm": vm_facts,
                  "chatcomputer": tool, "mcp_server_info": server_info,
                  "collector_sha256": collector_build["executable_sha256"],
                  "guest_machine_id": machine, "guest_os": guest["os_version"],
                  "collector_build_manifest_sha256": digest(case.root / "collector-build/manifest.json"),
                  "scope": "environment_registration", "app_identity_ready": False}
        if isinstance(guest.get("install_root"), str):
            record["install_root"] = guest["install_root"]
        case.add("environment.json", record)
        case.finish("complete", scope="environment_registration")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="environment_registration")
        raise


def validate_environment(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    required = {"environment.json", "vm/spec.json", "vm/MachineIdentifier.bin", "vm/HardwareModel.bin",
                "collector-build/manifest.json", "collector-health.json", "mcp-status.json", "mcp-screenshot.json",
                "mcp-initialize.json"}
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "environment_registration" or
            not required.issubset(names)):
        return False
    record = json.loads((root / "environment.json").read_text())
    initialize = json.loads((root / "mcp-initialize.json").read_text())
    UUID(initialize["transport_id"])
    request, reply = initialize["request"], initialize["response"]
    server_info = record.get("mcp_server_info")
    if (not isinstance(server_info, dict) or server_info.get("name") != "chatcomputer" or
            not isinstance(server_info.get("version"), str) or not server_info["version"] or
            initialize.get("server_info") != server_info or request.get("jsonrpc") != "2.0" or
            request.get("method") != "initialize" or type(request.get("id")) is not int or
            request.get("params") != {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {},
                                     "clientInfo": {"name": "Copy APP", "version": "0.1.2"}} or
            reply.get("jsonrpc") != "2.0" or type(reply.get("id")) is not int or reply["id"] != request["id"] or
            "error" in reply or reply.get("result", {}).get("serverInfo") != server_info):
        return False
    build = root / "collector-build"
    metadata = json.loads((build / "collector-build.json").read_text())
    response = json.loads((root / "collector-health.json").read_text())
    request, reply = response["request"], response["response"]
    from copyapp.macos.case import canonical
    import hashlib
    if (reply.get("status") != "complete" or request.get("method") != "health" or
            reply.get("request_sha256") != hashlib.sha256(canonical(request)).hexdigest() or
            reply.get("session_id") != request.get("session_id") or
            reply.get("request_id") != request.get("request_id") or
            reply.get("collector_sha256") != record.get("collector_sha256")):
        return False
    guest = reply["result"]
    UUID(record["guest_machine_id"])
    UUID(reply["collector_instance"])
    raw = json.loads((root / "mcp-screenshot.json").read_text())
    data, mime = ChatComputer.image(raw)
    image_path = "screen.png" if mime == "image/png" else "screen.jpg"
    if image_path not in names or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != digest(root / image_path):
        return False
    from PIL import Image
    import io
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as image:
        image.verify()
    return (record.get("schema_version") == 2 and record.get("platform") == "macos" and
            record.get("execution_environment") == "chatcomputer_vm" and
            record.get("scope") == "environment_registration" and record.get("app_identity_ready") is False and
            record.get("vm") == vm_identity(root / "vm") and
            record.get("chatcomputer", {}).get("bundle_id") == "app.chatcomputer.ChatComputer" and
            record.get("collector_build_manifest_sha256") == digest(build / "manifest.json") and
            record.get("collector_sha256") == metadata.get("executable_sha256") and
            record.get("guest_machine_id") == guest.get("guest_machine_id") == reply.get("guest_machine_id") and
            record.get("guest_os") == guest.get("os_version") and
            record.get("install_root") == guest.get("install_root") and verify_case(build))


@contextmanager
def environment_session(environment: Path, timeout: float = 30):
    """Recheck identity after every reconnect or snapshot restore."""
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if not verify_case(environment):
        raise ValueError("environment case is not verified")
    manifest = json.loads((environment / "manifest.json").read_text())
    if manifest.get("kind") != "mac_environment":
        raise ValueError("expected a registered Mac environment")
    record = json.loads((environment / "environment.json").read_text())
    vm = Path(record["vm_directory"])
    if vm_identity(vm) != record["vm"]:
        raise ValueError("VM identity or test configuration changed; register a new environment")
    tool = executable_facts(record["chatcomputer"]["path"])
    if tool != record["chatcomputer"]:
        raise ValueError("ChatComputer changed; review and register the new build")
    with ChatComputer(tool["path"], timeout, vm.parent) as computer:
        if computer.server_info != record["mcp_server_info"]:
            raise ValueError("MCP server identity changed; review and register the new session")
        with Collector(vm / "Shared", record["collector_sha256"], timeout) as collector:
            health = collector.call("health")
            guest = health["response"]["result"]
            if (guest.get("guest_machine_id") != record["guest_machine_id"] or
                    guest.get("os_version") != record["guest_os"] or guest.get("install_root") != record.get("install_root")):
                raise ValueError("collector answered from another guest or OS build")
            yield computer, collector, record, health
