`copyapp/macos/setup.py`:

```py
"""Build the guest helper as a separate app; do not grant host permissions."""

import json
import plistlib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, digest
from copyapp.macos.package import app_facts, inventory


APP = "CopyAppMacCollector.app"


def build_collector(output: Path, signing_identity: str = "-") -> Path:
    case = Case(output, "mac_collector_build")
    output = case.root
    source = Path(__file__).parent / "collector/Collector.swift"
    case.add("Collector.swift", source.read_bytes(), binary=True)
    saved = output / "Collector.swift"
    app = output / APP
    executable = app / "Contents/MacOS/CopyAppMacCollector"
    executable.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    (app / "Contents/Info.plist").write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({
        "CFBundleIdentifier": "dev.copyapp.MacCollector",
        "CFBundleName": "Copy APP Mac Collector", "CFBundleExecutable": executable.name,
        "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL", "CFBundleShortVersionString": "0.2.0",
        "CFBundleVersion": "1", "LSUIElement": True, "LSMinimumSystemVersion": "14.0"}))
    commands = [["xcrun", "swiftc", "-swift-version", "5", "-target", "arm64-apple-macos14.0",
                 str(saved), "-o", str(executable)],
                ["codesign", "--force", "--sign", signing_identity,
                 "--identifier", "dev.copyapp.MacCollector", str(app)],
                ["codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(app)],
                [str(executable), "--self-test"]]
    logs = []
    try:
        for argv in commands:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
            logs.append({"argv": argv, "returncode": result.returncode,
                         "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr})
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError("Collector build failed; inspect " + str(output / "build-log.json"))
        case.add("build-log.json", logs)
        case.add("collector-build.json", {
            "schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "protocol_version": 2,
            "source_sha256": digest(saved), "executable_sha256": digest(executable),
            "bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.MacCollector", "signing_identity": signing_identity,
            "app_path": APP, "app": app_facts(app), "entries": inventory(app),
            "self_test": json.loads(logs[-1]["stdout"])})
        case.finish("complete", scope="collector_build_only")
        return app
    except BaseException as exc:
        if not (output / "build-log.json").exists():
            case.add("build-log.json", logs)
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="collector_build_only")
        raise


def validate_build(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "collector_build_only" or
            not {"Collector.swift", "build-log.json", "collector-build.json"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    record = json.loads((root / "collector-build.json").read_text())
    logs = json.loads((root / "build-log.json").read_text())
    app = root / APP
    if app.is_symlink():
        return False
    facts = app_facts(app)
    self_test = record.get("self_test", {})
    methods = self_test.get("methods")
    from copyapp.macos.bridge import METHODS
    if (self_test.get("protocol_version") != 2 or not isinstance(methods, list) or
            any(not isinstance(method, str) for method in methods) or len(methods) != len(set(methods)) or
            not {"health", "app_identity", "observe"}.issubset(methods) or
            not set(methods).issubset(METHODS)):
        return False
    return (record.get("platform") == "macos" and record.get("schema_version") == 2 and
            record.get("protocol_version") == 2 and record.get("app_path") == APP and
            record.get("bundle_id") == "dev.copyapp.MacCollector" and
            record.get("source_sha256") == digest(root / "Collector.swift") and
            record.get("executable_sha256") == facts["binary_sha256"] and
            record.get("app") == facts and record.get("entries") == inventory(app) and
            isinstance(logs, list) and len(logs) == 4 and
            all(type(log.get("returncode")) is int and log["returncode"] == 0 for log in logs) and
            json.loads(logs[-1]["stdout"]) == record["self_test"])

```

`copyapp/macos/share.py`:

```py
"""A manual guest-Finder byte probe, usable before control permissions exist."""

import hashlib
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.environment import VM_FILES
from copyapp.macos.report import read, text


def shared(vm: Path) -> Path:
    vm = vm.resolve(strict=True)
    root = vm / "Shared"
    for path in (root, root / "inbox", root / "outbox"):
        if not path.is_dir() or path.resolve(strict=True) != path:
            raise ValueError("probe requires real existing VM shared inbox/outbox directories")
    return root


def task(record: dict) -> str:
    return ("# Guest shared-file probe\n\n"
            "In this ChatComputer guest's Finder, copy the single file\n\n`/Volumes/My Shared Files/inbox/" + record["filename"] +
            "`\n\nto `/Volumes/My Shared Files/outbox/`, retaining its exact name.\n\n"
            "Copy it once, then inspect the host outbox before any new action. Do not\n"
            "execute software, grant permissions, replace files or modify App data.\n\n"
            "This probe checks byte exchange only. It does not establish collector\n"
            "identity, App identity, input lease, screenshot or snapshot acceptance.\n")


def request_record(root: Path, vm_directory: str, probe_id: str) -> dict:
    UUID(probe_id)
    spec = read(root / "vm", "spec.json")
    UUID(spec["id"])
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "shared_file_request",
            "vm_directory": vm_directory, "vm_id": spec["id"], "setup_stage": spec["stage"],
            "vm_files": {name: digest(root / "vm" / name) for name in VM_FILES},
            "probe_id": probe_id, "filename": "copyapp-probe-" + probe_id + ".txt",
            "payload_sha256": digest(root / "payload.txt"), "guest_runtime_identity_verified": False}


def share_request(vm: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    vm = vm.resolve(strict=True)
    root = shared(vm)
    if output.resolve() == vm or vm in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("probe case must be outside its VM")
    probe_id = str(uuid4())
    case = Case(output, "mac_share_request")
    try:
        for name in VM_FILES:
            path = vm / name
            if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or path.stat().st_size > 1 << 20:
                raise ValueError("invalid public VM identity file")
            case.add("vm/" + name, path.read_bytes(), binary=True)
        payload = ("Copy APP shared-file probe\nnonce=" + probe_id + "\n").encode("ascii")
        case.add("payload.txt", payload, binary=True)
        record = request_record(case.root, str(vm), probe_id)
        case.add("request.json", record)
        case.add("GUEST_TASK.md", task(record).encode("utf-8"), binary=True)
        destination = root / "inbox" / record["filename"]
        if (root / "outbox" / record["filename"]).exists():
            raise FileExistsError("probe response already exists")
        temporary = destination.with_name("." + record["filename"] + ".pending")
        with temporary.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(payload); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        # Atomic no-replacement publication on the host; guest interruption and
        # cache recovery remain separate live acceptance work.
        os.link(temporary, destination)
        temporary.unlink()
        if digest(destination) != record["payload_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("published probe bytes differ")
        case.finish("complete", scope="shared_file_request")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="shared_file_request")
        raise


def share_result(request: Path, output: Path, reviewer: str, notes: str) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    request = request.resolve(strict=True)
    if not verify_case(request) or read(request, "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_share_request":
        raise ValueError("a verified shared-file request is required")
    if output.resolve() == request or request in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("probe result must be outside its request")
    text(reviewer); text(notes)
    record = read(request, "request.json")
    vm = Path(record["vm_directory"])
    root = shared(vm)
    if any(digest(vm / name) != record["vm_files"][name] for name in VM_FILES):
        raise ValueError("VM identity/configuration changed during probe; preserve it and review a new attempt")
    reply = root / "outbox" / record["filename"]
    if reply.is_symlink() or not reply.is_file() or reply.stat().st_size > 4096:
        raise ValueError("probe reply is absent, linked or too large")
    before = reply.stat()
    data = reply.read_bytes()
    after = reply.stat()
    if ((before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) != (after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns) or
            data != (request / "payload.txt").read_bytes()):
        raise ValueError("probe reply changed or differs from the published nonce")
    case = Case(output, "mac_share_result")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(request, case.root / "request", symlinks=True)
        case.record("request/manifest.json")
        case.add("reply.txt", data, binary=True)
        case.add("result.json", {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "shared_byte_roundtrip",
                                 "request_manifest_sha256": digest(request / "manifest.json"),
                                 "payload_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                                 "reviewer": reviewer, "notes": notes, "transfer_actor": "guest_finder_self_declared",
                                 "guest_runtime_identity_verified": False, "complete_environment_acceptance": False})
        case.finish("complete", scope="shared_byte_roundtrip")
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("copied probe evidence changed")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="shared_byte_roundtrip")
        raise


def validate_request(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    required = {"request.json", "payload.txt", "GUEST_TASK.md", *{"vm/" + name for name in VM_FILES}}
    if manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "shared_file_request" or not required.issubset(names):
        return False
    saved = read(root, "request.json")
    expected = request_record(root, saved["vm_directory"], saved["probe_id"])
    payload = ("Copy APP shared-file probe\nnonce=" + saved["probe_id"] + "\n").encode("ascii")
    return (Path(saved["vm_directory"]).is_absolute() and canonical(saved) == canonical(expected) and
            (root / "payload.txt").read_bytes() == payload and (root / "GUEST_TASK.md").read_text() == task(expected))


def validate_result(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "shared_byte_roundtrip" or
            not {"request/manifest.json", "reply.txt", "result.json"}.issubset(names) or
            not verify_case(root / "request") or read(root / "request", "manifest.json").get("kind") != "mac_share_request"):
        return False
    record = read(root, "result.json")
    text(record["reviewer"]); text(record["notes"])
    return (type(record.get("schema_version")) is int and record["schema_version"] == 2 and record.get("platform") == "macos" and
            record.get("scope") == "shared_byte_roundtrip" and record.get("transfer_actor") == "guest_finder_self_declared" and
            record.get("request_manifest_sha256") == digest(root / "request/manifest.json") and
            record.get("payload_sha256") == digest(root / "reply.txt") == digest(root / "request/payload.txt") and
            (root / "reply.txt").read_bytes() == (root / "request/payload.txt").read_bytes() and
            record.get("guest_runtime_identity_verified") is False and record.get("complete_environment_acceptance") is False)

```

`copyapp/macos/snapshots.py`:

```py
"""ChatComputer-owned snapshots with bounded public metadata and fresh sessions.

Copy APP never swaps VM disks, reads pairing secrets, deletes snapshots or
restores without the upstream safety snapshot. Metadata is not a disk hash.
"""

import hashlib
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from copyapp.macos.bridge import Collector
from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import ChatComputer, UnknownCompletion
from copyapp.macos.doctor import executable_facts
from copyapp.macos.environment import VM_FILES, vm_identity
from copyapp.macos.observation import validate_reply
from copyapp.macos.report import read, text

QUIESCE_SECONDS = 30


def validate_quiesce(reply: dict, health: dict, record: dict):
    if (not validate_reply(reply, record, "quiesce", health["response"]["collector_instance"]) or
            reply["request"]["session_id"] != health["request"]["session_id"] or
            reply["request"]["params"] != {"seconds": QUIESCE_SECONDS}):
        raise ValueError("collector quiesce is not bound to the pre-snapshot session")
    result = reply["response"]["result"]
    stamp = reply["response"].get("recorded_at")
    until = result.get("until")
    if (set(result) != {"scope", "seconds", "until"} or result["scope"] != "collector_polling_only" or
            type(result["seconds"]) is not int or result["seconds"] != QUIESCE_SECONDS or
            type(stamp) not in (int, float) or type(until) not in (int, float) or
            not 0 <= until - stamp <= QUIESCE_SECONDS + 1):
        raise ValueError("invalid bounded collector quiesce acknowledgment")


def uid(value):
    result = str(UUID(value))
    if value.lower() != result:
        raise ValueError("expected a canonical UUID spelling")
    return result


def public_json(path: Path):
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.resolve() != path or path.stat().st_size > 1 << 20:
        raise ValueError("snapshot metadata must be a bounded nonlinked JSON file")
    before = path.stat()
    data = path.read_bytes()
    after = path.stat()
    stamp = lambda value: (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
    if stamp(before) != stamp(after) or len(data) != before.st_size:
        raise ValueError("snapshot metadata changed during inspection")
    import json
    return json.loads(data)


def validate_metadata(value: dict):
    required = {"id", "name", "kind", "createdAt", "isProtected", "overlayCount", "hasThumbnail"}
    if (not isinstance(value, dict) or not required.issubset(value) or
            not set(value).issubset(required | {"parentID", "memoryBytes"}) or
            value["kind"] not in {"initial", "manual", "safety"} or
            type(value["isProtected"]) is not bool or type(value["hasThumbnail"]) is not bool or
            type(value["overlayCount"]) is not int or not 1 <= value["overlayCount"] <= 32):
        raise ValueError("unsupported snapshot metadata schema")
    uid(value["id"]); text(value["name"])
    if len(value["name"]) > 1024 or "\0" in value["name"]:
        raise ValueError("snapshot name exceeds the bound")
    date = datetime.fromisoformat(value["createdAt"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    if date.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("snapshot creation time lacks a timezone")
    if value.get("parentID") is not None: uid(value["parentID"])
    if value.get("memoryBytes") is not None and (type(value["memoryBytes"]) is not int or not 0 <= value["memoryBytes"] <= 1 << 40):
        raise ValueError("snapshot memory metadata exceeds the bound")


def validate_catalog(value: dict):
    if (not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"snapshots", "state", "current_id", "snapshot_directory_present",
                                                    "incomplete_directories", "restore_in_progress"} or
            type(value["snapshot_directory_present"]) is not bool or type(value["restore_in_progress"]) is not bool or
            not isinstance(value["snapshots"], list) or len(value["snapshots"]) > 512 or
            not isinstance(value["incomplete_directories"], list) or len(value["incomplete_directories"]) > 1024):
        raise ValueError("invalid bounded snapshot catalog")
    identifiers = []
    for row in value["snapshots"]:
        validate_metadata(row)
        identifiers.append(uid(row["id"]))
    if identifiers != sorted(set(identifiers)):
        raise ValueError("snapshot IDs are duplicated or unsorted")
    state = value["state"]
    if state is not None and (not isinstance(state, dict) or not set(state).issubset({"currentID"})):
        raise ValueError("invalid snapshot state metadata")
    current = uid(state["currentID"]) if state and state.get("currentID") is not None else None
    if value["current_id"] != current:
        raise ValueError("snapshot current ID differs from saved state")
    incomplete = value["incomplete_directories"]
    if (any(not isinstance(name, str) or not name or len(name) > 255 or "/" in name or "\0" in name for name in incomplete) or
            incomplete != sorted(set(incomplete)) or
            (not value["snapshot_directory_present"] and (state is not None or identifiers or incomplete or value["restore_in_progress"]))):
        raise ValueError("invalid incomplete snapshot directory record")


def catalog(vm: Path) -> dict:
    root = vm / "Snapshots"
    value = {"snapshots": [], "state": None, "current_id": None, "snapshot_directory_present": root.exists(),
             "incomplete_directories": [], "restore_in_progress": False}
    if root.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("snapshot root is linked")
    if not root.exists(): return value
    if not root.is_dir() or root.resolve() != root:
        raise ValueError("snapshot root is not a canonical directory")
    paths = sorted(root.iterdir())
    observed = []

    def read_metadata(path):
        result = public_json(path)
        observed.append((path, result))
        return result
    if len(paths) > 1024:
        raise ValueError("snapshot directory count exceeds the bound")
    for path in paths:
        if path.name == "state.json":
            value["state"] = read_metadata(path)
        elif path.name == ".restore":
            value["restore_in_progress"] = True
        elif path.name.startswith(".staging-"):
            value["incomplete_directories"].append(path.name)
        else:
            try: snapshot_id = uid(path.name)
            except ValueError: continue
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir() or not (path / "snapshot.json").exists():
                value["incomplete_directories"].append(path.name)
                continue
            row = read_metadata(path / "snapshot.json")
            validate_metadata(row)
            if uid(row["id"]) != snapshot_id:
                raise ValueError("snapshot directory and metadata IDs differ")
            value["snapshots"].append(row)
    value["snapshots"].sort(key=lambda row: uid(row["id"]))
    state = value["state"]
    value["current_id"] = uid(state["currentID"]) if state and state.get("currentID") is not None else None
    validate_catalog(value)
    # A concurrent upstream capture is not silently accepted as one observation.
    if ([path.name for path in paths] != sorted(path.name for path in root.iterdir()) or
            any(public_json(path) != value for path, value in observed)):
        raise ValueError("snapshot catalog changed during inspection")
    return value


def quiet_catalog(value: dict):
    validate_catalog(value)
    ids = {uid(row["id"]) for row in value["snapshots"]}
    if (value["incomplete_directories"] or value["restore_in_progress"] or (value["current_id"] and value["current_id"] not in ids) or
            any(row.get("parentID") is not None and uid(row["parentID"]) not in ids for row in value["snapshots"])):
        raise ValueError("snapshot metadata needs inspection; no take/restore was requested")


def inventory_record(root: Path, vm: str) -> dict:
    spec = read(root / "vm", "spec.json")
    uid(spec["id"])
    value = read(root, "catalog.json")
    validate_catalog(value)
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "snapshot_public_metadata_only",
            "vm_directory": vm, "vm_id": uid(spec["id"]), "setup_stage": spec["stage"],
            "public_vm_files": {name: digest(root / "vm" / name) for name in VM_FILES},
            "snapshot_count": len(value["snapshots"]), "current_id": value["current_id"],
            "disk_or_memory_bytes_verified": False, "guest_runtime_identity_verified": False}


def snapshot_inventory(vm: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    vm = vm.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == vm or vm in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("inventory case must be outside the VM")
    case = Case(output, "mac_snapshot_inventory")
    try:
        for name in VM_FILES:
            path = vm / name
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 1 << 20:
                raise ValueError("invalid bounded public VM file")
            case.add("vm/" + name, path.read_bytes(), binary=True)
        case.add("catalog.json", catalog(vm))
        case.add("inventory.json", inventory_record(case.root, str(vm)))
        case.finish("complete", scope="snapshot_public_metadata_only")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="snapshot_public_metadata_only")
        raise


def validate_inventory(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "snapshot_public_metadata_only" or
            not {"inventory.json", "catalog.json", *{"vm/" + name for name in VM_FILES}}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    saved = read(root, "inventory.json")
    return Path(saved["vm_directory"]).is_absolute() and saved == inventory_record(root, saved["vm_directory"])


def pinned_environment(record: dict) -> Path:
    vm = Path(record["vm_directory"])
    if vm_identity(vm) != record["vm"] or executable_facts(record["chatcomputer"]["path"]) != record["chatcomputer"]:
        raise ValueError("VM configuration or ChatComputer build changed; review a new registration")
    return vm


def health_matches(health: dict, record: dict):
    if not validate_reply(health, record, "health"):
        raise ValueError("collector health is not bound to this environment")
    guest = health["response"]["result"]
    if guest.get("os_version") != record["guest_os"] or guest.get("install_root") != record.get("install_root"):
        raise ValueError("guest OS/user install root changed across snapshot operation")


def traced(case: Case, name: str, computer, tool: str, arguments=None):
    result = computer.call(tool, arguments)
    case.add(name, computer.evidence())
    return result


def phase(case: Case, prefix: str, computer, collector, record):
    traced(case, prefix + "/status.json", computer, "status")
    shot = traced(case, prefix + "/screenshot-rpc.json", computer, "screenshot")
    data, mime = computer.image(shot)
    case.add(prefix + ("/screen.png" if mime == "image/png" else "/screen.jpg"), data, binary=True)
    health = collector.call("health")
    case.add(prefix + "/health.json", health)
    health_matches(health, record)
    return health


def check_catalog_tools(catalog: dict, action: str):
    tools = {row["name"]: row for row in catalog["tools"]}
    selected = {"move": {"x": "integer", "y": "integer"},
                "snapshot_take": {"name": "string"},
                "snapshot_restore": {"snapshot": "string", "save_current": "boolean"}}
    for name in ("move", "snapshot_" + action):
        schema = tools[name]["inputSchema"]
        if schema.get("type") != "object" or any(schema["properties"].get(key, {}).get("type") != kind
                                                   for key, kind in selected[name].items()):
            raise ValueError("installed snapshot/input MCP schema is incompatible")


def transition(before: dict, after: dict, action: str, chosen: dict = None, label: str = None) -> tuple:
    quiet_catalog(before); quiet_catalog(after)
    old = {uid(row["id"]): row for row in before["snapshots"]}
    new = {uid(row["id"]): row for row in after["snapshots"]}
    if any(key not in new or new[key] != row for key, row in old.items()):
        raise ValueError("an existing snapshot changed or disappeared during the operation")
    additions = [new[key] for key in sorted(set(new) - set(old))]
    initials = [row for row in additions if row["kind"] == "initial"]
    if initials:
        if (len(initials) != 1 or any(row["kind"] == "initial" for row in old.values()) or not initials[0]["isProtected"] or
                initials[0].get("parentID") is not None):
            raise ValueError("unexpected initial snapshot transition")
    parent = before["current_id"] or (uid(initials[0]["id"]) if initials else None)
    if action == "take":
        candidates = [row for row in additions if row["kind"] == "manual" and row["name"] == label]
        if len(candidates) != 1 or len(additions) != len(initials) + 1:
            raise ValueError("take did not produce exactly one uniquely named manual snapshot")
        chosen = candidates[0]
        safety = None
    else:
        if chosen is None or old.get(uid(chosen["id"])) != chosen:
            raise ValueError("target snapshot differs from the pinned take case")
        candidates = [row for row in additions if row["kind"] == "safety"]
        if len(candidates) != 1 or len(additions) != len(initials) + 1:
            raise ValueError("restore did not retain exactly one new safety snapshot")
        safety = candidates[0]
    child = chosen if action == "take" else safety
    if (child["isProtected"] or (uid(child["parentID"]) if child.get("parentID") is not None else None) != parent or
            after["current_id"] != uid(chosen["id"])):
        raise ValueError("snapshot ancestry or final current ID differs from the operation")
    return chosen, safety


def operation_record(environment: Path, before: dict, after: dict, first: dict, last: dict,
                     action: str, chosen: dict, safety: dict, label: str) -> dict:
    result = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "snapshot_metadata_and_reconnect",
            "operation": action, "label": label, "snapshot": chosen, "safety_snapshot": safety,
            "environment_manifest_sha256": digest(environment / "manifest.json"),
            "before_catalog_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(before)).hexdigest(),
            "after_catalog_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(after)).hexdigest(),
            "before_session": first["request"]["session_id"], "after_session": last["request"]["session_id"],
            "collector_instance_changed": first["response"]["collector_instance"] != last["response"]["collector_instance"],
            "takeover_guard": "preflight_input_lease_only", "atomic_takeover_exclusion_verified": False,
            "shared_data_reset": False, "behavior_restoration_verified": False,
            "disk_or_memory_bytes_verified": False, "action_retried": False}
    if "quiesce" in first["response"]["result"].get("capabilities", []):
        result.update(collector_polling_quiesced=True, collector_quiesce_seconds=QUIESCE_SECONDS,
                      all_guest_file_io_quiesced=False)
    return result


def snapshot_operation(source: Path, output: Path, action: str, timeout: float = 120) -> Path:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    source = source.resolve(strict=True)
    expected = "mac_environment" if action == "take" else "mac_snapshot_take"
    if (action not in {"take", "restore"} or not verify_case(source) or read(source, "manifest.json").get("kind") != expected or
            output.resolve() == source or source in output.resolve().parents):
        raise ValueError("take needs a verified environment; restore needs a verified Copy APP snapshot take case")
    environment = source if action == "take" else source / "environment"
    record = read(environment, "environment.json")
    vm = pinned_environment(record)
    if output.resolve() == vm or vm in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("snapshot operation evidence must be outside the VM")
    chosen = None if action == "take" else read(source, "snapshot-operation.json")["snapshot"]
    label = "copyapp-" + str(uuid4()) if action == "take" else None
    case = Case(output, "mac_snapshot_" + action)
    submitted = False
    try:
        child = "environment" if action == "take" else "snapshot"
        shutil.copytree(source, case.root / child, symlinks=True)
        case.record(child + "/manifest.json")
        saved_environment = case.root / "environment" if action == "take" else case.root / "snapshot/environment"
        with Collector(vm / "Shared", record["collector_sha256"], min(timeout, 120)) as collector:
            before = catalog(vm)
            case.add("before/catalog.json", before)
            quiet_catalog(before)
            if chosen is not None and chosen not in before["snapshots"]:
                raise ValueError("pinned snapshot metadata changed or is absent; restore was not requested")
            with ChatComputer(record["chatcomputer"]["path"], timeout, vm.parent) as computer:
                case.add("mcp-catalog.json", computer.catalog)
                check_catalog_tools(computer.catalog, action)
                first = phase(case, "before", computer, collector, record)
                traced(case, "control.json", computer, "move", {"x": 0, "y": 0})
                if "quiesce" in first["response"]["result"].get("capabilities", []):
                    paused = collector.call("quiesce", {"seconds": QUIESCE_SECONDS})
                    case.add("before/quiesce.json", paused)
                    validate_quiesce(paused, first, record)
                # A takeover already active here blocks the normal input lease.
                # Upstream snapshots have no atomic expected-lease precondition;
                # do not claim this closes a later human-takeover race.
                submitted = True
                arguments = {"name": label} if action == "take" else {"snapshot": chosen["id"], "save_current": True}
                traced(case, "operation.json", computer, "snapshot_" + action, arguments)
            # Keep the same exclusive collector lock across both the VM action
            # and this fresh protocol epoch. Old outbox files are left untouched.
            collector.new_session()
            pinned_environment(record)
            with ChatComputer(record["chatcomputer"]["path"], timeout, vm.parent) as computer:
                last = phase(case, "after", computer, collector, record)
            after = catalog(vm)
            case.add("after/catalog.json", after)
            chosen, safety = transition(before, after, action, chosen, label)
        case.add("snapshot-operation.json", operation_record(saved_environment, before, after, first, last, action, chosen, safety, label))
        case.finish("complete", scope="snapshot_metadata_and_reconnect", operation=action)
        if not verify_case(case.root):
            raise ValueError("snapshot operation evidence failed revalidation")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        for attribute, name in (("chatcomputer_evidence", "failed-mcp.json"), ("collector_evidence", "failed-collector.json")):
            if isinstance(getattr(exc, attribute, None), dict): case.add(name, getattr(exc, attribute))
        try: case.add("failure-catalog.json", catalog(vm))
        except BaseException as inspection:
            case.add("failure-catalog-error.json", {"error": type(inspection).__name__, "message": str(inspection)})
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc),
                                  "action_submitted": submitted, "needs_inspection": True,
                                  "completion_unknown": isinstance(exc, UnknownCompletion), "action_retried": False})
        case.finish("failed", scope="snapshot_metadata_and_reconnect", operation=action)
        raise


def mcp_result(value: dict, tool: str, arguments: dict, record: dict):
    uid(value["transport_id"])
    request, reply = value["request"], value["response"]
    if (value["server_info"] != record["mcp_server_info"] or
            request.get("jsonrpc") != "2.0" or request.get("method") != "tools/call" or
            request.get("params") != {"name": tool, "arguments": arguments} or type(request.get("id")) is not int or
            reply.get("jsonrpc") != "2.0" or type(reply.get("id")) is not int or reply["id"] != request["id"] or "error" in reply):
        raise ValueError("snapshot MCP request/response binding differs")
    result = reply["result"]
    if result.get("isError", False) is not False or not isinstance(result.get("content"), list):
        raise ValueError("snapshot MCP action is incomplete or failed")
    return result


def validate_operation(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    from copyapp.verify import verify_case
    action = manifest.get("operation")
    if action not in {"take", "restore"} or manifest.get("kind") != "mac_snapshot_" + action:
        return False
    child = "environment" if action == "take" else "snapshot"
    required = {child + "/manifest.json", "mcp-catalog.json", "before/catalog.json", "after/catalog.json", "control.json",
                "operation.json", "snapshot-operation.json", *{phase + "/" + name for phase in ("before", "after")
                    for name in ("status.json", "screenshot-rpc.json", "health.json")}}
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "snapshot_metadata_and_reconnect" or
            not required.issubset(names) or not verify_case(root / child)):
        return False
    if read(root / child, "manifest.json").get("kind") != ("mac_environment" if action == "take" else "mac_snapshot_take"):
        return False
    environment = root / "environment" if action == "take" else root / "snapshot/environment"
    record, saved = read(environment, "environment.json"), read(root, "snapshot-operation.json")
    check_catalog_tools(read(root, "mcp-catalog.json"), action)
    before, after = read(root, "before/catalog.json"), read(root, "after/catalog.json")
    label = saved["label"]
    if action == "take":
        if not isinstance(label, str) or not label.startswith("copyapp-"): return False
        uid(label[len("copyapp-"):])
        chosen = None
    else:
        if label is not None: return False
        chosen = read(root / "snapshot", "snapshot-operation.json")["snapshot"]
    chosen, safety = transition(before, after, action, chosen, label)
    transports, healths = [], []
    for prefix in ("before", "after"):
        status, shot = read(root, prefix + "/status.json"), read(root, prefix + "/screenshot-rpc.json")
        mcp_result(status, "status", {}, record)
        raw = mcp_result(shot, "screenshot", {}, record)
        if status["transport_id"] != shot["transport_id"]: return False
        data, mime = ChatComputer.image(raw)
        image = prefix + ("/screen.png" if mime == "image/png" else "/screen.jpg")
        if image not in names or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != digest(root / image): return False
        from PIL import Image
        import io
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(data)) as opened: opened.verify()
        health = read(root, prefix + "/health.json")
        health_matches(health, record)
        transports.append(status["transport_id"]); healths.append(health)
    if transports[0] == transports[1] or healths[0]["request"]["session_id"] == healths[1]["request"]["session_id"]:
        return False
    if "quiesce" in healths[0]["response"]["result"].get("capabilities", []):
        if "before/quiesce.json" not in names: return False
        validate_quiesce(read(root, "before/quiesce.json"), healths[0], record)
    control, operation = read(root, "control.json"), read(root, "operation.json")
    mcp_result(control, "move", {"x": 0, "y": 0}, record)
    arguments = {"name": label} if action == "take" else {"snapshot": chosen["id"], "save_current": True}
    mcp_result(operation, "snapshot_" + action, arguments, record)
    if any(value["transport_id"] != transports[0] for value in (control, operation)): return False
    if not (read(root, "before/status.json")["request"]["id"] < read(root, "before/screenshot-rpc.json")["request"]["id"] <
            control["request"]["id"] < operation["request"]["id"]): return False
    return saved == operation_record(environment, before, after, *healths, action, chosen, safety, label)
```

`copyapp/macos/ui.py`:

```py
"""Measured UI settings for comparable Mac runs; no settings are changed here."""

import math


def validate_ui(value: dict):
    if (not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"schema_version", "appearance", "locale", "preferred_languages",
                                                    "display_bounds", "display_pixels", "backing_scale"} or
            type(value.get("schema_version")) is not int or value["schema_version"] != 1 or
            value.get("appearance") not in {"light", "dark"} or
            not isinstance(value.get("locale"), str) or not 1 <= len(value["locale"]) <= 128):
        raise ValueError("invalid measured Mac UI settings")
    languages = value["preferred_languages"]
    if (not isinstance(languages, list) or not 1 <= len(languages) <= 128 or
            any(not isinstance(item, str) or not 1 <= len(item) <= 128 for item in languages)):
        raise ValueError("invalid preferred languages")
    frame(value["display_bounds"])
    pixels = value["display_pixels"]
    if (not isinstance(pixels, dict) or set(pixels) != {"width", "height"} or
            any(type(pixels[key]) is not int or not 0 < pixels[key] <= 32768 for key in pixels) or
            type(value["backing_scale"]) not in {int, float} or not 0 < value["backing_scale"] <= 8):
        raise ValueError("invalid display pixels or scale")


def frame(value: dict):
    if (not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"x", "y", "width", "height"} or
            any(type(item) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(item) for item in value.values()) or
            value["width"] <= 0 or value["height"] <= 0):
        raise ValueError("invalid window/display frame")


def check_ui(expected: dict, health: dict):
    validate_ui(expected)
    actual = health["response"]["result"].get("ui_environment")
    validate_ui(actual)
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("guest UI settings differ from the frozen comparison conditions")


def check_window(tree: dict, expected: dict):
    frame(expected)
    index = tree.get("focused_window_node")
    if (tree.get("source_channel") != "ax" or tree.get("truncated") is not False or
            type(index) is not int or not 0 <= index < len(tree.get("nodes", []))):
        raise ValueError("a complete focused-window observation is required")
    node = tree["nodes"][index]
    if node.get("role") != "AXWindow" or node.get("frame") != expected:
        raise ValueError("initial focused window differs from the declared placement")
```

`copyapp/macos/visual.py`:

```py
"""Explicit review of every full Mac screenshot pair and each starting state."""

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.report import read, text


def template(comparison: dict) -> dict:
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "reviewer": "",
            "judgments": [{"id": pair["id"], "verdict": None, "notes": "", "reviewed_full_screens": False}
                          for pair in comparison["screenshot_pairs"]],
            "starting_states": [{"round": row["round"], "flow_id": row["flow_id"], "judgment": "unknown", "notes": ""}
                                for row in comparison["flows"]]}


def review_task(comparison: dict) -> str:
    lines = ["# Review Mac paired runs", "",
             "Open both full, unmasked screenshots for every pair below. Review the actual App",
             "content, controls, window placement, menus/dialogs and visible differences. Metrics",
             "and predeclared masks are measurements; they cannot substitute for this review.", "",
             "Compare each initial launch and starting-state assertion too. Judge whether the",
             "declared starting states are equivalent. Mark uncertainty instead of assuming it.", "",
             "Copy visual-judgments-template.json to an ignored case workspace and fill every",
             "entry. Use equivalent, minor_difference or major_difference for screenshot pairs;",
             "use equivalent, different or unknown for starting states. Retain specific differences.", "",
             "Run copyapp mac visual-review --check <THIS_CASE> --judgments <JSON> --out <NEW_CASE>.", "",
             "The reviewer label is self-declared. Verification checks image identity and coverage,",
             "not the truth of a subjective judgment or the completeness of the App inventory.", ""]
    for pair in comparison["screenshot_pairs"]:
        lines.extend(["- " + pair["id"] + ": [original](" + quote(pair["original"]["path"]) +
                      ") · [rebuilt](" + quote(pair["rebuilt"]["path"]) + ")"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def reviewed(check: Path, judgments: dict) -> dict:
    from copyapp.macos.checks import require
    require(check, "mac_rebuild_check")
    data = read(check, "comparison.json")
    if (not isinstance(judgments, dict) or set(judgments) != {"schema_version", "platform", "reviewer", "judgments", "starting_states"} or
            type(judgments.get("schema_version")) is not int or judgments["schema_version"] != 2 or judgments.get("platform") != "macos"):
        raise ValueError("invalid Mac visual review")
    text(judgments["reviewer"])
    entries, states = judgments["judgments"], judgments["starting_states"]
    if (not isinstance(entries, list) or [row["id"] for row in entries] != [pair["id"] for pair in data["screenshot_pairs"]] or
            not isinstance(states, list) or [(row["round"], row["flow_id"]) for row in states] !=
            [(row["round"], row["flow_id"]) for row in data["flows"]]):
        raise ValueError("review must cover every screenshot pair and starting state exactly once in template order")
    results = []
    for entry, pair in zip(entries, data["screenshot_pairs"]):
        if (set(entry) != {"id", "verdict", "notes", "reviewed_full_screens"} or
                entry["verdict"] not in {"equivalent", "minor_difference", "major_difference"} or
                entry["reviewed_full_screens"] is not True):
            raise ValueError("each pair needs an explicit full-screen review and verdict")
        text(entry["notes"])
        results.append({**entry, "original_sha256": pair["original"]["sha256"], "rebuilt_sha256": pair["rebuilt"]["sha256"]})
    for entry in states:
        if (set(entry) != {"round", "flow_id", "judgment", "notes"} or
                type(entry["round"]) is not int or entry["judgment"] not in {"equivalent", "different", "unknown"}):
            raise ValueError("each starting state needs an explicit judgment")
        text(entry["notes"])
    return {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "full_screenshot_review",
            "check_manifest_sha256": digest(check / "manifest.json"), "reviewer": judgments["reviewer"],
            "judgments": results, "starting_states": states, "complete": True,
            "major_differences": sum(row["verdict"] == "major_difference" for row in entries),
            "minor_differences": sum(row["verdict"] == "minor_difference" for row in entries),
            "starting_state_issues": sum(row["judgment"] != "equivalent" for row in states),
            "dimension_mismatches": sum(not row["metrics"]["dimensions_match"] for row in data["screenshot_pairs"])}


def markdown(data: dict) -> str:
    lines = ["# Mac screenshot review", "", "Reviewer (self-declared): " + data["reviewer"], "",
             "All required full screenshot pairs have explicit judgments. This verifies coverage",
             "and image identity; it does not certify the truth of the judgments.", "",
             "Major differences: " + str(data["major_differences"]) + "; minor differences: " + str(data["minor_differences"]) +
             "; starting-state issues: " + str(data["starting_state_issues"]) + ".", ""]
    for row in data["judgments"]:
        lines.append("- " + row["id"] + ": " + row["verdict"] + ". " + row["notes"])
    lines.extend(["", "## Starting states", ""])
    for row in data["starting_states"]:
        lines.append("- Round " + str(row["round"]) + " / " + row["flow_id"] + ": " + row["judgment"] + ". " + row["notes"])
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def visual_review(check: Path, judgments_path: Path, output: Path) -> Path:
    check = check.resolve(strict=True)
    if output.resolve() == check or check in output.resolve().parents:
        raise ValueError("visual review must be outside its check case")
    judgments = json.loads(judgments_path.read_text())
    reviewed(check, judgments)
    case = Case(output, "mac_visual_review")
    try:
        shutil.copytree(check, case.root / "check", symlinks=True)
        case.record("check/manifest.json")
        data = reviewed(case.root / "check", judgments)
        case.add("review-input.json", judgments)
        case.add("visual-review.json", data)
        case.add("review.md", markdown(data).encode("utf-8"), binary=True)
        case.finish("complete", scope="full_screenshot_review")
        from copyapp.macos.checks import require
        require(case.root, "mac_visual_review")
        return case.root
    except BaseException as exc:
        case.add("failure.json", {"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        case.finish("failed", scope="full_screenshot_review")
        raise


def validate_visual(root: Path, manifest: dict, names: set) -> bool:
    if (manifest.get("status") != "complete" or manifest.get("scope") != "full_screenshot_review" or
            not {"check/manifest.json", "review-input.json", "visual-review.json", "review.md"}.issubset(names)):
        return False
    data = reviewed(root / "check", read(root, "review-input.json"))
    return canonical(data) == canonical(read(root, "visual-review.json")) and (root / "review.md").read_text() == markdown(data)
```

`copyapp/method_scout.py`:

```py
"""Rank local Objective-C instance methods as possible UI action entry points."""

import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional


def _score(class_name: str, selector: str) -> tuple:
    name = selector.lower()
    cls = class_name.lower()
    reasons = []
    score = 0
    if re.search(r"buttonpressed|buttonpressed:|buttondidpress", name):
        score, reasons = 120, ["explicit button press handler"]
    elif re.search(r"(^|:)tapped|didtap|ontap|tapped$|tapped:", name):
        score, reasons = 110, ["explicit tap handler"]
    elif re.search(r"(^|:)pressed|didpress|clicked|didclick", name):
        score, reasons = 100, ["explicit press or click handler"]
    elif "didselect" in name or "selectionchanged" in name:
        score, reasons = 90, ["selection event handler"]
    elif name.startswith("touchesended:"):
        score, reasons = 75, ["UIKit touch completion handler"]
    elif name.startswith(("show", "open", "navigate", "add", "reset", "save",
                          "delete", "increment", "decrement")):
        score, reasons = 35, ["possible navigation or state-change handler"]
    elif "action" in name or "button" in name:
        score, reasons = 45, ["possible action or button method"]
    if not score:
        return 0, []
    if name.startswith(("set", "get", "can", "is", "has", "accessibility")):
        score -= 55
        reasons.append("property, capability or accessibility method penalty")
    if any(part in cls for part in ("appdelegate", "application", "scene")):
        score -= 35
        reasons.append("application lifecycle class penalty")
    if any(part in cls for part in ("controller", "model", "view")):
        score += 5
        reasons.append("UI or model class")
    return max(score, 0), reasons


def _label_matches(selector: str, label: str) -> bool:
    """Accept only an exact action suffix present as a UI label word."""
    action = re.fullmatch(
        r"(show|open|navigate|add|reset|save|delete|increment|decrement)"
        r"([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*):?", selector)
    if action is None:
        return False
    words = [word.casefold() for word in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*", label)
             if len(word) >= 3]
    if not words:
        return False
    if words[0] in {"show", "open", "navigate", "add", "reset", "save",
                    "delete", "increment", "decrement"} and words[0] != action.group(1):
        return False
    return action.group(2).casefold() in words


def scout_methods(objc_index: Path, limit: int = 20,
                  tap_labels: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> dict:
    if not 1 <= limit <= 100:
        raise ValueError("method scout limit must be between 1 and 100")
    index = json.loads(objc_index.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (index.get("schema_version") != 1 or
            not isinstance(index.get("binary_sha256"), str) or
            not isinstance(index.get("classes"), list)):
        raise ValueError("invalid Objective-C method index")
    ranked = []
    seen = set()
    for cls in index["classes"]:
        if not isinstance(cls, dict) or not isinstance(cls.get("name"), str):
            continue
        for method in cls.get("instance_methods", []):
            if not isinstance(method, dict) or not isinstance(method.get("selector"), str):
                continue
            key = (cls["name"], method["selector"])
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            score, reasons = _score(*key)
            if score:
                ranked.append({"class": key[0], "selector": key[1],
                               "method": key[0] + "::" + key[1],
                               "static_address": method.get("imp"),
                               "score": score, "reasons": reasons})
    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["score"], item["class"], item["selector"]))
    leader = ranked[0] if ranked else None
    runner = ranked[1] if len(ranked) > 1 else None
    margin = leader["score"] - runner["score"] if runner else None
    strong = leader if leader and leader["score"] >= 100 and (margin is None or margin >= 20) else None
    selected = [strong] if strong else []
    label_matches = []
    ambiguous_labels = []
    for label in tap_labels or []:
        if not isinstance(label, str):
            continue
        matches = [item for item in ranked if _label_matches(item["selector"], label)]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            label_matches.append({"label": label, "method": matches[0]["method"]})
            if matches[0] not in selected:
                selected.append(matches[0])
        elif len(matches) > 1:
            ambiguous_labels.append(label)
    if ambiguous_labels and strong is None:
        selected = []
    if len(selected) > 32:
        selected = []
    selection_basis = ("combined_high_score_and_labels" if strong and label_matches else
                       "unique_high_score_action" if strong else
                       "unique_exact_tap_labels" if selected else None)
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "objc_ui_method_scout",
            "binary_sha256": index["binary_sha256"],
            "selection_policy": "unique action method with score >=100 and >=20 lead, plus unique exact action suffix matches for tap labels; ambiguous labels stop auto-selection unless a strong action exists; heuristic only",
            "status": "selected" if selected else "needs_review",
            "selected_method": selected[0]["method"] if len(selected) == 1 else None,
            "selected_methods": [item["method"] for item in selected],
            "selection_basis": selection_basis, "label_matches": label_matches,
            "ambiguous_labels": ambiguous_labels,
            "top_score_margin": margin, "ranked": ranked[:limit],
            "limitation": "Names suggest possible UI entry points; they do not prove a method handles the supplied flow. An ambiguous label without a strong action, or more than 32 matches, stops before device interaction."}


def _class_leaf(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the final Swift/Objective-C class component when unambiguous."""
    if name.startswith("_TtC"):
        cursor = 4
        parts = []
        while cursor < len(name) and name[cursor].isdigit():
            end = cursor
            while end < len(name) and name[end].isdigit():
                end += 1
            length = int(name[cursor:end])
            part = name[end:end + length]
            if length < 1 or len(part) != length:
                return ""
            parts.append(part)
            cursor = end + length
        return parts[-1] if cursor == len(name) and parts else ""
    return name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]


def refine_scout_with_view_tree(scout: dict, objc_index: Path,
                                view_tree: Path, tap_labels: List[str]) -> dict:
    """Use exact visible button classes to choose unique action-method leads.

    The output remains a candidate selection; only the later runtime trace can
    show whether that method was called during the gesture.
    """
    index = json.loads(objc_index.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    raw_tree = view_tree.read_bytes()
    tree = json.loads(raw_tree)
    nodes = tree.get("nodes")
    if (index.get("binary_sha256") != scout.get("binary_sha256") or
            tree.get("type") != "view_tree" or not isinstance(nodes, list) or
            not 1 <= len(nodes) <= 500):
        raise ValueError("runtime view tree or Objective-C index is invalid")
    actions = {}
    for cls in index.get("classes", []):
        if not isinstance(cls, dict) or not isinstance(cls.get("name"), str):
            continue
        leaf = _class_leaf(cls["name"])
        if not leaf:
            continue
        for method in cls.get("instance_methods", []):
            selector = method.get("selector") if isinstance(method, dict) else None
            if not isinstance(selector, str):
                continue
            score, _ = _score(cls["name"], selector)
            if score >= 100:
                actions.setdefault(leaf, set()).add(cls["name"] + "::" + selector)
    matches = []
    for label in dict.fromkeys(item for item in tap_labels
                               if isinstance(item, str) and item):
        candidates = set()
        origin_ids = []
        for position, node in enumerate(nodes):
            if (not isinstance(node, dict) or node.get("id") != position or
                    (node.get("parent") is not None and
                     (type(node["parent"]) is not int or
                      not 0 <= node["parent"] < position))):
                raise ValueError("runtime view tree node order is invalid")
            if label not in (node.get("accessibility_label"), node.get("text"),
                             node.get("title")):
                continue
            origin_ids.append(position)
            current = position
            while current is not None:
                ancestor = nodes[current]
                leaf = _class_leaf(str(ancestor.get("class_name") or ""))
                methods = actions.get(leaf, set())
                if methods:
                    candidates.update(methods)
                    break
                current = ancestor.get("parent")
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            matches.append({"label": label, "node_ids": origin_ids,
                            "method": next(iter(candidates))})
    selected = list(dict.fromkeys(item["method"] for item in matches))
    result = dict(scout)
    result["runtime_view_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(raw_tree).hexdigest()
    result["runtime_view_matches"] = matches
    if selected and len(selected) <= 32:
        result.update({"status": "selected", "selected_method": selected[0] if
                       len(selected) == 1 else None, "selected_methods": selected,
                       "selection_basis": "runtime_visible_class_unique_action"})
    return result

```

`copyapp/native_disasm.py`:

```py
"""Hash-bound, bounded ARM64 disassembly using the local Xcode toolchain.

This is assembly evidence, not decompiled source or a semantic interpretation.
REA is never imported or invoked by this module.
"""

import json
import io
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Tuple

from copyapp.ipa import MAX_BINARY, inspect_macho
from copyapp.objc import MachOImage
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


LC_FUNCTION_STARTS = 0x26
MAX_FUNCTION_STARTS = 1_000_000
MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT = 512 * 1024
INSTRUCTION = re.compile(r"^([0-9a-fA-F]+):\s", re.MULTILINE)
DIRECT_CALL = re.compile(
    r"^([0-9a-fA-F]+):\s+[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\s+bl\s+0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)"
    r"(?:\s+<([^>\n]{1,300})>)?", re.MULTILINE)
DIRECT_BRANCH = re.compile(
    r"^([0-9a-fA-F]+):\s+[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\s+(b(?:\.[a-z]+)?)\s+"
    r"0x([0-9a-fA-F]+)", re.MULTILINE)
MAX_DIRECT_CALLS = 256


def is_arm64_blr(image: MachOImage, address: int, register: str) -> bool:
    """Check a disassembled BLR against the acquired Mach-O instruction bytes."""
    if (not re.fullmatch(r"x(?:[0-9]|[12][0-9]|30)", register) or
            address % 4):
        return False
    return image.unpack("<I", address)[0] == (0xd63f0000 | (int(register[1:]) << 5))


def direct_calls(assembly: str) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:
    """Extract only literal ARM64 BL edges; dynamic dispatch remains unknown."""
    found = []
    truncated = False
    for match in DIRECT_CALL.finditer(assembly):
        if len(found) >= MAX_DIRECT_CALLS:
            truncated = True
            break
        symbol = match.group(3)
        selector = (symbol[len("_objc_msgSend$"):] if
                    symbol and symbol.startswith("_objc_msgSend$") and
                    "+0x" not in symbol else None)
        found.append({"site": f"0x{int(match.group(1), 16):x}",
                      "target": f"0x{int(match.group(2), 16):x}",
                      "symbol": symbol,
                      "objc_selector_stub": selector})
    return found, truncated


def direct_branches(assembly: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract literal B/B.cond edges, without guessing computed BR targets."""
    return [{"site": f"0x{int(match.group(1), 16):x}",
             "mnemonic": match.group(2),
             "target": f"0x{int(match.group(3), 16):x}"}
            for match in DIRECT_BRANCH.finditer(assembly)]


def rank_native_candidates(options: list, digest: str, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Rank only hash-bound candidates with real nonzero runtime observations."""
    scored = []
    seen = set()
    for item in options:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("candidate entry is invalid")
        address = item.get("static_address")
        observations = item.get("observations")
        if (not isinstance(address, str) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", address) or
                int(address, 16) in seen or item.get("binary_sha256") != digest or
                not isinstance(observations, list) or not observations):
            raise ValueError("candidate address, binary or observations are invalid")
        seen.add(int(address, 16))
        current = direct = 0
        for hit in observations:
            if not isinstance(hit, dict):
                raise ValueError("candidate observation is invalid")
            calls = hit.get("calls")
            static_calls = (hit.get("static_entry") or {}).get("calls", 0)
            if (type(calls) is not int or calls < 0 or
                    type(static_calls) is not int or static_calls < 0):
                raise ValueError("candidate call count is invalid")
            current += calls
            direct += static_calls
        if not current and not direct:
            raise ValueError("candidate has no observed calls")
        scored.append(((-direct, -current, int(address, 16)), item))
    return [item for _, item in sorted(scored, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[:limit]]


def _function_starts(image: MachOImage) -> list[int]:
    """Decode LC_FUNCTION_STARTS as VM addresses relative to the image base."""
    blob = image.data
    ncmds = struct.unpack_from("<I", blob, 16)[0]
    cursor = 32
    for _ in range(ncmds):
        command, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", blob, cursor)
        if command == LC_FUNCTION_STARTS:
            if size < 16:
                raise ValueError("short LC_FUNCTION_STARTS command")
            offset, length = struct.unpack_from("<II", blob, cursor + 8)
            if offset + length > len(blob) or length > 8 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise ValueError("function starts exceed Mach-O bounds")
            starts = []
            delta = 0
            value = 0
            shift = 0
            for byte in blob[offset:offset + length]:
                value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift
                if byte & 0x80:
                    shift += 7
                    if shift > 63:
                        raise ValueError("invalid function-start delta")
                    continue
                if value == 0:
                    break
                delta += value
                starts.append(image.base + delta)
                if len(starts) > MAX_FUNCTION_STARTS:
                    raise ValueError("too many function starts")
                value = shift = 0
            else:
                if shift:
                    raise ValueError("truncated function-start delta")
            return starts
        cursor += size
    return []


def _bounds(image: MachOImage, address: int, max_bytes: int) -> Tuple[int, str, bool]:
    sections = [(segment, base, base + length) for (segment, section),
                (base, length, _) in image.sections.items()
                if section == "__text" and segment in ("__TEXT", "__TEXT_EXEC")]
    containing = [(segment, start, end) for segment, start, end in sections
                  if start <= address < end]
    if len(containing) != 1 or address % 4:
        raise ValueError("address is not aligned inside a unique executable __text section")
    _, _, section_end = containing[0]
    starts = _function_starts(image)
    exact = address in starts
    next_start = next((item for item in starts if item > address), None)
    end = min(section_end, address + max_bytes,
              next_start if next_start is not None else section_end)
    if end <= address:
        raise ValueError("empty executable window")
    boundary = "next_function_start" if exact and next_start == end else "bounded_window"
    return end, boundary, boundary != "next_function_start"


def local_direct_targets(image: MachOImage, starts: set[int],
                         summary: dict, seen: set[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Return exact function starts reached by literal BL or B in local text."""
    text_ranges = [(base, base + length) for (segment, section),
                   (base, length, _) in image.sections.items()
                   if section == "__text" and segment in ("__TEXT", "__TEXT_EXEC")]
    targets = set()
    for edge in summary.get("direct_calls", []) + summary.get("direct_branches", []):
        target = int(edge["target"], 16)
        if (target in starts and target not in seen and
                any(start <= target < end for start, end in text_ranges)):
            targets.add(target)
    return sorted(targets)


def disassemble_native_function(binary: Path, digest: str, address: str,
                                output: Path, max_bytes: int = 1024,
                                tool: Optional[Path] = None,
                                timeout: int = 30) -> Path:
    """Save a bounded instruction window for an exact acquired Mach-O."""
    if not 16 <= max_bytes <= 4096 or max_bytes % 4:
        raise ValueError("max_bytes must be a multiple of four between 16 and 4096")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", address):
        raise ValueError("address must be hexadecimal")
    binary = binary.resolve(strict=True)
    if binary.stat().st_size > MAX_BINARY:
        raise ValueError("binary exceeds analysis size limit")
    if sha256_file(binary) != digest:
        raise ValueError("binary SHA-256 differs from requested digest")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    image = MachOImage(binary.read_bytes())
    if inspect_macho(image.data).get("encrypted_on_disk") is True:
        raise ValueError("selected Mach-O is still marked encrypted on disk")
    start = int(address, 16)
    end, boundary, truncated = _bounds(image, start, max_bytes)
    if tool is None:
        xcrun = shutil.which("xcrun")
        if not xcrun:
            raise FileNotFoundError("Xcode llvm-objdump is unavailable")
        found = subprocess.run([xcrun, "--find", "llvm-objdump"],
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
                               check=True).stdout.strip()
        tool = Path(found)
    tool = tool.resolve(strict=True)
    command = [str(tool), "--disassemble", f"--start-address=0x{start:x}",
               f"--stop-address=0x{end:x}", str(binary)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True,
                            timeout=timeout, check=True)
    assembly = result.stdout
    if len(assembly.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT:
        raise ValueError("disassembler output exceeds bound")
    addresses = [int(match, 16) for match in INSTRUCTION.findall(assembly)]
    if (not addresses or addresses[0] != start or
            any(item < start or item >= end or item % 4 for item in addresses) or
            addresses != sorted(set(addresses))):
        raise ValueError("disassembler returned an unexpected instruction range")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text_path = output / "assembly.txt"
    text_path.write_text(assembly, encoding="utf-8")
    calls, calls_truncated = direct_calls(assembly)
    branches = direct_branches(assembly)
    summary = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "native_disassembly",
               "status": "complete", "binary_path": str(binary),
               "binary_sha256": digest, "address": f"0x{start:x}",
               "stop_address": f"0x{end:x}", "max_bytes": max_bytes,
               "boundary": boundary, "truncated": truncated,
               "instruction_count": len(addresses),
               "direct_calls": calls, "direct_calls_truncated": calls_truncated,
               "direct_branches": branches,
               "tool": str(tool), "tool_name": "llvm-objdump",
               "assembly_sha256": sha256_file(text_path),
               "limitation": "Assembly only; a bounded window may omit instructions and does not establish runtime execution or original source."}
    summary_path = output / "summary.json"
    summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                            encoding="utf-8")
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "native_disassembly",
                "status": "complete", "evidence": [
                    {"path": "assembly.txt", "sha256": sha256_file(text_path)},
                    {"path": "summary.json", "sha256": sha256_file(summary_path)}]}
    (output / "manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return summary_path


def disassemble_native_candidates(candidates_dir: Path, output: Path,
                                  limit: int = 4, max_bytes: int = 1024,
                                  timeout: int = 30, follow_limit: int = 4,
                                  follow_depth: int = 2) -> Path:
    """Attempt bounded assembly for verified static candidates; retain failures."""
    if not 1 <= limit <= 32:
        raise ValueError("limit must be between 1 and 32")
    if not 0 <= follow_limit <= 16 or not 0 <= follow_depth <= 4:
        raise ValueError("follow_limit must be 0–16 and follow_depth must be 0–4")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        if not verify_case(candidates_dir):
            raise ValueError("candidate evidence hash mismatch")
    source_path = candidates_dir / "candidates.json"
    source = json.loads(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    digest = source.get("binary_sha256")
    binary = Path(source.get("binary_path", ""))
    if (source.get("kind") != "runtime_static_candidates" or
            not isinstance(digest, str) or
            not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", digest) or
            not binary.is_file() or binary.stat().st_size > MAX_BINARY or
            sha256_file(binary) != digest):
        raise ValueError("candidate case has no matching analysis binary")
    options = source.get("candidates")
    if not isinstance(options, list) or not options:
        raise ValueError("candidate case has no function addresses")

    selected = rank_native_candidates(options, digest, limit)
    image = MachOImage(binary.read_bytes())
    starts = set(_function_starts(image))
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "native_candidate_queue",
              "candidate_case_sha256": sha256_file(source_path),
              "binary_sha256": digest, "limit": limit,
              "max_bytes": max_bytes, "follow_limit": follow_limit,
              "follow_depth": follow_depth, "results": [],
              "decisions": [], "followed": []}
    seen = {int(item["static_address"], 16) for item in selected}
    for index, item in enumerate(selected, 1):
        address = item.get("static_address")
        if (not isinstance(address, str) or
                item.get("binary_sha256") != digest or
                not re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+", address)):
            raise ValueError("candidate address or binary identity is invalid")
        target = output / f"function-{index:02d}"
        result = {"index": index, "address": address,
                  "class": item.get("class"), "selector": item.get("selector")}
        try:
            summary = disassemble_native_function(binary, digest, address, target,
                                                  max_bytes, timeout=timeout)
            result.update(status="complete", summary=str(summary.relative_to(output)))
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError) as exc:
            result.update(status="unavailable", error={"type": type(exc).__name__,
                                                       "message": str(exc)[:300]})
        record["results"].append(result)
    for root in record["results"]:
        if root["status"] != "complete":
            continue
        source_address = root["address"]
        summary = json.loads((output / root["summary"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        depth = 0
        while True:
            eligible = local_direct_targets(image, starts, summary, seen)
            if summary.get("direct_calls_truncated"):
                status = "truncated_calls"
            elif depth >= follow_depth:
                status = "depth_limit"
            elif len(eligible) > 1:
                status = "ambiguous"
            elif not eligible:
                status = "none"
            elif len(record["followed"]) >= follow_limit:
                status = "function_limit"
            else:
                status = "followed"
            record["decisions"].append({"root_address": root["address"],
                                        "source_address": source_address,
                                        "depth": depth,
                                        "eligible_targets": [f"0x{item:x}" for item in eligible],
                                        "status": status})
            if status != "followed":
                break
            target_address = eligible[0]
            seen.add(target_address)
            target = output / f"followed-{len(record['followed']) + 1:02d}"
            followed = {"root_address": root["address"],
                        "source_address": source_address,
                        "address": f"0x{target_address:x}", "depth": depth + 1}
            try:
                path = disassemble_native_function(binary, digest,
                                                   followed["address"], target,
                                                   max_bytes, timeout=timeout)
                followed.update(status="complete", summary=str(path.relative_to(output)))
                summary = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError) as exc:
                followed.update(status="unavailable", error={"type": type(exc).__name__,
                                                             "message": str(exc)[:300]})
            record["followed"].append(followed)
            if followed["status"] != "complete":
                break
            source_address = followed["address"]
            depth += 1
    successes = sum(item["status"] == "complete" for item in
                    record["results"] + record["followed"])
    total = len(record["results"]) + len(record["followed"])
    record["status"] = ("complete" if successes == total else
                        "partial" if successes else "unavailable")
    index_path = output / "index.json"
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                          encoding="utf-8")
    evidence = [{"path": str(path.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha256_file(path)}
                for path in sorted(output.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()]
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "native_candidate_queue",
                "status": record["status"], "evidence": evidence}
    manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                             encoding="utf-8")
    return index_path
```
