`copyapp/onboarding.py`:

```py
"""One-command entry for first-device setup and actionable capability checks."""

import asyncio
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from uuid import uuid4

from pymobiledevice3.usbmux import list_devices

from copyapp.doctor import run_doctor


def _choose_device(devices: list, requested: Optional[str]) -> str:
    ids = sorted({item.serial for item in devices
                  if str(getattr(item, "connection_type", "")).lower().endswith("usb")})
    if requested:
        if requested not in ids:
            raise ValueError("requested UDID is not connected over USB; found: " +
                             (", ".join(ids) or "none"))
        return requested
    if not ids:
        raise ValueError("no USB iPhone is visible; unlock it, connect USB and accept Trust This Computer")
    if len(ids) > 1:
        raise ValueError("multiple USB devices are connected; choose --udid from: " +
                         ", ".join(ids))
    return ids[0]


def _prepare_ssh_key(identity: Path) -> bool:
    """Create only the host keypair; phone authorization remains a separate step."""
    if identity.exists():
        if not identity.is_file():
            raise ValueError("SSH identity path exists but is not a file")
        return False
    parent_existed = identity.parent.exists()
    identity.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not parent_existed:
        os.chmod(identity.parent, 0o700)
    subprocess.run(["ssh-keygen", "-q", "-t", "ed25519", "-N", "",
                    "-f", str(identity), "-C", "copyapp"], check=True)
    os.chmod(identity, 0o600)
    return True


def run_onboarding(udid: Optional[str] = None, output: Optional[Path] = None,
                   ssh_identity: Path = Path("cases/ssh/id_ed25519"),
                   ssh_known_hosts: Path = Path("cases/ssh-known-hosts"),
                   ssh_port: int = 22222, prepare_ssh: bool = True,
                   stage: str = "survey", mode: Optional[str] = None) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    """Identify one device, prepare the local key and save a guided doctor case."""
    if stage not in ("survey", "analyze", "rebuild"):
        raise ValueError("stage must be survey, analyze or rebuild")
    devices = asyncio.run(list_devices())
    selected = _choose_device(devices, udid)
    if output is None:
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
        output = Path("cases") / f"onboard-{stamp}-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"refusing to overwrite setup case: {output}")
    if mode is not None:
        from copyapp.ios_capabilities import collect_capabilities
        collect_capabilities(selected, output, mode, ssh_port, ssh_identity, ssh_known_hosts)
        record = json.loads((output / "capabilities.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        operation = record["operations"][stage]
        print(f"Device: {selected}")
        print(f"Mode: {record['selected_mode']}; UI backend: {record['ui_backend']}")
        print(f"Setup report: {output / 'report.md'}")
        print(f"{stage}: " + ("ready for an attempt" if operation["ready_for_attempt"] else "needs setup"))
        for item in operation["missing"]:
            print(f"- Missing: {item}")
        print("This does not certify UI behavior, signing profiles, or a completed rebuild.")
        return output / "report.md", operation["ready_for_attempt"]
    created_key = _prepare_ssh_key(ssh_identity) if prepare_ssh and stage != "survey" else False
    report, connected = run_doctor(selected, output, ssh_port, ssh_identity,
                                   ssh_known_hosts, survey_only=(stage == "survey"))
    record = json.loads((output / "device.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    survey_ready = (connected and
                    record["probes"].get("usb_screenshot", {}).get("status") == "available")
    roothide = bool(record["probes"].get("rootless_marker", {}).get("roothide_namespace"))
    runtime_ready = (not roothide or
                     record["probes"].get("frida_usb", {}).get("transport") ==
                     "usb_roothide_sidecar")
    analysis_ready = (survey_ready and
                      all(record["probes"].get(name, {}).get("status") == "available"
                          for name in ("ssh_mobile", "frida_usb", "ios_mcp")) and
                      runtime_ready and
                      record["host"]["xcode"]["status"] == "available")
    signing_tool_ready = any(record["host"].get(name, {}).get("status") == "available"
                             for name in ("ldid", "development_signing"))
    rebuild_ready = (analysis_ready and
                     record["host"]["xcodegen"]["status"] == "available" and
                     signing_tool_ready)
    ready = {"survey": survey_ready, "analyze": analysis_ready,
             "rebuild": rebuild_ready}[stage]
    print(f"Device: {selected}")
    if created_key:
        print(f"Created dedicated Mac SSH key: {ssh_identity}")
    print(f"Setup report: {report}")
    print("First USB survey: " + ("ready" if survey_ready else "needs setup"))
    print("Deep analysis: " + ("not checked (rerun with --stage analyze)" if stage == "survey"
                               else "ready" if analysis_ready else "needs setup"))
    print("Rebuild host tools: " + ("not checked (rerun with --stage rebuild)"
                                    if stage == "survey" else "ready" if rebuild_ready
                                    else "needs setup"))
    if stage == "rebuild" and rebuild_ready:
        print("A specific App still needs a compatible signing profile or TrollStore route on this device.")
    relevant = {"survey": {"usb_lockdown", "usb_screenshot"},
                "analyze": {"usb_lockdown", "usb_screenshot", "ssh_mobile",
                            "frida_usb", "frida_roothide", "ios_mcp", "xcode",
                            "theos_tweak"},
                "rebuild": None}[stage]
    for step in record["next_steps"]:
        if relevant is None or step["for"] in relevant:
            print(f"- {step['for']}: {step['action']}")
    if ready and stage == "survey":
        print(f"Next: .venv/bin/copyapp apps --udid {selected} --all")
        print(f"For full analysis: .venv/bin/copyapp onboard --udid {selected} --stage analyze")
    elif ready and stage in ("analyze", "rebuild"):
        print("Device commands open exact-device USB forwards when needed; no persistent tunnel is required.")
        print(f"Use .venv/bin/copyapp tunnel --udid {selected} only for interactive checks or first SSH host-key pinning.")
    return report, ready

```

`copyapp/output_paths.py`:

```py
"""Resolve copy-job paths without creating files or selecting an implicit resume."""

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.source_root import source_root


def copy_paths(bundle: str, *, workspace: Optional[Path] = None,
               output_dir: Optional[Path] = None, output: Optional[Path] = None,
               project: Optional[Path] = None, resume: bool = False):
    workspace = (workspace or source_root()).resolve(strict=True)
    if output is not None and output_dir is not None:
        raise ValueError("use --output-dir or --out, not both")
    if resume and output is None and output_dir is None:
        raise ValueError("--resume requires the previous --output-dir or --out; no latest job is selected")
    if output is not None:
        if project is None:
            raise ValueError("legacy --out requires --project; use --output-dir for a combined job directory")
        evidence = output.resolve()
    else:
        if output_dir is None:
            label = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "-", bundle).strip(".-")[:80] or "app"
            stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
            output_dir = workspace / "output" / f"{label}-{stamp}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        root = output_dir.resolve()
        evidence = root / "evidence"
        project = project if project is not None else root / "project"
    project = project.resolve()
    if (not workspace.is_dir() or not evidence.is_relative_to(workspace) or
            not project.is_relative_to(workspace) or evidence == project or
            evidence in project.parents or project in evidence.parents):
        raise ValueError("workflow output and independent project must be separate workspace paths")
    return workspace, evidence, project

```

`copyapp/playbook.py`:

```py
"""Replay a bounded UI scenario on one named iPhone with retained evidence."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from contextlib import ExitStack
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple

from copyapp.experiment import ExperimentUI
from copyapp.gestures import GESTURE_ACTIONS, gesture_params
from copyapp.text_actions import TYPE_ACTION, type_params
from copyapp.ictrl import DEFAULT_CLIENT, ICtrlClient
from copyapp.ocr_file import ocr_file
from copyapp.usb_tunnel import ictrl_tunnel, ios_mcp_tunnel
from copyapp.ui_capture import capture_stable, frame_health
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


async def _fresh_launch(udid: str, bundle: str) -> None:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "copyapp.dvt_launch", udid, bundle],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20, check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise TimeoutError("Instruments fresh launch exceeded 20 seconds") from exc
    if result.returncode:
        detail = (result.stderr or result.stdout).strip()[-300:]
        raise RuntimeError(f"Instruments fresh launch exited {result.returncode}: {detail}")


def _text(observation: Dict[str, Any], backend: str) -> str:
    if backend == "ictrl":
        return str(observation.get("source") or "")
    return "\n".join(str(item.get("text") or "") for item in observation.get("elements", [])
                     if isinstance(item, dict))


def _exact_labels(observation: Dict[str, Any], backend: str) -> set:
    """Return visible accessibility labels without substring or OCR matching."""
    if backend == "ictrl":
        if observation.get("source_channel") != "ax":
            return set()
        labels = re.findall(r"\blabel: '((?:\\.|[^'\\])*)'", str(observation.get("source") or ""))
        return {label.replace("\\'", "'").replace("\\\\", "\\") for label in labels}
    return {item["text"] for item in observation.get("elements", [])
            if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("text"), str) and item["text"]}


def _record_file(output: Path, path: Path, evidence: list) -> None:
    evidence.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha256_file(path)})


def _check_fresh_launch_frame(ui: ExperimentUI, bundle: str, output: Path,
                              record: dict) -> None:
    """Recover a DVT-launched app whose compositor still paints black."""
    frames = record["fresh_launch_frames"] = []
    for phase in ("initial", "after_reactivation"):
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            path = output / f"fresh-launch-{phase}-{attempt}.jpg"
            ui.screenshot(path)
            health = frame_health(path.read_bytes())
            _record_file(output, path, record["evidence"])
            frames.append({"phase": phase, "attempt": attempt,
                           "path": str(path.relative_to(output)),
                           "sha256": sha256_file(path),
                           "source": getattr(ui, "last_screenshot_source", "unknown"),
                           **health})
            if not health["near_uniform_black"]:
                return
            time.sleep(0.35)
        if phase == "initial":
            ui.client.call_ui("press_home")
            time.sleep(0.35)
            ui.launch(bundle)
            record["fresh_launch_render_recovery"] = "home_then_ios_mcp_launch"
            for _ in range(10):
                if ui.frontmost() == bundle:
                    break
                time.sleep(0.3)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("target did not return to foreground after black-frame recovery")
            time.sleep(1.0)
    raise RuntimeError("fresh launch remained near-uniform black after reactivation")


def _check_standard_launch_frame(ui: ExperimentUI, bundle: str, output: Path, record: dict) -> None:
    """Reject black launch frames and bound Home/activate recovery before actions."""
    frames = record["standard_launch_frames"] = []
    for phase in ("initial", "after_reactivation"):
        path = output / f"standard-launch-{phase}.jpg"
        ui.screenshot(path)
        health = frame_health(path.read_bytes())
        _record_file(output, path, record["evidence"])
        frames.append({"path": path.name, "sha256": sha256_file(path),
                       "source": ui.last_screenshot_source, **health})
        if not health["near_uniform_black"]:
            if ui.frontmost() != bundle:
                raise RuntimeError("target left foreground during standard launch check")
            return
        if phase == "initial":
            ui.client.call_ui("home")
            ui.launch(bundle)
            record["fresh_launch_render_recovery"] = "home_then_xctest_activate"
            if ui.frontmost() != bundle:
                raise RuntimeError("target could not reactivate; unlock the device before retrying")
    raise RuntimeError("standard launch remained black; inspect screen/lock state before retrying")


def run_playbook(udid: str, backend: str, script: Path, output: Path,
                 port: Optional[int] = None, ictrl_client: Path = DEFAULT_CLIENT,
                 trace_observer=None, mode: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[Path, bool]:
    if backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl"):
        raise ValueError("unsupported UI backend")
    if mode not in (None, "standard", "enhanced"):
        raise ValueError("invalid execution mode")
    if mode == "standard" and (backend != "ictrl" or trace_observer is not None):
        raise ValueError("standard playbooks require ictrl and cannot attach runtime observers")
    plan = json.loads(script.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    bundle = plan.get("bundle_id")
    scenario_id = plan.get("scenario_id")
    steps = plan.get("steps")
    if (plan.get("schema_version") != 1 or not isinstance(bundle, str) or
            not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", bundle) or
            (scenario_id is not None and (not isinstance(scenario_id, str) or
             not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,80}", scenario_id))) or
            not isinstance(steps, list) or not 1 <= len(steps) <= 64):
        raise ValueError("invalid UI playbook")
    for index, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
        if isinstance(step, dict) and "ready_ocr_labels" in step:
            labels = step["ready_ocr_labels"]
            if (step.get("action") != "screenshot" or not isinstance(labels, list) or
                    not labels or any(not isinstance(label, str) or not label.strip()
                                      for label in labels)):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid ready_ocr_labels at step {index}")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    script_copy = output / "playbook.json"
    shutil.copyfile(script, script_copy)
    record: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": bundle, "ui_backend": backend,
        "scenario_id": scenario_id,
        "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
        "started_at": _now(), "status": "failed", "steps": [], "evidence": [],
    }
    if mode is not None:
        record["execution_mode"] = mode
    _record_file(output, script_copy, record["evidence"])
    manifest = output / "manifest.json"
    numbers: Dict[str, int] = {}
    try:
        if mode == "standard":
            tunnel = (ictrl_tunnel(udid, ictrl_client, require_xctest=True,
                                  log_path=output / "xcuitest.log") if port is None else None)
        else:
            tunnel = (ios_mcp_tunnel(udid) if backend == "ios-mcp" else
                      ictrl_tunnel(udid, ictrl_client)) if port is None else None
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            own_port = stack.enter_context(tunnel) if tunnel is not None else port
            identity_port = None
            if backend == "ictrl" and mode != "standard":
                try:
                    identity_port = stack.enter_context(ios_mcp_tunnel(udid))
                except (OSError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
                    # iCTRL remains usable without the optional helper.
                    # Retain the reason when its own foreground cache is stale.
                    record["identity_tunnel_error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}"
            _run_steps(udid, bundle, backend, steps, plan, output, own_port,
                       ictrl_client, record, numbers, trace_observer,
                       identity_port=identity_port)
        record["status"] = "complete"
    except Exception as exc:
        record["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:400],
                           "step_index": len(record["steps"])}
    finally:
        log_path = output / "xcuitest.log"
        if log_path.is_file():
            _record_file(output, log_path, record["evidence"])
        if trace_observer is not None:
            try:
                trace_observer.finish()
            except Exception as exc:
                record["status"] = "failed"
                record["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__,
                                   "message": f"trace cleanup: {str(exc)[:350]}",
                                   "step_index": len(record["steps"])}
        record["finished_at"] = _now()
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest, record["status"] == "complete"


def _run_steps(udid: str, bundle: str, backend: str, steps: list, plan: dict,
               output: Path, port: int, ictrl_client: Path, record: dict,
               numbers: Dict[str, int], trace_observer=None,
               identity_port: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
    ui = ExperimentUI(backend, port, ictrl_client, identity_port=identity_port,
                      bundle_id=bundle)
    ui.standard_mode = record.get("execution_mode") == "standard"
    ui.device_udid = udid
    record["frontmost_backend"] = (
        "ios-mcp" if identity_port is not None or backend == "ios-mcp" else "ictrl")
    width, height = ui.bounds()
    if not isinstance(width, (int, float)) or not isinstance(height, (int, float)):
        raise RuntimeError("device screen bounds unavailable")
    record["screen"] = {"width": width, "height": height, "coordinate_space": "points"}
    # Reject malformed gestures before launching or touching the App.
    for step in steps:
        if isinstance(step, dict) and step.get("action") in GESTURE_ACTIONS:
            gesture_params(step, width, height)
        elif isinstance(step, dict) and step.get("action") == TYPE_ACTION:
            type_params(step)
    if plan.get("fresh_launch") is True:
        if backend == "ictrl":
            # XCTest can terminate and relaunch its target without an
            # Instruments connection, which may be unavailable on this XR.
            ui.client.call_ui("terminate_app", {"bundle_id": bundle})
            ui.launch(bundle)
            record["fresh_launch_backend"] = "ictrl"
        else:
            try:
                asyncio.run(_fresh_launch(udid, bundle))
                record["fresh_launch_backend"] = "instruments"
            except (TimeoutError, RuntimeError, OSError) as exc:
                record["fresh_launch_primary_error"] = (
                    f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:250]}")
                # The iCTRL runner can terminate and relaunch the exact target
                # without Instruments. Keep iOS MCP for observations and taps.
                with ictrl_tunnel(udid, ictrl_client) as fallback_port:
                    lifecycle = ICtrlClient(port=fallback_port, client=ictrl_client)
                    lifecycle.call_ui("terminate_app", {"bundle_id": bundle})
                    lifecycle.call_ui("launch_app", {"bundle_id": bundle})
                record["fresh_launch_backend"] = "ictrl_lifecycle_fallback"
        for _ in range(10):
            if ui.frontmost() == bundle:
                break
            time.sleep(0.3)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("target did not become frontmost after fresh launch")
        # SpringBoard can report the new foreground app before UIKit paints its
        # first complete navigation bar. XR / iOS 16 Clock reproduced this.
        time.sleep(2.0)
        if backend == "ios-mcp" and record.get("fresh_launch_backend") == "instruments":
            _check_fresh_launch_frame(ui, bundle, output, record)
        if ui.standard_mode:
            _check_standard_launch_frame(ui, bundle, output, record)
    if trace_observer is not None:
        if ui.frontmost() != bundle:
            raise RuntimeError("target is not frontmost before trace attachment")
        trace_observer.start(udid, bundle)
    for index, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
        step_started = time.monotonic()
        if not isinstance(step, dict) or step.get("action") not in (
                "observe", "tap", "tap_label", "screenshot", "expect_foreground",
                *GESTURE_ACTIONS, TYPE_ACTION):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid playbook step {index}")
        wait_ms = step.get("wait_ms", 0)
        if type(wait_ms) is not int or not 0 <= wait_ms <= 5000:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid wait_ms at step {index}")
        if wait_ms:
            time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
        action = step["action"]
        if action == "expect_foreground":
            expected_frontmost = step.get("bundle_id")
            if (not isinstance(expected_frontmost, str) or
                    not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", expected_frontmost)):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid expected foreground app at step {index}")
            for attempt in range(1, 11):
                frontmost = ui.frontmost()
                if frontmost == expected_frontmost:
                    break
                time.sleep(0.3)
        else:
            frontmost = ui.frontmost()
            if frontmost != bundle:
                raise RuntimeError(f"target left foreground at step {index}: {frontmost}")
        item: Dict[str, Any] = {"index": index, "action": action,
                                "at": _now(), "frontmost": frontmost}
        record["steps"].append(item)
        if action == "expect_foreground":
            item["expected_frontmost"] = expected_frontmost
            item["attempts"] = attempt
            if frontmost != expected_frontmost:
                raise RuntimeError(f"expected foreground app was not reached at step {index}: {frontmost}")
        elif action == "observe":
            expected = step.get("contains", [])
            if isinstance(expected, str):
                expected = [expected]
            if not isinstance(expected, list) or any(not isinstance(s, str) for s in expected):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid contains at step {index}")
            exact_labels = step.get("exact_labels", [])
            if isinstance(exact_labels, str):
                exact_labels = [exact_labels]
            if (not isinstance(exact_labels, list) or
                    any(not isinstance(s, str) or not s for s in exact_labels)):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid exact_labels at step {index}")
            for attempt in range(1, 6):
                value = ui.observe()
                visible = _text(value, backend)
                missing = [s for s in expected if s not in visible]
                missing_exact = [s for s in exact_labels if s not in _exact_labels(value, backend)]
                if (not missing and not missing_exact) or attempt == 5:
                    break
                time.sleep(0.3)
            path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-observe.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            _record_file(output, path, record["evidence"])
            if missing:
                image_path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-observe-ocr.jpg"
                ocr_path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-observe-ocr.json"
                ui.screenshot(image_path)
                _record_file(output, image_path, record["evidence"])
                ocr_file(image_path, ocr_path)
                _record_file(output, ocr_path, record["evidence"])
                ocr_record = json.loads(ocr_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                ocr_text = "\n".join(str(entry.get("text") or "") for entry in
                                     ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict))
                missing = [s for s in expected if s not in ocr_text]
                item["observation_source"] = "screenshot_ocr"
                item["observation_image_path"] = str(image_path.relative_to(output))
                item["observation_image_sha256"] = sha256_file(image_path)
                item["observation_ocr_path"] = str(ocr_path.relative_to(output))
                item["observation_ocr_sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
                visible = ocr_text
            else:
                item["observation_source"] = "accessibility"
            item["attempts"] = attempt
            item["accessibility_coverage"] = value.get("ax_coverage")
            item["element_count"] = value.get("element_count", value.get("total_returned"))
            item["visible_text"] = visible[:2000]
            item["missing"] = missing
            item["missing_exact_labels"] = missing_exact
            if exact_labels:
                item["exact_label_source"] = "accessibility"
            item["evidence_path"] = str(path.relative_to(output))
            if missing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"missing visible text at step {index}: {missing}")
            if missing_exact:
                raise RuntimeError(f"missing exact accessibility labels at step {index}: {missing_exact}")
            extract = step.get("capture_number")
            if extract:
                name, pattern = extract.get("name"), extract.get("pattern")
                if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(pattern, str):
                    raise ValueError("invalid capture_number")
                match = re.search(pattern, visible)
                if not match or not match.group(1).isdigit():
                    raise RuntimeError(f"numeric capture failed at step {index}")
                numbers[name] = int(match.group(1))
                item["captured_number"] = {"name": name, "value": numbers[name]}
            compare = step.get("compare_number")
            if compare:
                name, pattern, delta = compare.get("to"), compare.get("pattern"), compare.get("delta")
                if name not in numbers or not isinstance(pattern, str) or type(delta) is not int:
                    raise ValueError("invalid compare_number")
                match = re.search(pattern, visible)
                if not match or not match.group(1).isdigit():
                    raise RuntimeError(f"numeric comparison failed at step {index}")
                actual = int(match.group(1))
                item["number_comparison"] = {"before": numbers[name], "after": actual, "delta": delta}
                if actual != numbers[name] + delta:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"numeric delta mismatch at step {index}")
        elif action == "tap_label":
            label = step.get("label")
            if not isinstance(label, str) or not label:
                raise ValueError(f"invalid tap label at step {index}")
            region = step.get("region_points")
            if region is not None and (
                    not isinstance(region, list) or len(region) != 4 or
                    any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                        for value in region) or
                    not 0 <= region[0] < region[2] <= width or
                    not 0 <= region[1] < region[3] <= height):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid tap label region at step {index}")
            if trace_observer is not None:
                trace_observer.begin_step(index, action)
            try:
                item["result"] = ui.tap_label(label, region, bundle)
            finally:
                if trace_observer is not None:
                    trace_observer.end_step()
            match = item["result"].get("match", {})
            tap_y = match.get("y") if isinstance(match, dict) else None
            if isinstance(tap_y, (int, float)) and tap_y >= height * 0.8:
                # Tab changes can expose accessibility labels before the new
                # view has finished painting; settle before observing it.
                time.sleep(2.0)
                item["post_tap_settle_ms"] = 2000
        elif action == "tap":
            x, y = step.get("x"), step.get("y")
            if (not isinstance(x, (int, float)) or isinstance(x, bool) or
                    not isinstance(y, (int, float)) or isinstance(y, bool) or
                    not 0 <= x <= width or not 0 <= y <= height):
                raise ValueError(f"invalid tap coordinates at step {index}")
            if trace_observer is not None:
                trace_observer.begin_step(index, action)
            try:
                item["result"] = ui.tap(x, y)
            finally:
                if trace_observer is not None:
                    trace_observer.end_step()
        elif action in GESTURE_ACTIONS:
            gesture = gesture_params(step, width, height)
            item["gesture"] = gesture
            if trace_observer is not None:
                trace_observer.begin_step(index, action)
            try:
                if action == "swipe":
                    item["result"] = ui.swipe(
                        gesture["from_x"], gesture["from_y"],
                        gesture["to_x"], gesture["to_y"],
                        gesture["duration_ms"], gesture["steps"])
                elif action == "long_press":
                    item["result"] = ui.long_press(
                        gesture["x"], gesture["y"], gesture["duration_ms"])
                else:
                    item["result"] = ui.double_tap(
                        gesture["x"], gesture["y"], gesture["interval_ms"])
            finally:
                if trace_observer is not None:
                    trace_observer.end_step()
        elif action == TYPE_ACTION:
            item["typed_text"] = type_params(step)
            if trace_observer is not None:
                trace_observer.begin_step(index, action)
            try:
                item["result"] = ui.type_text(step["text"])
            finally:
                if trace_observer is not None:
                    trace_observer.end_step()
        else:
            path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-screenshot.jpg"
            for frame_attempt in range(1, 4):
                if step.get("stable") is True:
                    # Allow accessibility to reach the rendered frame first.
                    time.sleep(1.0)
                    sample = output / f".step-{index:02d}-sample.jpg"
                    try:
                        def capture() -> bytes:
                            ui.screenshot(sample)
                            return sample.read_bytes()

                        image, stability = capture_stable(capture, samples=6,
                                                          interval=0.35, threshold=0.012,
                                                          minimum_samples=5)
                    finally:
                        sample.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    path.write_bytes(image)
                    item["stability"] = stability
                else:
                    ui.screenshot(path)
                health = frame_health(path.read_bytes())
                item.setdefault("frame_attempts", []).append({
                    "attempt": frame_attempt, "source": getattr(ui, "last_screenshot_source", "unknown"),
                    "sha256": sha256_file(path), **health})
                if not health["near_uniform_black"]:
                    break
                if frame_attempt < 3:
                    rejected = output / f"step-{index:02d}-black-attempt-{frame_attempt}.jpg"
                    shutil.copyfile(path, rejected)
                    _record_file(output, rejected, record["evidence"])
                    time.sleep(0.35)
            item["sha256"] = sha256_file(path)
            item["evidence_path"] = str(path.relative_to(output))
            _record_file(output, path, record["evidence"])
            if health["near_uniform_black"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"screenshot remains near-uniform black at step {index}")
            if step.get("stable") is True and not item["stability"]["stable"]:
                raise RuntimeError(f"screenshot did not settle at step {index}")
            if ui.frontmost() != bundle:
                raise RuntimeError(f"target left foreground during screenshot at step {index}")
            ready_contains = step.get("ready_contains")
            if ready_contains is not None:
                if not isinstance(ready_contains, str) or not ready_contains:
                    raise ValueError(f"invalid ready_contains at step {index}")
                for attempt in range(1, 6):
                    value = ui.observe()
                    visible = _text(value, backend)
                    if ready_contains in visible or attempt == 5:
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.3)
                item["ready_contains"] = ready_contains
                item["ready_attempts"] = attempt
                item["ready_visible_text"] = visible[:2000]
                if ready_contains in visible:
                    item["ready_source"] = "accessibility"
                    item["ready_found"] = True
                else:
                    ocr_path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-ready-ocr.json"
                    ocr_file(path, ocr_path)
                    _record_file(output, ocr_path, record["evidence"])
                    ocr_record = json.loads(ocr_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    ocr_text = "\n".join(str(entry.get("text") or "") for entry in
                                         ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict))
                    item["ready_source"] = "screenshot_ocr"
                    item["ready_ocr_path"] = str(ocr_path.relative_to(output))
                    item["ready_ocr_sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
                    item["ready_found"] = ready_contains in ocr_text
                if not item["ready_found"]:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"screenshot target content was not ready at step {index}")
            image_labels = step.get("ready_ocr_labels")
            if image_labels is not None:
                ocr_path = output / f"step-{index:02d}-visual-ocr.json"
                ocr_file(path, ocr_path)
                _record_file(output, ocr_path, record["evidence"])
                ocr_record = json.loads(ocr_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                painted = {str(entry.get("text") or "").strip() for entry in
                           ocr_record["result"]["texts"] if isinstance(entry, dict)}
                missing = [label for label in image_labels if label not in painted]
                item["ready_ocr_labels"] = image_labels
                item["ready_ocr_labels_path"] = str(ocr_path.relative_to(output))
                item["ready_ocr_labels_sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
                item["missing_ready_ocr_labels"] = missing
                if missing:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"screenshot lacks visible labels at step {index}: {missing}")
        item["duration_ms"] = round((time.monotonic() - step_started) * 1000)

```

`copyapp/playbook_auto.py`:

```py
"""Try a second UI backend only when the first failed before any touch."""

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.gestures import GESTURE_ACTIONS
from copyapp.text_actions import TYPE_ACTION
from copyapp.ictrl import DEFAULT_CLIENT
from copyapp.playbook import run_playbook
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def run_playbook_auto(udid: str, primary: str, fallback: str, script: Path,
                      output: Path, ictrl_client: Path = DEFAULT_CLIENT) -> tuple:
    if {primary, fallback} != {"ios-mcp", "ictrl"}:
        raise ValueError("playbook-auto requires one ios-mcp and one ictrl backend")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    plan = json.loads(script.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    script_sha256 = sha256_file(script)
    prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    attempts = []
    evidence = []
    final_backend = None
    status = "failed"
    for index, backend in enumerate((primary, fallback), 1):
        root = output / ("primary" if index == 1 else "fallback")
        manifest, complete = run_playbook(udid, backend, script, root,
                                          ictrl_client=ictrl_client)
        if not verify_case(root):
            raise ValueError(f"{backend} playbook evidence hash mismatch")
        record = json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if (sha256_file(root / "playbook.json") != script_sha256 or
                record.get("bundle_id") != plan.get("bundle_id") or
                record.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != prefix or
                record.get("ui_backend") != backend or
                record.get("status") != ("complete" if complete else "failed")):
            raise ValueError("playbook attempt identity or script changed")
        touched = any(step.get("action") in ("tap", "tap_label", *GESTURE_ACTIONS,
                                              TYPE_ACTION)
                      for step in record["steps"])
        attempts.append({"backend": backend, "status": record["status"],
                         "touch_attempted": touched,
                         "manifest": str(manifest.relative_to(output)),
                         "error": record.get("error")})
        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
            if path.is_file():
                evidence.append({"path": str(path.relative_to(output)), "sha256": sha256_file(path)})
        if complete:
            status = "complete"
            final_backend = backend
            break
        if touched:
            break
    result = {"schema_version": 1, "status": status,
              "bundle_id": plan.get("bundle_id"), "scenario_id": plan.get("scenario_id"),
              "script_sha256": script_sha256,
              "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
              "primary_backend": primary, "fallback_backend": fallback,
              "selected_backend": final_backend,
              "fallback_skipped_after_touch": bool(attempts[-1]["touch_attempted"] and status != "complete"),
              "attempts": attempts, "finished_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
              "evidence": evidence}
    target = output / "manifest.json"
    target.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return target, status == "complete"

```

`copyapp/plist_schema.py`:

```py
"""Describe a captured property list's structure without exporting values."""

import json
import plistlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.sqlite_schema import _source_file
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


MAX_PLIST_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_NODES = 2048
MAX_FIELDS = 1024
MAX_DEPTH = 12


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")


def _type(value) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return "dictionary"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return "array"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "boolean"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "integer"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return "real"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "string"
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return "data"
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return "date"
    if isinstance(value, plistlib.UID):
        return "uid"
    raise ValueError("property list contains an unsupported value type")


def _structure(value) -> dict:
    observed = set()
    fields = []
    scanned = 0
    truncated = False

    def walk(current, path: str, depth: int) -> None:
        nonlocal scanned, truncated
        if scanned >= MAX_NODES:
            truncated = True
            return
        scanned += 1
        kind = _type(current)
        key = (path, kind)
        if key not in observed:
            if len(fields) >= MAX_FIELDS:
                truncated = True
                return
            observed.add(key)
            fields.append({"path": path, "type": kind})
        if depth >= MAX_DEPTH:
            if isinstance(current, (dict, list)) and current:
                truncated = True
            return
        if isinstance(current, dict):
            for name in sorted(current):
                if not isinstance(name, str) or len(name) > 256 or any(
                        ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in name):
                    truncated = True
                    continue
                escaped = name.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
                child = path + "/" + escaped
                if len(child) > 1024:
                    truncated = True
                    continue
                walk(current[name], child, depth + 1)
        elif isinstance(current, list):
            for child in current:
                walk(child, path + "/*", depth + 1)

    walk(value, "", 0)
    fields.sort(key=lambda item: (item["path"], item["type"]))
    return {"root_type": _type(value), "fields": fields,
            "nodes_scanned": scanned, "truncated": truncated}


def inspect_plist_source(case: Path, relative: str) -> dict:
    source, digest, index_digest = _source_file(case, relative)
    if not 0 < source.stat().st_size <= MAX_PLIST_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("property list exceeds bounded size")
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    try:
        value = plistlib.loads(raw)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OSError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("selected file is not a valid property list") from exc
    structure = _structure(value)
    if sha256_file(source) != digest:
        raise ValueError("property list changed during structure inspection")
    return {"source_case": str(case.resolve()),
            "source_index_sha256": index_digest,
            "source_relative_path": relative, "source_sha256": digest,
            "structure": structure,
            "scope": "Property-list key paths and value types only. Values, array lengths and data bytes are omitted; repeated array element shapes are merged."}


def create_plist_schema(case: Path, relative: str, output: Path) -> Path:
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"property-list output is not empty: {output}")
    if output.resolve() == case.resolve():
        raise ValueError("property-list output must differ from source case")
    result = inspect_plist_source(case, relative)
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result.update({"schema_version": 1, "kind": "plist_schema",
                   "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")})
    _write(output / "profile.json", result)
    structure = result["structure"]
    lines = ["# Property List 数据结构", "",
             f"- 来源：`{result['source_case']}` / `{relative}`。",
             f"- 文件 SHA-256：`{result['source_sha256']}`。",
             f"- 键路径与类型：{len(structure['fields'])} 项；"
             f"扫描对象：{structure['nodes_scanned']}；"
             f"截断：{'是' if structure['truncated'] else '否'}。", "",
             "| 键路径 | 类型 |", "| --- | --- |"]
    for item in structure["fields"]:
        label = json.dumps(item["path"] or "/", ensure_ascii=False).replace("|", "\\|")
        lines.append(f"| {label} | {item['type']} |")
    lines.extend(["", "只记录键路径与类型；值、数组长度和二进制正文未导出。"
                  "结构不能单独证明 App 的读写时机或业务语义。", ""])
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _write(output / "manifest.json", {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "plist_schema",
        "status": "complete", "source_index_sha256": result["source_index_sha256"],
        "evidence": [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
                     for name in ("profile.json", "report.md")]})
    return output / "report.md"


def validate_plist_schema_case(output: Path) -> bool:
    saved = _read(output / "profile.json")
    source = Path(saved["source_case"]).resolve(strict=True)
    if source == output.resolve() or source in output.resolve().parents:
        return False
    actual = inspect_plist_source(source, saved["source_relative_path"])
    manifest = _read(output / "manifest.json")
    return (saved.get("schema_version") == 1 and saved.get("kind") == "plist_schema" and
            manifest.get("schema_version") == 1 and manifest.get("kind") == "plist_schema" and
            manifest.get("status") == "complete" and
            manifest.get("source_index_sha256") == actual["source_index_sha256"] and
            set(saved) == set(actual) | {"schema_version", "kind", "created_at"} and
            all(saved.get(key) == value for key, value in actual.items()))

```

`copyapp/prepare_analysis.py`:

```py
"""Resume a multi-flow investigation and prepare its coding-agent review task."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.draft_analysis import draft_analysis
from copyapp.investigate_app import investigate_app
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _verified(path: Path) -> bool:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        return verify_case(path)


def _save(output: Path, record: dict) -> Path:
    record["updated_at"] = _now()
    record["evidence"] = [
        {"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
        for name in ("toolchain-doctor.json", "draft/manifest.json")
        if (output / name).is_file()]
    path = output / "manifest.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def _ghidra_ready(output: Path, ghidra_dir: Optional[Path],
                  java_home: Optional[Path],
                  disabled_analyzer: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """Check the selected decompiler before any phone touch is attempted."""
    from copyapp.ghidra_direct import check_direct_ghidra
    if ghidra_dir is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError("direct Ghidra requires --ghidra-dir or GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR")
    selected_java = java_home or (Path(os.environ["JAVA_HOME"])
                                  if os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME") else None)
    if selected_java is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError("direct Ghidra requires a JDK via --java-home or JAVA_HOME")
    result = check_direct_ghidra(ghidra_dir, selected_java, disabled_analyzer)
    (output / "toolchain-doctor.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _hopper_ready(output: Path, hopper_app: Optional[Path]) -> None:
    from copyapp.hopper_direct import check_direct_hopper
    result = check_direct_hopper(hopper_app)
    (output / "toolchain-doctor.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def prepare_analysis(udid: str, analysis: Path, scripts: list[Path], output: Path,
                     backend: str = "ios-mcp", provider: str = "none",
                     rea_limit: int = 4, rea_script: Optional[Path] = None,
                     ghidra_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
                     java_home: Optional[Path] = None, timeout: int = 240,
                     rebuilt_bundle_id: str = "", resume: bool = False,
                     investigation: Optional[Path] = None,
                     disabled_analyzer: Optional[str] = None,
                     network: bool = False,
                     hopper_app: Optional[Path] = None) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    """Prepare a verified review task; completion still needs semantic agent work."""
    if not 1 <= len(scripts) <= 12:
        raise ValueError("provide 1–12 playbooks for one app")
    if disabled_analyzer is not None and provider != "ghidra-direct":
        raise ValueError("disabled analyzer requires ghidra-direct provider")
    if provider not in ("none", "ghidra-direct", "hopper-direct") or rea_script is not None:
        raise ValueError("unsupported analysis provider or removed REA script option")
    if ghidra_dir is None and os.environ.get("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR"):
        ghidra_dir = Path(os.environ["GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR"])
    if java_home is None and os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME"):
        java_home = Path(os.environ["JAVA_HOME"])
    analysis = analysis.resolve(strict=True)
    if not _verified(analysis):
        raise ValueError("analysis case evidence hash mismatch")
    survey = _read(analysis / "survey/manifest.json")
    bundle = survey.get("bundle_id")
    prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    if not isinstance(bundle, str) or survey.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != prefix:
        raise ValueError("analysis case belongs to another device")
    script_records = []
    for script in scripts:
        script = script.resolve(strict=True)
        if _read(script).get("bundle_id") != bundle:
            raise ValueError(f"playbook belongs to another app: {script}")
        script_records.append({"path": str(script), "sha256": sha256_file(script)})
    if len({item["sha256"] for item in script_records}) != len(script_records):
        raise ValueError("duplicate playbooks are not allowed")
    investigation = investigation.resolve(strict=True) if investigation else output / "investigation"
    resolved_output = output.resolve()
    internal_investigation = (resolved_output / "investigation").resolve()
    if (analysis == investigation or
            (resolved_output == analysis or resolved_output in analysis.parents) or
            (investigation != internal_investigation and
             (investigation == resolved_output or resolved_output in investigation.parents))):
        raise ValueError("source cases must be distinct and outside the preparation output")
    source = {"analysis_case": str(analysis),
              "analysis_index_sha256": sha256_file(analysis / "analysis-index.json"),
              "investigation_case": str(investigation.resolve()),
              "external_investigation": investigation.resolve() != internal_investigation,
              "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix, "bundle_id": bundle,
              "scripts": script_records, "ui_backend": backend, "provider": provider,
              "rebuilt_bundle_id": rebuilt_bundle_id}
    if disabled_analyzer is not None:
        source["disabled_analyzer"] = disabled_analyzer
    if network:
        source["network_requested"] = True
    parent = output / "manifest.json"
    if resume:
        if not parent.is_file():
            raise ValueError("resume requires an existing preparation manifest")
        record = _read(parent)
        if (record.get("kind") != "analysis_preparation" or
                record.get("disabled_analyzer") != disabled_analyzer or
                bool(record.get("network_requested")) != network or
                any(record.get(key) != value for key, value in source.items())):
            raise ValueError("resume target, scripts or settings differ")
    else:
        if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
            raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "analysis_preparation", **source,
                  "created_at": _now(), "status": "running"}
        _save(output, record)
    try:
        child_manifest = investigation / "manifest.json"
        if child_manifest.is_file() and _read(child_manifest).get("status") == "complete":
            if not _verified(investigation):
                raise ValueError("completed investigation failed source verification")
            if bool(_read(child_manifest).get("network_requested")) != network:
                raise ValueError("completed investigation network setting differs")
        elif source["external_investigation"]:
            raise ValueError("external investigation is not complete")
        else:
            if provider == "ghidra-direct":
                _ghidra_ready(output, ghidra_dir, java_home, disabled_analyzer)
            elif provider == "hopper-direct":
                _hopper_ready(output, hopper_app)
            _save(output, record)
            _, complete = investigate_app(
                udid, analysis, [Path(item["path"]) for item in script_records], investigation,
                backend, provider, rea_limit, rea_script, ghidra_dir, java_home,
                timeout, resume and child_manifest.is_file(),
                **({"hopper_app": hopper_app} if provider == "hopper-direct" else {}),
                **({"network": True} if network else {}),
                **({"disabled_analyzer": disabled_analyzer}
                   if disabled_analyzer is not None else {}))
            if not complete:
                record["status"] = "investigation_incomplete"
                record["investigation_status"] = _read(child_manifest).get("status")
                record["investigation_manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(child_manifest)
                return _save(output, record), False
            if not _verified(investigation):
                raise ValueError("new investigation failed source verification")
        investigated = _read(child_manifest)
        if (investigated.get("bundle_id") != bundle or
                investigated.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != prefix or
                investigated.get("analysis_index_sha256") != source["analysis_index_sha256"] or
                investigated.get("scripts") != script_records or
                investigated.get("ui_backend") != backend or
                investigated.get("provider") != provider or
                investigated.get("disabled_analyzer") != disabled_analyzer):
            raise ValueError("investigation identity differs from preparation input")
        record["investigation_manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(child_manifest)
        _save(output, record)
        draft = output / "draft"
        if (draft / "manifest.json").is_file() and _read(draft / "manifest.json").get("status") == "complete":
            if not _verified(draft):
                raise ValueError("completed review task failed source verification")
        else:
            if draft.exists():
                archive = output / "attempts" / (
                    "draft-" + datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%f"))
                archive.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                shutil.move(str(draft), str(archive))
            _, complete = draft_analysis(analysis, investigation, draft, rebuilt_bundle_id)
            if not complete:
                record["status"] = "draft_incomplete"
                return _save(output, record), False
            if not _verified(draft):
                raise ValueError("new review task failed source verification")
        task = _read(draft / "task.json")
        if (task.get("kind") != "agent_semantic_review_task" or
                task.get("analysis_index_sha256") != source["analysis_index_sha256"] or
                task.get("app_investigation_sha256") != record["investigation_manifest_sha256"] or
                task.get("target_bundle_id") != bundle or
                task.get("device_id_sha256_prefix") != prefix):
            raise ValueError("review task identity differs from preparation input")
        record["status"] = "needs_semantic_review"
        record.pop("error", None)
        return _save(output, record), True
    except Exception as exc:
        record["status"] = "failed"
        record["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:400]}
        _save(output, record)
        return parent, False

```

```py
"""Join installed-app collection and selected-flow analysis preparation."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Awaitable, Callable, Optional

from copyapp.analyze import analyze_case
from copyapp.prepare_analysis import _ghidra_ready, prepare_analysis
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _verified(path: Path) -> bool:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        return verify_case(path)


def _save(output: Path, record: dict) -> Path:
    record["updated_at"] = _now()
    record["evidence"] = [
        {"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
        for name in ("toolchain-doctor.json", "analysis/analysis-index.json",
                     "preparation/manifest.json")
        if (output / name).is_file()
    ]
    path = output / "manifest.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return path


async def prepare_app(udid: str, bundle: str, scripts: list[Path], output: Path,
                      survey: Callable[..., Awaitable[int]], *,
                      launch: bool = True, ui_backend: str = "ios-mcp",
                      backend: str = "ios-mcp", decrypt: bool = False,
                      decrypt_helper: Path = Path("../toolchains/ipadecrypt-helper-arm64"),
                      ssh_port: int = 22222, ssh_user: str = "mobile",
                      ssh_identity: Path = Path("cases/ssh/id_ed25519"),
                      ssh_known_hosts: Path = Path("cases/ssh-known-hosts"),
                      provider: str = "none", rea_limit: int = 4,
                      rea_script: Optional[Path] = None,
                      ghidra_dir: Optional[Path] = None,
                      java_home: Optional[Path] = None, timeout: int = 240,
                      rebuilt_bundle_id: str = "", resume: bool = False,
                      disabled_analyzer: Optional[str] = None,
                      network: bool = False,
                      hopper_app: Optional[Path] = None) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    """Produce a source-bound semantic-review task from one connected App."""
    if not 1 <= len(scripts) <= 12:
        raise ValueError("provide 1–12 playbooks for one app")
    if disabled_analyzer is not None and provider != "ghidra-direct":
        raise ValueError("disabled analyzer requires ghidra-direct provider")
    if not bundle or not udid or ui_backend not in ("usb", "ios-mcp") or \
            backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl") or provider not in ("none", "ghidra-direct", "hopper-direct"):
        raise ValueError("invalid device, bundle, UI backend or analysis provider")
    if rea_script is not None:
        raise ValueError("REA script option has been removed")
    if not 1 <= ssh_port <= 65535 or ssh_user not in ("root", "mobile"):
        raise ValueError("invalid SSH transport")
    if provider == "none":
        rea_script = ghidra_dir = java_home = None
    else:
        if ghidra_dir is None and os.environ.get("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR"):
            ghidra_dir = Path(os.environ["GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR"])
        if java_home is None and os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME"):
            java_home = Path(os.environ["JAVA_HOME"])
    script_records = []
    for script in scripts:
        script = script.resolve(strict=True)
        if _read(script).get("bundle_id") != bundle:
            raise ValueError(f"playbook belongs to another app: {script}")
        script_records.append({"path": str(script), "sha256": sha256_file(script)})
    if len({item["sha256"] for item in script_records}) != len(script_records):
        raise ValueError("duplicate playbooks are not allowed")
    output = output.resolve()
    if any(output == Path(item["path"]) or output in Path(item["path"]).parents
           for item in script_records):
        raise ValueError("playbooks must be outside the preparation output")
    prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    source = {
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "app_preparation",
        "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
        "scripts": script_records, "launch": launch, "ui_backend": ui_backend,
        "investigation_backend": backend, "decrypt": decrypt,
        "decrypt_helper": str(decrypt_helper.resolve()),
        "ssh_port": ssh_port, "ssh_user": ssh_user,
        "ssh_identity": str(ssh_identity.resolve()),
        "ssh_known_hosts": str(ssh_known_hosts.resolve()),
        "provider": provider, "rea_limit": rea_limit,
        "rea_script": str(rea_script.resolve()) if rea_script else None,
        "ghidra_dir": str(ghidra_dir.resolve()) if ghidra_dir else None,
        "java_home": str(java_home.resolve()) if java_home else None,
        "hopper_app": str(hopper_app.resolve()) if hopper_app else None,
        "timeout": timeout, "rebuilt_bundle_id": rebuilt_bundle_id,
    }
    if disabled_analyzer is not None:
        source["disabled_analyzer"] = disabled_analyzer
    if network:
        source["network_requested"] = True
    parent = output / "manifest.json"
    if resume:
        if not parent.is_file():
            raise ValueError("resume requires an existing app preparation manifest")
        record = _read(parent)
        if (record.get("disabled_analyzer") != disabled_analyzer or
                bool(record.get("network_requested")) != network or
                any(record.get(key) != value for key, value in source.items())):
            raise ValueError("resume target, playbooks or settings differ")
    else:
        if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
            raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = dict(source, created_at=_now(), status="preparing")
        _save(output, record)
    analysis = output / "analysis"
    preparation = output / "preparation"
    try:
        analysis_index = analysis / "analysis-index.json"
        expected_stages = {"survey", "bundle", "sandbox"}
        if decrypt:
            expected_stages.add("decryption")
        analysis_ok = (
            analysis_index.is_file() and
            record.get("analysis_index_sha256") == sha256_file(analysis_index) and
            set(_read(analysis_index).get("steps", {})) == expected_stages and
            all(item.get("ok") is True for item in _read(analysis_index).get("steps", {}).values()) and
            _read(analysis / "run-state.json").get("bundle_id") == bundle and
            _read(analysis / "run-state.json").get("device_id_sha256_prefix") == prefix and
            _read(analysis / "run-state.json").get("decrypt_requested") == decrypt and
            _verified(analysis)
        )
        if not analysis_ok:
            # Explicit decompilation needs a toolchain preflight before device work.
            if provider == "ghidra-direct":
                _ghidra_ready(output, ghidra_dir, java_home, disabled_analyzer)
            elif provider == "hopper-direct":
                from copyapp.prepare_analysis import _hopper_ready
                _hopper_ready(output, hopper_app)
            _save(output, record)
            completed = await analyze_case(
                udid, bundle, analysis, launch, ssh_port, ssh_user,
                ssh_identity, ssh_known_hosts, survey, decrypt,
                decrypt_helper, (analysis / "run-state.json").is_file())
            if not completed:
                record["status"] = "analysis_incomplete"
                record["analysis_index_sha256"] = (
                    sha256_file(analysis_index) if analysis_index.is_file() else None)
                return _save(output, record), False
            if not _verified(analysis):
                raise ValueError("new analysis failed source verification")
        record["analysis_index_sha256"] = sha256_file(analysis_index)
        record["status"] = "analysis_ready"
        _save(output, record)
        preparation_manifest = preparation / "manifest.json"
        if (preparation_manifest.is_file() and
                record.get("preparation_manifest_sha256") == sha256_file(preparation_manifest) and
                _read(preparation_manifest).get("status") == "needs_semantic_review" and
                _verified(preparation)):
            record["preparation_status"] = "needs_semantic_review"
            record["status"] = "needs_semantic_review"
            record.pop("error", None)
            return _save(output, record), True
        prepared, complete = await asyncio.to_thread(
            prepare_analysis, udid, analysis,
            [Path(item["path"]) for item in script_records],
            preparation, backend, provider, rea_limit, rea_script,
            ghidra_dir, java_home, timeout, rebuilt_bundle_id,
            (preparation / "manifest.json").is_file(),
            **({"network": True} if network else {}),
            **({"disabled_analyzer": disabled_analyzer}
               if disabled_analyzer is not None else {}),
            **({"hopper_app": hopper_app} if provider == "hopper-direct" else {}))
        record["preparation_manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(prepared)
        record["preparation_status"] = _read(prepared).get("status")
        record["status"] = "needs_semantic_review" if complete else "preparation_incomplete"
        record.pop("error", None)
        return _save(output, record), complete
    except Exception as exc:
        record["status"] = "failed"
        record["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:400]}
        return _save(output, record), False
```

`copyapp/prepare_rebuild.py`:

```py
"""Resume the verified report-to-plan-to-agent-task handoff."""

import io
import json
import shutil
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from copyapp.agent_task import UDID, create_agent_task
from copyapp.rebuild_plan import FLOW_ID, create_rebuild_plan
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _verified(path: Path) -> bool:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        return verify_case(path)


def _write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _archive(output: Path, name: str) -> None:
    source = output / name
    if not source.exists():
        return
    attempts = output / "attempts"
    attempts.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
    shutil.move(str(source), str(attempts / f"{name}-{stamp}"))


def prepare_rebuild(report: Path, output: Path, backend: str = "ios-mcp",
                    flow_ids: Optional[list[str]] = None, udid: Optional[str] = None,
                    project: Optional[Path] = None,
                    resume: bool = False) -> tuple[Path, bool]:
    """Produce a source-bound plan and task, reusing verified stages on resume."""
    report = report.resolve(strict=True)
    output = output.resolve()
    if output == report or output in report.parents or report in output.parents:
        raise ValueError("report and preparation output must be separate directories")
    if not _verified(report):
        raise ValueError("analysis report evidence hash mismatch")
    if backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl"):
        raise ValueError("unsupported UI backend")
    if udid is not None and not UDID.fullmatch(udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    spec = _read(report / "feature-spec.json")
    index = _read(report / "report-index.json")
    flows = spec.get("flows")
    if (spec.get("schema_version") != 1 or
            spec.get("review_status") == "needs_semantic_review" or
            not isinstance(flows, list) or not flows or
            spec.get("target_bundle_id") != index.get("target_bundle_id")):
        raise ValueError("report has no reviewed rebuild specification")
    known = [item.get("id") for item in flows if isinstance(item, dict)]
    if (len(known) != len(flows) or len(set(known)) != len(known) or
            any(not isinstance(item, str) or not FLOW_ID.fullmatch(item) for item in known)):
        raise ValueError("feature specification has invalid or duplicate flow IDs")
    selected = list(flow_ids) if flow_ids is not None else known
    if (not 1 <= len(selected) <= 12 or len(set(selected)) != len(selected) or
            any(item not in known for item in selected)):
        raise ValueError("provide 1–12 unique flow IDs from the report")
    identity = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "rebuild_preparation",
                "report": str(report),
                "report_index_sha256": sha256_file(report / "report-index.json"),
                "feature_spec_sha256": sha256_file(report / "feature-spec.json"),
                "selected_flow_ids": selected, "ui_backend": backend,
                "device_udid": udid,
                "project_dir": str(project.resolve()) if project else None,
                "evidence": []}
    manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        if not resume or not manifest_path.is_file():
            raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not an existing preparation: {output}")
        previous = _read(manifest_path)
        if any(previous.get(key) != value for key, value in identity.items()):
            raise ValueError("resume report, flow selection or settings differ")
    else:
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        _write(manifest_path, dict(identity, status="preparing"))

    plan = output / "plan"
    task = output / "task"
    previous = _read(manifest_path)
    plan_manifest = plan / "manifest.json"
    try:
        plan_data = _read(plan / "rebuild-plan.json") if plan_manifest.is_file() else {}
        plan_ok = (plan_manifest.is_file() and
                   previous.get("plan_manifest_sha256") == sha256_file(plan_manifest) and
                   _verified(plan) and
                   plan_data.get("source_report_index_sha256") ==
                   identity["report_index_sha256"] and
                   plan_data.get("ui_backend") == backend and
                   [item.get("flow_id") for item in plan_data["flows"]] == selected)
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        plan_ok = False
    if not plan_ok:
        if task.exists():
            _archive(output, "task")
        if plan.exists():
            _archive(output, "plan")
        create_rebuild_plan(report, plan, backend, selected)
    previous["plan_manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(plan_manifest)
    if not plan_ok:
        previous.pop("task_manifest_sha256", None)
    previous["status"] = "plan_ready"
    _write(manifest_path, previous)

    task_manifest = task / "manifest.json"
    try:
        task_data = _read(task / "task.json") if task_manifest.is_file() else {}
        task_ok = (task_manifest.is_file() and
                   _read(manifest_path).get("task_manifest_sha256") == sha256_file(task_manifest) and
                   _verified(task) and
                   task_data.get("report_index_sha256") == identity["report_index_sha256"] and
                   task_data.get("rebuild_plan_sha256") ==
                   sha256_file(plan / "rebuild-plan.json") and
                   task_data.get("device_udid") == udid and
                   (project is None or task_data.get("project_dir") == str(project.resolve())))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        task_ok = False
    if not task_ok:
        if task.exists():
            _archive(output, "task")
        create_agent_task(report, plan, task, udid, project)
    status = _read(task / "task.json")["status"]
    previous["task_manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(task_manifest)
    previous["status"] = status
    _write(manifest_path, previous)
    return manifest_path, status in ("ready_for_agent", "selected_flows_ready")
```
