`copyapp/ui_capture.py`:

```py
"""Select a settled UI screenshot before OCR or visual interpretation."""

import io
import time
from typing import Callable, Dict, Tuple

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat


def _thumbnail(image: bytes) -> Image.Image:
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(image)) as source:
        return source.convert("L").resize((48, 48), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)


def frame_health(image: bytes) -> Dict:
    """Flag an almost uniform black app area, excluding system chrome.

    This is deliberately narrow: dark themed screens with text and controls
    retain enough variance to pass. A flagged frame is diagnostic evidence,
    never a successful screenshot for a UI playbook.
    """
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(image)) as source:
        gray = source.convert("L")
        width, height = gray.size
        if width < 20 or height < 20:
            raise ValueError("screenshot is too small to assess")
        app_area = gray.crop((int(width * .2), int(height * .2),
                              max(int(width * .9), 1), max(int(height * .9), 1)))
        stats = ImageStat.Stat(app_area)
    mean = round(stats.mean[0], 2)
    deviation = round(stats.stddev[0], 2)
    return {"mean_luma": mean, "stddev_luma": deviation,
            "near_uniform_black": mean <= 4 and deviation <= 3,
            "region": "central_70_percent"}


def capture_stable(capture: Callable[[], bytes], samples: int = 5,
                   interval: float = 0.35, threshold: float = 0.02,
                   minimum_samples: int = 2) -> Tuple[bytes, Dict]:
    """Return the newest frame once two successive downscaled frames are similar.

    Dynamic areas may remain in the image. The stability flag describes only
    visual change during this short window, not whether the app is ready.
    """
    if samples < 2 or not 2 <= minimum_samples <= samples or interval < 0 or not 0 <= threshold <= 1:
        raise ValueError("invalid capture stability settings")
    previous = capture()
    previous_thumb = _thumbnail(previous)
    distance = None
    for attempt in range(2, samples + 1):
        time.sleep(interval)
        current = capture()
        current_thumb = _thumbnail(current)
        distance = ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(previous_thumb, current_thumb)).mean[0] / 255
        if attempt >= minimum_samples and distance <= threshold:
            return current, {"stable": True, "samples": attempt,
                             "mean_pixel_change": round(distance, 5), "threshold": threshold}
        previous, previous_thumb = current, current_thumb
    return previous, {"stable": False, "samples": samples,
                      "mean_pixel_change": round(distance, 5), "threshold": threshold}

```

`copyapp/ui_evidence.py`:

```py
"""Conservative attribution of captured accessibility evidence."""

import re
from typing import Any, Dict


def ui_attribution(ui: Dict[str, Any], target_name: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """Identify only unambiguous system permission overlays; otherwise stay unsure."""
    captions = [str(item.get("caption") or "") for item in ui.get("elements", [])]
    for caption in captions:
        match = re.search(r'Allow [“"](.+?)[”"] to use your location\?', caption)
        if match:
            observed = match.group(1)
            return {"status": "system_permission_for_target" if observed == target_name
                    else "different_app_system_permission",
                    "observed_app_name": observed}
    return {"status": "unverified"}
```

`copyapp/usb_ax.py`:

```py
"""USB Accessibility Audit fallback for observing and activating named elements."""

from typing import Any, Dict, List

from pymobiledevice3.lockdown import create_using_usbmux
from pymobiledevice3.services.accessibilityaudit import AccessibilityAudit


async def usb_ax(udid: str, action: str, caption: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if action not in ("observe", "press"):
        raise ValueError("unsupported USB accessibility action")
    if action == "press" and not caption:
        raise ValueError("press requires an exact accessibility caption")
    device = await create_using_usbmux(serial=udid, connection_type="USB", autopair=False)
    try:
        async with AccessibilityAudit(device) as audit:
            elements = [element async for element in audit.iter_elements()]
            if action == "observe":
                return {"source": "USB Accessibility Audit", "elements": [
                    element.to_dict() for element in elements
                ]}
            matches: List[Any] = [element for element in elements if element.caption == caption]
            if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].element is None:
                raise ValueError(f"expected exactly one current element with caption {caption!r}; found {len(matches)}")
            await audit.perform_press(matches[0].element.identifier)
            return {
                "source": "USB Accessibility Audit", "requested": "press",
                "caption": caption,
                "note": "Activation request sent; observe the screen again to verify its effect.",
            }
    finally:
        await device.close()
```

`copyapp/usb_tunnel.py`:

```py
"""Own a short-lived USB mux port forward for one named iOS device."""

import asyncio
import json
import re
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterator, Optional

from copyapp.ios_mcp import IOSMCPClient
from copyapp.ictrl import ICtrlClient, DEFAULT_CLIENT
from copyapp.source_root import source_root


@contextmanager
def ssh_tunnel(udid: str, port: int = 22222) -> Iterator[int]:
    """Forward SSH for one exact USB device while a probe is running."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise ValueError("invalid SSH host port")
    with socket.socket() as reserved:
        reserved.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pymobiledevice3", "usbmux", "forward",
               str(port), "22", "--serial", udid]
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("USB SSH forward exited before it was ready")
            try:
                with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=0.3):
                    pass
                break
            except (ConnectionRefusedError, TimeoutError, OSError):
                time.sleep(0.1)
        else:
            raise TimeoutError("USB SSH forward did not become reachable")
        yield port
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=2)


@contextmanager
def exact_ssh_tunnel(udid: str, port: int, identity: Path,
                     known_hosts: Path, user: str = "mobile") -> Iterator[int]:
    """Reuse or open an SSH forward only after authenticating the exact phone."""
    from copyapp.ssh_acquire import _ssh_argv

    try:
        with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=0.3):
            occupied = True
    except OSError:
        occupied = False
    context = nullcontext(port) if occupied else ssh_tunnel(udid, port)
    with context as active_port:
        result = subprocess.run(_ssh_argv(active_port, identity, known_hosts, user) +
                                ["deviceinfo uniqueid"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=15)
        if result.returncode or result.stdout.strip() != udid:
            raise RuntimeError("SSH forward does not authenticate the requested USB device")
        yield active_port


def configured_ictrl_runner_bundle(udid: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Read the Bundle ID installed by setup for this exact device."""
    config = source_root() / "toolchains" / "ictrl-runners.json"
    if config.is_file():
        try:
            value = json.loads(config.read_text()).get(udid)
            if isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", value):
                return value
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return None


def ictrl_runner_bundle(udid: str) -> str:
    bundle = configured_ictrl_runner_bundle(udid)
    if bundle is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError("iCTRL runner is not configured for this device; run copyapp setup ictrl")
    return bundle


async def _ios_version(udid: str) -> str:
    from pymobiledevice3.lockdown import create_using_usbmux

    device = await create_using_usbmux(serial=udid, connection_type="USB", autopair=False)
    try:
        values = await device.get_value()
        if values.get("UniqueDeviceID") != udid:
            raise RuntimeError("USB runner target identity does not match requested UDID")
        return str(values.get("ProductVersion", ""))
    finally:
        await device.close()


@contextmanager
def ictrl_xcuitest_session(udid: str, bundle: str,
                          log_path: Optional[Path] = None,
                          auto_approve_first_pair: bool = False,
                          ios_version: str = "") -> Iterator[subprocess.Popen]:
    """Keep iOS 17+ testmanagerd attached while the iCTRL service is in use."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", bundle):
        raise ValueError("invalid runner Bundle ID")
    major = int(ios_version.split(".", 1)[0]) if re.match(r"^\d+", ios_version) else 0
    # On the tested iOS 26 phone, native RSD listed processes but could not
    # start testmanagerd. A mounted DDI plus the userspace tunnel did.
    transport = "--userspace" if major >= 26 else "--native"
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pymobiledevice3", "developer", "dvt",
               "xcuitest", transport, "--udid", udid]
    if auto_approve_first_pair:
        command.extend(["--env", "ICTRL_ALLOW_AUTH_ONCE=1"])
    command.append(bundle)
    log_file = log_path.open("w+b") if log_path is not None else tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode="w+b")
    with log_file as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        try:
            yield process
        finally:
            try:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    # Disconnecting testmanagerd alone leaves a briefly live
                    # HTTP server which the next capture can mistake for a
                    # usable XCTest session. Stop our runner before detaching.
                    stopped = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, "-m", "copyapp.ictrl_runner_stop", udid, bundle],
                        capture_output=True, timeout=50, check=False)
                    if stopped.returncode:
                        raise RuntimeError("could not stop the owned iCTRL runner; inspect device state before reuse")
            finally:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.terminate()
                    try:
                        process.wait(timeout=3)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        process.kill()
                        process.wait(timeout=3)


async def _launch_ictrl_runner(udid: str) -> None:
    from pymobiledevice3.lockdown import create_using_usbmux
    from copyapp.device_developer import launch_app

    device = await create_using_usbmux(serial=udid, connection_type="USB", autopair=False)
    try:
        values = await device.get_value()
        if values.get("UniqueDeviceID") != udid:
            raise RuntimeError("USB runner target identity does not match requested UDID")
        await launch_app(device, udid, str(values.get("ProductVersion", "")),
                         ictrl_runner_bundle(udid))
    finally:
        await device.close()


@contextmanager
def ictrl_tunnel(udid: str, client: Path = DEFAULT_CLIENT,
                  require_xctest: bool = False,
                  log_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> Iterator[int]:
    """Launch the paired runner and forward its encrypted UI protocol."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    if not client.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"iCTRL client not found: {client}")
    if require_xctest:
        # A surviving heartbeat does not prove a live testmanagerd session.
        stopped = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "copyapp.ictrl_runner_stop", udid, ictrl_runner_bundle(udid)],
            capture_output=True, timeout=50, check=False)
        if stopped.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("could not stop the prior iCTRL runner before owning XCTest")
    with socket.socket() as reserved:
        reserved.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = reserved.getsockname()[1]
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pymobiledevice3", "usbmux", "forward",
               str(port), "8200", "--serial", udid]
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        rpc = ICtrlClient(port=port, client=client)

        def runner_ready() -> bool:
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("USB mux forward exited before iCTRL was reachable")
            try:
                rpc._run("call", "logs", json.dumps({"max_elements": 1}), timeout=2)
                return True
            except Exception:
                return False

        # A prior capture may have left the runner active. Avoid an Instruments
        # relaunch in that case: it can block indefinitely on this device.
        ready = False
        probe_deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
        while time.monotonic() < probe_deadline:
            if runner_ready():
                ready = True
                break
            time.sleep(0.2)
        version = asyncio.run(_ios_version(udid)) if not ready or require_xctest else ""
        major = int(version.split(".", 1)[0]) if version[:1].isdigit() else 0
        session = (ictrl_xcuitest_session(udid, ictrl_runner_bundle(udid),
                                        log_path=log_path, ios_version=version)
                   if (not ready or require_xctest) and major >= 17 else nullcontext(None))
        with session as test_process:
            if not ready and test_process is None:
                try:
                    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "copyapp.ictrl_runner_launch", udid],
                                   capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
                    raise TimeoutError("launching the iCTRL runner timed out") from exc
            deadline = time.monotonic() + (60 if test_process is not None else 15)
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if test_process is not None and test_process.poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError("iCTRL XCTest session exited before its UI service became reachable")
                started = True
                if require_xctest and log_path is not None and test_process is not None:
                    log_text = log_path.read_text(errors="replace")
                    started = "didBeginExecutingTestPlan" in log_text and "testCaseDidStart" in log_text
                if started and runner_ready():
                    break
                time.sleep(0.3)
            else:
                raise TimeoutError("paired iCTRL runner did not become reachable on the named USB device")
            yield port
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=2)


@contextmanager
def ios_mcp_tunnel(udid: str) -> Iterator[int]:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", udid):
        raise ValueError("invalid device UDID")
    with socket.socket() as reserved:
        reserved.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = reserved.getsockname()[1]
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pymobiledevice3", "usbmux", "forward",
               str(port), "8090", "--serial", udid]
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("USB mux forward exited before iOS MCP was reachable")
            try:
                IOSMCPClient(port=port, timeout=0.5).health()
                break
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(0.2)
        else:
            raise TimeoutError("iOS MCP did not become reachable through the named USB device")
        yield port
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=2)
```

`copyapp/verify.py`:

```py
"""Check saved case files against the hashes recorded during acquisition."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import posixpath
import re
import sqlite3
import tarfile
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Dict, Iterable
from zipfile import BadZipFile


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def checked_path(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    name = PurePosixPath(relative)
    if name.is_absolute() or not name.parts or ".." in name.parts:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid evidence path: {relative}")
    path = root.joinpath(*name.parts).resolve()
    if root.resolve() not in path.parents:
        raise ValueError(f"evidence path escapes case: {relative}")
    return path


def compare(root: Path, records: Iterable[Dict[str, str]]) -> bool:
    ok = True
    for item in records:
        relative = str(item["path"])
        try:
            path = checked_path(root, relative)
            match = path.is_file() and sha256_file(path) == item["sha256"]
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            match = False
        print(f"{'OK' if match else 'MISMATCH'} {relative}")
        ok &= match
    return ok


def verify_survey(directory: Path) -> bool:
    manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return compare(directory, manifest["evidence"])


def verify_acquisition(directory: Path) -> bool:
    manifest = json.loads((directory / "acquisition.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    app_name = posixpath.basename(manifest["remote_bundle_path"])
    if not app_name.endswith(".app") or "/" in app_name:
        raise ValueError("invalid acquired app name")
    records = [{"path": "bundle/" + app_name + "/" + item["relative"],
                "sha256": item["sha256"]} for item in manifest["files"]]
    records.append({"path": "bundle-snapshot.ipa", "sha256": manifest["snapshot_sha256"]})
    return compare(directory, records)


def install_transport_complete(record: dict) -> bool:
    """Check the saved installation method without conflating USB and TrollStore."""
    transport = record.get("transport", "trollstore")
    if transport == "trollstore":
        legacy = record.get("helper_exit_code") == 0
        direct = (record.get("helper_run_status") == "process_exited" and
                  record.get("helper_effective_uid") == 0 and
                  record.get("helper_install_verified") is True and
                  isinstance(record.get("installed_path"), str) and
                  record["installed_path"].startswith("/") and
                  record["installed_path"].endswith(".app"))
        return ((legacy or direct) and
                record.get("staged_sha256") == record.get("ipa_sha256"))
    if transport == "usb":
        return (record.get("usb_install_completed") is True and
                record.get("installed_profile_validated") is True and
                isinstance(record.get("installed_path"), str) and
                record["installed_path"].startswith("/") and
                record["installed_path"].endswith(".app"))
    return False


def verify_install(directory: Path) -> bool:
    """Recheck saved IPA identity; this cannot prove the phone still has it installed."""
    try:
        from copyapp.ipa import analyze_ipa
        record = json.loads((directory / "install.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ipa_name = record.get("ipa")
        if (record.get("schema_version") != 1 or record.get("status") != "installed" or
                not install_transport_complete(record) or
                not isinstance(record.get("device_id"), str) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Fa-f0-9-]{16,80}", record["device_id"]) or
                not isinstance(ipa_name, str) or not ipa_name):
            return False
        ipa = Path(ipa_name)
        if (not ipa.is_file() or ipa.is_symlink() or
                sha256_file(ipa) != record["ipa_sha256"]):
            return False
        if record.get("transport") == "trollstore" and record.get("helper_install_verified") is True:
            run = json.loads((directory / "device-run/result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            command = run.get("command")
            if (run.get("device_id") != record["device_id"] or
                    run.get("status") != "process_exited" or
                    run.get("effective_uid") != 0 or
                    not isinstance(run.get("pid"), int) or run["pid"] <= 0 or
                    not isinstance(command, list) or len(command) != 4 or
                    command[:3] != [record.get("helper"), "install", "custom"]):
                return False
        package = analyze_ipa(ipa)
        ok = (package.get("bundle_id") == record.get("bundle_id") and
              package.get("version") == record.get("version") and
              package.get("build") == record.get("build"))
        print(f"{'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH'} install.json / IPA")
        return ok
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, BadZipFile,
            json.JSONDecodeError):
        return False


def _verify_silent(directory: Path) -> bool:
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        return verify_case(directory)


def verify_case(directory: Path) -> bool:
    # Dispatch Mac cases before legacy filenames, so a legacy-looking extra file
    # cannot bypass platform and kind-specific validation.
    if (directory / "manifest.json").is_file():
        manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if (manifest.get("platform") == "ios" or
                str(manifest.get("kind", "")).startswith("ios_")):
            from copyapp.ios_cases import verify_ios_case
            return verify_ios_case(directory)
        if manifest.get("kind") in {"fidelity_plan", "fidelity_check"}:
            from copyapp.fidelity import verify_fidelity
            return verify_fidelity(directory)
        if (manifest.get("platform") == "macos" or
                str(manifest.get("kind", "")).startswith("mac_")):
            from copyapp.macos.case import verify_mac_case
            return verify_mac_case(directory)
    if (directory / "report-index.json").is_file():
        index = json.loads((directory / "report-index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return compare(directory, index["artifacts"].values())
    if (directory / "analysis-index.json").is_file():
        index = json.loads((directory / "analysis-index.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        records = list(index["artifacts"].values())
        ok = compare(directory, records)
        if (directory / "survey" / "manifest.json").is_file():
            ok = verify_survey(directory / "survey") and ok
        if (directory / "acquired" / "acquisition.json").is_file():
            ok = verify_acquisition(directory / "acquired") and ok
        if (directory / "decrypted" / "manifest.json").is_file():
            ok = _verify_silent(directory / "decrypted") and ok
        return ok
    if (directory / "manifest.json").is_file():
        manifest = json.loads((directory / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ok = verify_survey(directory)
        if ((directory / "playbook.json").is_file() and
                manifest.get("status") == "complete" and
                (manifest.get("ui_backend") == "ios-mcp" or
                 manifest.get("execution_mode") == "standard")):
            # A saved accessibility-ready flag cannot turn a compositor-black
            # image into valid visual evidence. Reinspect pixels on verification.
            try:
                from copyapp.ui_capture import frame_health
                for step in manifest.get("steps", []):
                    if step.get("action") != "screenshot":
                        continue
                    image = checked_path(directory, step["evidence_path"])
                    if frame_health(image.read_bytes())["near_uniform_black"]:
                        return False
            except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
                return False

                            len(by_flow.get(item["id"], [])) == item.get("screenshot_pairs")
                            for item in results)
                        source_ok = (source_ok and
                                     delivery.get("visual_unreviewed_flow_count") == 0 and
                                     delivery.get("visual_major_difference_flow_count") == sum(
                                         item.get("visual_review_status") == "major_difference"
                                         for item in results) and
                                     delivery.get("visual_minor_difference_flow_count") == sum(
                                         item.get("visual_review_status") == "minor_difference"
                                         for item in results))
                elif source_ok:
                    source_ok = (delivery.get("visual_review_manifest_sha256") is None and
                                 not any("visual_review_status" in item
                                         for item in delivery.get("flow_results", [])) and
                                 "visual_reviewed" not in delivery.get("status", ""))
            except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, tarfile.TarError):
                source_ok = False
            return ok and source_ok
        if manifest.get("kind") == "analysis_delivery":
            try:
                from copyapp.analysis_delivery import validate_analysis_delivery
                delivery = json.loads((directory / "delivery.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                task = Path(delivery["task_case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                report = Path(delivery["report_case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                run = (Path(delivery["agent_run"]["case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                       if delivery.get("agent_run") else None)
                if directory.resolve() in (task, report, run):
                    return False
                expected = validate_analysis_delivery(task, report, run)
                source_ok = (
                    delivery.get("schema_version") == 1 and
                    delivery.get("kind") == "analysis_delivery" and
                    delivery.get("status") == manifest.get("status") ==
                    "source_linked_report_ready_for_review" and
                    all(delivery.get(key) == value for key, value in expected.items()) and
                    manifest.get("task_manifest_sha256") == delivery.get("task_manifest_sha256") and
                    manifest.get("report_index_sha256") == delivery.get("report_index_sha256") and
                    sha256_file(directory / "reviewed-findings.json") ==
                    delivery.get("findings_sha256") == sha256_file(report / "findings.json") and
                    sha256_file(directory / "reviewed-feature-spec.json") ==
                    delivery.get("feature_spec_sha256") ==
                    sha256_file(report / "feature-spec.json")
                )
            except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
                source_ok = False
            return ok and source_ok
        if manifest.get("kind") == "sqlite_schema":
            try:
                from copyapp.sqlite_schema import validate_sqlite_schema_case
                return ok and validate_sqlite_schema_case(directory)
            except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, sqlite3.DatabaseError,
                    json.JSONDecodeError):
                return False
        if manifest.get("kind") == "visual_audit":
            try:
                from copyapp.visual_audit import compute_visual_audit
                audit = json.loads((directory / "audit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                source = Path(audit["rebuild_check_case"]).resolve(strict=True)
                if source == directory.resolve():
                    return False
                expected = compute_visual_audit(
                    source, audit["roi_pixels"],
                    audit["max_normalized_mean_absolute_rgb"],
                    audit["max_changed_pixel_fraction"],
                    audit["difference_threshold"])
                source_ok = (
                    audit.get("status") == manifest.get("status") and
                    manifest.get("rebuild_check_manifest_sha256") ==
                    audit.get("rebuild_check_manifest_sha256") and
                    set(audit) == set(expected) | {"created_at"} and
                    all(audit.get(key) == value for key, value in expected.items())
                )
            except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
                source_ok = False
            return ok and source_ok
        if manifest.get("kind") == "branch_observation_map":
            mapped = json.loads((directory / "branch-map.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            binary_path = mapped.get("binary_path")
            sources = mapped.get("sources")
            if (not isinstance(binary_path, str) or not binary_path or
                    not isinstance(sources, list) or not sources or len(sources) > 32 or
                    not isinstance(mapped.get("binary_sha256"), str)):
                return False
            binary = Path(binary_path)
            if not binary.is_file() or sha256_file(binary) != mapped["binary_sha256"]:
                return False
            for item in sources:
                if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("path"), str):
                    return False
                source = Path(item["path"])
                source_manifest = source / "manifest.json"
                if (source.resolve() == directory.resolve() or not source_manifest.is_file() or
                        sha256_file(source_manifest) != item.get("manifest_sha256")):
                    return False
                source_data = json.loads(source_manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if (source_data.get("kind") != "ui_flow_capture" or
                        source_data.get("status") != "complete" or
                        not verify_case(source)):
                    return False
        return ok
    if (directory / "acquisition.json").is_file():
        return verify_acquisition(directory)
    if (directory / "install.json").is_file():
        return verify_install(directory)
    raise FileNotFoundError("no analysis, survey or acquisition manifest")
```

`copyapp/view_tree.py`:

```py
"""Capture the frontmost app's UIKit view structure through its Frida process."""

import hashlib
import json
import re
import threading
import time
from contextlib import ExitStack
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple

from copyapp.experiment import ExperimentUI, _bounded_cleanup
from copyapp.ictrl import DEFAULT_CLIENT
from copyapp.usb_tunnel import ictrl_tunnel, ios_mcp_tunnel
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


MAX_NODES = 500
MAX_DEPTH = 20
SCAN_JS = r"""
const maxNodes = 500;
const maxDepth = 20;
function safeString(value) {
    try { return value === null || value === undefined ? null : String(value).slice(0, 200); }
    catch (_) { return null; }
}
function frame(value) {
    try {
        const values = Array.isArray(value)
            ? [value[0][0], value[0][1], value[1][0], value[1][1]]
            : [value.origin.x, value.origin.y, value.size.width, value.size.height];
        const numbers = values.map(Number);
        if (!numbers.every(Number.isFinite)) return null;
        return {x: numbers[0], y: numbers[1],
                width: numbers[2], height: numbers[3]};
    } catch (_) { return null; }
}
ObjC.schedule(ObjC.mainQueue, function () {
    try {
        if (!ObjC.available) throw new Error('Objective-C runtime unavailable');
        const app = ObjC.classes.UIApplication.sharedApplication();
        const windows = app.windows();
        const nodes = [];
        const roots = [];
        let truncated = false;
        function walk(view, parent, depth, sibling) {
            if (nodes.length >= maxNodes || depth > maxDepth) { truncated = true; return; }
            const id = nodes.length;
            const node = {id: id, parent: parent, depth: depth, sibling: sibling,
                          class_name: safeString(view.$className), frame: frame(view.frame()),
                          hidden: Boolean(view.isHidden()), alpha: Number(view.alpha()),
                          accessibility_label: safeString(view.accessibilityLabel()),
                          accessibility_identifier: safeString(view.accessibilityIdentifier())};
            try {
                if (view.isKindOfClass_(ObjC.classes.UILabel)) {
                    node.text = safeString(view.text());
                    const font = view.font();
                    if (font) {
                        node.font_name = safeString(font.fontName());
                        node.font_point_size = Number(font.pointSize());
                    }
                } else if (view.isKindOfClass_(ObjC.classes.UIButton))
                    node.title = safeString(view.currentTitle());
                else if (view.isKindOfClass_(ObjC.classes.UITextField))
                    node.text = safeString(view.text());
            } catch (error) { node.content_error = safeString(error); }
            nodes.push(node);
            const children = view.subviews();
            const count = Number(children.count());
            node.subview_count = count;
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) walk(children.objectAtIndex_(i), id, depth + 1, i);
        }
        const count = Number(windows.count());
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const window = windows.objectAtIndex_(i);
            roots.push({window_index: i, class_name: safeString(window.$className),
                        key_window: Boolean(window.isKeyWindow()),
                        window_level: Number(window.windowLevel()), frame: frame(window.frame()),
                        root_node: nodes.length});
            walk(window, null, 0, i);
        }
        send({type: 'view_tree', roots: roots, nodes: nodes, truncated: truncated,
              max_nodes: maxNodes, max_depth: maxDepth});
    } catch (error) {
        send({type: 'view_tree_error', message: safeString(error)});
    }
});
"""


def _script_source() -> str:
    import frida_tools
    bridge = Path(frida_tools.__file__).parent / "bridges" / "objc.js"
    if not bridge.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("Frida Objective-C bridge is unavailable")
    return bridge.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "\nconst ObjC = bridge;\n" + SCAN_JS


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def capture_view_tree(udid: str, bundle: str, output: Path,
                      backend: str = "ios-mcp", port: Optional[int] = None,
                      ictrl_client: Path = DEFAULT_CLIENT,
                      launch: bool = True) -> Tuple[Path, bool]:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", bundle):
        raise ValueError("invalid bundle id")
    if backend not in ("ios-mcp", "ictrl"):
        raise ValueError("unsupported UI backend")
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"output directory is not empty: {output}")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record: Dict[str, Any] = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "uikit_view_tree",
                              "bundle_id": bundle,
                              "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
                              "ui_backend": backend, "started_at": _now(), "status": "failed",
                              "launch_requested": launch,
                              "scope": "Current UIKit windows and bounded subview tree, plus accessibility observation when available. SwiftUI content may be drawn without UILabel nodes. Runtime observations are not original source."}
    manifest = output / "manifest.json"
    stage = "connect_ui"
    try:
        tunnel = (ios_mcp_tunnel(udid) if backend == "ios-mcp" else
                  ictrl_tunnel(udid, ictrl_client)) if port is None else None
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            own_port = stack.enter_context(tunnel) if tunnel is not None else port
            identity_port = None
            if backend == "ictrl":
                try:
                    identity_port = stack.enter_context(ios_mcp_tunnel(udid))
                except (OSError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
                    record["identity_tunnel_error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {str(exc)[:200]}"
            _capture_with_port(udid, bundle, output, backend, own_port,
                               ictrl_client, record, launch, identity_port)
    except Exception as exc:
        record["error"] = {"stage": record.get("stage", stage), "type": type(exc).__name__,
                           "message": str(exc)[:400]}
    finally:
        record.pop("stage", None)
        record["finished_at"] = _now()
        record["evidence"] = [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
                              for name in ("screenshot.jpg", "scan.js", "view-tree.json",
                                           "accessibility.json")
                              if (output / name).is_file()]
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return manifest, record["status"] == "complete"


def _capture_with_port(udid: str, bundle: str, output: Path, backend: str,
                       port: int, ictrl_client: Path, record: dict, launch: bool,
                       identity_port: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
    record["stage"] = "connect_ui"
    ui = ExperimentUI(backend, port, ictrl_client,
                      identity_port=identity_port, bundle_id=bundle)
    record["frontmost_backend"] = "ios-mcp" if identity_port is not None or backend == "ios-mcp" else "ictrl"
    if launch:
        ui.launch(bundle)
        time.sleep(0.5)
    record["stage"] = "verify_frontmost"
    before = ui.frontmost()
    record["frontmost_before"] = before
    if before != bundle:
        raise RuntimeError(f"target not frontmost: {before}")
    ui.screenshot(output / "screenshot.jpg")

    record["stage"] = "attach_frida"
    from copyapp.frida_device import get_usb_device
    device = get_usb_device(udid)
    app = next((item for item in device.enumerate_applications(scope="full")
                if item.identifier == bundle and item.pid), None)
    if app is None:
        raise RuntimeError("target app process is unavailable")
    record["pid"] = app.pid
    source = _script_source()
    (output / "scan.js").write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    session = script = None
    try:
        session = device.attach(app.pid)
        ready = threading.Event()
        result = {}

        def on_message(message, _data) -> None:
            if not isinstance(message, dict):
                return
            if message.get("type") == "error":
                result["error"] = str(message.get("description") or message)[:400]
                ready.set()
            payload = message.get("payload")
            if message.get("type") == "send" and isinstance(payload, dict) and \
                    payload.get("type") in ("view_tree", "view_tree_error"):
                result["payload"] = payload
                ready.set()

        script = session.create_script(source)
        script.on("message", on_message)
        script.load()
        record["stage"] = "scan_views"
        if not ready.wait(12):
            raise TimeoutError("UIKit view scan did not finish within 12 seconds")
        if result.get("error"):
            raise RuntimeError(result["error"])
        payload = result.get("payload", {})
        if payload.get("type") != "view_tree":
            raise RuntimeError(str(payload.get("message") or "view scan failed"))
        nodes = payload.get("nodes")
        roots = payload.get("roots")
        if (not isinstance(nodes, list) or not isinstance(roots, list) or
                len(nodes) > MAX_NODES or any(not isinstance(node, dict) for node in nodes)):
            raise RuntimeError("Frida returned invalid view tree")
        (output / "view-tree.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                                               encoding="utf-8")
        record.update({"node_count": len(nodes), "window_count": len(roots),
                       "truncated": payload.get("truncated"),
                       "frontmost_after": ui.frontmost()})
        if record["frontmost_after"] != bundle:
            raise RuntimeError("target left foreground during view scan")
        record["stage"] = "observe_accessibility"
        try:
            observation = ui.observe()
            (output / "accessibility.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(observation, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            record["accessibility_element_count"] = observation.get(
                "element_count", observation.get("total_returned"))
        except Exception as exc:
            record["accessibility_error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__,
                                             "message": str(exc)[:240]}
        record["frontmost_after"] = ui.frontmost()
        if record["frontmost_after"] != bundle:
            raise RuntimeError("target left foreground after accessibility observation")
        record["status"] = "complete"
    finally:
        if script is not None:
            warning = _bounded_cleanup("script unload", script.unload)
            if warning:
                record.setdefault("cleanup_warnings", []).append(warning)
        if session is not None:
            warning = _bounded_cleanup("session detach", session.detach)
            if warning:
                record.setdefault("cleanup_warnings", []).append(warning)
```

`copyapp/visual_audit.py`:

```py
"""Measure saved screenshot pairs in a declared content region."""

import io
import json
import math
import os
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat

from copyapp.verify import checked_path, sha256_file, verify_case


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    result = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return result


def _write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _measure(original: Path, rebuilt: Path, roi: list, threshold: int) -> dict:
    with Image.open(original) as first, Image.open(rebuilt) as second:
        if first.size != second.size or first.width * first.height > 5_000_000:
            raise ValueError("screenshots differ in size or exceed image limit")
        width, height = first.size
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = roi
        if (x2 > width or y2 > height or
                (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) < width * height * 0.5):
            raise ValueError("audit region must cover at least half of the screen")
        diff = ImageChops.difference(first.convert("RGB").crop(tuple(roi)),
                                     second.convert("RGB").crop(tuple(roi)))
    mean = sum(ImageStat.Stat(diff).mean) / (3 * 255)
    changed = sum(max(pixel) > threshold for pixel in diff.getdata())
    return {"width": width, "height": height,
            "normalized_mean_absolute_rgb": round(mean, 7),
            "changed_pixel_fraction": round(changed / ((x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1)), 7)}


def compute_visual_audit(check_case: Path, roi: list, max_mean: float,
                         max_changed: float, difference_threshold: int = 24) -> dict:
    """Recompute metrics for every pair in one verified multi-flow device check."""
    check_case = check_case.resolve(strict=True)
    if (not isinstance(roi, list) or len(roi) != 4 or
            any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in roi) or
            roi[0] >= roi[2] or roi[1] >= roi[3] or
            type(difference_threshold) is not int or
            not 0 <= difference_threshold <= 255 or
            type(max_mean) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(max_mean) or
            not 0 < max_mean <= 1 or
            type(max_changed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(max_changed) or
            not 0 < max_changed <= 1):
        raise ValueError("invalid visual audit region or thresholds")
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        if not verify_case(check_case):
            raise ValueError("rebuild check failed hash verification")
    source = _read(check_case / "manifest.json")
    flows = source.get("flows")
    if (source.get("kind") != "rebuild_check" or source.get("status") != "complete" or
            not isinstance(flows, list) or not 1 <= len(flows) <= 32):
        raise ValueError("visual audit requires a complete bounded rebuild check")
    pairs_out = []
    seen = set()
    for flow in flows:
        if not isinstance(flow, dict):
            raise ValueError("invalid rebuild flow")
        flow_id = flow.get("flow_id")
        if (not isinstance(flow_id, str) or not flow_id or flow_id in seen or
                not isinstance(flow.get("comparison_index"), str)):
            raise ValueError("invalid or duplicate rebuild flow")
        seen.add(flow_id)
        index_path = checked_path(check_case, flow["comparison_index"])
        comparison = _read(index_path)
        pairs = comparison.get("screenshots")
        artifacts = comparison.get("artifacts")
        if (not isinstance(pairs, list) or not pairs or len(pairs) > 64 or
                len(pairs) != flow.get("screenshot_pairs") or
                not isinstance(artifacts, dict)):
            raise ValueError(f"missing screenshot pairs: {flow_id}")
        seen_steps = set()
        for pair in pairs:
            if not isinstance(pair, dict):
                raise ValueError("invalid screenshot pair")
            step = pair.get("step")
            if type(step) is not int or step < 1 or step in seen_steps:
                raise ValueError("invalid screenshot step")
            seen_steps.add(step)
            names = [f"original/step-{step:02d}-screenshot.jpg",
                     f"rebuilt/step-{step:02d}-screenshot.jpg"]
            paths = [checked_path(index_path.parent, name) for name in names]
            hashes = []
            for name, path in zip(names, paths):
                actual = sha256_file(path)
                if actual != artifacts.get(name, {}).get("sha256"):
                    raise ValueError(f"comparison screenshot changed: {name}")
                hashes.append(actual)
            measured = _measure(paths[0], paths[1], roi, difference_threshold)
            if (measured["width"] != pair.get("visual", {}).get("width") or
                    measured["height"] != pair.get("visual", {}).get("height")):
                raise ValueError("comparison dimensions changed")
            passed = (measured["normalized_mean_absolute_rgb"] <= max_mean and
                      measured["changed_pixel_fraction"] <= max_changed)
            pairs_out.append({"flow_id": flow_id, "step": step,
                              "original_path": str(paths[0]), "original_sha256": hashes[0],
                              "rebuilt_path": str(paths[1]), "rebuilt_sha256": hashes[1],
                              **measured, "within_declared_threshold": passed})
    status = ("metric_within_threshold" if all(pair["within_declared_threshold"]
                                               for pair in pairs_out) else "metric_exceeded")
    return {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "visual_audit", "status": status,
            "rebuild_check_case": str(check_case),
            "rebuild_check_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(check_case / "manifest.json"),
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": source.get("device_id_sha256_prefix"),
            "roi_pixels": roi, "max_normalized_mean_absolute_rgb": max_mean,
            "max_changed_pixel_fraction": max_changed,
            "difference_threshold": difference_threshold, "pairs": pairs_out,
            "scope_limit": "Pixel metrics cover only saved screenshots and the declared region; dynamic states, semantics and whole-app visual parity remain unverified."}


def create_visual_audit(check_case: Path, output: Path, roi: list,
                        max_mean: float, max_changed: float,
                        difference_threshold: int = 24) -> Path:
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"visual audit output is not empty: {output}")
    result = compute_visual_audit(check_case, roi, max_mean, max_changed,
                                  difference_threshold)
    result["created_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _write(output / "audit.json", result)
    def link(path: Path, label: str) -> str:
        return f"[{label}]({os.path.relpath(path, output)})"
    lines = ["# 成对截图区域审计", "",
             f"- 来源：{link(Path(result['rebuild_check_case']) / 'report.md', '真机对照')}；"
             f"设备 ID 哈希前缀：`{result['device_id_sha256_prefix']}`。",
             f"- 区域 `{roi}`；平均 RGB 差上限 `{max_mean}`（归一化）；"
             f"单像素最大通道差大于 `{difference_threshold}` 的比例上限 `{max_changed}`。",
             f"- 指标结果：`{result['status']}`；{len(result['pairs'])} 张成对截图。", "",
             "| 流程 | 步骤 | 平均 RGB 差 | 差异像素比例 | 结果 |",
             "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |"]
    for pair in result["pairs"]:
        lines.append(f"| `{pair['flow_id']}` | {pair['step']} | "
                     f"{pair['normalized_mean_absolute_rgb']:.5f} | "
                     f"{pair['changed_pixel_fraction']:.3%} | "
                     f"{'阈值内' if pair['within_declared_threshold'] else '超过阈值'} |")
    lines.extend(["", "阈值若在查看截图后设定，属于事后诊断，不是预先声明的视觉验收。"
                  "人工审阅仍需记录具体界面差异。", ""])
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _write(output / "manifest.json", {
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "visual_audit", "status": result["status"],
        "rebuild_check_manifest_sha256": result["rebuild_check_manifest_sha256"],
        "evidence": [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
                     for name in ("audit.json", "report.md")],
    })
    return output / "report.md"

```

`copyapp/visual_review.py`:

```py
"""Bind an explicit image-by-image review to saved device screenshots."""

import io
import json
import os
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.verify import checked_path, sha256_file, verify_case


VERDICTS = {"match", "minor_difference", "major_difference"}


def _read(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _write(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def screenshot_pairs(check_case: Path) -> list[dict]:
    """Collect the exact screenshots and display composites in a verified check."""
    check_case = check_case.resolve(strict=True)
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        if not verify_case(check_case):
            raise ValueError("rebuild check failed verification")
    source = _read(check_case / "manifest.json")
    flows = source.get("flows")
    if (source.get("kind") != "rebuild_check" or source.get("status") != "complete" or
            not isinstance(flows, list) or not 1 <= len(flows) <= 32):
        raise ValueError("visual review requires a complete rebuild check")
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for flow in flows:
        if not isinstance(flow, dict) or not isinstance(flow.get("flow_id"), str):
            raise ValueError("invalid flow in rebuild check")
        flow_id = flow["flow_id"]
        if not flow_id or flow_id in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate flow in rebuild check")
        seen.add(flow_id)
        index_path = checked_path(check_case, flow["comparison_index"])
        comparison = _read(index_path)
        screenshots = comparison.get("screenshots")
        artifacts = comparison.get("artifacts")
        if (not isinstance(screenshots, list) or not screenshots or len(screenshots) > 64 or
                len(screenshots) != flow.get("screenshot_pairs") or
                not isinstance(artifacts, dict)):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid screenshots for {flow_id}")
        steps = set()
        for item in screenshots:
            step = item.get("step") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
            if type(step) is not int or step < 1 or step in steps:
                raise ValueError(f"invalid screenshot step for {flow_id}")
            steps.add(step)
            paths = {}
            for role, name in (
                ("original", f"original/step-{step:02d}-screenshot.jpg"),
                ("rebuilt", f"rebuilt/step-{step:02d}-screenshot.jpg"),
                ("side_by_side", f"comparison/step-{step:02d}-side_by_side.png"),
            ):
                path = checked_path(index_path.parent, name)
                actual = sha256_file(path)
                if actual != artifacts.get(name, {}).get("sha256"):
                    raise ValueError(f"comparison image changed: {flow_id} {name}")
                paths[role + "_path"] = str(path.relative_to(check_case))
                paths[role + "_sha256"] = actual
            result.append({"flow_id": flow_id, "step": step, **paths})
    return result


def validate_review(review: dict, check_case: Path) -> bool:
    """Rebind recorded judgments to every unchanged source image."""
    check_case = check_case.resolve(strict=True)
    expected = screenshot_pairs(check_case)
    rows = review.get("pairs")
    if (review.get("schema_version") != 1 or review.get("kind") != "visual_review" or
            Path(review.get("rebuild_check_case", "")).resolve() != check_case or
            review.get("rebuild_check_manifest_sha256") !=
            sha256_file(check_case / "manifest.json") or
            not isinstance(review.get("reviewer"), str) or
            not review["reviewer"].strip() or
            not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != len(expected)):
        return False
    for actual, source in zip(rows, expected):
        if (not isinstance(actual, dict) or
                any(actual.get(key) != value for key, value in source.items()) or
                actual.get("verdict") not in VERDICTS or
                not isinstance(actual.get("note"), str) or
                len(actual["note"].strip()) < 12):
            return False
    return review.get("status") == (
        "reviewed_with_major_differences" if any(item["verdict"] == "major_difference" for item in rows)
        else "reviewed_with_minor_differences" if any(item["verdict"] == "minor_difference" for item in rows)
        else "reviewed_matching")


def create_visual_review(check_case: Path, judgments_path: Path,
                         output: Path, reviewer: str) -> Path:
    """Save subjective judgments, while mechanically verifying image coverage and identity."""
    if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"visual review output is not empty: {output}")
    check_case = check_case.resolve(strict=True)
    judgments = _read(judgments_path.resolve(strict=True))
    supplied = judgments.get("pairs")
    if not isinstance(supplied, list):
        raise ValueError("judgments must contain a pairs list")
    keyed = {}
    for row in supplied:
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or type(row.get("step")) is not int:
            raise ValueError("invalid judgment pair")
        key = (row.get("flow_id"), row["step"])
        if key in keyed or not isinstance(key[0], str):
            raise ValueError("duplicate or invalid judgment pair")
        keyed[key] = row
    expected = screenshot_pairs(check_case)
    if len(keyed) != len(expected) or set(keyed) != {
            (item["flow_id"], item["step"]) for item in expected}:
        raise ValueError("judgments must cover every saved screenshot pair exactly once")
    rows = []
    for source in expected:
        judgment = keyed[(source["flow_id"], source["step"])]
        verdict = judgment.get("verdict")
        note = judgment.get("note")
        if (verdict not in VERDICTS or not isinstance(note, str) or
                len(note.strip()) < 12):
            raise ValueError("each pair needs a verdict and a concrete note")
        rows.append(dict(source, verdict=verdict, note=note.strip()))
    status = ("reviewed_with_major_differences" if any(
        row["verdict"] == "major_difference" for row in rows) else
        "reviewed_with_minor_differences" if any(
            row["verdict"] == "minor_difference" for row in rows) else
        "reviewed_matching")
    review = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "visual_review", "status": status,
              "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
              "reviewer": reviewer, "rebuild_check_case": str(check_case),
              "rebuild_check_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(check_case / "manifest.json"),
              "pairs": rows,
              "scope_limit": "Judgments cover saved screenshots only; reviewer notes are subjective, and animations, unseen states and whole-app parity remain unverified."}
    if not validate_review(review, check_case):
        raise ValueError("review failed source validation")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _write(output / "review.json", review)
    lines = ["# 成对截图逐张审阅", "",
             f"- 来源：[真机对照]({os.path.relpath(check_case / 'report.md', output)})。",
             f"- 审阅者：`{reviewer}`；结果：`{status}`；{len(rows)} 对截图。",
             "- 结论是审阅者对保存画面的判断；哈希验证只能证明图片和判断没有被替换。", "",
             "| 流程 | 步骤 | 判断 | 可见差异 | 图片 |",
             "| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |"]
    for row in rows:
        side = check_case / row["side_by_side_path"]
        lines.append(f"| `{row['flow_id']}` | {row['step']} | `{row['verdict']}` | "
                     f"{row['note'].replace('|', '/')} | "
                     f"[并排图]({os.path.relpath(side, output)}) |")
    lines += ["", "未出现的页面、动画和其他设备未纳入本次视觉审阅。", ""]
    (output / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _write(output / "manifest.json", {
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "visual_review", "status": status,
        "rebuild_check_manifest_sha256": review["rebuild_check_manifest_sha256"],
        "evidence": [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(output / name)}
                     for name in ("review.json", "report.md")],
    })
    return output / "report.md"
```

```m
@implementation MCPAXUIClientDelegateBridge

- (void)mcp_appendHistoryEntry:(NSDictionary *)entry
                    forKeyPath:(NSString *)keyPath
                     maxLength:(NSUInteger)maxLength {
    if (!entry || keyPath.length == 0) return;
    @synchronized (self) {
        NSArray *current = [self valueForKey:keyPath];
        NSMutableArray *next = [current isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] ? [current mutableCopy] : [NSMutableArray array];
        [next addObject:entry];
        if (next.count > maxLength) {
            [next removeObjectsInRange:NSMakeRange(0, next.count - maxLength)];
        }
        [self setValue:[next copy] forKey:keyPath];
    }
}

- (void)userInterfaceClient:(id)client willActivateUserInterfaceServiceWithInitializationMessage:(id)message {
    self.uiServerReady = YES;
    self.lastInitializationMessageClass = message ? NSStringFromClass([message class]) : nil;
    self.lastInitializationMessageDescription = [message description] ?: nil;
    NSMutableDictionary *entry = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    entry[@"timestamp"] = @([[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970]);
    if (self.lastInitializationMessageClass.length > 0) {
        entry[@"class"] = self.lastInitializationMessageClass;
    }
    if (self.lastInitializationMessageDescription.length > 0) {
        entry[@"description"] = self.lastInitializationMessageDescription;
    }
    [self mcp_appendHistoryEntry:entry forKeyPath:@"initializationHistory" maxLength:12];
    (void)client;
}

- (id)userInterfaceClient:(id)client processMessageFromServer:(id)message withIdentifier:(id)identifier error:(id *)error {
    self.lastServerMessageClass = message ? NSStringFromClass([message class]) : nil;
    self.lastServerMessageDescription = [message description] ?: nil;
    if ([identifier isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]]) {
        self.lastServerMessageIdentifier = identifier;
    } else if ([identifier respondsToSelector:@selector(integerValue)]) {
        self.lastServerMessageIdentifier = @([identifier integerValue]);
    } else {
        self.lastServerMessageIdentifier = nil;
    }
    NSMutableDictionary *entry = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    entry[@"timestamp"] = @([[NSDate date] timeIntervalSince1970]);
    if (self.lastServerMessageClass.length > 0) {
        entry[@"class"] = self.lastServerMessageClass;
    }
    if (self.lastServerMessageDescription.length > 0) {
        entry[@"description"] = self.lastServerMessageDescription;
    }
    if (self.lastServerMessageIdentifier) {
        entry[@"identifier"] = self.lastServerMessageIdentifier;
    } else if (identifier) {
        entry[@"identifierDescription"] = [identifier description];
    }
    [self mcp_appendHistoryEntry:entry forKeyPath:@"serverMessageHistory" maxLength:24];
    if (error) *error = nil;
    (void)client;
    return nil;
}

static BOOL MCPAXProcessHasLoadedImageToken(NSString *token) {
    if (token.length == 0) return NO;
    uint32_t imageCount = _dyld_image_count();
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < imageCount; i++) {
        const char *imageName = _dyld_get_image_name(i);
        if (!imageName) continue;
        NSString *name = [NSString stringWithUTF8String:imageName];
        if (name.length == 0) continue;
        if ([name rangeOfString:token options:NSCaseInsensitiveSearch].location != NSNotFound) {
            return YES;
        }
    }
    return NO;
}

static NSDictionary *MCPAXBundleInfo(NSString *bundleDir, NSString *fallbackExecutableName) {
    if (bundleDir.length == 0) return @{};

    NSString *plistPath = [bundleDir stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"Info.plist"];
    NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
    NSMutableDictionary *info = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    info[@"bundlePath"] = bundleDir;
    info[@"infoPlistPath"] = plistPath;
    info[@"bundleExists"] = @([fm fileExistsAtPath:bundleDir]);
    info[@"infoPlistExists"] = @([fm fileExistsAtPath:plistPath]);

    NSDictionary *plist = [NSDictionary dictionaryWithContentsOfFile:plistPath];
    NSString *bundleIdentifier = nil;
    NSString *principalClass = nil;
    NSString *executableName = fallbackExecutableName;
    if ([plist isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) {
        bundleIdentifier = [plist[@"CFBundleIdentifier"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? plist[@"CFBundleIdentifier"] : nil;
        principalClass = [plist[@"NSPrincipalClass"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? plist[@"NSPrincipalClass"] : nil;
        NSString *plistExecutable = [plist[@"CFBundleExecutable"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] ? plist[@"CFBundleExecutable"] : nil;
        if (plistExecutable.length > 0) {
            executableName = plistExecutable;
        }
    }

    if (bundleIdentifier.length > 0) info[@"bundleIdentifier"] = bundleIdentifier;
    if (principalClass.length > 0) info[@"principalClass"] = principalClass;
    if (executableName.length > 0) {
        info[@"executableName"] = executableName;
        NSString *binaryPath = [bundleDir stringByAppendingPathComponent:executableName];
        info[@"binaryPath"] = binaryPath;
        info[@"binaryExists"] = @([fm fileExistsAtPath:binaryPath]);
    } else {
        info[@"binaryExists"] = @NO;
    }

    return [info copy];
}

    dispatch_once(&onceToken, ^{
        cached = MCPAXBundleInfo(@"/System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/AccessibilityUI.framework",
                                 @"AccessibilityUI");
    });
    return cached;
}
```
