`docs/assets/social/generate_cards.py`:

```py
"""Render the Copy APP X announcement cards from public, selected evidence.

Run with the bundled Codex Python (Pillow required):
python docs/assets/social/generate_cards.py

Original device screenshots are composited without altering their pixels.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W, H = 1600, 900

INK = "#202820"
MUTED = "#536357"
CREAM = "#F8FCF8"
WHITE = "#FFFFFF"
PANEL = "#FFFFFF"
PURPLE = "#6949C6"
LAVENDER = "#EAE3F8"
ORANGE = "#DE663F"
PEACH = "#FFE5D7"
GREEN = "#087D44"
MINT = "#DBF6E5"
PINK = "#FCE2EC"
YELLOW = "#FFE078"
PLUM = "#EDF5EE"

REG = "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf"
BOLD = "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf"
MONO = "/System/Library/Fonts/Menlo.ttc"


def font(size, bold=False, mono=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(MONO if mono else BOLD if bold else REG, size)


def text(draw, xy, value, size, fill=INK, bold=False, mono=False):
    draw.text(xy, value, font=font(size, bold, mono), fill=fill)


def box(draw, xy, fill, radius=32, outline=None, width=2):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)


def base(number, label, title, subtitle):
    im = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), CREAM)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    for x in range(0, W, 58):
        d.line((x, 0, x, H), fill="#E8F0E9", width=1)
    for y in range(0, H, 58):
        d.line((0, y, W, y), fill="#E8F0E9", width=1)
    d.ellipse((1320, -190, 1800, 290), fill=LAVENDER)
    d.ellipse((-170, 740, 180, 1090), fill=PEACH)
    box(d, (66, 48, 286, 94), "#00D861", 22)
    text(d, (88, 58), "COPY APP", 23, INK, True)
    text(d, (1336, 57), f"{number} / 04", 25, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (70, 128), label.upper(), 20, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (70, 166), title, 62, INK, True)
    text(d, (72, 249), subtitle, 25, MUTED)
    return im, d


def save(im, name):
    im.save(OUT / name, optimize=True)


def card_one():
    im, d = base("01", "System map", "A real phone. A traceable rebuild.",
                 "The Mac coordinates analysis; the selected jailbroken iPhone supplies the evidence.")
    box(d, (70, 324, 829, 746), MINT, 36)
    box(d, (945, 324, 1530, 746), PEACH, 36)
    text(d, (108, 355), "MAC", 24, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (108, 393), "Control + analysis", 38, INK, True)
    mac_items = [("Coding agent", "Interpret and implement"), ("Copy APP CLI", "Pin device + verify cases"),
                 ("Local evidence", "Hashes, sources, report"), ("Xcode", "Build an independent app")]
    for i, (head, sub) in enumerate(mac_items):
        x = 109 + (i % 2) * 355
        y = 463 + (i // 2) * 119
        box(d, (x, y, x + 324, y + 96), PANEL, 19)
        text(d, (x + 18, y + 15), head, 23, GREEN, True)
        text(d, (x + 18, y + 53), sub, 17, MUTED)
    d.line((849, 502, 918, 502), fill=ORANGE, width=8)
    d.polygon([(919, 502), (898, 488), (898, 516)], fill=ORANGE)
    d.line((919, 609, 850, 609), fill=GREEN, width=8)
    d.polygon([(848, 609), (870, 594), (870, 624)], fill=GREEN)
    box(d, (856, 537, 916, 574), YELLOW, 17)
    text(d, (862, 544), "USB", 20, INK, True)
    text(d, (985, 355), "JAILBROKEN IPHONE", 24, ORANGE, True)
    text(d, (985, 393), "Source + test device", 38, INK, True)
    for i, (head, sub, color) in enumerate([
        ("OpenSSH", "Package + bounded sandbox", GREEN),
        ("iOS MCP / iCTRL", "UI tree + screenshots", PURPLE),
        ("Frida", "Targeted runtime traces", ORANGE),
    ]):
        y = 469 + i * 80
        box(d, (985, y, 1488, y + 67), PANEL, 18)
        d.ellipse((1003, y + 22, 1025, y + 44), fill=color)
        text(d, (1044, y + 10), head, 22, INK, True)
        text(d, (1044, y + 39), sub, 16, MUTED)
    text(d, (74, 791), "ANALYZE", 22, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (293, 791), "→", 28, ORANGE, True)
    text(d, (350, 791), "SET SCOPE", 22, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (594, 791), "→", 28, ORANGE, True)
    text(d, (651, 791), "REBUILD", 22, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (870, 791), "→", 28, ORANGE, True)
    text(d, (927, 791), "COMPARE", 22, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (73, 841), "Exact device · exact app build · measured selected flows", 20, MUTED)
    save(im, "01-system-map.png")


def card_two():
    im, d = base("02", "Evidence", "Analysis, with receipts.",
                 "A cited report joins what was observed, inferred, and still unknown.")
    types = [
        ("PACKAGE", "Binary + imports", LAVENDER, PURPLE),
        ("SANDBOX", "Files + schemas", MINT, GREEN),
        ("UI", "Screens + hierarchy", PEACH, ORANGE),
        ("RUNTIME", "Bounded Frida traces", PINK, "#B63469"),
    ]
    for i, (label, detail, bg, fg) in enumerate(types):
        y = 329 + i * 114
        box(d, (70, y, 565, y + 91), bg, 23)
        text(d, (100, y + 13), label, 23, fg, True)
        text(d, (100, y + 47), detail, 22, INK)
    box(d, (620, 329, 1530, 799), PLUM, 31)
    box(d, (649, 352, 1501, 409), "#D9EADC", 17)
    d.ellipse((674, 373, 690, 389), fill=ORANGE)
    d.ellipse((702, 373, 718, 389), fill=YELLOW)
    d.ellipse((730, 373, 746, 389), fill="#00D861")
    text(d, (780, 365), "Hopper · selected iOS 17 Calculator function", 21, INK, True)
    code = [
        ("// CalculatorModel", "#657B69"),
        ("buttonPressed(arg2)", INK),
        ("  var_18 = retain(self);", "#3F5043"),
        ("  sub_10000fb4c(arg2);", PURPLE),
        ("  r0 = var_18;", "#3F5043"),
    ]
    for i, (line, fill) in enumerate(code):
        text(d, (675, 448 + i * 50), line, 26, fill, mono=True)
    d.line((674, 719, 1476, 719), fill="#B4C9B8", width=2)
    text(d, (676, 738), "Recorded excerpt · not original source · not the full algorithm", 18, MUTED)
    text(d, (72, 825), "Function interpretation remains linked to its exact binary and evidence case.", 19, MUTED)
    save(im, "02-evidence.png")


def screenshot_card(im, d, path, x, label, color):
    box(d, (x, 315, x + 550, 821), color, 28)
    text(d, (x + 27, 337), label, 27, INK, True)
    shot = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    # Preserve the captured screenshot pixels; only resize for this display card.
    shot = shot.resize((204, 442), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    box(d, (x + 165, 370, x + 385, 826), "#3A413B", 25)
    im.paste(shot, (x + 173, 377))


def card_three():
    im, d = base("03", "Same-device comparison", "Same flow. Same device.",
                 "iPhone 14 · iOS 17.3.1 · selected Calculator flow: 7 + 8 = 15")
    screenshot_card(im, d, ROOT / "assets/calculator-original.jpg", 70, "ORIGINAL", MINT)
    screenshot_card(im, d, ROOT / "assets/calculator-rebuilt.jpg", 980, "INDEPENDENT REBUILD", PINK)
    box(d, (663, 473, 937, 634), YELLOW, 34)
    text(d, (707, 497), "7 + 8", 42, INK, True)
    text(d, (733, 554), "= 15", 43, PURPLE, True)
    text(d, (670, 720), "Paired observation", 22, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (670, 753), "Differences stay", 19, MUTED)
    text(d, (670, 779), "visible in the report.", 19, MUTED)
    save(im, "03-calculator-comparison.png")


def card_four():
    im, d = base("04", "Deliverables", "A report. A runnable app. Clear limits.",
                 "The target adapts to the app's complexity; every verified flow stays explicit.")
    box(d, (70, 334, 757, 725), MINT, 34)
    box(d, (799, 334, 1530, 725), PEACH, 34)
    text(d, (106, 370), "01 / ANALYZE", 25, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (106, 422), "Deep, cited report", 41, INK, True)
    for i, item in enumerate(["Package and sandbox", "UI structure and flows", "Selected native functions", "Unknowns called out"]):
        y = 493 + i * 48
        d.ellipse((108, y + 7, 123, y + 22), fill=GREEN)
        text(d, (144, y), item, 24, INK)
    text(d, (835, 370), "02 / REBUILD", 25, ORANGE, True)
    text(d, (835, 422), "Independent iOS app", 41, INK, True)
    for i, item in enumerate(["Implement selected flows", "Install on the same device", "Compare behavior + visuals", "Report verified coverage + gaps"]):
        y = 493 + i * 48
        d.ellipse((837, y + 7, 852, y + 22), fill=ORANGE)
        text(d, (873, y), item, 23, INK)
    box(d, (70, 758, 1530, 844), MINT, 25)
    text(d, (98, 781), "TESTED PATHS", 21, GREEN, True)
    text(d, (296, 778), "iOS 16  ·  iOS 17  ·  iOS 26", 29, INK, True)
    text(d, (920, 786), "Named devices, not a universal guarantee", 19, MUTED)
    save(im, "04-deliverables.png")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    card_one()
    card_two()
    card_three()
    card_four()
    preview = Image.new("RGB", (1600, 900), CREAM)
    for i, path in enumerate(sorted(OUT.glob("0[1-4]-*.png"))):
        tile = Image.open(path).resize((800, 450), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        preview.paste(tile, ((i % 2) * 800, (i // 2) * 450))
    preview.save(OUT / "preview.png", optimize=True)

`docs/assets/social/post-draft.md`:

```md
# Copy APP X announcement

Published as [one X post with four images](https://x.com/everettjf/status/2111909890046501003) on 2026-10-18.

These four 1600 × 900 cards use a light background and fine grid, with green from the [project website](https://xnu.app/copyapp/) as the main accent. Orange, purple and pink distinguish secondary content. The captured Calculator screenshots are only resized and placed inside the comparison card; their visible content is not retouched. The Hopper card is an illustration of a recorded excerpt, not a screenshot or the original source code.

## X post

The four images below accompany one post:

> Copy APP is open source. It uses a jailbroken iPhone to collect package, sandbox, UI, Frida and selected native-code evidence for a cited report, then helps build an independent iOS app and compare selected flows on the same device.
>
> Real-device tests:
> • iPhone XR · iOS 16.1.1 · Dopamine — SSH, Frida, UI and selected rebuilds
> • iPhone 14 · iOS 17.3.1 · Relaxin/RootHide — Calculator analysis and paired UI checks
> • iPhone 11 · iOS 26.0.1 · Relaxin/RootHide — Calculator and Clock checks
>
> These are scoped results; current gaps are documented in the repo.
> https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp

## Image order and alt text

1. **[System map](01-system-map.png)** — Light, grid-backed diagram showing a Mac running the coding agent, Copy APP CLI, evidence store and Xcode, connected by USB to a jailbroken iPhone that supplies OpenSSH files, UI observations and Frida traces.
2. **[Evidence](02-evidence.png)** — Green, purple, orange and pink package, sandbox, UI and runtime evidence cards beside a designed excerpt of a recorded iOS 17 Calculator Hopper function. The excerpt does not claim to be original source code or the complete algorithm.
3. **[Calculator comparison](03-calculator-comparison.png)** — Original and independent Calculator screenshots from the same iPhone 14 on iOS 17.3.1 after a selected 7 + 8 = 15 flow. The screenshots are resized without retouching inside green and pink comparison panels; remaining differences are documented.
4. **[Deliverables](04-deliverables.png)** — Light green and orange panels: a cited analysis report and an independent runnable iOS app, followed by same-device comparison and explicit coverage gaps. The tested paths shown are iOS 16, 17 and 26 on named devices.

The illustrations are generated by [generate_cards.py](generate_cards.py) from text and the public, selected screenshots in `docs/assets/`. Raw evidence cases remain local.

```

```py
"""Render six Chinese, 3:4 Copy APP cards for a Xiaohongshu image post.

Run from the repository root with `.venv/bin/python`.
The two Calculator captures are only resized to fit the phone frames.
"""

from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
OUT = HERE / "publish"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
W, H = 1242, 1656

BG = "#F8FCF8"
INK = "#1E3025"
MUTED = "#52675A"
GREEN = "#087D44"
LIME = "#00D861"
MINT = "#DCF5E5"
PEACH = "#FFE6D9"
ORANGE = "#D9613D"
LAVENDER = "#EAE3F8"
PURPLE = "#6949C6"
PINK = "#FCE4EE"
WHITE = "#FFFFFF"
GRID = "#E9F1EA"
YELLOW = "#FFE177"

ZH = "/System/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Medium.ttc"
ZH_LIGHT = "/System/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Light.ttc"
LATIN = "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf"
MONO = "/System/Library/Fonts/Menlo.ttc"


def f(size, light=False, latin=False, mono=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(
        MONO if mono else LATIN if latin else ZH_LIGHT if light else ZH, size
    )


def t(d, xy, value, size=36, color=INK, light=False, latin=False, mono=False):
    d.text(xy, value, font=f(size, light, latin, mono), fill=color)


def center(d, y, value, size=36, color=INK, light=False):
    face = f(size, light)
    width = d.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=face)[2]
    d.text(((W - width) / 2, y), value, font=face, fill=color)


def rr(d, xy, color, radius=30, outline=None, width=2):
    d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius, fill=color, outline=outline, width=width)


def dot(d, x, y, color=GREEN, r=8):
    d.ellipse((x-r, y-r, x+r, y+r), fill=color)


def pill(d, xy, value, bg=MINT, fg=GREEN, size=27):
    rr(d, xy, bg, 24)
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    face = f(size)
    width = d.textbbox((0, 0), value, font=face)[2]
    d.text((x1+(x2-x1-width)/2, y1+(y2-y1-size)/2-3), value, font=face, fill=fg)


def base(n, kicker, lines, subtitle):
    im = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    for x in range(0, W, 54):
        d.line((x, 0, x, H), fill=GRID, width=1)
    for y in range(0, H, 54):
        d.line((0, y, W, y), fill=GRID, width=1)
    d.ellipse((940, -210, 1410, 260), fill=LAVENDER)
    d.ellipse((-160, 1420, 200, 1780), fill=PEACH)
    pill(d, (68, 56, 316, 116), "COPY APP", LIME, INK, 30)
    t(d, (1030, 68), f"{n} / 06", 30, GREEN, latin=True)
    t(d, (70, 173), kicker, 30, GREEN)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        t(d, (69, 228+i*111), line, 83, INK)
    t(d, (72, 255+len(lines)*111), subtitle, 35, MUTED, light=True)
    d.line((70, 1565, 1172, 1565), fill="#C8DBCD", width=2)
    t(d, (72, 1590), "开源项目 · 选定流程实测 · 差异如实记录", 24, MUTED)
    return im, d


def save(im, name):
    im.save(OUT / name, optimize=True)


def cover():
    im, d = base("01", "一个开源实验", ["把越狱 iPhone", "接给 Coding Agent"],
                 "分析 App，再做可运行复刻")
    rr(d, (86, 645, 818, 1200), WHITE, 42, "#CEE2D2", 3)

    rr(d, (148, 713, 462, 767), LIME, 23)
    t(d, (173, 723), "COPY APP", 28, INK, latin=True)
    t(d, (148, 818), "coding agent  →  证据", 38, GREEN)
    t(d, (148, 890), "报告  →  新 iOS 工程", 38, INK)
    t(d, (148, 962), "同机对照  →  差异清单", 38, INK)
    rr(d, (282, 1200, 622, 1230), "#73877A", 15)
    rr(d, (231, 1230, 675, 1250), "#9DB0A1", 10)
    rr(d, (817, 727, 1148, 1278), INK, 51)
    rr(d, (834, 756, 1131, 1237), "#FFF8F1", 31)
    pill(d, (878, 790, 1089, 842), "越狱 iPhone", PEACH, ORANGE, 27)
    rr(d, (891, 903, 1073, 1085), MINT, 36)
    t(d, (929, 944), "APP", 45, GREEN, latin=True)

    d.line((790, 957, 817, 957), fill=ORANGE, width=8)
    d.polygon([(821, 957), (802, 944), (802, 970)], fill=ORANGE)
    for x, label, bg, fg in [(70, "证据分析", MINT, GREEN),
                             (447, "独立复刻", PEACH, ORANGE),

# 小红书图文笔记

## 标题

越狱 iPhone × Coding Agent

## 正文

最近 REA 让“Agent 辅助逆向”受到更多关注。我一直在想：如果 Coding Agent 能直接使用一台越狱 iPhone，能不能把 App 分析、独立复刻和真机验证串起来？

这就是开源项目 Copy APP 的起点。手工逆向常要在 SSH、Frida、Hopper、截图与 Xcode 之间切换；单张截图或一次方法命中又很容易被误读。Copy APP 把每一步绑定到具体设备、Bundle ID、App 构建和本地证据 case，报告区分“观察到”“推断”和“未知”。

架构上，Mac 运行 Codex / Claude Code 与 Copy APP CLI；越狱 iPhone 经 USB/SSH 提供包和沙盒，iOS MCP / iCTRL 采集界面，Frida 观察选定运行路径；Ghidra / Hopper 可选做原生分析。Agent 据此写报告和功能规格，再构建独立 iOS App，回到同一台手机重放选定流程、逐张对照。

第一阶段是深度分析；第二阶段按 App 复杂度定复刻目标。简单 App 可以覆盖更广，复杂 App 先选有用的功能切片，差异和未验证项都要写清楚。iOS 16、17、26 的三台手机已跑过选定流程，这不等于任意 App 都能“一键完整复制”。

想试试：GitHub 搜索 everettjf/copyapp。欢迎 Star，先按 README 跑 onboard / survey；也欢迎分享可复现的真机问题和改进建议。

#iOS开发 #逆向工程 #开源项目 #CodingAgent

## 配图顺序

1. `publish/01-cover.png`
2. `publish/02-architecture.png`
3. `publish/03-evidence.png`
4. `publish/04-workflow.png`
5. `publish/05-comparison.png`
6. `publish/06-github.png`

`docs/copy-workflow.md`:

```md
# Analyze → Rebuild workflow

[English](copy-workflow.md) · [简体中文](copy-workflow.zh-CN.md) · [Documentation](README.md)

Copy APP runs a resumable, evidence-gated job for one exact device and installed App build. Begin with [setup](setup.md) and `copyapp doctor`. Use `--agent-provider current` from an active Codex or Claude Code session; it pauses for the current agent's work without starting another agent process. `codex` and `claude` select external CLI processes when that is intended.

## 1. Discover representative behavior

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --udid <UDID> --bundle <ORIGINAL_BUNDLE> \
  --auto-discover --agent-provider current \
  --rebuilt-bundle <NEW_BUNDLE>
```

New jobs default to `output/<bundle>-<UTC>-<unique-id>/` in the workspace, with
`project/` for independent source and `evidence/` for reports, captures and checks.
Use `--output-dir output/my-job` to choose a job directory. The existing explicit
`--project <SOURCE> --out <CASE>` form remains supported. Paths must stay inside
the selected workspace (`--workspace <DIR>`); the root `output/` is Git-ignored.
Existing examples and cases stay in place. On resume, pin the printed
`--output-dir` (or legacy `--out` and `--project`) and retain all other settings;
`--resume` never guesses the latest job.

The first pause writes `discovery-agent/TASK.md`. Observe the real App and author 3–12 distinct bounded UI playbooks. Each should identify its starting page, contain a meaningful action, assert an observable final state where possible, and save a stable screenshot. Run `copyapp discover-check` as directed by the task, verify its case, and resume the **same** `copy` command with `--resume`. Existing selected scripts may be supplied through repeated `--script <FILE>`; a verified discovery case may be passed with `--discovery <CASE>`. These alternatives replace `--auto-discover`.

Use one UI backend per playbook. When comparing original and clone, use the same backend and aligned starting state. Read the [gesture](ui-gesture-playbooks.md) and [text-entry](ui-text-playbooks.md) guides for action bounds. A successful action RPC is not a result assertion. Preserve failed or uncertain attempts; inspect the current screen before another tap.

## 2. Collect and interpret evidence

After discovery verifies, `copy` runs package, sandbox, UI and requested runtime collection. It pauses at `analysis-agent/TASK.md`. Read the acquired binary indexes, UI evidence, trace and any optional Ghidra/Hopper pseudocode. Write a reviewed `findings.json` and `feature-spec.json`, then create and verify the formal `copyapp report` and `analysis-delivery` specified by the task. `analysis.md` from `analyze` is only a collection index. Every substantive functional claim needs a source case and a stated observation or inference; unknown server or native behavior remains unknown.

Encrypted binaries may require [analysis IPA recovery](full-package-decryption.md). If the installed Mach-O is already unencrypted, a source snapshot is recorded; do not describe that as a decryption. Ghidra and Hopper are optional; [direct Hopper](rea-hopper-integration.md) does not require REA. A static function candidate and a nearby Frida hit are different kinds of evidence.

Before implementation, inventory known user-visible capabilities and set a [reviewed coverage target](coverage-targets.md). Use `coverage-plan` to freeze the target, selected flows, weights and deferred/blocked items. An uncertain inventory should produce a named target without a percentage.

## 3. Build, install and compare

Resume the parent. `prepare-rebuild` writes `rebuild-agent/TASK.md`. Implement an independent Xcode project at the selected path and give it a different Bundle ID. Build, sign and install it on the exact phone. For a development-signed IPA:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> \
  --ipa <SIGNED_IPA> --out cases/<INSTALL>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/<INSTALL>
```

Use the compatible TrollStore path where appropriate. An install case does not establish launch or equivalence. Run the task's original/rebuilt paired checks, inspect all screenshot pairs, save an explicit `visual-review`, and bind source, install and check cases with `agent-delivery`. For data-changing flows, compare relevant bounded sandbox contents before and after; a matching UI count cannot prove matching persistence. Mark simulated backend behavior as simulated.

Resume `copy` again after every child verifies. A completed parent proves that the selected evidence gates were met; `copyapp verify cases/<WORKFLOW>` rechecks saved hashes and source links, not semantic correctness or behavior outside the selected flows. Finish with `coverage-delivery` and a reviewer decision for each known capability. Report target coverage, milestone completion and verified known coverage separately, with a defensible denominator and explicit unknowns.

See [current status](current-status.md) for named-device results and unresolved limitations. Raw case folders stay local and Git-ignored.

```

`docs/copy-workflow.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# 分析到复刻工作流

[English](copy-workflow.md) · 简体中文 · [文档目录](README.zh-CN.md)

Copy APP 对精确指定的一台手机与一个已安装 App 构建运行可续跑、有证据门槛的流程。先按[安装指南](setup.zh-CN.md)配置并运行 `copyapp doctor`。在现有 Codex 或 Claude Code 会话中使用 `--agent-provider current`：它等待当前 Agent 完成任务，不会再启动一个 Agent 进程。需要独立 CLI 进程时才选择 `codex` 或 `claude`。

## 1. 发现代表性行为

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --udid <UDID> --bundle <ORIGINAL_BUNDLE> \
  --auto-discover --agent-provider current \
  --rebuilt-bundle <NEW_BUNDLE>
```

新任务默认写入工作区的 `output/<Bundle ID>-<UTC 时间>-<唯一编号>/`：
`project/` 放独立源码，`evidence/` 放报告、截图及检查结果。
可用 `--output-dir output/my-job` 自定义任务目录，也保留原有的
`--project <源码目录> --out <案例目录>`。路径须位于所选工作区内
（可用 `--workspace <目录>`）；仓库根目录的 `output/` 已被 Git 忽略，现有示例和案例不移动。
续跑时固定命令打印的 `--output-dir`（或原有 `--out`、`--project`），
其余设置保持相同，再加 `--resume`；不会自动猜测最近一次任务。

首次暂停会生成 `discovery-agent/TASK.md`。观察真实 App，写 3–12 条不同的有界 UI 脚本。每条应标明起始页面、包含有意义的操作、尽可能断言可见末端状态并保存稳定截图。按任务要求运行 `copyapp discover-check`，校验案例后用**完全相同**的 `copy` 参数加 `--resume` 续跑。已有脚本可重复传 `--script <FILE>`；已校验的发现案例可用 `--discovery <CASE>`。这两种方式替代 `--auto-discover`。

每条 playbook 只使用一个 UI 后端。原版与复刻版对照时使用同一后端、对齐起始状态。操作边界见[手势](ui-gesture-playbooks.zh-CN.md)和[文字输入](ui-text-playbooks.zh-CN.md)指南。RPC 返回成功不是结果断言。保留失败或结果不明的尝试；再次点击前先查看当前画面。

## 2. 采集并解释证据

发现案例通过后，`copy` 采集包、沙盒、界面与请求的运行证据，再于 `analysis-agent/TASK.md` 暂停。阅读二进制索引、界面、轨迹及可选的 Ghidra/Hopper 伪代码；撰写审阅过的 `findings.json`、`feature-spec.json`，按任务创建并校验正式 `copyapp report` 与 `analysis-delivery`。`analyze` 生成的 `analysis.md` 只是采集索引。每条重要功能结论都要有来源案例，标明观察或推断；未知的服务端或原生行为仍标为未知。

加密二进制可能需要[分析 IPA 恢复](full-package-decryption.md)。如果已安装 Mach-O 本来就未加密，只记录来源快照，不称为“解密成功”。Ghidra 与 Hopper 可选；[直连 Hopper](rea-hopper-integration.zh-CN.md)不依赖 REA。静态候选函数与相近时间的 Frida 命中是两种不同证据。

实现前盘点已知的用户可见能力，并设定[审阅后的覆盖目标](coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)。用 `coverage-plan` 固定目标、选定流程、权重与延期／阻塞项。清单不够确定时，使用有名字的目标，不给出无法支撑的百分比。

## 3. 构建、安装和对照

继续续跑父流程。`prepare-rebuild` 生成 `rebuild-agent/TASK.md`。在指定路径实现独立 Xcode 工程，使用不同的 Bundle ID，在精确选定的手机上构建、签名并安装。开发签名 IPA 的命令：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> \
  --ipa <SIGNED_IPA> --out cases/<INSTALL>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/<INSTALL>
```

适配的包也可走 TrollStore。安装案例不证明启动或功能等价。运行任务要求的原版／复刻版成对检查，逐张查看截图，保存明确的 `visual-review`，再以 `agent-delivery` 绑定源码、安装和检查案例。改变数据的流程还应对照相关沙盒内容的前后变化；界面计数一致不代表持久化一致。模拟服务端行为必须标注为模拟。

子案例均通过后再次续跑 `copy`。完成的父案例说明选定证据门槛通过；`copyapp verify cases/<WORKFLOW>` 复核保存哈希与来源链接，不证明语义正确或其他流程。最后运行 `coverage-delivery`，对每项已知能力给出审阅结论。分别报告目标覆盖、阶段完成度、已验证的已知覆盖；分母必须有依据，并列出未知项。

指定设备结果及限制见[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。原始案例只保存在被 Git 忽略的本地目录。

```

# Setting a rebuild coverage target

[English](coverage-targets.md) · [简体中文](coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)

“Complete rebuild” is a goal to define for a specific App and device state, not a default claim. A small App may have a bounded, observable feature set that can be fully implemented and checked. A large App may need a first milestone covering 50–60% of its **known** capabilities. Set that target after reconnaissance, then report the achieved scope and every important gap.

## 1. Make a capability inventory after analysis

List user-visible capabilities and their important states, not classes, screens or lines of code. For example, “create a local note and find it after relaunch” is a capability; an editor screenshot alone is not. Include navigation, data persistence, permissions, offline/network behavior, extensions and account or payment paths when they are part of the App. Group related states so one action is not split into many trivial items. Link each item to observed evidence and mark unobserved or inaccessible states. The inventory is a *known-capability baseline*, never a proof that no hidden feature exists.

For each item record: stable ID, description and acceptance behavior, evidence basis, relative importance (1–5), feasibility/dependencies, and one of `selected`, `deferred`, or `blocked`. Explicitly list the unknown feature areas beside the inventory. Never silently remove a difficult known feature from the denominator.

## 2. Choose a milestone target

Select capabilities that form useful end-to-end journeys. Record the selected IDs, target device and App build, target date or iteration, and why each deferred/blocked item was left out. Prioritize critical paths and connected behavior before decorative breadth. The percentage is descriptive, not a substitute for the named acceptance list.

Use the declared importance weights consistently:

`target coverage = selected known-capability weight / total known-capability weight`

Do not call `3/3` tested flows “100% of the App.” That is only 100% of those three selected flows. If the inventory is too uncertain to support a denominator, state a **named-scope target** without an App percentage and continue discovery. For a large App, 50–60% is a possible negotiated milestone, not an automatic threshold or a guarantee. A small App can aim for 100% of its known inventory, with unknown states and test limits still disclosed.

Freeze the inventory and weights before implementation. When new evidence changes scope, create a new target with `--previous` and a `revision_reason`; both cases remain available. A revision can add capabilities or change scope, but it cannot remove or weaken an existing known capability or its weight. A changed analysis baseline requires a new report and target. Do not lower the target after a failed check merely to make the result appear complete.

`copyapp rebuild-plan --report <REPORT> --flow <ID> ... --out <PLAN>` selects 1–12 reviewed flows for one implementation task. A larger milestone needs multiple bounded plans/tasks/cases; `coverage-plan` accepts repeated `--plan` and `coverage-delivery` accepts repeated `--delivery` to aggregate them. One completed `copyapp copy` parent cannot certify all of a large App. Keep each selected capability linked to its task and checks.

## 3. Build in two passes and measure delivery

First make the selected journeys runnable with the right page structure and core interactions. Then deepen state transitions, persistence, permission states, network-backed outcomes and visual fidelity. For each selected capability, compare original and clone on the same device from equivalent starting states. Mark it `verified` only when its declared behavior and visual acceptance checks pass; otherwise use `partial`, `failed` or `untested` with evidence and a reason. A simulated server response must be labelled `simulated` and does not count as equivalent production behavior.

Report three distinct numbers, if a known-capability denominator exists:

- **Target coverage:** selected weight / known inventory weight.
- **Milestone completion:** verified selected weight / selected weight.
- **Verified known coverage:** verified selected weight / known inventory weight.

For example, if ten equally weighted capabilities are known, six are selected and five pass, report a 60% target, 5/6 milestone completion (83%), and 50% verified known coverage. Also report the 1 selected gap, 4 deferred items, unknown areas, major visual differences, and device/build limits. Do not count a capability merely because a screen renders or a script exits successfully.

`copyapp coverage-plan` now validates and freezes the submitted inventory against the report and selected rebuild plans. `coverage-delivery` calculates the three numbers from that inventory and one or more verified `agent-delivery` cases. A human reviewer must decide each capability result and describe the evidence. The CLI refuses `verified` when any mapped flow lacks a passing behavior assertion or a completed visual review without a major difference. Its hashes and arithmetic are machine checked; inventory completeness, weights and semantic equivalence remain reviewed judgments. The existing `feature-spec.json` and `agent-delivery` remain selected-flow evidence, not an App-wide score by themselves.

## CLI contract

Save an inventory JSON after the reviewed report and rebuild plan exist:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
  "rebuilt_bundle_id": "com.example.clone",
  "rationale": "Start with local creation and search",
  "unknowns": ["Server-only states not observed"],
  "capabilities": [
    {"id": "create", "name": "Create item", "acceptance": "Create and display a local item", "basis": "Reviewed original flow", "weight": 3, "scope": "selected", "flow_ids": ["create"]},
    {"id": "sync", "name": "Account sync", "acceptance": "Sync across devices", "basis": "Visible account entry; not exercised", "weight": 2, "scope": "blocked", "flow_ids": [], "reason": "No test account"}
  ]
}
```

Every selected rebuild flow must belong to exactly one selected capability. Weights are integers 1–5. Deferred and blocked capabilities stay in the known denominator and need a reason. Keep acceptance narrow enough to match the mapped flow evidence; a screenshot cannot establish persistence or server equivalence.

```sh
copyapp coverage-plan --report <REPORT_CASE> --plan <REBUILD_PLAN_CASE> \
  --inventory <INVENTORY_JSON> --out <TARGET_CASE>
copyapp verify <TARGET_CASE>
```

To revise the same report baseline, add `revision_reason` to the new inventory and pass `--previous <OLD_TARGET_CASE>`; use a fresh output directory. After the real-device `agent-delivery`, provide one decision per inventory item:

```json
{"schema_version": 1, "capabilities": [
  {"id": "create", "result": "verified", "notes": "Paired behavior passed; minor icon difference recorded"},
  {"id": "sync", "result": "untested", "notes": "No test account"}
]}
```

`result` is `verified`, `partial`, `failed`, or `untested`; deferred/blocked items must remain `untested`. Then run:

```sh
copyapp coverage-delivery --plan <TARGET_CASE> --delivery <AGENT_DELIVERY_CASE> \
  --review <REVIEW_JSON> --out <COVERAGE_CASE>
copyapp verify <COVERAGE_CASE>
```

Use repeated `--plan` and `--delivery` for multiple bounded tasks. The target is met only when all selected weight is verified. The resulting report names every gap and unknown; a 100% milestone completion still refers only to the selected known capabilities.

## Case record template

| ID | Capability and acceptance behavior | Evidence | Weight | Scope | Result | Gap / reason |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| local-create | Create a local item; it survives relaunch | Original flow + local data observation | 5 | selected | verified / partial / failed / untested | State the exact difference |
| account-sync | Sync an account item across devices | unobserved | 5 | blocked | untested | Account/server access unavailable |

Below the table record the known inventory total, selected IDs, target revision, the three coverage numbers where justified, unknown areas and links to the exact original/clone checks. A major visual gap or untested backend behavior must remain visible in the final user-facing summary even when the milestone's other checks pass.

```

```md
# 如何设定动态复刻目标

[English](coverage-targets.md) · [简体中文](coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)

“完整复刻”应针对具体 App 和设备状态定义，不能默认承诺。简单 App 的功能边界可能足够清楚，可以把已知功能全部实现并验证；大型 App 的第一阶段可以只选择已知能力的 50–60%。分析后确定目标，交付时明确实际完成的范围和缺口。

## 1. 分析后建立能力清单

按用户可见的能力及关键状态盘点，不按类、页面或代码行数计数。例如，“创建本地笔记，重启后仍可搜索到”是一项能力；编辑器截图本身不是。视 App 情况纳入导航、持久化、权限、离线与网络行为、扩展、账号和支付等。把相关状态组成合理的功能项，避免把一项操作拆成很多容易通过的小项。每项关联观测证据，未观察到的状态要标明。清单只是**已知能力基线**，无法证明没有隐藏功能。

每项记录稳定 ID、描述与验收行为、证据依据、相对重要性权重（1–5）、可行性或依赖，以及 `selected`、`deferred` 或 `blocked`。另外列出未知功能领域。已知但困难的功能不能悄悄从分母删掉。

## 2. 选择阶段目标

选择能组成完整用户旅程的能力，记录选中的 ID、目标设备与原版构建、阶段时间或迭代，以及每项推迟或受阻的原因。先做核心路径和连续行为，再扩展装饰性页面。百分比用于描述范围，不能代替逐项验收。

沿用事先声明的权重：

`目标覆盖率 = 已选已知能力的权重 / 已知能力总权重`

“3/3 条测试流程通过”仅表示这三条选定流程 100% 通过，不能写成整个 App 的 100%。若能力清单尚不充分，先只声明**具名范围**，不要给整个 App 一个百分比，继续发现。大型 App 的 50–60% 只是可能商定的阶段目标，不是自动阈值或效果保证。简单 App 可以把已知清单的 100% 作为目标，但仍须披露未知状态及测试限制。

实现前固定清单和权重。新证据改变范围时，用 `--previous` 与 `revision_reason` 新建目标，保留原案例和修订案例。修订可以增加能力或调整范围，但不能删除、弱化已知能力或改变其权重。分析基线变化时应建立新的报告和目标。不能因为验证失败就降低目标来制造完成的印象。

`copyapp rebuild-plan --report <报告> --flow <ID> ... --out <计划>` 可以为一个实施任务选择 1–12 条已审阅流程。更大的阶段目标需要多个有界计划／任务／案例；`coverage-plan` 支持重复 `--plan`，`coverage-delivery` 支持重复 `--delivery` 汇总。一个完成的 `copyapp copy` 父案例不能证明大型 App 的全部能力。每项选定能力都应链接到对应任务和检查。

## 3. 先浅后深，再核算交付

先让选定用户旅程可运行，具备主要页面结构与核心操作；再补状态变化、持久化、权限、网络结果和视觉细节。每项在同一台设备、等价初始状态下对照原版和复刻版。只有声明的行为及视觉验收均通过，才标记 `verified`；否则标记 `partial`、`failed` 或 `untested`，附证据和原因。模拟的服务端结果必须写明 `simulated`，不能算作真实服务行为等价。

如果已知能力分母成立，交付时分别给出三个数字：

- **目标覆盖率：**已选权重 / 已知清单总权重。
- **阶段完成率：**已验证的已选权重 / 已选权重。
- **已知能力实证覆盖率：**已验证的已选权重 / 已知清单总权重。

例如已知十项同权重能力，选六项、五项通过，应报告目标 60%、阶段完成 5/6（83%）、已知能力实证覆盖 50%。同时列出一项未完成、四项延后、未知领域、重大视觉差异以及设备与构建限制。页面能显示或脚本成功退出都不足以把能力计为完成。

`copyapp coverage-plan` 现在会校验并固定人工提交的能力清单，绑定审阅报告与已选复刻计划。`coverage-delivery` 根据该清单与一个或多个通过校验的 `agent-delivery` 案例计算三个数字。审阅者仍须逐项判断结果并说明证据；若对应流程缺少通过的行为断言，或没有完成逐图审阅，或存在重大视觉差异，CLI 会拒绝把它标记为 `verified`。哈希与算术可机器校验；清单是否完整、权重是否合理、语义是否等价仍需人工审阅。单独的 `feature-spec.json` 和 `agent-delivery` 只是选定流程的证据，不能直接当作整个 App 的分数。

## CLI 输入与命令

审阅报告与复刻计划就绪后保存能力清单 JSON：

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
  "rebuilt_bundle_id": "com.example.clone",
  "rationale": "先实现本地创建和搜索",
  "unknowns": ["未观察到的服务端状态"],
  "capabilities": [
    {"id": "create", "name": "创建项目", "acceptance": "创建并显示本地项目", "basis": "审阅后的原版流程", "weight": 3, "scope": "selected", "flow_ids": ["create"]},
    {"id": "sync", "name": "账号同步", "acceptance": "跨设备同步", "basis": "可见账号入口，但未操作", "weight": 2, "scope": "blocked", "flow_ids": [], "reason": "没有测试账号"}
  ]
}
```

每条选定的复刻流程必须恰好归属一项选定能力；权重为 1–5 的整数。延后和受阻的已知能力仍计入分母，并须写明原因。验收描述应与关联流程的证据一致；单张截图不能证明持久化或服务端等价。

```sh
copyapp coverage-plan --report <报告案例> --plan <复刻计划案例> \
  --inventory <清单_JSON> --out <目标案例>
copyapp verify <目标案例>
```

修订同一报告基线时，在新清单添加 `revision_reason`，传入 `--previous <旧目标案例>`，并使用新的输出目录。真机 `agent-delivery` 完成后，为清单中每一项提交判断：

```json
{"schema_version": 1, "capabilities": [
  {"id": "create", "result": "verified", "notes": "成对行为通过；已记录轻微图标差异"},
  {"id": "sync", "result": "untested", "notes": "没有测试账号"}
]}
```

`result` 可以是 `verified`、`partial`、`failed` 或 `untested`；延后／受阻项必须保持 `untested`。随后执行：

```sh
copyapp coverage-delivery --plan <目标案例> --delivery <复刻交付案例> \
  --review <审阅_JSON> --out <覆盖交付案例>
copyapp verify <覆盖交付案例>
```

多个有界任务可重复使用 `--plan` 和 `--delivery`。只有全部选定权重通过验证时，阶段目标才算达成。结果报告逐项列出缺口和未知；即便阶段完成率为 100%，也只针对选定的已知能力。

## 案例记录模板

| ID | 能力与验收行为 | 证据 | 权重 | 范围 | 结果 | 差异／原因 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| local-create | 创建本地项目，重启后仍存在 | 原版流程与本地数据观测 | 5 | selected | verified / partial / failed / untested | 写明具体差异 |
| account-sync | 跨设备同步账号项目 | unobserved | 5 | blocked | untested | 无账号或服务端访问条件 |

表格后记录已知清单总量、选定 ID、目标修订、合理情况下的三个覆盖数字、未知领域，以及原版／复刻版精确检查的链接。即使阶段中其他检查通过，最终面向用户的摘要也必须写明重大视觉缺口和未验证的后端行为。

# Current support and validation

[English](current-status.md) · [简体中文](current-status.zh-CN.md) · [Documentation](README.md)

**Current release:** [v0.2.0](releases/v0.2.0.md) supports jailbroken iOS and macOS through ChatComputer. **Previous iOS-only release:** [v0.1.2](releases/v0.1.2.md). The phone table below retains its named-device evidence and dates; this release does not add new iPhone executions.

## macOS support

The named ChatComputer 0.9.11 / macOS 27.0.1 guest has two sample Apps, each with three selected flows across three rounds (9/9 comparisons per sample), full screenshot review, takeover/refusal and controlled reply-loss evidence, and one quiesced running-editor snapshot take/restore. The owned editor has a 7/9 known-capability strict delivery and a same-binary manual selected-flow recheck on one physical Mac. Stocks meets the later offline-prototype target at 81/100, with 207 major visual differences retained; it has no strict delivery or verified capability coverage. See [Mac support](macos-support.md), [the ledger](macos-implementation-plan.md) and [Stocks source](../examples/macos/Stocks/README.md).

Mac support does not establish arbitrary-Mac compatibility, whole-App parity, deep native function analysis, complete data or a live Stocks service. The release passes 410 local tests and an isolated wheel check; named live records precede the final version-metadata update.


## Named-device results

| Device | Current-code result | Boundaries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone XR, iOS 16.1.1, Dopamine rootless | SSH package/sandbox route, Frida, iOS MCP and iCTRL; selected Notes, Calculator, Translate and Clock analysis/rebuild paths. A recent Counter original/clone check passed after aligning state. | Optional developer file listing returns `ConnectionTerminatedError` on this phone. SSH-backed acquisition remains usable. |
| iPhone 14, iOS 17.3.1, Relaxin/RootHide | Current-code `doctor` and original Calculator acquisition verified; four iOS MCP original/independent-app flows passed final assertions (`15`, `0.3`, `−7`, `0.5`), with five image pairs reviewed as minor differences. Original-App Frida tracing hit the selected button method once on each of five taps. | v0.1.1 iCTRL paired replay could fail after premature XCTest-session teardown. The v0.1.2 fix passed four original/rebuilt iCTRL flows and left runner PID 0 on exit. Reboot/rejailbreak durability and this change on other devices remain untested. |
| iPhone 11, iOS 26.0.1, Relaxin/RootHide | USB/SSH acquisition, iCTRL and iOS MCP UI, Frida attach, reviewed Calculator and Clock reports, signed independent apps, selected arithmetic and Stopwatch paired checks. A Clock Start → Stop → Reset comparison and visual review passed. | iOS MCP may capture a black app area after Instruments fresh launch. Rejected frames and bounded Home/relaunch recovery are recorded; long-term reliability is unknown. |

The v0.1.2 suite passed **346 tests**, and its isolated-wheel installation check passed. The earlier [macOS bootstrap, unit-test and isolated-wheel run](https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/actions/runs/39151891412) passed on commit `1499222`. Saved case evidence, including failed attempts, stays under ignored local `cases/` and is not shipped with the repository or release. `copyapp verify` checks case consistency and source binding; it does not prove a reverse-engineering interpretation or whole-app equivalence.

## iOS 17 iCTRL session fix (v0.1.2)

The previous orchestration detached its owned XCTest host after capturing the original, then reused a runner that could still briefly answer log requests. In this reproduction, the clone's equals request received zero bytes, while an independent screenshot showed 15: the tap had executed and must not be repeated just because its reply was lost. A controlled experiment retaining one host completed two four-flow checks, supporting the session-lifetime diagnosis.

`rebuild-check` now retains the session through all paired flows and immediate view-tree captures, stops its owned runner before detaching, and reports unknown completion after an HTTP disconnect. Two independent production-command runs (local cases `cases/ios17-ictrl-session-fixed-four-flow-run1-20261018` and `cases/ios17-ictrl-session-fixed-four-flow-run2-20261018`) each passed all four final assertions and left runner PID 0 on exit. All ten screenshot pairs were reviewed as minor differences. Failures, request timelines, source snapshots and experiment records remain under local `cases/ios17-ictrl-transport-diagnosis-20261018/`. This is a named-device, selected-flow regression fix, not reboot or long-term validation; the v0.1.1 release record is unchanged.

## What is still open

- **Low priority:** XR's optional DVT developer-file listing returned `ConnectionTerminatedError` in repeated October 17 and 18 probes. SSH package and sandbox acquisition still work, so this does not block the main workflow.
- **Monitor with recovery:** iOS 26 iOS MCP produced black fresh-launch frames in several distinct October 18 Calculator and Clock runs. Each cited run rejected the frames and completed after bounded reactivation. Revisit the capture path if recovery fails, the black frame reaches accepted evidence, or a new device/build shows the issue without a working fallback.
- Reboot/rejailbreak persistence and longer-running UI/backend reliability need dedicated checks.
- A full first-use phone onboarding on a **second physical Mac** has not been tested; that work is deferred for now. A fresh checkout on the same Mac and a clean GitHub-hosted macOS bootstrap passed narrower setup checks.
- Selected-flow deliveries do not demonstrate arbitrary-app discovery, complete app parity, server-side behavior, or pixel-perfect visuals. Some independent app projects adapted existing source; distinguish those from new-source work.

### Next verification pass

| Open item | Evidence needed to close it |
| --- | --- |
| iCTRL session-change boundaries | Multi-step regression passed on the named iPhone 14; check reboot/rejailbreak behavior and exercise the changed session cleanup on the other named devices. |
| XR DVT file listing | Keep the optional-path limit documented. Reinvestigate when a change to developer services or a new device makes this route necessary; SSH acquisition is already verified. |
| Reboot / rejailbreak durability | Reboot each tested phone, restore its jailbreak and services, run `doctor`, acquire a small case, and complete a UI check. Check that any rejected iOS 26 black frame still recovers before accepting a screenshot; investigate the capture path only if that recovery stops working. |
| Second physical Mac | Follow the public setup guide from a fresh checkout and USB trust through SSH key pinning, UI capture, package acquisition and a signed or TrollStore-installed rebuild. |
| Broader app coverage | Test an unfamiliar app with a reviewed capability inventory, source-linked report, named rebuild target, paired flows and documented unknowns. Do not infer full-app parity from a few passing flows. |

The [illustrated overview](articles/copyapp-overview.zh-CN.md) and [system diagram](assets/architecture-overview.svg) show the current workflow and selected public evidence examples. The underlying raw cases remain local.

One-off failures that do not recur after a comparable retry should be kept in their saved case, not carried as an active defect. The iCTRL, DVT, and black-frame observations above were repeated. The named-device iCTRL regression fix is recorded; prioritize the remaining issues by whether they block the main workflow or have a verified fallback.

## Publication rule

Number only tagged, published releases. The [current plan](../PLAN.en.md) tracks the next verification work. Raw IPAs, account data, sandbox exports and private keys are never release assets.

# 当前支持与真机验证

[English](current-status.md) · 简体中文 · [文档目录](README.zh-CN.md)

**当前正式版：**[v0.2.0](releases/v0.2.0.zh-CN.md) 支持越狱 iOS 和通过 ChatComputer 的 macOS。**上一版仅支持 iOS 的版本：**[v0.1.2](releases/v0.1.2.zh-CN.md)。下方手机记录保留原设备与时间范围，本版不增加新的 iPhone 真机执行声明。

## macOS 支持

指定 ChatComputer 0.9.11／macOS 27.0.1 客体已完成两个样例各三条流程、各三轮（每个 9/9）、完整截图审阅、真人接管／输入拒绝、受控回复丢失和一次暂停轮询后的运行中编辑器快照取回／恢复。自有编辑器完成 7/9 已知能力严格交付，并在指定实体 Mac 以相同二进制手动复验选定行为。Stocks 达到后来要求的 81/100 离线原型目标，207 项明显差异保留，尚无严格交付或已验证能力覆盖。详见 [Mac 支持](macos-support.zh-CN.md)、[实施账本](macos-implementation-plan.md)及 [Stocks 源码](../examples/macos/Stocks/README.md)。

macOS 支持不代表任意 Mac 兼容、整 App 等价、深层函数分析、完整数据或实时行情。本版通过 410 项本地测试和隔离 wheel 检查；指定真实记录早于最终版本元数据更新。

## 指定手机的结果

| 设备 | 当前代码结果 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone XR，iOS 16.1.1，Dopamine rootless | SSH 包／沙盒采集、Frida、iOS MCP 与 iCTRL；Notes、Calculator、Translate、Clock 的选定分析／复刻路径。最近一次 Counter 原版／复刻版在状态对齐后通过。 | 这台手机的可选开发者文件列表返回 `ConnectionTerminatedError`；SSH 采集仍可用。 |
| iPhone 14，iOS 17.3.1，Relaxin/RootHide | 当前代码的 `doctor` 和原版 Calculator 采集通过；经 iOS MCP 的四条原版／独立 App 流程通过末端断言（`15`、`0.3`、`−7`、`0.5`），五组截图审阅为轻微差异。原版 Frida 跟踪在五次点击中各记录一次选定按钮方法调用。 | v0.1.1 的 iCTRL 成对重放会因 XCTest 会话过早断开而失败；v0.1.2 修复后四条原版／复刻版 iCTRL 流程通过，退出后 runner PID 为 0。重启／重新越狱及其他设备上的本次改动仍待验证。 |
| iPhone 11，iOS 26.0.1，Relaxin/RootHide | USB／SSH 采集、iCTRL 与 iOS MCP 界面、Frida 附加、Calculator 与 Clock 审阅报告、签名独立 App、选定运算和秒表成对检查。Clock Start → Stop → Reset 对照与逐图审阅通过。 | Instruments 新启动后 iOS MCP 可能截到黑色 App 区域；已保存拒绝的黑帧并在已观察案例中通过有界返回主屏／重启恢复。长期稳定性未知。 |

v0.1.2 本地测试通过 **346 项**，本轮隔离 wheel 安装检查也通过。先前提交 `1499222` 的 [GitHub macOS 全新安装、单元测试与隔离 wheel 检查](https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/actions/runs/39151891412)也通过。成功和失败的原始案例都保存在被忽略的本地 `cases/`，不进入仓库或发布附件。`copyapp verify` 核对案例内容与来源绑定，不证明逆向解释正确或整 App 等价。

## iOS 17 iCTRL 会话修复（v0.1.2）

旧逻辑会在原版采集结束时断开自建 XCTest 宿主，后续流程又复用仍能短暂响应日志的 runner。本轮重现中，复刻版等号请求收到 0 字节，独立截图却显示 15：点击已执行，不能因响应丢失直接重发。保持同一宿主的受控实验完成两轮四流程检查，支持会话生命周期这一原因判断。

当前 `rebuild-check` 将会话保持到全部成对流程和即时 view-tree 采集完成；自建会话退出前停止 runner，HTTP 断开时明确提示执行结果未知。两轮独立正式命令（本地案例 `cases/ios17-ictrl-session-fixed-four-flow-run1-20261018`、`cases/ios17-ictrl-session-fixed-four-flow-run2-20261018`）每轮四条末端断言均通过，退出后 runner PID 均为 0；十对截图逐张审阅为轻微差异。原始失败、请求时间线、源码快照和实验记录留在本地 `cases/ios17-ictrl-transport-diagnosis-20261018/`。这是指定设备与选定流程的回归修复，不能替代重启和长期验收；v0.1.1 的发布记录保持原样。

## 尚未完成

- **低优先级：**XR 可选的 DVT 开发者文件列表在 10 月 17 日和 18 日多次返回 `ConnectionTerminatedError`。SSH 包和沙盒采集仍可用，不阻塞主流程。
- **保留恢复机制并观察：**iOS 26 的 iOS MCP 在 10 月 18 日多次独立的 Calculator、Clock 新启动流程中得到黑帧。相关流程均拒绝黑帧，并在有界重新激活后完成。只有恢复失败、黑帧被当作有效证据，或新设备／构建缺少可用替代路径时，再深入排查截图通道。
- 重启／重新越狱后的持续可用性，以及较长时间的界面与后端稳定性，还需专门验证。
- **第二台实体 Mac** 的从零手机配置尚未实测，本轮暂缓。同一台 Mac 上的全新检出与 GitHub 托管 Mac 的无手机安装检查覆盖范围更窄。
- 已通过的选定流程不能证明任意 App 的自主发现、整 App 等价、服务端行为或像素级一致。有些独立工程改自已有源码，应与从零新写工程区分。

### 下一轮验收条件

| 尚待验证 | 完成所需证据 |
| --- | --- |
| iCTRL 会话改动的设备边界 | 指定 iPhone 14 上的多步回归已通过；继续做重启／重新越狱检查，并在其他指定设备上复验本次会话清理改动。 |
| XR 的 DVT 文件列表 | 保留可选路径限制。只有开发者服务变化或新设备确实需要此路径时再调查；SSH 采集已获验证。 |
| 重启／重新越狱后的持续可用性 | 在每台已测手机重启并恢复越狱和服务，重新运行 `doctor`、采集小型案例并完成界面检查；若遇到 iOS 26 黑帧，先确认仍能拒绝并恢复，只有恢复失效时才深入排查截图通道。 |
| 第二台实体 Mac | 从全新检出与 USB 信任开始，按公开安装指南走到 SSH 指纹固定、界面采集、包采集，以及签名或 TrollStore 安装的复刻版。 |
| 更广泛的 App 覆盖 | 对陌生 App 审阅能力清单、带来源报告和明确复刻目标，再做成对流程并列明未知项；少量流程通过不能推导整 App 等价。 |

[图文介绍](articles/copyapp-overview.zh-CN.md)和[系统架构图](assets/architecture-overview.svg)展示当前流程及经过筛选的公开证据示例。底层原始案例仍留在本地。

对可比重试后未再出现的单次故障，只保留原始案例，不长期列为待修问题。上述 iCTRL、DVT 和黑帧现象均曾重复出现；iCTRL 的指定设备回归修复已记录，其余问题按是否阻塞主流程和是否已有可用替代路径排序。

只有打标签并公开发布的版本才编号。[当前计划](../PLAN.md)记录下一阶段的验证工作。原始 IPA、账号数据、沙盒导出与私钥不作为发布资源。

`docs/fidelity.md`:

```md
# Bounded reconstruction quality

The v0.2.0 release adds a reviewed **grade target**, default **80/100**, and
**three implementation/check cycles including the first**. Use 70 for a quick
prototype or 90 for closer detail. This does not measure objective image similarity
or the proportion of an App's known capabilities. Keep coverage and selected-flow
pass rate separate.

The current agent freezes the target after the reviewed report and implementation
task exist, then implements the selected scope directly. Do not keep polishing
after `target_met`. At `iteration_limit`, stop and deliver current runnable artifacts
and remaining gaps as incomplete. Failed build/install/comparison attempts also
consume cycles; inspect uncertain device state before any new operation.

```sh
# TASK is an iOS agent-task case or a Mac rebuild-plan case.
.venv/bin/copyapp fidelity-plan --task <TASK> --out cases/quality-plan
# Optional: --fidelity 70|80|90 --max-iterations 3
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/quality-plan
```

Read its `TASK.md`. Build, install, compare selected flows and review all saved
screenshots using the existing platform commands. For Mac, `--evidence` below is
the verified `mac visual-review` case. For iOS it is the verified `agent-delivery`
case with a complete `visual-review`, including any recorded visual gap.
For a bounded Mac prototype, one paired repetition (`mac check-plan --rounds 1`)
usually provides the initial selected-flow check; repeat only for observed
instability or an explicit reliability requirement. The separate release plan's
three-round acceptance remains a release gate, not three mandatory polishing cycles.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp fidelity-template --plan cases/quality-plan \
  --evidence <EVIDENCE> --out cases/quality-review.json
# Review and fill the JSON; do not use generated scores or hide differences.
.venv/bin/copyapp fidelity-check --plan cases/quality-plan \
  --evidence <EVIDENCE> --review cases/quality-review.json \
  --out cases/quality-cycle-1
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/quality-cycle-1
```

The score is behavior **40%**, layout **40%**, details **20%**. Behavior receives
100 only when all selected flow assertions pass. Layout and details receive explicit
integer reviewer grades with concrete notes and saved image IDs. For example,
behavior 100, layout 80 and details 45 gives **81/100**. It may meet an 80 target
while visibly differing. Reviewer judgments are subjective; verification checks
their source chain, coverage, arithmetic and stopping decision, not their truth.

Every visual difference must retain its original verdict and an explicit blocking
or non-blocking impact with a reason. A major visible content substitution may be
non-blocking for an offline prototype, but cannot disappear from the report.
Wrong source/install identity, incomplete review, uncertain Mac starting state,
image dimension mismatch and failed core assertions prevent target achievement at
every setting. A 100 target additionally requires no recorded image differences.

`fidelity-check.json` and `report.md` record one of:

- `target_met`: the reviewed selected scope meets the grade target; stop polishing.
- `continue`: a further implementation/check cycle remains.
- `iteration_limit`: the target was not met within the budget; stop and disclose gaps.

The command exits 0, 2 or 3 respectively. All three outcomes can form valid
verifiable evidence; only exit 0 means the grade target was met. `copyapp verify`
checks case consistency and does not turn an incomplete result into success.

Only after `continue`, use a new evidence case and `--previous cases/quality-cycle-1`
for the next cycle. Regrading identical evidence cannot consume another cycle.
New Mac builds may use fresh install paths, preserving the same report, source
project, Bundle ID and selected scope. A changed target/scope needs a new plan.
Keep the earlier chain. This counts submitted cycles, not hidden work or a global
wall-clock budget; the agent must also follow the bound while diagnosing failures.

A failed `mac_build`, `mac_install`, `mac_rebuild_check` or iOS `rebuild_check` case
can be submitted as evidence to consume a failed cycle. It receives zero behavior
and visual points, with no verified execution claim. Its grade review must use
zero layout/details and empty image/difference lists. Other incomplete artifacts
remain unsupported. Do not invent a passing visual review for a failed run.

These cases reference retained source cases by absolute path and manifest hash;
keep all those ignored local cases. Creation requires current source to match the
paired build/delivery. Later verification checks saved source evidence, allowing
subsequent implementation changes without rewriting history.

This is the default bounded path for agent-led tasks in this preview.
Historical `mac delivery`, standalone `copy` and `agent-run --verify-rebuild` keep
their strict acceptance rules; a fidelity milestone does not turn an incomplete
strict parent into success. Use stages directly for a bounded current-agent task.
Release, physical-device and capability-coverage gates remain separate. This is
not part of the older stable iOS v0.1.2 release.

## 中文要点

默认 `--fidelity 80 --max-iterations 3`；70 为快速原型，90 为精细档。三轮包含首轮，
与同一版本重复重放三次不同。分数来自选定范围的审阅：行为 40%、布局 40%、细节 20%。
核心流程必须通过，所有截图仍须看过；字体、间距、动画或明确说明的示例内容差异可以记录为
非阻断差异，不再因为存在任何明显视觉差异而无限修正。

先对 iOS `agent-task` 或 Mac `rebuild-plan` 创建 `fidelity-plan`，再使用本平台原有构建、
安装、配对和逐图审阅命令。通过 `fidelity-template` 生成引用准确图片的评分 JSON，人工／
当前 Agent 审阅填写后运行 `fidelity-check`。达标就停止；未达标且轮数耗尽则交付当前可运行
版本、明确标注未达标和剩余问题。下一轮必须引用 `--previous`，失败的构建／安装／对照
也应计入轮数。旧严格交付及其父工作流不会因此被改成通过。

“81 分达到 80 档”不等于“客观相似度 81%”，也不是“整 App 覆盖率 81%”。已知能力的分母、
已验证覆盖、真机／虚拟机范围和所有可见差异继续单独报告。调整目标应新建计划，保留旧记录。

# First-run tasks for a coding agent

[English](first-run-agent.md) · [简体中文](first-run-agent.zh-CN.md)

Open Codex or Claude Code with local command execution on your Mac, then connect and unlock your jailbroken iPhone. You do not need to install Copy APP manually first: the agent can clone the repository, configure the Mac and invoke the CLI. If you already have a checkout, open the agent there. The prompt explicitly reads the repository's [first-use skill](../skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md); no extension or slash-command configuration is required.

## Analyze and rebuild

Replace `<APP NAME OR BUNDLE ID>` and paste this into the agent conversation:

```text
Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp to analyze and rebuild <APP NAME OR BUNDLE ID> on my USB-connected jailbroken iPhone.
Clone into a new directory if needed, or reuse its existing checkout. Read AGENTS.md and skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md first.
Check and configure the environment, identify the exact phone and app, discover representative flows, and complete a cited deep report, a named rebuild target, an independent project, device installation and original/rebuilt comparisons.
Execute the steps you can perform yourself. Tell me the specific action only when you need phone-side participation or missing target information. Deliver the report, project, tested scope and remaining differences.
```

The agent should complete discovery, semantic review and implementation handoffs within this task. A CLI message waiting for an agent or a generated `TASK.md` still requires it to continue. It works in the current session without starting nested Codex or Claude CLIs.

## Analyze only

```text
Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp to analyze <APP NAME OR BUNDLE ID> on my USB-connected jailbroken iPhone. Do not rebuild it in this task.
Clone into a new directory if needed. Read AGENTS.md and skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md first, then check the environment, identify the phone and app, collect evidence and investigate relevant classes/functions.
Deliver a reviewed, cited deep report and feature-spec.json, and verify the case. Distinguish observations, inferences and unknowns; do not stop when survey or analyze/analysis.md has been generated.
```

For a connection check only, replace the deliverable with: “Stop after a verified first USB survey and show its report, screenshot and missing setup.” This route needs USB trust and the foreground app, but no phone-side Copy APP tweak, OpenSSH or Frida. Additional analysis and rebuild prerequisites are in [setup](setup.md).

## What you receive

- The exact device/app identity and verified evidence cases.
- For analysis: a cited deep report and feature specification, beyond the collection index.
- For rebuilding: an independent project, build/install results, same-device paired checks, image-by-image review and measured scope with differences.
- If phone-side prerequisites are missing: the completed Mac work and the specific action you need to take. Unlocking, trust, initial SSH fingerprint checks, permissions or signing access may require your participation.

Keep raw IPAs, screenshots, sandbox data and credentials under ignored local `cases/`. Selected-flow success does not establish whole-app parity; see [coverage targets](coverage-targets.md) and the [named-device limits](current-status.md).

# 交给 Coding Agent 的首次运行任务

[English](first-run-agent.md) · [简体中文](first-run-agent.zh-CN.md)

在 Mac 上打开能执行本地命令的 Codex 或 Claude Code，连接并解锁已越狱的 iPhone。无需先手动安装 Copy APP：把任务交给 Agent，它可以检出仓库、配置 Mac 环境并调用 CLI。已有检出时，在该目录打开 Agent 即可。仓库内的[首次使用 Skill](../skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md)通过提示词明确读取，无需先配置扩展或斜杠命令。

## 分析并复刻

把 `<App 名称或 Bundle ID>` 换成目标后，复制到 Agent 对话中：

```text
请使用 https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp，分析并复刻 USB 连接的越狱 iPhone 上的 <App 名称或 Bundle ID>。
如未检出项目，克隆到一个新目录；已有检出就复用。先阅读 AGENTS.md 和 skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md。
检查和配置环境，识别准确设备与 App，自主发现代表性流程，完成带来源的深度报告、明确的复刻目标、独立工程、真机安装和原版／复刻版对照。
能执行的步骤请直接完成，只在确需手机操作或目标不明确时告诉我具体需要。最终给我报告、工程、实测范围和剩余差异。
```

Agent 应继续完成当前任务中的发现、报告审阅和实现交接；CLI 显示等待 Agent 或生成 `TASK.md` 时，仍需它继续工作。它在当前会话中执行，不再启动嵌套的 Codex／Claude CLI。

## 只做分析

```text
请使用 https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp，分析 USB 连接的越狱 iPhone 上的 <App 名称或 Bundle ID>，这次先不复刻。
如未检出项目，克隆到新目录。先阅读 AGENTS.md 和 skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md，完成环境检查、设备与 App 身份确认、证据采集及相关类／函数调查。
交付经过审阅、有来源引用的深度报告和 feature-spec.json，并校验案例。区分观测、推断与未知；不要在 survey 或 analyze/analysis.md 生成后就结束。
```

只想验证连接时，将交付要求改为“完成并校验首次 USB survey 后停止，给我报告、截图和仍缺少的配置”。这条路径需要 USB 信任和前台 App，不需要手机端 Copy APP tweak、OpenSSH 或 Frida。深度分析和复刻的额外条件见[安装指南](setup.zh-CN.md)。

## 你会得到什么

- 精确设备与 App 身份，以及通过校验的证据案例。
- 分析任务：带来源引用的深度报告和功能规格，而非只有采集索引。
- 复刻任务：独立工程、构建／安装结果、同机成对检查、逐张截图审阅与实际覆盖和差异。
- 缺少手机侧条件时：已完成的 Mac 工作，以及需要你参与的具体操作。解锁、信任、首次 SSH 指纹核对、权限或签名条件可能需要你确认。

原始 IPA、截图、沙盒数据和凭据保留在忽略的本地 `cases/`。选定流程通过不表示整 App 等价；已知能力清单与目标见[覆盖方法](coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)，实测设备边界见[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。

`docs/full-package-decryption.md`:

```md
# Encrypted package recovery for analysis

[English](full-package-decryption.md) · [简体中文](full-package-decryption.zh-CN.md) · [Setup](setup.md)

An App Store bundle may contain encrypted Mach-O executables in the main app and extensions. Copy APP can produce an **analysis IPA** whose indexed executables have `cryptid=0`, then audit exactly which bytes changed. It does not recover the developer's original source or produce a signed installable IPA.

## Path and checks

1. `copyapp acquire` reads the installed bundle over authenticated mobile SSH on the exact USB device and saves a hash-bound snapshot.
2. `scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh` fetches the pinned `londek/ipadecrypt` helper into an external `../toolchains/` directory; it is not vendored in this repository.
3. `copyapp decrypt-package` verifies device, app and snapshot identity. On tested ordinary rootless iOS it starts a bounded root process via Frida; on tested RootHide devices it uses authenticated mobile SSH in the RootHide namespace.
4. The helper uses suspended spawning and `mach_vm_read` to recover each encrypted executable. Copy APP checks length and UUID, audits changes against only the declared encrypted ranges and `cryptid` fields, verifies all unchanged ZIP members, and writes canonical package metadata.
5. The command indexes the recovered IPA and records per-file results. `copyapp verify <DECRYPT_CASE>` rechecks saved identities, hashes, changed-byte audit and package encryption headers.

```sh
sh scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp acquire --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --out cases/<ACQUIRE>
.venv/bin/copyapp decrypt-package --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --snapshot cases/<ACQUIRE>/bundle-snapshot.ipa \
  --out cases/<DECRYPT>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/<DECRYPT>
```

`copyapp analyze --decrypt` composes the recovery with UI survey, bundle acquisition and bounded sandbox indexing. It writes `analysis.md`, which is a collection index; a semantic report still needs reviewed UI/runtime evidence and `copyapp report`.

## Tested scope and limits

Full-package recovery was verified on XR/iOS 16.1.1 for encrypted DeepSeek and Kimi main executables and extensions, and on iPhone 14/iOS 17.3.1 RootHide for the Remoboard main app and keyboard extension. These are specific package builds, not a guarantee for every App or iOS version. Some binaries are already unencrypted; the workflow records an unchanged source snapshot rather than claiming a decrypt operation. The RootHide helper does not require root SSH login. Analysis output, helper logs and extracted data remain in Git-ignored local `cases/`; they are not release assets. Inspect the exact case before reporting recovery success, and keep separate any UI, function or behavioral conclusions.

```

# 用于分析的加密包恢复

[English](full-package-decryption.md) · 简体中文 · [安装指南](setup.zh-CN.md)

App Store 安装包的主 App 和扩展可能包含加密 Mach-O。Copy APP 能生成索引内可执行文件 `cryptid=0` 的**分析 IPA**，并审计究竟修改了哪些字节。它不会恢复开发者原始源码，也不会产出已签名可安装 IPA。

## 路径与核验

1. `copyapp acquire` 经准确 USB 设备上的已认证 mobile SSH 读取安装包，并保存带哈希的快照。
2. `scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh` 将固定版 `londek/ipadecrypt` helper 下载到仓库外的 `../toolchains/`，仓库不打包该 helper。
3. `copyapp decrypt-package` 校验设备、App 和快照身份。已测普通 rootless iOS 通过 Frida 启动有界 root 进程；已测 RootHide 设备经其命名空间内已认证的 mobile SSH 运行。
4. helper 使用暂停启动和 `mach_vm_read` 恢复各加密可执行文件。Copy APP 检查长度与 UUID，仅允许声明的加密区和 `cryptid` 字段变化，核对未改变的 ZIP 成员，并写入规范化包元数据。
5. 命令对恢复后的 IPA 建索引并记录各文件结果。`copyapp verify <DECRYPT_CASE>` 复核来源身份、哈希、字节差异审计及整个包的加密头。

```sh
sh scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp acquire --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --out cases/<ACQUIRE>
.venv/bin/copyapp decrypt-package --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --snapshot cases/<ACQUIRE>/bundle-snapshot.ipa \
  --out cases/<DECRYPT>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/<DECRYPT>
```

`copyapp analyze --decrypt` 会把恢复与界面概览、包采集、有界沙盒索引组合起来，生成采集索引 `analysis.md`；语义报告仍需审阅 UI／运行证据并调用 `copyapp report`。

## 已测范围与边界

整包恢复已在 XR/iOS 16.1.1 的加密 DeepSeek、Kimi 主程序及扩展上，以及 iPhone 14/iOS 17.3.1 RootHide 的 Remoboard 主 App 与键盘扩展上验证。这些结论只适用于指定的安装包构建，不能保证任意 App 或系统可用。有些二进制本就未加密；工作流会记录未改变的来源快照，不宣称发生了解密。RootHide helper 不需要 root SSH 登录。分析产物、helper 日志和导出数据都保存在被 Git 忽略的本地 `cases/`，不作为发布资源。报告恢复成功前须检查准确案例，界面、函数和行为结论需另行建立证据。

## Package storefront provenance follow-up

The verifier re-extracts only the public numeric `s` field from the saved IPA and rejects a changed ID, a fabricated account-region claim or a rehashed format downgrade. Missing/malformed IDs stay unknown; malformed plist structure retains a failed download. Historical package/report/offline cases keep their original validation contract and are not rewritten.

[The two-download comparison](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/storefront-package-comparison.json) binds both case manifests: all four encrypted binaries' hashes, UUIDs and encryption spans match, while the complete IPA hashes differ. This is static package provenance, not loaded phone identity, account-region confirmation or positive recovery. No phone UI replay or privilege change was needed. This satisfies the plan's store-record requirement at the stated package-metadata evidence level; account region remains unverified.

This follow-up passed **475 tests in 53.698 seconds** ([log](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/unit-tests-storefront-final.log)). ## RootHide device recovery correction

After the user requested another Frida check, the [pinned sidecar setup](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/ios17-frida-roothide-recheck/setup.json) confirmed Frida 17.23.3 and 515 enumerated processes on the exact iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1. This reuses the existing isolated RootHide sidecar; enumeration is not itself an attachment or root test. Earlier method traces supply separate attachment evidence.

The [fresh Remoboard 7.1 (7100) snapshot](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/ios17-remoboard-roothide-acquisition/acquisition.json) contains an encrypted main and keyboard extension plus a clear framework. The original [RootHide mobile SSH helper run](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/ios17-remoboard-roothide-decryption/decryption.json) recovered both encrypted programs: 4,079 main and 4,081 extension code bytes changed inside their respective 4,096-byte encrypted spans. Package verification checks all three Mach-O files, unchanged UUIDs/lengths, changes restricted to cryptid and encrypted spans, and unchanged unencrypted members; the helper's precise SC_Info omission remains allowed. This is an analysis package with invalidated signatures, not an installable original or reconstructed source.

Capability model 3 binds a [read-only exact-device helper-route probe](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/ios17-roothide-decrypt-analysis/capabilities/package-recovery-route.json). It permits RootHide mobile SSH recovery even while the independently saved Frida child is UID 501. Ordinary rootless recovery still requires root Frida. The [complete new enhanced collector](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/ios17-roothide-decrypt-analysis/TASK.md) passed acquisition, sandbox indexing, full package recovery and a fresh-launch Remoboard homepage assertion; its decrypted child and parent both verify. The survey and all saved flow screenshots were opened. This tests collection and route selection, without claiming a reviewed deep function report or keyboard-network behavior. Old capability models and retained refusal cases remain verifiable; model downgrades cannot hide a saved route probe.

No separate FairPlay credential was used for this device recovery. A matching account credential is needed only for the independent host offline route in this plan. The iPhone 11 was kept in its user-requested inactive-jailbreak state.

This correction passed **479 tests in 65.865 seconds** ([log](../output/ios-device-support-20261023-7f2a/unit-tests-roothide-routing-unsandboxed.log)), including RootHide readiness without root, ordinary rootless refusal without root, exact-device probe failures, rehashed route tampering/downgrade rejection and resuming an old model-2 refusal through a fresh model-3 probe. ## Formal credential entry and installed-wheel isolation

The subsequent [`credential-retrieve` command](ios-fairplay-credentials.md) replaces the ad hoc adapter for normal use. It checks 33 public source inputs, builds/signs fresh native helpers, binds USB/SSH/native identity, selects an explicit installed App, optionally checks a verified IPA's account and SINF, and saves a new private alias only after SINF validation and remote cleanup. Existing aliases are not overwritten. New `ios_fairplay_credential` cases dispatch explicitly in `copyapp verify`; historical cases retain their validators. Saved verification does not read or hash the private credential.

The [formal live run](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/formal-retrieval/report.md) passed all stages on the same iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 and also validated the selected Remoboard IPA. The [full suite](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/full-unit-tests.log) passed **495 tests in 62.028 seconds**, including 16 new tests for exact identity, account mismatch, changed source, secret-store collision, invalid credential, interrupted observation, cleanup failure, rehashed record/source tampering and wheel SSH defaults. The [installed wheel check](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/installed-wheel-check.json) ran outside the checkout: **125 source resources matched; 50 expected case outcomes matched**. The wheel SHA-256 is `4cfc578fb2ef0a5ae72872752e5ada569f684cb1545548c284456c2bf79c5c93`. A [separate fresh-venv install](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/fresh-wheel-check.log) also passed.

Using the formal alias, the installed wheel then recovered Remoboard's encrypted main and keyboard extension inside macOS `sandbox-exec` with `(deny network*)`. [The probes](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/isolated-offline-check.json) observed denied USBMux socket access, denied device enumeration and denied localhost connectivity. The [offline case](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/remoboard-isolated-offline/report.md) and [cross-check](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/remoboard-isolated-cross-check/report.md) both verify and match the independent device recovery. Both phones were still physically connected during that first isolation run.

The user then physically unplugged both phones. [Fresh inventories](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/disconnected-offline-check.json) observed **zero devices before and after** a separate installed-wheel [offline run](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/remoboard-disconnected-offline/report.md) and [cross-check](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/remoboard-disconnected-cross-check/report.md), additionally protected by the same network-denial sandbox. Both complete recovered programs match the independent device recovery; their package and cross-check cases verify. This closes the physical-disconnection TODO. No iPhone 11 jailbreak activation or phone restart was performed. The PR stays draft and unmerged.

The [final installed-wheel audit](../output/fairplay-credential-ios17-20261023/final-validation.json), expanded with those four additional recovery/comparison cases, matches **all 54 expected case outcomes**, checks private credentials are absent from changed files, and resolves the local Markdown links in the changed documentation without missing targets. Credential values are compared only in memory and are never included in that audit.

## PR review corrections

The next review reproduced three edge cases, now fixed with 12 regressions. `copy --mode auto --agent-provider current` no longer applies the default device-decryption prerequisite to a selected standard route; explicit `analyze`/`prepare-app --mode auto --decrypt` still requires enhanced recovery. Offline recovery, credential preparation with a package, and behavior-report composition reject overlapping resolved source/output trees before creating files, including symlink aliases. UI-first analysis verification now recomputes numeric captures and deltas from linked AX/OCR evidence and checks the saved numeric metadata; cached text or a claimed comparison cannot substitute for the raw observation. Historical v1 and Mac validators are unchanged.

The [full suite](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/full-unit-tests.log) passed **507 tests in 57.369 seconds**. The [installed-wheel check](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/installed-wheel-check.json) matched **125 source resources and all 54 earlier expected case outcomes**, and also ran the **12 new regressions against the installed application modules** outside the checkout. A [fresh-venv installation](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/fresh-wheel-check.log) passed. The tested wheel SHA-256 is `872d561e5de257472e473d315972571ad7accd728cb0c90601cf513cdefa65e6`.

A new installed-wheel [real offline recovery](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/remoboard-offline/report.md) and [cross-check](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/remoboard-cross-check/report.md) still recover both Remoboard programs and match the separately saved device code. Adding these two verified cases brings the [final audit](../output/pr4-review-fixes-20261023/final-check.json) to **56 expected outcomes**, with no credential bytes in changed files. This follow-up uses local host evidence and simulated regression fixtures; it does not rerun phone UI, reactivate a jailbreak or replace the previous physically unplugged acceptance record. The PR remains draft and unmerged.

## Final pre-merge review

The owner subsequently authorized merging PR #4 after another review and passing tests. That review reproduced an additional output-overlap issue: writing a UI delivery inside its analysis/report, or an offline cross-check inside either source, adds files to sealed evidence and invalidates the source and dependent record. Both commands now reject overlapping resolved trees before validating sources or creating output. Two regression tests cover both sources, symlink aliases and preserved source validity; the review regression set now contains 14 tests.

The [full suite](../output/pr4-final-review-20261023/final-unit-tests.log) passed **509 tests in 52.652 seconds**. The [fresh-venv wheel check](../output/pr4-final-review-20261023/fresh-wheel-check.log) also passed. The [installed-wheel audit](../output/pr4-final-review-20261023/installed-check.json) rechecks source resources, historical case outcomes and the review regressions, then repeats real Remoboard recovery and matching-device code comparison with network access denied. Prior physical-disconnection and device UI evidence remains unchanged. The final GitHub CI is checked against the pushed commit before merging; local success alone does not bypass that check.

The published support list must remain narrower than this design until the open gates have actual evidence. No arbitrary-App copy, arbitrary-phone support, private sandbox access on ordinary phones, native function semantics or backend parity follows from these named results.
