`docs/ios-device-support-plan.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# 普通 iPhone 与越狱 iPhone 支持方案

[文档目录](README.zh-CN.md) · [当前能力](current-status.zh-CN.md) · [现有架构](architecture.zh-CN.md)

状态：当前约定的开发与测试范围已完成，2026-10-23；[当前使用与边界](ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md) · [验收账本](ios-device-support-acceptance.md)。P0 动作清单与 P1 单一计算器流程已在 iPhone 11／iOS 26.0.1 越狱未激活状态下完成，不能等同于从未越狱设备验收。真实账号下载 FocusTodo、两条普通 UI 流程、iOS 17.3.1 的新增强采集／方法跟踪、第二命名系统的显式普通模式以及 Mac 既有编辑器回归已经通过。iOS 17 的 Frida 子进程为 UID 501，但 RootHide 的 mobile SSH helper 已实测恢复 Remoboard 主程序和键盘扩展，完整 enhanced --decrypt 入口通过；新检查按 helper 路线判断，普通 rootless 路线仍要求 root Frida。后续已新增正式 `credential-retrieve` 入口，在同一 iOS 17 手机上取得并验证真实凭据；Remoboard 主程序／扩展的离线恢复、独立代码比较及安装后 wheel 的网络／USBMux 隔离运行通过。用户随后拔掉两台手机，执行前后设备列表均为空，安装后 wheel 在附加禁网隔离中完成独立的离线恢复与代码比较；[TODO](../TODO.md) 对应项已完成。用户已明确免除“从未越狱设备实测”这一必验项；现有设备状态说明保留，不再因此阻塞本目标。

Copy APP 将普通 iPhone 作为基础入口：观察原 App、整理可验证的功能规格、独立实现、签名安装，再在同一手机上比较选定流程。越狱 iPhone 在此基础上提供安装包和沙盒采集、设备端解密、运行时视图与函数跟踪。安装包和离线解密凭据作为独立输入，不与手机是否越狱绑定。

首个交付目标是普通手机上的一个完整选定流程闭环。没有原包、没有解密凭据、没有 SSH 或 Frida，都不应阻断这个基础目标。重建范围仍按[覆盖目标](coverage-targets.zh-CN.md)和[保真度里程碑](fidelity.md)冻结；不承诺任意 App 的完整复制。

## 用户路径

| 路径 | 必要输入 | 可交付内容 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 普通手机基础路径 | 配对手机、已安装原 App、可运行的 UI 自动化后端、重建签名环境 | UI 与交互报告、功能规格、独立源码、已安装 App、选定流程比较和视觉审阅 | 不要求原包；不声明原 App 函数语义、私有沙盒或服务端实现 |
| 普通手机加安装包 | 基础路径，以及来源明确的 IPA | 增加包身份、权限声明、资源与库索引；有可信解密代码时可增加函数分析 | 包的分析状态与 UI 观察状态分别记录 |
| 越狱手机增强路径 | 基础路径，以及分别探测通过的 SSH、Frida 或 iOS MCP 等能力 | 按实际能力增加包与沙盒采集、设备端代码恢复、运行时结构、方法跟踪和函数证据 | 越狱标记不等于所有能力可用；每项增强单独验收 |

开发者模式、有效的 runner 签名、设备信任和匹配的开发服务，是普通手机自动化的前置条件。手动截图或录屏可以作为明确标注的补充材料；没有可回放后端时，只能交付观察材料和待验证原型，不能宣称自动化比较已通过。[Appium 真机配置说明](https://appium.github.io/appium-xcuitest-driver/latest/getting-started/device-setup/)

## 设备能力与包能力分开建模

设备负责观察和执行，主机负责分析与构建。能力选择基于本次探测和目标操作，不基于一个全局的“已越狱”布尔值。

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Phone[指定 UDID 的 iPhone] --> Probe[设备与目标 App 能力探测]
    Probe --> UI[UI 观察与回放]
    Probe --> Extra[可用的 SSH Frida 与运行时增强]
    Store[App Store 下载或导入 IPA] --> Package[包身份与静态索引]
    Cred[已有匹配凭据] --> Offline[可选离线解密]
    Package --> Offline
    UI --> Report[审阅报告与功能规格]
    Extra --> Report
    Package --> Report
    Offline --> Report
    Report --> Build[独立实现与开发签名安装]
    Build --> Check[同一手机成对回放与视觉审阅]
```

| 能力 | 普通手机 | 越狱增强 | 实现原则 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| USB 身份与已安装 App 元数据 | 探测配对服务实际返回内容 | 相同 | 固定 UDID、Bundle ID、系统和构建；字段缺失不猜测 |
| 截图、点击、输入、滑动与可访问性树 | 开发签名的 XCTest 后端，需实测 | 可选 iCTRL 或 iOS MCP | 一次回放只由一个后端发送动作 |
| UIKit 类与内部视图对象 | 不作为基础能力 | 通过受支持的进程内采集 | 可访问性树与 UIKit 树使用不同证据类型 |
| 原 App 安装目录与私有沙盒 | 不承诺任意读取 | 经身份校验的 SSH 有界采集 | USB 配对或 DVT 可用不等于拥有任意文件权限 |
| App Store 包下载 | 主机上的账号与许可决定 | 相同 | 与目标手机是否越狱无关 |
| 离线解密 | 已有匹配凭据和受支持格式时可用 | 相同 | 独立主机能力，不标记为普通手机提取能力 |
| 首次获取 FairPlay 凭据 | 基础路径不提供 | 可选的独立准备任务 | 当前上游要求受支持的越狱设备和对应账号的已安装 App |
| 原 App 方法、寄存器与回调跟踪 | 不作为任意商店 App 的基础能力 | 经精确目标校验的 Frida | 自有开发 App 的调试能力不能推导为任意原 App 可附加 |
| 网络观察 | 可观察的行为、错误与受支持的元数据 | 可增加有界运行时观察 | 不默认取得 HTTPS 明文、原服务身份或服务端逻辑 |
| 重建安装与运行 | 开发签名和 USB 安装 | 可选已有 TrollStore 路径 | 原 App 解密包与独立重建的安装包分别存证 |

建议对每项能力记录 `available`、`unavailable`、`not_configured`、`not_probed`、`failed`，以及提供方、作用对象、前置条件、探测时间、源证据和原因。连接失效或恢复会话后，重新探测所需能力；历史成功不能代替当前连接身份。

## 普通手机基础闭环

1. **识别目标。** 列出已连接手机和可见 App，固定精确 UDID 与 Bundle ID。多手机时必须唯一选择；记录屏幕尺寸、系统、语言、文字大小及可获得的版本和构建。
2. **准备 UI 后端。** 优先验证现有 iCTRL 的开发签名、USB 安装和 XCTest 会话路径能否在普通手机工作。验证失败时保留原因，再评估 WDA/XCUITest 适配；首个版本不同时维护两个新的默认后端。普通路径不进入 SSH、TrollStore 或 tweak 安装修复。
3. **发现代表流程。** Agent 观察原 App，保存有起始状态、动作、截图检查点和最终行为断言的有界 playbook。复用现有流程格式和 `discover-check` 的适用规则；新增后端必须通过同样的动作和断言契约。
4. **审阅规格。** 依据 UI 证据编写行为报告与 `feature-spec.json`，保留流程脚本哈希。持久化通过退出重启后观察验证；没有私有数据证据时，不写成已知数据库结构。
5. **独立实现。** 冻结已知能力清单、选定范围和保真度目标，构建自有 Bundle ID 的 App，通过有效开发签名安装。没有签名条件时可以交付源码和构建诊断，设备交付仍标记未完成。
6. **成对验收。** 在同一手机、同一后端及等价起始状态下执行原版和重建版，验证每个选定流程的行为断言并审阅全部截图对。沿用现有保真度停止规则；严格交付仍要求其原有完整条件。

普通路径报告明确分为“直接观察”“推断”“未知”。UI 证据可以支持用户行为规格；函数结论仍必须有对应代码和推理依据。没有函数证据时，不把基础报告包装成深度函数报告。

若原 App 使用账号、云服务或不可访问的付费状态，在能力清单中保留这些依赖。独立实现若使用自有服务或模拟数据，应在相关能力和最终交付中标明，不能据此认定原服务等价。

## 可选安装包与离线代码分析

`ipatool` 提供商店包获取入口，用户也可导入已有 IPA。下载固定工具版本或 commit，并保存 Bundle ID、商店、请求版本、实际版本与构建、平台、时间、包哈希及来源类型。工具当前不支持购买付费 App；付费目标需要先拥有许可，下载和历史版本供应仍由服务端决定。[下载接口](https://github.com/majd/ipatool/blob/main/cmd/download.go)、[许可获取实现](https://github.com/majd/ipatool/blob/main/pkg/appstore/appstore_purchase.go)

没有凭据时，继续提供资源、元数据和可读取部分的索引；加密函数保留为不可分析。已有匹配 credential 时，可选调用固定版本的 `fairplay-decrypt`。当前支持范围包括 ARM64、SUPF v3/v5 和特定 SINF 记录格式；首次取得 credential 仍依赖上游支持的越狱设备。凭据准备与普通手机任务分开，不把它设为基础闭环的隐含前置条件。[格式范围](https://github.com/EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt#readme)、[凭据前置条件](https://github.com/EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt/blob/main/credential-retrieval/README.md)

解密结果至少经过以下独立检查：

- 先索引输入包的全部 Mach-O 与架构，再与工具实际处理列表比较，发现漏掉的加密程序或不支持的切片；部分成功不能写成整包成功。上游入口按 SUPF 建立处理列表，不能仅凭退出码判断包级完整性。[解密入口](https://github.com/EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt/blob/main/decrypt.py)
- 校验包成员、二进制长度与 UUID，并审计变更是否仅发生在允许的加密区域和加密标记；未涉及资源保持一致。支持范围与现有 thin ARM64 审计不一致时明确拒绝或标记部分结果，不能跳过检查。
- 检查输出全部相关 Mach-O 的加密标记。标记清零与字节变更只说明结构条件成立，不能单独证明明文正确。记录解密字节可信度；正式验证样本应与精确匹配构建的设备恢复代码或独立运行证据交叉核对。
- 保留输入输出哈希、工具版本、命令的脱敏参数、每个程序的结果和失败原因。输出为分析包，不直接作为已签名可安装 App。

凭据只从本地忽略的凭据存储通过不透明引用读取，不进入任务正文、报告、日志或 Git；账号会话、下载地址中的令牌及 SINF 也按敏感材料管理。上游工具的 root SSH、单设备假设不能直接绕过本项目的精确 UDID、端口和主机密钥校验；不支持当前设备路由时报告缺失条件。

## 包证据与手机观察的关联

包下载与 UI 采集可以发生在不同时间、不同设备。为每个来源保留自己的身份和时间，避免把离线代码、旧手机跟踪和新手机界面写成同一观察窗口。

| 关联程度 | 允许的结论 |
| --- | --- |
| 只有 Bundle ID 相同 | 同一产品线索，不能关联具体版本函数 |
| 版本和构建相同 | 元数据相符；设备变体和架构仍可能不同 |
| 相关架构、Mach-O UUID 与代码身份进一步核对 | 按实际匹配范围引用代码，声明核对方法 |
| 原始入口与实际加载模块绑定，并有对应步骤的运行命中 | 可以支持该设备、构建和观察窗口的运行结论，仍不能仅凭时间重合断言因果 |

普通手机无法取得足够二进制身份时，保留“商店包静态结论”和“手机 UI 观察”两条证据线，明确关联强度。旧版本包可以作为研究线索，不能替代新版本的函数证据。跨设备补充材料不能冒充现有同设备报告合并或严格交付。

## CLI 与证据模型改造

下表保留设计目标；已落地的显式模式、包适配器与使用方法见[开发分支说明](ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md)，其余验收条件不因新增命令而自动通过。

设备操作继续使用显式 `--udid` 和 `--bundle`。拟加入 `--mode auto|standard|enhanced`：`standard` 的基础任务不执行越狱专用采集；`enhanced` 依据请求操作检查所需增强能力；`auto` 只选择已探测可用的路线。用户要求函数跟踪而能力缺失时，返回具体阻塞原因，不静默换成 UI 成功。

| 模块 | 当前约束 | 拟议修改 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [onboarding](../copyapp/onboarding.py) 与 [doctor](../copyapp/doctor.py) | 分析与重建就绪条件绑定 SSH、Frida、iOS MCP | 按任务检查 UI 观察、包分析、运行跟踪和签名交付所需能力；区分主机工具就绪与设备闭环就绪 |
| [UI 后端](../copyapp/ictrl_setup.py) | 有 USB 安装和 XCTest 路径，但普通手机尚需命名设备验证 | 增加明确的普通设备路线和签名诊断，复用会话保活、动作完成未知及清理逻辑 |
| [分析编排](../copyapp/analyze.py) | 原包、沙盒与解密采集面向 SSH 工作流 | 新编排将 UI 设为基础阶段，包和运行证据设为可选阶段，记录缺失项及恢复点 |
| 商店获取与离线恢复 | 尚未接入两个上游工具 | 独立适配器与 case 类型；固定工具身份、来源与脱敏记录，不复用设备端恢复的成功身份 |
| [报告](../copyapp/report.py) 与功能规格 | 现有来源校验依赖采集 case 及其原包 | 增加 UI 行为报告和独立包来源的明确契约；未观测的函数、沙盒、网络字段允许带理由缺失 |
| [校验](../copyapp/verify.py) 与交付 | 历史 case 有固定来源和严格门槛 | 新增显式版本或 case kind 分派；旧 v1 校验语义、来源绑定及严格交付规则保持原样 |

新 case 格式应包含：实际执行模式、能力探测来源、设备/App 身份、每阶段状态、包来源、UI 后端、输入脚本哈希、缺失证据、结论适用范围和恢复记录。具体 schema 在 P0/P1 固定，格式版本升级不能自动给旧证据补出新能力。

流程阶段使用 `complete`、`skipped_optional`、`blocked`、`failed` 等明确状态。阶段完成、任务目标完成与整体交付分别判断：基础任务可在明确跳过可选增强后完成；深度任务缺少必需函数证据则仍阻塞。无法确认 tap 是否执行时，先观察当前状态，再决定恢复动作，不自动重发。

## 实施顺序与验收

| 阶段 | 交付范围 | 必须通过的验收 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P0 普通手机可行性 | 固定一台未越狱真机；验证已有 iCTRL 的开发签名路线，必要时再选 WDA | 记录精确设备、iOS、Xcode、签名与 runner 版本；无 SSH、Frida、TrollStore，完成身份核对、启动、截图、树、点击、输入、滑动、断言、会话结束和退出清理；至少覆盖一个非自有 App 的可访问流程 |
| P1 基础分析到重建 | 能力探测、新编排、UI 报告、新 case 校验和签名安装闭环 | 未提供 IPA 或 credential 时，完成一个独立重建和同机成对比较；审阅全部截图并按既定目标交付；缺少签名、runner 失效、身份不符和动作回复丢失有明确失败或恢复结果 |
| P2 商店包与离线分析 | `ipatool` 下载、IPA 导入、可选离线恢复、静态证据绑定 | 分别验证无凭据、有效凭据、错误凭据、主程序及扩展、格式不支持、残留加密程序、包版本不符；为可比的精确构建交叉核对恢复代码；在断开越狱设备后完成一次使用已有凭据的离线恢复 |
| P3 越狱增强与组合 | 原包和沙盒采集、设备端恢复、Frida/运行时证据接入新编排 | 原有命名设备回归；基础 UI 任务在增强不可用时仍可完成，明确请求的深度操作则准确阻塞；跨设备、跨构建证据混入被拒绝 |
| P4 兼容性与发布 | 引导、技能和双语说明；旧新格式兼容；独立安装包检查 | 第二台普通手机或另一个明确系统组合的回归；旧 v1 成功、失败及篡改样本仍按原规则校验；按能力公布命名设备支持范围 |

用户最初延后 P2，随后授权复用现有 iOS 17 手机，并将凭据提取接入正式流程。`credential-retrieve`、真实离线解密、独立代码比较和安装后 wheel 的网络／USBMux 全隔离恢复均已通过；两台手机物理拔线后的独立重跑也通过，执行前后设备列表为空，见 [TODO](../TODO.md) 与[验收账本](ios-device-support-acceptance.md)。P1 的普通手机闭环是首个产品里程碑，不以 P2 为隐含前置。P0 若现有 iCTRL 路线不可行，先固定替代后端及其依赖，再推进 P1；不能用越狱手机上的 XCTest 成功代替 P0。

实施中的代码检查应覆盖能力路由、阶段恢复、身份绑定、脱敏、格式升级和旧校验回归。真实设备验收分别保存原版、重建版、安装、比较、视觉审阅及交付 case，并对每个 case 执行 `.venv/bin/copyapp verify`。不为规划文档本身创建虚构设备 case。

## 交付口径与支持边界

每次交付分别说明观察依据、可用代码证据、选定功能、已验证结果、缺失与未知项，以及测试手机和构建。已知能力覆盖率、选定流程通过率和保真度评分分别报告；没有能力清单分母时，只报告具名范围。

本方案扩展 iOS 路径。macOS 继续使用独立的 `copyapp mac` 命令和 ChatComputer 环境身份；`ipatool` 能下载 macOS PKG 不构成 iOS 离线解密路线已支持 Mac App 的证据。

当前能力以[已发布状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)为准。普通手机支持、商店获取和离线解密须分别通过上述验收后，才能加入支持列表。

```md
# Prepare a FairPlay credential for offline iOS IPA analysis

[中文说明](#中文说明) · [standard/enhanced modes](ios-standard-mode.md) · [acceptance ledger](ios-device-support-acceptance.md)

`credential-retrieve` prepares a reusable account credential from one explicitly selected jailbroken iPhone and an installed App Store App. The later `decrypt-offline` command runs on the Mac using local files. Standard-mode UI collection does not need this preparation or a credential.

The phone's App and the IPA must belong to the same account. An ipatool login alone does not supply this credential. A successful run validates the recovered value against the installed App's SINF; passing `--package-case` also checks the selected IPA's account and SINF before publishing the credential.

## First preparation

Use Xcode's iPhoneOS SDK, `make`, `ldid`, the optional Python cryptography dependency, and the pinned upstream sources:

```sh
sh scripts/bootstrap-ios-host-tools.sh --offline
.venv/bin/python -m pip install '.[offline]'
```

The phone must already be paired and jailbroken, with a verified SSH key and pinned host key. Follow [setup](setup.md) / `copyapp onboard` for a new device. This command never changes SSH authentication or installs a jailbreak. Specify the exact device and installed App; it does not select the first connected phone or first App.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp credential-retrieve \
  --udid <JAILBROKEN_DEVICE_UDID> --bundle <INSTALLED_APP_BUNDLE> \
  --credential-ref <NEW_LOCAL_ALIAS> \
  --package-case cases/store-package \
  --out cases/credential-preparation
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/credential-preparation
```

`--package-case` is optional and must be a verified package for the same Bundle ID. If the IPA contains multiple license selectors, use `--sinf-member <EXACT_ZIP_MEMBER>` to select one. The installed App and package may have different versions; successful license validation establishes the credential's applicability, not matching installed code. Use separate package/device code checks for that claim.

The output must be a new directory in a separate tree from the package case. Nested outputs, including symlink aliases into the package case, are rejected before creating files or contacting the phone. `decrypt-offline` and behavior-report composition enforce the same source/output separation.

Per-device SSH profiles are reused. Explicit `--ssh-port`, `--ssh-identity` and `--ssh-known-hosts` override them. The default SSH user is `mobile`; the named RootHide iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 passed through that route. `--ssh-user root` is available for an existing verified root-key route, without automatic authentication fallback. This does not establish support for every jailbreak, phone or iOS version.

The command checks 33 public upstream source hashes at revision `1bad106ee1698c6d9c483f67d898183ffa4c6eb3`, copies only those inputs and rebuilds/signs the native helpers. It verifies USB, authenticated SSH and native FairPlay device identities, observes a bounded FairPlay daemon restart using a temporary App copy, validates SINF decoding, and removes remote temporary files before saving. The original App is not replaced. Build products already present in the upstream checkout are not trusted or reused.

Credentials use opaque aliases, remain in the ignored private store, and are created with mode 0600 under a 0700 directory. Existing aliases are never overwritten. The evidence case contains stage results, public tool provenance and optional package evidence; it excludes credential bytes, their hash, the actual storage path and raw account/session output. Verification checks saved provenance and record consistency without reading the credential or certifying the truth of every runtime observation. Failed cases are retained with a fixed error code.

## Later use on the Mac

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp decrypt-offline --package cases/store-package \
  --credential-ref <LOCAL_ALIAS> --out cases/offline-package
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/offline-package
.venv/bin/copyapp offline-cross-check --offline cases/offline-package \
  --device <VERIFIED_MATCHING_DEVICE_RECOVERY> --out cases/offline-cross-check
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/offline-cross-check
```

Offline recovery audits every program and resource. Structural success alone is not proof of correct plaintext. `offline-cross-check` compares all recovered programs—including extensions—with independently verified device recovery of matching encrypted code, UUIDs and encryption spans. An analysis IPA has changed signatures and is not claimed installable.

For an installed wheel invoked outside the checkout, set `COPYAPP_SOURCE_ROOT` to the checkout containing the ignored toolchains, SSH profiles and credential store. Explicit tool, store and SSH paths remain available. A custom credential store must be outside the evidence case; protect and exclude it from version control separately.

## 中文说明

首次获取用 `credential-retrieve`，后续在 Mac 上用 `decrypt-offline`。普通模式的 UI 采集不需要做这一步。

手机上选定的 App 和待分析 IPA 必须属于同一个账号。`--package-case` 可提前核对账号并验证该 IPA 的授权；只有登录 ipatool 不等于已经有凭据。出现多个授权选择时，用 `--sinf-member` 指定准确的 ZIP 成员。

默认沿用准确手机已验证的 mobile SSH 路由，本次 iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 RootHide 已通过；不能把这一结果推广到任意越狱环境。需要 root 的既有环境可显式传 `--ssh-user root`，命令不会猜密码、自动换用户或改 SSH 设置。

凭据使用新的本地别名，不覆盖旧文件，不写进报告或 Git。`verify` 检查证据一致性；要判断代码恢复是否正确，还应运行同构建设备结果的 `offline-cross-check`。首次获取与后续离线恢复的命名设备实测和剩余边界见[验收账本](ios-device-support-acceptance.md)。

# Standard iPhone mode

[中文](ios-standard-mode.zh-CN.md) · [Design and acceptance gates](ios-device-support-plan.zh-CN.md)

The latest `main` checkout supports explicit `--mode standard|auto|enhanced` routes. Unflagged historical iOS commands retain their existing contracts. This route is merged into `main` and is newer than the tagged v0.2.0 release; use the current source checkout. macOS continues to use `copyapp mac` and ChatComputer identities.

For `copy --mode auto --agent-provider current`, the default device-decryption setting applies only when the selected route is enhanced. Standard fallback does not require `--no-decrypt`. An explicit `analyze` or `prepare-app --mode auto --decrypt` request still selects enhanced mode and requires device recovery.

The named standard-mode sample is an iPhone 11 (`iPhone12,1`) on iOS 26.0.1, after an authorized reboot left its jailbreak inactive. SSH, Frida and iOS MCP were unavailable. It has previous jailbreak files and is not a pristine never-jailbroken device. A development-signed iCTRL runner was installed over USB; a selected Calculator addition flow was observed, independently implemented, signed, installed and compared on that same phone. Both screenshot pairs were reviewed; minor differences remain. The bounded fidelity milestone reached 87.4/100 in its first cycle. This is a selected-scope reviewer grade, separate from capability coverage and whole-App parity. The iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 also passed an explicit standard-mode fixture flow while its RootHide services remained active; this adds a named system regression, not pristine ordinary-device acceptance.

The user waived a separate never-jailbroken phone test for this goal. The recorded device histories remain evidence boundaries and no longer block this goal’s completion.

Use the repository virtual environment. Confirm the exact UDID and Bundle ID, Developer Mode, pairing/trust, Xcode and a valid development signing profile. A green heartbeat permits an attempt; it does not establish working XCTest actions or profile coverage.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp devices
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard --udid <UDID> --stage analyze --mode standard --out cases/standard-onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp setup ictrl --help
```

For the runner's normal signed installation, use the setup command's explicit `--transport usb`. This route never falls back to TrollStore or SSH. Prepare a signed runner IPA for the named device using the existing iCTRL setup instructions. Standard playbooks own a fresh XCTest session on the tested iOS 26 route and stop their runner on exit; screenshots come from the exact USB device. A black launch frame receives a bounded Home/activation recovery before flow actions. An uncertain action reply is retained as a failure, without automatic tap replay.

For supplied flows:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp analyze --mode standard --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE> \
  --script <FLOW.json> --out cases/standard-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/standard-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp report --case cases/standard-analysis --findings <REVIEWED.json> \
  --feature-spec <SPEC.json> --out cases/standard-report
.venv/bin/copyapp analysis-delivery --task cases/standard-analysis \
  --report cases/standard-report --out cases/standard-analysis-delivery
```

`prepare-app --mode standard` uses the same UI-first collector. Collection produces `TASK.md`, not a completed report. Review every screenshot and raw observation, distinguish observed/inferred/unknown claims, retain each `source_script_sha256`, and provide post-action assertions. The new `ios_behavior_report` and `ios_behavior_delivery` formats do not certify native functions or sandbox structure. Enhanced function analysis uses the existing explicit investigation and deep-report workflow.

The current coding agent can keep one resumable parent:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --mode standard --agent-provider current \
  --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE> --rebuilt-bundle <OWN_BUNDLE> \
  --auto-discover --output-dir output/<UNIQUE_JOB>
```

It writes handoff tasks and returns an incomplete status until their evidence exists. For discovery, author and inspect 3–12 distinct bounded flows, then run `discover-check --mode standard --backend ictrl` at the task's specified path. Supplied `--script` or an accepted `--discovery` case can replace `--auto-discover`. Resume with the same flags and exact job directory plus `--resume`. No nested agent CLI is launched. Do not retry an uncertain failed flow until its UI state is reviewed; `--resume --retry-failed` explicitly archives and retries failed analysis flows. Failed discovery replay requires its own review and a new case.

Resuming a failed collection takes a new capability probe before any action and keeps it under `capability-checks/`. An unavailable or changed route blocks replay; it does not overwrite the original capability snapshot or silently switch backends. If the same route is repaired, its newly accepted probe determines readiness, so an initially missing channel does not permanently prevent resume. Completed cases can be verified and reused without touching the phone. Enhanced CLI requests additionally pin device-decryption intent, survey backend, SSH route references and helper identity. Changing those inputs requires a new case. Enhanced survey, acquired IPA metadata, sandbox and any recovered package must match the live App version/build and saved device/system identity; an old build is rejected even if its stage success flags and hashes are valid.

Complete the report and analysis-delivery at the pinned paths, then follow `rebuild-preparation/task/TASK.md`. Freeze known capabilities and the fidelity milestone before implementation. Build an independent source tree with its own Bundle ID; standard mode requires development signing and `install --transport usb`. Run paired checks, inspect every screenshot pair, and create visual-review and agent-delivery without `--run`. The parent retains strict completion gates: a bounded fidelity milestone alone does not complete it. Omitted capabilities remain explicit.

Capability model 3 checks the package helper's actual route over authenticated exact-device SSH. RootHide uses its existing mobile SSH helper and does not require a root Frida child or an offline FairPlay credential. Ordinary rootless recovery still requires full Frida plus a successful UID-0 suspended-child probe; App tracing alone does not establish root. On the named iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1, Frida spawns UID 501, yet the RootHide helper recovered Remoboard's encrypted main and keyboard extension and the complete `analyze --mode enhanced --decrypt` collector passed. The resulting analysis IPA has modified signatures and is not asserted installable. Standard mode skips both jailbreak probes. Historical models 1 and 2 retain their saved contracts; model 2's blanket root gate prematurely refused this RootHide route and must not be interpreted as proof that recovery was impossible. See the [route correction and evidence](ios-device-support-acceptance.md#roothide-device-recovery-correction).

Host-side package inputs are optional and independent of phone privilege:

```sh
sh scripts/bootstrap-ios-host-tools.sh --all
# Authenticate interactively in the user's terminal; never put a password or token in a task.
toolchains/bin/ipatool auth login
.venv/bin/copyapp store-download --bundle <BUNDLE> --out cases/store-package
.venv/bin/copyapp package-import --ipa <FILE.ipa> --bundle <BUNDLE> --out cases/imported-package
.venv/bin/copyapp decrypt-offline --package cases/imported-package \
  --credential-ref <LOCAL_ALIAS> --out cases/offline-package
```

Check `--help` for exact arguments. `ipatool` is pinned to v2.7.0; FairPlay sources are pinned to commit `1bad106ee1698c6d9c483f67d898183ffa4c6eb3` and checked by four source hashes. Download records bind the executable hash/version, requested identity and actual package metadata. License acquisition requires explicit `--acquire-license`. Raw account output is not retained. An authenticated download of free FocusTodo 1.0.4 (4) now has named evidence in the acceptance ledger. Its two standard-mode UI flows passed on the inactive-jailbreak iPhone 11; its main/framework/Widget code remains encrypted. Tool installation alone establishes neither authentication nor download, and login is not a matching offline credential.

New downloads use `download_provenance_version: 2` to retain only the six-digit storefront ID from `iTunesMetadata.plist` field `s`, with basis `downloaded_package_metadata`. The verifier rereads that field from the saved IPA; missing/malformed identifiers remain unknown, and no account name, Apple ID or session output is copied to the record. This does not independently verify the account region. Historical records keep their old string/validation contract. FocusTodo's fixed external version `893656071` was downloaded again and matched, recording package storefront `143465`; the four encrypted binary hash/UUID/span records agree with the earlier download, while the whole IPA hashes differ. Neither comparison identifies loaded phone bytes.

For a wheel invoked outside the checkout, set `COPYAPP_SOURCE_ROOT` to the checkout containing these ignored toolchains and credential stores. Default ipatool, FairPlay source and credential lookup use that root, rather than the shell's current directory; explicit tool/store paths still override it.

Use the separate [`credential-retrieve` preparation step](ios-fairplay-credentials.md) on a supported jailbroken phone to create a matching local credential alias. It verifies the exact USB/SSH/native identity, selected App license and optional IPA account, builds pinned helpers, validates SINF decoding and cleans up before saving. RootHide mobile SSH passed on the named iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1; an ordinary phone cannot supply this credential through that route. Standard UI collection never invokes it automatically. Credentials remain only in the ignored private store; contents, hash and actual storage path are excluded from evidence. Existing aliases are never overwritten.

Offline recovery audits all binaries and resources and currently accepts audited thin ARM64 encrypted inputs. FAT inputs are rejected. Structural success is labelled `structural_only`, not verified plaintext; an already unencrypted package is unchanged passthrough and never claimed as decryption. Real Remoboard main/keyboard-extension recovery and independent matching-code comparison have passed, including an installed-wheel run after both phones were physically unplugged, with empty device lists before and after. See the [acceptance ledger](ios-device-support-acceptance.md) and completed [TODO](../TODO.md).

The package index also records unsupported 32-bit/swapped-endian Mach-O programs and programs outside the primary App. These inputs can retain static package evidence but block full offline recovery. All FAT inputs are rejected, including those whose selected ARM64 slice is already clear, because other slices have not been audited.

`offline-cross-check --offline <OFFLINE_CASE> --device <VERIFIED_DEVICE_DECRYPT_CASE> --out <NEW_CASE>` compares every recovered program, including extensions, against a verified historical `decrypted_package`. It requires matching version/build, encrypted-byte hash, UUID, encryption span and recovered-byte hash. This separate case retains both collection identities; it does not change the original offline `structural_only` label or make different-time observations simultaneous. It requires a real positive offline sample for device acceptance.

Pass repeated `--package-case` to UI-first analyze/prepare-app/copy to attach verified package evidence. Another Bundle ID is rejected; different versions remain `bundle_only`, while matching version/build is `metadata_match`. Neither establishes the installed runtime binary identity. Cite `package.1` etc. with finding `basis: "package"`; UI findings cite their flow IDs. Runtime and code claims require their own matching evidence.

Keep raw packages, license files, screenshots and traces ignored and local. Run `copyapp verify` on every case. New v2 iOS kinds dispatch explicitly; they never fall back to a legacy report filename. The implementation plan's remaining live-device, real-credential and regression gates still apply.

UI-first analysis verification recomputes `capture_number` and `compare_number` from source-linked AX or OCR records, including the saved numeric values and requested delta. Cached visible text or a claimed successful comparison is insufficient. Historical v1 validation rules remain unchanged. When recovering a package, preparing a credential from a package, or composing a behavior report, use separate source/output directory trees; nested paths and aliases into the source are rejected before output creation.

# 普通 iPhone 模式

[English](ios-standard-mode.md) · [方案与验收条件](ios-device-support-plan.zh-CN.md)

最新 `main` 检出支持显式 `--mode standard|auto|enhanced`。未加模式的历史 iOS 命令保留原有契约。此路线已合入 `main`，晚于标签版本 v0.2.0；使用时请检出当前源码。macOS 继续使用独立 `copyapp mac` 命令和 ChatComputer 身份。

`copy --mode auto --agent-provider current` 的默认设备解密设置只在选中增强路线时适用；回退到普通模式无需另传 `--no-decrypt`。显式的 `analyze` 或 `prepare-app --mode auto --decrypt` 仍选择增强模式并要求设备恢复。

已测普通模式样本是 iPhone 11（`iPhone12,1`）／iOS 26.0.1：经用户授权重启后，SSH、Frida 和 iOS MCP 不可用。手机有历史越狱文件，属于“越狱未激活”，不能视作从未越狱的干净手机。已通过 USB 安装开发签名 iCTRL runner，完成系统计算器加法的观察、独立实现、签名安装和同机对照；两对截图均已审阅，保留轻微差异。首轮达到 87.4/100 的有界保真度目标；这是选定范围的审阅评分，与能力覆盖率和整 App 等价分别报告。iPhone 14／iOS 17.3.1 也通过了显式普通模式的自有测试 App 流程，但其已有 RootHide 服务保持运行；这增加了一个命名系统回归，不能替代从未越狱设备的兼容性验收。

用户已明确免除本目标中“从未越狱手机另行实测”的必验项；以上设备历史仍如实保留，不再作为本目标的完成阻塞。

使用仓库 `.venv/bin/copyapp`，固定 UDID 与 Bundle ID。先确认配对、信任、开发者模式、Xcode 和覆盖该设备的有效开发签名。心跳成功只表示可以尝试，不能证明 XCTest 动作或签名安装可用。

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp devices
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard --udid <UDID> --stage analyze --mode standard --out cases/standard-onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp setup ictrl --help
```

按现有 iCTRL 安装说明准备覆盖该设备的签名 runner IPA，安装明确指定 `--transport usb`；失败不会回退到 TrollStore 或 SSH。在已测 iOS 26 路线上，普通模式回放创建并清理自己的 XCTest 会话，通过准确 USB 设备截图。启动黑屏只在业务动作前进行有界 Home／激活恢复；动作回复丢失不会自动重发点击。

已有流程时：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp analyze --mode standard --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE> \
  --script <FLOW.json> --out cases/standard-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/standard-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp report --case cases/standard-analysis --findings <REVIEWED.json> \
  --feature-spec <SPEC.json> --out cases/standard-report
.venv/bin/copyapp analysis-delivery --task cases/standard-analysis \
  --report cases/standard-report --out cases/standard-analysis-delivery
```

`prepare-app --mode standard` 也使用这个 UI 优先采集器。采集结束仅生成 `TASK.md`，不是正式报告。当前 Agent 审阅全部截图和可访问性原始观察，区分直接观察、推断和未知；每条规格保留 `source_script_sha256` 和最后动作后的行为断言。新增 `ios_behavior_report`、`ios_behavior_delivery` 只核验行为与来源；函数语义和私有沙盒仍走已有显式增强调查与深度报告流程。

需要一个可恢复父工作流时：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp copy --mode standard --agent-provider current \
  --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE> --rebuilt-bundle <OWN_BUNDLE> \
  --auto-discover --output-dir output/<UNIQUE_JOB>
```

命令在交接点返回未完成状态，当前会话继续任务。发现阶段观察原 App，编写 3–12 条不同的有界流程，在指定路径执行 `discover-check --mode standard --backend ictrl`。已有 `--script` 或已接受的 `--discovery` 可以替代 `--auto-discover`。恢复必须保留全部参数和准确任务目录，再加 `--resume`；不会启动嵌套 Coding Agent。未确认动作是否完成时先审阅设备状态；`--resume --retry-failed` 明确归档并重试失败的分析流程。发现重放失败仍需审阅并创建新案例。

失败采集恢复前会重新探测所需能力，保留在 `capability-checks/`；服务失效或路线改变时停止重放，不覆盖初次探测，也不静默切换后端。同一路线修复后，以新接受的探测判断就绪，初次缺失的能力不会使恢复永久阻塞。完整案例的校验与复用不再操作手机。增强 CLI 请求另外固定设备端解密意图、survey 后端、SSH 路由引用与 helper 身份，更改这些输入需要新案例。增强 survey、采集 IPA 元数据、沙盒及可选恢复包都必须与本次 App 版本／构建和设备／系统身份匹配；即使旧构建的成功标记和哈希有效，也会拒绝混入。

按指定路径完成报告和 analysis-delivery，再继续 `rebuild-preparation/task/TASK.md`。实现前固定能力清单与保真度目标；独立源码使用自己的 Bundle ID，普通模式开发签名并通过 `install --transport usb` 安装。完成原版／重建版成对断言、全部截图审阅、visual-review 和不带 `--run` 的 agent-delivery。父工作流仍按严格门槛完成，单独达到有界保真度目标不能替代它；延后能力必须保留。

能力模型 3 通过认证且核对准确 USB 身份的 SSH 探测 helper 实际路线。RootHide 沿用 mobile SSH helper，不要求 root Frida 子进程，也不要求离线 FairPlay 凭据；普通 rootless 路线仍需完整 Frida 与成功的 UID 0 暂停子进程探测，App 跟踪能力本身不证明 root。上述 iPhone 14／iOS 17.3.1 的 Frida 子进程为 UID 501，但 RootHide helper 已恢复 Remoboard 主程序和键盘扩展的加密代码，完整 `analyze --mode enhanced --decrypt` 采集入口也已通过。产出的分析 IPA 签名已改变，不声明可安装。普通模式跳过这两项越狱探测。历史模型 1、2 保留原校验；模型 2 把 root 条件套用到全部路线，曾过早拒绝此 RootHide 路线，不能据此判断无法解密。详见[路线修正与实测证据](ios-device-support-acceptance.md#roothide-device-recovery-correction)。

安装包与手机权限分开处理，可选使用：

```sh
sh scripts/bootstrap-ios-host-tools.sh --all
# 用户在本机终端交互登录，密码和令牌不要进入任务或对话。
toolchains/bin/ipatool auth login
.venv/bin/copyapp store-download --bundle <BUNDLE> --out cases/store-package
.venv/bin/copyapp package-import --ipa <FILE.ipa> --bundle <BUNDLE> --out cases/imported-package
.venv/bin/copyapp decrypt-offline --package cases/imported-package \
  --credential-ref <LOCAL_ALIAS> --out cases/offline-package
```

具体参数以 `--help` 为准。`ipatool` 固定 v2.7.0，FairPlay 固定 commit `1bad106ee1698c6d9c483f67d898183ffa4c6eb3` 并检查四个源文件哈希。下载记录工具哈希／版本、请求身份与实际包元数据；许可获取必须显式 `--acquire-license`，不保留原始账号日志。真实登录后已成功下载免费的 FocusTodo 1.0.4（4），并在上述越狱未激活的 iPhone 11 上通过两条普通模式 UI 流程；主程序、框架和 Widget 仍有加密。工具安装本身不证明登录或下载，登录成功也不等于已有匹配的离线凭据。

新下载使用 `download_provenance_version: 2`，仅从 IPA 的 `iTunesMetadata.plist` 字段 `s` 提取六位商店编号，明确标为 `downloaded_package_metadata`。校验器从保存的 IPA 重读该值；缺失或格式异常时保留未知，不把姓名、Apple ID 或账号会话输出复制到记录中。这不等于独立确认账号地区，旧记录仍按原字符串格式校验。真实再次下载 FocusTodo 的固定外部版本 `893656071` 已匹配，记录包内商店编号 `143465`；四个加密程序的哈希、UUID 和加密范围均与前次一致，整个 IPA 哈希不同。两者都不能证明手机加载的代码字节身份。

从源码目录外运行 wheel 时，把 `COPYAPP_SOURCE_ROOT` 设为包含这些忽略工具与凭据存储的检出目录。默认 ipatool、FairPlay 源码和 credential 查找基于该目录，不依赖 shell 当前目录；显式工具／存储路径仍优先。

首次获取使用独立的 [`credential-retrieve` 准备步骤](ios-fairplay-credentials.md)，需要受支持的越狱手机。命令核对准确 USB／SSH／原生设备身份、选定 App 的授权和可选 IPA 的账号，构建固定源码助手，验证 SINF 解码并清理远端后才保存。本次 iPhone 14／iOS 17.3.1 RootHide 的 mobile SSH 路线已通过，不能据此宣称可从普通手机取得凭据。普通 UI 采集不会自动触发它。凭据只保存在忽略的私有存储，内容、哈希和实际路径不进入证据，已有别名不会覆盖。

离线恢复检查全部程序和资源，当前审计范围为 thin ARM64 加密输入，拒绝 FAT。结构成功标为 `structural_only`；原本未加密的输入保留原样，不能算解密成功。真实 Remoboard 主程序／键盘扩展的离线恢复及独立代码比较已经通过；安装后的 wheel 也在两台手机物理拔线后通过重跑，执行前后设备列表均为空。详见[验收账本](ios-device-support-acceptance.md)与已完成的 [TODO](../TODO.md)。

包索引还会记录不支持的 32 位／反字节序 Mach-O，以及主 App 目录外的程序；这些输入可以保留静态包证据，但会阻断整包离线恢复。全部 FAT 都会拒绝，包括所选 ARM64 切片已无加密的情况，因为其他切片尚未审计。

`offline-cross-check --offline <离线案例> --device <已验证设备解密案例> --out <新案例>` 可与历史 `decrypted_package` 交叉检查全部恢复程序和扩展，要求版本／构建、原加密字节哈希、UUID、加密范围和恢复后哈希都相同。比较保留双方采集身份，不修改原案例的 `structural_only` 状态，也不把不同时间观察写成同时发生；真机验收仍需真实成功的离线样本。

给 UI 优先 analyze／prepare-app／copy 重复传 `--package-case` 可导入已验证包。Bundle ID 不符直接拒绝；版本不同仅记 `bundle_only`，版本／构建相同记 `metadata_match`，都不能证明手机实际运行二进制身份。静态结论用 `basis: "package"` 引用 `package.1` 等；UI 结论引用流程 ID，运行或函数结论需要自身对应证据。

包、许可文件、截图与跟踪留在忽略的本地目录，对每个案例执行 `copyapp verify`。v2 iOS 类型显式分派，不会通过历史报告文件名绕过检查。实施方案中未完成的真机、真实凭据和兼容性验收条件仍然有效。

UI 优先分析的校验会从绑定来源的 AX／OCR 记录重新计算 `capture_number`、`compare_number`，并核对记录值和要求的增量；缓存文本或声称比较成功不够。历史 v1 校验规则保持不变。包恢复、从包准备凭据、行为报告均要求输入与输出目录树分离；嵌套路径和指回输入的别名会在创建输出前被拒绝。

```

`docs/macos-acquisition.md`:

```md
# Mac shared-file probe and distribution import

These are development commands alongside iOS. They collect byte/structure evidence;
neither operation proves App launch, runtime identity or reconstructed behavior.
Keep the raw cases local and Git-ignored.

## Probe the shared folders before full control is ready

The shared folders can be inspected through the guest's visible Finder while
ChatComputer onboarding is still incomplete. Publish a fresh, non-secret nonce:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac share-probe \
  --vm-directory "$HOME/.chatcomputer/ChatComputer.vm" \
  --out cases/mac-share-request
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-share-request
```

Read `GUEST_TASK.md`. In the intended guest Finder, copy its named file once from
`/Volumes/My Shared Files/inbox` to `/Volumes/My Shared Files/outbox`, preserving
the name. No App/helper needs to run and no security permission needs to be granted.
If a new host file is absent in Finder, navigating out of and back into the folder
can refresh the view; this was required in the named development probe.

After observing the copy and checking the outbox, record it:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac share-probe-check --request cases/mac-share-request \
  --reviewer current-agent --notes "Describe the observed guest Finder copy." \
  --out cases/mac-share-result
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-share-result
```

The request pins public VM metadata and publishes a unique payload without replacing
an existing file. The result requires the same metadata and exact returned bytes.
The transfer actor is self-declared: verification checks byte identity and source
links, not the truth of an observer's account. It explicitly leaves
`guest_runtime_identity_verified` and `complete_environment_acceptance` false.
It cannot substitute for `mac connect`, collector identity or live MCP control.
Failed, mismatching and linked replies are rejected. Preserve them and inspect the
guest before a new action; the command does not repeat the copy.

## Import an App distribution without execution

For a local `.app`, continue to use `mac inspect`. For ZIP or DMG input:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac import-app --source /path/to/Example.zip \
  --out cases/mac-import-zip
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-import-zip
.venv/bin/copyapp mac import-app --source /path/to/Example.dmg \
  --out cases/mac-import-dmg
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-import-dmg
```

If a distribution contains several top-level Apps, pass its exact relative path
with `--app-relative Folder/Example.app`. No App, `.pkg` installer, hook or helper
inside the distribution is executed. Selection produces the usual verified
`package/` App index with Bundle ID/version, Mach-O platform/architecture, full
and arm64-slice hashes, complete package inventory and a separate package hash.

The case retains the original archive bytes and source hash. ZIPs are expanded
with explicit bounded reads, preserving ordinary file modes and safe internal
links. Traversal, duplicate names, case/Unicode collisions, special file modes,
encrypted entries and escaping/dangling links are rejected. Accepted inputs are
bounded to 8 GiB; ZIP uncompressed bytes and selected App packages are separately
bounded, with 40,000 entries including implicit directories.

ZIP verification reads the archived members again and compares their selected
App contents against the saved package. It does not trust only an extraction log
or refreshed artifact hash.

DMG import and re-verification currently require macOS 27's `diskutil image`
interface. The importer checks image metadata through the compatibility `hdiutil`
interface because it exposes the software-license flag. Passwords are not supplied;
encrypted or license-interactive images are rejected before attachment. The image
is attached read-only, hidden from Finder, with noexec/nosuid/nodev, at one owned
mount point. The actual mount flags are checked, and only the selected App is copied.
The image is ejected without force by its owned mount/device identity.

`verify` reattaches the exact saved DMG read-only and compares its selected App's
inventory and Mach-O facts with the package snapshot. It does not execute the App.
If cleanup fails, an owned mount and bounded diagnostic are preserved instead of
recursively deleting through the mount point. Inspect that diagnostic before any
manual cleanup; no unrelated disk number is guessed or ejected.

The imported package remains **static distribution evidence**. Use the normal
registered guest acquisition to establish the installed original App's identity;
compare its full package hash with the static package when linking the two.
`mac install` consumes a reviewed independent build, with separate target identity.
Live App discovery, sandbox data, behavior review and paired delivery still have
their own required evidence.

## Capture one explicitly selected App data file

`mac data-file` uses a verified guest acquisition and a collector build that
advertises `data_file`. Rebuild/deploy/register the new collector explicitly if
the registered build lacks this method; do not replace its identity in an old
environment case. This operation requests no new Accessibility permission and
does not grant filesystem access. If macOS denies a read, the failure is retained.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac data-file --acquisition cases/mac-original \
  --location sandbox --path Library/Preferences/dev.example.Editor.plist \
  --out cases/mac-selected-container-plist
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-selected-container-plist
```

The three locations are relative to the collector's actual guest home Library:

| Location | Selected file | Association limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sandbox` | `Containers/<Bundle ID>/Data/<path>` | Bundle-named container convention; not proof the App wrote every file |
| `preferences` | `Preferences/<Bundle ID>.plist` | `--path` must equal the acquired Bundle ID plus `.plist` |
| `support` | `Application Support/<explicit folder>/<file>` | Explicitly selected path; ownership by the App is not certified |

Group containers, ByHost preferences, external documents and arbitrary home paths
are not selected by these locations. No directory crawl or complete data inventory
is performed. A missing default plist does not establish that an App has no settings.
Discover the requested file from actual evidence and record any uncertain ownership.

Only one regular file of at most 64 MiB is accepted. Linked paths, devices, FIFOs,
traversal and changing/replaced files are rejected. The collector compares two
source reads, file metadata and the exported bytes, and checks the acquired App's
binary/Info.plist identity across the operation. The host copies and hashes the
returned file through its exact run/session/request exchange. The case preserves
the source acquisition, request/result, source path/metadata and local `data.bin`.
Source deletion or later changes cannot silently alter that saved case.

This is **one file observation**, not an atomic database snapshot, proof of file
ownership or complete App data. Matching two reads cannot establish transactional
consistency across SQLite, WAL and SHM or across several files. Keep raw bytes in
ignored `cases/`; they may contain private data. Do not present a passing byte
verifier as a database or preference interpretation.

## Extract structure and cite it in a behavior report

Select the format explicitly after reviewing the captured file's origin:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac data-schema --data cases/mac-selected-container-plist \
  --format plist --out cases/mac-preference-structure
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-preference-structure
.venv/bin/copyapp mac data-schema --data cases/mac-selected-database \
  --format sqlite --out cases/mac-database-structure
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-database-structure
```

Each structure case retains the verified data-file case, source identity,
`structure.json` and a readable `schema.md`. Verification recomputes the structure
from the saved bytes, rather than trusting a refreshed hash on a generated JSON.

Plist extraction accepts binary/XML files up to 4 MiB. It describes key paths and
types, merging repeated array shapes and recording bounded-walk truncation. It
omits scalar values, array lengths and data bytes. A truncated walk cannot establish
the absence of a key. Names/paths may themselves contain private information.

SQLite extraction accepts the saved main file up to 64 MiB. It opens a detached
copy read-only/immutable, disables trusted schema and denies SQL function execution
and attachment. It queries object names/types, column types/constraints, foreign
keys, user_version and application_id. It omits rows, SQL bodies and defaults,
and bounds schema objects/columns/foreign keys and query work. Unsupported or
malformed schemas fail with diagnostics. It merges no WAL/SHM; structure committed
only to an uncollected WAL may therefore be absent. This cannot establish the
complete schema or current transactional state of the live database.

In a formal review, add a finding with a structure citation:

```json
{
  "id": "stored-editor-keys",
  "certainty": "observed",
  "statement": "The saved plist has the cited editor key/type structure; its writer is not proven.",
  "evidence": [{"data_id": "preferences", "path": "structure.json"}]
}
```

Supply that structure case alongside the normal accepted flow inputs:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac report --discovery cases/mac-discovery \
  --data preferences=cases/mac-preference-structure \
  --data store=cases/mac-database-structure \
  --review cases/mac-formal-review.json --out cases/mac-report
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-report
```

Use one explicit reviewed citation for every supplied data case. Each `data_id`
must identify a verified `mac_data_schema` for the same exact App path, package,
Bundle ID and registered environment as the flow evidence. Only `structure.json`
is a permitted data citation; raw `data.bin` and arbitrary paths are excluded.
A flow's own findings still need captured UI/flow evidence: a data structure alone
cannot prove a visible behavior or persistence. The report preserves all source
cases and rechecks their chain. UI and data observations remain separate-time;
the agent must inspect their meaning and association before drawing a conclusion.

The report's data JSON/Markdown omit values/rows, but its archived child cases
include original raw bytes. Keep the entire case local; these rules do not turn
the archive into a sanitized sharing artifact.

```

`docs/macos-checks.md`:

```md
# Mac paired replay and selected delivery

These commands are development support. They preserve the iOS workflow and v1
cases. Passing local/simulated protocol tests does not complete the live guest,
sample-app or physical-Mac gates in the [implementation ledger](macos-implementation-plan.md).

## Freeze conditions before replay

Start with a verified `mac install` case. Its source plan selects the reviewed
flows, separate App identity and exact registered environment. Every selected
original playbook must have an exact `expect_text` assertion before its first
keyboard/mouse input. An empty expected value is allowed for an exact blank-field
assertion; `contains` needs nonempty text. The reviewer owns whether this assertion
actually represents the stated starting condition.

Write conditions JSON before running either side. Copy `expected_ui` from a recent
collector health response's `result.ui_environment`, such as the source flow's
`session-health.json`. Use measured settings and an observed focused window frame,
not the sample values below. `flows` must list every selected ID in plan order.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "reviewer": "current-agent",
  "expected_ui": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "appearance": "light",
    "locale": "en_US",
    "preferred_languages": ["en-US"],
    "display_bounds": {"x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 1280, "height": 800},
    "display_pixels": {"width": 2560, "height": 1600},
    "backing_scale": 2
  },
  "network_expectation": "The selected local-document flow uses no network service.",
  "flows": [
    {
      "id": "edit-save",
      "starting_state": "A new blank document is focused, confirmed by the first text assertion.",
      "window_frame": {"x": 100, "y": 80, "width": 700, "height": 500},
      "input_data": "The literal text and run-scoped output path in the saved playbook.",
      "reset_policy": "Each completed flow closes its document; inspect state before a new attempt after any failure."
    }
  ],
  "masks": []
}
```

Appearance, locale, preferred languages, main display bounds/pixels and backing
scale are measured by the collector. The runner checks them at each flow's start
and end. The first launch's focused-window frame must match before further input.
Starting-state text assertions still need semantic review. Input/reset descriptions
and network expectations are declarations; the CLI does not silently reset App
data, change system preferences or enforce network isolation.

Optional masks are declared now, in screenshot pixels, with a reason:

```json
{"flow_id": "edit-save", "capture": "steps/01/after", "rect": [1190, 0, 90, 24], "reason": "Menu-bar clock"}
```

`capture` is a saved capture directory from the original flow. Masks must stay
within the captured image and cannot cover the whole screen, even as a union.
Masks affect metrics only. All full, unmasked screenshot pairs still require review.
Do not edit a frozen plan after observing a rebuilt screenshot; preserve it and
create a new reviewed attempt when conditions need to change.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac check-plan --install cases/mac-install \
  --conditions cases/mac-conditions.json --rounds 3 --out cases/mac-check-plan
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-check-plan
.venv/bin/copyapp mac rebuild-check --plan cases/mac-check-plan --out cases/mac-check
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-check
```

`check-plan` establishes input readiness only. `rebuild-check` first acquires the
installed rebuilt package and checks it against its source build. For each round
and selected flow it runs the original, then the rebuild, using fresh session/run
IDs and the exact frozen scripts. Package and environment identities are checked
again by each playbook. All runs must start after the condition plan was frozen.

`expect_stopped` allows up to 30 seconds for normal process termination after a
successful quit-key reply. It polls exact App identity read-only and retains each
still-running observation. Inactive processes do not count as stopped; expiry
fails the run without sending another quit or forcing termination.

No input or failed run is automatically repeated. Failed/partial child cases and
the active round/flow/side remain saved. Inspect the guest before creating a new
attempt. Shared output directories are outside VM snapshots and use fresh run IDs.
Snapshot recovery and clock behavior have separate acceptance gates.

`comparison.json` lists every behavior result and every screenshot pair. Dimensions,
unmasked pixel count, normalized mean absolute RGB error and changed-pixel fraction
are recomputed during verification. Images are never resized to hide a dimension
mismatch; comparisons are bounded to 16 megapixels per image. Metrics are not a
visual verdict or whole-App coverage.

## Review all full screenshot pairs

Read `cases/mac-check/VISUAL_REVIEW.md`, open both full images for every pair and
fill a copy of `visual-judgments-template.json`. Record:

- A self-declared reviewer name.
- Every pair's `verdict`: `equivalent`, `minor_difference` or `major_difference`;
  nonempty `notes`; and `reviewed_full_screens: true`.
- Every round/flow's initial state: `equivalent`, `different` or `unknown`, with
  notes based on the first launch and starting assertions.

Keep template order. Record visible differences even when pixel metrics are zero.
An inconclusive or adverse review is a valid observation; it cannot pass delivery.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac visual-review --check cases/mac-check \
  --judgments cases/mac-visual-judgments.json --out cases/mac-visual-review
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-visual-review
```

The verifier binds every judgment to exact image hashes and review coverage. It
cannot certify the truth of subjective judgments.

## Review capabilities and deliver

Write one decision for every capability in the original report's frozen inventory,
in inventory order. A `verified` decision must be a planned target and cite all
that capability's selected flow IDs in sorted order. `deferred` and `blocked`
decisions retain a reason and an empty accepted-evidence list. Unknown behavior
remains in the source report; it is not silently removed from the delivery.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "reviewer": "current-agent",
  "capabilities": [
    {"id": "editing", "decision": "verified", "evidence_flow_ids": ["edit-save"], "reason": "The selected editing assertions and full visual review passed."},
    {"id": "printing", "decision": "deferred", "evidence_flow_ids": [], "reason": "Printing was outside the selected target."}
  ]
}
```

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac delivery --visual-review cases/mac-visual-review \
  --coverage cases/mac-capability-review.json --out cases/mac-delivery
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-delivery
```

Delivery requires the current project to match the built source, every target
capability to have a verified decision, all selected behavior assertions to pass,
all screenshot pairs to be reviewed, matching image dimensions, equivalent starting
states and no major visual difference. Minor differences remain explicit.

The standalone case preserves source/build/install/check/review provenance and
writes `delivery.md` and `delivery.json`. Later edits to the working project do not
rewrite this historical source snapshot. The report separates target known coverage,
verified known coverage and selected-flow pass rate, discloses omitted flows and
unknowns, and keeps `whole_app_parity: false` and `physical_mac_verified: false`.
It proves neither physical-Mac compatibility nor native function interpretation.

`docs/macos-discovery.md`:

```md
# Discover representative Mac flows

Use this development workflow when a Mac analysis/rebuild request has no selected
flows. Work in the current coding-agent session with the registered ChatComputer
environment. The iOS discovery commands and USB identities do not apply.

Observe the exact acquired App with `mac observe --ax`, inspect screenshots and
structured AX, and explore relevant menus, shortcuts, document/file dialogs and
windows. Record visible capabilities, deferred/blocked behavior and unknowns.
Choose three to twelve distinct representative flows appropriate to the requested
scope. Do not interact with account/payment or unrelated data just to reach a count.

Write bounded Mac playbooks and run each once with `mac playbook --acquisition
<CASE> --script <JSON> --out <NEW_CASE>`. Inspect the saved evidence and verify
each case. Every accepted replay needs an explicit text, output-file or stopped
process assertion. A lost response or interrupted action requires state inspection;
`discover-check` does not replay or repair it. Renaming a script cannot make it a
second representative flow.

Write a discovery review JSON using the actual saved script hashes:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "scope": "representative_flow_discovery",
  "reviewer": "current-agent",
  "selection_note": "Explain why these flows represent the requested scope.",
  "flows": [
    {
      "id": "edit-save",
      "source_script_sha256": "REPLACE_WITH_SAVED_PLAYBOOK_SHA256",
      "purpose": "Edit and save a new document.",
      "selection_reason": "Explain the observed capability exercised by this flow."
    }
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    {
      "id": "editing",
      "title": "Edit and save text",
      "flow_ids": ["edit-save"],
      "disposition": "available",
      "reason": "Describe the replay assertions and reviewed evidence."
    },
    {
      "id": "printing",
      "title": "Printing",
      "flow_ids": [],
      "disposition": "deferred",
      "reason": "Identified but outside the selected scope."
    }
  ],
  "inventory_note": "Describe how the known inventory was observed and its limits.",
  "unknowns": ["List unobserved behavior explicitly."]
}
```

The example shows the shape of one flow entry. Include entries for all three to
twelve actual replay cases; the command rejects the incomplete example. Capability
dispositions are `available`, `deferred` and `blocked`. Every flow must link to an
available capability; every available capability needs a flow. The reviewer owns
selection quality and inventory completeness.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac discover-check \
  --flow edit-save=cases/mac-edit-save \
  --flow reopen=cases/mac-reopen \
  --flow multiwindow=cases/mac-multiwindow \
  --review cases/mac-discovery-review.json --out cases/mac-discovery
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-discovery
```

Acceptance verifies complete replay assertions, the exact original App path,
package and registered environment, script identity and inventory links. It saves
immutable child cases, the reviewed selection and `TASK.md` for behavior review.
Its status is input readiness; it certifies neither review truth, whole-App
coverage nor reconstruction. Separate-time observations remain separate-time.

Read the task and all linked raw evidence, then write the formal review described
in [the behavior review contract](macos-review.md). Use the accepted nested flows:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac report --discovery cases/mac-discovery \
  --review cases/mac-formal-review.json --out cases/mac-report
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-report
```

The report preserves the discovery case and binds exactly its accepted replay
manifests. It requires all discovered capability IDs, including deferred/blocked
entries, to remain in the formal inventory. The formal review can add capabilities
and revise dispositions with reasons; the reviewer must carry unresolved unknowns
forward and inspect the meaning of any revisions. ID retention cannot prove that
two descriptions have the same semantics. Freeze the final known denominator and
explicit target with `mac rebuild-plan` before implementation.

For user-selected flows, the existing `mac report --flow ID=CASE` entry still
accepts one to twelve flows. Do not fabricate extra flows for a selected-flow job.

```

`docs/macos-implementation-plan.md`:

```md
# macOS support implementation and acceptance plan

This ledger records implementation and named acceptance for macOS support in
v0.2.0. Keep the measured scope and limitations explicit. Preserve the
published iOS v0.1.2 commands, USB transports, historical cases and verification
semantics working. Add macOS alongside iOS; do not reinterpret a Mac as an iPhone.

## Architecture

The current coding agent owns discovery, semantic review and independent source
implementation. Copy APP owns cases and acceptance. ChatComputer owns the virtual
Mac, computer input, screenshots and snapshots. A bounded Copy APP collector in
the guest supplies exact app/process identity and structured acquisition. Do not
launch another coding agent or ChatComputer's built-in model loop.

Pin the installed ChatComputer build. Its current MCP returns text and images,
not structured AX objects. Do not parse prose into identity assertions. The guest
collector must supply Bundle ID, executable path/hash, process and window identity.
Use a run-scoped request/result exchange through the existing shared folders if
P0 verifies atomic writes and recovery. Never depend on upstream's planned shell
API. Read neither ChatComputer credentials nor guest pairing secrets.

macOS cases use schema version 2 and explicit `platform: macos` and execution
environment. iOS v1 cases retain their existing validators. A static package index
does not prove installation, launch, UI behavior or binary runtime provenance.
Every new case kind needs a semantic validator; unknown Mac kinds must fail.

## Scope

First acceptance environment: Apple Silicon macOS 27 host and macOS 27 guest,
ChatComputer v0.9.11 (record actual version and hash). Native arm64 AppKit/SwiftUI
apps, plus explicitly identified arm64 Mac Catalyst packages for the requested
Stocks sample; Catalyst UI acceptance still needs live evidence. Universal bundles
retain full-file and selected-slice hashes. Begin with
independent `.app`, ZIP and DMG distribution. No initial promise for Intel/Rosetta,
encrypted store packages, drivers, system extensions, hardware-dependent or
account/payment workflows. Electron behavior compatibility is a later named test.

UI/static/file evidence produces a **behavior analysis** report, never an
unsupported deep function report. Optional Frida/Ghidra/Hopper evidence is a
separate capability and cannot be invented to satisfy a gate.

## Work and evidence ledger

| Stage | Required work | Acceptance evidence | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0 | Pin ChatComputer; ready desktop, input lease, screenshots, coordinates; file exchange; exact identity; snapshot recovery | Live probe cases, including failures; restart must not accept stale results | Named guest ready; one quiesced take/restore preserves the running editor state; earlier failures retained |
| P1 | `copyapp mac` CLI; target/environment identity; versioned cases and validators; old iOS compatibility | Positive cases and negative tampering/cross-platform tests; baseline and final iOS suite | Implemented; 410-test regression and isolated wheel passed |
| P2 | Guest collector; app/package/data acquisition; AX/window observations; bounded playbooks | Same-name app rejection, ambiguous element rejection, output and persistence assertions | Selected guest/UI and one preference-file evidence verified; broader data limits remain explicit |
| P3 | Discovery, reviewed report/specification, coverage plan, agent task, host build, guest install, paired check, visual review, delivery | End-to-end source-linked cases with explicit scope and remaining differences | Owned-fixture selected delivery verified; Stocks bounded 80-grade milestone met, strict delivery deferred |
| P4 | Control takeover, interrupted action, reconnect, snapshot restore, time and data resets | No blind action retries; new run/session identity; rejected old results | Controlled reply-loss/reconnect, real takeover refusal, explicitly authorized agent hand-back and one named editor snapshot recovery verified |
| P5 | Agent-first bilingual docs, wheel resources, examples and clean installation | Installed-wheel checks; two sample applications and one physical Mac recheck | Docs/wheel/two guest samples ready; named same-binary physical selected-flow recheck passed |
| M2 | Optional runtime/native function investigation | Debug fixture first, then named third-party build; report actual entitlement limits | Pending |

The requested development milestone now has implementation and named evidence
for P0–P5, including the selected checks in acceptance items 1–8 below. The user's
bounded Stocks prototype target is met; its strict delivery remains a separate
later scope. This is neither whole-App parity nor general macOS compatibility.
The later user instruction authorizes merging this branch and publishing
`v0.2.0-beta.1`. Earlier no-merge/no-release entries below describe the preceding
development phase; they no longer block this authorized release.
The subsequent user instruction publishes the final version as `v0.2.0` without
the beta suffix; this changes release metadata, not the measured acceptance scope.
The latest local completion evidence check revalidates 42 conditions, including
retained failed-case rejection, current collector source identity, unchanged
tested runtime code, source-linked deliveries and manual evidence hashes.

First-stage effort estimate is 13–20 developer days, revised after P0. This is not
a deadline or a reason to reduce scope. No tag/release until acceptance completes.

Issue #1 and PR #2 retain development review; the later user instruction
authorizes merge and prerelease after the final release checks. The requested real-app
sample is now Apple Stocks (`com.apple.stocks`), alongside the owned fixture.
The host has Stocks 8.0 (2028); acquire the actual guest build before choosing
flows. Discover and review at least three representative flows, freeze their
known-capability inventory, then implement the independent selected behavior under
`examples/macos/Stocks/` with a separate Bundle ID. Search, watchlist changes,
chart ranges and persistence are candidates for observation, not accepted flows.
Retain market-data/network dependencies and remaining differences explicitly;
captured prices do not establish a live data service or complete App parity.
Earlier TextEdit static distribution probes remain separate evidence.

script hash, requests, outcomes, timestamps, screenshots, structured AX observations
and output-file hashes. Keep observations, inference and unknowns separate.

Snapshots do not reset host shared folders or network services. Give every run its
own workspace, request IDs and results; re-establish the session after restoring.
Record both host and guest clocks. Persistence assertions run through actual quit
and relaunch within the flow. Pin language, appearance, scaling, window placement,
input data and network expectations before comparing original and rebuilt runs.

Do not overwrite installed apps or unrelated user data. Install rebuilds under a
separate Bundle ID. Preserve signed originals and separately identify any re-signed
or instrumented copies. No blanket SIP changes or credential copying.

## Release acceptance

1. Two sample apps: one owned fixture and one actual desktop app. At least three
   selected flows per app, three rounds each: 18 original/rebuild comparisons.
2. Cover menus, shortcuts, file dialogs, multiple windows, output correctness and
   quit/relaunch persistence. Validate every selected behavior, not screenshots alone.
3. Exercise takeover, connection interruption and snapshot recovery. Never repeat
   an action solely because its response was lost; inspect state first.
4. Tampered executable, script, screenshot, output, source link, target identity or
   incomplete result must be rejected. Same display name is not app identity.
5. Review all required screenshot pairs with explicit judgments. Image metrics do
   not certify visual equivalence; masks are declared before acceptance.
6. Freeze the known-capability denominator before implementation. Keep target,
   verified known coverage and selected-flow pass rate separate. Disclose unknowns.
7. At least one sample's selected flows pass on a physical Mac. Keep VM and physical
   results separate. Never describe a VM check as physical-Mac acceptance.
8. Existing iOS suite and installed wheel pass. Changes to iOS device execution
   require the affected named-device recheck, with failed evidence preserved.

`docs/macos-recovery.md`:

```md
# Mac snapshots, interrupted operations and reconnects

This development workflow uses the pinned ChatComputer public snapshot tools.
Copy APP never swaps VM disks itself, deletes snapshots, reads pairing secrets or
disables safety saves. These commands apply to the explicitly registered virtual
Mac; they are unrelated to iOS USB identities or physical-Mac snapshots.

## Inspect public metadata without changing the VM

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac snapshot-inspect \
  --vm-directory "$HOME/.chatcomputer/ChatComputer.vm" \
  --out cases/mac-snapshot-inventory
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-snapshot-inventory
```

This records the public VM identity files and bounded snapshot/state JSON metadata.
It reads no disk image, saved-memory file, credentials or pairing token. It can run
before guest control permissions are ready; a complete metadata case does not make
the guest ready. Incomplete staging directories, an interrupted restore and a
current ID with no valid snapshot remain inspectable facts, not repaired states.
Mutation commands refuse those conditions or missing ancestry.

The named development inventory at
`cases/macos-p0-20261021/snapshot-inventory-1` verified the actual VM at
`agentInstalled`, with zero snapshots and no restore in progress. No take/restore
was performed in that early inventory. Guest permissions were granted later;
the named live snapshot results below remain separate from this historical case.

## Take a reviewed baseline

Finish normal ChatComputer setup and deploy/register the verified collector first.
Choose a quiet test VM and inspect its desktop. Then:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac snapshot-take --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --out cases/mac-baseline-snapshot
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-baseline-snapshot
```

The command checks the exact pinned VM, ChatComputer executable and collector.
It obtains status/screenshot/health, then uses a normal input-lease request
(`move 0,0`) before the snapshot. An already active human takeover rejects that
request before `snapshot_take` is submitted. Copy APP generates a unique name and
submits the snapshot action once. It resolves the full resulting UUID from stable
public snapshot metadata, rather than treating the tool's prose as exact identity.
An upstream initial snapshot may also appear on the first operation.

After the action, Copy APP closes the old MCP connection, rotates the collector
session while retaining its exclusive host lock, and obtains fresh status,
screenshot and health through a new MCP connection. Old request/output files are
preserved. Metadata, guest/OS/build identity and both sessions are source-linked
into the case. A memory restore can retain the same collector instance UUID;
instance change is recorded rather than asserted as a requirement.

## Bound the collector's file polling around snapshots

New collector builds advertise optional `quiesce` support. After the input-lease
preflight succeeds, snapshot take/restore asks that collector to pause its own
shared-filesystem polling for 30 guest-clock seconds, then submits the VM operation
once. The collector closes its acknowledgment before pausing; it resumes polling
automatically after the bound. The host retains its exclusive bridge lock and
rotates to a fresh epoch as before. Interrupted calls still require inspection.

The case records `before/quiesce.json` and binds the request, acknowledgment,
collector instance and pre-snapshot session. It records
`collector_polling_quiesced: true` and `all_guest_file_io_quiesced: false`. This
does not quiesce Finder, other processes or external services. The mitigation
targets a hypothesis about in-flight shared-filesystem I/O; passing local protocol
tests alone cannot establish that it fixes live VM resume. Historical collectors
and cases without this advertised capability retain their existing semantics.

A separate unlocked-host diagnostic at
`output/macos-snapshot-unlocked-20261021/` obtained a successful snapshot RPC and
full post-take images retaining the synthetic unsaved text and Wrapping Off. Its
collector reconnection nevertheless timed out, and Finder could not finish opening
the bridge directory. The case stays failed, no restore was submitted, and no
snapshot input was repeated. A temporary readonly nonce share did not visibly
resolve the problem and was removed. After observed normal editor cleanup, normal
guest restart and relaunch of the unchanged verified collector restored health.
This supports visual preservation in that experiment, not a complete snapshot
acceptance or a proven quiescence fix.

A wider, bounded query of the Virtualization service for the original failed
operation found a `NSOSStatusErrorDomain` `-25308` decryption failure at
15:48:19 PDT. Apple's [error definition](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/errsecinteractionnotallowed)
means security-service interaction was not allowed. Host lock observations from
that development run make lock-related key access a hypothesis; the exact cause
and exact-instant lock state remain unproven. No keychain or secret contents were
read or altered. Raw diagnostic messages remain local.

## Restore a pinned Copy APP snapshot with a safety save

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac snapshot-restore --snapshot cases/mac-baseline-snapshot \
  --out cases/mac-restored
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-restored
```

Restoration requires a verified `snapshot-take` case and unchanged target metadata
in that exact VM. Copy APP submits the full UUID with `save_current: true`. There
is no no-save option. Verification requires one newly retained safety snapshot,
correct ancestry, the selected final current ID, unchanged previous snapshots,
fresh MCP/collector sessions and the pinned guest identity. It does not hash the
saved disk or memory, or certify that an App returned to the intended state.

Snapshots exclude host shared inbox/outbox contents and external services. Copy
APP does not delete/reset shared files; use fresh run IDs and output paths after
restoration. Acquire/recheck the installed App package, inspect the new screenshot
and assert its initial UI state before further input. Validate persistence and
outputs with actual playbooks; a reconnect is not a behavior comparison.

## Takeover and unknown results

Replay retains `failed-mcp-request.json` when a ChatComputer call fails: the
transport ID, server identity, exact JSON-RPC request and last received response
(or null when none arrived). This is separate from cleanup failure evidence, so a
failed release cannot replace the interrupted input's diagnostic. Its failed
case records `completion_unknown`, `needs_inspection` and `action_retried: false`.
ChatComputer's unstructured error replies can represent either a refusal before
dispatch or a failure after dispatch. For input/file/VM mutations, Copy APP treats
such a reply as an unknown outcome, closes that MCP transport and does not infer
non-execution from its text. Read-only errors do not assert an unknown mutation.

The snapshot API has **no atomic expected-input-lease condition**. The preflight
move detects an existing takeover but cannot close a race where someone takes
over immediately before the queued snapshot command. The case explicitly records
`takeover_guard: preflight_input_lease_only` and
`atomic_takeover_exclusion_verified: false`. This limitation is separate from
normal key/mouse input, for which ChatComputer checks its lease. Keep snapshot
work on a quiet dedicated test VM; do not programmatically hand back human control.

A timeout, disconnect or an error after snapshot commitment does not prove that
the operation did nothing. Copy APP saves the failed MCP request/reply, any
available current metadata and a `needs_inspection` diagnostic. It never repeats
the action, resumes it automatically, or reconnects merely to send cleanup input.
Failed cases are retained and are not accepted by `verify` as completed operations.

Inspect the GUI and use a new read-only inventory after an uncertain result.
Review the full IDs, the proposed unique name in the failed request and any new
safety snapshot. Re-establish exact collector/guest and App state before a new
explicit operation. Do not treat the failed case as a successful take case, and
do not repeat an interrupted input just because a connection was re-opened.

## Evidence boundary

The complete operation scope is `snapshot_metadata_and_reconnect`, with
`behavior_restoration_verified`, `shared_data_reset` and
`disk_or_memory_bytes_verified` all false. Hashes establish saved evidence
consistency, not the truth of a UI interpretation or hidden VM state. The current
snapshot transition/reconnect tests use a simulated metadata controller and a real
local collector; no actual VM disk/memory was restored in those tests.

On the named macOS 27.0.1 guest, the first actual take saved its snapshot but the
collector's new shared-file session timed out. Both failed attempts remain under
`cases/macos-p0-20261021/snapshot-take-live-{1,2}`. A GUI refresh of the bridge
directory restored health without restarting the collector; session rotation alone
did not resolve the failure. The collector now enumerates that directory before
reading the host's atomically replaced active epoch. This changes no request ID,
start marker or retry rule.

With the new pinned collector, `snapshot-take-directory-refresh-1` and
`snapshot-restore-directory-refresh-1` in that same local directory verified actual
save/restore metadata and fresh MCP/collector sessions, with one retained safety
snapshot on restore. This is evidence for this named VM and build. App-state
restoration, live takeover/interrupted input and all paired sample comparisons
remain separate acceptance requirements; the operation still records
`behavior_restoration_verified: false` and `shared_data_reset: false`.

The named guest also has a controlled reply-loss diagnostic at
`cases/macos-live-response-loss-20261021/`. Its local harness submits one real
`type` request to the pinned ChatComputer/collector environment, withholds the
matching genuine successful reply at the client receive boundary, and closes
that MCP process. Production replay saves `interrupted-playbook-1` with a null
last response, `completion_unknown`, `needs_inspection` and `action_retried: false`;
`verify` rejects it as incomplete. The harness retains the withheld envelope
separately rather than adding it to the failed production case. A fresh collector
session's verified `post-loss-readonly-observation-1` shows exactly one copy of the
probe text, and its complete screenshot was opened. Only after that inspection,
`observed-normal-exit-1` asserts the observed text and quits normally. The input
was never repeated. This tests controlled post-dispatch reply loss against a real
guest; it does not establish human-takeover behavior, an unplanned network failure
or snapshot App-state restoration. The diagnostic harness is local evidence and
does not alter production transport code.

A later live App-state probe found a failure, retained at
`cases/macos-fixture-snapshot-behavior-20261021/`. Its verified `baseline-1`
contains unsaved `Alpha β` / emoji text and Wrapping Off in the independent editor.
`snapshot-take-1` created the uniquely requested manual snapshot
`3BF59B3B-6B33-451E-883B-282BCD5B9303`, but returned an agent-disconnected error.
It remains a failed unknown-completion case and is rejected by `verify`; it was
not retried or converted into a successful take. The separate verified metadata
inventory matches its exact requested name, addition, current ID and ancestry.
No restore was submitted.

The desktop subsequently became ready. The collector needed an explicit relaunch
through its same verified deployment; a fresh probe and `environment-3` recheck
the same guest and retained Accessibility grant. The unchanged editor binary
has a new PID/start time and a blank document with Wrapping Off, as shown by the
verified acquisition, identity and `post-take-ui-inspection-1` full screen/AX.
The unsaved test text was not preserved. These observations are consistent with
a cold restart; the precise saved-state resume failure is unconfirmed.
`post-take-observed-cleanup-1` asserts that observed state, resets On and exits
normally. See `snapshot-app-state-findings.json` for exact source and image hashes.

That historical App-state attempt remains failed. Save needed work before snapshot
operations and use discardable fixture state for recovery experiments. A metadata
record with `memoryBytes` is insufficient evidence of memory or App-state restoration.
