`docs/macos-review.md`:

```md
# Mac behavior review contract

This is the input contract for `copyapp mac report` on the development branch.
It does not change iOS report schemas or claim native function analysis.

When the user has no preselected flows, first follow
[representative discovery](macos-discovery.md). Pass the verified discovery case
with `--discovery` instead of `--flow`; the report binds its exact replay evidence
and retains the discovered known-capability IDs. Discovery is input readiness,
not the semantic review itself. Explicitly selected jobs can use `--flow` directly.

For preferences or database structure, follow
[data acquisition and structure](macos-acquisition.md#extract-structure-and-cite-it-in-a-behavior-report).
Pass verified structure cases with repeated `--data ID=CASE` and cite
`{"data_id":"ID","path":"structure.json"}` in findings. These must match the
flow evidence's exact App/package/environment. Data-only findings cannot satisfy
a flow's behavior evidence requirement. Raw values/rows remain outside structure
citations, and their full archived sources still stay local.

First collect and verify one to twelve `mac playbook` cases. Each case must start
with launch, finish successfully and contain at least one explicit `expect_text`,
`expect_file` or `expect_stopped` assertion. All report flows must use the same
acquired package hash and exact registered environment. Their observations can be
from different times; the report does not make them simultaneous.

The current agent reads each flow's raw evidence and writes a review JSON like this.
Replace the script hash with SHA-256 of the case's saved `playbook.json`; flow IDs
must match its `scenario_id`. Citation paths must be recorded files under `steps/`
inside that flow case. Use actual observations rather than the example's claims.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "scope": "behavior_analysis",
  "reviewer": "current-agent",
  "summary": "The selected text editing flow has an asserted output file.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "saved-text",
      "certainty": "observed",
      "statement": "The captured output file contains the expected text.",
      "evidence": [{"flow_id": "edit-save", "path": "steps/05/output.bin"}]
    }
  ],
  "flows": [
    {
      "id": "edit-save",
      "source_script_sha256": "REPLACE_WITH_SAVED_PLAYBOOK_SHA256",
      "expected_behavior": "Edit and save the selected text.",
      "findings": ["saved-text"]
    }
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    {
      "id": "editing",
      "title": "Edit and save text",
      "flow_ids": ["edit-save"],
      "disposition": "available",
      "reason": "The selected flow has output assertions."
    },
    {
      "id": "printing",
      "title": "Printing",
      "flow_ids": [],
      "disposition": "deferred",
      "reason": "Identified in the known inventory but not exercised."
    }
  ],
  "inventory_note": "This is a reviewed known-capability inventory, not a complete census of the App.",
  "unknowns": ["Other document formats and unobserved menu actions remain unknown."]
}
```

Use `certainty: inferred` for an interpretation supported by the linked evidence.
Unknown behavior belongs in the nonempty `unknowns` list. Capability dispositions
are `available`, `deferred` or `blocked`; explain each and link available
capabilities to reviewed flows. IDs use ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`, with
at most 80 characters. The same review must cover exactly the supplied flows.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac report --flow edit-save=cases/mac-edit-save \
  --review cases/mac-review.json --out cases/mac-report
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-report
.venv/bin/copyapp mac rebuild-plan --report cases/mac-report \
  --bundle dev.example.IndependentEditor \
  --app-path "<GUEST_INSTALL_ROOT>/IndependentEditor.app" \
  --project rebuild/IndependentEditor --capability editing \
  --out cases/mac-rebuild-plan
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-rebuild-plan
```

The report preserves its source cases, reviewed JSON, hashed citations, readable
`report.md` and `feature-spec.json`. Its validator checks provenance and structure;
the reviewer owns interpretation and inventory completeness.

Use the registered environment's `environment.json` → `install_root` for
`<GUEST_INSTALL_ROOT>`; do not substitute the host's home directory. With the current
collector it normally names the guest's `~/Applications/CopyAppRebuilds`. The guest
installer accepts a new App directly inside that pinned root and never replaces
an existing file, directory or symbolic link.

The rebuild plan freezes the full known inventory and explicit target capability
IDs before implementation. Deferred or blocked entries cannot be selected without
a new review. It selects all flows linked to the target capabilities and records
omitted report flows. Generated scripts change only the App path and Bundle ID.
If the example targets one of two known capabilities, the target is 50% of that
known inventory; verified coverage and flow pass rate remain unavailable.

Read the generated `TASK.md` to continue independent implementation. Use the
[Mac build/install commands](macos-support.md#build-and-install-an-independent-app)
after writing the source. The plan itself does not create source, run a build,
install an App or certify delivery. Changing a
generated script invalidates that plan; preserve it and prepare a reviewed new
plan when the selected behavior needs to change.

```

`docs/macos-support.md`:

```md
# macOS preview support

[简体中文](macos-support.zh-CN.md) · [Implementation ledger](macos-implementation-plan.md)

The **v0.2.0** release supports macOS **alongside jailbroken iOS**; v0.1.2 is the previous iOS-only release. Existing iOS
commands and v1 cases keep their original meaning. This preview supplies
collection, bounded replay, reviewed reports, independent builds and selected
delivery. The owned fixture has a named selected-behavior delivery; this does not
certify whole-App or arbitrary-Mac reconstruction. Do not use an iOS UDID or IPA
case to represent a Mac.

ChatComputer owns the virtual desktop and all keyboard/mouse input. The current
coding agent does analysis and implementation; do not start ChatComputer's built-in
model loop or nest another coding-agent CLI. Its external MCP currently returns
text/images. Copy APP's bounded guest collector adds structured app identity and AX
observations without depending on a future upstream shell API.

For a pre-control shared-file probe or ZIP/DMG input, read
[shared files and distribution import](macos-acquisition.md). These commands keep
their byte/structure scope separate from runtime identity and UI acceptance.
The same guide describes `mac data-file` for a selected guest data file, including
path association limits and the lack of atomic database or complete-data coverage.
`mac data-schema` extracts bounded plist/SQLite structure for source-linked
`mac report --data` citations, with values/rows omitted from generated structure.

For requests without preselected flows, follow
[representative flow discovery](macos-discovery.md) before writing the formal
report. `mac discover-check` accepts reviewed replay inputs; `mac report --discovery`
retains their source identity and discovered known-capability IDs.

## Install and first use

For an agent-led first run, copy the [Mac task in the README](../README.md#macos-with-chatcomputer). The agent performs the commands below; guest initialization and system permissions may still need your interaction.

### 1. Prepare the host and repository CLI

As checked on **2026-10-22**, [ChatComputer's official installation page](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer#install) lists Apple Silicon, macOS 27, at least 16 GB RAM and about 70 GB free disk space. These are upstream requirements, not a new Copy APP compatibility test. Copy APP needs Python 3.9+ and the Swift compiler/macOS SDK; Xcode-project builds require full Xcode. Recheck the upstream requirements when installing a different ChatComputer version.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac --help
```

Reuse an existing checkout without overwriting local changes. The bootstrap installs the local Python CLI; it does not install ChatComputer, Xcode or guest services. For Mac targets, continue with `mac doctor` below; `onboard` is the iPhone setup path.

### 2. Install and open ChatComputer

With an existing Homebrew installation:

```sh
brew install --cask chatcomputer/tap/chatcomputer
open -a ChatComputer
```

Or download `ChatComputer.zip` from the [official Releases page](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer/releases), unzip it and move `ChatComputer.app` into Applications. For that path, use ChatComputer's **Settings → Coding agents** to make `chatcomputer` available on PATH. Homebrew installs the command as part of its cask. The current official cask is 0.9.11; newer versions require their own readiness check.

Finish guest initialization in the app, including the requested screen recording/control permissions. Keep it running and confirm the target App is installed and opens **inside the virtual Mac**. Follow the named 0.9.11 model-configuration note below if onboarding is complete but that page remains visible; external-agent control does not need its built-in model loop.

### 3. Check transport, then exact guest and target

Follow **Check the environment**, **Build and prepare the collector**, and **Register and observe** below. Deploy the collector inside the intended guest and approve its Accessibility access there. Each attempt uses a new case directory; keep successful cases for subsequent stages.

First setup is ready for behavior observation only after transport/screenshot checks, collector health and exact environment registration succeed, and the requested App has a verified identity plus a usable screenshot/AX observation. Inspect `needs_setup`, missing permissions and truncated observations rather than treating case verification as readiness. Continue into discovery/report/implementation only after those checks.

## Start with an agent

Open this source checkout in Codex or Claude Code and paste:

```text
Analyze the macOS App “APP NAME” using this Copy APP checkout and ChatComputer.
Read AGENTS.md and skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md first. Identify the exact guest,
App and build, collect representative flows and produce a cited behavior report.
Keep existing iOS support intact. Use the current agent session for review and
implementation, and report the actual acceptance scope and unfinished gates.
```

For new agent-led jobs, default to ignored `output/<app>-<unique-run>/`, with
sibling `project/` and `evidence/` folders. Honor the user's chosen directory;
keep existing examples and historical cases in place. Pass explicit child case
paths to the Mac commands' `--out` flags. The iOS `copy` command has a default
job layout and `--output-dir`; there is no `mac copy` wrapper yet.

For an independent rebuild, add the desired behavior and ask the agent to continue
through a reviewed rebuild plan, implementation, paired replay and delivery.
The development commands have local/simulated protocol tests and named live guest
evidence, an owned-fixture selected delivery and a named manual physical-Mac
selected-flow recheck. Stocks has a bounded offline-prototype milestone; strict
Stocks delivery remains deferred. See the ledger before treating a prepared task
or passing protocol check as a completed App.

For bounded snapshot metadata, safety-preserving restore and interrupted-operation
handling, read [Mac recovery](macos-recovery.md). A metadata/reconnect case does not
prove restored App behavior; upstream snapshots have only a preflight takeover
guard in this integration, not an atomic expected-lease condition.

The [owned AppKit fixture](../examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/README.md) is available
for acceptance development. Its three guest flows now have a reviewed report and
frozen reconstruction scope. The separate [independent editor](../examples/macos/IndependentEditor/README.md)
is a source-available acceptance example; consult the ledger for its live checks.

## Check the environment

Use an Apple Silicon Mac with the installed ChatComputer application. Finish its
guest onboarding in the GUI, then use the CLI from this checkout:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac doctor --out cases/mac-transport
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-transport
```

A `needs_setup` doctor case is verifiable evidence of missing prerequisites. A
successful doctor establishes transport and screenshot availability only; it does
not identify an app, validate runtime tracing or prove behavior. `--data-dir`
selects a non-default ChatComputer data directory explicitly.

On the named ChatComputer 0.9.11 build, saving the initial snapshot changes the
VM stage to `ready`, while the first-run window still shows model configuration.
Normally quitting and reopening ChatComputer then exposes the ready desktop to
external MCP without configuring its built-in model. This was observed with the
named development VM; verify your actual transport with `doctor` after reopening.
Keep the existing guest credential in ChatComputer's own local storage. It is not
an input to Copy APP cases, reports or GitHub artifacts.

## Build and prepare the collector

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-collector --out cases/mac-collector-build
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-collector-build
.venv/bin/copyapp mac prepare-collector --build cases/mac-collector-build \
  --out cases/mac-collector-deployment --request-accessibility
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-collector-deployment
chatcomputer share add "$PWD/cases/mac-collector-deployment/payload"
```

Share only this deployment payload, read-only. Use the guest path printed by
ChatComputer, open that folder in the **guest** Finder and run
`Start Collector.command`. It installs the exact hashed helper in the guest's
`~/Applications/CopyAppTools/<hash>/`. The launcher checks that it is inside a
virtual Mac and that the ChatComputer share exists. It does not modify the host.

`--request-accessibility` makes the helper ask macOS for Accessibility access in
the guest. The guest owner grants it through System Settings; no permission is
granted automatically. ChatComputer separately needs its normal guest capture and
control permissions. A local collector build/self-test requests neither permission.

The default collector signature is ad-hoc. For repeatable TCC identity, use a
suitable stable `--signing-identity` and retain the exact build; changing the
signature can require a new guest permission grant. A successful build is not a
notarized distribution or proof of installation.

In the named macOS 27 guest, the existing permission row still resolved to the old
hashed collector even after adding the new build. A per-App permission reset using
[Apple's documented utility](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/resetting-access-to-protected-resources-in-macos),
followed by adding the exact new guest App in System Settings, restored the new
collector's measured AX access. This was an authorized guest setup repair for
`dev.copyapp.MacCollector`; the CLI does not reset privacy permissions automatically.
Inspect the selected App path and the later collector health rather than relying
on a blue switch or granting access to an unrelated copy.

### Probe the collector without requesting UI permissions

For an explicitly limited setup probe, omit `--request-accessibility` when preparing
the collector. Copy only that verified deployment into a fresh directory in the
VM's existing shared inbox, then open its `payload/Start Collector.command` in the
guest Finder. This starts the bounded helper without invoking its permission prompt;
it does not grant or bypass ChatComputer/collector capture or Accessibility access.
Verify the published deployment again before running it. The launcher and its
permission-request flag are checked against the exact verified build.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac probe-collector \
  --vm-directory "$HOME/.chatcomputer/ChatComputer.vm" \
  --collector-build cases/mac-collector-build --out cases/mac-collector-probe
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-collector-probe
```

The probe uses two fresh health requests, binding their request hashes, session,
instance, executable build and first guest identity observed on this shared root.
It pins the public VM files and actual guest OS; it does not assume the guest has
the host's OS build. Its complete scope is `shared_collector_identity_probe`.
`chatcomputer_transport_verified`, `desktop_control_verified`, `app_behavior_verified`
and `complete_environment_acceptance` remain false. A failed read is retained and
not retried. This pre-control observation cannot be substituted for a ready
`mac connect` environment or passed directly to replay/report/delivery.

The named live probe at `cases/macos-p0-20261021/collector-identity-probe-1`
verified the actual guest on macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), while the upstream GUI remained
at setup step 4 and collector Accessibility was false. No permission request or
grant was made. See the implementation ledger for the remaining live gates.

## Register one exact VM

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac connect \
  --vm-directory "$HOME/.chatcomputer/ChatComputer.vm" \
  --collector-build cases/mac-collector-build --out cases/mac-environment
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-environment
```

Registration pins VM ID and machine/hardware identifier hashes, test configuration,
ChatComputer executable identity, collector executable hash, guest identity and OS.
It also saves the exact MCP initialization envelope and the server's self-reported
identity separately from the installed App's version. In the named 0.9.11 runs,
doctor through the CLI alias reported MCP version `0`, while registration using
the resolved App executable reported `0.9.11`. Reconnect checks the saved server
identity rather than deriving it from the App version.
It copies no password, model credential or pairing token. Reconnect checks these
identities again. A changed app/tool/OS needs a reviewed new registration, not a
silent rewrite of old evidence.

The helper bridge uses unique session and request IDs, a request hash and an
exclusive host session. Interrupted launch requests retain an outbox start marker
and are never blindly re-executed. Shared outbox files are outside VM snapshots:
old files must not be accepted as fresh results after restore.

## Collect static and UI evidence

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac inspect --app /path/to/Example.app --out cases/mac-package
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-package
.venv/bin/copyapp mac observe --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --app-path /Applications/Example.app --bundle example.app \
  --out cases/mac-app-identity
.venv/bin/copyapp mac observe --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --app-path /Applications/Example.app --bundle example.app --ax \
  --out cases/mac-ui-observation
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-ui-observation
```

`inspect` snapshots a local `.app`, inventories regular files and safe internal
symlinks, and distinguishes the whole executable hash from its arm64 slice hash.
It accepts arm64 Mach-O platform 1 (macOS) or 6 (Mac Catalyst), rejecting iOS,
iOS Simulator, conflicting platform declarations and Intel-only binaries. Catalyst
indices explicitly record `macho_platform: 6` and `runtime: mac_catalyst`; accepting
their package does not establish UI replay compatibility. It
copies package bytes and permissions without propagating protected system flags.
Its scope is **static package only**, never guest installation or execution.

`observe --ax` requires one exact foreground process with a known launch time. It
records bounded AX structure, raw MCP screenshot and before/after app identity.
AX and screenshot are sequential observations, not simultaneous captures. Truncated
trees and unavailable permissions remain explicit. These inputs still require
semantic review and do not establish function implementation or whole-app coverage.

## Replay and review selected behavior

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac acquire --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --app-path /Applications/Example.app --bundle example.app \
  --out cases/mac-acquisition
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-acquisition
.venv/bin/copyapp mac playbook --acquisition cases/mac-acquisition \
  --script cases/mac-flow.json --out cases/mac-flow
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-flow
```

Acquisition exports a bounded package snapshot through the collector and compares
the complete guest/source/copy inventories. Replay pins that package before and
after the flow. A minimal script is:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "scenario_id": "visible-editor",
  "bundle_id": "example.app",
  "app_path": "/Applications/Example.app",
  "steps": [
    {"action": "launch"},
    {"action": "expect_text", "selector": {"identifier": "editor"}, "text": "Expected text"}
  ]
}
```

Replace selectors and expectations with observations of the actual App. Supported
actions are launch, screenshot, click, click_element, key, type, scroll, drag, quit,
expect_text, expect_file, expect_stopped and wait. Input is bounded and follows an
exact foreground AX/screenshot capture; element matches must be unique. Selectors
can use exact `title`, `description`, `identifier` or `role`, optionally within a
named `window`. Catalyst often exposes visible labels through `description`. Text and
file assertions are exact unless a text assertion explicitly uses `match: contains`.
File assertions use run-relative paths and one of `text_equals`, `json_equals` or
`sha256`; substitute `{{output_dir}}` in typed text for the unique guest output
directory. Changing or linked output files are rejected. A failed action is retained
and never automatically repeated; inspect state before starting a new case.

Read the raw UI/output evidence, then follow the [review JSON contract](macos-review.md)
to run `mac report` and `mac rebuild-plan`. The report binds findings and a feature
specification to source cases. The plan freezes known capabilities, target coverage
and original/clone playbooks and writes `TASK.md` for the current agent. Neither
command proves implementation or delivery, and neither performs deep code analysis.

## Remaining acceptance

Agent-led development now uses [bounded fidelity](fidelity.md): default reviewed
grade 80/100 and three implementation/check cycles including the first. Stocks
version 7 meets this selected offline-prototype milestone at **81/100** (behavior
100, layout 80, details 45), reusing the already verified full paired review after
the user's new target request. No new guest run or original visual verdict was
substituted. Further cosmetic polishing stops at this milestone. This is separate
from the strict delivery/release gates below, objective similarity and capability
coverage; all 207 recorded major visual differences remain explicit.

Stocks acquisition, three original flows, reviewed discovery/report, independent
build/install and three rounds of paired behavior now have named guest evidence.
The historical build-4 comparison passed all nine selected behavior comparisons,
but its complete 195-pair review recorded major differences, including offline
data/news substitutions, menus, hover feedback and dialog stacking.
A later Stocks build retains Manage Watchlists beneath Delete confirmation and
distinguishes Cancel/Delete styling. A verified 28-step guest regression covers
cancel, subsequent deletion and normal exit; six full screens were inspected.
This targeted fix does not replace the earlier complete paired review or resolve
the remaining content/menu differences.
Build 6 also restores the cold empty-list page and its Add Symbol search entry;
a separate verified 31-step guest regression covers that state and the modal
flow, with the failed diagnostic attempt preserved.
A subsequent paired attempt stopped in the original search flow when a visible AAPL
row was temporarily absent from the AX tree. After inspecting the saved failure,
a revised search flow passed separately on both Apps using asserted ticker-text
points and settling waits. It requires the reviewed 1080×670 window at (100,56)
on the 1280×800 screenshot display. The refreshed report retains the same 11 known
capabilities and three targets. Version 7 then completed a new three-round paired
`check-5`: 9/9 selected behavior comparisons passed. All 207 full screenshot pairs
were reviewed (414 image occurrences, 320 exact unique full PNG hashes), and
`visual-review-5` verifies review coverage with zero dimension mismatches and
207 major differences. The corrected dialog stack and cold empty-list state are
visible, while offline content, menus, hover feedback, styling and example metrics
still differ. The declared starting task states match in all nine comparisons;
that does not make their content visually equivalent. Stocks has no accepted
delivery or verified capability coverage.

The owned fixture now has a verified selected-behavior delivery. The editor's
fresh three-round `check-3` passed nine selected behavior comparisons, and all
285 full screenshot pairs were reviewed (459 exact unique PNGs). Standard Window
menu rows are restored. The review records zero major and 285 minor differences,
including independent App identity, clock/caret/Dock phases and native-panel
directory history/focus. `delivery-1` verifies seven of nine reviewed known
capabilities (77.78%); undo/clipboard and general window management remain deferred.
That denominator does not cover every AppKit behavior, and the fixture source was
available to the author. Earlier `check-2` and its six major menu differences remain
preserved. Stocks strict delivery and broader data/runtime scope remain deferred.
The same guest original and rebuilt editor binaries later passed a manual
three-behavior recheck on one physical Mac. Real human takeover and input refusal,
controlled reply loss and explicitly user-authorized agent hand-back recovery
also have separate live evidence. The early failed snapshot probe remains failed;
a new quiesced take/restore preserves the running editor's unsaved Unicode text,
wrapping and exact process identity through an intervening state change. Its
operation cases and separate manual App-state review retain their own scope.
See [recovery](macos-recovery.md) and the ledger for exact cases and limits. Save
needed work and use discardable fixture state for snapshot tests. Runtime/native
investigation is separate and unverified; named evidence is not arbitrary-Mac support.

A later live guest data check captured the owned fixture's explicitly selected
Bundle-ID preference plist. The single-file case, value-free key/type structure
and a separately sourced formal report all verify. `/fixture.wrap` is a boolean;
native panel metadata types are also recorded without values. This is a later
observation than the UI flows, not an atomic database snapshot, proof of every
key's writer or complete App-data acceptance. Raw archived bytes remain local.

## Build and install an independent App

The rebuild plan's App path must be directly inside the registered guest's
`install_root`, recorded in `environment.json`. The default collector root is the
guest's `~/Applications/CopyAppRebuilds`; it is separate from the original App.
Prepare a new plan if an earlier target path points elsewhere.

Implement the source inside the host project directory pinned by that plan, then
choose one build mode:

```sh
# An Xcode project already configured for the independent Bundle ID and product.
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-app --plan cases/mac-rebuild-plan \
  --xcode-project IndependentEditor.xcodeproj --scheme IndependentEditor \
  --configuration Debug --out cases/mac-build

# Or direct Swift files with an @main entry point and source Info.plist.
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-app --plan cases/mac-rebuild-plan \
  --swift-source Main.swift --info-plist Info.plist \
  --resources Resources --out cases/mac-build-swift
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-build
.venv/bin/copyapp mac install --build cases/mac-build --out cases/mac-install
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-install
```

Paths in the build recipe are project-relative. Repeat `--swift-source` for several
files; omit `--resources` when absent. Direct Swift builds use Swift 5 language mode,
`@main`, native arm64 and macOS 14.0 by default, with Debug or Release optimization.
Set `--deployment-target` for a different Swift minimum; Xcode reads its deployment
target and entitlements from the project. Signing defaults to ad-hoc (`-`); use
`--signing-identity` when a suitable stable identity is available.

The build case preserves the plan, a source snapshot, compiler/signing identity,
SDK metadata, complete bounded command logs and the indexed signed `.app`. It
builds from its snapshot and rejects source rewrites; Xcode's new empty workspace
metadata directories are recorded separately. `.git`, `.build`, `DerivedData`,
`__pycache__` and `.DS_Store` are excluded only at the project root. Keep the build
case outside that source directory. This is source provenance and a local build,
not notarization, installation or behavioral acceptance.

New builds preserve xcrun's versioned SDK path and explicitly export that same
`SDKROOT` to the recorded child commands. The native regression inspects the
resulting Mach-O SDK version: direct swiftc without this environment stamped 14.0
instead of the installed 27.0 SDK and selected older AppKit window decoration in
the fixture. Historical build cases retain their original command/environment
records and remain verifiable; rebuilding creates new evidence.

Installation uses the build's original registered environment, stages the verified
package under its fresh inbox session, verifies the guest copy's signature and
inventories, then atomically creates the new target path without replacement. It
does not launch the App. A start marker prevents replay of interrupted installs;
failed attempts and replies remain recorded. After an unknown result, inspect the
guest and saved evidence instead of rerunning installation. A successful install
still needs an acquired rebuilt package, paired flow replay and visual review.

## Compare and deliver selected behavior

Follow [paired replay and delivery](macos-checks.md) to freeze measured UI conditions
and masks with `mac check-plan`, run fresh pairs with `mac rebuild-check`, review
every full screenshot through `mac visual-review`, then bind capability decisions
and the current source with `mac delivery`. The check produces a review task and
judgment template. It never retries a failed input automatically.

These commands verify source links and explicit gates. They do not certify a
reviewer's interpretation, whole-App parity or physical-Mac behavior. Actual
ChatComputer/sample acceptance is still required by the implementation ledger.

```

`docs/macos-support.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# macOS 预览支持

[English](macos-support.md) · [实施与验收清单](macos-implementation-plan.md)

**v0.2.0** 正式版同时支持越狱 iOS 和macOS；v0.1.2 为上一版仅支持 iOS 的版本。iOS 命令、设备链路和 v1 历史 case 保留原有含义。
当前分支已有采集、有界重放、报告、独立构建和选定交付；自有样例已完成指定行为交付，
不代表整 App 等价、深层函数分析或任意 Mac 兼容。
不要用虚拟 UDID 或 IPA 来表示 Mac。

ChatComputer 负责虚拟桌面和键鼠输入；当前 Coding Agent 负责解释与实现，不启动另一个
Agent 或 ChatComputer 内置模型循环。上游 MCP 目前主要返回文本和图片，Copy APP 的
有界客体采集器补充精确 App 身份与结构化 AX 观察，不依赖上游尚未实现的 shell 接口。

控制权限尚未就绪时，可按[共享文件与分发包采集](macos-acquisition.md)运行 `mac share-probe`
和 `mac share-probe-check`，由客体 Finder 完成一次唯一探针文件的复制，记录字节往返。
ZIP／DMG 输入使用 `mac import-app`；DMG 在 macOS 27 上以只读、禁止执行的方式挂载，
并在 `verify` 时重新比对。加密或需要交互接受许可的镜像会被拒绝。以上不等于 App 已安装、
已运行或已完成界面验收，原始文件仍留在被 Git 忽略的本地案例中。
`mac data-file` 可根据已验证的客体 App 采集案例读取一个明确指定的数据文件，保留两次读取的
一致性与来源记录。它只接受受限位置的普通文件，不代表文件归属已被证明、数据完整或数据库快照原子一致。
`mac data-schema --format plist|sqlite` 从已验证的数据案例提取键／类型或数据库元数据，
正式报告通过 `--data ID=CASE` 引用其中的 `structure.json`。生成结构不输出取值、表行或 SQL 正文；
原始字节仍在本地子案例中。结构证据不能替代界面行为证据，也不能证明不同时间的观察同时发生。

用户没有预选流程时，先按[代表流程发现](macos-discovery.md)观察、重放并审阅 3–12 个不同流程，
使用 `mac discover-check` 保存选择理由、已知能力和未知范围。再用 `mac report --discovery`
生成正式行为报告，保留已验收的流程来源和已发现的能力 ID。发现阶段只证明输入准备就绪。

## 安装与首次使用

通过 Agent 上手，可直接复制 [README 中的 Mac 任务](../README.zh-CN.md#macos-与-chatcomputer)。下面的命令由 Agent 执行；客体初始化与系统授权仍可能需要你在界面上操作。

### 1. 准备宿主与仓库 CLI

截至 **2026-10-22**，[ChatComputer 官方安装说明](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer#install)列出 Apple Silicon、macOS 27、至少 16GB 内存及约 70GB 可用空间。这是上游要求，不是新的 Copy APP 兼容性测试。Copy APP 另需 Python 3.9+、Swift 编译器和 macOS SDK；构建 Xcode 工程需要完整 Xcode。安装其他 ChatComputer 版本时，重新检查上游要求。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac --help
```

已有检出直接复用，保留本地改动。bootstrap 只安装本地 Python CLI，不会安装 ChatComputer、Xcode 或客体服务。Mac 目标接着运行下文的 `mac doctor`；`onboard` 属于 iPhone 配置入口。

### 2. 安装并打开 ChatComputer

已有 Homebrew 时：

```sh
brew install --cask chatcomputer/tap/chatcomputer
open -a ChatComputer
```

也可以从[官方 Releases](https://github.com/chatcomputer/chatcomputer/releases)下载 `ChatComputer.zip`，解压后把 `ChatComputer.app` 放进“应用程序”。这种安装方式还需在 ChatComputer 的 **Settings → Coding agents** 中配置 `chatcomputer` 命令；Homebrew cask 会一并安装命令。当前官方 cask 为 0.9.11，更新版本仍需单独检查就绪情况。

在界面里完成虚拟 Mac 初始化及要求的录屏／控制授权，保持 ChatComputer 运行，并确认目标 App 已安装且能在**虚拟 Mac 内**打开。0.9.11 初始化完成但仍停留在模型配置页的情况见下文；使用外部 Agent 不需要启动其内置模型循环。

### 3. 先检查传输，再确认准确客体与 App

继续按下文“环境与采集器”和“登记虚拟机与观察 App”操作。把采集器部署到指定客体，在客体里授予辅助功能权限；每次尝试用新案例目录，保留后续阶段需要引用的成功案例。

首次配置可用于行为观察的标志是：传输／截图检查、采集器健康与准确环境登记成功，目标 App 身份明确，并拿到可用的截图／AX 观察。`needs_setup`、权限缺失或观察截断需要继续处理，不能把文件校验通过当作环境就绪。之后再进入流程发现、报告和实现。

该分母不包含所有 AppKit 行为；自有样例源代码可见，也不属于盲源复刻测试。旧 `check-2`
及其六项明显菜单差异仍完整保留。Stocks 的交付验收仍未通过。
用户接管／输入中断、快照后的 App 行为和物理 Mac 复验等门槛仍开放；物理主机尝试在启动 App
前因锁屏而受阻。准确案例及状态见[实施清单](macos-implementation-plan.md)。
后续快照状态实验未通过：取快照虽生成元数据，却返回代理断连错误；编辑器随后换了进程，
未保存的测试文字丢失。环境已修复就绪，运行中 App 状态保留仍是失败门槛；进一步快照实验
应先保存需要保留的工作，使用可丢弃的测试状态。

另已完成真实客体单文件数据检查：明确选择自有样例 Bundle ID 的偏好 plist，原始文件案例、
不含值的键／类型结构和引用该结构的独立正式报告均通过验证。`/fixture.wrap` 为布尔类型，
也记录了原生面板元数据的类型。该采集晚于 UI 流程，不代表原子数据库快照、全部键的写入归属
或完整 App 数据验收；归档子案例中的原始字节仍仅保存在本地。

原生 Swift 构建保留 xcrun 返回的带版本 SDK 路径，并向构建子进程显式传递同一路径的
`SDKROOT`，把该设置写入日志。原生回归直接检查 Mach-O 中的 SDK 版本；此前缺少此环境时，
本机工具链会把 SDK 记为部署目标 14.0，样例因此出现旧式窗口装饰。历史构建案例保持原记录，
仍可验证；修复后的构建产生新案例。

验收开发可使用[自有 AppKit 样例](../examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/README.md)。它是原始测试 App，
包含原生文件对话框、编辑与统计、设置持久化和多窗口；宿主冒烟测试不等于客体采集、独立重建或对照交付。

在完整控制权限尚未就绪时，可准备**不带 `--request-accessibility`** 的采集器，
把经过校验的部署目录放入客体已有共享 inbox，核对后从客体 Finder 打开其启动器。
`mac probe-collector --vm-directory <VM> --collector-build <BUILD> --out <CASE>`
只做两次新的健康请求，校验构建、会话、实例和从该共享目录首次观察到的客体身份，并记录实际客体 OS。
它不申请或授予权限，不能替代 `mac connect`、桌面控制或行为验收。真实客体探针已观察到
macOS 27.0.1（26A434）、辅助功能权限为 false；初始化仍在第 4 步。

## 环境与采集器

在 Apple Silicon Mac 上安装 ChatComputer，完成图形界面中的客体初始化。然后运行：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac doctor --out cases/mac-transport
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-transport
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-collector --out cases/mac-collector-build
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-collector-build
.venv/bin/copyapp mac prepare-collector --build cases/mac-collector-build \
  --out cases/mac-collector-deployment --request-accessibility
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-collector-deployment
chatcomputer share add "$PWD/cases/mac-collector-deployment/payload"
```

只读共享这一份部署目录。使用 ChatComputer 返回的客体路径，在**虚拟 Mac 的 Finder**
里打开并执行 `Start Collector.command`。它检查虚拟机和共享目录，在客体用户的
`~/Applications/CopyAppTools/<hash>/` 安装精确哈希的采集器，不修改宿主系统。

`--request-accessibility` 让采集器请求客体辅助功能权限，实际授权仍由客体所有者通过
系统设置完成；它不会自动授予权限。ChatComputer 另需自身的客体录屏和控制权限。
仅编译和执行协议自检不会请求这些权限。默认使用 ad-hoc 签名；需要稳定 TCC 身份时用
`--signing-identity` 指定合适的稳定签名并保留该构建。签名变化可能需要重新授权。

更新临时签名的采集器后，要重新核对客体权限。本次 macOS 27 客体的系统开关仍指向
旧哈希目录；经已授权的单 App 权限重置，再在系统设置中添加准确的新 App 路径后，
新采集器的 AX 探针才变为 true。单 App 重置使用
[Apple 文档中的系统工具](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/resetting-access-to-protected-resources-in-macos)。
Copy APP 不会自动重置隐私权限；蓝色开关不能代替新构建的健康检查。

doctor 的 `needs_setup` 案例可以通过文件一致性校验，但表示环境尚未就绪。成功 doctor
只证明传输和截图可用，不等于 App 身份、深度分析或复刻已经就绪。

本次 ChatComputer 0.9.11 实测中，保存初始快照后 VM 状态已为 `ready`，但首次运行界面
仍显示模型配置。正常退出并重新打开 ChatComputer 后，外部 MCP 可以直接使用桌面，
无需配置其内置模型；重新打开后仍需运行 doctor 核实实际传输状态。客体账户凭据保留在
ChatComputer 自己的本机存储中，不作为 Copy APP 案例、报告或 GitHub 材料的输入。

## 登记虚拟机与观察 App

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac connect \
  --vm-directory "$HOME/.chatcomputer/ChatComputer.vm" \
  --collector-build cases/mac-collector-build --out cases/mac-environment
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-environment
.venv/bin/copyapp mac inspect --app /path/to/Example.app --out cases/mac-package
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-package
.venv/bin/copyapp mac observe --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --app-path /Applications/Example.app --bundle example.app --ax \
  --out cases/mac-ui-observation
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-ui-observation
```

非默认 ChatComputer 数据目录须显式指定。登记会固定 VM ID、机器／硬件标识哈希、测试
配置、ChatComputer 可执行文件、采集器构建、客体身份及系统版本；不会复制口令、模型
密钥或 pairing token。同时保存 MCP 初始化原始请求／响应及其自报服务身份，与安装的
App 版本分开记录。本次 App 为 0.9.11；通过 CLI 别名的 doctor 自报 MCP 版本 `0`，
登记时通过解析后的 App 可执行文件自报 `0.9.11`。后续连接比较保存的服务身份，
不从 App 版本推导它。每次连接重新检查身份；变化时新建审阅过的登记，不覆盖旧证据。

`inspect` 只采集本地 `.app` 静态包，记录完整文件清单和安全的内部符号链接，分别固定
完整可执行文件和 arm64 分片哈希，并检查 Mach-O 平台声明：接受 1（macOS）或
6（Mac Catalyst），拒绝 iOS、iOS Simulator、冲突的平台声明和
Intel-only 输入，不会把受保护系统文件标志传播到研究副本；原 App 不变。
Catalyst 索引单独记录 `macho_platform: 6` 和 `runtime: mac_catalyst`；包采集通过
不能证明界面重放或复刻通过。

`observe --ax` 要求准确的前台进程和启动时间，保存有界 AX 树、原始 MCP 截图及前后
身份。不传 `--ax` 时只采集 App 身份。截图和 AX 为先后观察，不能声称同时采集；截断
和权限缺失保持显式。报告还需要 Agent 审阅，不能从界面观察直接推断函数语义。

采集器使用独立会话、请求 ID、请求哈希和宿主排他锁。启动请求留存开始标记，断连或
恢复后不盲目重放。共享目录不会随客体快照回滚，旧结果不得作为新观察。

## 重放与审阅选定行为

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp mac acquire --environment cases/mac-environment \
  --app-path /Applications/Example.app --bundle example.app \
  --out cases/mac-acquisition
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-acquisition
.venv/bin/copyapp mac playbook --acquisition cases/mac-acquisition \
  --script cases/mac-flow.json --out cases/mac-flow
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-flow
```

`acquire` 经采集器导出有界 App 包，对比完整的客体源文件／副本／再次读取的源文件清单。
重放在流程前后重新固定包哈希，键鼠输入前要求准确前台进程的 AX／截图观察。
最小脚本结构如下，选择器和期望值必须换成目标 App 的实际观察：

```json
{
  "schema_version": 2,
  "platform": "macos",
  "scenario_id": "visible-editor",
  "bundle_id": "example.app",
  "app_path": "/Applications/Example.app",
  "steps": [
    {"action": "launch"},
    {"action": "expect_text", "selector": {"identifier": "editor"}, "text": "Expected text"}
  ]
}
```

动作包括 launch、screenshot、click、click_element、key、type、scroll、drag、quit、
expect_text、expect_file、expect_stopped 和 wait。元素必须唯一匹配；截断的 AX 树不能
用于元素选择。文本默认精确匹配，包含判断须显式加 `match: contains`。文件断言使用本轮
输出目录内的相对路径，选择 `text_equals`、`json_equals` 或 `sha256` 之一；输入文本中的
`{{output_dir}}` 会换成本轮客体输出目录。变化中的文件、符号链接及越界输出会被拒绝。
失败会保留，动作不会自动重复；新建尝试前先检查当前 App 状态。

审阅原始界面、输出证据后，按 [review JSON 契约](macos-review.md)运行 `mac report` 和
`mac rebuild-plan`。前者固定有来源的结论与功能规格，后者冻结已知能力清单、目标覆盖率
和原版／复刻版脚本，生成当前 Agent 执行的 `TASK.md`。它们不证明实现或交付完成，
也不执行深层函数分析。报告结论及能力清单的完整性仍由审阅者负责。

## 当前验收边界

两个样本各三条流程、各三轮成对行为检查及完整截图审阅已有证据；自有编辑器完成 7/9 已知能力
交付，Stocks 仅完成 81 分的选定离线原型目标，明显差异保留。单个偏好文件采集／结构报告、
同一二进制的实体 Mac 选定行为复验、真实人工接管后的输入拒绝、受控回复丢失以及用户明确授权
Agent 代点交回后的恢复均有独立证据。后者不冒称真人手动交回。

新版采集器暂停轮询后的一次取快照／保留安全快照的恢复，已通过真实客体的未保存 Unicode 文本、
换行状态和相同进程身份核对；旧失败案例保持失败。它不暂停全部客体 I/O，也不回滚宿主共享目录。
详见[恢复说明](macos-recovery.md)和实施账本。严格 Stocks 交付、更广数据和函数运行时分析仍属于后续范围，
不能由这些指定样本证据推导整 App 等价或任意 Mac 支持。

## 构建并安装独立 App

重建计划中的 App 路径应位于登记环境的 `environment.json` → `install_root` 下，且为
直接子目录。默认位置是**客体**的 `~/Applications/CopyAppRebuilds`，与原 App 分开。
旧计划若指定了其他位置，应保留旧证据并重新生成计划。

在计划固定的宿主工程目录实现源码后，选择一种构建方式：

```sh
# 已配置独立 Bundle ID 和产品名的 Xcode 工程。
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-app --plan cases/mac-rebuild-plan \
  --xcode-project IndependentEditor.xcodeproj --scheme IndependentEditor \
  --configuration Debug --out cases/mac-build

# 或直接编译带 @main 入口的 Swift 文件，使用源码中的 Info.plist。
.venv/bin/copyapp mac build-app --plan cases/mac-rebuild-plan \
  --swift-source Main.swift --info-plist Info.plist \
  --resources Resources --out cases/mac-build-swift
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-build
.venv/bin/copyapp mac install --build cases/mac-build --out cases/mac-install
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-install
```

构建参数中的路径相对于宿主工程目录；多个文件重复 `--swift-source`，没有资源目录时
不传 `--resources`。直接 Swift 构建使用 Swift 5 语言模式、`@main`、arm64 和默认 macOS
14.0 最低版本，可选 Debug／Release 优化；最低版本用 `--deployment-target` 修改。
Xcode 构建读取工程自己的最低版本和 entitlements，不会再替换其完成的签名。
默认签名为 ad-hoc（`-`），需要时用 `--signing-identity` 指定稳定签名身份。

构建案例保存计划、源码副本、编译器／签名工具身份、SDK 元数据、完整有界日志和带签名
App 索引。从保存的副本编译，拒绝输入文件变化；Xcode 新建的空 workspace 元数据目录
单独记录。只在工程顶层排除 `.git`、`.build`、`DerivedData`、`__pycache__` 和 `.DS_Store`。
构建案例须放在源码目录之外。这证明本机构建及来源关系，不等于公证、安装或行为验收。

安装使用构建来源中的准确登记环境，在新 inbox 会话暂存已验证的包，检查客体副本的签名
和文件清单，再以禁止覆盖的原子操作创建目标目录；不会启动 App。已有文件、目录或符号
链接都不能被替换。安装开始标记阻止中断后盲目重放，失败和原始回复会保留。结果未知时
先观察客体和证据，不要直接重装。成功后仍需重新采集复刻版、成对重放和视觉审阅。

## 成对复验与选定行为交付

按[成对复验与交付契约](macos-checks.md)继续：

1. `mac check-plan` 在新一轮运行前固定实际界面设置、起始窗口和截图遮罩。
2. `mac rebuild-check` 重新采集已安装的复刻版，按冻结脚本依次运行每轮原版／复刻版，
   检查语言、外观、显示设置、窗口位置和起始文本断言。失败不自动重放。
3. 阅读生成的 `VISUAL_REVIEW.md`，打开每对完整、未遮罩截图，填写模板后运行
   `mac visual-review`，逐项记录差异和起始状态是否可比。
4. 对冻结清单中的每项已知能力给出明确决定，用 `mac delivery` 绑定源代码、构建、安装、
   成对检查和审阅结果。

交付要求目标能力均经确认、全部选定行为断言通过、完整视觉审阅、图像尺寸一致、起始
状态等价且没有重大视觉差异；小差异仍保留。目标覆盖率、已验证的已知能力覆盖率和选定
流程通过率分别报告。网络和重置策略的文字声明不会被当成已验证的隔离或数据重置。
这些命令检查来源和门槛，不认证主观判断、整 App 等价或实体 Mac 行为。

# Direct Hopper integration

[English](rea-hopper-integration.md) · [简体中文](rea-hopper-integration.zh-CN.md) · [Architecture](architecture.md)

Copy APP calls a locally installed Hopper application directly; **REA is not required at runtime**. The old `rea-function`, `rea-queue` and `rea-bridge` entry points were removed. A Hopper license and a normal logged-in macOS GUI session are required for new Hopper analysis.

## Evidence path

1. Acquire or recover the target Mach-O and pin its original SHA-256. Select and separately hash the ARM64 slice of a fat binary. Reject an encrypted binary until an analysis copy is recovered.
2. `hopper-function` launches Hopper with a bounded Python script that resolves one requested function entry and asks its `Document`/`Procedure` APIs for pseudocode.
3. Save the launcher script and log, source identity, selected address, result and hashes. The verifier checks the original bytes, slice and address binding.
4. `hopper-queue` selects a limited set of addresses from a verified candidate case. `--provider hopper-direct` passes those results through investigation, report and agent handoff; the parent `copy` command uses `--analysis-provider hopper-direct`.

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <ORIGINAL_SHA256> --address 0xADDRESS --out cases/<FUNCTION>
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-queue --candidates cases/<CANDIDATES> \
  --limit 4 --out cases/<QUEUE>
.venv/bin/copyapp investigate-flow --udid <UDID> \
  --analysis cases/<ANALYSIS> --script playbooks/<FLOW>.json \
  --provider hopper-direct --out cases/<INVESTIGATION>
```

Use `--hopper-app '/Applications/Hopper Disassembler.app'` or `HOPPER_APP` when automatic discovery fails. A constrained shell may report `Cannot launch Hopper!` even when a normal GUI session succeeds. The direct function/queue target has a 600-second default timeout; inspect the saved failure log instead of treating partial pseudocode as complete.

Pseudocode is an analysis result, not original source or proof that a UI action executed that function. Pair it with hash-bound static candidates and, where useful, a separately verified Frida trace. Direct Ghidra remains available for bounded caller/callee and instruction facts, including selected indirect-call investigation. The Hopper adapter design was informed by MIT-licensed REA code; its license is retained at [REA-LICENSE.txt](third-party/REA-LICENSE.txt). Copy APP's script, queue and verifier are maintained here.

```

# Hopper 直连

[English](rea-hopper-integration.md) · 简体中文 · [架构](architecture.zh-CN.md)

Copy APP 直接调用本机安装的 Hopper，**运行时不依赖 REA**。旧的 `rea-function`、`rea-queue` 和 `rea-bridge` 入口已删除。新的 Hopper 分析需要 Hopper 许可与正常登录的 macOS 图形会话。

## 证据路径

1. 采集或恢复目标 Mach-O，固定原始 SHA-256；胖二进制另行选择 ARM64 切片并记录其哈希。二进制仍加密时先恢复分析副本。
2. `hopper-function` 用有界 Python 脚本启动 Hopper，通过 `Document`／`Procedure` API 解析指定函数入口并请求伪代码。
3. 保存启动脚本及日志、来源身份、地址、结果和哈希；校验器核对原始字节、切片和地址绑定。
4. `hopper-queue` 从已校验候选案例选取有限地址。`--provider hopper-direct` 将结果交给调查、报告与 Agent 任务；父级 `copy` 命令使用 `--analysis-provider hopper-direct`。

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <ORIGINAL_SHA256> --address 0xADDRESS --out cases/<FUNCTION>
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-queue --candidates cases/<CANDIDATES> \
  --limit 4 --out cases/<QUEUE>
.venv/bin/copyapp investigate-flow --udid <UDID> \
  --analysis cases/<ANALYSIS> --script playbooks/<FLOW>.json \
  --provider hopper-direct --out cases/<INVESTIGATION>
```

自动定位失败时可传 `--hopper-app '/Applications/Hopper Disassembler.app'` 或设置 `HOPPER_APP`。受限 shell 可能报 `Cannot launch Hopper!`，而正常图形会话能够运行。直连函数／队列目标默认限时 600 秒；失败时查看保存的日志，不能把部分伪代码当成完成结果。

伪代码是分析结果，不是原作者源码，也不证明某次 UI 操作执行了该函数。应与哈希绑定的静态候选结合，必要时另行校验 Frida 跟踪。直连 Ghidra 仍可提供有界调用者、被调用者和指令资料，以及选定间接调用调查。Hopper 适配设计参考了 MIT 许可的 REA 代码，许可证保存在 [REA-LICENSE.txt](third-party/REA-LICENSE.txt)；脚本、队列与校验器由本仓库维护。

```md
# REA independence

[English](rea-independence.md) · [简体中文](rea-independence.zh-CN.md) · [Architecture](architecture.md)

The supported Copy APP analysis and rebuild workflow runs without an REA process, package or MCP service. Its default native path indexes Mach-O metadata and bounded assembly; optional direct Ghidra and [direct Hopper](rea-hopper-integration.md) supply hash-bound pseudocode. Runtime tracing is provided by Frida. The old REA bridge entry points are no longer part of the CLI.

`--provider none` can collect UI, static indexes and runtime observations, but it does not generate new pseudocode. Select `ghidra-direct` or `hopper-direct` when function-level pseudocode is needed, then import verified evidence into `copyapp report`. A decompiler output still needs a human or coding agent to interpret the function, link it to an observed flow and state uncertainty.

The direct Hopper design was informed by MIT-licensed REA code and retains its [license](third-party/REA-LICENSE.txt). That attribution does not add REA as a runtime dependency. The remaining external prerequisites are the device-side services and whichever Mac toolchain is selected for a task. See [setup](setup.md) and [current status](current-status.md).

```

# 不依赖 REA 的运行路径

[English](rea-independence.md) · 简体中文 · [架构](architecture.zh-CN.md)

Copy APP 的正式分析到复刻流程不需要 REA 进程、软件包或 MCP 服务。默认原生分析会索引 Mach-O 元数据及有界汇编；可选的直连 Ghidra 与[直连 Hopper](rea-hopper-integration.zh-CN.md)提供与二进制哈希绑定的伪代码。Frida 负责运行时跟踪。旧 REA 桥接命令已不再属于 CLI。

Hopper 直连设计参考了 MIT 许可的 REA 代码并保留[许可证](third-party/REA-LICENSE.txt)，这不使 REA 成为运行依赖。其他外部前提取决于任务所选手机服务和 Mac 工具链。见[安装指南](setup.zh-CN.md)及[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · العربية · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

يجمع Copy APP أدلة عن حزمة التطبيق وواجهته وبياناته داخل بيئة العزل وسلوكه أثناء التشغيل على iPhone مكسور الحماية. وينشئ تقرير تحليل مرتبطًا بمصادره، ثم يساعد على بناء تطبيق iOS مستقل يعيد تنفيذ وظائف محددة ومقارنتها على الجهاز الحقيقي.

## كيف يعمل

يدير وكيل برمجي أداة Copy APP CLI على Mac. وتجمع OpenSSH وFrida وiOS MCP، أو iCTRL الاختياري، الأدلة من هاتف iPhone المحدد. ويمكن استخدام Ghidra أو Hopper على Mac لتحليل الشيفرة الأصلية. يوجّه التقرير المراجع وملف `feature-spec.json` تنفيذ التطبيق الجديد؛ ثم تُعاد خطوات الاختبار على التطبيق الأصلي والجديد في الهاتف نفسه وتُراجع لقطات الشاشة. يتوفر [مخطط البنية ودليل التثبيت الكامل](../README.md) بالإنجليزية.

## البدء السريع

ثبّت Python 3.9 أو أحدث على Mac، وصِل iPhone مكسور الحماية عبر USB ووافق على الثقة، ثم شغّل:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

ابدأ [بالفحص الأولي عبر USB](../setup.md). يحتاج التحليل المتعمق أيضًا إلى SSH وFrida وخدمة للتحكم بالواجهة على الهاتف.

## المبادئ والمساهمة

احفظ الأدلة قبل تفسيرها، واذكر ما لا يزال مجهولًا بوضوح. نجاح خطوات محددة لا يثبت تكافؤ التطبيق كاملًا. نرحب بالأخطاء القابلة لإعادة الإنتاج والاختبارات ونصوص الواجهة والترجمات. لا ترفع ملفات IPA أو بيانات الاعتماد أو بيانات العزل الخام إلى Git. راجع [دليل المساهمة](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

تم التحقق من iPhone XR بنظام iOS 16.1.1، وiPhone 14 بنظام iOS 17.3.1، ومسارات محددة لتطبيقَي Calculator وClock على iPhone 11 بنظام iOS 26.0.1. راجع [نطاق الدعم](../../README.md). لغة التوثيق لا تغيّر لغة أداة CLI أو التقارير.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · Deutsch · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP sammelt Paket-, UI-, Sandbox- und Laufzeitbelege einer installierten App auf einem iPhone mit Jailbreak. Daraus entsteht ein Analysebericht mit Quellenverweisen. Anschließend hilft das Projekt, ausgewählte Funktionen in einer unabhängigen, lauffähigen iOS-App umzusetzen und auf dem echten Gerät zu vergleichen.

## Funktionsweise

Ein Coding Agent steuert die Copy APP CLI auf dem Mac. OpenSSH, Frida sowie iOS MCP oder optional iCTRL erfassen Belege vom genau ausgewählten iPhone. Bei Bedarf untersuchen Ghidra oder Hopper den nativen Code auf dem Mac. Der geprüfte Bericht und `feature-spec.json` leiten die neue Implementierung an. Original und Nachbau werden auf demselben Telefon mit denselben Abläufen und Bildschirmfotos verglichen. [Architekturdiagramm und vollständige Installation](../README.md) stehen im englischen Handbuch.

## Schnellstart

Python 3.9+ auf dem Mac installieren, das iPhone mit Jailbreak per USB verbinden und ihm vertrauen. Dann:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Zuerst die [erste USB-Bestandsaufnahme](../setup.md) durchführen. Für tiefere Analysen werden zusätzlich SSH, Frida und ein UI-Dienst auf dem Telefon benötigt.

## Grundsätze und Mitarbeit

Erst Belege sichern, dann erklären; Unbekanntes ausdrücklich kennzeichnen. Ein bestandener Test ausgewählter Abläufe bedeutet keine vollständige Gleichwertigkeit der Apps. Reproduzierbare Fehler, Tests, UI-Skripte und Übersetzungen sind willkommen. Keine IPAs, Zugangsdaten oder rohen Sandbox-Daten einchecken. Siehe [Beitragsleitfaden](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Geprüft wurden ausgewählte Abläufe auf dem iPhone XR mit iOS 16.1.1 und dem iPhone 14 mit iOS 17.3.1 sowie Calculator und Clock auf dem iPhone 11 mit iOS 26.0.1. Einzelheiten stehen im [Testumfang](../../README.md). Die Dokumentationssprache ändert weder CLI noch Berichtssprache.

Το Copy APP συλλέγει τεκμήρια για το πακέτο, το περιβάλλον χρήστη, το sandbox και τη συμπεριφορά κατά την εκτέλεση μιας εφαρμογής εγκατεστημένης σε iPhone με jailbreak. ## Πώς λειτουργεί

Ένας agent προγραμματισμού χειρίζεται το Copy APP CLI στο Mac. Τα OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP ή το προαιρετικό iCTRL συλλέγουν τεκμήρια από το συγκεκριμένο iPhone. Αν χρειάζεται, τα Ghidra ή Hopper αναλύουν τον εγγενή κώδικα στο Mac. Η ελεγμένη αναφορά και το `feature-spec.json` καθοδηγούν τη νέα υλοποίηση· τα ίδια σενάρια εκτελούνται στην αρχική και στη νέα εφαρμογή, ενώ εξετάζονται και τα στιγμιότυπα οθόνης. Το [διάγραμμα αρχιτεκτονικής και ο πλήρης οδηγός εγκατάστασης](../README.md) είναι στα αγγλικά.

## Γρήγορη εκκίνηση

Εγκαταστήστε Python 3.9+ στο Mac, συνδέστε μέσω USB ένα iPhone με jailbreak, επιβεβαιώστε την εμπιστοσύνη και εκτελέστε:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Ξεκινήστε με την [αρχική εξέταση μέσω USB](../setup.md). Για βαθύτερη ανάλυση χρειάζονται επίσης SSH, Frida και υπηρεσία χειρισμού διεπαφής στο τηλέφωνο.

## Αρχές και συνεισφορά

Καταγράφετε πρώτα τα τεκμήρια και μετά τα ερμηνεύετε, δηλώνοντας ρητά τα άγνωστα. Η επιτυχία επιλεγμένων σεναρίων δεν αποδεικνύει πλήρη ισοδυναμία εφαρμογών. Δεκτές είναι οι αναπαραγώγιμες αναφορές σφαλμάτων, οι δοκιμές, τα σενάρια UI και οι μεταφράσεις. Μην υποβάλλετε IPA, διαπιστευτήρια ή ακατέργαστα δεδομένα sandbox στο Git. Δείτε τον [οδηγό συνεισφοράς](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Έχουν επαληθευτεί επιλεγμένες ροές στο iPhone XR με iOS 16.1.1, στο iPhone 14 με iOS 17.3.1 και για τα Calculator και Clock στο iPhone 11 με iOS 26.0.1. Δείτε το [εύρος υποστήριξης](../../README.md). Η γλώσσα της τεκμηρίωσης δεν αλλάζει τη γλώσσα του CLI ή των αναφορών.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · Español · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP recopila pruebas del paquete, la interfaz, el sandbox y el comportamiento en ejecución de una aplicación instalada en un iPhone con jailbreak. Produce un informe de análisis con referencias a las fuentes y ayuda a crear una aplicación iOS independiente que reproduzca funciones seleccionadas para compararlas en el dispositivo real.

## Cómo funciona

Un agente de programación controla la CLI de Copy APP en el Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP o el iCTRL opcional obtienen pruebas del iPhone elegido. Cuando hace falta, Ghidra o Hopper analizan el código nativo en el Mac. El informe revisado y `feature-spec.json` guían la nueva aplicación; después se repiten los mismos flujos en la original y la nueva, y se revisan las capturas. El [diagrama de arquitectura y la instalación detallada](../README.md) están en inglés.

## Inicio rápido

Instala Python 3.9+ en el Mac, conecta por USB un iPhone con jailbreak y acepta la confianza. Después ejecuta:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Completa primero la [inspección inicial por USB](../setup.md). El análisis profundo también necesita SSH, Frida y un servicio de interfaz en el teléfono.

## Principios y contribuciones

Primero se conserva la evidencia; después se interpreta, indicando lo que sigue siendo desconocido. Verificar unos flujos no demuestra equivalencia completa. Se agradecen errores reproducibles, pruebas, guiones de UI y traducciones. No incluyas IPA, credenciales ni datos sin procesar del sandbox en Git. Consulta la [guía de contribución](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Se han verificado flujos seleccionados en el iPhone XR con iOS 16.1.1 y el iPhone 14 con iOS 17.3.1, además de Calculator y Clock en el iPhone 11 con iOS 26.0.1. Consulte el [alcance de compatibilidad](../../README.md). El idioma de la documentación no cambia el idioma de la CLI ni de los informes.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · فارسی · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP شواهد مربوط به بستهٔ برنامه، رابط کاربری، محیط ایزوله و رفتار زمان اجرا را از برنامه‌ای نصب‌شده روی آیفون جیلبریک‌شده جمع‌آوری می‌کند. سپس گزارشی تحلیلی با ارجاع به منابع می‌سازد و برای پیاده‌سازی مستقل قابلیت‌های منتخب در یک برنامهٔ قابل اجرای iOS و مقایسهٔ آن روی دستگاه واقعی کمک می‌کند.

## سازوکار

یک عامل کدنویسی Copy APP CLI را روی مک اجرا می‌کند. OpenSSH، Frida، iOS MCP یا iCTRL اختیاری، شواهد را از آیفون مشخص‌شده می‌گیرند. در صورت نیاز، Ghidra یا Hopper کد بومی را روی مک بررسی می‌کنند. گزارش بازبینی‌شده و `feature-spec.json` پیاده‌سازی جدید را هدایت می‌کنند؛ سپس جریان‌های برنامهٔ اصلی و نسخهٔ جدید روی همان گوشی تکرار و تصویرها بررسی می‌شوند. [نمودار معماری و راهنمای کامل نصب](../README.md) به انگلیسی در دسترس است.

## شروع سریع

Python 3.9 یا جدیدتر را روی مک نصب کنید، آیفون جیلبریک‌شده را با USB وصل کنید و اعتماد به رایانه را تأیید کنید؛ سپس اجرا کنید:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

ابتدا [بررسی اولیهٔ USB](../setup.md) را انجام دهید. تحلیل عمیق به SSH، Frida و سرویس رابط کاربری روی گوشی نیز نیاز دارد.

## اصول و مشارکت

پیش از تفسیر، شواهد را ثبت کنید و موارد نامعلوم را روشن بگویید. تأیید چند جریان منتخب به معنای برابری کامل برنامه‌ها نیست. گزارش خطای بازتولیدپذیر، آزمون، اسکریپت رابط کاربری و ترجمه پذیرفته می‌شود. فایل IPA، اطلاعات ورود یا دادهٔ خام محیط ایزوله را در Git قرار ندهید. [راهنمای مشارکت](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) را ببینید.

جریان‌های منتخب روی iPhone XR با iOS 16.1.1 و iPhone 14 با iOS 17.3.1 و همچنین Calculator و Clock روی iPhone 11 با iOS 26.0.1 آزمایش شده‌اند. برای جزئیات، [محدودهٔ پشتیبانی](../../README.md) را ببینید. زبان مستندات، زبان CLI یا گزارش‌ها را تغییر نمی‌دهد.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · Français · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP recueille des preuves sur le paquet, l'interface, le bac à sable et le comportement d'une application installée sur un iPhone jailbreaké. Il produit un rapport d'analyse relié à ses sources, puis aide à créer une application iOS indépendante qui reproduit des fonctions choisies et les compare sur l'appareil réel.

## Fonctionnement

Un agent de codage pilote la CLI Copy APP sur Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP ou iCTRL en option recueillent des preuves sur l'iPhone sélectionné. Ghidra ou Hopper peuvent analyser le code natif sur Mac. Le rapport relu et `feature-spec.json` guident la nouvelle application ; les mêmes parcours sont ensuite rejoués dans l'original et la reconstruction, avec examen des captures d'écran. Le [schéma d'architecture et le guide d'installation détaillé](../README.md) sont en anglais.

## Démarrage rapide

Installez Python 3.9+ sur Mac, branchez un iPhone jailbreaké en USB et confirmez la confiance, puis lancez :

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Commencez par le [premier relevé USB](../setup.md). Une analyse approfondie nécessite aussi SSH, Frida et un service d'interface sur le téléphone.

## Principes et contributions

Conserver les preuves avant de les interpréter et signaler les inconnues. La validation de parcours choisis ne démontre pas une équivalence complète. Les bogues reproductibles, tests, scripts UI et traductions sont bienvenus. Ne commitez ni IPA, ni identifiants, ni données brutes du bac à sable. Voir le [guide de contribution](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Des parcours choisis ont été vérifiés sur l'iPhone XR sous iOS 16.1.1 et l'iPhone 14 sous iOS 17.3.1, ainsi que pour Calculator et Clock sur l'iPhone 11 sous iOS 26.0.1. Voir le [périmètre de prise en charge](../../README.md). La langue de la documentation ne modifie pas celle de la CLI ou des rapports.

# Copy APP

Copy APP mengumpulkan bukti paket aplikasi, antarmuka, sandbox, dan perilaku saat berjalan dari aplikasi yang terpasang pada iPhone jailbreak. Proyek ini menghasilkan laporan analisis dengan rujukan sumber dan membantu membangun aplikasi iOS mandiri yang meniru fungsi terpilih untuk dibandingkan pada perangkat asli.

## Cara kerja

Coding Agent menjalankan Copy APP CLI di Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP, atau iCTRL opsional mengumpulkan bukti dari iPhone yang dipilih secara tepat. Jika diperlukan, Ghidra atau Hopper menganalisis kode native di Mac. Laporan yang ditinjau dan `feature-spec.json` memandu implementasi baru; alur yang sama dijalankan pada aplikasi asli dan aplikasi baru, lalu tangkapan layar diperiksa. [Diagram arsitektur dan panduan instalasi lengkap](../README.md) tersedia dalam bahasa Inggris.

## Mulai cepat

Pasang Python 3.9+ di Mac, sambungkan iPhone jailbreak melalui USB, terima permintaan kepercayaan, lalu jalankan:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Mulailah dengan [survei USB pertama](../setup.md). Analisis mendalam juga memerlukan SSH, Frida, dan layanan antarmuka di ponsel.

## Prinsip dan kontribusi

Simpan bukti sebelum menafsirkannya dan jelaskan hal yang belum diketahui. Keberhasilan beberapa alur terpilih tidak membuktikan kesetaraan seluruh aplikasi. Laporan bug yang dapat diulang, pengujian, skrip UI, dan terjemahan sangat diterima. Jangan memasukkan IPA, kredensial, atau data sandbox mentah ke Git. Lihat [panduan kontribusi](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Alur terpilih telah diverifikasi pada iPhone XR dengan iOS 16.1.1 dan iPhone 14 dengan iOS 17.3.1, serta untuk Calculator dan Clock pada iPhone 11 dengan iOS 26.0.1. Lihat [cakupan dukungan](../../README.md). Bahasa dokumentasi tidak mengubah bahasa CLI atau laporan.

Copy APP raccoglie prove relative al pacchetto, all'interfaccia, alla sandbox e al comportamento di un'app installata su un iPhone con jailbreak. ```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Completa prima la [prima ricognizione USB](../setup.md). L'analisi approfondita richiede anche SSH, Frida e un servizio per l'interfaccia sul telefono.

## Principi e contributi

Conserva le prove prima di interpretarle e indica chiaramente ciò che resta ignoto. La verifica dei percorsi scelti non dimostra l'equivalenza completa delle app. Sono benvenuti bug riproducibili, test, script UI e traduzioni. Non inviare IPA, credenziali o dati grezzi della sandbox a Git. Consulta la [guida ai contributi](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Sono stati verificati flussi selezionati sull'iPhone XR con iOS 16.1.1 e sull'iPhone 14 con iOS 17.3.1, oltre a Calculator e Clock sull'iPhone 11 con iOS 26.0.1. Consulta l'[ambito del supporto](../../README.md). La lingua della documentazione non cambia quella della CLI o dei rapporti.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · 日本語 · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP は、脱獄済み iPhone にインストールされたアプリのパッケージ、UI、サンドボックス、実行時の証拠を収集します。根拠を示す分析レポートを作成し、選んだ機能を再現する独立した iOS アプリの開発と実機比較を支援します。

## 仕組み

Coding Agent が Mac 上の Copy APP CLI を操作します。指定した端末から OpenSSH、Frida、iOS MCP または任意の iCTRL を使って証拠を取得し、必要に応じて Mac の Ghidra または Hopper でネイティブコードを調べます。レビュー済みレポートと `feature-spec.json` を基に別のアプリを作り、同じ iPhone で元アプリとの操作結果とスクリーンショットを比較します。[構成図と詳細なセットアップ](../README.md)は英語版を参照してください。

## クイックスタート

Mac に Python 3.9 以降を用意し、脱獄済み iPhone を USB 接続して信頼した後、実行します。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

まず[USB 調査の手順](../setup.md)を完了してください。詳しい分析には端末側の SSH、Frida、UI サービスが必要です。

## 方針と貢献

説明より先に証拠を残し、不明な点を明記します。選んだ操作の検証はアプリ全体の同等性を意味しません。再現手順のある不具合、テスト、UI スクリプト、翻訳を歓迎します。IPA、認証情報、端末の生データはコミットしないでください。[貢献ガイド](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)を参照してください。

選定した解析・再実装フローは iOS 16.1.1 の iPhone XR と iOS 17.3.1 の iPhone 14 で検証済みです。iOS 26.0.1 の iPhone 11 では Calculator と Clock の選定フローも検証しました。詳細は[対応範囲](../../README.md)をご覧ください。文書の言語は CLI や生成レポートの言語を変更しません。

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · 한국어 · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP은 탈옥한 iPhone에 설치된 앱의 패키지, UI, 샌드박스 및 실행 중 동작의 증거를 수집합니다. 출처가 연결된 분석 보고서를 만들고, 선택한 기능을 독립적인 iOS 앱으로 구현해 실제 기기에서 비교하도록 돕습니다.

## 작동 방식

Coding Agent가 Mac의 Copy APP CLI를 실행합니다. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP 또는 선택 사항인 iCTRL을 통해 지정한 iPhone에서 증거를 모읍니다. 필요할 때 Mac의 Ghidra나 Hopper로 네이티브 코드를 분석합니다. 검토된 보고서와 `feature-spec.json`을 바탕으로 새 앱을 만든 뒤, 같은 iPhone에서 원본과 새 앱의 동작 및 스크린샷을 비교합니다. [아키텍처 그림과 전체 설치 안내](../README.md)는 영어 문서를 참조하세요.

## 빠른 시작

Mac에 Python 3.9 이상을 준비하고 탈옥한 iPhone을 USB로 연결하여 신뢰한 다음 실행하세요.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

먼저 [USB 조사 절차](../setup.md)를 완료하세요. 심층 분석에는 기기의 SSH, Frida 및 UI 서비스가 추가로 필요합니다.

## 원칙과 기여

해석 전에 증거를 남기고 모르는 부분을 명시합니다. 선택한 흐름의 검증이 앱 전체의 동등성을 뜻하지는 않습니다. 재현 가능한 버그, 테스트, UI 스크립트, 번역 기여를 환영합니다. IPA, 자격 증명, 기기의 원본 데이터를 커밋하지 마세요. [기여 안내](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)를 읽어 주세요.

현재 iOS 16.1.1의 iPhone XR과 iOS 17.3.1의 iPhone 14에서 선택한 분석 및 복제 흐름을 검증했습니다. iOS 26.0.1의 iPhone 11에서도 Calculator와 Clock의 선택한 흐름을 검증했습니다. 자세한 범위는 [지원 현황](../../README.md)을 참조하세요. 문서 언어는 CLI나 보고서의 언어를 바꾸지 않습니다.

Copy APP zbiera dowody dotyczące pakietu, interfejsu, piaskownicy i działania zainstalowanej aplikacji na iPhonie z jailbreakiem. Tworzy raport analityczny z odnośnikami do źródeł i pomaga zbudować niezależną aplikację iOS odtwarzającą wybrane funkcje, które następnie można porównać na prawdziwym urządzeniu.

## Jak to działa

Agent programistyczny steruje Copy APP CLI na Macu. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP lub opcjonalny iCTRL zbierają dowody z dokładnie wskazanego iPhone'a. W razie potrzeby Ghidra lub Hopper analizują kod natywny na Macu. Sprawdzony raport i `feature-spec.json` prowadzą nową implementację; te same scenariusze są odtwarzane w oryginale i nowej aplikacji, a zrzuty ekranu porównywane. [Schemat architektury i pełna instalacja](../README.md) są dostępne po angielsku.

## Szybki start

Zainstaluj Python 3.9+ na Macu, podłącz iPhone'a z jailbreakiem przez USB i potwierdź zaufanie, a następnie uruchom:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Najpierw wykonaj [pierwszą inspekcję USB](../setup.md). Głębsza analiza wymaga ponadto SSH, Fridy i usługi interfejsu na telefonie.

## Zasady i współpraca

Najpierw zapisuj dowody, potem je interpretuj, wyraźnie oznaczając niewiadome. Sprawdzenie wybranych scenariuszy nie oznacza pełnej równoważności aplikacji. Mile widziane są odtwarzalne błędy, testy, skrypty UI i tłumaczenia. Nie dodawaj do Git plików IPA, danych logowania ani surowych danych piaskownicy. Zobacz [przewodnik współtworzenia](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Zweryfikowano wybrane przebiegi na iPhonie XR z iOS 16.1.1 i iPhonie 14 z iOS 17.3.1 oraz aplikacje Calculator i Clock na iPhonie 11 z iOS 26.0.1. Szczegóły opisuje [zakres wsparcia](../../README.md). Język dokumentacji nie zmienia języka CLI ani raportów.

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · Português (Brasil) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

O Copy APP coleta evidências do pacote, da interface, do sandbox e do comportamento em execução de um app instalado em um iPhone com jailbreak. Ele produz um relatório de análise com referências às fontes e ajuda a criar um app iOS independente que reproduz funções selecionadas para comparação no dispositivo real.

## Como funciona

Um agente de programação controla a CLI do Copy APP no Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP ou o iCTRL opcional coletam evidências do iPhone selecionado. Quando necessário, Ghidra ou Hopper analisam código nativo no Mac. O relatório revisado e `feature-spec.json` orientam a nova implementação; os mesmos fluxos são executados no app original e no novo, e as capturas de tela são examinadas. O [diagrama de arquitetura e a instalação completa](../README.md) estão em inglês.

## Início rápido

Instale Python 3.9+ no Mac, conecte um iPhone com jailbreak por USB, confirme a confiança e execute:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Comece pela [primeira inspeção via USB](../setup.md). A análise aprofundada também precisa de SSH, Frida e um serviço de interface no telefone.

## Princípios e contribuição

Registre as evidências antes de interpretá-las e deixe as incertezas explícitas. Validar fluxos escolhidos não comprova equivalência completa entre apps. Aceitamos relatos reproduzíveis, testes, scripts de UI e traduções. Não envie IPAs, credenciais ou dados brutos do sandbox para o Git. Veja o [guia de contribuição](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Fluxos selecionados foram validados no iPhone XR com iOS 16.1.1 e no iPhone 14 com iOS 17.3.1, além de Calculator e Clock no iPhone 11 com iOS 26.0.1. Consulte o [escopo de compatibilidade](../../README.md). O idioma da documentação não muda o idioma da CLI nem dos relatórios.

```

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · Русский · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP собирает сведения о пакете, интерфейсе, песочнице и поведении установленного приложения на iPhone с джейлбрейком. На их основе создаётся аналитический отчёт со ссылками на источники, а выбранные функции реализуются в отдельном работающем iOS-приложении и сравниваются на настоящем устройстве.

## Как это работает

Кодовый агент управляет Copy APP CLI на Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP или необязательный iCTRL собирают данные с указанного iPhone. При необходимости Ghidra или Hopper анализируют нативный код на Mac. Проверенный отчёт и `feature-spec.json` направляют реализацию; сценарии исходного и нового приложения запускаются на одном телефоне, а снимки экрана сравниваются. [Схема архитектуры и подробная установка](../README.md) доступны на английском.

## Быстрый старт

Установите Python 3.9+ на Mac, подключите iPhone с джейлбрейком по USB, подтвердите доверие и выполните:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Сначала пройдите [первичное USB-обследование](../setup.md). Для глубокого анализа нужны SSH, Frida и сервис управления интерфейсом на телефоне.

## Принципы и участие

Сначала сохраняйте доказательства, затем делайте выводы; неизвестное обозначайте явно. Проверка выбранных сценариев не доказывает полную эквивалентность приложения. Приветствуются воспроизводимые ошибки, тесты, UI-сценарии и переводы. Не отправляйте IPA, учётные данные и исходные данные песочницы. См. [руководство для участников](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Проверены выбранные сценарии на iPhone XR с iOS 16.1.1 и iPhone 14 с iOS 17.3.1, а также Calculator и Clock на iPhone 11 с iOS 26.0.1. Подробности см. в [области поддержки](../../README.md). Язык документации не меняет язык CLI или отчётов.

## Nasıl çalışır?

Bir kodlama ajanı Mac'teki Copy APP CLI'yi yönetir. OpenSSH, Frida ve iOS MCP ya da isteğe bağlı iCTRL, belirtilen iPhone'dan kanıt toplar. Gerekirse Ghidra veya Hopper Mac'te yerel kodu inceler. Mac'te Python 3.9+ kurun, jailbreak uygulanmış iPhone'u USB ile bağlayıp güvenin ve çalıştırın:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Önce [USB ile ilk incelemeyi](../setup.md) tamamlayın. Derin analiz için telefonda SSH, Frida ve arayüz servisi gerekir.

## İlkeler ve katkı

Önce kanıtı kaydedin, sonra açıklayın; bilinmeyenleri açıkça belirtin. Seçilen akışların doğrulanması uygulamanın tümüyle eşdeğer olduğu anlamına gelmez. Tekrarlanabilir hata raporları, testler, UI betikleri ve çeviriler memnuniyetle karşılanır. IPA, kimlik bilgileri veya ham telefon verilerini göndermeyin. [Katkı kılavuzuna](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) bakın.

iOS 16.1.1 yüklü iPhone XR ve iOS 17.3.1 yüklü iPhone 14 üzerindeki seçili akışlar ile iOS 26.0.1 yüklü iPhone 11'deki Calculator ve Clock akışları doğrulandı. Ayrıntılar için [destek kapsamına](../../README.md) bakın. Belge dili CLI veya rapor dilini değiştirmez.

Copy APP збирає докази про пакет, інтерфейс, пісочницю та поведінку встановленого застосунку на iPhone із джейлбрейком. Проєкт створює аналітичний звіт із посиланнями на джерела й допомагає реалізувати вибрані функції в незалежному робочому iOS-застосунку та порівняти їх на реальному пристрої.

## Як це працює

Агент програмування керує Copy APP CLI на Mac. OpenSSH, Frida, iOS MCP або необов'язковий iCTRL збирають дані саме з вибраного iPhone. За потреби Ghidra чи Hopper аналізують нативний код на Mac. .venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

Спочатку пройдіть [первинне USB-обстеження](../setup.md). Для глибокого аналізу додатково потрібні SSH, Frida та служба інтерфейсу на телефоні.

## Принципи й участь

Спершу зберігайте докази, потім робіть висновки; невідоме позначайте явно. Перевірка вибраних сценаріїв не доводить повної еквівалентності застосунків. Вітаємо відтворювані звіти про помилки, тести, UI-сценарії та переклади. Не додавайте до Git IPA, облікові дані чи сирі дані пісочниці. Див. [посібник для учасників](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Copy APP

[English](../../README.md) · [简体中文](../../README.zh-CN.md) · 繁體中文 · [日本語](README_ja.md) · [한국어](README_ko.md) · [Türkçe](README_tr.md) · [Русский](README_ru.md) · [Tiếng Việt](README_vi.md) · [ไทย](README_th.md) · [Deutsch](README_de.md) · [Español](README_es.md) · [Français](README_fr.md) · [Українська](README_uk.md) · [Polski](README_pl.md) · [Português (Brasil)](README_pt-BR.md) · [العربية](README_ar.md) · [فارسی](README_fa.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](README_id.md) · [Italiano](README_it.md) · [Ελληνικά](README_el.md)

Copy APP 在越獄 iPhone 上蒐集已安裝 App 的套件、介面、沙盒及執行時證據，產生附有來源的分析報告，並協助建立獨立、可執行的 iOS App 來重現選定功能。

## 運作方式

Coding Agent 驅動 Mac 上的 Copy APP CLI；OpenSSH、Frida，以及 iOS MCP 或可選的 iCTRL 從指定手機取得證據。Mac 可選用 Ghidra 或 Hopper 分析原生程式碼。經審閱的報告與 `feature-spec.json` 交給復刻階段；新 App 安裝到同一台手機後，逐條重放原版與復刻版流程並審閱截圖。完整[架構圖與安裝指南](../README.md)以英文提供。

## 快速開始

在 Mac 安裝 Python 3.9+、連接並信任越獄 iPhone，然後執行：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
```

先依照[完整安裝步驟](../setup.md)完成 USB 初步調查；深入分析才需要手機端 SSH、Frida 與介面服務。

## 理念與貢獻

先保存證據，再解釋功能；明確指出未知部分。驗證選定流程不代表整個 App 等價。歡迎提交可重現的問題、測試、介面腳本和翻譯；請勿提交原始 IPA、憑證或手機沙盒資料。請參閱[貢獻指南](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)。

目前已驗證 iPhone XR / iOS 16.1.1、iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 的選定分析與復刻流程，以及 iPhone 11 / iOS 26.0.1 的 Calculator 和 Clock 選定流程。詳細範圍見[英文相容性表](../../README.md)。文件語言不會改變 CLI 或報告語言。

# Copy APP v0.1.0

[English](v0.1.0.md) · [简体中文](v0.1.0.zh-CN.md)

Copy APP connects two stages: evidence-backed analysis of an installed iOS App on a jailbroken phone, then an independent runnable App with measured coverage. This release records selected-flow validation on three phones. It does not recover original source or claim whole-App equivalence.

| Phone | iOS / jailbreak | Verified selected scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| iPhone XR | 16.1.1 / Dopamine rootless | USB, SSH, Frida, iOS MCP and iCTRL; reviewed Notes and other selected reports; independent App installation and paired behavior checks. |
| iPhone 14 | 17.3.1 / Relaxin RootHide | The core channels, pinned Frida 17.23.3 sidecar, encrypted package recovery, reviewed Calculator report and signed independent clone checks. |
| iPhone 11 | 26.0.1 / Relaxin RootHide | USB/SSH, personalized developer image and userspace iCTRL, ElleKit and iOS MCP service, Frida attach, reviewed Calculator report, signed independent App installation and one paired `7 + 8 = 15` check. |

The iOS 26 release validation identified a screenshot limitation: iOS MCP can capture a black App area after an Instruments fresh launch, so the passing paired screenshots used iCTRL. The iOS 26 Calculator result is SwiftUI-backed and absent from the bounded UIKit label scan; an explicit screenshot OCR assertion now checks the exact result within a saved, hash-bound screen region. After adapting the existing independent source to the observed iOS 26 layout, the final pair passed visual review with **minor differences** and no major difference. This is report-guided adaptation of existing source, not generation of a new project from scratch. The chosen UIKit method hooks recorded zero calls, so Calculator's SwiftUI input dispatch remains unknown.

## Install

Clone this tag and run `sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh`, then follow the [first survey and phone-service setup](../../README.md#start-here). The wheel `copyapp-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` contains the Mac CLI. The phone tweak, Theos, Xcode signing, Frida sidecar and credentials are set up separately for the target device. Raw IPAs, screenshots, sandbox data and keys stay in local Git-ignored `cases/` and are not release assets.

The release gate ran the repository test suite and verified the saved iOS 26 report, install, paired check and visual review. Device evidence is scoped to the named configurations and flows. Clean-Mac setup, long-running reliability, unfamiliar-App autonomous discovery, iOS 26 screenshot recovery and broader visual fidelity remain open.
