# Copy APP v0.1.2

[English](v0.1.2.md) · [简体中文](v0.1.2.zh-CN.md)

This patch fixes the iCTRL XCTest-session lifetime fault seen in iOS 17 paired replays and puts agent-led first use at the front of the README.

## Changes

- Keep one owned iCTRL session through all selected original/rebuilt flows and their immediate view-tree captures. Stop the owned runner before disconnecting its XCTest host so the next command cannot reuse a briefly responsive remnant of that session.
- Preserve a failed result when session cleanup fails. On a lost HTTP reply, explain that action completion is unknown and the caller must inspect logs and UI before retrying; touches are not automatically replayed.
- Add the repository's `copyapp-start` skill and copyable Codex / Claude Code tasks in the English and Chinese READMEs. The agent can clone the repository, check the Mac, identify the exact phone/app and continue into the requested survey, analysis or rebuild. Manual CLI instructions remain available.

## Validation and limits

On the named iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 / Relaxin RootHide, two independent production-command runs each passed four original/rebuilt Calculator flows: `15`, `0.3`, `−7` and `0.5`. Together they issued 88 labelled tap commands. Runner PID was 0 after each run. All ten screenshot pairs were reviewed, with minor font, position and symbol differences retained. The original failed attempts and controlled experiments remain in ignored local cases.

The release passes **346 local unit tests** and an isolated wheel build/install check. The wheel check requires the new runner-stop module to be packaged. The named-device results are saved evidence from the fix verification; this release pass does not repeat every phone workflow.

The changed cleanup has **not** been revalidated on the named iOS 16 or iOS 26 phones. Reboot/rejailbreak durability, long-running stability, second-physical-Mac onboarding and unfamiliar-app autonomous discovery remain open. Earlier named-device results and the iOS 26 black-frame recovery boundary are preserved in [current status](../current-status.md). Selected-flow success does not establish whole-app or server-side equivalence.

## Use

Give the [README task](../../README.md#start-here) to Codex or Claude Code running locally on your Mac, or check out this tag and run `sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh`. Phone trust, initial permissions and signing access may require user participation.

The attached `copyapp-0.1.2-py3-none-any.whl` installs the Mac CLI; `SHA256SUMS` records its checksum. Keep a source checkout for repository skills and optional source-built tools. The wheel does not contain phone tweaks, Theos, signing assets, device evidence or credentials. Historical [v0.1.1 notes](v0.1.1.md) remain unchanged.

# Copy APP v0.1.2

[English](v0.1.2.md) · 简体中文

本次小版本修复 iOS 17 成对重放中的 iCTRL XCTest 会话生命周期故障，并把交给 Coding Agent 的首次使用入口放到 README 最前面。

## 本版改动

- 在全部选定原版／复刻版流程及即时 view-tree 采集期间保持同一个自建 iCTRL 会话。退出时先停止所拥有的 runner，再断开 XCTest 宿主，避免下一次命令复用仍能短暂响应的残留会话。

本版通过 **346 项本地单元测试**及隔离 wheel 构建／安装检查；打包检查要求包含新的 runner-stop 模块。上述真机结果来自本次修复已保存的复验记录，本轮发布打包没有重跑全部手机流程。

本次修改的清理逻辑**尚未在指定 iOS 16 和 iOS 26 手机上复验**。重启／重新越狱后的持续可用性、长时间稳定性、第二台实体 Mac 首次配置和陌生 App 自主探索仍待验证。历史指定设备结果与 iOS 26 黑帧恢复边界见[当前状态](../current-status.zh-CN.md)。选定流程通过不能证明整 App 或服务端行为等价。

# Copy APP v0.2.0-beta.1

[English](v0.2.0-beta.1.md) · [简体中文](v0.2.0-beta.1.zh-CN.md)

This preview adds **macOS App analysis and selected-behavior rebuilding through
ChatComputer**, alongside the existing **jailbroken iOS** workflows. It is a
GitHub prerelease; v0.1.2 remains the latest stable iOS release.

## What's included

- Separate `copyapp mac` commands for an exact virtual Mac and App: bounded
  collector/AX observations, arm64 and Mac Catalyst package acquisition, flow
  discovery, cited behavior reports, independent builds/installations, paired
  checks, full screenshot review and selected delivery.
- Computer use through ChatComputer on an Apple Silicon Mac. The current Codex
  or Claude Code session performs interpretation and implementation; no nested
  agent or ChatComputer model loop is needed.
- Snapshot metadata/reconnect cases, unknown-result preservation and a bounded
  30-second collector-polling pause around snapshot operations. Human takeover
  refuses subsequent input; uncertain actions are not automatically retried.
- Agent-led fidelity defaults to a reviewed **80/100 grade and three cycles**.
  Core selected behavior and complete image review remain required. Grades,
  known-capability coverage and selected-flow pass rate stay separate. Historical
  strict delivery and standalone parent workflows retain their existing rules.
- New `copyapp copy` jobs default to `output/<bundle>-<UTC>-<unique-id>/`, with
  sibling `project/` and `evidence/`. `--output-dir` overrides the root; legacy
  explicit paths remain supported. Resume pins the previous directory. Mac
  agent-led jobs use this layout with explicit child paths; there is no `mac copy`
  wrapper.
- Bilingual README/site entry points with copyable AI tasks for both platforms.
  The [Stocks source example](../../examples/macos/Stocks/README.md) includes
  independent AppKit code, playbooks and a local build script. Its prices/news
  are illustrative offline content, with no live market service or Apple assets.
  The [independent editor](../../examples/macos/IndependentEditor/README.md) and
  [owned fixture](../../examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/README.md) are also included.

## Validation and limits

The release passes **410 local tests** and an isolated wheel build/install check.
Existing iOS commands and v1 evidence validators are preserved; this release does
not claim new physical-iPhone runs beyond the named saved results in
[current status](../current-status.md).

Named Mac evidence uses ChatComputer 0.9.11 (43), macOS guest 27.0.1 (26A434) and
an Apple Silicon macOS 27.0 (26A428) host:

- Each of the two samples passes three selected flows across three rounds:
  **9/9 comparisons per sample**. The owned editor has a strict selected delivery
  of **7/9 known capabilities**; all 285 image pairs were reviewed, with zero
  major and 285 minor differences.
- Stocks' 207 full image pairs retain **207 major differences**. Its later
  requested offline-prototype milestone scores **81/100** against target 80;
  that is neither objective similarity nor strict delivery or capability coverage.
- Same guest original/rebuilt editor binaries pass a three-behavior manual
  recheck on one physical Mac. Actual human takeover/refusal, explicitly
  authorized agent hand-back and controlled real-input reply loss have separate
  records.
- One quiesced take/restore retains the running editor's exact process identity,
  unsaved Unicode text and wrapping through an intervening state change. A safety
  snapshot is retained. Earlier failed snapshots remain failed and preserved.

These live records precede the final release-version metadata update; collector
runtime logic is unchanged. The release collector is rebuilt by the native tests.
See [the ledger](../macos-implementation-plan.md) and [recovery limits](../macos-recovery.md).
Other guest I/O, shared folders and external services are not quiesced or rolled
back. Arbitrary-Mac compatibility, whole-App parity, deep Mac function analysis,
complete App data and a live Stocks service are not established.

## Install

Use the [README AI tasks](../../README.md#start-here), or check out this tag and
run `sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh`. Mac guest permissions, phone trust and
signing may require initial setup. `copyapp-0.2.0b1-py3-none-any.whl` installs the
CLI; `SHA256SUMS` records its checksum. Keep the source checkout for skills and
examples. No device/VM evidence, credentials, Apple packages or signed app products
are included in the wheel.

# Copy APP v0.2.0

[English](v0.2.0.md) · [简体中文](v0.2.0.zh-CN.md)

This release adds **macOS App analysis and selected-behavior rebuilding through
ChatComputer**, alongside the existing **jailbroken iOS** workflows. It is the
latest GitHub release, superseding v0.2.0-beta.1.
The change from beta.1 updates release metadata and documentation; runtime behavior
and the measured acceptance scope are unchanged. v0.1.2 is the previous iOS-only release.

## What's included

- Separate `copyapp mac` commands for an exact virtual Mac and App: bounded
  collector/AX observations, arm64 and Mac Catalyst package acquisition, flow
  discovery, cited behavior reports, independent builds/installations, paired
  checks, full screenshot review and selected delivery.
- Computer use through ChatComputer on an Apple Silicon Mac. The current Codex
  or Claude Code session performs interpretation and implementation; no nested
  agent or ChatComputer model loop is needed.
- Snapshot metadata/reconnect cases, unknown-result preservation and a bounded
  30-second collector-polling pause around snapshot operations. Human takeover
  refuses subsequent input; uncertain actions are not automatically retried.
- Agent-led fidelity defaults to a reviewed **80/100 grade and three cycles**.
  Core selected behavior and complete image review remain required. Grades,
  known-capability coverage and selected-flow pass rate stay separate. Historical
  strict delivery and standalone parent workflows retain their existing rules.
- New `copyapp copy` jobs default to `output/<bundle>-<UTC>-<unique-id>/`, with
  sibling `project/` and `evidence/`. `--output-dir` overrides the root; legacy
  explicit paths remain supported. Resume pins the previous directory. Mac
  agent-led jobs use this layout with explicit child paths; there is no `mac copy`
  wrapper.
- Bilingual README/site entry points with copyable AI tasks for both platforms.
  The [Stocks source example](../../examples/macos/Stocks/README.md) includes
  independent AppKit code, playbooks and a local build script. Its prices/news
  are illustrative offline content, with no live market service or Apple assets.
  The [independent editor](../../examples/macos/IndependentEditor/README.md) and
  [owned fixture](../../examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/README.md) are also included.

## Validation and limits

The release passes **410 local tests** and an isolated wheel build/install check.
Existing iOS commands and v1 evidence validators are preserved; this release does
not claim new physical-iPhone runs beyond the named saved results in
[current status](../current-status.md).

Named Mac evidence uses ChatComputer 0.9.11 (43), macOS guest 27.0.1 (26A434) and
an Apple Silicon macOS 27.0 (26A428) host:

  **9/9 comparisons per sample**. The owned editor has a strict selected delivery
  of **7/9 known capabilities**; all 285 image pairs were reviewed, with zero
  major and 285 minor differences.
- Stocks' 207 full image pairs retain **207 major differences**. Its later
  requested offline-prototype milestone scores **81/100** against target 80;
  that is neither objective similarity nor strict delivery or capability coverage.
- Same guest original/rebuilt editor binaries pass a three-behavior manual
  recheck on one physical Mac. Actual human takeover/refusal, explicitly
  authorized agent hand-back and controlled real-input reply loss have separate
  records.

  unsaved Unicode text and wrapping through an intervening state change. A safety
  snapshot is retained. Earlier failed snapshots remain failed and preserved.

These live records precede the final release-version metadata update; collector
runtime logic is unchanged. The release collector is rebuilt by the native tests.

Other guest I/O, shared folders and external services are not quiesced or rolled

```md
# Decompilers and reverse-engineering tools

[简体中文](reverse-engineering-tools.zh-CN.md) · [Project README](../README.md) · [Documentation](README.md)

Copy APP directly integrates **Ghidra and Hopper for decompilation**, alongside Frida runtime observations, LLVM disassembly, built-in Mach-O/Objective-C indexes and package recovery on verified device routes. Tools run on the Mac and save evidence tied to binary hashes, addresses and logs. The current coding agent interprets it.

## Supported tools

| Tool | Purpose | Copy APP entry | Prerequisites |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Ghidra** | Selected native-function pseudocode; bounded callers/callees, blocks and instruction references | `ghidra-function`, `ghidra-queue`, `ghidra-indirect`; `--provider ghidra-direct` | Separately installed Ghidra and a matching JDK; explicit installation paths |
| **Hopper Disassembler** | Selected-function pseudocode and bounded candidate queues | `hopper-function`, `hopper-queue`; `--provider hopper-direct` | Local Hopper, a usable license and a normal logged-in macOS GUI session |
| **LLVM / Xcode llvm-objdump** | Bounded ARM64 assembly and unique local direct call/branch followers | `native-disasm`, `native-queue` | Toolchain discoverable with `xcrun --find llvm-objdump`; assembly is not pseudocode |
| **Frida** | Named Objective-C hits, selected original entries and indirect-call register observations | `trace`, `experiment`, `flow-capture --method`; composed by investigations | Host Frida and compatible jailbroken-device services, exact device identity; bootstrap `--trace` when needed |
| **Built-in Mach-O / Objective-C parsing** | Package/load-command/encryption metadata and class/selector/method-address indexes | `ipa`, `objc`; Mac packages use `mac inspect` / `mac acquire` | Corresponding acquired files; no Ghidra/Hopper required; does not recover Swift source |
| **ipadecrypt helper and Copy APP recovery** | Recover encrypted Mach-O analysis copies on verified device routes | `decrypt-package`, `analyze --decrypt`; separate `decrypt-main` for the main executable | Exact device/App/snapshot, prepared and verified helper; device-specific SSH/Frida route |

The first two are decompilers. The others supply assembly, runtime observations, static indexes or package recovery. ChatComputer, iOS MCP and iCTRL supply UI observation/control rather than decompilation.

## Platform scope

**iOS:** existing native investigations bind replayed UI, Frida observations, Objective-C candidates, bounded assembly and optional pseudocode to the acquired binary. An agent must review them before reporting semantic findings. See [device status](current-status.md) and [package recovery](full-package-decryption.md) for named-device limits.

**macOS:** the separate workflow currently covers App packages, AX, screenshots and behavior comparisons. It does not have the equivalent iOS native-function investigation/report chain. Standalone function commands can process local Mach-O inputs that meet their constraints, but that alone establishes neither deep Mac function analysis nor arbitrary-App acceptance. See [Mac support](macos-support.md).

## Decompilation is opt-in

`investigate-flow`, `investigate-app`, `prepare-analysis` and `prepare-app` default to `--provider none`. That path can still collect UI, static indexes, runtime observations and available bounded assembly; it does not generate new decompiler pseudocode.

Select `--provider ghidra-direct` or `--provider hopper-direct` when needed. The parent `copy` workflow names the option `--analysis-provider`. These iOS investigation options must not be assumed to exist on `copyapp mac` commands.

The bootstrap does not install Ghidra, a JDK or Hopper. Follow [Ghidra's official installation instructions](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra#install) for a matching JDK, or install licensed Hopper from its [official site](https://www.hopperapp.com/). Failed launches, timeouts and still-encrypted inputs remain failures; partial pseudocode does not establish completion.

## Ask the current agent

Append this to an existing **iOS analysis task**:

```text
This task needs function-level pseudocode. Check the available Ghidra/JDK or Hopper installation, choose ghidra-direct or hopper-direct and record the actual provider in the report.
Verify the acquired binary, SHA-256, ARM64 slice and candidate addresses first. Decompile only a bounded set of functions relevant to the selected flows.
Separate actual Frida hits, static references, decompiler results and your semantic inferences. Cite verified evidence and do not call pseudocode original source.
Review in this current agent session without nesting another agent. For a Mac target, stay within the implemented Mac workflow and disclose the missing native-function chain.
```

For a specified tool, name its provider and installation paths explicitly. The agent can inspect installed tools; a Python package cannot supply a Hopper license or normal GUI session.

## One selected function from the CLI

Use the hash and address of the same verified analysis binary. Recover encrypted inputs through the verified device route first. Use a new case for every attempt.

Ghidra:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp ghidra-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <SHA256> --address <0xFUNCTION_ENTRY> \
  --ghidra-dir <GHIDRA_DIR> --java-home <JDK_HOME> --out <NEW_CASE>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify <NEW_CASE>
```

Hopper:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <SHA256> --address <0xFUNCTION_ENTRY> \
  --hopper-app '/Applications/Hopper Disassembler.app' --out <NEW_CASE>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify <NEW_CASE>
```

Use `ghidra-queue` / `hopper-queue` for verified candidates. Ghidra also supports bounded direct followers from a verified native queue and selected indirect-call investigation with Frida. Read repository `AGENTS.md` and the command's `--help` for those contracts. [Direct Hopper](rea-hopper-integration.md) documents GUI, timeout and failure requirements.

## Integration limits

There is currently no direct IDA Pro, Binary Ninja or radare2 provider or corresponding automatic evidence integration. A tool's own platform support does not establish Copy APP integration.

**REA is not a runtime dependency.** The old `rea-function`, `rea-queue` and `rea-bridge` commands were removed. Retained REA licenses attribute historical reference/adaptation; see [REA independence](rea-independence.md). Hopper's other upstream interfaces are not automatically integrated here: this project's direct adapter currently uses its Python scripting interface.

Pseudocode is generated interpretation, not original source. A temporal Frida hit alone does not prove that function caused a visible UI change. `copyapp verify` checks files, provenance and bindings; function semantics still need agent/human review.

## Implementation references

- CLI options: [`copyapp/cli.py`](../copyapp/cli.py)
- Decompiler adapters: [`ghidra_direct.py`](../copyapp/ghidra_direct.py), [`ghidra_queue.py`](../copyapp/ghidra_queue.py), [`hopper_direct.py`](../copyapp/hopper_direct.py), [`hopper_queue.py`](../copyapp/hopper_queue.py)
- Bounded assembly and indexes: [`native_disasm.py`](../copyapp/native_disasm.py), [`objc.py`](../copyapp/objc.py)
- Upstream information checked 2026-10-22; integration scope follows this repository's adapters and evidence.

```md
# 反编译与逆向工具支持

[English](reverse-engineering-tools.md) · [项目首页](../README.zh-CN.md) · [文档目录](README.zh-CN.md)

Copy APP 当前直接接入 **Ghidra 与 Hopper 两种反编译器**，并组合 Frida 动态跟踪、LLVM 反汇编、内置 Mach-O／Objective-C 索引和选定设备上的安装包恢复。工具在 Mac 上运行，生成带二进制哈希、地址与原始日志的证据；当前 Agent 负责解释。

## 工具支持表

| 工具 | 用途 | Copy APP 入口 | 需要准备 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Ghidra** | 指定原生函数伪代码；有界调用者／被调用者、基本块和指令引用 | `ghidra-function`、`ghidra-queue`、`ghidra-indirect`；`--provider ghidra-direct` | 单独安装的 Ghidra、与所选版本匹配的 JDK；提供 Ghidra 与 JDK 路径 |
| **Hopper Disassembler** | 指定函数伪代码与有界候选队列 | `hopper-function`、`hopper-queue`；`--provider hopper-direct` | 本机 Hopper、可用许可、正常登录的 macOS 图形会话 |
| **LLVM / Xcode llvm-objdump** | 有界 ARM64 汇编、唯一局部直接调用／分支跟随 | `native-disasm`、`native-queue` | `xcrun --find llvm-objdump` 能定位的工具链；输出是汇编，不是伪代码 |
| **Frida** | 指定 Objective-C 方法命中、选定原始入口及间接调用寄存器等运行观察 | `trace`、`experiment`、`flow-capture --method`；调查流程按需组合 | 宿主 Frida 与兼容的越狱手机服务、明确设备身份；需要时用 bootstrap 的 `--trace` |
| **内置 Mach-O／Objective-C 解析** | 安装包、加载命令、加密标记、类／selector／方法地址索引 | `ipa`、`objc`；Mac 包另用 `mac inspect`／`mac acquire` | 采集到的对应文件；不依赖 Ghidra 或 Hopper，也不恢复 Swift 原始源码 |
| **ipadecrypt helper 与 Copy APP 恢复流程** | 在已验证设备路径上恢复加密 Mach-O 分析副本 | `decrypt-package`、`analyze --decrypt`；主程序另有 `decrypt-main` | 明确手机／App／包快照，准备并校验 helper；SSH／Frida 路线按设备选择 |

前两项是反编译器；其余分别提供汇编、动态观察、静态索引与包恢复。ChatComputer、iOS MCP 和 iCTRL 提供界面观察／控制，不是反编译器。

## iOS 和 macOS 的范围分别是什么？

**iOS：**现有原生分析流程把 UI 重放、Frida 命中、Objective-C 地址候选、有界汇编与可选伪代码绑定到同一采集二进制。Agent 审阅证据后，才能写入正式报告。设备、版本及加密包恢复范围见[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)与[包恢复指南](full-package-decryption.zh-CN.md)。

**macOS：**当前独立工作流主要是 App 包、AX 辅助功能树、截图和行为对照。它没有接成与 iOS 等价的原生函数调查／报告链。底层函数命令可处理满足其约束的本地 Mach-O，但这不构成 Mac 深层函数分析或任意 Mac App 的验收结论。见 [Mac 支持](macos-support.zh-CN.md)。

## 默认不启动反编译器

`investigate-flow`、`investigate-app`、`prepare-analysis` 与 `prepare-app` 的默认参数是 `--provider none`。这条路径仍可采集 UI、静态索引、运行观察和可用的有界汇编，但不会生成新的反编译伪代码。

需要伪代码时显式选 `--provider ghidra-direct` 或 `--provider hopper-direct`。父工作流 `copy` 对应的选项名是 `--analysis-provider`。不要把这些 iOS 调查参数直接加到 `copyapp mac` 命令上。

Copy APP 的 bootstrap 不会同时安装 Ghidra、JDK 或 Hopper。Ghidra 按[官方安装说明](https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra#install)准备匹配的 JDK；Hopper 从[官网](https://www.hopperapp.com/)安装并准备许可。所选工具无法启动、超时或输入仍加密时，保留失败证据，不把部分伪代码写成完成结果。

## 交给 Agent 怎么说

在已有的 **iOS 分析任务**后补充：

```text
本次需要函数级伪代码。请检查可用的 Ghidra/JDK 或 Hopper，使用 ghidra-direct 或 hopper-direct，并在报告中记录实际选择。
先核对采集二进制、SHA-256、ARM64 切片与候选函数地址，再对与选定流程相关的有限函数运行反编译。
把 Frida 实际命中、静态引用、反编译结果和你的语义推断分别写清楚，引用校验过的证据；不要把伪代码称为原始源码。
在当前 Agent 会话里完成审阅，不启动嵌套 Agent。若当前目标是 Mac，只按已实现的 Mac 范围处理，明确原生函数链尚未接入。
```

已指定工具时，直接指定所需 provider，并提供安装路径。Agent 可以检查已有环境；Hopper 许可与正常图形会话不能由 Python 包安装替代。

## 手动调用一个已选定函数

以下 SHA-256 与地址必须来自同一份已验证的分析二进制。加密输入先按设备验证过的恢复流程处理。每次用新的案例目录。

Ghidra：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp ghidra-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <SHA256> --address <0xFUNCTION_ENTRY> \
  --ghidra-dir <GHIDRA_DIR> --java-home <JDK_HOME> --out <NEW_CASE>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify <NEW_CASE>
```

Hopper：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp hopper-function --file <MACHO> \
  --sha256 <SHA256> --address <0xFUNCTION_ENTRY> \
  --hopper-app '/Applications/Hopper Disassembler.app' --out <NEW_CASE>
.venv/bin/copyapp verify <NEW_CASE>
```

已有候选队列用 `ghidra-queue`／`hopper-queue`。Ghidra 还支持在已验证的原生队列上进行有界直接跟随，以及配合 Frida 的选定间接调用调查；具体要求见仓库 `AGENTS.md` 和对应命令的 `--help`。[Hopper 直连说明](rea-hopper-integration.zh-CN.md)记录图形会话、超时与失败诊断。

## 尚未接入的工具与解释边界

当前没有 IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、radare2 的直接 provider 或对应的自动证据接入链。工具自身支持某个平台，不代表 Copy APP 已自动集成该能力。

**REA 不是运行依赖。** 旧 `rea-function`、`rea-queue`、`rea-bridge` 命令已经移除；保留的 REA 许可证属于历史参考／改造代码的署名。[不依赖 REA 的路径](rea-independence.zh-CN.md)说明当前替代方式。Hopper 本身提供的其他接口，也不等于这里已接入；本项目当前直连使用其 Python 脚本接口。

伪代码是工具生成的解释，不是原作者源码。Frida 在某个操作窗口内命中一个函数，不足以单独证明该函数导致了可见 UI 变化。`copyapp verify` 校验文件、来源与绑定关系，函数语义仍需要 Agent 或人工审阅。

## 实现依据

- CLI 选项与命令：[`copyapp/cli.py`](../copyapp/cli.py)
- 反编译适配：[`ghidra_direct.py`](../copyapp/ghidra_direct.py)、[`ghidra_queue.py`](../copyapp/ghidra_queue.py)、[`hopper_direct.py`](../copyapp/hopper_direct.py)、[`hopper_queue.py`](../copyapp/hopper_queue.py)
- 有界反汇编与静态索引：[`native_disasm.py`](../copyapp/native_disasm.py)、[`objc.py`](../copyapp/objc.py)
- 上游信息核对：2026-10-22；支持范围以本仓库实际适配和案例为准。

`docs/setup.md`:

```md
# Set up a Mac and jailbroken iPhone

[English](setup.md) · [简体中文](setup.zh-CN.md) · [Documentation](README.md)

## Choose a setup level

| Goal | Required components |
| --- | --- |
| First USB survey | macOS, Python 3.9+, USB trust, unlocked phone, Copy APP CLI. |
| Deep analysis | Compatible jailbreak, mobile OpenSSH and pinned SSH key, iOS MCP UI service, Frida; full Xcode for developer services. Ghidra/Hopper only when requested. |
| Runnable rebuild | Deep-analysis setup plus full Xcode, signing or TrollStore, and a verified install route. iCTRL is optional. |

These instructions describe the v0.1.2 checkout. The release wheel contains the Mac CLI but does not contain Theos, the phone tweak, signing assets, or private credentials. If using the wheel for optional source-built components, also keep a checkout and set `COPYAPP_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/copyapp`.

## 1. Install the Mac CLI and identify the phone

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp apps --udid <UDID> --all
```

`onboard` prints the exact UDID; supply `--udid` when more than one phone is connected. Unlock the phone and accept USB trust. For developer services, select a full Xcode with `xcode-select -p`, enable Developer Mode if prompted, and use the compatible developer image. On iOS 26, the tested iCTRL route uses a personalized developer image and a userspace XCTest tunnel. Read the saved `onboard` report before installing more components.

For a first case, open the target app on the phone and run:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp survey --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --ui-backend usb --out cases/first-survey
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-survey
```

This is an initial screen and device check. Use a new `--out` directory for a retry.

## 2. Establish mobile SSH over the exact USB phone

Install a jailbreak-compatible OpenSSH server on the phone. Run `.venv/bin/copyapp onboard --udid <UDID> --stage analyze` to create a dedicated Mac key and list the remaining repairs. For first-time host-key verification, keep the USB forward open in another terminal:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp tunnel --udid <UDID> --ssh-only
```

The default local SSH port is `22222`. With multiple phones, use distinct `--ssh-port` and `--ssh-known-hosts` values per device. Compare the forwarded SSH host-key fingerprint with the fingerprint shown on the selected phone before saving it. Add the Mac public key `cases/ssh/id_ed25519.pub` to the phone's `mobile` account `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, using the phone terminal or one verified password-authenticated SSH session. Never put a phone password in a command, repository file or chat. Keep the private key in ignored `cases/`.

In the repository terminal, while the SSH forward runs, inspect the forwarded key:

```sh
ssh-keyscan -p 22222 127.0.0.1 > cases/ssh-known-hosts
ssh-keygen -lf cases/ssh-known-hosts
```

On the selected phone, use its terminal to run `ssh-keygen -lf <PHONE_SSH_HOST_PUBLIC_KEY>` for the OpenSSH host public key and compare the fingerprint. The package may place that key under `/etc/ssh/` or a jailbreak-specific prefix. Only after the values match, authorize the Mac public key. If password login is enabled, this one-time command keeps the password at the interactive prompt:

```sh
cat cases/ssh/id_ed25519.pub | ssh -p 22222 \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=cases/ssh-known-hosts \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no \
  mobile@127.0.0.1 'umask 077; mkdir -p ~/.ssh; cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 700 ~/.ssh; chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys'
ssh -p 22222 -i cases/ssh/id_ed25519 \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=cases/ssh-known-hosts \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes mobile@127.0.0.1 'deviceinfo uniqueid'
```

The last command must return the selected UDID. Then run:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp doctor --udid <UDID> --out cases/first-doctor
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-doctor
```

After successful authentication, `onboard`/`doctor` records the exact-device port and key paths in ignored `cases/ssh/profiles.json`; later commands reuse them. Do not replace a pinned host key merely because it differs. The XR/iOS 16 developer file-listing probe can fail with `ConnectionTerminatedError`; SSH package and sandbox acquisition are the verified alternative.

## 3. Add UI control and Frida

**iOS MCP:** build [`device/ios-mcp`](../device/ios-mcp/README.md) with full Xcode, Theos, iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK and `ldid`, install the matching rootless or RootHide package, and reload SpringBoard. Theos and the SDK are external prerequisites. RootHide needs its Theos fork, `THEOS_PACKAGE_SCHEME=roothide`, and a tweak loader such as ElleKit. Run `doctor` again and check the `ios_mcp` row.

**Frida:** install host tracing support with `sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh --trace` and a compatible device server. On the tested iOS 17/26 RootHide devices, pin host `frida==17.23.3`, then configure the isolated sidecar:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pip install 'frida==17.23.3'
.venv/bin/copyapp setup frida-roothide --udid <UDID> \
  --out cases/frida-roothide-setup
```

RootHide's older packaged Frida server did not attach to the tested original Calculator; process enumeration alone does not prove attachment. On ordinary rootless iOS, use a server matching the host Frida version. The RootHide package-recovery helper uses authenticated mobile SSH; the ordinary rootless helper route uses a verified root Frida process.

**Optional iCTRL:** install `xcodegen` (`brew install xcodegen`), configure Apple Development signing in Xcode, or supply an already signed compatible runner IPA. Then run:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp setup ictrl --udid <UDID> --out cases/ictrl-setup
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/ictrl-setup
```

The first source build downloads the pinned iCTRL framework. Approve device-side XCTest, notification and pairing prompts for the matching fingerprint. On iOS 17+, `--auto-approve-first-pair` can approve one local USB request in a development runner. The app and runner use team-scoped `com.copyapp.<team-id>` IDs. See [`vendor/ictrl/UPSTREAM.md`](../vendor/ictrl/UPSTREAM.md) for provenance. A current iOS 17 multi-step clone replay still has an iCTRL transport failure; use iOS MCP for the verified four-flow Calculator path and inspect [current status](current-status.md) before relying on iCTRL for acceptance.

## 4. Analyze and install a rebuild

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp analyze --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --launch --ui-backend ios-mcp --out cases/first-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-analysis
```

`analysis.md` is a collection index, not a semantic reverse-engineering report. Encrypted App Store binaries may need `sh scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh` and `analyze --decrypt`; the output is an **analysis IPA**, not a signed installable app. See [package recovery](full-package-decryption.md). A full report needs reviewed UI flows, function evidence and `copyapp report`; follow the [workflow guide](copy-workflow.md).

Build and sign the independent Xcode app. On a development-signed route:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> \
  --ipa <SIGNED_IPA> --out cases/clone-install
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/clone-install
```

A successful install does not prove launch or equivalence. Replay selected original and clone flows, check final behavior, inspect every screenshot pair and report gaps. The XR TrollStore path remains available for compatible packages. Keep all IPAs, screenshots, sandbox data, SSH keys and pairing material in ignored `cases/`.

```

`docs/setup.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# 配置 Mac 与越狱 iPhone

[English](setup.md) · 简体中文 · [文档目录](README.zh-CN.md)

## 先选目标

| 目标 | 所需组件 |
| --- | --- |
| 首次 USB 概览 | macOS、Python 3.9+、USB 信任、已解锁手机、Copy APP CLI。 |
| 深入分析 | 兼容越狱环境、mobile OpenSSH 与固定的 SSH 密钥、iOS MCP 界面服务、Frida；开发者服务需要完整 Xcode。仅在需要时加 Ghidra/Hopper。 |
| 可运行复刻 | 深入分析环境，加完整 Xcode、签名或 TrollStore，以及经过验证的安装路径。iCTRL 可选。 |

以下步骤针对 v0.1.2 检出。正式 wheel 包含 Mac CLI，但不包含 Theos、手机 tweak、签名资源或私有凭据。使用 wheel 搭配源码构建的可选组件时，另保留一份仓库检出，并设置 `COPYAPP_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/copyapp`。

## 1. 安装 CLI 并识别手机

```sh
git clone https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp.git
cd copyapp
sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh
.venv/bin/copyapp onboard
.venv/bin/copyapp apps --udid <UDID> --all
```

`onboard` 输出精确 UDID；连接多台手机时显式传 `--udid`。解锁手机并接受 USB 信任。需要开发者服务时，用 `xcode-select -p` 确认选择完整 Xcode，按提示启用开发者模式并挂载兼容的开发者镜像。iOS 26 上已测的 iCTRL 路径使用个性化开发者镜像与 userspace XCTest 隧道。先阅读 `onboard` 保存的报告，再配置其他组件。

在手机上打开目标 App，做首次采集：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp survey --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --ui-backend usb --out cases/first-survey
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-survey
```

这只是设备和首屏检查。重试时使用新的 `--out` 目录。

## 2. 经准确的 USB 设备配置 mobile SSH

在手机上安装适配当前越狱方式的 OpenSSH 服务。运行 `.venv/bin/copyapp onboard --udid <UDID> --stage analyze`，生成专用 Mac 密钥并查看待修复项。第一次核对主机密钥时，在另一个终端保持 USB 转发：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp tunnel --udid <UDID> --ssh-only
```

默认本地 SSH 端口为 `22222`。多台手机分别使用不同的 `--ssh-port` 和 `--ssh-known-hosts`。保存转发端的 SSH 主机密钥前，先与所选手机上显示的指纹核对。将 Mac 公钥 `cases/ssh/id_ed25519.pub` 加入手机 `mobile` 用户的 `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`，可用手机终端，或在指纹核对后通过一次密码 SSH 会话完成。不要把手机密码放入命令、仓库文件或聊天；私钥留在被 Git 忽略的 `cases/`。

保持 SSH 转发运行，在仓库终端检查转发端的主机密钥：

```sh
ssh-keyscan -p 22222 127.0.0.1 > cases/ssh-known-hosts
ssh-keygen -lf cases/ssh-known-hosts
```

在所选手机的终端运行 `ssh-keygen -lf <PHONE_SSH_HOST_PUBLIC_KEY>`，读取 OpenSSH 主机公钥指纹并比较。该公钥可能在 `/etc/ssh/` 或越狱专用前缀下。**确认一致后**才授权 Mac 公钥。若已启用密码登录，下面的一次性命令只在交互提示中输入密码：

```sh
cat cases/ssh/id_ed25519.pub | ssh -p 22222 \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=cases/ssh-known-hosts \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o PubkeyAuthentication=no \
  mobile@127.0.0.1 'umask 077; mkdir -p ~/.ssh; cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys; chmod 700 ~/.ssh; chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys'
ssh -p 22222 -i cases/ssh/id_ed25519 \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=cases/ssh-known-hosts \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes mobile@127.0.0.1 'deviceinfo uniqueid'
```

最后一条命令必须返回所选 UDID。之后运行：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp doctor --udid <UDID> --out cases/first-doctor
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-doctor
```

认证通过后，`onboard`／`doctor` 会把精确设备的端口和密钥路径写入被忽略的 `cases/ssh/profiles.json`，后续命令可复用。不要仅因主机密钥不匹配就替换已固定的密钥。XR/iOS 16 的开发者文件列表探针可能报 `ConnectionTerminatedError`；SSH 包／沙盒采集是已验证的替代路径。

## 3. 加入界面控制与 Frida

**iOS MCP：**使用完整 Xcode、Theos、iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK 与 `ldid` 构建 [`device/ios-mcp`](../device/ios-mcp/README.zh-CN.md)，安装对应 rootless 或 RootHide 包并重新加载 SpringBoard。Theos 和 SDK 需自行安装。RootHide 需使用适配的 Theos fork、`THEOS_PACKAGE_SCHEME=roothide` 及 ElleKit 等 tweak loader。再运行 `doctor` 查看 `ios_mcp` 行。

**Frida：**运行 `sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh --trace` 安装 Mac 侧依赖，手机使用兼容的服务端。在已测 iOS 17／26 RootHide 设备上，固定 host `frida==17.23.3` 并设置隔离侧车：

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pip install 'frida==17.23.3'
.venv/bin/copyapp setup frida-roothide --udid <UDID> \
  --out cases/frida-roothide-setup
```

RootHide 较旧的打包版 Frida 无法附加已测原版 Calculator；能列出进程不代表可附加。普通 rootless 系统使用与 Mac 版本匹配的服务端。RootHide 的整包恢复 helper 使用已认证 mobile SSH；普通 rootless 路径使用经过验证的 root Frida 进程。

**可选 iCTRL：**安装 `xcodegen`（`brew install xcodegen`），在 Xcode 配置 Apple Development 签名，或准备已签名且兼容的 runner IPA，然后运行：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp setup ictrl --udid <UDID> --out cases/ictrl-setup
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/ictrl-setup
```

首次源码构建会下载固定版本的 iCTRL 框架。手机出现 XCTest、通知和配对提示时核对指纹并批准。iOS 17+ 开发 runner 可用 `--auto-approve-first-pair` 自动批准一次本地 USB 请求。设置 App 和 runner 使用按团队区分的 `com.copyapp.<team-id>` ID；来源见 [`vendor/ictrl/UPSTREAM.md`](../vendor/ictrl/UPSTREAM.md)。当前 iOS 17 复刻版多步重放仍有 iCTRL 传输故障；四流程 Calculator 验收已由 iOS MCP 完成，依赖 iCTRL 验收前应查看[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。

## 4. 分析与安装复刻版

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp analyze --udid <UDID> --bundle <BUNDLE_ID> \
  --launch --ui-backend ios-mcp --out cases/first-analysis
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/first-analysis
```

`analysis.md` 是采集索引，不是完成的逆向语义报告。加密的 App Store 二进制可能需要 `sh scripts/prepare-ipadecrypt-helper.sh` 和 `analyze --decrypt`；产物是**分析 IPA**，并非已签名可安装 App。见[整包恢复](full-package-decryption.md)。正式报告还需审阅界面流程、函数证据和 `copyapp report`；按[工作流指南](copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)继续。

构建并签名独立 Xcode App。开发签名的 USB 安装路径：

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> \
  --ipa <SIGNED_IPA> --out cases/clone-install
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/clone-install
```

安装成功不代表能启动或与原版等价。还需重放选定原版／复刻版流程、核对末端行为、逐张审阅截图并列出缺口。XR 上仍有适配包的 TrollStore 路径。IPA、截图、沙盒数据、SSH 密钥及配对材料都放在被忽略的 `cases/`。

# UI gesture playbooks

[English](ui-gesture-playbooks.md) · [简体中文](ui-gesture-playbooks.zh-CN.md) · [Workflow](copy-workflow.md)

Playbooks accept `swipe`, `long_press` and `double_tap` alongside `tap` and `tap_label`. Coordinates are screen **points** from the selected backend's observation, not Retina pixels. Run original and rebuilt scripts from comparable states with the same backend. `discover-check`, `compare-playbooks` and `rebuild-check` validate action identity and bounds before accepting a pair.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
  "scenario_id": "open-detail",
  "fresh_launch": true,
  "steps": [
    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Items"]},
    {"action": "swipe", "from_x": 320, "from_y": 280,
     "to_x": 120, "to_y": 280, "duration_ms": 350, "steps": 20},
    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Detail"]},
    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": true, "ready_contains": "Detail"}
  ]
}
```

Run `copyapp playbook --udid <UDID> --backend ios-mcp|ictrl --script <FILE> --out cases/<CASE>`, then `copyapp verify cases/<CASE>`. A discovery candidate needs a distinct scenario ID, identifying first observation, meaningful action and stable final screenshot. Prefer an explicit post-action assertion: a successful gesture RPC alone does not prove a UI result.

| Action | Fields | Bounds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `swipe` | `from_x`, `from_y`, `to_x`, `to_y`; optional `duration_ms` (300), `steps` (20) | At least 15 points; 100–2000 ms; 2–60 steps. |
| `long_press` | `x`, `y`; optional `duration_ms` (800) | 300–3000 ms. |
| `double_tap` | `x`, `y`; optional `interval_ms` (100) | 50–300 ms. |

Coordinates must fit the observed screen. iCTRL maps swipe duration to `fast` (≤125 ms), `normal` (126–375 ms) or `slow` (>375 ms); its real duration and intermediate points need not match iOS MCP. Its double-tap interval is also backend-defined. Keep screenshots, accessibility results and OCR conclusions separate. A Frida hit during a gesture is temporal evidence, not proof that the hit caused the visible change. See [current status](current-status.md) for tested devices and open backend limits.

```

# UI 手势脚本

[English](ui-gesture-playbooks.md) · 简体中文 · [工作流](copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)

playbook 除 `tap`、`tap_label` 外，还支持 `swipe`、`long_press` 和 `double_tap`。坐标是所选后端观察到的屏幕**点**，不是 Retina 像素。原版与复刻版应从可比状态开始，使用同一后端。`discover-check`、`compare-playbooks` 和 `rebuild-check` 在接受成对结果前会核对操作身份与边界。

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
  "scenario_id": "open-detail",
  "fresh_launch": true,
  "steps": [
    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Items"]},
    {"action": "swipe", "from_x": 320, "from_y": 280,
     "to_x": 120, "to_y": 280, "duration_ms": 350, "steps": 20},
    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Detail"]},
    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": true, "ready_contains": "Detail"}
  ]
}
```

运行 `copyapp playbook --udid <UDID> --backend ios-mcp|ictrl --script <FILE> --out cases/<CASE>`，再运行 `copyapp verify cases/<CASE>`。发现候选脚本需要不同的场景 ID、可识别的首个观察、有效操作和稳定的末端截图。尽量加操作后断言：手势 RPC 成功本身不证明界面结果。

| 操作 | 字段 | 边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `swipe` | `from_x`、`from_y`、`to_x`、`to_y`；可选 `duration_ms`（300）、`steps`（20） | 至少 15 点；100–2000 毫秒；2–60 步。 |
| `long_press` | `x`、`y`；可选 `duration_ms`（800） | 300–3000 毫秒。 |
| `double_tap` | `x`、`y`；可选 `interval_ms`（100） | 50–300 毫秒。 |

坐标须落在实际观察的屏幕内。iCTRL 把滑动时长映射为 `fast`（≤125 毫秒）、`normal`（126–375 毫秒）或 `slow`（>375 毫秒）；实际时长和中间点不一定与 iOS MCP 完全相同。双击间隔也由其后端决定。截图、无障碍结果和 OCR 结论要分开记录。手势期间的 Frida 命中是时间相关证据，不证明它造成了可见变化。已测设备和未解后端限制见[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。

# Text entry in UI playbooks

[English](ui-text-playbooks.md) · [简体中文](ui-text-playbooks.zh-CN.md) · [Workflow](copy-workflow.md)

Use `type_text` after focusing an input field. It accepts 1–128 printable Unicode characters, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. It does not clear an existing value or press Return. Prefer synthetic text: source playbooks and backend results remain in ignored local `cases/`.

```json
{"action": "tap", "x": 100, "y": 201}
{"action": "type_text", "text": "copyappfixture"}
{"action": "observe", "contains": ["copyappfixture"]}
```

`playbook`, `discover-check`, flow traces, paired comparison, rebuild checks and delivery gates recognize this action. The step record stores text length and hash; the source script retains the actual text. Original and rebuilt scripts must type the same bytes. A backend failure after typing is never retried automatically through another backend because the action may already have taken effect.

**Assert the visible outcome.** A successful input RPC does not prove that the app received the text; focus and keyboard state matter. Inspect the screen and accessibility/OCR result, and record any automatic submission or transformation separately. Use the same starting field state for a paired comparison. See [current status](current-status.md) for the tested backend scope.

```

# UI 脚本中的文字输入

[English](ui-text-playbooks.md) · 简体中文 · [工作流](copy-workflow.zh-CN.md)

先让输入框获得焦点，再使用 `type_text`。它接受 1–128 个可打印 Unicode 字符，最多 512 个 UTF-8 字节；不会自动清空旧值或按回车。优先使用合成文字，因为来源脚本和后端结果保存在被忽略的本地 `cases/`。

```json
{"action": "tap", "x": 100, "y": 201}
{"action": "type_text", "text": "copyappfixture"}
{"action": "observe", "contains": ["copyappfixture"]}
```

`playbook`、`discover-check`、流程跟踪、成对比较、复刻检查和交付门槛均识别此操作。步骤记录保存文字长度与哈希；来源脚本仍包含原文。原版与复刻版必须输入相同字节。输入后若后端报错，不能自动换后端重试，因为输入可能已经生效。

**必须断言可见结果。** 输入 RPC 成功不证明 App 收到了文字；焦点和键盘状态都会影响结果。检查画面及无障碍／OCR 结果，另外记录自动提交或内容转换。成对比较须让输入框处于同一初始状态。已测后端范围见[当前状态](current-status.zh-CN.md)。

# Examples

`examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/README.md`:

```md
# Owned macOS behavior fixture

This is an **original test application**, not an independently rebuilt delivery.
It supplies deterministic, offline native AppKit behavior for the macOS acceptance
plan. The published iOS examples and workflows are unchanged.

Build on an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode command-line tools. Choose a fresh output
directory; failed builds and source/log snapshots remain in that directory:

```sh
.venv/bin/python examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/build.py \
  --out cases/mac-fixture-build
.venv/bin/copyapp mac inspect \
  --app cases/mac-fixture-build/BehaviorFixture.app --out cases/mac-fixture-index
.venv/bin/copyapp verify cases/mac-fixture-index
```

The builder saves its inputs, compiler/signing diagnostics and binary hash. It
signs the original fixture ad-hoc, verifies the signature and does not launch or
install it. `build.json` is a development build log, not a Copy APP delivery case.
`mac inspect` proves the static package inventory only.

The Bundle ID is `dev.copyapp.fixture.Behavior`, version 1.0, build 2. Use the
registered guest's actual App path after copying the reviewed original there;
collect it with `mac acquire` and compare its full package hash to the static
index. Do not use `mac install` for an original: that command is for a reviewed
independent rebuild. Keep host/guest and each original/rebuilt build separate.

## Behavior to observe before freezing flows

| Surface | Intended behavior | Evidence to capture |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Editor | Plain UTF-8 text; character, whitespace-separated word and UTF-8 byte counts | AX text plus actual saved bytes |
| File → Save As / Open | Native panels; saving retains exact UTF-8 bytes; opening creates another document | Panel/AX captures, saved output, reopened text |
| File → New | A new numbered window, Command-N | Two distinct document windows and precise Window-menu selection |
| Tools → Show Inspector | A separate window with the current document's counts | Window identity and count text |
| File → Export Summary | JSON with text, characters, words, utf8_bytes and wrapping | Full expected JSON assertion |
| Tools → Toggle Wrapping | Global fixture setting, Command-Shift-W, persisted across normal quit/relaunch | Before/after status plus a stopped-process check and fresh launch |
| Tools → Reset Fixture Settings | Set fixture wrapping to On; touches only this App's preference key | Assert the restored status before another run |
| Window menu | Switch/close/minimize native windows | Exact titles/identifiers; OS-injected commands require separate scope review |

An empty document has zero characters and words. Character count uses Swift
String grapheme clusters; UTF-8 bytes are counted separately. Documents are not
autosaved and close/quit without an unsaved-change prompt. Open panels accept
plain text; summary export uses JSON. No network, account or payment is involved.
The setting key is `fixture.wrap` in this Bundle ID's UserDefaults. This describes
the fixture's intended behavior; actual replay and comparison remain required.

Use scoped selectors: `fixture.editor` and `fixture.status` repeat across document
windows. Document titles are `Fixture Document N`; inspectors are `Fixture
Inspector N`. An ambiguous selector must fail rather than picking the first node.

Prepare at least three distinct **observed** flow cases, covering edit/save/reopen,
setting quit/relaunch persistence, and multiple windows/inspector/summary export.
Use fresh run-scoped output paths and no replacement of existing files. Observe
the real guest panels and AX before authoring replay selectors; do not substitute
host coordinates or treat this checklist as accepted playbooks. Freeze the reviewed
known inventory/target before independently implementing the rebuild under another
Bundle ID. Then compare every selected flow for three rounds, with full image and
output review. An original-only smoke test cannot satisfy any paired-delivery gate.

## Recorded development scope

On 2026-10-21, the host's build-1 compilation failure was retained, and build-2
(version 1.0/build 1) was opened through the computer-use UI. Editing, native save
and open panels, an inspector, JSON output and wrapping across quit/relaunch were
observed. The saved test text was exactly 32 UTF-8 bytes, and its summary contained
the asserted six words and 32 characters/bytes. This was a host original-only
smoke test, with manually recorded observations, not a verified reconstruction.

Build-3 (version 1.0/build 2) adds the native Window menu. It compiled/signed and
passed its static index verifier. Its actual UI showed two listed documents and
switched from Document 2 back to Document 1 through that menu. The fixture was
then quit and its process absence checked. Earlier observations from another
binary are not merged into this build's acceptance. Logs and output files remain
under ignored `cases/macos-owned-fixture-20261021/`.

Guest replay, independent reconstruction, three paired rounds and physical-Mac
reconstruction recheck are still outstanding. Follow
[the implementation ledger](../../../docs/macos-implementation-plan.md),
[Mac skill](../../../skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md) and
[paired check contract](../../../docs/macos-checks.md).

```

`examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/Sources/Main.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

final class DocumentWindow: NSObject, NSWindowDelegate, NSTextViewDelegate {
    let window: NSWindow
    let editor = NSTextView()
    let status = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
    let number: Int
    var url: URL?
    var inspector: NSWindow?
    var statistics: NSTextField?
    weak var owner: FixtureApp?

    init(number: Int, owner: FixtureApp) {
        self.number = number
        self.owner = owner
        window = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 180 + number * 24, y: 180 + number * 24, width: 720, height: 480),
                          styleMask: [.titled, .closable, .miniaturizable, .resizable], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        super.init()
        window.title = "Fixture Document \(number)"
        window.identifier = NSUserInterfaceItemIdentifier("fixture.document.\(number)")
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.delegate = self
        window.minSize = NSSize(width: 480, height: 320)
        let content = window.contentView!
        let scroll = NSScrollView()
        scroll.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        scroll.hasVerticalScroller = true
        scroll.borderType = .bezelBorder
        editor.isRichText = false
        editor.allowsUndo = true
        editor.font = .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .regular)
        editor.textContainerInset = NSSize(width: 12, height: 12)
        editor.isVerticallyResizable = true
        editor.autoresizingMask = [.width]
        editor.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.editor")
        editor.delegate = self
        editor.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 660, height: 380)
        scroll.documentView = editor
        status.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        status.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12)
        status.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.status")
        content.addSubview(scroll)
        content.addSubview(status)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            scroll.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            scroll.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            scroll.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.topAnchor, constant: 16),
            scroll.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: status.topAnchor, constant: -12),
            status.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scroll.leadingAnchor),
            status.trailingAnchor.constraint(lessThanOrEqualTo: scroll.trailingAnchor),
            status.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: content.bottomAnchor, constant: -14)
        ])
        editor.minSize = NSSize(width: 0, height: 0)
        editor.maxSize = NSSize(width: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude, height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        editor.textContainer?.containerSize = NSSize(width: 660, height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        applyWrapping()
    }

    var text: String { editor.string }
    var words: Int { text.split(whereSeparator: { $0.isWhitespace }).count }

    func applyWrapping() {
        let enabled = owner?.wrap ?? true
        editor.isHorizontallyResizable = !enabled
        editor.textContainer?.widthTracksTextView = enabled
        editor.enclosingScrollView?.hasHorizontalScroller = !enabled
        editor.textContainer?.containerSize = NSSize(width: enabled ? max(100, window.contentView!.bounds.width - 58) : 100_000,
                                                    height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        refresh()
    }

    func refresh() {
        status.stringValue = "Wrapping: \((owner?.wrap ?? true) ? "On" : "Off") | Characters: \(text.count) | Words: \(words)"
        statistics?.stringValue = "Characters: \(text.count)\nWords: \(words)\nUTF-8 bytes: \(text.utf8.count)"
    }

    func show() {
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        window.makeFirstResponder(editor)
    }

    func textDidChange(_ notification: Notification) { refresh() }
    func windowDidBecomeKey(_ notification: Notification) { owner?.active = self }
    func windowWillClose(_ notification: Notification) {
        inspector?.close()
        owner?.documents.removeAll { $0 === self }
        if owner?.active === self { owner?.active = owner?.documents.last }
    }

    func showInspector() {
        if inspector == nil {
            let panel = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 970, y: 310, width: 300, height: 170),
                                 styleMask: [.titled, .closable], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.title = "Fixture Inspector \(number)"
            panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
            let label = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
            label.frame = NSRect(x: 24, y: 26, width: 252, height: 112)
            label.font = .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .regular)
            label.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.statistics")
            panel.contentView!.addSubview(label)
            inspector = panel
            statistics = label
        }
        refresh()
        inspector?.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
    }
}

final class FixtureApp: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {
    var documents: [DocumentWindow] = []
    weak var active: DocumentWindow?
    var counter = 0
    var wrap: Bool {
        get { UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: "fixture.wrap") }
        set {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: "fixture.wrap")
            for document in documents { document.applyWrapping() }
        }
    }

    func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ notification: Notification) {
        UserDefaults.standard.register(defaults: ["fixture.wrap": true])
        NSApplication.shared.mainMenu = menus()
        NSApplication.shared.setActivationPolicy(.regular)
        newDocument(nil)
        NSApplication.shared.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
    }

    func applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed(_ sender: NSApplication) -> Bool { false }

    func item(_ title: String, _ action: Selector, _ key: String = "", shift: Bool = false) -> NSMenuItem {
        let result = NSMenuItem(title: title, action: action, keyEquivalent: key)
        result.target = self
        result.keyEquivalentModifierMask = shift ? [.command, .shift] : [.command]
        return result
    }

    func menus() -> NSMenu {
        let bar = NSMenu()
        func menu(_ title: String) -> NSMenu {
            let heading = NSMenuItem(title: title, action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
            let menu = NSMenu(title: title)
            heading.submenu = menu
            bar.addItem(heading)
            return menu
        }
        let app = menu("Behavior Fixture")
        let quit = NSMenuItem(title: "Quit Behavior Fixture", action: #selector(NSApplication.terminate(_:)), keyEquivalent: "q")
        quit.target = NSApplication.shared
        app.addItem(quit)
        let file = menu("File")
        file.addItem(item("New", #selector(newDocument(_:)), "n"))
        file.addItem(item("Open…", #selector(openDocument(_:)), "o"))
        file.addItem(item("Save As…", #selector(saveDocument(_:)), "s"))
        file.addItem(item("Export Summary…", #selector(exportSummary(_:)), "e", shift: true))
        let edit = menu("Edit")
        for (title, selector, key) in [("Undo", "undo:", "z"), ("Cut", "cut:", "x"),
                                       ("Copy", "copy:", "c"), ("Paste", "paste:", "v"), ("Select All", "selectAll:", "a")] {
            edit.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: title, action: NSSelectorFromString(selector), keyEquivalent: key))
        }
        let tools = menu("Tools")
        tools.addItem(item("Toggle Wrapping", #selector(toggleWrapping(_:)), "w", shift: true))
        tools.addItem(item("Show Inspector", #selector(showInspector(_:)), "i", shift: true))
        tools.addItem(.separator())
        tools.addItem(item("Reset Fixture Settings", #selector(resetSettings(_:))))
        let windows = menu("Window")
        windows.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: "Close", action: #selector(NSWindow.performClose(_:)), keyEquivalent: "w"))
        windows.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: "Minimize", action: #selector(NSWindow.performMiniaturize(_:)), keyEquivalent: "m"))
        windows.addItem(.separator())
        let all = NSMenuItem(title: "Bring All to Front", action: #selector(NSApplication.arrangeInFront(_:)), keyEquivalent: "")
        all.target = NSApplication.shared
        windows.addItem(all)
        NSApplication.shared.windowsMenu = windows
        return bar
    }

    @objc func newDocument(_ sender: Any?) {
        counter += 1
        let document = DocumentWindow(number: counter, owner: self)
        documents.append(document)
        document.show()
    }

    func selected() -> DocumentWindow? {
        if let active { return active }
        newDocument(nil)
        return active ?? documents.last
    }

    func fail(_ error: Error) { NSAlert(error: error).runModal() }

    @objc func openDocument(_ sender: Any?) {
        let panel = NSOpenPanel()
        panel.allowedContentTypes = [.plainText]
        panel.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        panel.canChooseDirectories = false
        if panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url {
            do {
                let text = try String(contentsOf: url, encoding: .utf8)
                newDocument(nil)
                let document = documents.last!
                document.url = url
                document.editor.string = text
                document.refresh()
            } catch { fail(error) }
        }
    }

    @objc func saveDocument(_ sender: Any?) {
        guard let document = selected() else { return }
        let panel = NSSavePanel()
        panel.allowedContentTypes = [.plainText]
        panel.nameFieldStringValue = "fixture.txt"
        if panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url {
            do {
                try Data(document.text.utf8).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
                document.url = url
                document.refresh()
            } catch { fail(error) }
        }
    }

    @objc func exportSummary(_ sender: Any?) {
        guard let document = selected() else { return }
        let panel = NSSavePanel()
        panel.allowedContentTypes = [.json]
        panel.nameFieldStringValue = "summary.json"
        if panel.runModal() == .OK, let url = panel.url {
            do {
                let value: [String: Any] = ["text": document.text, "characters": document.text.count,
                                           "words": document.words, "utf8_bytes": document.text.utf8.count,
                                           "wrapping": wrap]
                try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: value, options: [.sortedKeys, .prettyPrinted]).write(to: url, options: .atomic)
            } catch { fail(error) }
        }
    }

    @objc func toggleWrapping(_ sender: Any?) { wrap.toggle() }
    @objc func resetSettings(_ sender: Any?) { wrap = true }
    @objc func showInspector(_ sender: Any?) { selected()?.showInspector() }
}

let application = NSApplication.shared
let delegate = FixtureApp()
application.delegate = delegate
application.run()

```

`examples/macos/BehaviorFixture/build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build an owned original sample. This is not a Copy APP rebuilt delivery."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    output = args.out.resolve()
    if output == source or source in output.parents:
        raise ValueError("build outside the source fixture")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    snapshot = output / "source"
    shutil.copytree(source, snapshot, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    inputs = {str(path.relative_to(snapshot)): sha(path) for path in sorted(snapshot.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()}
    app = output / "BehaviorFixture.app"
    binary = app / "Contents/MacOS/BehaviorFixture"
    binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(snapshot / "Info.plist", app / "Contents/Info.plist")
    logs = []
    record = {"scope": "owned_original_fixture_build_only", "inputs": inputs, "launched": False}
    try:
        for argv in (["xcrun", "swiftc", "-swift-version", "5", "-target", "arm64-apple-macos14.0",
                      str(snapshot / "Sources/Main.swift"), "-o", str(binary)],
                     ["/usr/bin/codesign", "--sign", "-", "--identifier", "dev.copyapp.fixture.Behavior", str(app)],
                     ["/usr/bin/codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(app)]):
            result = subprocess.run(argv, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
            logs.append({"argv": argv, "returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr})
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError("fixture build failed; inspect build-log.json")
        if any(sha(source / name) != value or sha(snapshot / name) != value for name, value in inputs.items()):
            raise ValueError("fixture source changed during build")
        record.update(status="built", executable_sha256=sha(binary))
    except BaseException as exc:
        record.update(status="failed", error=type(exc).__name__, message=str(exc))
        raise
    finally:
        (output / "build-log.json").write_text(json.dumps(logs, indent=2) + "\n")
        (output / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(app)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Independent selected-behavior editor

This native AppKit example implements the reviewed behavior of the owned
`BehaviorFixture` sample under a separate Bundle ID (`dev.copyapp.examples.Editor`).
It provides plain text documents, UTF-8 Save/Open, per-document inspectors, JSON
summary export and a saved wrapping preference. The compatibility document titles
and AX identifiers allow the same bounded playbooks to run on both applications.

The reviewed target and verified selected delivery both cover seven of nine named
known capabilities (77.78%). Three rounds passed 9/9 selected behavior comparisons;
all 285 full screenshot pairs were reviewed, with zero major and 285 minor
differences. Independent App identity, clock/caret/Dock phases and native-panel
directory history/focus remain recorded. Clipboard/Undo behavior and general window management are
deferred. Arbitrary Unicode, long text, error paths, other OS builds and physical
Mac behavior are unverified. The original fixture source was available to the
author; this is a workflow acceptance example, not a blind reconstruction benchmark.

Local evidence begins at `cases/macos-owned-fixture-20261021/report-1` and the frozen
`rebuild-plan-3`; the accepted historical chain is `rebuilt-build-4`,
`rebuilt-install-3`, `check-plan-3`, `check-3`, `visual-review-3` and `delivery-1`.
Raw evidence remains ignored and local. Older failed/adverse attempts are retained.
Build with `copyapp mac build-app --plan <PLAN> --swift-source
Sources/Main.swift --info-plist Info.plist --out <NEW_BUILD_CASE>`. Install and
compare through the Mac skill; a successful build is not acceptance.

`examples/macos/IndependentEditor/Sources/Main.swift`:

```swift
import AppKit
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

// Independent implementation of the selected, observed fixture contract.
// The source fixture's package and data are never loaded by this application.
final class EditorSession: NSObject, NSWindowDelegate, NSTextViewDelegate {
    let index: Int
    unowned let workspace: EditorWorkspace
    let window: NSWindow
    let textView = NSTextView()
    let caption = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
    let viewport = NSScrollView()
    var inspector: NSWindow?
    var readout: NSTextField?

    var wordCount: Int { textView.string.split(whereSeparator: { $0.isWhitespace }).count }

    init(index: Int, workspace: EditorWorkspace, text: String) {
        self.index = index
        self.workspace = workspace
        window = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 180 + index * 24, y: 180 + index * 24,
                                              width: 720, height: 480),
                          styleMask: [.titled, .closable, .miniaturizable, .resizable],
                          backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        super.init()
        window.title = "Fixture Document \(index)"
        window.identifier = NSUserInterfaceItemIdentifier("fixture.document.\(index)")
        window.delegate = self
        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
        window.minSize = NSSize(width: 480, height: 320)
        viewport.frame = NSRect(x: 16, y: 42, width: 688, height: 422)
        viewport.autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
        viewport.borderType = .bezelBorder
        viewport.hasVerticalScroller = true
        textView.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 669, height: 421)
        textView.isRichText = false
        textView.allowsUndo = true
        textView.font = .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .regular)
        textView.textContainerInset = NSSize(width: 12, height: 12)
        textView.minSize = .zero
        textView.maxSize = NSSize(width: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude, height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        textView.isVerticallyResizable = true
        textView.autoresizingMask = [.width]
        textView.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.editor")
        textView.delegate = self
        textView.string = text
        viewport.documentView = textView
        caption.frame.origin = NSPoint(x: 16, y: 14)
        caption.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12)
        caption.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.status")
        window.contentView!.addSubview(viewport)
        window.contentView!.addSubview(caption)
        updateWrapping()
    }

    func focus() {
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        window.makeFirstResponder(textView)
    }

    func updateWrapping() {
        textView.isHorizontallyResizable = !workspace.wrapping
        textView.textContainer?.widthTracksTextView = workspace.wrapping
        textView.textContainer?.containerSize = NSSize(
            width: workspace.wrapping ? max(100, window.contentView!.bounds.width - 58) : 100_000,
            height: CGFloat.greatestFiniteMagnitude)
        viewport.hasHorizontalScroller = !workspace.wrapping
        refresh()
    }

    func refresh() {
        let count = textView.string.count
        caption.stringValue = "Wrapping: \(workspace.wrapping ? "On" : "Off") | Characters: \(count) | Words: \(wordCount)"
        caption.sizeToFit()
        readout?.stringValue = "Characters: \(count)\nWords: \(wordCount)\nUTF-8 bytes: \(textView.string.utf8.count)"
    }

    func inspect() {
        if inspector == nil {
            let panel = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 970, y: 310, width: 300, height: 170),
                                 styleMask: [.titled, .closable], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
            panel.title = "Fixture Inspector \(index)"
            panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
            let label = NSTextField(wrappingLabelWithString: "")
            label.frame = NSRect(x: 24, y: 26, width: 252, height: 112)
            label.font = .monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .regular)
            label.setAccessibilityIdentifier("fixture.statistics")
            panel.contentView!.addSubview(label)
            inspector = panel
            readout = label
        }
        refresh()
        inspector!.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
    }

    func textDidChange(_ notification: Notification) { refresh() }
    func windowDidBecomeKey(_ notification: Notification) { workspace.selected = self }
    func windowWillClose(_ notification: Notification) {
        inspector?.close()
        workspace.sessions.removeAll { $0 === self }
        if workspace.selected === self { workspace.selected = workspace.sessions.last }
    }
}

final class EditorWorkspace: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {
    var sessions: [EditorSession] = []
    weak var selected: EditorSession?
    var nextIndex = 0
    var wrapping: Bool {
        get { UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: "editor.wrapping") as? Bool ?? true }
        set {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: "editor.wrapping")
            sessions.forEach { $0.updateWrapping() }
        }
    }

    func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ notification: Notification) {
        installMenus()
        NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.regular)
        addDocument("")
        NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
    }

    func addDocument(_ text: String) {
        nextIndex += 1
        let session = EditorSession(index: nextIndex, workspace: self, text: text)
        sessions.append(session)
        session.focus()
    }

    func installMenus() {
        let bar = NSMenu()
        func group(_ title: String) -> NSMenu {
            let heading = NSMenuItem(title: title, action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
            let menu = NSMenu(title: title)
            heading.submenu = menu
            bar.addItem(heading)
            return menu
        }
        func command(_ menu: NSMenu, _ title: String, _ action: Selector, _ key: String = "", shifted: Bool = false) {
            let entry = NSMenuItem(title: title, action: action, keyEquivalent: key)
            entry.target = self
            entry.keyEquivalentModifierMask = shifted ? [.command, .shift] : [.command]
            menu.addItem(entry)
        }
        let app = group("Copy APP Editor")
        let quit = NSMenuItem(title: "Quit Copy APP Editor", action: #selector(NSApplication.terminate(_:)), keyEquivalent: "q")
        quit.target = NSApp
        app.addItem(quit)
        let file = group("File")
        command(file, "New", #selector(newDocument(_:)), "n")
        command(file, "Open…", #selector(openDocument(_:)), "o")
        command(file, "Save As…", #selector(saveDocument(_:)), "s")
        command(file, "Export Summary…", #selector(exportSummary(_:)), "e", shifted: true)
        let edit = group("Edit")
        for (title, selector, key) in [("Undo", "undo:", "z"), ("Cut", "cut:", "x"), ("Copy", "copy:", "c"),
                                       ("Paste", "paste:", "v"), ("Select All", "selectAll:", "a")] {
            edit.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: title, action: NSSelectorFromString(selector), keyEquivalent: key))
        }
        let tools = group("Tools")
        command(tools, "Toggle Wrapping", #selector(toggleWrapping(_:)), "w", shifted: true)
        command(tools, "Show Inspector", #selector(showInspector(_:)), "i", shifted: true)
        tools.addItem(.separator())
        command(tools, "Reset Fixture Settings", #selector(resetSettings(_:)))
        let windows = group("Window")
        windows.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: "Close", action: #selector(NSWindow.performClose(_:)), keyEquivalent: "w"))
        windows.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: "Minimize", action: #selector(NSWindow.performMiniaturize(_:)), keyEquivalent: "m"))
        windows.addItem(.separator())
        let front = NSMenuItem(title: "Bring All to Front", action: #selector(NSApplication.arrangeInFront(_:)), keyEquivalent: "")
        front.target = NSApp
        windows.addItem(front)
        NSApp.windowsMenu = windows
        // Attach the completed menu tree so AppKit can add its standard window
        // commands before the application becomes active.
        NSApp.mainMenu = bar
    }

    @objc func newDocument(_ sender: Any?) { addDocument("") }
    @objc func toggleWrapping(_ sender: Any?) { wrapping.toggle() }
    @objc func resetSettings(_ sender: Any?) { wrapping = true }
    @objc func showInspector(_ sender: Any?) { selected?.inspect() }

    @objc func openDocument(_ sender: Any?) {
        let chooser = NSOpenPanel()
        chooser.allowedContentTypes = [.plainText]
        chooser.canChooseDirectories = false
        chooser.allowsMultipleSelection = false
        guard chooser.runModal() == .OK, let file = chooser.url else { return }
        do { addDocument(try String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8)) }
        catch { NSAlert(error: error).runModal() }
    }

    func write(using type: UTType, name: String, payload: () throws -> Data) {
        let chooser = NSSavePanel()
        chooser.allowedContentTypes = [type]
        chooser.nameFieldStringValue = name
        guard chooser.runModal() == .OK, let file = chooser.url else { return }
        do { try payload().write(to: file, options: .atomic) }
        catch { NSAlert(error: error).runModal() }
    }

    @objc func saveDocument(_ sender: Any?) {
        guard let session = selected else { return }
        write(using: .plainText, name: "fixture.txt") { Data(session.textView.string.utf8) }
    }

    @objc func exportSummary(_ sender: Any?) {
        guard let session = selected else { return }
        let text = session.textView.string
        let summary: [String: Any] = ["text": text, "characters": text.count, "words": session.wordCount,
                                     "utf8_bytes": text.utf8.count, "wrapping": wrapping]
        write(using: .json, name: "summary.json") {
            try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: summary, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys])
        }
    }
}

@main enum CopyAppEditor {
    static func main() {
        let app = NSApplication.shared
        let workspace = EditorWorkspace()
        app.delegate = workspace
        app.run()
    }
}

# Stocks selected-behavior example

An independent AppKit example based on observed Apple Stocks 8.0 (2028) behavior
in a named ChatComputer macOS 27.0.1 guest. Bundle ID:
`dev.copyapp.examples.Stocks`. Original Apple binaries, artwork, news articles and
account data are not included. Curves are generated; prices are **illustrative
offline data**, labelled inside the App. This example has no live market service.

Ask the current Codex or Claude Code agent:

```text
Read AGENTS.md and skills/copyapp-mac/SKILL.md. Work on examples/macos/Stocks.
Use ChatComputer and the bounded collector to identify the exact guest and Stocks
build. Review and replay its three example playbooks from an inspected AAPL detail
with a blank search field. Preserve failures and freeze the reviewed known scope
before changing this independent example. Build, install at a separate guest path,
compare the selected flows and disclose visual/data differences. Keep iOS support
intact. Use the current agent session and keep original and independent Apps separate.
```

The current selected scope is symbol search/detail navigation, chart-period
selection with quit/relaunch persistence, and creation/management of local named
watchlists. The reviewed original inventory has 11 known capabilities; these three
are a target of 3/11 (27.27%) of that inventory. This is a target, not verified
coverage or a whole-App completeness estimate.

The original scripts in `playbooks/` target `/System/Applications/Stocks.app`.
Use them only after acquiring the actual original and inspecting its state. They
search MSFT, switch the AAPL chart period, and create then remove the test-only
`CopyAPP Test` watchlist. An unexpected dialog, duplicate test name or failed input
requires inspection. Generated rebuild plans change only App identity/path; do not
edit a frozen plan's scripts to make a clone pass.

The search script uses reviewed ticker-text click points after unique AX assertions
and bounded settling waits. It requires the observed 1080×670 window at (100, 56)
on the 1280×800 screenshot display. Inspect that frame before a standalone run;
paired checks freeze and validate it. If the frame or interface changes, prepare
a new reviewed script and evidence chain instead of editing a frozen case.

To build a local demo without the evidence workflow:

```sh

This compiles/signs a fresh `.app` and retains source/build diagnostics. Open the
resulting App normally. Its menu supports New Watchlist and Manage Watchlists;
search matches the small bundled symbol catalog. It stores periods and watchlist
names in its own UserDefaults domain. It does not change Apple's Stocks data.

For a source-linked guest build, use the reviewed `mac rebuild-plan` and:

```sh

  --swift-source Sources/Main.swift --info-plist Info.plist --out <NEW_BUILD_CASE>

Remaining differences include the restricted local symbol catalog, generated
