```swift
import AppKit

// Independent local-data reconstruction of the reviewed interaction scope.
// These illustrative quotes and generated curves never contact a market service.
struct Symbol {
    let ticker: String
    let company: String
    let price: Double
    let change: Double
    var rowLabel: String { "\(company), \(ticker)" }
}

let symbols: [Symbol] = [
    Symbol(ticker: "Dow Jones", company: "Dow Jones Industrial Average", price: 52780, change: 284),
    Symbol(ticker: "S&P 500", company: "Standard & Poor’s 500", price: 7765, change: 53),
    Symbol(ticker: "AAPL", company: "Apple Inc.", price: 344.50, change: 5),
    Symbol(ticker: "BA", company: "The Boeing Company", price: 192.60, change: 2.12),
    Symbol(ticker: "BRK-B", company: "Berkshire Hathaway Inc.", price: 542, change: 2.18),
    Symbol(ticker: "DIS", company: "The Walt Disney Company", price: 111.20, change: -0.47),
    Symbol(ticker: "GE", company: "GE Aerospace", price: 299.50, change: -0.37),
    Symbol(ticker: "MSFT", company: "Microsoft Corporation", price: 532.50, change: 0.63)
]

let relatedSymbols = [
    Symbol(ticker: "^MSFT", company: "Cboe Microsoft Call Writing Ind", price: 73.33, change: 0.07),
    Symbol(ticker: "^MSFTIO", company: "Cboe Microsoft Income Only Inde", price: 101.29, change: 0),
    Symbol(ticker: "^MSFTCW", company: "Cboe Microsoft Call Writing Ind", price: 73.38, change: 0.05),
    Symbol(ticker: "^MSFTDI", company: "Cboe Microsoft Defined Income I", price: 265.29, change: 0.46),
    Symbol(ticker: "MSFTD.BA", company: "Microsoft Corporation", price: 18.73, change: 0.20),
    Symbol(ticker: "MSFTC.BA", company: "Microsoft Corporation", price: 17.76, change: 0.07)
]

final class State {
    let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
    var selected = "news"
    var query = ""
    var lists: [String]
    var activeList: String?
    var periods: [String: String]
    // Creating a list opens search; a cold launch restores the empty-list page.
    var showingEmptyListSearch = false
    init() {
        lists = defaults.stringArray(forKey: "watchlists") ?? []
        periods = defaults.dictionary(forKey: "periods") as? [String: String] ?? [:]
        activeList = defaults.string(forKey: "activeWatchlist")
        if !lists.contains(activeList ?? "") { activeList = nil }
    }
    func save() {
        defaults.set(lists, forKey: "watchlists")
        defaults.set(periods, forKey: "periods")
        defaults.set(activeList, forKey: "activeWatchlist")
    }
    var symbol: Symbol { (symbols + relatedSymbols).first { $0.ticker == selected } ?? symbols[2] }
    var period: String { periods[selected] ?? "1 day" }
}

final class PressElement: NSAccessibilityElement {
    var press: (() -> Void)?
    override func accessibilityPerformPress() -> Bool {
        guard let press else { return false }
        press(); return true
    }
}

final class StocksView: NSView, NSTextFieldDelegate {
    let state: State
    let search = NSTextField()
    let nameField = NSTextField()
    var dialog: String?
    var selectedList: String?
    var ax: [Any] = []
    var hits: [(NSRect, () -> Void)] = []
    let green = NSColor.systemGreen
    let muted = NSColor.secondaryLabelColor
    var bodyX: CGFloat { 370 }
    var bodyWidth: CGFloat { bounds.width - 410 }
    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }

    init(state: State) {
        self.state = state
        super.init(frame: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1080, height: 670))
        autoresizingMask = [.width, .height]
        setAccessibilityElement(true)
        setAccessibilityRole(.group)
        for field in [search, nameField] {
            field.isBordered = false
            field.drawsBackground = false
            field.focusRingType = .none
            field.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 13)
            field.delegate = self
            addSubview(field)
        }
        search.placeholderString = "Stocks"
        search.setAccessibilityLabel("Stocks")
        nameField.placeholderString = "New Watchlist"
        nameField.setAccessibilityLabel("Name")
        nameField.isHidden = true
    }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) is unsupported") }
    override var acceptsFirstResponder: Bool { true }
    override func viewDidMoveToWindow() { super.viewDidMoveToWindow(); refresh() }
    override func layout() {
        super.layout()
        search.frame = NSRect(x: 42, y: 69, width: 245, height: 22)
        if dialog == "new" {
            nameField.frame = NSRect(x: bounds.midX - 100, y: bounds.midY + 1, width: 245, height: 22)
        }
    }
    func refresh() {
        state.save()
        window?.title = state.selected == "news" ? "Stocks" : "\(state.symbol.ticker) – \(state.symbol.company)"
        needsLayout = true
        needsDisplay = true
        rebuildAccessibility()
    }
    func controlTextDidChange(_ notification: Notification) {
        if notification.object as? NSTextField === search { state.query = search.stringValue }
        refresh()
    }
    func text(_ string: String, _ x: CGFloat, _ y: CGFloat, _ size: CGFloat = 13,
              _ weight: NSFont.Weight = .regular, _ color: NSColor = .labelColor) {
        (string as NSString).draw(at: NSPoint(x: x, y: y), withAttributes: [
            .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: size, weight: weight), .foregroundColor: color])
    }
    func box(_ rect: NSRect, _ color: NSColor, radius: CGFloat = 0) {
        color.setFill()
        NSBezierPath(roundedRect: rect, xRadius: radius, yRadius: radius).fill()
    }
    func line(_ x: CGFloat, _ y: CGFloat, _ width: CGFloat) {
        box(NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: width, height: 0.5), .separatorColor)
    }
    func chart(_ rect: NSRect, seed: Int, color: NSColor, fill: Bool) {
        let path = NSBezierPath()
        let count = 90
        for i in 0..<count {
            let t = Double(i) / Double(count - 1)
            let wave = 0.18 * sin(t * 19 + Double(seed)) + 0.07 * sin(t * 77)
            let p = NSPoint(x: rect.minX + t * rect.width,
                            y: rect.maxY - (0.14 + 0.67 * t + wave) * rect.height)
            if i == 0 { path.move(to: p) } else { path.line(to: p) }
        }
        if fill {
            let area = path.copy() as! NSBezierPath
            area.line(to: NSPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.maxY))
            area.line(to: NSPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY)); area.close()
            NSGradient(starting: color.withAlphaComponent(0.24), ending: color.withAlphaComponent(0.01))?
                .draw(in: area, angle: 90)
        }
        color.setStroke(); path.lineWidth = fill ? 1.6 : 1.2; path.stroke()
    }
    var resultSymbols: [Symbol] {
        let query = state.query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        return (symbols + relatedSymbols).filter { $0.ticker.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(query) || $0.company.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(query) }
    }
    func resultY(_ index: Int) -> CGFloat { index == 0 ? 108 : 172 + CGFloat(index - 1) * 92 }
    override func draw(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
        box(bounds, NSColor.windowBackgroundColor)
        box(NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 330, height: bounds.height), NSColor.windowBackgroundColor)
        box(NSRect(x: 8, y: 62, width: 314, height: 36), NSColor.textBackgroundColor, radius: 18)
        text("⌕", 20, 67, 22, .regular, muted)
        if !state.query.isEmpty { text("⊗", 294, 70, 17, .regular, muted) }
        box(NSRect(x: 278, y: 7, width: 44, height: 38), .textBackgroundColor, radius: 19)
        text("•••⌄", 287, 17, 13, .semibold)
        if !state.query.isEmpty {
            for (i, symbol) in resultSymbols.enumerated() {
                if resultY(i) < bounds.height - 56 { drawRow(symbol, y: resultY(i), searchResult: true) }
            }
            if resultSymbols.isEmpty { text("No Results", 115, 220, 16, .semibold, muted) }
        } else if let list = state.activeList {
            if state.showingEmptyListSearch {
                let lens = NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 138, y: 269, width: 42, height: 42))
                lens.move(to: NSPoint(x: 174, y: 305))
                lens.line(to: NSPoint(x: 191, y: 322))
                muted.withAlphaComponent(0.4).setStroke()
                lens.lineWidth = 4.5; lens.lineCapStyle = .round; lens.stroke()
                text("Search Stocks", 96, 358, 21)
                text("Add symbols to “\(list).”", 54, 391, 13, .regular, muted)
            } else {
                drawBusinessNews()
                text(list, 24, 214, 15, .semibold)
                text("No Symbols", 112, 326, 16, .semibold)
                text("Add symbols to see price quotes.", 65, 351, 12, .regular, muted)
                drawButton("Add Symbol", NSRect(x: 62, y: 372, width: 194, height: 24))
            }
        } else {
            drawBusinessNews()
            for (i, symbol) in symbols.prefix(7).enumerated() { drawRow(symbol, y: CGFloat(190 + i * 61), searchResult: false) }
        }
        box(NSRect(x: 0, y: bounds.height - 56, width: 330, height: 56), NSColor.windowBackgroundColor)
        text("Copy APP", 26, bounds.height - 36, 14, .bold, muted)
        text("Demo data · offline", 167, bounds.height - 35, 11, .medium, muted)
        if state.selected == "news" { drawOverview() } else { drawDetail() }
        if let dialog { drawDialog(dialog) }
    }
    func drawBusinessNews() {
        if state.selected == "news" { box(NSRect(x: 10, y: 130, width: 310, height: 60), NSColor.selectedContentBackgroundColor.withAlphaComponent(0.15), radius: 12) }
        text("Business News", 26, 141, 14, .semibold)
        text("Local demo overview", 26, 162, 11, .regular, muted)
    }
    func drawRow(_ symbol: Symbol, y: CGFloat, searchResult: Bool) {
        let selected = symbol.ticker == state.selected
        let height: CGFloat = searchResult ? (symbol.ticker == "MSFT" ? 64 : 92) : 61
        if selected { box(NSRect(x: 10, y: y, width: 310, height: height), NSColor.labelColor.withAlphaComponent(0.10), radius: 12) }
        let left: CGFloat = searchResult ? 56 : 26
        text(symbol.ticker, left, y + 11, 14, .semibold)
        if searchResult {
            let exchange = symbol.ticker.hasPrefix("^") ? "Chicago Board Options Exchange" : (symbol.ticker.contains(".BA") ? "Buenos Aires · USD" : "NASDAQ · USD")
            if symbol.ticker == "MSFT" { text(exchange, left + 47, y + 14, 10, .regular, muted) }
            else { text(String(exchange.prefix(29)), left, y + 30, 11, .regular, muted) }
            text(String(symbol.company.prefix(28)), left, y + (symbol.ticker == "MSFT" ? 34 : 60), 11, .regular, muted)
            text(String(format: "%+.2f", symbol.change), 266, y + 34, 13, .medium, symbol.change >= 0 ? green : .systemRed)
        } else { text(String(symbol.company.prefix(27)), left, y + 32, 11, .regular, muted) }
        text(String(format: "%.2f", symbol.price), 247, y + 11, 14, .semibold)
        let color: NSColor = symbol.change >= 0 ? green : .systemRed
        if !searchResult {
            box(NSRect(x: 245, y: y + 33, width: 59, height: 18), color, radius: 3)
            text(String(format: "%+.2f", symbol.change), 250, y + 34, 11, .semibold, .white)
            chart(NSRect(x: 167, y: y + 30, width: 45, height: 20), seed: symbol.ticker.count, color: color, fill: false)
        }
        line(20, y + height, 290)
    }
    func drawOverview() {
        text("Stocks", bodyX, 72, 28, .bold)
        text("Local Demo", bodyX + 96, 73, 28, .bold, muted)
        text("Market Overview", bodyX, 150, 23, .bold)
        for i in 0..<2 {
            let x = bodyX + CGFloat(i) * (bodyWidth / 2 + 8)
            let r = NSRect(x: x, y: 192, width: bodyWidth / 2 - 8, height: 381)
            box(r, .textBackgroundColor, radius: 18)
            box(NSRect(x: x, y: 192, width: r.width, height: 246), (i == 0 ? NSColor.systemGreen : NSColor.systemBlue).withAlphaComponent(0.08), radius: 16)
            chart(NSRect(x: x + 20, y: 224, width: r.width - 40, height: 185), seed: i + 2, color: i == 0 ? green : .systemBlue, fill: true)
            text("Copy APP · Local example", x + 16, 452, 11, .semibold, muted)
            text(i == 0 ? "An independent Stocks example" : "Your watchlists, on this Mac", x + 16, 474, 16, .bold)
            text("Illustrative data. No live news service.", x + 16, 505, 11, .regular, muted)
            drawPreviewCard(x, 589, i)
        }
    }
    let periods = [("1D", "1 day"), ("1W", "1 week"), ("1M", "1 month"), ("3M", "3 months"),
                   ("6M", "6 months"), ("YTD", "year to date"), ("1Y", "1 year"),
                   ("2Y", "2 years"), ("5Y", "5 years"), ("10Y", "10 years"), ("ALL", "ALL")]
    func drawDetail() {
        let symbol = state.symbol
        text(symbol.ticker, bodyX, 60, 34, .bold)
        text(symbol.company, bodyX + 105, 77, 17, .semibold, muted)
        text("NASDAQ · USD", bodyX, 94, 12, .medium, muted)
        text(String(format: "%.2f", symbol.price), bounds.width - 134, 68, 14, .bold)
        text(String(format: "%+.2f", symbol.change), bounds.width - 74, 69, 11, .semibold, green)
        line(bodyX, 122, bodyWidth)
        text("Illustrative market data", bodyX, 140, 15, .semibold)
        text("Offline example", bounds.width - 145, 141, 13, .medium, .systemBlue)
        line(bodyX, 175, bodyWidth)
        let step = (bodyWidth - 36) / 10
        for (i, item) in periods.enumerated() {
            let x = bodyX + CGFloat(i) * step
            if state.period == item.1 { box(NSRect(x: x, y: 181, width: 36, height: 32), NSColor.labelColor.withAlphaComponent(0.07), radius: 16) }
            text(item.0, x + 9, 189, 12, .semibold)
        }
        let plot = NSRect(x: bodyX, y: 220, width: bodyWidth - 36, height: 192)
        for i in 0...4 { line(plot.minX, plot.minY + CGFloat(i) * 48, bodyWidth) }
        let periodIndex = periods.firstIndex { $0.1 == state.period } ?? 0
        let symbolSeed = symbol.ticker.utf8.reduce(0) { $0 + Int($1) }
        chart(plot, seed: symbolSeed + periodIndex * 7, color: symbol.change >= 0 ? green : .systemRed, fill: true)
        let interval: Double = state.period == "1 day" ? (symbol.ticker == "MSFT" ? 2 : 1) : 25
        for i in 0...4 {
            text(String(format: "%.0f", ceil(symbol.price) - Double(i) * interval), plot.maxX + 8, plot.minY + CGFloat(i * 48) - 8, 13, .semibold)
        }
        for (i, label) in (state.period == "1 day" ? ["7", "8", "9", "10", "11", "12"] : ["October", "February", "June", "October"]).enumerated() {
            text(label, bodyX + CGFloat(i) * (state.period == "1 day" ? 110 : 205), 419, 12, .semibold)
        }
        for i in 0..<100 {
            let height = CGFloat((i * 7 + 3) % 9 + 1)
            box(NSRect(x: bodyX + CGFloat(i) * (bodyWidth - 36) / 100, y: 452 - height, width: 2, height: height), muted.withAlphaComponent(0.5), radius: 1)
        }
        for col in 0..<4 {
            let names = [["Open", "High", "Low"], ["Vol", "P/E", "Mkt Cap"], ["52W H", "52W L", "Avg Vol"], ["Yield", "Beta", "EPS"]][col]
            for row in 0..<3 {
                text(names[row], bodyX + CGFloat(col) * 175, CGFloat(467 + row * 22), 13, .regular, muted)
                text(["339.20", "345.25", "338.83", "17.58M", "39.50", "5.027T", "348.15", "243.42", "44.07M", "0.32%", "1.07", "8.72"][col * 3 + row], bodyX + CGFloat(col) * 175 + 93, CGFloat(467 + row * 22), 13, .medium)
            }
        }
        text("Generated curves and sample values · no market connection", bodyX, 548, 12, .regular, muted)
        for i in 0..<2 {
            let x = bodyX + CGFloat(i) * (bodyWidth / 2 + 8)
            drawPreviewCard(x, 578, i)
        }
    }
    func drawPreviewCard(_ x: CGFloat, _ y: CGFloat, _ i: Int) {
            box(NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: bodyWidth / 2 - 8, height: 178), .textBackgroundColor, radius: 16)
            let imageRect = NSRect(x: x + bodyWidth / 2 - 120, y: y + 14, width: 96, height: 100)
            box(imageRect, (i == 0 ? NSColor.systemGreen : NSColor.systemBlue).withAlphaComponent(0.08), radius: 8)
            chart(imageRect.insetBy(dx: 7, dy: 15), seed: i + 3, color: i == 0 ? green : .systemBlue, fill: true)
            text(i == 0 ? "Copy APP" : "Local Demo", x + 14, y + 14, 11, .semibold)
            text(i == 0 ? "Search and explore" : "Charts and saved", x + 14, y + 36, 13, .semibold)
            text(i == 0 ? "market symbols" : "watchlists on this Mac", x + 14, y + 54, 13, .semibold)
    }
    func drawDialog(_ kind: String) {
        // Keep the selected list visible beneath its modal confirmation.
        // Input/AX still expose only the active confirmation's controls.
        if kind == "delete" { drawDialog("manage") }
        box(bounds, .black.withAlphaComponent(0.18))
        let width: CGFloat = kind == "manage" ? 340 : (kind == "delete" ? 260 : 330)
        let height: CGFloat = kind == "manage" ? 446 : (kind == "delete" ? 146 : 170)
        let r = NSRect(x: bounds.midX - width / 2, y: bounds.midY - height / 2, width: width, height: height)
        box(r, .textBackgroundColor, radius: kind == "delete" ? 26 : 18)
        if kind == "new" {
            text("New Watchlist", r.minX + 119, r.minY + 20, 13, .semibold)
            text("Enter a name for this watchlist.", r.minX + 78, r.minY + 49, 12)
            text("Name:", r.minX + 20, r.minY + 88, 12, .regular, muted)
            drawButton("Cancel", NSRect(x: r.minX + 170, y: r.minY + 126, width: 66, height: 24))
            drawButton("Save", NSRect(x: r.minX + 244, y: r.minY + 126, width: 66, height: 24), enabled: !nameField.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty)
        } else if kind == "manage" {
            text("Manage Watchlists", r.minX + 108, r.minY + 19, 13, .semibold)
            let table = NSRect(x: r.minX + 16, y: r.minY + 72, width: 308, height: 278)
            box(table, .controlBackgroundColor)
            for (i, list) in state.lists.enumerated() {
                let row = NSRect(x: r.minX + 16, y: r.minY + 72 + CGFloat(i * 32), width: 308, height: 32)
                if selectedList == list { box(row, .selectedContentBackgroundColor) }
                text(list, row.minX + 10, row.minY + 9, 12, .regular, selectedList == list ? .white : .labelColor)
            }
            NSColor.separatorColor.setStroke()
            NSBezierPath(rect: table).stroke()
            box(NSRect(x: r.minX + 14, y: r.minY + 354, width: 63, height: 32), NSColor.labelColor.withAlphaComponent(0.06), radius: 16)
            text("+", r.minX + 23, r.minY + 361, 17, .regular, muted)
            text("−", r.minX + 54, r.minY + 361, 17, .regular, selectedList != nil ? muted : .tertiaryLabelColor)
            drawButton("Done", NSRect(x: r.minX + 268, y: r.minY + 410, width: 56, height: 24))
        } else {
            text("Delete Watchlist", r.minX + 21, r.minY + 19, 13, .semibold)
            text("Are you sure you want to delete", r.minX + 21, r.minY + 48, 12)
            text("this watchlist?", r.minX + 21, r.minY + 65, 12)
            drawButton("Cancel", NSRect(x: r.minX + 16, y: r.minY + 101, width: 110, height: 28), background: .systemBlue, foreground: .white, radius: 14)
            drawButton("Delete", NSRect(x: r.minX + 134, y: r.minY + 101, width: 110, height: 28), background: NSColor.systemRed.withAlphaComponent(0.24), foreground: .systemRed, radius: 14)
        }
    }
    func drawButton(_ title: String, _ r: NSRect, enabled: Bool = true,
                    background: NSColor = NSColor.labelColor.withAlphaComponent(0.06),
                    foreground: NSColor = .labelColor, radius: CGFloat = 6) {
        box(r, background, radius: radius)
        let size = (title as NSString).size(withAttributes: [.font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 12)])
        text(title, r.midX - size.width / 2, r.midY - 7, 12, .regular, enabled ? foreground : .tertiaryLabelColor)
    }
    func element(_ role: String, _ label: String, _ rect: NSRect, value: String? = nil,
                 identifier: String? = nil, title: String? = nil, enabled: Bool = true,
                 press: (() -> Void)? = nil) -> PressElement {
        let e = PressElement()
        e.setAccessibilityRole(NSAccessibility.Role(rawValue: role))
        e.setAccessibilityLabel(label)
        e.setAccessibilityParent(self)
        e.setAccessibilityEnabled(enabled)
        if let window { e.setAccessibilityFrame(window.convertToScreen(convert(rect, to: nil))) }
        if let value { e.setAccessibilityValue(value) }
        if let identifier { e.setAccessibilityIdentifier(identifier) }
        if let title { e.setAccessibilityTitle(title) }
        e.press = press
        ax.append(e)
        if let press, enabled { hits.append((rect, press)) }
        return e
    }
    func rebuildAccessibility() {
        guard window != nil else { return }
        ax = []; hits = []
        if let kind = dialog { buildDialogAX(kind); setAccessibilityChildren(ax); return }
        ax.append(search)
        if !state.query.isEmpty {
            element("AXButton", "Clear text", NSRect(x: 294, y: 70, width: 20, height: 20), press: { [weak self] in self?.clearSearch() })
            for (i, symbol) in resultSymbols.enumerated() {
                guard resultY(i) < bounds.height - 56 else { continue }
                element("AXGenericElement", symbol.ticker, NSRect(x: 6, y: resultY(i), width: 318, height: symbol.ticker == "MSFT" ? 64 : 92), value: "\(symbol.company), NASDAQ · USD, \(symbol.price)", identifier: symbol.ticker, press: { [weak self] in self?.select(symbol.ticker) })
            }
        } else if let list = state.activeList {
            if state.showingEmptyListSearch {
                element("AXGenericElement", "Search Stocks\nAdd symbols to “\(list).”", NSRect(x: 0, y: 110, width: 330, height: 470))
            } else {
                element("AXStaticText", "Business News\nLocal demo overview", NSRect(x: 10, y: 130, width: 310, height: 60), press: { [weak self] in self?.select("news") })
                element("AXStaticText", list, NSRect(x: 24, y: 206, width: 280, height: 31))
                element("AXStaticText", "No Symbols", NSRect(x: 62, y: 326, width: 194, height: 19))
                element("AXButton", "Add Symbol", NSRect(x: 62, y: 372, width: 194, height: 24), press: { [weak self] in
                    guard let self else { return }
                    self.state.showingEmptyListSearch = true
                    self.refresh(); self.window?.makeFirstResponder(self.search)
                })
            }
        } else {
            element("AXStaticText", "Business News\nLocal demo overview", NSRect(x: 10, y: 130, width: 310, height: 60), press: { [weak self] in self?.select("news") })
            for (i, symbol) in symbols.prefix(7).enumerated() {
                element("AXGenericElement", symbol.rowLabel, NSRect(x: 10, y: 190 + i * 61, width: 310, height: 61), value: String(format: "%.2f", symbol.price), press: { [weak self] in self?.select(symbol.ticker) })
            }
        }
        element("AXMenuButton", "More options", NSRect(x: 278, y: 7, width: 44, height: 38), press: { [weak self] in self?.showOptions() })
        element("AXHeading", state.selected == "news" ? "Stocks" : state.symbol.ticker, NSRect(x: bodyX, y: 60, width: 100, height: 40))
        if state.selected != "news" {
            let group = element("AXScrollArea", "Reporting period", NSRect(x: 330, y: 175, width: bounds.width - 330, height: 44), value: state.period)
            var children: [Any] = []
            for (i, item) in periods.enumerated() {
                let e = element("AXButton", item.1, NSRect(x: bodyX + CGFloat(i) * (bodyWidth - 36) / 10, y: 181, width: 36, height: 32), value: state.period == item.1 ? "selected" : nil, press: { [weak self] in
                    guard let self else { return }; self.state.periods[self.state.selected] = item.1; self.refresh()
                })
                ax.removeLast(); e.setAccessibilityParent(group); children.append(e)
            }
            group.setAccessibilityChildren(children)
        }
        setAccessibilityChildren(ax)
    }
    func buildDialogAX(_ kind: String) {
        let w: CGFloat = kind == "manage" ? 340 : (kind == "delete" ? 260 : 330)
        let h: CGFloat = kind == "manage" ? 446 : (kind == "delete" ? 146 : 170)
        let x = bounds.midX - w / 2, y = bounds.midY - h / 2
        let sheet = element("AXSheet", "", NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: w, height: h))
        if kind == "new" {
            ax.append(nameField)
            element("AXButton", "Cancel", NSRect(x: x + 170, y: y + 126, width: 66, height: 24), press: { [weak self] in self?.closeDialog() })
            element("AXButton", "Save", NSRect(x: x + 244, y: y + 126, width: 66, height: 24), enabled: !nameField.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty, press: { [weak self] in self?.saveList() })
        } else if kind == "manage" {
            element("AXHeading", "Manage Watchlists", NSRect(x: x + 100, y: y + 19, width: 150, height: 19))
            for (i, list) in state.lists.enumerated() {
                element("AXButton", list, NSRect(x: x + 16, y: y + 72 + CGFloat(i * 32), width: 308, height: 32), press: { [weak self] in self?.selectedList = list; self?.refresh() })
            }
            element("AXRadioButton", "add", NSRect(x: x + 14, y: y + 354, width: 31, height: 32), press: { [weak self] in self?.newList() })
            element("AXRadioButton", "remove", NSRect(x: x + 45, y: y + 354, width: 32, height: 32), enabled: selectedList != nil, press: { [weak self] in self?.dialog = "delete"; self?.refresh() })
            element("AXButton", "Done", NSRect(x: x + 268, y: y + 410, width: 56, height: 24), press: { [weak self] in self?.closeDialog() })
        } else {
            element("AXButton", "Cancel", NSRect(x: x + 16, y: y + 101, width: 110, height: 28), title: "Cancel", press: { [weak self] in self?.dialog = "manage"; self?.refresh() })
            element("AXButton", "Delete", NSRect(x: x + 134, y: y + 101, width: 110, height: 28), title: "Delete", press: { [weak self] in self?.removeList() })
        }
        let children = Array(ax.dropFirst())
        sheet.setAccessibilityChildren(children)
        for child in children { (child as? PressElement)?.setAccessibilityParent(sheet) }
        ax = [sheet]
    }
    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
        let point = convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil)
        if let hit = hits.last(where: { $0.0.contains(point) }) { hit.1() }
    }
    func clearSearch() { state.query = ""; search.stringValue = ""; refresh() }
    func select(_ ticker: String) { state.selected = ticker; state.showingEmptyListSearch = false; refresh() }
    func newList() {
        dialog = "new"; nameField.stringValue = ""; nameField.isHidden = false
        refresh(); layoutSubtreeIfNeeded(); window?.makeFirstResponder(nameField)
    }
    func closeDialog() {
        dialog = nil; nameField.isHidden = true; window?.makeFirstResponder(self); refresh()
    }
    func saveList() {
        let name = nameField.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !name.isEmpty else { return }
        if !state.lists.contains(name) { state.lists.append(name) }
        state.activeList = name; state.showingEmptyListSearch = true; clearSearch(); closeDialog()
        window?.makeFirstResponder(search)
    }
    func removeList() {
        if let list = selectedList {
            state.lists.removeAll { $0 == list }
            if state.activeList == list { state.activeList = nil }
        }
        selectedList = nil; dialog = "manage"; refresh()
    }
    func showOptions() {
        let menu = NSMenu()
        let item = NSMenuItem(title: "New Watchlist", action: #selector(menuNew), keyEquivalent: "")
        item.target = self; item.setAccessibilityIdentifier("stocksui.watchlist.create")
        menu.addItem(item)
        let manage = NSMenuItem(title: "Manage Watchlists", action: #selector(menuManage), keyEquivalent: "")
        manage.target = self; menu.addItem(manage)
        menu.popUp(positioning: nil, at: NSPoint(x: 274, y: 47), in: self)
    }
    @objc func menuNew() { newList() }
    @objc func menuManage() {
        dialog = "manage"; selectedList = nil; nameField.isHidden = true
        window?.makeFirstResponder(self); refresh()
    }
}

final class AppDelegate: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {
    var window: NSWindow!
    var view: StocksView!
    func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ notification: Notification) {
        let state = State()
        view = StocksView(state: state)
        window = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1080, height: 670),
                          styleMask: [.titled, .closable, .miniaturizable, .resizable, .fullSizeContentView],
                          backing: .buffered, defer: false)
        window.titleVisibility = .hidden
        window.titlebarAppearsTransparent = true
        window.contentView = view
        window.minSize = NSSize(width: 1080, height: 670)
        let top = NSScreen.main?.frame.maxY ?? 800
        window.setFrame(NSRect(x: 100, y: top - 56 - 670, width: 1080, height: 670), display: true)
        let main = NSMenu()
        let appMenu = NSMenu(); let appItem = NSMenuItem(); appItem.submenu = appMenu; main.addItem(appItem)
        appMenu.addItem(withTitle: "About Copy APP Stocks", action: #selector(NSApplication.orderFrontStandardAboutPanel(_:)), keyEquivalent: "")
        appMenu.addItem(.separator())
        appMenu.addItem(withTitle: "Quit Copy APP Stocks", action: #selector(NSApplication.terminate(_:)), keyEquivalent: "q")
        let file = NSMenu(title: "File"); let fileItem = NSMenuItem(title: "File", action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
        fileItem.submenu = file; main.addItem(fileItem)
        let new = NSMenuItem(title: "New Watchlist", action: #selector(StocksView.menuNew), keyEquivalent: "n")
        new.target = view; new.setAccessibilityIdentifier("new_watchlist"); file.addItem(new)
        let manage = NSMenuItem(title: "Manage Watchlists", action: #selector(StocksView.menuManage), keyEquivalent: "")
        manage.target = view; manage.setAccessibilityIdentifier("manage_watchlists"); file.addItem(manage)
        let edit = NSMenu(title: "Edit"); let editItem = NSMenuItem(title: "Edit", action: nil, keyEquivalent: "")
        editItem.submenu = edit; main.addItem(editItem)
        for (title, selector, key) in [("Cut", #selector(NSText.cut(_:)), "x"), ("Copy", #selector(NSText.copy(_:)), "c"), ("Paste", #selector(NSText.paste(_:)), "v"), ("Select All", #selector(NSText.selectAll(_:)), "a")] {
            edit.addItem(withTitle: title, action: selector, keyEquivalent: key)
        }
        NSApp.mainMenu = main
        NSApp.applicationIconImage = NSImage(size: NSSize(width: 256, height: 256), flipped: true) { rect in
            NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.12, alpha: 1).setFill()
            NSBezierPath(roundedRect: rect.insetBy(dx: 8, dy: 8), xRadius: 52, yRadius: 52).fill()
            let path = NSBezierPath()
            for (i, point) in [NSPoint(x: 34, y: 185), NSPoint(x: 71, y: 126), NSPoint(x: 104, y: 148), NSPoint(x: 150, y: 71), NSPoint(x: 178, y: 93), NSPoint(x: 222, y: 40)].enumerated() {
                if i == 0 { path.move(to: point) } else { path.line(to: point) }
            }
            NSColor.systemGreen.setStroke(); path.lineWidth = 10; path.stroke()
            return true
        }
        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
        NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
        view.refresh()
    }
    func applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed(_ sender: NSApplication) -> Bool { true }
}

@main
struct Main {
    static func main() {
        let app = NSApplication.shared
        let delegate = AppDelegate()
        app.setActivationPolicy(.regular); app.delegate = delegate
        withExtendedLifetime(delegate) { app.run() }
    }
}

`examples/macos/Stocks/build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the independent offline demo; this is not an accepted Copy APP delivery."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
    output = parser.parse_args().out.resolve()
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if output == source or source in output.parents:
        raise ValueError("build outside the source directory")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    snapshot = output / "source"
    shutil.copytree(source, snapshot, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
    inputs = {str(p.relative_to(snapshot)): sha(p) for p in sorted(snapshot.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
    app = output / "CopyAppStocks.app"
    binary = app / "Contents/MacOS/CopyAppStocks"
    binary.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(snapshot / "Info.plist", app / "Contents/Info.plist")
    logs = []
    record = {"scope": "independent_offline_demo_build_only", "inputs": inputs, "launched": False}
    try:
        sdk_result = subprocess.run(["xcrun", "--sdk", "macosx", "--show-sdk-path"],
                                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                    check=True, timeout=30)
        sdk = str(Path(sdk_result.stdout.strip()).resolve(strict=True))
        record["sdkroot"] = sdk
        build_env = dict(os.environ, SDKROOT=sdk)
        commands = [
            ["xcrun", "swiftc", "-parse-as-library", "-swift-version", "5", "-target", "arm64-apple-macos14.0",
             "-sdk", sdk, str(snapshot / "Sources/Main.swift"), "-o", str(binary)],
            ["/usr/bin/codesign", "--sign", "-", "--identifier", "dev.copyapp.examples.Stocks", str(app)],
            ["/usr/bin/codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(app)],
        ]
        for argv in commands:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                    env=build_env, timeout=180)
            logs.append({"argv": argv, "returncode": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr})
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError("demo build failed; inspect build-log.json")
        if any(sha(source / name) != value or sha(snapshot / name) != value for name, value in inputs.items()):
            raise ValueError("demo source changed during build")
        record.update(status="built", executable_sha256=sha(binary))
    except BaseException as exc:
        record.update(status="failed", error=type(exc).__name__, message=str(exc))
        raise
    finally:
        (output / "build-log.json").write_text(json.dumps(logs, indent=2) + "\n")
        (output / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(app)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

        true
    }

    func application(
        _ application: UIApplication,
        configurationForConnecting connectingSceneSession: UISceneSession,
        options: UIScene.ConnectionOptions

```swift
import UIKit

final class CalculatorViewController: UIViewController {
    override var preferredStatusBarStyle: UIStatusBarStyle { .lightContent }

    private struct Key {
        let title: String
        let label: String
        let row: Int
        let column: Int
        let span: Int
        let kind: Kind
    }

    private enum Kind { case function, number, operation }

    private let display = UILabel()
    private var buttons: [(Key, UIButton)] = []
    private var clearButton: UIButton?
    private var displayText = "0" { didSet { updateDisplay() } }
    private var storedValue: Double?
    private var pendingOperator: String?
    private var repeatedOperator: String?
    private var repeatedOperand: Double?
    private var startsNewNumber = true
    private var justEvaluated = false
    private var allClearActive = true

    private let keys: [Key] = [
        Key(title: "AC", label: "all clear", row: 0, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "+/−", label: "plus, minus", row: 0, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "%", label: "percent", row: 0, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "÷", label: "divide", row: 0, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "7", label: "7", row: 1, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "8", label: "8", row: 1, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "9", label: "9", row: 1, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "×", label: "multiply", row: 1, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "4", label: "4", row: 2, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "5", label: "5", row: 2, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "6", label: "6", row: 2, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "−", label: "subtract", row: 2, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "1", label: "1", row: 3, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "2", label: "2", row: 3, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "3", label: "3", row: 3, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "+", label: "add", row: 3, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "0", label: "0", row: 4, column: 0, span: 2, kind: .number),
        Key(title: ".", label: "decimal", row: 4, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "=", label: "equals", row: 4, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation)
    ]

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .black
        display.textColor = .white
        display.textAlignment = .right
        // The XR reference's internal grouped numeral face draws larger at
        // 93 pt than the public thin face. Match its visible glyph geometry.
        display.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 112, weight: .thin)
        display.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
        display.minimumScaleFactor = 0.35
        display.isAccessibilityElement = true
        view.addSubview(display)
        for key in keys {
            let button = UIButton(type: .custom)
            button.setTitle(key.title, for: .normal)
            button.titleLabel?.font = font(for: key)
            button.contentHorizontalAlignment = key.span == 2 ? .left : .center
            if key.span == 2 { button.contentEdgeInsets.left = 31 }
            button.backgroundColor = switchColor(for: key.kind)
            button.setTitleColor(key.kind == .function ? .black : .white, for: .normal)
            button.accessibilityLabel = key.label
            button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(keyPressed(_:)), for: .touchUpInside)
            button.tag = buttons.count
            view.addSubview(button)
            buttons.append((key, button))
            if key.label == "all clear" { clearButton = button }
        }
        updateDisplay()
    }

    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {
        super.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
        let width = view.bounds.width
        let diameter = (width - 74) / 4
        let gap: CGFloat = 14
        let left: CGFloat = 16
        let keyboardTop = view.bounds.height - view.safeAreaInsets.bottom - 40 - 5 * diameter - 4 * gap
        display.frame = CGRect(x: 20, y: keyboardTop - 120.5,
                               width: width - 54, height: 111)
        for (key, button) in buttons {
            let x = left + CGFloat(key.column) * (diameter + gap)
            let y = keyboardTop + CGFloat(key.row) * (diameter + gap)
            let buttonWidth = CGFloat(key.span) * diameter + CGFloat(key.span - 1) * gap
            button.frame = CGRect(x: x, y: y, width: buttonWidth, height: diameter)
            button.layer.cornerRadius = diameter / 2
        }
    }

    private func switchColor(for kind: Kind) -> UIColor {
        switch kind {
        case .number: return UIColor(red: 0.20, green: 0.20, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
        case .function: return UIColor(red: 0.65, green: 0.65, blue: 0.65, alpha: 1)
        case .operation: return UIColor(red: 1, green: 0.62, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
        }
    }

    private func font(for key: Key) -> UIFont {
        switch key.label {
        case "plus, minus", "percent":
            return .systemFont(ofSize: 34, weight: .medium)
        case "decimal":
            return .systemFont(ofSize: 40, weight: .semibold)
        default:
            switch key.kind {
            case .function: return .systemFont(ofSize: 34, weight: .medium)
            case .number: return .systemFont(ofSize: 40, weight: .regular)
            case .operation: return .systemFont(ofSize: 46, weight: .medium)
            }
        }
    }

    private func updateDisplay() {
        display.text = displayText
        display.accessibilityLabel = displayText
        clearButton?.setTitle(allClearActive ? "AC" : "C", for: .normal)
        clearButton?.accessibilityLabel = allClearActive ? "all clear" : "clear"
    }

    @objc private func keyPressed(_ sender: UIButton) {
        let key = buttons[sender.tag].0
        let action = sender === clearButton ? (allClearActive ? "all clear" : "clear") : key.label
        switch action {
        case "all clear":
            storedValue = nil
            pendingOperator = nil
            repeatedOperator = nil
            repeatedOperand = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = true
            displayText = "0"
        case "clear":
            // C clears only the current entry. The original retains the
            // repeated operation, so C followed by = can reuse its operand.
            startsNewNumber = true
            allClearActive = true
            displayText = "0"
        case "plus, minus":
            if let value = Double(displayText) { displayText = format(-value) }
            allClearActive = false
        case "percent":
            if let value = Double(displayText) {
                let base = (pendingOperator == "add" || pendingOperator == "subtract")
                    ? (storedValue ?? 1) : 1
                displayText = format(base * value / 100)
            }
            allClearActive = false
        case "add", "subtract", "multiply", "divide":
            if let pending = pendingOperator, let lhs = storedValue,
               let rhs = Double(displayText), !startsNewNumber {
                storedValue = calculate(lhs, rhs, pending)
                displayText = format(storedValue ?? 0)
            } else {
                storedValue = Double(displayText)
            }
            pendingOperator = key.label
            repeatedOperator = nil
            repeatedOperand = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = false
        case "equals":
            if let pending = pendingOperator, let lhs = storedValue,
               let rhs = Double(displayText) {
                displayText = format(calculate(lhs, rhs, pending))
                repeatedOperator = pending
                repeatedOperand = rhs
            } else if justEvaluated, let operation = repeatedOperator,
                      let rhs = repeatedOperand, let lhs = Double(displayText) {
                displayText = format(calculate(lhs, rhs, operation))
            }
            storedValue = nil
            pendingOperator = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = true
            // A repeated equals after C keeps the AC key visible in the
            // observed Calculator flow; ordinary equals keeps the prior C state.
        default:
            if justEvaluated {
                repeatedOperator = nil
                repeatedOperand = nil
            }
            if key.label == "decimal" {
                if startsNewNumber { displayText = "0." }
                else if !displayText.contains(".") { displayText += "." }
            } else {
                if startsNewNumber || displayText == "0" { displayText = key.title }
                else { displayText += key.title }
            }
            startsNewNumber = false
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = false
        }
        updateDisplay()
    }

    private func calculate(_ lhs: Double, _ rhs: Double, _ operation: String) -> Double {
        switch operation {
        case "add": return lhs + rhs
        case "subtract": return lhs - rhs
        case "multiply": return lhs * rhs
        case "divide": return rhs == 0 ? .nan : lhs / rhs
        default: return rhs
        }
    }

    private func format(_ value: Double) -> String {
        guard value.isFinite else { return "Error" }
        if value.rounded() == value && abs(value) < 1e12 { return String(Int(value)) }
        return String(format: "%.8g", value)
    }
}

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorClone/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(
        _ scene: UIScene,
        willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
        options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions
    ) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = CalculatorViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorClone/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppCalculator.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppCalculator \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-calculator.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppCalculator.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculator.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculator.app/CopyAppCalculator"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppCalculator.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppCalculator.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppCalculator.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppCalculator.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorExternalAgent/Sources/CalculatorViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class CalculatorViewController: UIViewController {
    override var preferredStatusBarStyle: UIStatusBarStyle { .lightContent }

    private struct Key {
        let title: String
        let label: String
        let row: Int
        let column: Int
        let span: Int
        let kind: Kind
    }

    private enum Kind { case function, number, operation }

    private let display = UILabel()
    private var buttons: [(Key, UIButton)] = []
    private var clearButton: UIButton?
    private var displayText = "0" { didSet { updateDisplay() } }
    private var storedValue: Double?
    private var pendingOperator: String?
    private var repeatedOperator: String?
    private var repeatedOperand: Double?
    private var startsNewNumber = true
    private var justEvaluated = false
    private var allClearActive = true

    private let keys: [Key] = [
        Key(title: "AC", label: "all clear", row: 0, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "+/−", label: "plus, minus", row: 0, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "%", label: "percent", row: 0, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .function),
        Key(title: "÷", label: "divide", row: 0, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "7", label: "7", row: 1, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "8", label: "8", row: 1, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "9", label: "9", row: 1, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "×", label: "multiply", row: 1, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "4", label: "4", row: 2, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "5", label: "5", row: 2, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "6", label: "6", row: 2, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "−", label: "subtract", row: 2, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "1", label: "1", row: 3, column: 0, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "2", label: "2", row: 3, column: 1, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "3", label: "3", row: 3, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "+", label: "add", row: 3, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation),
        Key(title: "0", label: "0", row: 4, column: 0, span: 2, kind: .number),
        Key(title: ".", label: "decimal", row: 4, column: 2, span: 1, kind: .number),
        Key(title: "=", label: "equals", row: 4, column: 3, span: 1, kind: .operation)
    ]

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .black
        display.textColor = .white
        display.textAlignment = .right
        // The XR reference's internal grouped numeral face draws larger at
        // 93 pt than the public thin face. Match its visible glyph geometry.
        display.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 112, weight: .thin)
        display.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
        display.minimumScaleFactor = 0.35
        display.isAccessibilityElement = true
        display.accessibilityLabel = "Result"
        view.addSubview(display)
        for key in keys {
            let button = UIButton(type: .custom)
            button.setTitle(key.title, for: .normal)
            button.titleLabel?.font = font(for: key)
            button.contentHorizontalAlignment = key.span == 2 ? .left : .center
            if key.span == 2 { button.contentEdgeInsets.left = 31 }
            button.backgroundColor = switchColor(for: key.kind)
            button.setTitleColor(key.kind == .function ? .black : .white, for: .normal)
            button.accessibilityLabel = key.label
            button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(keyPressed(_:)), for: .touchUpInside)
            button.tag = buttons.count
            view.addSubview(button)
            buttons.append((key, button))
            if key.label == "all clear" { clearButton = button }
        }
        updateDisplay()
    }

    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {
        super.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
        let width = view.bounds.width
        let diameter = (width - 74) / 4
        let gap: CGFloat = 14
        let left: CGFloat = 16
        let keyboardTop = view.bounds.height - view.safeAreaInsets.bottom - 40 - 5 * diameter - 4 * gap
        display.frame = CGRect(x: 20, y: keyboardTop - 120.5,
                               width: width - 54, height: 111)
        for (key, button) in buttons {
            let x = left + CGFloat(key.column) * (diameter + gap)
            let y = keyboardTop + CGFloat(key.row) * (diameter + gap)
            let buttonWidth = CGFloat(key.span) * diameter + CGFloat(key.span - 1) * gap
            button.frame = CGRect(x: x, y: y, width: buttonWidth, height: diameter)
            button.layer.cornerRadius = diameter / 2
        }
    }

    private func switchColor(for kind: Kind) -> UIColor {
        switch kind {
        case .number: return UIColor(red: 0.20, green: 0.20, blue: 0.20, alpha: 1)
        case .function: return UIColor(red: 0.65, green: 0.65, blue: 0.65, alpha: 1)
        case .operation: return UIColor(red: 1, green: 0.62, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
        }
    }

    private func font(for key: Key) -> UIFont {
        switch key.label {
        case "plus, minus", "percent":
            return .systemFont(ofSize: 34, weight: .medium)
        case "decimal":
            return .systemFont(ofSize: 40, weight: .semibold)
        default:
            switch key.kind {
            case .function: return .systemFont(ofSize: 34, weight: .medium)
            case .number: return .systemFont(ofSize: 40, weight: .regular)
            case .operation: return .systemFont(ofSize: 46, weight: .medium)
            }
        }
    }

    private func updateDisplay() {
        display.text = displayText
        display.accessibilityValue = displayText
        clearButton?.setTitle(allClearActive ? "AC" : "C", for: .normal)
        clearButton?.accessibilityLabel = allClearActive ? "all clear" : "clear"
    }

    @objc private func keyPressed(_ sender: UIButton) {
        let key = buttons[sender.tag].0
        let action = sender === clearButton ? (allClearActive ? "all clear" : "clear") : key.label
        switch action {
        case "all clear":
            storedValue = nil
            pendingOperator = nil
            repeatedOperator = nil
            repeatedOperand = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = true
            displayText = "0"
        case "clear":
            // C clears only the current entry. The original retains the
            // repeated operation, so C followed by = can reuse its operand.
            startsNewNumber = true
            allClearActive = true
            displayText = "0"
        case "plus, minus":
            if let value = numericValue { displayText = format(-value) }
            allClearActive = false
        case "percent":
            if let value = numericValue {
                let base = (pendingOperator == "add" || pendingOperator == "subtract")
                    ? (storedValue ?? 1) : 1
                displayText = format(base * value / 100)
            }
            allClearActive = false
        case "add", "subtract", "multiply", "divide":
            if let pending = pendingOperator, let lhs = storedValue,
               let rhs = numericValue, !startsNewNumber {
                storedValue = calculate(lhs, rhs, pending)
                displayText = format(storedValue ?? 0)
            } else {
                storedValue = numericValue
            }
            pendingOperator = key.label
            repeatedOperator = nil
            repeatedOperand = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = false
        case "equals":
            if let pending = pendingOperator, let lhs = storedValue,
               let rhs = numericValue {
                displayText = format(calculate(lhs, rhs, pending))
                repeatedOperator = pending
                repeatedOperand = rhs
            } else if justEvaluated, let operation = repeatedOperator,
                      let rhs = repeatedOperand, let lhs = numericValue {
                displayText = format(calculate(lhs, rhs, operation))
            }
            storedValue = nil
            pendingOperator = nil
            startsNewNumber = true
            justEvaluated = true
            // A repeated equals after C keeps the AC key visible in the
            // observed Calculator flow; ordinary equals keeps the prior C state.
        default:
            if justEvaluated {
                repeatedOperator = nil
                repeatedOperand = nil
            }
            if key.label == "decimal" {
                if startsNewNumber { displayText = "0." }
                else if !displayText.contains(".") { displayText += "." }
            } else {
                if startsNewNumber || displayText == "0" { displayText = key.title }
                else { displayText += key.title }
            }
            startsNewNumber = false
            justEvaluated = false
            allClearActive = false
        }
        updateDisplay()
    }

    private func calculate(_ lhs: Double, _ rhs: Double, _ operation: String) -> Double {
        switch operation {
        case "add": return lhs + rhs
        case "subtract": return lhs - rhs
        case "multiply": return lhs * rhs
        case "divide": return rhs == 0 ? .nan : lhs / rhs
        default: return rhs
        }
    }

    private var numericValue: Double? {
        Double(displayText.replacingOccurrences(of: "−", with: "-"))
    }

    private func format(_ value: Double) -> String {
        guard value.isFinite else { return "Error" }
        if value.rounded() == value && abs(value) < 1e12 {
            return String(Int(value)).replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "−")
        }
        return String(format: "%.8g", value).replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "−")
    }
}

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorExternalAgent/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(
        _ scene: UIScene,
        willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
        options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions
    ) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = CalculatorViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorExternalAgent/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.xcodeproj \
  -scheme CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos \
  -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build \
  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-calculator-external.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.app/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppCalculatorExternalAgent.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorFreshProbe/Sources/AppDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

@main
final class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    func application(_ application: UIApplication,
                     configurationForConnecting session: UISceneSession,
                     options: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) -> UISceneConfiguration {
        let configuration = UISceneConfiguration(name: "Main", sessionRole: session.role)
        configuration.delegateClass = SceneDelegate.self
        return configuration
    }
}

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
               options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = CalculatorViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorFreshProbe/Sources/CalculatorViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

/// A small independent implementation of selected basic-mode flows.
final class CalculatorViewController: UIViewController {
    private struct Key {
        let title: String
        let accessibility: String
        let action: String
        let row: Int
        let column: Int
        let span: Int
    }

    private let keys: [Key] = [
        Key(title: "AC", accessibility: "all clear", action: "clear", row: 0, column: 0, span: 1),
        Key(title: "+/−", accessibility: "plus, minus", action: "sign", row: 0, column: 1, span: 1),
        Key(title: "%", accessibility: "percent", action: "percent", row: 0, column: 2, span: 1),
        Key(title: "÷", accessibility: "divide", action: "divide", row: 0, column: 3, span: 1),
        Key(title: "7", accessibility: "7", action: "7", row: 1, column: 0, span: 1),
        Key(title: "8", accessibility: "8", action: "8", row: 1, column: 1, span: 1),
        Key(title: "9", accessibility: "9", action: "9", row: 1, column: 2, span: 1),
        Key(title: "×", accessibility: "multiply", action: "multiply", row: 1, column: 3, span: 1),
        Key(title: "4", accessibility: "4", action: "4", row: 2, column: 0, span: 1),
        Key(title: "5", accessibility: "5", action: "5", row: 2, column: 1, span: 1),
        Key(title: "6", accessibility: "6", action: "6", row: 2, column: 2, span: 1),
        Key(title: "−", accessibility: "subtract", action: "subtract", row: 2, column: 3, span: 1),
        Key(title: "1", accessibility: "1", action: "1", row: 3, column: 0, span: 1),
        Key(title: "2", accessibility: "2", action: "2", row: 3, column: 1, span: 1),
        Key(title: "3", accessibility: "3", action: "3", row: 3, column: 2, span: 1),
        Key(title: "+", accessibility: "add", action: "add", row: 3, column: 3, span: 1),
        Key(title: "0", accessibility: "0", action: "0", row: 4, column: 0, span: 2),
        Key(title: ".", accessibility: "decimal", action: "decimal", row: 4, column: 2, span: 1),
        Key(title: "=", accessibility: "equals", action: "equals", row: 4, column: 3, span: 1)
    ]

    private let display = UILabel()
    private var buttons: [UIButton] = []
    private var input = "0"
    private var leftOperand: Decimal?
    private var pendingOperation: String?
    private var startNewOperand = false

    override var preferredStatusBarStyle: UIStatusBarStyle { .lightContent }
    override var supportedInterfaceOrientations: UIInterfaceOrientationMask { .portrait }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .dark
        view.backgroundColor = .black

        display.text = input
        display.textColor = .white
        display.textAlignment = .right
        display.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 92, weight: .thin)
        display.minimumScaleFactor = 0.45
        display.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
        display.isAccessibilityElement = true
        display.accessibilityLabel = "Result"
        display.isUserInteractionEnabled = true
        let deleteSwipe = UISwipeGestureRecognizer(target: self, action: #selector(deleteLastDigit))
        deleteSwipe.direction = .left
        display.addGestureRecognizer(deleteSwipe)
        view.addSubview(display)

        for (index, key) in keys.enumerated() {
            let button = UIButton(type: .system)
            button.tag = index
            button.setTitle(key.title, for: .normal)
            button.accessibilityLabel = key.accessibility
            button.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: key.action == "sign" ? 30 : (key.row == 0 ? 36 : 39),
                                                   weight: .regular)
            if key.action == "0" {
                button.contentHorizontalAlignment = .left
                button.titleEdgeInsets = UIEdgeInsets(top: 0, left: 31, bottom: 0, right: 0)
            }
            button.titleLabel?.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
            button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(press(_:)), for: .touchUpInside)
            view.addSubview(button)
            buttons.append(button)
        }
        updateButtons()
    }

    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {
        super.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
        let width = view.bounds.width
        let height = view.bounds.height
        let margin: CGFloat = 16
        let gap: CGFloat = 14
        let diameter = (width - 2 * margin - 3 * gap) / 4
        let rowTop = height - (5 * diameter + 4 * gap + 74)
        display.frame = CGRect(x: margin, y: rowTop - 116,
                               width: width - 2 * margin, height: 116)
        for (index, key) in keys.enumerated() {
            let x = margin + CGFloat(key.column) * (diameter + gap)
            let y = rowTop + CGFloat(key.row) * (diameter + gap)
            let keyWidth = diameter * CGFloat(key.span) + gap * CGFloat(key.span - 1)
            buttons[index].frame = CGRect(x: x, y: y, width: keyWidth, height: diameter)
            buttons[index].layer.cornerRadius = diameter / 2
        }
    }

    private func updateButtons() {
        for (index, key) in keys.enumerated() {
            let button = buttons[index]
            if key.row == 0 && key.column < 3 {
                button.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.64, alpha: 1)
                button.setTitleColor(.black, for: .normal)
            } else if key.column == 3 {
                button.backgroundColor = UIColor(red: 1, green: 0.62, blue: 0.04, alpha: 1)
                button.setTitleColor(.white, for: .normal)
            } else {
                button.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.20, alpha: 1)
                button.setTitleColor(.white, for: .normal)
            }
        }
        let clear = buttons[0]
        let allClear = input == "0" && leftOperand == nil && pendingOperation == nil
        clear.setTitle(allClear ? "AC" : "C", for: .normal)
        clear.accessibilityLabel = allClear ? "all clear" : "clear"
        display.text = input
        display.accessibilityValue = input
    }

    private func numericValue() -> Decimal {
        Decimal(string: input.replacingOccurrences(of: "−", with: "-")) ?? 0
    }

    private func show(_ value: Decimal) {
        let text = NSDecimalNumber(decimal: value).stringValue
        input = text == "-0" ? "0" : text.replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "−")
        updateButtons()
    }

    @objc private func deleteLastDigit() {
        guard input != "0" else { return }
        input = String(input.dropLast())
        if input.isEmpty || input == "−" {
            input = "0"
        }
        startNewOperand = false
        updateButtons()
    }

    @objc private func press(_ sender: UIButton) {
        let action = keys[sender.tag].action
        if action.count == 1, let digit = action.first, digit.isNumber {
            if startNewOperand || input == "0" {
                input = action
                startNewOperand = false
            } else {
                input += action
            }
            updateButtons()
            return
        }
        switch action {
        case "clear":
            input = "0"
            leftOperand = nil
            pendingOperation = nil
            startNewOperand = false
            updateButtons()
        case "decimal":
            if startNewOperand {
                input = "0."
                startNewOperand = false
            } else if !input.contains(".") {
                input += "."
            }
            updateButtons()
        case "sign":
            if input != "0" {
                input = input.hasPrefix("−") ? String(input.dropFirst()) : "−" + input
            }
            updateButtons()
        case "percent":
            show(numericValue() / Decimal(100))
        case "add", "subtract", "multiply", "divide":
            leftOperand = numericValue()
            pendingOperation = action
            startNewOperand = true
            updateButtons()
        case "equals":
            guard let left = leftOperand, let operation = pendingOperation else { return }
            let right = numericValue()
            switch operation {
            case "add": show(left + right)
            case "subtract": show(left - right)
            case "multiply": show(left * right)
            case "divide": show(right == 0 ? 0 : left / right)
            default: break
            }
            leftOperand = nil
            pendingOperation = nil
            startNewOperand = true
            updateButtons()
        default:
            break
        }
    }
}

```

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorFreshProbe/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppCalculatorFresh.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppCalculatorFresh \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-calculator.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.app/CopyAppCalculatorFresh"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppCalculatorFresh.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppCalculatorFresh.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/README.md`:

```md
# iOS 17 Calculator selected-flow rebuild

This is a newly authored UIKit project for the iPhone 14 / iOS 17.3.1 Calculator analysis. It uses Bundle ID `dev.copyapp.calculator.ios17fresh` and targets iOS 17.0 or later. The original report covers fresh-launch `7 + 8 = 15`; three additional flows were observed on that phone and added to the tracked [selected-flow specification](feature-spec.json). They cover decimal addition (`0.3`), negative addition (`−7`) and percentage (`0.5`). This does not establish the original Calculator's full arithmetic state machine.

Generate the Xcode project with `xcodegen generate --spec project.yml`, then build the `CopyAppCalculatorIOS17Fresh` scheme for a generic iOS device. Sign the App with your own Apple Development identity and a provisioning profile covering the Bundle ID. Installation, all four exact final results and five screenshot pairs were checked on the named iPhone 14; the signed IPA and device evidence stay in ignored local `cases/`.

From the repository root, after installing the signed App on the exact iPhone, run:

```sh
.venv/bin/copyapp rebuild-check --udid <IPHONE_14_UDID> \
  --feature-spec examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/feature-spec.json --backend ios-mcp \
  --pair calculator-basic-addition examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/basic-addition.original.json examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/basic-addition.rebuilt.json \
  --pair decimal-addition examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/decimal-addition.original.json examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/decimal-addition.rebuilt.json \
  --pair negative-addition examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/negative-addition.original.json examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/negative-addition.rebuilt.json \
  --pair percent-of-fifty examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/percent-of-fifty.original.json examples/rebuild/CalculatorIOS17Fresh/playbooks/percent-of-fifty.rebuilt.json \
  --out cases/calculator-ios17fresh-recheck
```

The source does not reuse the earlier `CalculatorFreshProbe` implementation. The [current status](../../../docs/current-status.md) records the latest named-device result and the separate iCTRL limitation. Raw report and replay cases remain local under ignored `cases/`.

```

```swift
import UIKit

@main
final class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func application(
        _ application: UIApplication,
        didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?
    ) -> Bool {
        let window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
        window.rootViewController = CalculatorViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
        return true
    }
}
