```swift
import UIKit

private let panel = UIColor(red: 0.16, green: 0.16, blue: 0.17, alpha: 1)

private func systemButton(_ name: String, selector: Selector, target: AnyObject) -> UIBarButtonItem {
    let item: UIBarButtonItem
    if name == "Add" {
        item = UIBarButtonItem(image: UIImage(systemName: "plus"), style: .plain,
                               target: target, action: selector)
    } else {
        item = UIBarButtonItem(title: name, style: .plain, target: target, action: selector)
    }
    item.tintColor = .systemOrange
    item.accessibilityLabel = name
    return item
}

final class WorldClockController: UITableViewController {
    init() { super.init(style: .plain) }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "World Clock"
        tableView.backgroundColor = .black
        tableView.separatorColor = .darkGray
        navigationItem.leftBarButtonItem = systemButton("Edit", selector: #selector(noop), target: self)
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = systemButton("Add", selector: #selector(addCity), target: self)
    }

    @objc private func noop() {}
    @objc private func addCity() {
        let chooser = CityChooserController()
        let navigation = UINavigationController(rootViewController: chooser)
        navigation.setNavigationBarHidden(true, animated: false)
        navigation.modalPresentationStyle = .pageSheet
        present(navigation, animated: true)
    }

    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int { 1 }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, heightForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> CGFloat { 96 }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .default, reuseIdentifier: nil)
        cell.backgroundColor = .black
        let subtitle = UILabel(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 17, width: 210, height: 18))
        let now = Date()
        var beijingCalendar = Calendar(identifier: .gregorian)
        beijingCalendar.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "Asia/Shanghai")!
        let localDay = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: now)
        let beijingParts = beijingCalendar.dateComponents([.year, .month, .day], from: now)
        let beijingDay = Calendar.current.date(from: beijingParts) ?? localDay
        let dayDelta = Calendar.current.dateComponents([.day], from: localDay,
                                                       to: beijingDay).day ?? 0
        let relativeDay = dayDelta > 0 ? "Tomorrow" : dayDelta < 0 ? "Yesterday" : "Today"
        let offsetHours = (beijingCalendar.timeZone.secondsFromGMT(for: now) -
                           TimeZone.current.secondsFromGMT(for: now)) / 3600
        subtitle.text = "\(relativeDay), \(offsetHours >= 0 ? "+" : "")\(offsetHours)HRS"
        subtitle.textColor = .secondaryLabel
        subtitle.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14)
        let city = UILabel(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 42, width: 210, height: 32))
        city.text = "Beijing"
        city.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 23)
        let time = UILabel(frame: CGRect(x: 255, y: 16, width: 140, height: 60))
        let format = DateFormatter()
        format.dateFormat = "HH:mm"
        format.timeZone = TimeZone(identifier: "Asia/Shanghai")
        time.text = format.string(from: Date())
        time.textAlignment = .right
        time.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 54, weight: .ultraLight)
        [subtitle, city, time].forEach { cell.contentView.addSubview($0) }
        cell.accessibilityLabel = "Beijing, Tomorrow, +15HRS"
        return cell
    }
}

final class CityChooserController: UITableViewController, UISearchBarDelegate {
    private let cities = ["Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire", "Abu Dhabi, U.A.E.", "Acapulco, Mexico",
                          "Accra, Ghana", "Acton, U.S.A.", "Adak, U.S.A.",
                          "Adamstown, Pitcairn Islands", "Addis Ababa, Ethiopia",
                          "Adelaide, Australia", "Aden, Yemen", "Aguascalientes, Mexico",
                          "Aktau, Kazakhstan", "Albuquerque, U.S.A.", "Alexandria, Egypt",
                          "Algiers, Algeria", "Alofi, Niue"]
    private var filtered: [String] = []
    init() { super.init(style: .plain); filtered = cities }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        tableView.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.11, alpha: 1)
        tableView.separatorColor = .darkGray
        let width = view.window?.windowScene?.screen.bounds.width ?? tableView.bounds.width
        let header = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: 110))
        header.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.11, alpha: 1)
        let heading = UILabel(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 12, width: width - 40, height: 25))
        heading.text = "Choose a City"
        heading.textAlignment = .center
        heading.textColor = .white
        heading.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14)
        header.addSubview(heading)
        let search = UISearchBar(frame: CGRect(x: 12, y: 48, width: width - 105, height: 44))
        search.placeholder = "Search"
        search.searchBarStyle = .minimal
        search.delegate = self
        header.addSubview(search)
        let cancel = UIButton(type: .system)
        cancel.frame = CGRect(x: width - 85, y: 48, width: 75, height: 44)
        cancel.setTitle("Cancel", for: .normal)
        cancel.tintColor = .systemOrange
        cancel.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 17)
        cancel.addTarget(self, action: #selector(self.cancel), for: .touchUpInside)
        header.addSubview(cancel)
        tableView.tableHeaderView = header
    }

    @objc private func cancel() { dismiss(animated: true) }
    func searchBar(_ searchBar: UISearchBar, textDidChange searchText: String) {
        filtered = searchText.isEmpty ? cities : cities.filter { $0.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(searchText) }
        tableView.reloadData()
    }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int { filtered.count }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, titleForHeaderInSection section: Int) -> String? {
        filtered.isEmpty ? nil : "A"
    }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .default, reuseIdentifier: nil)
        cell.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.11, alpha: 1)
        cell.textLabel?.text = filtered[indexPath.row]
        cell.textLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 17)
        return cell
    }
}

final class AlarmController: UITableViewController {
    init() { super.init(style: .plain) }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Alarm"
        tableView.backgroundColor = .black
        tableView.separatorColor = .darkGray
        tableView.separatorInset = UIEdgeInsets(top: 0, left: 20, bottom: 0, right: 0)
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = systemButton("Add", selector: #selector(addAlarm), target: self)
    }

    @objc private func addAlarm() {
        let navigation = UINavigationController(rootViewController: AlarmEditorController())
        navigation.modalPresentationStyle = .pageSheet
        present(navigation, animated: true)
    }

    override func numberOfSections(in tableView: UITableView) -> Int { 2 }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int { 1 }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, heightForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> CGFloat {
        indexPath.section == 0 ? 50 : 62
    }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .value1, reuseIdentifier: nil)
        cell.backgroundColor = .black
        cell.selectionStyle = .none
        if indexPath.section == 0 {
            cell.imageView?.image = UIImage(systemName: "bed.double.fill")
            cell.imageView?.tintColor = .white
            cell.imageView?.transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: 20, y: 3)
            cell.textLabel?.text = "Sleep | Wake Up"
            cell.textLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .medium)
            cell.textLabel?.transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: -14, y: 3)
        } else {
            cell.textLabel?.text = "No Alarm"
            cell.textLabel?.textColor = .secondaryLabel
            cell.textLabel?.transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: 20, y: 0)
            let setup = UIButton(type: .system)
            setup.setTitle("SET UP", for: .normal)
            setup.setTitleColor(.systemOrange, for: .normal)
            setup.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14, weight: .semibold)
            setup.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.18, alpha: 1)
            setup.layer.cornerRadius = 16
            setup.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 74, height: 32)
            setup.transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: 20, y: 0)
            cell.accessoryView = setup
        }
        return cell
    }
}

final class AlarmEditorController: UITableViewController {
    private let rows = ["Repeat", "Label", "Sound", "Snooze"]
    init() { super.init(style: .insetGrouped) }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Add Alarm"
        navigationItem.largeTitleDisplayMode = .never
        tableView.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.11, alpha: 1)
        navigationItem.leftBarButtonItem = systemButton("Cancel", selector: #selector(cancel), target: self)
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = systemButton("Save", selector: #selector(cancel), target: self)
        let picker = UIDatePicker(frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 414, height: 210))
        picker.datePickerMode = .time
        picker.preferredDatePickerStyle = .wheels
        picker.backgroundColor = .black
        tableView.tableHeaderView = picker
    }

    @objc private func cancel() { dismiss(animated: true) }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int { rows.count }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .value1, reuseIdentifier: nil)
        cell.backgroundColor = panel
        cell.textLabel?.text = rows[indexPath.row]
        switch indexPath.row {
        case 0: cell.detailTextLabel?.text = "Never"
        case 1: cell.detailTextLabel?.text = "Alarm"
        case 2: cell.detailTextLabel?.text = "Radar"
        default:
            let toggle = UISwitch()
            toggle.isOn = true
            toggle.accessibilityLabel = "Snooze"
            cell.accessoryView = toggle
        }
        if indexPath.row == 0 || indexPath.row == 2 { cell.accessoryType = .disclosureIndicator }
        return cell
    }
}

final class StopwatchController: UIViewController {
    private let timeLabel = UILabel()
    private let leftButton = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let rightButton = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let lapLabel = UILabel()
    private let lapTimeLabel = UILabel()
    private let lapDivider = UIView()
    private let completedLapsStack = UIStackView()
    private var ticker: Timer?
    private var startedAt: Date?
    private var elapsed: TimeInterval = 0
    private var lapStartedAt: TimeInterval = 0
    private var laps: [TimeInterval] = []

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .black
        timeLabel.text = "00:00.00"
        timeLabel.font = .monospacedDigitSystemFont(ofSize: 88, weight: .ultraLight)
        timeLabel.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
        timeLabel.minimumScaleFactor = 0.8
        timeLabel.textAlignment = .center
        [leftButton, rightButton].forEach { button in
            button.layer.cornerRadius = 42
            button.layer.borderWidth = 0
            button.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16)
        }
        leftButton.setTitle("Lap", for: .normal)
        leftButton.setTitleColor(.lightGray, for: .normal)
        leftButton.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.13, alpha: 1)
        leftButton.layer.borderColor = UIColor(white: 0.25, alpha: 1).cgColor
        leftButton.addTarget(self, action: #selector(lapOrReset), for: .touchUpInside)
        rightButton.addTarget(self, action: #selector(startOrStop), for: .touchUpInside)
        for label in [lapLabel, lapTimeLabel] {
            label.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16)
            label.textColor = .white
        }
        lapTimeLabel.textAlignment = .right
        lapDivider.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.18, alpha: 1)
        completedLapsStack.axis = .vertical
        completedLapsStack.spacing = 0
        let bottomDivider = UIView()
        bottomDivider.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.18, alpha: 1)
        let dots = UILabel()
        dots.text = "● ●"
        dots.textColor = .lightGray
        dots.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12)
        dots.textAlignment = .center
        [timeLabel, leftButton, rightButton, lapLabel, lapTimeLabel,
         lapDivider, completedLapsStack, bottomDivider, dots].forEach {
            $0.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            view.addSubview($0)
        }
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            timeLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 24),
            timeLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -24),
            timeLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 150),
            timeLabel.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 112),
            leftButton.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            leftButton.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 366),
            leftButton.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            leftButton.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            rightButton.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            rightButton.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: leftButton.topAnchor),
            rightButton.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            rightButton.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            dots.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            dots.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: leftButton.centerYAnchor),
            bottomDivider.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            bottomDivider.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            bottomDivider.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: leftButton.bottomAnchor, constant: 16),
            bottomDivider.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 1),
            lapLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.leadingAnchor),
            lapLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.bottomAnchor, constant: 12),
            lapTimeLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.trailingAnchor),
            lapTimeLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: lapLabel.topAnchor),
            lapDivider.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.leadingAnchor),
            lapDivider.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.trailingAnchor),
            lapDivider.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: lapLabel.bottomAnchor, constant: 12),
            lapDivider.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 1),
            completedLapsStack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.leadingAnchor),
            completedLapsStack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bottomDivider.trailingAnchor),
            completedLapsStack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: lapDivider.bottomAnchor),
        ])
        refresh()
    }

    override func viewWillAppear(_ animated: Bool) {
        super.viewWillAppear(animated)
        navigationController?.setNavigationBarHidden(true, animated: false)
    }

    deinit { ticker?.invalidate() }

    private var total: TimeInterval {
        elapsed + (startedAt.map { Date().timeIntervalSince($0) } ?? 0)
    }

    private func formatted(_ duration: TimeInterval) -> String {
        let hundredths = max(0, Int(duration * 100))
        return String(format: "%02d:%02d.%02d", hundredths / 6000,
                      (hundredths / 100) % 60, hundredths % 100)
    }

    private func refresh() {
        let running = startedAt != nil
        timeLabel.text = formatted(total)
        rightButton.setTitle(running ? "Stop" : "Start", for: .normal)
        rightButton.setTitleColor(running ? .systemRed : .systemGreen, for: .normal)
        rightButton.backgroundColor = (running ? UIColor.systemRed : UIColor.systemGreen)
            .withAlphaComponent(0.2)
        rightButton.layer.borderColor = (running ? UIColor.systemRed : UIColor.systemGreen)
            .withAlphaComponent(0.35).cgColor
        leftButton.setTitle(running ? "Lap" : elapsed > 0 ? "Reset" : "Lap", for: .normal)
        leftButton.setTitleColor(elapsed > 0 || running ? .white : .lightGray, for: .normal)
        let showLap = elapsed > 0 || running
        lapLabel.isHidden = !showLap
        lapTimeLabel.isHidden = !showLap
        lapDivider.isHidden = !showLap
        lapLabel.text = "Lap \(laps.count + 1)"
        lapTimeLabel.text = showLap ? formatted(total - lapStartedAt) : nil
    }

    private func renderCompletedLaps() {
        completedLapsStack.arrangedSubviews.forEach { row in
            completedLapsStack.removeArrangedSubview(row)
            row.removeFromSuperview()
        }
        let shortest = laps.min()
        let longest = laps.max()
        for index in laps.indices.reversed() {
            let duration = laps[index]
            let row = UIView()
            let name = UILabel()
            let value = UILabel()
            let divider = UIView()
            name.text = "Lap \(index + 1)"
            value.text = formatted(duration)
            value.textAlignment = .right
            let color: UIColor
            if laps.count > 1, shortest != longest, duration == shortest {
                color = .systemGreen
            } else if laps.count > 1, shortest != longest, duration == longest {
                color = .systemRed
            } else {
                color = .white
            }
            for label in [name, value] {
                label.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16)
                label.textColor = color
                label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
                row.addSubview(label)
            }
            divider.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.18, alpha: 1)
            divider.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            row.addSubview(divider)
            NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
                row.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 44),
                name.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.leadingAnchor),
                name.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.centerYAnchor),
                value.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.trailingAnchor),
                value.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.centerYAnchor),
                divider.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.leadingAnchor),
                divider.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.trailingAnchor),
                divider.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: row.bottomAnchor),
                divider.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 1),
            ])
            completedLapsStack.addArrangedSubview(row)
        }
    }

    @objc private func startOrStop() {
        if let start = startedAt {
            elapsed += Date().timeIntervalSince(start)
            startedAt = nil
            ticker?.invalidate()
            ticker = nil
        } else {
            startedAt = Date()
            ticker = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.05, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
                self?.refresh()
            }
        }
        refresh()
    }

    @objc private func lapOrReset() {
        if startedAt != nil {
            let currentTotal = total
            laps.append(currentTotal - lapStartedAt)
            lapStartedAt = currentTotal
        } else if elapsed > 0 {
            elapsed = 0
            lapStartedAt = 0
            laps.removeAll()
        }
        renderCompletedLaps()
        refresh()
    }
}

final class TimerController: UIViewController, UIPickerViewDataSource, UIPickerViewDelegate {
    private let picker = UIPickerView()
    private let cancel = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let start = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let sound = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let ring = UIView()
    private let ringStroke = CAShapeLayer()
    private let remainingLabel = UILabel()
    private let endTimeLabel = UILabel()
    private var fieldLabels: [UILabel] = []
    private var ticker: Timer?
    private var endsAt: Date?
    private var pausedRemaining: TimeInterval?
    private var totalDuration: TimeInterval = 0

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .black
        navigationItem.largeTitleDisplayMode = .never
        picker.dataSource = self
        picker.delegate = self
        picker.accessibilityLabel = "Hours, Minutes, Seconds"
        picker.selectRow(15, inComponent: 1, animated: false)
        picker.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(picker)

        let fields = ["Hours", "Minutes", "Seconds"]
        for (index, text) in fields.enumerated() {
            let label = UILabel()
            label.text = text
            label.textColor = .secondaryLabel
            label.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 15)
            label.frame = CGRect(x: 62 + index * 110, y: 275, width: 100, height: 25)
            view.addSubview(label)
            fieldLabels.append(label)
        }

        cancel.setTitle("Cancel", for: .normal)
        cancel.isEnabled = false
        cancel.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.11, alpha: 1)
        cancel.layer.cornerRadius = 42
        cancel.layer.borderWidth = 2
        cancel.layer.borderColor = UIColor.darkGray.cgColor
        start.setTitle("Start", for: .normal)
        start.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemGreen.withAlphaComponent(0.25)
        start.layer.cornerRadius = 42
        start.layer.borderWidth = 2
        start.layer.borderColor = UIColor.systemGreen.withAlphaComponent(0.4).cgColor
        start.setTitleColor(.systemGreen, for: .normal)
        cancel.addTarget(self, action: #selector(cancelCountdown), for: .touchUpInside)
        start.addTarget(self, action: #selector(startPauseResume), for: .touchUpInside)
        sound.accessibilityLabel = "When Timer Ends"
        sound.backgroundColor = panel
        sound.layer.cornerRadius = 9
        let soundText = UILabel()
        soundText.text = "When Timer Ends"
        soundText.isAccessibilityElement = false
        soundText.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        sound.addSubview(soundText)
        let soundDetail = UILabel()
        soundDetail.text = "Radar  ›"
        soundDetail.textColor = .secondaryLabel
        soundDetail.isAccessibilityElement = false
        soundDetail.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        sound.addSubview(soundDetail)
        sound.addTarget(self, action: #selector(showSoundPicker), for: .touchUpInside)
        ring.isHidden = true
        ring.isUserInteractionEnabled = false
        ring.layer.addSublayer(ringStroke)
        ringStroke.fillColor = UIColor.clear.cgColor
        ringStroke.strokeColor = UIColor.systemOrange.cgColor
        ringStroke.lineWidth = 8
        remainingLabel.font = .monospacedDigitSystemFont(ofSize: 72, weight: .ultraLight)
        remainingLabel.textAlignment = .center
        remainingLabel.text = "15:00"
        endTimeLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 17)
        endTimeLabel.textColor = .secondaryLabel
        endTimeLabel.textAlignment = .center
        endTimeLabel.accessibilityLabel = "Alarm"
        [remainingLabel, endTimeLabel].forEach {
            $0.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            ring.addSubview($0)
        }
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            remainingLabel.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: ring.centerXAnchor),
            remainingLabel.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: ring.centerYAnchor, constant: -5),
            endTimeLabel.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: ring.centerXAnchor),
            endTimeLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: remainingLabel.bottomAnchor, constant: 2),
        ])
        [cancel, start, sound].forEach {
            $0.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            view.addSubview($0)
        }
        ring.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(ring)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            picker.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 4),
            picker.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            picker.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            picker.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 285),
            cancel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.topAnchor, constant: 414),
            cancel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            cancel.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            cancel.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            start.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: cancel.topAnchor),
            start.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            start.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            start.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 84),
            sound.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: cancel.bottomAnchor, constant: 34),
            sound.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 16),
            sound.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            sound.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 52),
            soundText.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: sound.leadingAnchor, constant: 18),
            soundText.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: sound.centerYAnchor),
            soundDetail.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: sound.trailingAnchor, constant: -16),
            soundDetail.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: sound.centerYAnchor),
            ring.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 16),
            ring.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            ring.widthAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.widthAnchor, constant: -40),
            ring.heightAnchor.constraint(equalTo: ring.widthAnchor)
        ])
    }

    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {
        super.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
        let center = CGPoint(x: ring.bounds.midX, y: ring.bounds.midY)
        ringStroke.frame = ring.bounds
        ringStroke.path = UIBezierPath(arcCenter: center, radius: max(0, ring.bounds.width / 2 - 5),
                                      startAngle: -.pi / 2, endAngle: .pi * 1.5,
                                      clockwise: true).cgPath
    }

    deinit { ticker?.invalidate() }

    private func updateCountdown() {
        let remaining = max(0, endsAt.map { $0.timeIntervalSinceNow } ?? pausedRemaining ?? 0)
        let seconds = Int(ceil(remaining))
        remainingLabel.text = seconds >= 3600
            ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", seconds / 3600, (seconds / 60) % 60, seconds % 60)
            : String(format: "%02d:%02d", seconds / 60, seconds % 60)
        ringStroke.strokeEnd = totalDuration > 0 ? CGFloat(remaining / totalDuration) : 0
        if remaining <= 0 && endsAt != nil { cancelCountdown() }
    }

    private func setCountdownVisible(_ visible: Bool) {
        navigationController?.setNavigationBarHidden(visible, animated: false)
        picker.isHidden = visible
        fieldLabels.forEach { $0.isHidden = visible }
        sound.isHidden = false
        ring.isHidden = !visible
        cancel.isEnabled = visible
        cancel.setTitleColor(visible ? .white : .secondaryLabel, for: .normal)
        start.setTitle(visible ? "Pause" : "Start", for: .normal)
        start.setTitleColor(visible ? .systemOrange : .systemGreen, for: .normal)
        start.backgroundColor = (visible ? UIColor.systemOrange : UIColor.systemGreen)
            .withAlphaComponent(0.25)
        start.layer.borderColor = (visible ? UIColor.systemOrange : UIColor.systemGreen)
            .withAlphaComponent(0.4).cgColor
    }

    @objc private func startPauseResume() {
        if let end = endsAt {
            pausedRemaining = max(0, end.timeIntervalSinceNow)
            endsAt = nil
            ticker?.invalidate()
            ticker = nil
            start.setTitle("Resume", for: .normal)
            updateCountdown()
            return
        }
        if let paused = pausedRemaining {
            endsAt = Date().addingTimeInterval(paused)
            pausedRemaining = nil
        } else {
            let seconds = picker.selectedRow(inComponent: 0) * 3600 +
                picker.selectedRow(inComponent: 1) * 60 + picker.selectedRow(inComponent: 2)
            totalDuration = TimeInterval(max(1, seconds))
            endsAt = Date().addingTimeInterval(totalDuration)
        }
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "HH:mm"
        let bell = NSTextAttachment()
        bell.image = UIImage(systemName: "bell.fill")?.withTintColor(.secondaryLabel)
        let endText = NSMutableAttributedString(attachment: bell)
        endText.append(NSAttributedString(string: "  " + formatter.string(from: endsAt!)))
        endTimeLabel.attributedText = endText
        setCountdownVisible(true)
        updateCountdown()
        ticker?.invalidate()
        ticker = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.2, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
            self?.updateCountdown()
        }
    }

    @objc private func cancelCountdown() {
        ticker?.invalidate()
        ticker = nil
        endsAt = nil
        pausedRemaining = nil
        totalDuration = 0
        setCountdownVisible(false)
    }

    @objc private func showSoundPicker() {
        let navigation = UINavigationController(rootViewController: SoundChooserController())
        navigation.modalPresentationStyle = .pageSheet
        present(navigation, animated: true)
    }
    func numberOfComponents(in pickerView: UIPickerView) -> Int { 3 }
    func pickerView(_ pickerView: UIPickerView, numberOfRowsInComponent component: Int) -> Int { component == 0 ? 24 : 60 }
    func pickerView(_ pickerView: UIPickerView, widthForComponent component: Int) -> CGFloat { 110 }
    func pickerView(_ pickerView: UIPickerView, titleForRow row: Int, forComponent component: Int) -> String? {
        let selected = pickerView.selectedRow(inComponent: component)
        if row == selected {
            return component == 0 ? "\(row) hours" : component == 1 ? "\(row) min" : "\(row) sec"
        }
        return "\(row)"
    }
}

final class SoundChooserController: UITableViewController {
    private let sounds = ["Radar (Default)", "Apex", "Beacon", "Bulletin", "By The Seaside",
                          "Chimes", "Circuit", "Constellation", "Cosmic", "Crystals",
                          "Hillside", "Illuminate", "Night Owl", "Opening", "Playtime",
                          "Presto", "Radiate", "Reflection"]
    init() { super.init(style: .insetGrouped) }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "When Timer Ends"
        navigationItem.largeTitleDisplayMode = .never
        tableView.backgroundColor = .black
        tableView.contentInset.top = -18
        navigationItem.leftBarButtonItem = systemButton("Cancel", selector: #selector(cancel), target: self)
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = systemButton("Set", selector: #selector(cancel), target: self)
    }

    @objc private func cancel() { dismiss(animated: true) }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int { sounds.count }
    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .default, reuseIdentifier: nil)
        cell.backgroundColor = panel
        let label = UILabel()
        label.text = sounds[indexPath.row]
        label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        cell.contentView.addSubview(label)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            label.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: cell.contentView.leadingAnchor, constant: 58),
            label.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: cell.contentView.centerYAnchor)
        ])
        cell.accessibilityLabel = sounds[indexPath.row]
        if indexPath.row == 0 {
            let check = UILabel()
            check.text = "✓"
            check.textColor = .systemOrange
            check.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 23)
            check.frame = CGRect(x: 22, y: 7, width: 28, height: 30)
            cell.contentView.addSubview(check)
        }
        return cell
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/ClockIOS26/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class ClockTabsController: UITabBarController {
    private let tray = UIView()
    private var controls: [UIControl] = []
    private let names = ["World Clock", "Alarms", "Stopwatch", "Timers"]
    private let icons = ["globe", "alarm", "stopwatch", "timer"]

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        tabBar.isHidden = true
        tray.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.12, alpha: 1)
        tray.layer.cornerRadius = 30
        tray.layer.borderWidth = 0.5
        tray.layer.borderColor = UIColor(white: 0.27, alpha: 1).cgColor
        view.addSubview(tray)
        for index in names.indices {
            let control = UIControl()
            control.tag = index
            control.isAccessibilityElement = true
            control.accessibilityLabel = names[index]
            control.accessibilityTraits = .button
            control.layer.cornerRadius = 27
            control.addTarget(self, action: #selector(selectPage(_:)), for: .touchUpInside)
            let icon = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: icons[index]))
            icon.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
            icon.tag = 100
            let title = UILabel()
            title.text = names[index]
            title.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 10)
            title.textAlignment = .center
            title.tag = 101
            control.addSubview(icon)
            control.addSubview(title)
            tray.addSubview(control)
            controls.append(control)
        }
        updateSelectedPage()
    }

    override func viewDidLayoutSubviews() {
        super.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
        tray.frame = CGRect(x: 21, y: view.bounds.height - 82,
                            width: view.bounds.width - 42, height: 61)
        let itemWidth = tray.bounds.width / CGFloat(controls.count)
        for (index, control) in controls.enumerated() {
            control.frame = CGRect(x: CGFloat(index) * itemWidth, y: 3,
                                   width: itemWidth, height: 55)
            control.viewWithTag(100)?.frame = CGRect(x: (itemWidth - 24) / 2,
                                                     y: 7, width: 24, height: 24)
            control.viewWithTag(101)?.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 35,
                                                     width: itemWidth, height: 15)
        }
        view.bringSubviewToFront(tray)
    }

    @objc private func selectPage(_ sender: UIControl) {
        selectedIndex = sender.tag
        updateSelectedPage()
    }

    private func updateSelectedPage() {
        for (index, control) in controls.enumerated() {
            let selected = index == selectedIndex
            control.backgroundColor = selected ? UIColor(white: 0.22, alpha: 1) : .clear
            let color = selected ? UIColor.systemOrange : UIColor.white
            (control.viewWithTag(100) as? UIImageView)?.tintColor = color
            (control.viewWithTag(101) as? UILabel)?.textColor = color
        }
    }
}

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
               options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let world = UINavigationController(rootViewController: WorldClockController())
        let alarm = UINavigationController(rootViewController: AlarmController())
        let stopwatch = UINavigationController(rootViewController: StopwatchController())
        let timer = UINavigationController(rootViewController: TimerController())
        let pages = [world, alarm, stopwatch, timer]
        for page in pages { page.navigationBar.prefersLargeTitles = true }
        world.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(title: "World Clock", image: UIImage(systemName: "globe"), tag: 0)
        alarm.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(title: "Alarms", image: UIImage(systemName: "alarm"), tag: 1)
        stopwatch.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(title: "Stopwatch", image: UIImage(systemName: "stopwatch"), tag: 2)
        timer.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(title: "Timers", image: UIImage(systemName: "timer"), tag: 3)

        let tabs = ClockTabsController()
        tabs.viewControllers = pages
        tabs.selectedIndex = 0
        tabs.tabBar.tintColor = .systemOrange
        tabs.tabBar.unselectedItemTintColor = UIColor(white: 0.55, alpha: 1)
        tabs.tabBar.backgroundColor = .black
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .dark
        window.rootViewController = tabs
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/ClockIOS26/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppClockIOS26.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppClockIOS26 \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-clock.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppClockIOS26.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppClockIOS26.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppClockIOS26.app/CopyAppClockIOS26"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppClockIOS26.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppClockIOS26.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppClockIOS26.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppClockIOS26.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/CompassClone/Sources/CompassDialView.swift`:

```swift
import CoreLocation
import UIKit

final class CompassDialView: UIControl {
    var heading: CLLocationDirection = 0 { didSet { setNeedsDisplay() } }
    var lockedBearing: CLLocationDirection? { didSet { setNeedsDisplay() } }

    override init(frame: CGRect) {
        super.init(frame: frame)
        backgroundColor = .clear
        isAccessibilityElement = true
        accessibilityTraits = [.button]
        accessibilityHint = "Double tap to set or clear a bearing"
    }

    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) has not been implemented") }

    override func draw(_ rect: CGRect) {
        guard let context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext() else { return }
        let center = CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.midY)
        let radius = min(rect.width, rect.height) * 0.355
        let angle = CGFloat(heading * .pi / 180)

        func point(_ degrees: CGFloat, _ distance: CGFloat) -> CGPoint {
            let radians = degrees * .pi / 180 - .pi / 2 - angle
            return CGPoint(x: center.x + cos(radians) * distance,
                           y: center.y + sin(radians) * distance)
        }

        for degree in stride(from: 0, to: 360, by: 2) {
            let major = degree % 30 == 0
            let length: CGFloat = major ? 21 : (degree % 10 == 0 ? 20 : 19)
            let start = point(CGFloat(degree), radius - length)
            let end = point(CGFloat(degree), radius)
            context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.white.cgColor)
            context.setLineWidth(major ? 1.0 : 0.75)
            context.move(to: start)
            context.addLine(to: end)
            context.strokePath()
        }

        let numberStyle: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 15, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.white
        ]
        for degree in stride(from: 0, to: 360, by: 30) {
            if let bearing = lockedBearing {
                let distance = abs((Double(degree) - bearing + 540)
                    .truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360) - 180)
                if distance < 15 { continue }
            }
            let position = point(CGFloat(degree), radius + 38)
            let label = NSString(string: String(degree))
            let size = label.size(withAttributes: numberStyle)
            label.draw(at: CGPoint(x: position.x - size.width / 2,
                                   y: position.y - size.height / 2), withAttributes: numberStyle)
        }

        let cardinalStyle: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 27, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.white
        ]
        for (label, degree) in [("N", 0), ("E", 90), ("S", 180), ("W", 270)] {
            let position = point(CGFloat(degree), radius * 0.70)
            let text = NSString(string: label)
            let size = text.size(withAttributes: cardinalStyle)
            text.draw(at: CGPoint(x: position.x - size.width / 2,
                                  y: position.y - size.height / 2), withAttributes: cardinalStyle)
        }

        if let bearing = lockedBearing {
            var difference = (bearing - heading).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
            if difference > 180 { difference -= 360 }
            if difference < -180 { difference += 360 }
            if abs(difference) > 0.06 {
                let segments = max(2, Int(ceil(abs(difference) / 2)))
                // XR runtime evidence: CompassBearingView inner/outer radii are 82/119 pt.
                let scale = radius / 138.15
                let innerRadius = 82 * scale
                let outerRadius = 119 * scale
                let sector = UIBezierPath()
                for index in 0...segments {
                    let bearingAtPoint = CGFloat(heading + difference * Double(index) / Double(segments))
                    let location = point(bearingAtPoint, innerRadius)
                    if index == 0 { sector.move(to: location) }
                    else { sector.addLine(to: location) }
                }
                for index in stride(from: segments, through: 0, by: -1) {
                    let bearingAtPoint = CGFloat(heading + difference * Double(index) / Double(segments))
                    sector.addLine(to: point(bearingAtPoint, outerRadius))
                }
                sector.close()
                UIColor.red.setFill()
                sector.fill()
            }
        }

        let northTip = point(0, radius + 18)
        let northBase = point(0, radius + 5)
        let tangent = CGPoint(x: -sin(-angle - .pi / 2) * 6,
                              y: cos(-angle - .pi / 2) * 6)
        context.setFillColor(UIColor.systemRed.cgColor)
        context.move(to: northTip)
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: northBase.x + tangent.x, y: northBase.y + tangent.y))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: northBase.x - tangent.x, y: northBase.y - tangent.y))
        context.closePath()
        context.fillPath()

        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.white.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(3.5)
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y - radius - 45))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y - radius + 20))
        context.strokePath()

        context.setFillColor(UIColor(white: 0.12, alpha: 1).cgColor)
        context.fillEllipse(in: CGRect(x: center.x - 47, y: center.y - 47,
                                       width: 94, height: 94))
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.systemGray.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(1)
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: center.x - 78, y: center.y))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: center.x + 78, y: center.y))
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y - 78))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y + 78))
        context.strokePath()

        if let bearing = lockedBearing {
            let start = point(CGFloat(bearing), radius - 8)
            let end = point(CGFloat(bearing), radius - 47)
            context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.systemRed.cgColor)
            context.setLineWidth(1)
            context.move(to: start)
            context.addLine(to: end)
            context.strokePath()

            let position = point(CGFloat(bearing), radius + 39)
            let label = NSString(string: String(Int(bearing.rounded()) % 360))
            let style: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .regular),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.white
            ]
            let size = label.size(withAttributes: style)
            label.draw(at: CGPoint(x: position.x - size.width / 2,
                                   y: position.y - size.height / 2), withAttributes: style)
        }
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/CompassClone/Sources/CompassViewController.swift`:

```swift
import CoreLocation
import CoreMotion
import UIKit

final class CompassViewController: UIViewController, CLLocationManagerDelegate {
    private let locationManager = CLLocationManager()
    private let motionManager = CMMotionManager()
    private let geocoder = CLGeocoder()
    private let dial = CompassDialView()
    private let headingLabel = UILabel()
    private let bearingLabel = UILabel()
    private let coordinatesButton = UIButton(type: .system)
    private let placeLabel = UILabel()
    private let elevationLabel = UILabel()
    private var currentHeading: CLLocationDirection = 0
    private var motionFrame: CMAttitudeReferenceFrame?
    private var displayLink: CADisplayLink?
    private var lastLocation: CLLocation?
    private var lastGeocodeDate = Date.distantPast
    private var lastGeocodeLocation: CLLocation?
    private var dialCenterYConstraint: NSLayoutConstraint?
    private var labelsTopConstraint: NSLayoutConstraint?

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .black
        overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .dark
        configureLayout()
        locationManager.delegate = self
        locationManager.headingFilter = 0.5
        locationManager.desiredAccuracy = kCLLocationAccuracyBest
        updateLocationAuthorization()
        updateHeadingLabel()
    }

    override func viewDidAppear(_ animated: Bool) {
        super.viewDidAppear(animated)
        startMotionIfAvailable()
    }

    override func viewWillDisappear(_ animated: Bool) {
        super.viewWillDisappear(animated)
        displayLink?.invalidate()
        displayLink = nil
        motionManager.stopDeviceMotionUpdates()
        locationManager.stopUpdatingHeading()
        motionFrame = nil
    }

    private func configureLayout() {
        dial.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dial.addTarget(self, action: #selector(toggleBearing), for: .touchUpInside)
        view.addSubview(dial)

        let stack = UIStackView()
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.alignment = .center
        stack.spacing = 7
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)

        headingLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 70, weight: .thin)
        headingLabel.textColor = .white
        headingLabel.transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: -12, y: -3)
        headingLabel.accessibilityIdentifier = "heading"
        bearingLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 15, weight: .medium)
        bearingLabel.textColor = .systemYellow
        bearingLabel.accessibilityIdentifier = "bearing"
        coordinatesButton.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 20)
        coordinatesButton.tintColor = .white
        coordinatesButton.accessibilityIdentifier = "coordinates"
        coordinatesButton.addTarget(self, action: #selector(openMaps), for: .touchUpInside)
        placeLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 20)
        placeLabel.textColor = .white
        placeLabel.accessibilityIdentifier = "place"
        elevationLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 20)
        elevationLabel.textColor = .white
        elevationLabel.accessibilityIdentifier = "elevation"
        [headingLabel, bearingLabel, coordinatesButton, placeLabel, elevationLabel].forEach(stack.addArrangedSubview)

        let dialCenterY = dial.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.centerYAnchor, constant: -130)
        dialCenterYConstraint = dialCenterY
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            dial.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            dialCenterY,
            dial.widthAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.widthAnchor, multiplier: 0.94),
            dial.heightAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dial.widthAnchor),
            stack.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            stack.topAnchor.constraint(greaterThanOrEqualTo: dial.bottomAnchor, constant: 32),
            stack.bottomAnchor.constraint(lessThanOrEqualTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor, constant: -22)
        ])
        let preferred = stack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dial.bottomAnchor, constant: 82)
        labelsTopConstraint = preferred
        preferred.priority = .defaultHigh
        preferred.isActive = true
        coordinatesButton.isHidden = true
        coordinatesButton.isEnabled = false
        placeLabel.text = ""
        placeLabel.isHidden = true
        elevationLabel.text = ""
        elevationLabel.isHidden = true
        bearingLabel.isHidden = true
    }

    private func clearLocationDisplay() {
        lastLocation = nil
        lastGeocodeLocation = nil
        lastGeocodeDate = .distantPast
        coordinatesButton.setTitle(nil, for: .normal)
        coordinatesButton.isEnabled = false
        coordinatesButton.isHidden = true
        placeLabel.text = ""
        placeLabel.isHidden = true
        elevationLabel.text = ""
        elevationLabel.isHidden = true
        setLocationLayout(hasLocation: false)
    }

    private func setLocationLayout(hasLocation: Bool) {
        dialCenterYConstraint?.constant = hasLocation ? -130 : -100
        labelsTopConstraint?.constant = hasLocation ? 82 : 116
    }

    private func updateLocationAuthorization() {
        switch locationManager.authorizationStatus {
        case .notDetermined:
            clearLocationDisplay()
            locationManager.requestWhenInUseAuthorization()
        case .authorizedAlways, .authorizedWhenInUse: locationManager.startUpdatingLocation()
        default:
            locationManager.stopUpdatingLocation()
            geocoder.cancelGeocode()
            clearLocationDisplay()
        }
        if view.window != nil { startMotionIfAvailable() }
    }

    private func startMotionIfAvailable() {
        guard motionManager.isDeviceMotionAvailable else {
            if CLLocationManager.headingAvailable() { locationManager.startUpdatingHeading() }
            return
        }
        let available = CMMotionManager.availableAttitudeReferenceFrames()
        let authorized = locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedAlways ||
            locationManager.authorizationStatus == .authorizedWhenInUse
        let desired: CMAttitudeReferenceFrame
        if available.contains(.xMagneticNorthZVertical) {
            desired = .xMagneticNorthZVertical
        } else if authorized && available.contains(.xTrueNorthZVertical) {
            desired = .xTrueNorthZVertical
        } else {
            if CLLocationManager.headingAvailable() { locationManager.startUpdatingHeading() }
            return
        }
        if motionFrame != desired || !motionManager.isDeviceMotionActive {
            motionManager.stopDeviceMotionUpdates()
            motionManager.deviceMotionUpdateInterval = 1.0 / 60.0
            motionManager.startDeviceMotionUpdates(using: desired)
            motionFrame = desired
        }
        if displayLink == nil {
            let link = CADisplayLink(target: self, selector: #selector(refreshMotionHeading))
            link.preferredFramesPerSecond = 60
            link.add(to: .main, forMode: .common)
            displayLink = link
        }
    }

    @objc private func refreshMotionHeading() {
        guard let heading = motionManager.deviceMotion?.heading,
              heading.isFinite, heading >= 0 else { return }
        let normalized = heading.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
        let difference = abs(normalized - currentHeading)
        guard min(difference, 360 - difference) >= 0.1 else { return }
        currentHeading = normalized
        dial.heading = normalized
        updateHeadingLabel()
    }

    func locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization(_ manager: CLLocationManager) {
        updateLocationAuthorization()
    }

    func locationManager(_ manager: CLLocationManager, didUpdateHeading newHeading: CLHeading) {
        guard !motionManager.isDeviceMotionActive else { return }
        let candidate = newHeading.trueHeading >= 0 ? newHeading.trueHeading : newHeading.magneticHeading
        guard candidate >= 0 else { return }
        currentHeading = candidate.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
        dial.heading = currentHeading
        updateHeadingLabel()
    }

    func locationManager(_ manager: CLLocationManager, didUpdateLocations locations: [CLLocation]) {
        guard let location = locations.last, location.horizontalAccuracy >= 0 else { return }
        lastLocation = location
        setLocationLayout(hasLocation: true)
        let northSouth = location.coordinate.latitude >= 0 ? "N" : "S"
        let eastWest = location.coordinate.longitude >= 0 ? "E" : "W"
        let coordinates = "\(formatDMS(location.coordinate.latitude)) \(northSouth)  \(formatDMS(location.coordinate.longitude)) \(eastWest)"
        coordinatesButton.setTitle(coordinates, for: .normal)
        coordinatesButton.isEnabled = true
        coordinatesButton.isHidden = false
        elevationLabel.text = location.verticalAccuracy >= 0 ? String(format: "%.0f m Elevation", location.altitude) : ""
        elevationLabel.isHidden = location.verticalAccuracy < 0
        let moved = lastGeocodeLocation.map { location.distance(from: $0) > 1000 } ?? true
        guard moved || Date().timeIntervalSince(lastGeocodeDate) > 60 else { return }
        lastGeocodeDate = Date()
        lastGeocodeLocation = location
        geocoder.reverseGeocodeLocation(location) { [weak self] placemarks, _ in
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                guard let self, let latest = self.lastLocation,
                      latest.distance(from: location) < 1000 else { return }
                let mark = placemarks?.first
                self.placeLabel.text = [mark?.locality, mark?.administrativeArea]
                    .compactMap { $0 }.joined(separator: ", ")
                self.placeLabel.isHidden = self.placeLabel.text?.isEmpty ?? true
            }
        }
    }

    func locationManager(_ manager: CLLocationManager, didFailWithError error: Error) {
        if lastLocation == nil { clearLocationDisplay() }
    }

    @objc private func toggleBearing() {
        dial.lockedBearing = dial.lockedBearing == nil ? currentHeading : nil
        bearingLabel.isHidden = true
        bearingLabel.text = dial.lockedBearing.map { String(format: "Bearing locked at %.0f°", $0) }
        dial.accessibilityValue = dial.lockedBearing == nil ? "Unlocked" : "Bearing locked"
    }

    @objc private func openMaps() {
        guard let location = lastLocation else { return }
        let coordinate = location.coordinate
        guard let url = URL(string: String(format: "maps:ll=%f,%f&trackingMode=2",
                                                coordinate.latitude, coordinate.longitude)) else { return }
        UIApplication.shared.open(url)
    }

    private func updateHeadingLabel() {
        let directions = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]
        let index = Int((currentHeading + 22.5) / 45) % directions.count
        headingLabel.text = "\(Int(currentHeading.rounded()) % 360)° \(directions[index])"
        dial.accessibilityLabel = "Compass, \(headingLabel.text ?? "")"
    }

    private func formatDMS(_ coordinate: CLLocationDegrees) -> String {
        let totalSeconds = Int((abs(coordinate) * 3600).rounded())
        let degrees = totalSeconds / 3600
        let minutes = (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60
        let seconds = totalSeconds % 60
        return "\(degrees)°\(minutes)′\(seconds)″"
    }

}
```

`examples/rebuild/CompassClone/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(
        _ scene: UIScene,
        willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
        options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions
    ) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = CompassViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/CompassClone/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppCompass.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppCompass \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-compass.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppCompass.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCompass.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppCompass.app/CopyAppCompass"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppCompass.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppCompass.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppCompass.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppCompass.ipa

```

```swift
import UIKit

@main
final class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    func application(
        _ application: UIApplication,
        didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]? = nil
    ) -> Bool {
        true
    }

    func application(
        _ application: UIApplication,
        configurationForConnecting connectingSceneSession: UISceneSession,
        options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions
    ) -> UISceneConfiguration {
        let configuration = UISceneConfiguration(name: "Default Configuration", sessionRole: connectingSceneSession.role)
        configuration.delegateClass = SceneDelegate.self
        return configuration
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/DeepSeekClone/Sources/LoginViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

private final class WhaleMarkView: UIView {
    override func draw(_ rect: CGRect) {
        let scale = min(rect.width / 54, rect.height / 44)
        let context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext()
        context?.saveGState()
        context?.translateBy(x: (rect.width - 54 * scale) / 2, y: (rect.height - 44 * scale) / 2)
        context?.scaleBy(x: scale, y: scale)

        let body = UIBezierPath()
        body.move(to: CGPoint(x: 3, y: 25))
        body.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 23, y: 8), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 3, y: 13), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 12, y: 7))
        body.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 40, y: 15), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 31, y: 9), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 37, y: 12))
        body.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 47, y: 5))
        body.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 48, y: 15))
        body.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 54, y: 13))
        body.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 39, y: 23), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 51, y: 22), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 45, y: 25))
        body.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 22, y: 39), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 36, y: 33), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 31, y: 39))
        body.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 3, y: 25), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 11, y: 39), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 4, y: 33))
        body.close()
        UIColor(red: 0.26, green: 0.43, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1).setFill()
        body.fill()

        let belly = UIBezierPath()
        belly.move(to: CGPoint(x: 11, y: 27))
        belly.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 31, y: 33), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 16, y: 31), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 22, y: 35))
        belly.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: 20, y: 27), controlPoint1: CGPoint(x: 27, y: 29), controlPoint2: CGPoint(x: 23, y: 27))
        belly.close()
        UIColor.white.setFill()
        belly.fill()

        let eye = UIBezierPath(ovalIn: CGRect(x: 25, y: 16, width: 3, height: 3))
        eye.fill()
        context?.restoreGState()
    }
}

private final class GoogleMarkView: UIView {
    override func draw(_ rect: CGRect) {
        let center = CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.midY)
        let radius = min(rect.width, rect.height) * 0.34
        let parts: [(UIColor, CGFloat, CGFloat)] = [
            (UIColor(red: 0.26, green: 0.52, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1), -.pi / 4, .pi / 4),
            (UIColor(red: 0.20, green: 0.66, blue: 0.33, alpha: 1), .pi / 4, .pi * 3 / 4),
            (UIColor(red: 0.98, green: 0.74, blue: 0.05, alpha: 1), .pi * 3 / 4, .pi * 5 / 4),
            (UIColor(red: 0.92, green: 0.26, blue: 0.21, alpha: 1), .pi * 5 / 4, .pi * 7 / 4)
        ]
        for (color, start, end) in parts {
            let arc = UIBezierPath(arcCenter: center, radius: radius, startAngle: start,
                                   endAngle: end, clockwise: true)
            arc.lineWidth = 4
            color.setStroke()
            arc.stroke()
        }
        let bar = UIBezierPath(roundedRect: CGRect(x: center.x, y: center.y - 2,
                                                  width: radius + 2, height: 4), cornerRadius: 1)
        UIColor(red: 0.26, green: 0.52, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1).setFill()
        bar.fill()
    }
}

final class LoginViewController: UIViewController {
    private let blue = UIColor(red: 0.26, green: 0.43, blue: 0.96, alpha: 1)
    private let dimView = UIView()
    private let dialog = UIView()
    private let agreementMark = UILabel()
    private var hasAgreed = false

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .white
        makeHome()
        makeDialog()
    }

    private func makeHome() {
        let contact = UILabel()
        contact.text = "Contact us"
        contact.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 15)
        contact.textColor = .systemGray
        contact.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(contact)

        let brand = UILabel()
        brand.text = "deepseek"
        brand.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 32, weight: .semibold)
        brand.textColor = blue
        brand.textAlignment = .center
        brand.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(brand)

        let mark = WhaleMarkView()
        mark.backgroundColor = .clear
        mark.isAccessibilityElement = false
        mark.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(mark)

        let buttons = UIStackView()
        buttons.axis = .vertical
        buttons.spacing = 14
        buttons.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(buttons)
        for title in ["Continue with Google", "Continue with Apple",
                      "Continue with Password", "Sign up"] {
            let button = UIButton(type: .system)
            button.setTitle(title, for: .normal)
            button.setTitleColor(.black, for: .normal)
            button.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .medium)
            button.titleEdgeInsets = UIEdgeInsets(top: 0, left: 24, bottom: 0, right: -24)
            button.layer.cornerRadius = 25
            button.layer.borderWidth = 1
            button.layer.borderColor = UIColor(white: 0.92, alpha: 1).cgColor
            button.accessibilityLabel = title
            button.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 50).isActive = true
            if title == "Continue with Password" || title == "Sign up" {
                button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(showTerms), for: .touchUpInside)
            }
            if title == "Continue with Google" {
                let glyph = GoogleMarkView()
                glyph.backgroundColor = .clear
                glyph.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
                glyph.isAccessibilityElement = false
                button.addSubview(glyph)
                NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
                    glyph.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: button.leadingAnchor, constant: 78),
                    glyph.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: button.centerYAnchor),
                    glyph.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 22),
                    glyph.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 22)
                ])
            } else if let symbol = title == "Continue with Apple" ? "apple.logo" :
                        title == "Continue with Password" ? "lock.fill" : nil,
                      let image = UIImage(systemName: symbol) {
                let icon = UIImageView(image: image)
                icon.tintColor = .black
                icon.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
                icon.isAccessibilityElement = false
                icon.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
                button.addSubview(icon)
                NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
                    icon.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: button.leadingAnchor, constant: 78),
                    icon.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: button.centerYAnchor),
                    icon.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 20),
                    icon.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 20)
                ])
            }
            buttons.addArrangedSubview(button)
        }

        agreementMark.text = "○"
        agreementMark.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 21)
        agreementMark.textColor = UIColor(white: 0.8, alpha: 1)
        agreementMark.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(agreementMark)

        let agreement = UILabel()
        let agreementText = "I confirm that I have read and agree to DeepSeek's\nTerms of Use and Privacy Policy"
        let agreementStyled = NSMutableAttributedString(
            string: agreementText,
            attributes: [.foregroundColor: UIColor.systemGray]
        )
        let agreementTerms = (agreementText as NSString).range(of: "Terms of Use and Privacy Policy")
        agreementStyled.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: UIColor.black, range: agreementTerms)
        agreement.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 12)
        agreement.textColor = .systemGray
        agreement.textAlignment = .center
        agreement.numberOfLines = 2
        agreement.attributedText = agreementStyled
        agreement.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(agreement)

        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            contact.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 14),
            contact.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -22),
            brand.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            brand.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor, constant: -125),
            mark.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: brand.centerXAnchor),
            mark.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: brand.topAnchor, constant: -7),
            mark.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 54),
            mark.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 44),
            buttons.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 32),
            buttons.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -32),
            buttons.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor, constant: -72),
            agreement.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor, constant: -10),
            agreement.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor, constant: 11),
            agreementMark.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: agreement.centerYAnchor),
            agreementMark.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 40)
        ])
    }

    private func makeDialog() {
        dimView.backgroundColor = UIColor.black.withAlphaComponent(0.24)
        dimView.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dimView.isHidden = true
        view.addSubview(dimView)
        dialog.backgroundColor = .white
        dialog.layer.cornerRadius = 16
        dialog.clipsToBounds = true
        dialog.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.isHidden = true
        view.addSubview(dialog)

        let title = UILabel()
        title.text = "Terms of Use and Privacy Policy"
        title.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .semibold)
        title.textColor = .black
        title.numberOfLines = 1
        title.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(title)

        let message = UILabel()
        let messageText = "I confirm that I have read and agree to\nDeepSeek's Terms of Use and Privacy\nPolicy"
        let messageStyled = NSMutableAttributedString(
            string: messageText,
            attributes: [.foregroundColor: UIColor.systemGray]
        )
        let messageTerms = (messageText as NSString).range(of: "Terms of Use and Privacy\nPolicy")
        messageStyled.addAttribute(.foregroundColor, value: UIColor.darkText, range: messageTerms)
        message.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14)
        message.textColor = .systemGray
        message.numberOfLines = 3
        message.textAlignment = .center
        message.attributedText = messageStyled
        message.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(message)

        let separator = UIView()
        separator.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.91, alpha: 1)
        separator.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(separator)
        let divider = UIView()
        divider.backgroundColor = UIColor(white: 0.91, alpha: 1)
        divider.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(divider)

        let cancel = UIButton(type: .system)
        cancel.setTitle("Cancel", for: .normal)
        cancel.setTitleColor(.systemGray, for: .normal)
        cancel.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16)
        cancel.accessibilityLabel = "Cancel"
        cancel.addTarget(self, action: #selector(hideTerms), for: .touchUpInside)
        cancel.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(cancel)

        let agree = UIButton(type: .system)
        agree.setTitle("Agree", for: .normal)
        agree.setTitleColor(blue, for: .normal)
        agree.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .medium)
        agree.accessibilityLabel = "Agree"
        agree.addTarget(self, action: #selector(acceptTerms), for: .touchUpInside)
        agree.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        dialog.addSubview(agree)

        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            dimView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor),
            dimView.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor),
            dimView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.topAnchor),
            dimView.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.bottomAnchor),
            dialog.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            dialog.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor),
            dialog.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 290),
            dialog.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 194),
            title.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.leadingAnchor, constant: 22),
            title.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.trailingAnchor, constant: -12),
            title.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.topAnchor, constant: 28),
            message.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: title.leadingAnchor),
            message.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.trailingAnchor, constant: -20),
            message.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: title.bottomAnchor, constant: 16),
            separator.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.leadingAnchor),
            separator.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.trailingAnchor),
            separator.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.bottomAnchor, constant: -52),
            separator.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 1),
            divider.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.centerXAnchor),
            divider.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: separator.bottomAnchor),
            divider.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.bottomAnchor),
            divider.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 1),
            cancel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.leadingAnchor),
            cancel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: divider.leadingAnchor),
            cancel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: separator.bottomAnchor),
            cancel.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.bottomAnchor),
            agree.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: divider.trailingAnchor),
            agree.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.trailingAnchor),
            agree.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: separator.bottomAnchor),
            agree.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: dialog.bottomAnchor)
        ])
    }

    @objc private func showTerms() {
        if hasAgreed { return }
        dimView.isHidden = false
        dialog.isHidden = false
    }

    @objc private func hideTerms() {
        dimView.isHidden = true
        dialog.isHidden = true
    }

    @objc private func acceptTerms() {
        hasAgreed = true
        agreementMark.text = "✓"
        hideTerms()
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/DeepSeekClone/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(
        _ scene: UIScene,
        willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
        options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions
    ) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = LoginViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}

```

`examples/rebuild/DeepSeekClone/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppDeepSeek.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppDeepSeek \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-deepseek.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppDeepSeek.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppDeepSeek.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppDeepSeek.app/CopyAppDeepSeek"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppDeepSeek.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppDeepSeek.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppDeepSeek.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppDeepSeek.ipa

```

```swift
import Foundation

public struct CatalogItem {
    public let title: String
    public let detail: String

    public init(title: String, detail: String) {
        self.title = title
        self.detail = detail
    }
}

public enum CatalogItems {
    public static func localSamples() -> [CatalogItem] {
        [CatalogItem(title: "Alpha", detail: "Local sample A"),
         CatalogItem(title: "Beta", detail: "Local sample B")]
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/Sources/CatalogViewController.swift`:

```swift
import CloneCatalogCore
import UIKit

final class CatalogViewController: UITableViewController {
    private let items = CatalogItems.localSamples()

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Catalog"
        tableView.register(UITableViewCell.self, forCellReuseIdentifier: "item")
        tableView.tableFooterView = UIView()
        tableView.rowHeight = 60
    }

    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int {
        items.count
    }

    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView,
                            cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = UITableViewCell(style: .subtitle, reuseIdentifier: "item")
        let item = items[indexPath.row]
        cell.textLabel?.text = item.title
        cell.detailTextLabel?.text = item.detail
        cell.selectionStyle = .none
        return cell
    }
}
```
