`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/Sources/HomeViewController.swift`:

```swift
import SwiftUI
import UIKit

final class HomeViewController: UIViewController {
    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Copy APP Fixture"
        view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground

        let actions: [(String, Selector)] = [
            ("Counter · UserDefaults", #selector(showCounter)),
            ("Notes · SQLite", #selector(showNotes)),
            ("Catalog · Framework", #selector(showCatalog)),
        ]
        let stack = UIStackView()
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.alignment = .leading
        stack.spacing = 20
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        for (name, action) in actions {
            let button = UIButton(type: .system)
            button.setTitle(name, for: .normal)
            button.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 20)
            button.contentHorizontalAlignment = .leading
            button.addTarget(self, action: action, for: .touchUpInside)
            button.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 50).isActive = true
            stack.addArrangedSubview(button)
        }
        view.addSubview(stack)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 24),
            stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -24),
            stack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 30),
        ])
    }

    @objc private func showCounter() {
        let controller = UIHostingController(rootView: CounterPage())
        controller.title = "Counter"
        navigationController?.pushViewController(controller, animated: true)
    }

    @objc private func showNotes() {
        navigationController?.pushViewController(NotesViewController(), animated: true)
    }

    @objc private func showCatalog() {
        navigationController?.pushViewController(CatalogViewController(), animated: true)
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/Sources/NoteStore.swift`:

```swift
import Foundation
import SQLite3

final class NoteStore {
    private let fileURL: URL

    init() {
        let documents = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        fileURL = documents.appendingPathComponent("fixture-notes.sqlite")
    }

    private func withDatabase<T>(_ work: (OpaquePointer) -> T?) -> T? {
        var database: OpaquePointer?
        guard sqlite3_open(fileURL.path, &database) == SQLITE_OK,
              let database = database else {
            if let database = database { sqlite3_close(database) }
            return nil
        }
        defer { sqlite3_close(database) }
        guard sqlite3_exec(database,
                           "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, text TEXT NOT NULL)",
                           nil, nil, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return nil }
        return work(database)
    }

    func count() -> Int {
        withDatabase { database in
            var statement: OpaquePointer?
            guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(database, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes", -1,
                                     &statement, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return nil }
            defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
            guard sqlite3_step(statement) == SQLITE_ROW else { return nil }
            return Int(sqlite3_column_int(statement, 0))
        } ?? 0
    }

    @discardableResult
    func addSample() -> Bool {
        withDatabase { database in
            var statement: OpaquePointer?
            guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(database, "INSERT INTO notes (text) VALUES (?)", -1,
                                     &statement, nil) == SQLITE_OK else { return nil }
            defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
            let note = "Sample note \(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970))"
            let bound = note.withCString { pointer in
                sqlite3_bind_text(statement, 1, pointer, -1,
                                  unsafeBitCast(-1, to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self))
            }
            guard bound == SQLITE_OK else {
                return nil
            }
            return sqlite3_step(statement) == SQLITE_DONE
        } ?? false
    }
}

```

`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/Sources/NotesViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class NotesViewController: UIViewController {
    private let store = NoteStore()
    private let countLabel = UILabel()

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Notes"
        view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground

        countLabel.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 17)
        countLabel.textAlignment = .center
        countLabel.text = "Saved notes: \(store.count())"

        let addButton = UIButton(type: .system)
        addButton.setTitle("Add sample note", for: .normal)
        addButton.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 17)
        addButton.addTarget(self, action: #selector(addNote), for: .touchUpInside)

        let stack = UIStackView(arrangedSubviews: [countLabel, addButton])
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.alignment = .center
        stack.spacing = 20
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            stack.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor),
        ])
    }

    @objc private func addNote() {
        if store.addSample() {
            countLabel.text = "Saved notes: \(store.count())"
        }
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
               options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) {
        guard let scene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: scene)
        window.rootViewController = UINavigationController(rootViewController: HomeViewController())
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/FixtureClone/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppFixtureClone.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppFixtureClone \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

stage="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-fixture-clone.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$stage/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppFixtureClone.app \
  "$stage/Payload/CopyAppFixtureClone.app"
app="$stage/Payload/CopyAppFixtureClone.app"
ldid -S "$app/Frameworks/CloneCatalogCore.framework/CloneCatalogCore"
ldid -S "$app/CopyAppFixtureClone"
(
  cd "$stage"
  zip -q -r CopyAppFixtureClone.ipa Payload
)
mv "$stage/CopyAppFixtureClone.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppFixtureClone.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppFixtureClone.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/NotesClone/README.md`:

```md
# Notes selected-flow rebuild

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

This independent UIKit app implements three local Notes flows selected from the XR/iOS 16 analysis: folder navigation, plain-text note creation with local persistence, and title/body search. Its Bundle ID is `com.copyapp.notes`; its minimum deployment target is iOS 16.0. It uses original Swift source in this folder and a JSON store in its own Documents container. It does not import Apple's code, assets, data or account state.

On a Mac with Xcode, XcodeGen and `ldid`, run `sh package.sh` from this folder to produce `build/dist/CopyAppNotes.ipa`. The local test installed this IPA on the jailbroken XR through Copy APP's TrollStore route. The package script signs for that route; normal USB installation requires a development signing identity and provisioning profile for the Bundle ID.

The XR result is a scoped comparison, not complete Notes equivalence. The three paired scripts passed and three screenshots were reviewed with minor differences. Repeated synthetic tests left different note counts in the original and clone. iCloud, rich text, attachments, sharing, locking and iOS 17 Notes behavior are outside this implementation.

```

`examples/rebuild/NotesClone/README.zh-CN.md`:

```md
# Notes 选定流程复刻

[English](README.md) · 简体中文

这个独立 UIKit App 实现了 XR/iOS 16 分析选定的三条本地 Notes 流程：文件夹导航、纯文本笔记创建与本地持久化、标题及正文搜索。Bundle ID 为 `com.copyapp.notes`，最低 iOS 16.0。源码独立编写，数据写入复刻版自身 Documents 容器的 JSON 文件；未导入 Apple 的代码、资源、数据或账户状态。

Mac 安装 Xcode、XcodeGen 和 `ldid` 后，在本目录运行 `sh package.sh`，得到 `build/dist/CopyAppNotes.ipa`。XR 实测通过 Copy APP 的 TrollStore 路径安装；普通 USB 安装需要该 Bundle ID 对应的开发签名与描述文件。

这只是选定流程对照，不能代表完整 Notes 复刻。三条成对脚本通过，三组截图审阅为轻微差异。重复测试使原版与复刻版积累的合成笔记数量不同。iCloud、富文本、附件、共享、锁定及 iOS 17 原版 Notes 行为均未覆盖。

```

```swift
import UIKit

@main
final class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func application(
        _ application: UIApplication,
        didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?
    ) -> Bool {
        let window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
        window.rootViewController = NotesController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
        return true
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/NotesClone/Sources/NotesController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

private struct LocalNote: Codable {
    let id: UUID
    var text: String
    var modified: Date
    var title: String { text.components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? "" }
    var body: String { text.components(separatedBy: .newlines).dropFirst().joined(separator: "\n") }
}

private final class NoteStore {
    static let shared = NoteStore()
    private let file: URL
    private(set) var notes: [LocalNote] = []

    private init() {
        let documents = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        file = documents.appendingPathComponent("local-notes.json")
        if let data = try? Data(contentsOf: file),
           let saved = try? JSONDecoder().decode([LocalNote].self, from: data) {
            notes = saved
        }
    }

    func add() -> UUID {
        let note = LocalNote(id: UUID(), text: "", modified: Date())
        notes.insert(note, at: 0)
        save()
        return note.id
    }

    func update(_ id: UUID, text: String) {
        guard let index = notes.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return }
        notes[index].text = text
        notes[index].modified = Date()
        save()
    }

    func note(_ id: UUID) -> LocalNote? { notes.first { $0.id == id } }

    private func save() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(notes) {
            try? data.write(to: file, options: .atomic)
        }
    }
}

final class NotesController: UIViewController, UITextViewDelegate, UITextFieldDelegate {
    private enum Page: String { case folders, list, editor, search }
    private let ink = UIColor(red: 0.85, green: 0.67, blue: 0.11, alpha: 1)
    private let paper = UIColor(red: 0.95, green: 0.95, blue: 0.97, alpha: 1)
    private let store = NoteStore.shared
    private var page: Page = Page(rawValue: UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "page") ?? "folders") ?? .folders
    private var activeNoteID: UUID?
    private var searchField: UITextField?

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = paper
        show(page)
    }

    private func show(_ next: Page) {
        page = next
        UserDefaults.standard.set(next.rawValue, forKey: "page")
        view.endEditing(true)
        view.subviews.forEach { $0.removeFromSuperview() }
        searchField = nil
        switch next {
        case .folders: folders()
        case .list: list()
        case .editor: editor()
        case .search: search()
        }
    }

    private func label(_ text: String, size: CGFloat, weight: UIFont.Weight = .regular,
                       color: UIColor = .label) -> UILabel {
        let item = UILabel()
        item.text = text
        item.font = .systemFont(ofSize: size, weight: weight)
        item.textColor = color
        item.isAccessibilityElement = true
        return item
    }

    private func button(_ title: String, frame: CGRect, action: Selector,
                        systemImage: String? = nil) -> UIButton {
        let item = UIButton(type: .system)
        item.frame = frame
        if let systemImage = systemImage { item.setImage(UIImage(systemName: systemImage), for: .normal) }
        else { item.setTitle(title, for: .normal) }
        item.tintColor = ink
        item.setTitleColor(ink, for: .normal)
        item.accessibilityLabel = title
        item.addTarget(self, action: action, for: .touchUpInside)
        view.addSubview(item)
        return item
    }

    private var width: CGFloat { view.bounds.width }
    private var height: CGFloat { view.bounds.height }
    private func shortTime(_ date: Date) -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "HH:mm"
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
    private func title(_ text: String) {
        let header = label(text, size: 34, weight: .bold)
        header.frame = CGRect(x: 20, y: 96, width: width - 40, height: 44)
        view.addSubview(header)
    }

    private func backButton(_ text: String, action: Selector) {
        let item = button(text, frame: CGRect(x: 8, y: 48, width: 110, height: 44), action: action)
        item.setTitle("‹  " + text, for: .normal)
        item.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 18)
        item.contentHorizontalAlignment = .left
    }

    private func searchButton() {
        let item = button("Search", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 145, width: width - 40, height: 36),
                          action: #selector(openSearch))
        item.backgroundColor = UIColor(red: 0.89, green: 0.89, blue: 0.91, alpha: 1)
        item.layer.cornerRadius = 10
        item.setTitle("⌕  Search", for: .normal)
        item.setTitleColor(.secondaryLabel, for: .normal)
        item.contentHorizontalAlignment = .left
        item.contentEdgeInsets = UIEdgeInsets(top: 0, left: 9, bottom: 0, right: 0)
    }

    private func bottomNewNote() {
        button("New note", frame: CGRect(x: width - 59, y: height - 80, width: 52, height: 44),
               action: #selector(newNote), systemImage: "square.and.pencil")
    }

    private func folders() {
        view.backgroundColor = paper
        title("Folders")
        button("Edit", frame: CGRect(x: width - 64, y: 48, width: 50, height: 44), action: #selector(noop))
        searchButton()
        let account = label("On My iPhone", size: 21, weight: .bold)
        account.frame = CGRect(x: 20, y: 196, width: width - 40, height: 46)
        view.addSubview(account)
        button("Notes", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 242, width: width - 40, height: 44),
               action: #selector(openList)).contentHorizontalAlignment = .left
        button("New folder", frame: CGRect(x: 4, y: height - 80, width: 70, height: 44),
               action: #selector(noop), systemImage: "folder.badge.plus")
        bottomNewNote()
    }

    private func list() {
        view.backgroundColor = paper
        backButton("Folders", action: #selector(openFolders))
        button("Folder Actions", frame: CGRect(x: width - 58, y: 48, width: 44, height: 44),
               action: #selector(noop), systemImage: "ellipsis.circle")
        title("Notes")
        searchButton()
        let entries = store.notes.filter { !$0.text.isEmpty }
        if entries.isEmpty {
            let empty = label("No Notes", size: 12)
            empty.textAlignment = .center
            empty.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: height - 79, width: width, height: 30)
            view.addSubview(empty)
        } else {
            let today = label("Today", size: 20, weight: .semibold)
            today.frame = CGRect(x: 40, y: 207, width: 180, height: 27)
            view.addSubview(today)
            let card = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 242, width: width - 40,
                                            height: CGFloat(min(entries.count, 9)) * 60))
            card.backgroundColor = .white
            card.layer.cornerRadius = 10
            card.clipsToBounds = true
            view.addSubview(card)
            for (index, note) in entries.prefix(9).enumerated() {
                let row = UIButton(type: .system)
                row.frame = CGRect(x: 28, y: CGFloat(index) * 60 + 6,
                                   width: card.bounds.width - 56, height: 26)
                row.setTitle(note.title, for: .normal)
                row.setTitleColor(.label, for: .normal)
                row.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 16, weight: .semibold)
                row.contentHorizontalAlignment = .left
                row.tag = index
                row.accessibilityLabel = note.title
                row.addTarget(self, action: #selector(openFirstNote), for: .touchUpInside)
                card.addSubview(row)
                let subtitle = label("\(shortTime(note.modified))  \(note.body)",
                                     size: 14, color: .secondaryLabel)
                subtitle.frame = CGRect(x: 28, y: CGFloat(index) * 60 + 31,
                                        width: card.bounds.width - 56, height: 20)
                card.addSubview(subtitle)
                if index > 0 {
                    let line = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 28, y: CGFloat(index) * 60,
                                                    width: card.bounds.width - 28, height: 0.5))
                    line.backgroundColor = .separator
                    card.addSubview(line)
                }
            }
            let count = label("\(entries.count) Notes", size: 12)
            count.textAlignment = .center
            count.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: height - 79, width: width, height: 30)
            view.addSubview(count)
        }
        bottomNewNote()
    }

    private func editor() {
        view.backgroundColor = .white
        backButton("Folders", action: #selector(openFolders))
        button("Share", frame: CGRect(x: width - 113, y: 48, width: 42, height: 44),
               action: #selector(noop), systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up")
        button("Note Actions", frame: CGRect(x: width - 60, y: 48, width: 42, height: 44),
               action: #selector(noop), systemImage: "ellipsis.circle")

        guard let id = activeNoteID ?? store.notes.first?.id else { show(.list); return }
        activeNoteID = id
        let noteText = store.note(id)?.text ?? ""
        if noteText.isEmpty {
            let editor = UITextView(frame: CGRect(x: 21, y: 102, width: width - 42,
                                                  height: height - 192))
            editor.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 18)
            editor.text = noteText
            editor.delegate = self
            editor.accessibilityLabel = "Note"
            editor.textContainerInset = .zero
            view.addSubview(editor)
            button("Done", frame: CGRect(x: width - 76, y: 92, width: 64, height: 42), action: #selector(done))
            editor.becomeFirstResponder()
        } else {
            let title = label(store.note(id)?.title ?? "", size: 28, weight: .bold,
                              color: UIColor(white: 0.26, alpha: 1))
            title.frame = CGRect(x: 27, y: 102, width: width - 54, height: 36)
            view.addSubview(title)
            let body = label(store.note(id)?.body ?? "", size: 17,
                             color: UIColor(white: 0.27, alpha: 1))
            body.numberOfLines = 0
            body.frame = CGRect(x: 27, y: 139, width: width - 54, height: 28)
            view.addSubview(body)
        }
        let tools = ["checklist", "camera", "pencil.tip", "square.and.pencil"]
        for (index, symbol) in tools.enumerated() {
            button(symbol, frame: CGRect(x: CGFloat(index) * width / 4 + 12,
                                         y: height - 80, width: 48, height: 44),
                   action: symbol == "square.and.pencil" ? #selector(newNote) : #selector(noop),
                   systemImage: symbol)
        }
    }

    private func search() {
        view.backgroundColor = paper
        let field = UITextField(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 56, width: width - 105, height: 37))
        field.borderStyle = .roundedRect
        field.backgroundColor = UIColor(red: 0.89, green: 0.89, blue: 0.91, alpha: 1)
        field.placeholder = "Search"
        field.accessibilityLabel = "Search"
        let glass = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: "magnifyingglass"))
        glass.tintColor = .secondaryLabel
        glass.contentMode = .center
        glass.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 28, height: 37)
        field.leftView = glass
        field.leftViewMode = .always
        field.returnKeyType = .search
        field.autocorrectionType = .no
        field.spellCheckingType = .no
        field.delegate = self
        field.addTarget(self, action: #selector(queryChanged), for: .editingChanged)
        view.addSubview(field)
        searchField = field
        button("Cancel", frame: CGRect(x: width - 79, y: 56, width: 70, height: 37),
               action: #selector(openFolders))
        field.becomeFirstResponder()
    }

    @objc private func queryChanged() {
        view.subviews.filter { $0.tag == 900 }.forEach { $0.removeFromSuperview() }
        guard let query = searchField?.text, !query.isEmpty else { return }
        let matching = store.notes.filter { $0.text.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(query) }
        let top = Array(matching.prefix(2))
        let rest = Array(matching.dropFirst(2))
        let notesY = CGFloat(112 + top.count * 81 + 65)
        let attachmentsY = notesY + CGFloat(rest.count * 81 + 63)
        let headings = [("Top Hits", top.isEmpty ? "None Found" : "\(top.count) Found", CGFloat(112)),
                        ("Notes", rest.isEmpty ? "None Found" : "\(rest.count) Found", notesY),
                        ("Attachments", "None Found", attachmentsY)]
        for (heading, count, y) in headings {
            let left = label(heading, size: 20, weight: .semibold)
            left.frame = CGRect(x: 36, y: y, width: 230, height: 30)
            left.tag = 900
            view.addSubview(left)
            let right = label(count, size: 16, color: .secondaryLabel)
            right.textAlignment = .right
            right.frame = CGRect(x: width - 150, y: y, width: 113, height: 30)
            right.tag = 900
            view.addSubview(right)
        }
        for (index, first) in matching.prefix(4).enumerated() {
            let y = index < 2 ? CGFloat(146 + index * 81) : notesY + 34 + CGFloat(index - 2) * 81
            let card = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: y, width: width - 40, height: 81))
            card.backgroundColor = .white
            card.layer.cornerRadius = 10
            card.tag = 900
            view.addSubview(card)
            let item = label(first.title, size: 16, weight: .semibold, color: ink)
            item.frame = CGRect(x: 28, y: 9, width: card.bounds.width - 56, height: 22)
            card.addSubview(item)
            let subtitle = label("\(shortTime(first.modified))  \(first.body)",
                                 size: 14, color: .secondaryLabel)
            subtitle.frame = CGRect(x: 28, y: 31, width: card.bounds.width - 56, height: 20)
            card.addSubview(subtitle)
            let folder = label("Notes — On My iPhone", size: 14, color: .secondaryLabel)
            folder.frame = CGRect(x: 28, y: 51, width: card.bounds.width - 56, height: 20)
            card.addSubview(folder)
        }
    }

    func textViewDidChange(_ textView: UITextView) {
        if let id = activeNoteID { store.update(id, text: textView.text) }
    }

    @objc private func noop() {}
    @objc private func openFolders() { show(.folders) }
    @objc private func openList() { show(.list) }
    @objc private func openSearch() { show(.search) }
    @objc private func newNote() { activeNoteID = store.add(); show(.editor) }
    @objc private func done() {
        view.endEditing(true)
        show(.editor)
    }
    @objc private func openFirstNote(_ sender: UIButton) {
        let notes = store.notes.filter { !$0.text.isEmpty }
        guard sender.tag < notes.count else { return }
        activeNoteID = notes[sender.tag].id
        show(.editor)
    }
}

```

`examples/rebuild/NotesClone/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppNotes.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppNotes \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-notes.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppNotes.app "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppNotes.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppNotes.app/CopyAppNotes"
(cd "$package_root" && zip -q -r CopyAppNotes.ipa Payload)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppNotes.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppNotes.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppNotes.ipa

```

`examples/rebuild/PodcastsFreshProbe/README.md`:

```md
# Apple Podcasts selected navigation probe

This UIKit project was authored from the reviewed iOS 16 and iOS 17 Apple Podcasts evidence under `cases/ios{16,17}-podcasts-reviewed-report-20261017/`. It implements only the four-tab shell and the three selected navigation results. It uses system symbols and original layout code; it does not copy Apple's artwork, private account data, playback engine, network API, or subscription behavior.

The iOS 16 device has an empty Library and Listen Now state. The iOS 17 device has account-specific material, which this probe represents only by section headings. A passing page-title assertion will not imply content or visual parity. The final device comparison and its screenshot review must record the remaining differences explicitly.

Generate `CopyAppPodcastsFresh.xcodeproj` with `xcodegen generate --spec project.yml`, then build its `CopyAppPodcastsFresh` scheme for a generic iOS device. The deployment target is iOS 16.0. For a TrollStore test install, package the resulting `.app` as `Payload/CopyAppPodcastsFresh.app` in an IPA and sign its executable with `ldid`. For the iOS 17 test route, use your own Apple Development identity and a provisioning profile covering `com.copyapp.podcasts.fresh`, then install the signed IPA with `copyapp install --transport usb --udid <UDID> --ipa <IPA> --out <CASE>`. Keep signing material, IPAs, device screenshots and account content outside Git.

The saved local two-device cases record 3/3 selected navigation checks on each phone, with major screenshot differences. The clone does not implement search results, subscriptions, playback, downloads or account sync.

```

```swift
import UIKit

@main
final class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func application(_ application: UIApplication,
                     didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool {
        let window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
        window.rootViewController = PodcastsTabController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
        return true
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/PodcastsFreshProbe/Sources/PodcastsTabController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

private let accent = UIColor(red: 0.48, green: 0.11, blue: 0.85, alpha: 1)

final class PodcastsTabController: UITabBarController {
    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .light
        tabBar.tintColor = accent
        tabBar.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemBackground

        let pages: [(UIViewController, String, String)] = [
            (ListenNowController(), "Listen Now", "play.circle.fill"),
            (BrowseController(), "Browse", "square.grid.2x2.fill"),
            (LibraryController(), "Library", "square.stack.fill"),
            (SearchController(), "Search", "magnifyingglass")
        ]
        viewControllers = pages.map { page, title, symbol in
            let navigation = UINavigationController(rootViewController: page)
            navigation.navigationBar.prefersLargeTitles = true
            navigation.tabBarItem = UITabBarItem(title: title, image: UIImage(systemName: symbol), tag: 0)
            return navigation
        }
        selectedIndex = 1
        installMiniPlayer()
    }

    private func installMiniPlayer() {
        let bar = UIView()
        bar.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        bar.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemGray6.withAlphaComponent(0.97)
        bar.layer.borderWidth = 0.5
        bar.layer.borderColor = UIColor.systemGray4.cgColor
        view.addSubview(bar)

        let artwork = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: "dot.radiowaves.left.and.right"))
        artwork.tintColor = UIColor.systemGray2
        artwork.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemGray5
        artwork.contentMode = .center
        artwork.layer.cornerRadius = 4
        artwork.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        bar.addSubview(artwork)

        let label = UILabel()
        label.text = "Not Playing"
        label.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14)
        label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        bar.addSubview(label)

        let play = UIButton(type: .system)
        play.setImage(UIImage(systemName: "play.fill"), for: .normal)
        play.tintColor = .black
        play.accessibilityLabel = "Play"
        play.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        bar.addSubview(play)

        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            bar.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor),
            bar.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor),
            bar.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: tabBar.topAnchor),
            bar.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 58),
            artwork.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bar.leadingAnchor, constant: 20),
            artwork.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bar.centerYAnchor),
            artwork.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 44),
            artwork.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 44),
            label.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: artwork.trailingAnchor, constant: 14),
            label.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bar.centerYAnchor),
            play.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bar.trailingAnchor, constant: -22),
            play.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: bar.centerYAnchor),
            play.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 36),
            play.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 36)
        ])
    }
}

class BasePage: UIViewController {
    init(title: String) {
        super.init(nibName: nil, bundle: nil)
        self.title = title
        navigationItem.largeTitleDisplayMode = .always
    }

    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("Storyboard is unused") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground
    }

    func addEmptyState() {
        let stack = UIStackView()
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.alignment = .center
        stack.spacing = 12
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)
        let headline = UILabel()
        headline.text = "No Shows Yet?"
        headline.font = .boldSystemFont(ofSize: 21)
        headline.textAlignment = .center
        stack.addArrangedSubview(headline)
        let detail = UILabel()
        detail.text = "Use the Browse tab to discover new stories, or search for a favorite show."
        detail.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 14)
        detail.textColor = .secondaryLabel
        detail.textAlignment = .center
        detail.numberOfLines = 0
        stack.addArrangedSubview(detail)
        for title in ["Search For a Podcast", "Follow a Show by URL"] {
            let button = UIButton(type: .system)
            button.setTitle(title, for: .normal)
            button.tintColor = accent
            button.titleLabel?.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 15)
            stack.addArrangedSubview(button)
        }
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 34),
            stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -34),
            stack.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor, constant: -64)
        ])
    }

    func addSectionList(_ titles: [String]) {
        let stack = UIStackView()
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.spacing = 0
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)
        for title in titles {
            let row = UILabel()
            row.text = "   " + title + "    ›"
            row.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 18)
            row.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 48).isActive = true
            stack.addArrangedSubview(row)
            let line = UIView()
            line.backgroundColor = .systemGray5
            line.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 0.5).isActive = true
            stack.addArrangedSubview(line)
        }
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 12),
            stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 20),
            stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor, constant: -20)
        ])
    }
}

final class LibraryController: BasePage {
    init() { super.init(title: "Library") }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("Storyboard is unused") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersion.majorVersion >= 17 {
            addSectionList(["Shows", "Channels", "Saved", "Downloaded", "Latest Episodes"])
            let recent = UILabel()
            recent.text = "Recently Updated"
            recent.font = .boldSystemFont(ofSize: 21)
            recent.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
            view.addSubview(recent)
            NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
                recent.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor, constant: 20),
                recent.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 278)
            ])
        } else {
            addEmptyState()
        }
    }
}

final class ListenNowController: BasePage {
    init() { super.init(title: "Listen Now") }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("Storyboard is unused") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem = UIBarButtonItem(
            image: UIImage(systemName: "person.crop.circle"), style: .plain,
            target: self, action: #selector(showAccount))
        navigationItem.rightBarButtonItem?.accessibilityLabel = "Account Settings"
        if ProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersion.majorVersion >= 17 {
            addSectionList(["Up Next", "Recently Played"])
        } else {
            addEmptyState()
        }
    }

    @objc private func showAccount() {
        let alert = UIAlertController(title: "Account Settings", message: nil, preferredStyle: .alert)
        alert.addAction(UIAlertAction(title: "Done", style: .cancel))
        present(alert, animated: true)
    }
}

final class BrowseController: BasePage {
    init() { super.init(title: "Browse") }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("Storyboard is unused") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        addSectionList(["New Shows", "Featured", "Top Charts", "Categories"])
    }
}

final class SearchController: BasePage, UISearchBarDelegate {
    private let categories: [(String, String, UIColor)] = [
        ("Top Charts", "chart.bar.fill", UIColor(red: 0.56, green: 0.54, blue: 0.00, alpha: 1)),
        ("Audiobooks", "books.vertical.fill", UIColor(red: 0.96, green: 0.22, blue: 0.32, alpha: 1)),
        ("Horror & Supernatural", "moon.stars.fill", UIColor(red: 0.68, green: 0.20, blue: 0.70, alpha: 1)),
        ("Sleep", "moon.fill", UIColor(red: 0.02, green: 0.49, blue: 0.95, alpha: 1)),
        ("Comedy", "face.smiling.fill", UIColor(red: 0.94, green: 0.42, blue: 0.01, alpha: 1)),
        ("Business", "briefcase.fill", UIColor(red: 0.02, green: 0.36, blue: 0.84, alpha: 1)),
        ("Education", "graduationcap.fill", UIColor(red: 0.04, green: 0.66, blue: 0.62, alpha: 1)),
        ("Society & Culture", "person.2.fill", UIColor(red: 0.93, green: 0.37, blue: 0.02, alpha: 1))
    ]

    init() { super.init(title: "Search") }
    required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("Storyboard is unused") }

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        let scroll = UIScrollView()
        scroll.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(scroll)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            scroll.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor),
            scroll.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor),
            scroll.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor),
            scroll.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor)
        ])
        let content = UIStackView()
        content.axis = .vertical
        content.spacing = 10
        content.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        scroll.addSubview(content)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            content.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scroll.contentLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 4),
            content.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scroll.frameLayoutGuide.leadingAnchor, constant: 20),
            content.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scroll.frameLayoutGuide.trailingAnchor, constant: -20),
            content.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scroll.contentLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor),
        ])
        let search = UISearchBar()
        search.placeholder = ProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersion.majorVersion >= 17
            ? "Shows, Episodes, and More" : "All Podcasts"
        search.searchBarStyle = .minimal
        search.delegate = self
        content.addArrangedSubview(search)
        for start in stride(from: 0, to: categories.count, by: 2) {
            let row = UIStackView()
            row.axis = .horizontal
            row.spacing = 10
            row.distribution = .fillEqually
            for index in start..<min(start + 2, categories.count) {
                row.addArrangedSubview(categoryCard(categories[index]))
            }
            content.addArrangedSubview(row)
        }
    }

    private func categoryCard(_ category: (String, String, UIColor)) -> UIView {
        let card = UIView()
        card.backgroundColor = category.2
        card.layer.cornerRadius = 7
        card.clipsToBounds = true
        card.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 126).isActive = true
        card.isAccessibilityElement = true
        card.accessibilityLabel = category.0
        let symbol = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: category.1))
        symbol.tintColor = UIColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.4)
        symbol.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
        symbol.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        card.addSubview(symbol)
        let label = UILabel()
        label.text = category.0
        label.textColor = .white
        label.font = .boldSystemFont(ofSize: 14)
        label.numberOfLines = 2
        label.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        card.addSubview(label)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            symbol.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: card.topAnchor, constant: 15),
            symbol.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: card.trailingAnchor, constant: -14),
            symbol.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 58),
            symbol.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 60),
            label.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: card.leadingAnchor, constant: 11),
            label.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: card.trailingAnchor, constant: -6),
            label.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: card.bottomAnchor, constant: -9)
        ])
        return card
    }

    func searchBarSearchButtonClicked(_ searchBar: UISearchBar) {
        searchBar.resignFirstResponder()
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/README.md`:

```md
# Independent app examples

Each directory contains original project source or an experimental probe. The name is not a claim of complete app equivalence. Only the named device and selected flows in the linked case documentation have been checked; see [current status](../../docs/current-status.md).

| Example | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [NotesClone](NotesClone/README.md) | iOS 16 Notes selected flows; scoped folder, note and search behavior. |
| [CalculatorIOS17Fresh](CalculatorIOS17Fresh/README.md) | iOS 17 Calculator selected arithmetic flows and paired playbooks. |
| [ClockIOS26](ClockIOS26/README.md) | iOS 26 Clock selected Stopwatch flow. |
| [CompassClone](CompassClone/) | Compass pilot source and playbooks. |
| [CalculatorClone](CalculatorClone/), [CalculatorFreshProbe](CalculatorFreshProbe/), [CalculatorExternalAgent](CalculatorExternalAgent/) | Earlier Calculator implementations and agent probes. |
| [ClockClone](ClockClone/), [ClockCurrentProbe](ClockCurrentProbe/), [ClockCurrentAutoProbe](ClockCurrentAutoProbe/) | Earlier Clock implementations and probes. |
| [DeepSeekClone](DeepSeekClone/), [FixtureClone](FixtureClone/), [PodcastsFreshProbe](PodcastsFreshProbe/), [TranslateFreshProbe](TranslateFreshProbe/) | Target-specific experiments and fixtures. |

Run `xcodegen generate --spec project.yml` from the selected directory when the generated Xcode project is absent or stale. For projects with `package.sh`, run the script from that directory and inspect its signing requirements. Examples do not include the local `cases/` needed to reproduce device claims. Use a new output directory for your own app rather than editing a published example in place.

```

`examples/rebuild/TranslateFreshProbe/Sources/AppDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

@main
class AppDelegate: UIResponder, UIApplicationDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func application(_ application: UIApplication,
                     didFinishLaunchingWithOptions launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: Any]?) -> Bool {
        let window = UIWindow(frame: UIScreen.main.bounds)
        window.rootViewController = TranslateViewController()
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
        return true
    }
}
```

`examples/rebuild/TranslateFreshProbe/Sources/TranslateViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class TranslateViewController: UIViewController, UITextViewDelegate {
    private enum Page: Int { case translation, camera, conversation, favorites }
    private let accent = UIColor(red: 0.18, green: 0.69, blue: 0.75, alpha: 1)
    private let canvas = UIColor(red: 0.96, green: 0.96, blue: 0.98, alpha: 1)
    private var page: Page = .translation
    private var editingText = false
    private var textView: UITextView?

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        render()
    }

    private func label(_ text: String, frame: CGRect, size: CGFloat,
                       weight: UIFont.Weight = .regular, color: UIColor = .black,
                       alignment: NSTextAlignment = .left) -> UILabel {
        let value = UILabel(frame: frame)
        value.text = text
        value.font = .systemFont(ofSize: size, weight: weight)
        value.textColor = color
        value.textAlignment = alignment
        value.adjustsFontSizeToFitWidth = true
        value.minimumScaleFactor = 0.8
        return value
    }

    private func render() {
        textView?.resignFirstResponder()
        textView = nil
        view.subviews.forEach { $0.removeFromSuperview() }
        view.backgroundColor = canvas
        let width = view.bounds.width > 0 ? view.bounds.width : UIScreen.main.bounds.width
        let height = view.bounds.height > 0 ? view.bounds.height : UIScreen.main.bounds.height

        if page == .favorites {
            renderFavorites(width: width, height: height)
        } else if page == .camera {
            renderCamera(width: width, height: height)
        } else {
            renderLanguageCards(width: width)
            if page == .translation {
                renderTranslation(width: width, height: height)
            } else {
                renderConversation(width: width, height: height)
            }
        }
        if !editingText { renderTabs(width: width, height: height) }
    }

    private func renderLanguageCards(width: CGFloat) {
        let gap: CGFloat = 8
        let cardWidth = (width - 32 - gap) / 2
        for index in 0..<2 {
            let x = 16 + CGFloat(index) * (cardWidth + gap)
            let card = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: x, y: 64, width: cardWidth, height: 54))
            card.backgroundColor = .white
            card.layer.cornerRadius = 10
            view.addSubview(card)
            let divider = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: cardWidth - 30, y: 0,
                                               width: 1, height: 54))
            divider.backgroundColor = canvas
            card.addSubview(divider)
            if index == 0 {
                card.addSubview(label("English", frame: CGRect(x: 32, y: 8, width: 100, height: 20),
                                      size: 16, weight: .medium))
                card.addSubview(label("US", frame: CGRect(x: 32, y: 27, width: 70, height: 20),
                                      size: 15, color: .gray))
                let dot = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 9, y: 18, width: 17, height: 17))
                dot.backgroundColor = accent.withAlphaComponent(0.22)
                dot.layer.cornerRadius = 8.5
                card.addSubview(dot)
                let center = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: 13.5, y: 22.5, width: 8, height: 8))
                center.backgroundColor = accent
                center.layer.cornerRadius = 4
                card.addSubview(center)
            } else {
                card.addSubview(label("Spanish", frame: CGRect(x: 21, y: 16, width: 112, height: 22),
                                      size: 16, weight: .medium, alignment: .center))
            }
            let arrow = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: "chevron.down"))
            arrow.tintColor = accent
            arrow.frame = CGRect(x: cardWidth - 23, y: 23, width: 13, height: 9)
            card.addSubview(arrow)
        }
    }

    private func renderTranslation(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) {
        let card = UIButton(type: .custom)
        card.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 135, width: width, height: height - 135)
        card.backgroundColor = .white
        card.layer.cornerRadius = 11
        card.addTarget(self, action: #selector(openEditor), for: .touchUpInside)
        view.addSubview(card)
        if editingText {
            let editor = UITextView(frame: CGRect(x: 30, y: 184, width: width - 60,
                                                  height: max(250, height - 490)))
            editor.backgroundColor = .clear
            editor.font = .systemFont(ofSize: 28, weight: .semibold)
            editor.textColor = .black
            editor.textContainerInset = .zero
            editor.textContainer.lineFragmentPadding = 0
            editor.autocorrectionType = .yes
            editor.spellCheckingType = .yes
            editor.returnKeyType = .go
            editor.delegate = self
            editor.accessibilityLabel = "Enter text"
            view.addSubview(editor)
            textView = editor
            let close = UIButton(type: .system)
            close.frame = CGRect(x: width - 49, y: 151, width: 38, height: 38)
            close.setImage(UIImage(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill"), for: .normal)
            close.tintColor = UIColor(white: 0.5, alpha: 0.45)
            close.accessibilityLabel = "Close"
            close.addTarget(self, action: #selector(closeEditor), for: .touchUpInside)
            view.addSubview(close)
            DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak editor] in editor?.becomeFirstResponder() }
        } else {
            let placeholder = label("Enter text", frame: CGRect(x: 32, y: 169, width: width - 64, height: 34),
                                    size: 27, weight: .semibold,
                                    color: UIColor(white: 0.85, alpha: 1))
            view.addSubview(placeholder)
            roundAction(symbol: "mic.fill", center: CGPoint(x: width / 2, y: height - 153),
                        diameter: 64, color: accent, symbolColor: .white)
            roundAction(symbol: "ellipsis", center: CGPoint(x: width - 58, y: height - 153),
                        diameter: 48, color: UIColor(white: 0.92, alpha: 1), symbolColor: accent)
        }
    }

    private func renderFavorites(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) {
        view.addSubview(label("Favorites", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 91, width: width - 40, height: 44),
                              size: 34, weight: .bold))
        let star = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: "star.fill"))
        star.tintColor = UIColor(white: 0.55, alpha: 1)
        star.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
        star.frame = CGRect(x: width / 2 - 27, y: height / 2 - 28, width: 54, height: 54)
        view.addSubview(star)
        view.addSubview(label("No Favorites", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: height / 2 + 41,
                                                             width: width - 40, height: 32),
                              size: 22, weight: .bold, alignment: .center))
        view.addSubview(label("Your favorite translations will appear here.",
                              frame: CGRect(x: 25, y: height / 2 + 72, width: width - 50, height: 26),
                              size: 15, color: .gray, alignment: .center))
    }

    private func renderConversation(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) {
        view.addSubview(label("Tap mic to speak", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 144,
                                                                width: width - 40, height: 30),
                              size: 22, weight: .semibold,
                              color: UIColor(white: 0.85, alpha: 1), alignment: .center))
        view.addSubview(label("Toca el micrófono para hablar", frame: CGRect(x: 10, y: 191,
                                                                               width: width - 20, height: 28),
                              size: 20, weight: .semibold,
                              color: UIColor(white: 0.85, alpha: 1), alignment: .center))
        roundAction(symbol: "mic.fill", center: CGPoint(x: width / 2, y: height - 153),
                    diameter: 64, color: accent, symbolColor: .white)
        roundAction(symbol: "ellipsis", center: CGPoint(x: width - 58, y: height - 153),
                    diameter: 48, color: UIColor(white: 0.90, alpha: 1), symbolColor: accent)
        roundAction(symbol: "rectangle.on.rectangle", center: CGPoint(x: 58, y: height - 153),
                    diameter: 48, color: UIColor(white: 0.90, alpha: 1), symbolColor: accent)
    }

    private func renderCamera(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) {
        view.addSubview(label("Camera", frame: CGRect(x: 20, y: 83, width: width - 40, height: 44),
                              size: 34, weight: .bold))
        view.addSubview(label("Camera translation is not included in this probe.",
                              frame: CGRect(x: 24, y: height / 2 - 15,
                                            width: width - 48, height: 30),
                              size: 16, color: .gray, alignment: .center))
    }

    private func roundAction(symbol: String, center: CGPoint, diameter: CGFloat,
                             color: UIColor, symbolColor: UIColor) {
        let circle = UIView(frame: CGRect(x: center.x - diameter / 2,
                                          y: center.y - diameter / 2,
                                          width: diameter, height: diameter))
        circle.backgroundColor = color
        circle.layer.cornerRadius = diameter / 2
        view.addSubview(circle)
        let icon = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: symbol))
        icon.tintColor = symbolColor
        icon.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
        icon.frame = circle.bounds.insetBy(dx: diameter * 0.30, dy: diameter * 0.30)
        circle.addSubview(icon)
    }

    private func renderTabs(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) {
        let names = ["Translation", "Camera", "Conversation", "Favorites"]
        let symbols = ["character.bubble.fill", "camera.fill", "person.2.fill", "star.fill"]
        for index in 0..<4 {
            let itemWidth = width / 4
            let x = CGFloat(index) * itemWidth
            let selected = page.rawValue == index
            let color = selected ? accent : UIColor(white: 0.60, alpha: 1)
            let button = UIButton(type: .custom)
            button.frame = CGRect(x: x, y: height - 89, width: itemWidth, height: 72)
            button.tag = index
            button.accessibilityLabel = names[index]
            button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(selectTab(_:)), for: .touchUpInside)
            view.addSubview(button)
            let icon = UIImageView(image: UIImage(systemName: symbols[index]))
            icon.frame = CGRect(x: itemWidth / 2 - 14, y: 9, width: 28, height: 28)
            icon.contentMode = .scaleAspectFit
            icon.tintColor = color
            button.addSubview(icon)
            button.addSubview(label(names[index], frame: CGRect(x: 0, y: 42,
                                                                width: itemWidth, height: 22),
                                    size: 11, color: color, alignment: .center))
        }
    }

    @objc private func selectTab(_ sender: UIButton) {
        guard let selected = Page(rawValue: sender.tag) else { return }
        page = selected
        editingText = false
        render()
    }

    @objc private func openEditor() {
        guard !editingText else { return }
        editingText = true
        render()
    }

    @objc private func closeEditor() {
        editingText = false
        render()
    }
}

```

`examples/rebuild/TranslateFreshProbe/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppTranslate.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppTranslate \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

package_root="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-translate.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$package_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$package_root/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppTranslate.app \
  "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppTranslate.app"
ldid -S "$package_root/Payload/CopyAppTranslate.app/CopyAppTranslate"
(
  cd "$package_root"
  zip -q -r CopyAppTranslate.ipa Payload
)
mv "$package_root/CopyAppTranslate.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppTranslate.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppTranslate.ipa

```

`examples/report-inputs/README.md`:

```md
# Pilot report inputs

[English](README.md) · [Documentation](../../docs/README.md)

These six JSON files are **historical, target-specific inputs** for the repository's pilot report-composition scripts. They are retained as runnable examples and format references, outside the current documentation tree. Their claims describe particular local test cases and must not be reused as facts about another device, app build or current run. The source evidence referenced by the scripts is stored under ignored local `cases/`; a fresh public checkout will not contain it.

For a new analysis, create a new `findings.json` and `feature-spec.json` from the target's verified evidence. The [analysis skill](../../skills/copyapp-analyze/SKILL.md) describes the source-binding and review requirements. Do not commit extracted binaries, screenshots, sandbox contents or credentials with examples.

```

```json
  "schema_version": 1,
  "target_bundle_id": "com.apple.calculator",
  "title": "Calculator：iPhone XR / iOS 16.1.1 逆向与实机分析",
```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/README.md`:

```md
# Copy APP 源码已知测试夹具

这是用于检验分析报告真伪的独立 iOS 16+ App，Bundle ID 为 `dev.copyapp.fixture`。运行 `sh package.sh` 会用 XcodeGen/Xcode 构建主 App、`FixtureCore.framework` 和 `FixtureShare.appex`，再以本地测试签名打包到 `build/dist/CopyAppFixture.ipa`。源码不包含账号或远程服务。

| 流程 | 源码事实 | 预期可观察证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Counter | `CounterView.swift` 使用 SwiftUI `@AppStorage("fixture.counter")` | 点击 Increment 后数字变化；数据容器的偏好设置发生变化 |
| Notes | `NotesViewController.swift` 使用 UIKit 与 SQLite3 | 点击 Add sample note 后计数增加；`Documents/fixture-notes.sqlite` 写入；静态代码含建表、INSERT、bind、step |
| Catalog | `CatalogViewController.swift` 调用 `FixtureCore.mockResponse()` | 列出 Alpha、Beta；主程序链接嵌入 Framework，内容为本地模拟数据 |

分享扩展是独立的 `FixtureShare.appex`；主页面提供 **Share sample text** 入口。扩展会读取系统分享的固定合成文本并显示 `Received: Copy APP fixture sample text`。XR/iOS 16 与 iPhone 14/iOS 17 的选定分享路径已验证；不保证任意内容类型或扩展都兼容。

本机编译的主程序、Framework 和扩展均为 `cryptid=0`，因为它们未经过 App Store FairPlay 加密；不能将其当作砸壳成功样本。夹具用于核对已知源码、包索引、UI、沙盒变化和运行跟踪，正式能力边界见[当前状态](../../docs/current-status.zh-CN.md)。生成的 IPA、签名资料和手机证据留在被 Git 忽略的本地目录。

```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/ShareExtension/ShareViewController.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

@objc(FixtureShareViewController)
final class ShareViewController: UIViewController {
    private let payloadLabel = UILabel()

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground

        let titleLabel = UILabel()
        titleLabel.text = "Copy APP Fixture Share Extension"
        titleLabel.textAlignment = .center
        payloadLabel.text = "Loading shared text…"
        payloadLabel.textAlignment = .center
        payloadLabel.numberOfLines = 0

        let stack = UIStackView(arrangedSubviews: [titleLabel, payloadLabel])
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.spacing = 16
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            stack.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor),
            stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(greaterThanOrEqualTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.leadingAnchor, constant: 24),
            stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(lessThanOrEqualTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.trailingAnchor, constant: -24),
        ])
        loadSharedText()
    }

    private func loadSharedText() {
        let providers = (extensionContext?.inputItems ?? [])
            .compactMap { $0 as? NSExtensionItem }
            .flatMap { $0.attachments ?? [] }
        guard let pair = providers.compactMap({ provider -> (NSItemProvider, String)? in
            guard let type = provider.registeredTypeIdentifiers.first(where: {
                UTType($0)?.conforms(to: .text) == true
            }) else { return nil }
            return (provider, type)
        }).first else {
            payloadLabel.text = "No shared text"
            return
        }

        pair.0.loadItem(forTypeIdentifier: pair.1, options: nil) { [weak self] item, _ in
            let text: String?
            if let value = item as? String {
                text = value
            } else if let data = item as? Data {
                text = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)
            } else {
                text = nil
            }
            DispatchQueue.main.async {
                self?.payloadLabel.text = text.map { "Received: " + String($0.prefix(200)) }
                    ?? "Unable to read shared text"
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/Sources/CatalogViewController.swift`:

```swift
import FixtureCore
import UIKit

@objc(FixtureCatalogViewController)
final class CatalogViewController: UITableViewController {
    private let cards = FixtureCatalog.mockResponse()

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Catalog"
        tableView.register(UITableViewCell.self, forCellReuseIdentifier: "card")
    }

    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, numberOfRowsInSection section: Int) -> Int {
        cards.count
    }

    override func tableView(_ tableView: UITableView, cellForRowAt indexPath: IndexPath) -> UITableViewCell {
        let cell = tableView.dequeueReusableCell(withIdentifier: "card", for: indexPath)
        let card = cards[indexPath.row]
        var content = cell.defaultContentConfiguration()
        content.text = card.title
        content.secondaryText = card.detail
        cell.contentConfiguration = content
        return cell
    }
}
```

```swift
import SwiftUI

struct CounterView: View {
    @AppStorage("fixture.counter") private var count = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Text("Counter: \(count)").font(.largeTitle)
            Button("Increment counter") { count += 1 }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            Button("Reset counter") { count = 0 }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .navigationTitle("Counter")
    }
}
```

```swift
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.leadingAnchor, constant: 24),
            stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.trailingAnchor, constant: -24),
            stack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 30),
        ])
        addButton("Counter · UserDefaults", action: #selector(showCounter))
        addButton("Notes · SQLite", action: #selector(showNotes))
        addButton("Catalog · Framework", action: #selector(showCatalog))
        addButton("Share sample text", action: #selector(shareSampleText))
    }

    private func addButton(_ title: String, action: Selector) {
        let button = UIButton(type: .system)
        button.setTitle(title, for: .normal)
        button.contentHorizontalAlignment = .leading
        button.titleLabel?.font = .preferredFont(forTextStyle: .title3)
        button.heightAnchor.constraint(greaterThanOrEqualToConstant: 54).isActive = true
        button.addTarget(self, action: action, for: .touchUpInside)
        stack.addArrangedSubview(button)
    }

    @objc private func showCounter() {
        navigationController?.pushViewController(UIHostingController(rootView: CounterView()), animated: true)
    }

    @objc private func showNotes() {
        navigationController?.pushViewController(NotesViewController(), animated: true)
    }

    @objc private func showCatalog() {
        navigationController?.pushViewController(CatalogViewController(), animated: true)
    }

    @objc private func shareSampleText(_ sender: UIButton) {
        let sheet = UIActivityViewController(activityItems: ["Copy APP fixture sample text"], applicationActivities: nil)
        if let popover = sheet.popoverPresentationController {
            popover.sourceView = sender
            popover.sourceRect = sender.bounds
        }
        present(sheet, animated: true)
    }
}
```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/Sources/NotesViewController.swift`:

```swift
import SQLite3
import UIKit

@objc(FixtureNotesViewController)
final class NotesViewController: UIViewController {
    private let status = UILabel()
    private let store = NoteStore()

    override func viewDidLoad() {
        super.viewDidLoad()
        title = "Notes"
        view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground
        let button = UIButton(type: .system)
        button.setTitle("Add sample note", for: .normal)
        button.addTarget(self, action: #selector(addNote), for: .touchUpInside)
        let stack = UIStackView(arrangedSubviews: [status, button])
        stack.axis = .vertical
        stack.spacing = 24
        stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
        view.addSubview(stack)
        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
            stack.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor),
            stack.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor),
        ])
        refresh()
    }

    @objc private func addNote() {
        do { try store.addSampleNote(); refresh() }
        catch { status.text = "SQLite error: \(error.localizedDescription)" }
    }

    private func refresh() {
        do { status.text = "Saved notes: \(try store.count())" }
        catch { status.text = "SQLite error: \(error.localizedDescription)" }
    }
}

final class NoteStore {
    private let path: String

    init() {
        let directory = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
        path = directory.appendingPathComponent("fixture-notes.sqlite").path
    }

    private func withDatabase<T>(_ body: (OpaquePointer) throws -> T) throws -> T {
        var handle: OpaquePointer?
        guard sqlite3_open(path, &handle) == SQLITE_OK, let db = handle else {
            if handle != nil { sqlite3_close(handle) }
            throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 1)
        }
        defer { sqlite3_close(db) }
        guard sqlite3_exec(db, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, text TEXT NOT NULL)",
                           nil, nil, nil) == SQLITE_OK else {
            throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 2)
        }
        return try body(db)
    }

    func addSampleNote() throws {
        try withDatabase { db in
            var statement: OpaquePointer?
            guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "INSERT INTO notes (text) VALUES (?)", -1,
                                     &statement, nil) == SQLITE_OK else {
                throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 3)
            }
            defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
            let note = "Sample note \(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970))"
            let result = note.withCString { pointer in
                sqlite3_bind_text(statement, 1, pointer, -1, unsafeBitCast(-1, to: sqlite3_destructor_type.self))
                return sqlite3_step(statement)
            }
            guard result == SQLITE_DONE else {
                throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 4)
            }
        }
    }

    func count() throws -> Int {
        try withDatabase { db in
            var statement: OpaquePointer?
            guard sqlite3_prepare_v2(db, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes", -1,
                                     &statement, nil) == SQLITE_OK else {
                throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 5)
            }
            defer { sqlite3_finalize(statement) }
            guard sqlite3_step(statement) == SQLITE_ROW else {
                throw NSError(domain: "CopyAppFixture.SQLite", code: 6)
            }
            return Int(sqlite3_column_int(statement, 0))
        }
    }
}
```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/Sources/SceneDelegate.swift`:

```swift
import UIKit

final class SceneDelegate: UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate {
    var window: UIWindow?

    func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession,
               options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) {
        guard let windowScene = scene as? UIWindowScene else { return }
        let window = UIWindow(windowScene: windowScene)
        window.rootViewController = UINavigationController(rootViewController: HomeViewController())
        window.makeKeyAndVisible()
        self.window = window
    }
}
```

`fixture/CopyAppFixture/package.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd "$(dirname "$0")"
xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null
xcodebuild -quiet -project CopyAppFixture.xcodeproj -scheme CopyAppFixture \
  -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

stage="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/copyapp-fixture.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$stage/Payload" build/dist
ditto build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/CopyAppFixture.app \
  "$stage/Payload/CopyAppFixture.app"
app="$stage/Payload/CopyAppFixture.app"
ldid -S "$app/Frameworks/FixtureCore.framework/FixtureCore"
ldid -S "$app/PlugIns/FixtureShare.appex/FixtureShare"
ldid -S "$app/CopyAppFixture"
(
  cd "$stage"
  zip -q -r CopyAppFixture.ipa Payload
)
mv "$stage/CopyAppFixture.ipa" build/dist/CopyAppFixture.ipa
shasum -a 256 build/dist/CopyAppFixture.ipa

```

`scripts/bootstrap-ios-host-tools.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Optional host tools; never reads or obtains account/FairPlay credentials.
set -eu
case "${1:-}" in
  --ipatool) install_store=1; install_offline=0 ;;
  --offline) install_store=0; install_offline=1 ;;
  --all) install_store=1; install_offline=1 ;;
  *) echo "Usage: sh scripts/bootstrap-ios-host-tools.sh --ipatool|--offline|--all" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
task_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
mkdir -p "$task_root/toolchains/bin"
if [ "$install_store" -eq 1 ]; then
  command -v go >/dev/null || { echo "Go is required to build pinned ipatool v2.7.0" >&2; exit 1; }
  GOBIN="$task_root/toolchains/bin" go install -ldflags '-X github.com/majd/ipatool/v2/cmd.version=2.7.0' github.com/majd/ipatool/v2@v2.7.0
  "$task_root/toolchains/bin/ipatool" --version
fi
if [ "$install_offline" -eq 1 ]; then
  task_revision=1bad106ee1698c6d9c483f67d898183ffa4c6eb3
  task_source="$task_root/toolchains/fairplay-decrypt-src"
  if [ -e "$task_source" ]; then
    [ "$(git -C "$task_source" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$task_revision" ] || {
      echo "Existing FairPlay checkout differs from pinned revision; preserve it before selecting another directory." >&2; exit 1;
    }
  else
    git clone https://github.com/EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt.git "$task_source"
    git -C "$task_source" checkout --detach "$task_revision"
  fi
  command -v cc >/dev/null || { echo "Apple command-line compiler is required" >&2; exit 1; }
  echo "Pinned sources ready. Install the optional Python dependency with: .venv/bin/python -m pip install '.[offline]'"
  echo "decrypt-offline checks source hashes before compiling or reading a credential. No credential was obtained."
  echo "For first credential preparation, install Xcode + ldid and use copyapp credential-retrieve with an explicit jailbroken device and App."
fi

```

`scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Install the Copy APP Mac CLI in a repository-local virtual environment.
set -eu

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh [--trace]

Without options, install the repository CLI for iOS and macOS workflows.
--trace also installs the host Frida Python package for iOS runtime analysis.
The script does not install ChatComputer, Xcode or phone/guest services.
EOF
}

trace=0
case "${1:-}" in
    "") ;;
    --trace) trace=1 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
if [ "$#" -gt 1 ]; then
    usage >&2
    exit 2
fi

if [ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ]; then
    echo "Copy APP device setup currently requires macOS." >&2
    exit 1
fi

root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
python=${PYTHON3:-python3}
if ! command -v "$python" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Python 3.9 or newer is required." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! "$python" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 9) else 1)'; then
    echo "Python 3.9 or newer is required." >&2
    exit 1
fi

new_venv=0
if [ ! -d "$root/.venv" ]; then
    "$python" -m venv "$root/.venv"
    new_venv=1
fi
venv_python="$root/.venv/bin/python"
if [ ! -x "$venv_python" ]; then
    echo "The existing .venv is incomplete; inspect it before retrying." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$new_venv" -eq 1 ] || ! "$venv_python" -c '
import pip, setuptools, wheel
def version(value):
    return tuple(int(part) for part in value.split(".")[:2])
raise SystemExit(0 if version(pip.__version__) >= (21, 3) and
                 version(setuptools.__version__) >= (64, 0) else 1)
' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'Preparing Python packaging tools...\n'
    "$venv_python" -m pip install --quiet --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
fi
printf 'Installing Copy APP in .venv...\n'
if [ "$trace" -eq 1 ]; then
    "$venv_python" -m pip install --quiet --no-build-isolation -e "$root[trace]"
else
    "$venv_python" -m pip install --quiet --no-build-isolation -e "$root"
fi
"$root/.venv/bin/copyapp" --help >/dev/null

printf '\nCopy APP CLI is ready. Choose your target:\n'
printf '  iOS: .venv/bin/copyapp onboard\n'
printf '  With several iPhones, supply --udid <UDID>.\n'
printf '  macOS: follow docs/macos-support.md for ChatComputer and guest setup.\n'
printf '  Then run .venv/bin/copyapp mac doctor --out <NEW_CASE>.\n'
if [ "$trace" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '\nFor runtime tracing later: sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh --trace\n'
fi
if ! xcodebuild -version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '\nFull Xcode is needed for iOS developer services/builds and Xcode-project builds.\n'
fi

```

`scripts/build-ictrl-client.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

copyapp_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
source_dir="$copyapp_dir/vendor/ictrl"
binary_dir="$copyapp_dir/toolchains"

mkdir -p "$binary_dir"
cd "$source_dir/cli"
cc -O2 -std=c11 -o "$binary_dir/ictrl-macos" main.c sha256.c x25519.c util.c nearby.c
cc -O2 -std=c11 -o "$binary_dir/ictrl-selftest" selftest.c sha256.c x25519.c util.c
"$binary_dir/ictrl-selftest"
echo "Built $binary_dir/ictrl-macos from vendored iCTRL d88bbf0b3a5addead31b4298d605d7ac7a87d6e7"
```
