`tests/test_agent_delivery.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.agent_delivery import create_agent_delivery
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value) + "\n")


class AgentDeliveryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.task = self.root / "task"
        self.project = self.root / "rebuild/Clone"
        self.project.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.project / "App.swift").write_text("struct Clone {}\n")
        self.original_script = self.root / "original.json"
        self.rebuilt_script = self.root / "rebuilt.json"
        write(self.original_script, {"bundle_id": "com.example.original"})
        write(self.rebuilt_script, {"bundle_id": "dev.example.clone"})
        self.udid = "00008020-1111111111111111"
        self.prefix = hashlib.sha256(self.udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        write(self.task / "task.json", {
            "status": "ready_for_agent", "device_udid": self.udid,
            "project_dir": str(self.project),
            "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "rebuilt_bundle_id": "dev.example.clone",
            "flows": [{"id": "one", "scenario_id": "one",
                       "original_script": str(self.original_script),
                       "rebuilt_script": str(self.rebuilt_script)}]})
        write(self.task / "manifest.json", {"kind": "agent_implementation_task"})
        self.ipa = self.root / "Clone.ipa"
        self.ipa.write_bytes(b"independent-test-package")
        self.install = self.root / "install.json"
        self.install_data = {
            "schema_version": 1, "status": "installed", "helper_exit_code": 0,
            "ipa": str(self.ipa), "ipa_sha256": sha256_file(self.ipa),
            "staged_sha256": sha256_file(self.ipa), "device_id": self.udid,
            "bundle_id": "dev.example.clone", "version": "0.1", "build": "2"}
        write(self.install, self.install_data)
        self.check = self.root / "check"
        comparison = self.check / "flows/one/comparison/report-index.json"
        write(comparison, {
            "scenario_id": "one", "original_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "rebuilt_bundle_id": "dev.example.clone",
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix, "checks_status": "unreviewed"})
        self.check_data = {
            "kind": "rebuild_check", "status": "complete",
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix,
            "installed_apps": [
                {"bundle_id": "com.example.original", "version": "1", "build": "1"},
                {"bundle_id": "dev.example.clone", "version": "0.1", "build": "2"}],
            "pairs": [{"flow_id": "one", "scenario_id": "one",
                       "original_script_sha256": sha256_file(self.original_script),
                       "rebuilt_script_sha256": sha256_file(self.rebuilt_script)}],
            "flows": [{"flow_id": "one", "scenario_id": "one",
                       "comparison_index": "flows/one/comparison/report-index.json",
                       "comparison_sha256": sha256_file(comparison),
                       "final_view_status": "passed", "checks_status": "unreviewed",
                       "screenshot_pairs": 1}]}
        write(self.check / "manifest.json", self.check_data)

    def _create(self):
        with patch("copyapp.agent_delivery.verify_case", return_value=True):
            return create_agent_delivery(self.task, self.install, self.check,
                                         self.root / "delivery")

    def test_records_scoped_behavior_and_unreviewed_visuals(self):
        report = self._create()
        data = json.loads((report.parent / "delivery.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data["status"], "selected_behavior_verified_visual_unreviewed")
        self.assertEqual(data["asserted_flow_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(data["visual_unreviewed_flow_count"], 1)
        self.assertIsNone(data["agent_run_status"])
        self.assertTrue((report.parent / "source-project.tar").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((report.parent / "installed.ipa").is_file())
        with patch("copyapp.verify._verify_silent", return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(report.parent))
            (self.project / "App.swift").write_text("struct NewVersion {}\n")
            self.ipa.write_bytes(b"later-build")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(report.parent))

    def test_accepts_verified_usb_install_record(self):
        self.install_data.pop("helper_exit_code")
        self.install_data.pop("staged_sha256")
        self.install_data.update({"transport": "usb", "usb_install_completed": True,
                                  "installed_profile_validated": True,
                                  "installed_path": "/Applications/Clone.app"})
        write(self.install, self.install_data)
        report = self._create()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((report.parent / "delivery.json").read_text())["status"],
                         "selected_behavior_verified_visual_unreviewed")

    def test_explicit_review_records_differences_separately_from_script_checks(self):
        review_case = self.root / "review"
        write(review_case / "review.json", {
            "rebuild_check_case": str(self.check.resolve()),
            "rebuild_check_manifest_sha256": sha256_file(self.check / "manifest.json"),
            "pairs": [{"flow_id": "one", "step": 3,
                       "verdict": "minor_difference", "note": "Glyph shape differs."}],
        })
        write(review_case / "manifest.json", {"kind": "visual_review"})
        with patch("copyapp.agent_delivery.verify_case", return_value=True):
            report = create_agent_delivery(self.task, self.install, self.check,
                                           self.root / "reviewed-delivery",
                                           visual_review_case=review_case)
        data = json.loads((report.parent / "delivery.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(data["status"],
                         "selected_behavior_verified_visual_reviewed_with_differences")
        self.assertEqual(data["visual_unreviewed_flow_count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(data["visual_minor_difference_flow_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(data["flow_results"][0]["visual_checks_status"], "unreviewed")
        self.assertEqual(data["flow_results"][0]["visual_review_status"], "minor_difference")
        with patch("copyapp.verify._verify_silent", return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(report.parent))
            data["flow_results"][0]["visual_review_status"] = "match"
            write(report.parent / "delivery.json", data)
            manifest = json.loads((report.parent / "manifest.json").read_text())
            for item in manifest["evidence"]:
                if item["path"] == "delivery.json":
                    item["sha256"] = sha256_file(report.parent / "delivery.json")
            write(report.parent / "manifest.json", manifest)
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(report.parent))

    def test_rejects_installed_package_hash_change(self):
        self.ipa.write_bytes(b"different-package")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "no longer matches"):
            self._create()

    def test_rejects_clone_version_mismatch(self):
        self.check_data["installed_apps"][1]["build"] = "3"
        write(self.check / "manifest.json", self.check_data)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "different clone version"):
            self._create()

    def test_rejects_missing_task_flow(self):
        self.check_data["flows"] = []
        write(self.check / "manifest.json", self.check_data)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "does not cover every task flow"):
            self._create()

    def test_post_tap_numeric_assertion_counts_without_uikit_label(self):
        original = {"bundle_id": "com.example.original", "steps": [
            {"action": "observe", "contains": "Increment counter"},
            {"action": "tap_label", "label": "Increment counter"},
            {"action": "observe", "compare_number": {
                "to": "before", "pattern": "Counter: ([0-9]+)", "delta": 1}},
        ]}
        write(self.original_script, original)
        write(self.rebuilt_script, dict(original, bundle_id="dev.example.clone"))
        pair = self.check_data["pairs"][0]
        pair["original_script_sha256"] = sha256_file(self.original_script)
        pair["rebuilt_script_sha256"] = sha256_file(self.rebuilt_script)
        self.check_data["flows"][0]["final_view_status"] = "not_configured"
        write(self.check / "manifest.json", self.check_data)
        report = self._create()
        delivery = json.loads((report.parent / "delivery.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(delivery["status"], "selected_behavior_verified_visual_unreviewed")
        self.assertEqual(delivery["asserted_flow_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(delivery["flow_results"][0]["script_assertions"],
                         ["step-03:numeric_change"])
        with patch("copyapp.verify._verify_silent", return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(report.parent))
            delivery["flow_results"][0]["script_assertions"] = []
            write(report.parent / "delivery.json", delivery)
            manifest = json.loads((report.parent / "manifest.json").read_text())
            for item in manifest["evidence"]:
                if item["path"] == "delivery.json":
                    item["sha256"] = sha256_file(report.parent / "delivery.json")
            write(report.parent / "manifest.json", manifest)
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(report.parent))

    def test_selected_subset_delivery_lists_omitted_report_flow(self):
        task = json.loads((self.task / "task.json").read_text())

                     "needs_attention_count": 0,
                     "omitted_flow_ids": ["two"]})

        self.assertIn("`two`", report.read_text())

    def test_selected_subset_may_reuse_check_covering_extra_flows(self):
```

`tests/test_agent_task.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.agent_task import _evidence_files, create_agent_task
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


class AgentTaskTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.report = self.root / "report"
        self.plan = self.root / "plan"
        self.script = {"schema_version": 1, "scenario_id": "one",
                       "bundle_id": "com.example.original", "fresh_launch": True,
                       "steps": [{"action": "observe", "contains": "ready"},
                                 {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True,
                                  "ready_contains": "ready"}]}
        evidence = self.report / "evidence/ui.original"
        write(evidence / "playbook.json", self.script)
        write(evidence / "manifest.json", {"status": "complete"})
        self.spec = {"schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
                     "rebuilt_bundle_id": "dev.example.clone", "minimum_ios": "16.0",
                     "reference_device": "iPhone XR", "flows": [
                         {"id": "one", "entry": "launch", "expected": ["ready"],
                          "verification": "screen visible", "evidence": ["ui.original"]}],
                     "unknowns": ["other screens"]}
        write(self.report / "feature-spec.json", self.spec)
        (self.report / "report.md").write_text("# Example\n")
        artifacts = {}
        for path in self.report.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                name = str(path.relative_to(self.report))
                artifacts[name] = {"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(path)}
        write(self.report / "report-index.json", {
            "schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "evidence": {"ui.original": {"kind": "playbook",
                                         "path": "evidence/ui.original/manifest.json"}},
            "artifacts": artifacts})
        write(self.plan / "feature-spec.json", self.spec)
        write(self.plan / "flows/one/original.json", self.script)
        rebuilt_script = dict(self.script)
        rebuilt_script["bundle_id"] = "dev.example.clone"
        write(self.plan / "flows/one/rebuilt.json", rebuilt_script)
        (self.plan / "runbook.md").write_text("# Plan\n")
        write(self.plan / "rebuild-plan.json", {
            "schema_version": 1, "kind": "rebuild_plan", "status": "complete",
            "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "rebuilt_bundle_id": "dev.example.clone", "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
            "source_report_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.report / "report-index.json"),
            "feature_spec_sha256": sha256_file(self.plan / "feature-spec.json"),
            "ready_count": 1, "needs_attention_count": 0,
            "flows": [{"flow_id": "one", "status": "ready_for_implementation",
                       "source_evidence_id": "ui.original",
                       "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(evidence / "playbook.json"),
                       "scenario_id": "one", "original_script": "flows/one/original.json",
                       "rebuilt_script": "flows/one/rebuilt.json"}],
            "rebuild_check_argv": ["copyapp", "rebuild-check", "--udid", "<UDID>",
                                   "--out", "<NEW_CASE>"]})
        self._refresh_plan_manifest()

    def _refresh_plan_manifest(self):
        files = [{"path": str(path.relative_to(self.plan)), "sha256": sha256_file(path)}
                 for path in self.plan.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and path.name != "manifest.json"]
        write(self.plan / "manifest.json", {"schema_version": 1, "evidence": files})

    def test_creates_verified_source_linked_task(self):
        output = self.root / "task"
        create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, output,
                          "00008020-1111111111111111", self.root / "Clone")
        task = json.loads((output / "task.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(task["status"], "ready_for_agent")
        self.assertEqual(task["flows"][0]["source_evidence_id"], "ui.original")
        self.assertIn("evidence/ui.original/playbook.json",
                      task["flows"][0]["evidence"][0]["files"])
        self.assertIn("00008020-1111111111111111", (output / "TASK.md").read_text())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_direct_queue_links_each_function_for_rebuild_agent(self):
        queue = self.report / "evidence/code.chain"
        write(queue / "manifest.json", {"status": "complete"})
        write(queue / "queue.json", {"results": [
            {"status": "complete", "summary": "targets/function-01/summary.json"},
            {"status": "complete", "summary": "targets/function-02/summary.json"}]})
        for index in (1, 2):
            target = queue / f"targets/function-{index:02d}"
            write(target / "summary.json", {"address": f"0x{index:x}"})
            (target / "pseudocode.txt").write_text(f"function {index}\n")
            (target / "function-facts.json").write_text("{}\n")
        native = queue / "sources/native"
        write(native / "index.json", {"results": [], "followed": [
            {"status": "complete", "summary": "followed-01/summary.json"}]})
        write(native / "followed-01/summary.json", {"address": "0x2"})
        (native / "followed-01/assembly.txt").write_text("bl 0x2\n")
        write(queue / "sources/branch-flow/trace/trace.json", {"branch_call_counts": [1]})
        entry = {"kind": "ghidra_direct_queue",
                 "path": "evidence/code.chain/manifest.json"}
        files = _evidence_files(self.report.resolve(), entry)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/queue.json", files)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/targets/function-01/pseudocode.txt", files)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/targets/function-02/pseudocode.txt", files)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/targets/function-01/function-facts.json", files)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/sources/native/followed-01/assembly.txt", files)
        self.assertIn("evidence/code.chain/sources/branch-flow/trace/trace.json", files)

    def test_rejects_stale_report_index(self):
        path = self.report / "report-index.json"
        index = json.loads(path.read_text())
        index["changed"] = True
        write(path, index)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "stale"):
            create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, self.root / "task")

    def test_verified_task_detects_source_report_change_after_creation(self):
        output = self.root / "task"
        create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, output)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        path = self.report / "report-index.json"
        index = json.loads(path.read_text())
        index["changed"] = True
        write(path, index)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(output))

    def test_rejects_clone_script_that_changes_behavior(self):
        path = self.plan / "flows/one/rebuilt.json"
        script = json.loads(path.read_text())
        script["steps"][0]["contains"] = "different"
        write(path, script)
        self._refresh_plan_manifest()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "no longer match cited"):
            create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, self.root / "task")

    def test_missing_original_playbook_is_not_marked_ready(self):
        path = self.plan / "rebuild-plan.json"
        plan = json.loads(path.read_text())
        plan["ready_count"] = 0
        plan["needs_attention_count"] = 1
        plan["flows"] = [{"flow_id": "one", "status": "needs_original_playbook",
                          "reason": "no cited original playbook"}]

        self._refresh_plan_manifest()

        create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, output)
        task = json.loads((output / "task.json").read_text())

        self.assertEqual(task["ready_count"], 0)

    def test_selected_subset_does_not_claim_whole_report_ready(self):
        self.spec["flows"].append({"id": "two", "entry": "another page",
                                   "expected": ["other"], "evidence": ["ui.original"]})
        write(self.report / "feature-spec.json", self.spec)
        write(self.plan / "feature-spec.json", self.spec)
        report_index_path = self.report / "report-index.json"
        report_index = json.loads(report_index_path.read_text())
        report_index["artifacts"]["feature-spec.json"]["sha256"] = sha256_file(
            self.report / "feature-spec.json")
        write(report_index_path, report_index)
        plan_path = self.plan / "rebuild-plan.json"
        plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
        plan["source_report_index_sha256"] = sha256_file(report_index_path)
        plan["feature_spec_sha256"] = sha256_file(self.plan / "feature-spec.json")
        write(plan_path, plan)
        self._refresh_plan_manifest()
        output = self.root / "task"
        create_agent_task(self.report, self.plan, output)
        task = json.loads((output / "task.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(task["status"], "selected_flows_ready")
        self.assertEqual(task["omitted_flow_ids"], ["two"])
```

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.analysis_delivery import _covered_flows, create_analysis_delivery
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value), encoding="utf-8")


class AnalysisDeliveryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.task = self.root / "task"
        self.report = self.root / "report"
        self.analysis = self.root / "analysis"
        self.investigation = self.root / "investigation"
        write(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json", {"case": "analysis"})
        write(self.investigation / "manifest.json", {"case": "investigation"})
        write(self.task / "manifest.json", {"kind": "draft_analysis"})
        digest = "a" * 64
        write(self.task / "task.json", {
            "kind": "agent_semantic_review_task", "status": "needs_semantic_review",
            "target_bundle_id": "dev.example", "analysis_case": str(self.analysis),
            "app_investigation_case": str(self.investigation),
            "analysis_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json"),
            "app_investigation_sha256": sha256_file(self.investigation / "manifest.json"),
            "flows": [{"id": "flow-01", "source_script_sha256": digest}]})
        write(self.task / "feature-spec.json", {"flows": [{
            "id": "flow-01", "source_script_sha256": digest,
            "expected": ["具体行为待审阅"]}]})
        write(self.report / "report-index.json", {
            "target_bundle_id": "dev.example",
            "source_case": str(self.analysis),
            "source_case_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json"),
            "evidence": {"app.all": {"kind": "app_investigation",
                                      "sha256": sha256_file(self.investigation / "manifest.json")}}})
        write(self.report / "feature-spec.json", {
            "target_bundle_id": "dev.example", "flows": [{
                "id": "reviewed-flow", "source_script_sha256": digest,
                "entry": "tap Add", "expected": ["result label shows 15"],
                "verification": "replay original and inspect result label",
                "evidence": ["app.all"]}]})
        write(self.report / "findings.json", {
            "target_bundle_id": "dev.example", "sections": [{"title": "flow", "findings": [
                {"claim": "result label shows 15", "confidence": "observed",
                 "evidence": ["app.all"]}]}]})

    def test_binds_report_and_detects_later_spec_change(self):
        output = self.root / "delivery"
        with patch("copyapp.analysis_delivery.verify_case", return_value=True):
            create_analysis_delivery(self.task, self.report, output)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
            result = json.loads((output / "delivery.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(result["flow_coverage"][0]["report_flow_id"],
                             "reviewed-flow")
            self.assertIsNone(result["agent_run"])
            spec = json.loads((self.report / "feature-spec.json").read_text())
            spec["flows"][0]["expected"] = ["changed later"]
            write(self.report / "feature-spec.json", spec)
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(output))

    def test_rejects_unchanged_provisional_scenario(self):
        task = json.loads((self.task / "task.json").read_text())
        draft = json.loads((self.task / "feature-spec.json").read_text())
        reviewed = json.loads((self.report / "feature-spec.json").read_text())
        reviewed["flows"][0]["expected"] = draft["flows"][0]["expected"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "concrete reviewed assertions"):
            _covered_flows(task, draft, reviewed)

    def test_rejects_missing_investigated_flow(self):
        task = json.loads((self.task / "task.json").read_text())
        draft = json.loads((self.task / "feature-spec.json").read_text())
        reviewed = json.loads((self.report / "feature-spec.json").read_text())
        reviewed["flows"][0]["source_script_sha256"] = "b" * 64
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "omits investigated flow"):
            _covered_flows(task, draft, reviewed)

    def test_rejects_another_investigation_even_with_same_app(self):
        index = json.loads((self.report / "report-index.json").read_text())
        index["evidence"]["app.all"]["sha256"] = "b" * 64
        write(self.report / "report-index.json", index)
        with patch("copyapp.analysis_delivery.verify_case", return_value=True), \
                self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "different source identity"):
            create_analysis_delivery(self.task, self.report, self.root / "delivery")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "delivery").exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
    def test_resume_rejects_corrupted_derived_ui_and_static_indexes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            output = Path(root)
            udid, bundle = "device-123", "com.example.app"
            prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
            survey = output / "survey"
            survey.mkdir()
            (survey / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
                "evidence": []}))
            (survey / "app.json").write_text("{}")
            (survey / "ui.json").write_text('{"elements": []}')
            survey_record = {"ok": True,
                "key_sha256": hashlib.sha256((survey / "manifest.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "artifact_hashes": _artifact_hashes(output, "survey")}
            self.assertTrue(_stage_valid(output, "survey", survey_record, udid, bundle))
            (survey / "ui.json").write_text('{"elements": ["corrupted"]}')
            self.assertFalse(_stage_valid(output, "survey", survey_record, udid, bundle))

            acquired = output / "acquired"
            (acquired / "static").mkdir(parents=True)
            (acquired / "acquisition.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix}))
            (acquired / "static/ipa-index.json").write_text('{"binaries": []}')
            bundle_record = {"ok": True,
                "key_sha256": hashlib.sha256((acquired / "acquisition.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "artifact_hashes": _artifact_hashes(output, "bundle")}
            with patch("copyapp.analyze.verify_case", return_value=True):
                self.assertTrue(_stage_valid(output, "bundle", bundle_record, udid, bundle))
                (acquired / "static/ipa-index.json").write_text("corrupted")
                self.assertFalse(_stage_valid(output, "bundle", bundle_record, udid, bundle))
```

`tests/test_assemble.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import plistlib
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile

from copyapp.assemble import assemble_analysis_ipa, assemble_main_ipa


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def fixture(root):
    original = bytearray(80)
    struct.pack_into("<IiiIIIII", original, 0, 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C, 0, 2,
                     1, 24, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<IIIIII", original, 32, 0x2C, 24, 64, 8, 1, 0)
    original[64:72] = b"ENCRYPT!"
    recovered = bytearray(original)
    struct.pack_into("<I", recovered, 48, 0)
    recovered[64:72] = b"CODECODE"
    case = root / "case"
    case.mkdir()
    (case / "encrypted-main.bin").write_bytes(original)
    (case / "decrypted-main.bin").write_bytes(recovered)
    (case / "decryption.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "bundle_id": "com.example.test", "executable": "Example",
        "installed_version": "1.0", "cryptoff": 64, "cryptsize": 8,
        "encrypted_file_sha256": digest(original),
        "decrypted_file_sha256": digest(recovered),
    }))
    plist = {"CFBundleIdentifier": "com.example.test", "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
             "CFBundleVersion": "1", "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0"}
    snapshot = root / "snapshot.ipa"
    with ZipFile(snapshot, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist", plistlib.dumps(plist))
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Example", original)
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Extension.appex/Extension", original)
    return snapshot, case, bytes(recovered)


class AssembleTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_replaces_main_and_extension_only_from_matching_evidence(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            snapshot, main_case, recovered = fixture(root)
            extension_case = root / "extension"
            extension_case.mkdir()
            (extension_case / "encrypted-extension.bin").write_bytes(
                (main_case / "encrypted-main.bin").read_bytes())
            (extension_case / "decrypted-extension.bin").write_bytes(recovered)
            record = json.loads((main_case / "decryption.json").read_text())
            record["executable"] = "Extension"
            record["relative_path"] = "PlugIns/Extension.appex/Extension"
            (extension_case / "decryption.json").write_text(json.dumps(record))
            manifest = assemble_analysis_ipa(snapshot, [main_case, extension_case], root / "out")
            result = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
            self.assertTrue(result["all_macho_headers_decrypted"])
            self.assertEqual(len(result["recovered_binaries"]), 2)
            with ZipFile(root / "out" / "analysis-snapshot.ipa") as archive:
                self.assertEqual(archive.read("Payload/Example.app/Example"), recovered)
                self.assertEqual(archive.read("Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Extension.appex/Extension"), recovered)

    def test_replaces_only_main_and_reports_remaining_encrypted_extension(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            snapshot, case, recovered = fixture(root)
            manifest = assemble_main_ipa(snapshot, case, root / "out")
            result = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
            self.assertFalse(result["all_macho_headers_decrypted"])
            self.assertIn("still_encrypted:Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Extension.appex/Extension",
                          result["remaining_failures"])
            with ZipFile(root / "out" / "analysis-snapshot.ipa") as archive:
                self.assertEqual(archive.read("Payload/Example.app/Example"), recovered)

    def test_rejects_unexpected_patch_outside_encrypted_range(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            snapshot, case, _ = fixture(root)
            path = case / "decrypted-main.bin"
            bad = bytearray(path.read_bytes())
            bad[60] = 7
            path.write_bytes(bad)
            record_path = case / "decryption.json"
            record = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
            record["decrypted_file_sha256"] = digest(bad)
            record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "outside cryptid and encrypted range"):
                assemble_main_ipa(snapshot, case, root / "out")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_branch_map.py`:

```py
import unittest
import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.branch_map import summarize_mappings
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class BranchMapTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_probe_coverage_does_not_create_false_conflicts(self):
        rows = [
            {"status": "correlated", "raw_argument": 8, "label": "add",
             "instrumented_offsets": ["0x1136c", "0xeb5c"],
             "branch_hits": {"0x1136c": 1}},
            {"status": "correlated", "raw_argument": 8, "label": "add",
             "instrumented_offsets": ["0x14840", "0x12cac"], "branch_hits": {}},
            {"status": "correlated", "raw_argument": 1, "label": "clear",
             "instrumented_offsets": ["0x14840", "0x12cac"],
             "branch_hits": {"0x14840": 1, "0x12cac": 1}},
            {"status": "hook_disagreement", "raw_argument": None, "label": "bad",
             "instrumented_offsets": ["0x1136c"], "branch_hits": {"0x1136c": 1}},
        ]
        result = summarize_mappings(rows)
        self.assertEqual([(item["raw_argument"], item["status"],
                           item["candidate_branch_offset"]) for item in result],
                         [(1, "multiple_branches", None),
                          (8, "single_observed_branch", "0x1136c")])

    def test_missing_hit_in_a_probe_is_not_a_single_branch(self):
        rows = [{"status": "correlated", "raw_argument": 8, "label": "add",
                 "instrumented_offsets": ["0x1136c"], "branch_hits": {"0x1136c": 1}},
                {"status": "correlated", "raw_argument": 8, "label": "add",
                 "instrumented_offsets": ["0x1136c"], "branch_hits": {}}]
        self.assertEqual(summarize_mappings(rows)[0]["status"],
                         "inconsistent_or_partial")

    def test_map_verification_detects_changed_source_case(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            source = root / "source"
            source.mkdir()
            (source / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "ui_flow_capture", "status": "complete", "evidence": []}))
            binary = root / "App"
            binary.write_bytes(b"app")
            output = root / "map"
            output.mkdir()
            mapped = {"binary_path": str(binary), "binary_sha256": sha256_file(binary),
                      "sources": [{"path": str(source),
                                   "manifest_sha256": sha256_file(source / "manifest.json")}]}
            (output / "branch-map.json").write_text(json.dumps(mapped))
            (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "branch_observation_map", "evidence": [
                    {"path": "branch-map.json",
                     "sha256": sha256_file(output / "branch-map.json")}] }))
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
            (source / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "ui_flow_capture", "status": "failed", "evidence": []}))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(output))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_candidates.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.candidates import build_candidates
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


class CandidatesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def _minimal_macho():
        data = bytearray(104)
        data[:4] = b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe"
        struct.pack_into("<II", data, 16, 1, 72)
        struct.pack_into("<II", data, 32, 0x19, 72)
        struct.pack_into("<QQQQ", data, 56, 0x100000000, 0x1000, 0, len(data))
        return bytes(data)

    def test_exact_binary_and_completed_experiment_yield_only_observed_instance_method(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            binary = root / "App.app" / "App"
            binary.parent.mkdir()
            binary.write_bytes(self._minimal_macho())
            digest = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            index = root / "objc-index.json"
            index.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1, "binary_sha256": digest,
                                         "image_base": "0x100000000",
                                         "classes": [{"name": "View", "instance_methods": [
                                             {"selector": "tap:", "imp": "0x100001000"}],
                                             "class_methods": [{"selector": "shared", "imp": "0x100002000"}]}]}))
            experiment = root / "experiment"
            experiment.mkdir()
            before, after = b"before", b"after"
            (experiment / "before.jpg").write_bytes(before)
            (experiment / "after.jpg").write_bytes(after)
            udid = "00008020-1111111111111111"
            experiment_data = {
                "status": "complete", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
                "frontmost_before": "com.example.app", "frontmost_after": "com.example.app",
                "requested_methods": ["View::tap:", "View::shared"],
                "methods": [{"class": "View", "selector": "tap:", "status": "hooked", "imp": "0x1234",
                             "imp_stripped": "0x100131000", "module_base": "0x100130000",
                             "module_offset": "0x1000", "module_path": "/Applications/App.app/App"},
                            {"class": "View", "selector": "shared", "status": "hooked", "imp": "0x5678"}],
                "call_counts": [1, 1],
                "screenshot_before_sha256": hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),
                "screenshot_after_sha256": hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest(),
            }
            (experiment / "experiment.json").write_text(json.dumps(experiment_data))
            result, ok = build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                          [experiment], root / "output")
            self.assertTrue(ok)
            summary = json.loads(result.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(summary["candidates"][0]["static_address"], "0x100001000")
            self.assertEqual(summary["candidates"][0]["observations"][0]["binding"]["status"], "offset_match")
            self.assertEqual(len(summary["candidates"]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(summary["unresolved"][0]["selector"], "shared")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root / "output"))

            experiment_data["methods"][0]["module_offset"] = "0x2000"
            (experiment / "experiment.json").write_text(json.dumps(experiment_data))
            mismatched, has_candidates = build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                                          [experiment], root / "mismatch")
            self.assertFalse(has_candidates)
            rejected = json.loads(mismatched.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(rejected["unresolved"][0]["binding"]["status"], "mismatch")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root / "mismatch"))

            conflict_exp = root / "conflict-experiment"
            shutil.copytree(experiment, conflict_exp)
            experiment_data["methods"][0]["module_offset"] = "0x1000"
            (experiment / "experiment.json").write_text(json.dumps(experiment_data))
            conflict_path, conflict_ok = build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary,
                                                          index, [experiment, conflict_exp],
                                                          root / "conflicting")
            self.assertFalse(conflict_ok)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(conflict_path.read_text())["candidates"], [])

            # A framework can swizzle the live IMP. A separately observed app
            # entry restores the static link while retaining the mismatch.
            experiment_data["methods"][0]["module_path"] = "/System/Library/AccessibilityBundles/App.axbundle/App"
            experiment_data["methods"][0]["module_offset"] = "0x5300"
            experiment_data["methods"][0]["module_base"] = "0x100130000"
            experiment_data["methods"][0]["imp_stripped"] = "0x100135300"
            experiment_data["static_binary_sha256"] = digest
            experiment_data["static_requested_offsets"] = ["0x1000", "0x2000"]
            experiment_data["static_call_counts"] = [1, 0]
            experiment_data["static_entries"] = [
                {"index": 0, "class": "View", "selector": "tap:", "status": "hooked",
                 "address": "0x100131000", "module_base": "0x100130000",
                 "module_offset": "0x1000", "module_path": "/Applications/App.app/App"},
                {"index": 1, "class": "View", "selector": "shared", "status": "hooked",
                 "address": "0x100132000", "module_base": "0x100130000",
                 "module_offset": "0x2000", "module_path": "/Applications/App.app/App"},
            ]
            (experiment / "experiment.json").write_text(json.dumps(experiment_data))
            direct, direct_ok = build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                                 [experiment], root / "direct")
            self.assertTrue(direct_ok)
            observation = json.loads(direct.read_text())["candidates"][0]["observations"][0]
            self.assertEqual(observation["binding"]["status"], "mismatch")
            self.assertEqual(observation["static_entry"]["status"], "direct_static_entry")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root / "direct"))

            experiment_data["static_entries"][0]["module_offset"] = "0x1004"
            (experiment / "experiment.json").write_text(json.dumps(experiment_data))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "static entry does not match"):
                build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                 [experiment], root / "invalid-direct")

    def test_binary_hash_mismatch_rejected_before_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            binary = root / "App"
            binary.write_bytes(b"different")
            index = root / "objc-index.json"
            index.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1, "binary_sha256": "0" * 64,
                                         "classes": []}))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                build_candidates("device", "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                 [root / "nonexistent"], root / "output")
            self.assertFalse((root / "output").exists())

    def test_traced_flow_yields_step_attributed_static_candidate(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            binary = root / "App.app" / "App"
            binary.parent.mkdir()
            binary.write_bytes(self._minimal_macho())
            digest = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            index = root / "objc-index.json"
            index.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1, "binary_sha256": digest,
                "image_base": "0x100000000", "classes": [{"name": "View",
                "instance_methods": [{"selector": "tap:", "imp": "0x100001000"}]}]}))
            flow = root / "flow"
            (flow / "playbook").mkdir(parents=True)
            (flow / "view-tree").mkdir()
            (flow / "trace").mkdir()
            (flow / "manifest.json").write_text("{}")
            (flow / "trace/trace.json").write_text("{}")
            udid = "device"
            trace = {"methods": [{"class": "View", "selector": "tap:",
                                   "status": "hooked", "imp": "0xdead",
                                   "imp_stripped": "0x100135300", "module_base": "0x100130000",
                                   "module_offset": "0x5300",
                                   "module_path": "/System/Library/AccessibilityBundles/App.axbundle/App"}],
                     "static_binary_sha256": digest,
                     "static_requested_offsets": ["0x1000"],
                     "static_entries": [{"index": 0, "class": "View", "selector": "tap:",
                                         "status": "hooked", "address": "0x100131000",
                                         "module_base": "0x100130000", "module_offset": "0x1000",
                                         "module_path": "/Applications/App.app/App"}],
                     "steps": [{"index": 2, "action": "tap", "call_counts": [1],
                                "static_call_counts": [1]},
                               {"index": 3, "action": "tap_label", "call_counts": [1],
                                "static_call_counts": [1]}]}
            validated = {"trace": trace,
                         "files": ["manifest.json", "trace/trace.json"]}
            with patch("copyapp.candidates._validate_flow_capture", return_value=validated) as check:
                path, ok = build_candidates(udid, "com.example.app", binary, index,
                                            [flow], root / "output")
            check.assert_called_once_with(flow, "com.example.app",
                                          hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
                                          {digest})
            self.assertTrue(ok)
            result = json.loads(path.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(result["experiment_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(result["observation_count"], 2)
            observations = result["candidates"][0]["observations"]
            self.assertEqual([item["step_index"] for item in observations], [2, 3])
            self.assertTrue(all(item["static_entry"]["calls"] == 1 for item in observations))
            self.assertEqual(observations[0]["binding"]["status"], "mismatch")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root / "output"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_compare_playbooks.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.compare_playbooks import _color_match_check, _load_run, _pulse_check, compare_playbooks
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class ComparePlaybooksTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.original = self._run("original", "com.example.original", (10, 20, 30))
        self.rebuilt = self._run("rebuilt", "dev.example.rebuilt", (20, 30, 40))

    def _run(self, name, bundle, color):
        root = self.root / name
        root.mkdir()
        plan = {"schema_version": 1, "scenario_id": "bearing-lock",
                "bundle_id": bundle, "steps": [
                    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True, "ready_contains": "heading"},
                    {"action": "tap", "x": 20, "y": 30},
                    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True, "ready_contains": "heading"}]}
        (root / "playbook.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        evidence = [{"path": "playbook.json", "sha256": sha256_file(root / "playbook.json")}]
        steps = []
        for index, action in enumerate(("screenshot", "tap", "screenshot"), 1):
            item = {"index": index, "action": action, "frontmost": bundle,
                    "duration_ms": 30}
            if action == "screenshot":
                path = root / f"step-{index:02d}-screenshot.jpg"
                Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), color).save(path)
                item.update({"evidence_path": path.name, "sha256": sha256_file(path)})
                item.update({"stability": {"stable": True},
                             "ready_contains": "heading", "ready_found": True})
                evidence.append({"path": path.name, "sha256": item["sha256"]})
            steps.append(item)
        manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "scenario_id": "bearing-lock",
                    "bundle_id": bundle, "status": "complete", "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
                    "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device01",
                    "screen": {"width": 40, "height": 60, "coordinate_space": "points"},
                    "steps": steps, "evidence": evidence}
        (root / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        return root

    def _add_exact_observation(self, root, label):
        plan_path = root / "playbook.json"
        plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
        plan["steps"].append({"action": "observe", "exact_labels": [label]})
        plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        observation = root / "step-04-observe.json"
        observation.write_text(json.dumps({"elements": [{"text": label}]}))
        manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["steps"].append({"index": 4, "action": "observe",
            "frontmost": manifest["bundle_id"], "observation_source": "accessibility",
            "exact_label_source": "accessibility", "missing_exact_labels": [],
            "evidence_path": observation.name})
        manifest["evidence"][0]["sha256"] = sha256_file(plan_path)
        manifest["evidence"].append({"path": observation.name,
                                      "sha256": sha256_file(observation)})
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))

    def test_rejects_asymmetric_exact_observation_labels(self):
        self._add_exact_observation(self.original, "Stop")
        self._add_exact_observation(self.rebuilt, "Start")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "observation conditions differ"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_rechecks_exact_labels_against_saved_accessibility_evidence(self):
        self._add_exact_observation(self.original, "Stop")
        self._add_exact_observation(self.rebuilt, "Stop")
        observation = self.rebuilt / "step-04-observe.json"
        observation.write_text(json.dumps({"elements": [{"text": "Stopwatch"}]}))
        manifest_path = self.rebuilt / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["evidence"][-1]["sha256"] = sha256_file(observation)
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "exact observation labels do not match evidence"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_creates_verifiable_visual_and_behavior_record(self):
        output = self.root / "comparison"
        report = compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, output)
        self.assertIn("平均 RGB 绝对差", report.read_text())
        self.assertTrue((output / "comparison/step-01-side_by_side.png").is_file())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_rejects_different_device(self):
        path = self.rebuilt / "manifest.json"
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        data["device_id_sha256_prefix"] = "other"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "same scenario, device and backend"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_rejects_tampered_screenshot(self):
        (self.rebuilt / "step-03-screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(b"tampered")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SHA-256"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_rejects_completed_run_without_screenshot_readiness(self):
        path = self.rebuilt / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
        manifest["steps"][2]["ready_found"] = False
        path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "readiness was not verified"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_screenshot_ocr_readiness_is_bound_to_saved_image(self):
        root = self.original
        image = root / "step-01-screenshot.jpg"
        ocr_path = root / "step-01-ready-ocr.json"
        source_hash = sha256_file(image)
        ocr = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "saved_screenshot_ocr",
               "source_sha256": source_hash, "source_width": 40, "source_height": 60,
               "roi": None, "ocr_input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               "result": {"engine": "macos-vision", "texts": [{"text": "heading"}]}}
        ocr_path.write_text(json.dumps(ocr))
        manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["steps"][0].update({"ready_source": "screenshot_ocr",
                                      "ready_ocr_path": ocr_path.name,
                                      "ready_ocr_sha256": sha256_file(ocr_path)})
        manifest["evidence"].append({"path": ocr_path.name,
                                     "sha256": sha256_file(ocr_path)})
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        _load_run(root)
        ocr["source_sha256"] = "0" * 64
        ocr_path.write_text(json.dumps(ocr))
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["steps"][0]["ready_ocr_sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
        manifest["evidence"][-1]["sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "OCR source mismatch"):
            _load_run(root)

    def test_rejects_different_tap_coordinate(self):
        path = self.rebuilt / "playbook.json"
        plan = json.loads(path.read_text())
        plan["steps"][1]["x"] = 21
        path.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        manifest_path = self.rebuilt / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["evidence"][0]["sha256"] = sha256_file(path)
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "tap coordinates differ"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_rejects_different_label_regions(self):
        for root, region in ((self.original, [0, 30, 20, 50]),
                             (self.rebuilt, [20, 30, 40, 50])):
            plan_path = root / "playbook.json"
            manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
            plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
            plan["steps"][1] = {"action": "tap_label", "label": "0",
                                "region_points": region}
            manifest["steps"][1]["action"] = "tap_label"
            manifest["steps"][1]["result"] = {
                "match": {"x": (region[0] + region[2]) / 2,
                          "y": (region[1] + region[3]) / 2}}
            plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
            manifest["evidence"][0]["sha256"] = sha256_file(plan_path)
            manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "tap labels or regions differ"):
            compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt, self.root / "comparison")

    def test_color_pulse_requires_visible_rise_and_return(self):
        images = {}
        for step, color in ((1, (0, 0, 0)), (3, (200, 0, 0)),
                            (5, (0, 0, 0))):
            path = self.root / f"pulse-{step}.png"
            Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), color).save(path)
            images[step] = path
        check = {"id": "red-marker", "kind": "color_pulse", "channel": "red",
                 "roi": [0, 0, 20, 20], "steps": [1, 3, 5],
                 "minimum_channel": 25, "dominance_ratio": 1.5,
                 "min_rise": 15, "max_return_delta": 10}
        self.assertTrue(_pulse_check(check, images)["passed"])
        Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (0, 0, 0)).save(images[3])
        self.assertFalse(_pulse_check(check, images)["passed"])

    def test_color_match_accepts_absent_marker_and_rejects_one_sided_marker(self):
        original = self.root / "marker-original.png"
        rebuilt = self.root / "marker-rebuilt.png"
        Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (0, 0, 0)).save(original)
        Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (0, 0, 0)).save(rebuilt)
        check = {"id": "red-marker", "kind": "color_match", "channel": "red",
                 "roi": [0, 0, 20, 30], "steps": [1], "minimum_channel": 25,
                 "dominance_ratio": 1.5, "max_count_delta": 10}
        self.assertTrue(_color_match_check(check, {1: original}, {1: rebuilt})["original"]["passed"])
        Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (255, 0, 0)).save(rebuilt)
        self.assertFalse(_color_match_check(check, {1: original}, {1: rebuilt})["original"]["passed"])

    def test_accepts_verified_same_app_handoff(self):
        for root in (self.original, self.rebuilt):
            plan_path = root / "playbook.json"
            manifest_path = root / "manifest.json"
            plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
            plan["steps"].append({"action": "expect_foreground",
                                  "bundle_id": "com.apple.Maps"})
            manifest["steps"].append({"index": 4, "action": "expect_foreground",
                                      "frontmost": "com.apple.Maps",
                                      "expected_frontmost": "com.apple.Maps"})
            plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
            manifest["evidence"][0]["sha256"] = sha256_file(plan_path)
            manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        report = compare_playbooks(self.original, self.rebuilt,
                                   self.root / "comparison")
        self.assertIn("com.apple.Maps", report.read_text())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_copy_workflow.py`:

```py
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.copy_workflow import copy_app, validate_copy_workflow
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value) + '\n')


class CopyWorkflowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.output = self.root / 'cases/copy'
        self.project = self.root / 'rebuild/Clone'
        self.script = self.root / 'playbook.json'
        write(self.script, {'bundle_id': 'com.example.original'})
        self.executable = self.root / 'fake-codex'
        self.executable.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
        self.executable.chmod(0o755)
        self.calls = []
        self.fail_analysis = False
        self.bad_report = False

    async def survey(self, *args):
        return 0

    async def prepare(self, udid, bundle, scripts, output, survey, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append('prepare')
        write(output / 'manifest.json', {
            'status': 'needs_semantic_review', 'bundle_id': bundle,
            'device_id_sha256_prefix': hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
            'scripts': [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha256_file(path)}
                        for path in scripts],
            'rebuilt_bundle_id': kwargs['rebuilt_bundle_id'],
            'provider': kwargs['provider'], 'ui_backend': kwargs['ui_backend'],
            'investigation_backend': kwargs['backend'], 'decrypt': kwargs['decrypt'],
            'network_requested': kwargs['network'],
            'decrypt_helper': str(kwargs['decrypt_helper'].resolve()),
            'ssh_port': kwargs['ssh_port'], 'ssh_user': kwargs['ssh_user'],
            'ssh_identity': str(kwargs['ssh_identity'].resolve()),
            'ssh_known_hosts': str(kwargs['ssh_known_hosts'].resolve()),
            'ghidra_dir': None, 'java_home': None, 'disabled_analyzer': None,
            'timeout': kwargs['timeout'],
        })
        write(output / 'preparation/draft/task.json', {'kind': 'agent_semantic_review_task'})
        return output / 'manifest.json', True

    def agent(self, task, output, *args, **kwargs):
        if kwargs.get('verify_analysis'):
            self.calls.append('analysis-agent')
            output.mkdir(parents=True)
            write(output / 'run.json', {'status': 'agent_exited_unverified',
                                        'provider': args[0],
                                        'task_case': str(task)})
            write(output / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'agent_execution'})
            if self.fail_analysis:
                return output / 'run.json', False
            report = output / 'reviewed-report'
            write(report / 'report-index.json', {'kind': 'report'})
            write(report / 'feature-spec.json', {
                'target_bundle_id': 'com.example.original',
                'rebuilt_bundle_id': ('com.example.wrong' if self.bad_report
                                      else 'com.example.clone'),
                'flows': [{'id': 'one'}],
            })
            delivery = output / 'analysis-delivery'
            write(delivery / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'analysis_delivery'})
            write(output / 'analysis-verification.json', {
                'status': 'source_linked_report_ready_for_review',
                'report_case': str(report), 'analysis_delivery_case': str(delivery),
                'analysis_delivery_manifest_sha256': sha256_file(delivery / 'manifest.json'),
            })
            return output / 'run.json', True
        self.calls.append('rebuild-agent')
        output.mkdir(parents=True)
        write(output / 'run.json', {'status': 'agent_exited_unverified',
                                    'provider': args[0],
                                    'task_case': str(task)})
        write(output / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'agent_execution'})
        delivery = output / 'agent-delivery'
        write(delivery / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'agent_delivery'})
        write(delivery / 'delivery.json', {
            'asserted_flow_count': 1, 'visual_unreviewed_flow_count': 0,
            'visual_major_difference_flow_count': 0,
            'flow_results': [{'script_assertions_status': 'passed'}],
        })
        write(output / 'rebuild-verification.json', {
            'status': 'selected_flows_verified',
            'agent_delivery_case': str(delivery),
            'agent_delivery_manifest_sha256': sha256_file(delivery / 'manifest.json'),
            'selected_flow_count': 1, 'asserted_flow_count': 1,
        })
        return output / 'run.json', True

    def rebuild(self, report, output, backend, flow_ids, udid, project, resume=False):
        self.calls.append('rebuild-preparation')
        write(output / 'manifest.json', {
            'status': 'ready_for_agent', 'report': str(report),
            'device_udid': udid, 'project_dir': str(project),
            'ui_backend': backend, 'selected_flow_ids': ['one'],
        })
        write(output / 'task/task.json', {'kind': 'agent_implementation_task',
                                          'flows': [{'id': 'one'}]})
        return output / 'manifest.json', True

    def run_workflow(self, *, resume=False, discovery_case=None):
        with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.prepare_app', side_effect=self.prepare), \
             patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.run_agent_task', side_effect=self.agent), \
             patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.prepare_rebuild', side_effect=self.rebuild), \
             patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.verify_case', return_value=True):
            return asyncio.run(copy_app(
                '00008020-1111111111111111', 'com.example.original',
                [self.script], self.project, 'com.example.clone', self.output,
                self.survey, workspace=self.root, agent_executable=self.executable,
                discovery_case=discovery_case,
                resume=resume))

    def test_full_handoff_and_resume_reuse_verified_stages(self):
        path, complete = self.run_workflow()
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text())['status'], 'complete')
        self.assertEqual(self.calls, ['prepare', 'analysis-agent',
                                      'rebuild-preparation', 'rebuild-agent'])
        with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.verify_case', return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(validate_copy_workflow(self.output, json.loads(path.read_text())))
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.output))
        path, complete = self.run_workflow(resume=True)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 4)

    def test_failed_agent_is_retained_and_not_replayed_on_resume(self):
        self.fail_analysis = True
        path, complete = self.run_workflow()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text())['status'], 'analysis_agent_needs_review')
        self.fail_analysis = False
        path, complete = self.run_workflow(resume=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.calls, ['prepare', 'analysis-agent'])

    def test_mismatched_reviewed_report_stops_before_rebuild(self):
        self.bad_report = True
        path, complete = self.run_workflow()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'failed')
        self.assertIn('rebuilt bundle differs', record['error']['message'])
        self.assertNotIn('rebuild-preparation', self.calls)

    def test_resume_rejects_changed_playbook_without_device_work(self):
        self.run_workflow()
        write(self.script, {'bundle_id': 'com.example.original', 'changed': True})
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'settings differ'):
            self.run_workflow(resume=True)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 4)

    def test_saved_success_is_rejected_if_visual_or_behavior_gap_appears(self):
        path, complete = self.run_workflow()
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        delivery = self.output / 'rebuild-agent/agent-delivery/delivery.json'
        data = json.loads(delivery.read_text())
        data['visual_major_difference_flow_count'] = 1
        write(delivery, data)
        with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.verify_case', return_value=True):
            self.assertFalse(validate_copy_workflow(self.output,
                                                    json.loads(path.read_text())))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(self.output))
        path, complete = self.run_workflow(resume=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 4)

    def test_discovery_source_is_pinned_across_the_full_workflow(self):
        discovery = self.root / 'cases/discovery'
        write(discovery / 'manifest.json', {'status': 'complete'})
        with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.accepted_playbooks',
                   return_value=[self.script.resolve()]):
            path, complete = self.run_workflow(discovery_case=discovery)
            self.assertTrue(complete)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text())['discovery_case'], str(discovery))
            write(discovery / 'manifest.json', {'status': 'changed'})
            with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.verify_case', return_value=True):
                self.assertFalse(validate_copy_workflow(
                    self.output, json.loads(path.read_text())))

    def test_auto_discovery_precedes_preparation_and_pins_agent_evidence(self):
        scripts = [self.script]

        discoveries = []

        def discover(udid, bundle, backend, output, **kwargs):
            discoveries.append(kwargs['resume'])
            if not kwargs['resume']:

                    'status': 'complete', 'device_udid': udid,

                                for path in scripts],

            return output / 'manifest.json', True

        def run(*, resume=False):
            with patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.run_discovery_agent', side_effect=discover), \
                 patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.accepted_playbooks', return_value=scripts), \

                 patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.run_agent_task', side_effect=self.agent), \
                 patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.prepare_rebuild', side_effect=self.rebuild), \
                 patch('copyapp.copy_workflow.verify_case', return_value=True):
                return asyncio.run(copy_app(
                    '00008020-1111111111111111', 'com.example.original', [],

                    workspace=self.root, agent_executable=self.executable,
                    auto_discover=True, resume=resume))

        path, complete = run()

        path, complete = run(resume=True)

        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 4)
        write(self.output / 'discovery-agent/discovery/manifest.json',

    def test_current_agent_handoffs_resume_without_nested_cli(self):
```

`tests/test_coverage.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.coverage import create_coverage_delivery, create_coverage_plan
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


class CoverageTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.report = self.root / "report"
        write(self.report / "report-index.json", {"target_bundle_id": "com.example.original"})
        write(self.report / "feature-spec.json", {
            "schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "rebuilt_bundle_id": "com.example.clone",
            "flows": [{"id": "create"}, {"id": "search"}]})
        self.plans = []
        for name in ("create", "search"):
            plan = self.root / f"plan-{name}"
            write(plan / "manifest.json", {"kind": "rebuild_plan"})
            write(plan / "rebuild-plan.json", {
                "kind": "rebuild_plan", "status": "complete",
                "source_report_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.report / "report-index.json"),
                "feature_spec_sha256": sha256_file(self.report / "feature-spec.json"),
                "flows": [{"flow_id": name}]})
            self.plans.append(plan)
        self.inventory = self.root / "inventory.json"
        write(self.inventory, {
            "schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
            "rebuilt_bundle_id": "com.example.clone",
            "rationale": "Selected local tasks first", "unknowns": ["server behavior"],
            "capabilities": [
                {"id": "create", "name": "Create", "acceptance": "Create an item",
                 "basis": "observed original flow", "weight": 3,
                 "scope": "selected", "flow_ids": ["create"]},
                {"id": "search", "name": "Search", "acceptance": "Find an item",
                 "basis": "observed original flow", "weight": 2,
                 "scope": "selected", "flow_ids": ["search"]},
                {"id": "account", "name": "Account", "acceptance": "Sync an item",
                 "basis": "visible account entry; not entered", "weight": 5,
                 "scope": "blocked", "flow_ids": [], "reason": "No test account"}]})
        self.review = self.root / "review.json"
        write(self.review, {"schema_version": 1, "capabilities": [
            {"id": "create", "result": "verified", "notes": "Original and clone checks pass"},
            {"id": "search", "result": "partial", "notes": "Search result differs"},
            {"id": "account", "result": "untested", "notes": "Account unavailable"}]})
        self.deliveries = []
        for name, source in zip(("create", "search"), self.plans):
            task = self.root / f"task-{name}"
            write(task / "task.json", {
                "report_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.report / "report-index.json"),
                "rebuild_plan_sha256": sha256_file(source / "rebuild-plan.json")})
            delivery = self.root / f"delivery-{name}"
            write(delivery / "manifest.json", {"kind": "agent_delivery"})
            write(delivery / "delivery.json", {
                "kind": "agent_delivery", "task_case": str(task),
                "target_bundle_id": "com.example.original",
                "rebuilt_bundle_id": "com.example.clone",
                "flow_results": [{"id": name, "script_assertions_status": "passed",
                                  "final_view_status": "not_configured",
                                  "visual_review_status": "minor_difference"}]})
            self.deliveries.append(delivery)

    def test_target_revision_and_conservative_delivery_math(self):
        with patch("copyapp.coverage._verified"):
            first = self.root / "target-1"
            create_coverage_plan(self.report, self.plans, self.inventory, first)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(first))
            target = json.loads((first / "coverage-plan.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(target["target_percent"], 50.0)
            self.assertEqual(target["revision"], 1)
            final = self.root / "final"
            create_coverage_delivery(first, self.deliveries, self.review, final)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(final))
            result = json.loads((final / "coverage-delivery.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(result["milestone_completion_percent"], 60.0)
            self.assertEqual(result["verified_known_percent"], 30.0)
            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "target_not_met")
            source_plan = self.plans[0] / "manifest.json"
            write(source_plan, {"kind": "rebuild_plan", "changed": True})
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(first))
            write(source_plan, {"kind": "rebuild_plan"})
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(first))
            revision = json.loads(self.inventory.read_text())
            revision["revision_reason"] = "New priority after review"
            write(self.inventory, revision)
            second = self.root / "target-2"
            create_coverage_plan(self.report, self.plans, self.inventory, second, first)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(second))
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((second / "coverage-plan.json").read_text())["revision"], 2)
            revised_final = self.root / "revised-final"
            create_coverage_delivery(second, self.deliveries, self.review, revised_final)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(revised_final))
            revised = json.loads((revised_final / "coverage-delivery.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(revised["previous_target_percent"], 50.0)
            self.assertEqual(revised["revision_reason"], "New priority after review")

    def test_cannot_promote_unchecked_flow_or_drop_known_capability(self):
        with patch("copyapp.coverage._verified"):
            target = self.root / "target"
            create_coverage_plan(self.report, self.plans, self.inventory, target)
            inventory = json.loads(self.inventory.read_text())
            inventory["revision_reason"] = "Narrower target"
            inventory["capabilities"].pop()
            write(self.inventory, inventory)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "remove or weaken"):
                create_coverage_plan(self.report, self.plans, self.inventory,
                                     self.root / "bad-revision", target)
            inventory["capabilities"].append({
                "id": "account", "name": "Account", "acceptance": "Sync an item",
                "basis": "visible account entry; not entered", "weight": 1,
                "scope": "blocked", "flow_ids": [], "reason": "No test account"})
            write(self.inventory, inventory)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "remove or weaken"):
                create_coverage_plan(self.report, self.plans, self.inventory,
                                     self.root / "bad-weight", target)
            review = json.loads(self.review.read_text())
            review["capabilities"][1]["result"] = "verified"
            write(self.review, review)
            flow = self.deliveries[1] / "delivery.json"
            data = json.loads(flow.read_text())
            data["flow_results"][0]["visual_review_status"] = "major_difference"
            write(flow, data)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "complete behavior and visual evidence"):
                create_coverage_delivery(target, self.deliveries, self.review,
                                         self.root / "false-success")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
