```py
import hashlib
import json
import plistlib
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZipInfo

from copyapp.decrypt_package import (PINNED_HELPER_SHA256, _canonicalize_analysis_ipa,
                                     _verify_changed_binaries, _write_case_manifest,
                                     decrypt_package)
from copyapp.decrypt_verify import inspect_decrypted_ipa, write_decryption_check
from copyapp.ipa import analyze_ipa, write_ipa_report
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


def binary(encrypted=True):
    value = bytearray(80)
    struct.pack_into("<IiiIIIII", value, 0, 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C, 0, 2,
                     1, 24, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<IIIIII", value, 32, 0x2C, 24, 64, 8, int(encrypted), 0)
    value[64:72] = b"ENCRYPT!" if encrypted else b"CODECODE"
    return bytes(value)


class PackageByteAuditTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.snapshot = self.root / "source.ipa"
        self.recovered = self.root / "recovered.ipa"
        self.main = "Payload/Example.app/Example"
        self.extension = "Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Share.appex/Share"
        plist = plistlib.dumps({"CFBundleIdentifier": "com.example.test",
                                "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
                                "CFBundleVersion": "1",
                                "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0"})
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot, "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist", plist)
            archive.writestr(self.main, binary())
            archive.writestr(self.extension, binary())
        self.index = analyze_ipa(self.snapshot)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def write_result(self, corrupt=False):
        extension = bytearray(binary(False))
        if corrupt:
            extension[60] = 7
        with ZipFile(self.recovered, "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr(self.main, binary(False))
            archive.writestr(self.extension, extension)

    def test_accepts_main_and_extension_with_only_encryption_changes(self):
        self.write_result()
        rows = _verify_changed_binaries(self.snapshot, self.recovered, self.index)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(row["only_cryptid_and_encrypted_region_changed"] for row in rows))

    def test_rejects_modified_code_outside_encrypted_range(self):
        self.write_result(corrupt=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "outside encrypted region"):
            _verify_changed_binaries(self.snapshot, self.recovered, self.index)

    def _device_archive(self, destination, stamp, plist_override=None, omitted=()):
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot) as source, ZipFile(destination, "w") as archive:
            for info in source.infolist():
                if info.filename in omitted:
                    continue
                data = source.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename in (self.main, self.extension):
                    data = binary(False)
                if info.filename.endswith("Info.plist") and plist_override is not None:
                    data = plist_override
                device_info = ZipInfo(info.filename, stamp)
                device_info.compress_type = info.compress_type
                archive.writestr(device_info, data)

    def test_canonical_ipa_ignores_device_zip_timestamps(self):
        first = self.root / "device-1.ipa"
        second = self.root / "device-2.ipa"
        out1 = self.root / "canonical-1.ipa"
        out2 = self.root / "canonical-2.ipa"
        self._device_archive(first, (2026, 10, 15, 12, 0, 0))
        self._device_archive(second, (2026, 10, 15, 14, 0, 0))
        replaced = {self.main, self.extension}
        for recovered, output in ((first, out1), (second, out2)):
            rows = _verify_changed_binaries(self.snapshot, recovered, self.index)
            self.assertEqual({row["path"] for row in rows}, replaced)
            _canonicalize_analysis_ipa(self.snapshot, recovered, output, replaced)
        self.assertEqual(out1.read_bytes(), out2.read_bytes())
        with ZipFile(out1) as archive, ZipFile(self.snapshot) as source:
            self.assertEqual(archive.read(self.main), binary(False))
            self.assertEqual(archive.read(self.extension), binary(False))
            self.assertEqual(archive.read("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist"),
                             source.read("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist"))

    def test_canonical_ipa_rejects_nonbinary_mutation(self):
        self._device_archive(self.recovered, (2026, 10, 15, 14, 0, 0),
                             plist_override=b"changed")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "changed unencrypted member"):
            _canonicalize_analysis_ipa(self.snapshot, self.recovered,
                                       self.root / "canonical.ipa",
                                       {self.main, self.extension})

    def test_canonical_ipa_accepts_only_sc_info_omission(self):
        receipt = "Payload/Example.app/SC_Info/Example.sinf"
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot, "a") as source:
            source.writestr(receipt, b"receipt")
        self._device_archive(self.recovered, (2026, 10, 15, 14, 0, 0),
                             omitted={receipt})
        output = self.root / "canonical.ipa"
        _canonicalize_analysis_ipa(self.snapshot, self.recovered, output,
                                   {self.main, self.extension})
        with ZipFile(output) as archive:
            self.assertNotIn(receipt, archive.namelist())

        other = self.root / "missing-plist.ipa"
        self._device_archive(other, (2026, 10, 15, 14, 0, 0),
                             omitted={"Payload/Example.app/Info.plist"})
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "member list differs"):
            _canonicalize_analysis_ipa(self.snapshot, other,
                                       self.root / "invalid.ipa",
                                       {self.main, self.extension})

    def test_standalone_package_case_rechecks_source_and_changed_bytes(self):
        self._device_archive(self.recovered, (2026, 10, 15, 14, 0, 0))
        case = self.root / "case"
        case.mkdir()
        ipa = case / "analysis.ipa"
        changed = _verify_changed_binaries(self.snapshot, self.recovered, self.index)
        _canonicalize_analysis_ipa(self.snapshot, self.recovered, ipa,
                                   {item["path"] for item in changed})
        check = inspect_decrypted_ipa(ipa, "com.example.test")
        self.assertTrue(check["header_check_passed"])
        write_decryption_check(check, case / "check")
        write_ipa_report(analyze_ipa(ipa), case / "static")
        (case / "static/objc-status.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"status": "unsupported", "reason": "synthetic Mach-O"}))
        (case / "device-run").mkdir()
        device_id = "00000000-0000000000000000"
        (case / "device-run/result.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "device_id": device_id, "exit_code": 0,
            "command": ["helper", "-v", "decrypt", "com.example.test", "/app", "/out"],
        }))
        (case / "device-run/output.txt").write_text("fixture")
        record = {
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.example.test",
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(device_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
            "installed_version": "1.0", "installed_build": "1",
            "source_snapshot_sha256": hashlib.sha256(self.snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "analysis_ipa_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ipa.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "helper_sha256": PINNED_HELPER_SHA256,
            "all_macho_headers_decrypted": True,
            "checked_macho_count": check["checked_binaries"],
            "recovered_binaries": changed,
            "objc_class_count": None, "objc_method_count": None,
        }
        (case / "decryption.json").write_text(json.dumps(record))
        _write_case_manifest(case, self.snapshot, record)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
        record["recovered_binaries"][0]["changed_encrypted_bytes"] += 1
        (case / "decryption.json").write_text(json.dumps(record))
        _write_case_manifest(case, self.snapshot, record)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_standalone_already_decrypted_package_needs_no_changed_binary(self):
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot) as source:
            info_plist = source.read('Payload/Example.app/Info.plist')

        }))
        (case / 'device-run/output.txt').write_text('already decrypted')
        record = {
            'schema_version': 1, 'bundle_id': 'com.example.test',
            'device_id_sha256_prefix': hashlib.sha256(device_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
            'installed_version': '1.0', 'installed_build': '1',
            'source_snapshot_sha256': hashlib.sha256(self.snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'analysis_ipa_sha256': hashlib.sha256(ipa.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),

    def test_unencrypted_package_skips_device_helper_and_verifies(self):
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot) as source:
            plist = source.read('Payload/Example.app/Info.plist')
        with ZipFile(self.snapshot, 'w') as source:
            source.writestr('Payload/Example.app/Info.plist', plist)
            source.writestr(self.main, binary(False))
            source.writestr(self.extension, binary(False))
        udid = '00000000-0000000000000000'
        app = {'CFBundleShortVersionString': '1.0', 'CFBundleVersion': '1'}

        async def installed_main(*_):
            return '/private/var/containers/Bundle/Application/Example.app/Example', None, app

        with patch('copyapp.decrypt_package._installed_main', installed_main), \
                patch('copyapp.decrypt_package._ssh_argv', return_value=['ssh']), \
                patch('copyapp.decrypt_package.subprocess.run', return_value=
                      subprocess.CompletedProcess(['ssh'], 0, udid.encode(), b'')) as run:
            case = self.root / 'skipped-case'
            decrypt_package(udid, 'com.example.test', self.snapshot,
                            self.root / 'missing-helper', case, 22222,
                            self.root / 'identity', self.root / 'known-hosts')
        self.assertEqual(run.call_count, 1)
        record = json.loads((case / 'decryption.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record['recovery_strategy'], 'source_snapshot_unencrypted')
        self.assertEqual(record['recovered_binaries'], [])
        self.assertEqual((case / 'analysis.ipa').read_bytes(), self.snapshot.read_bytes())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
        record['recovered_binaries'] = [{'path': self.main}]
        (case / 'decryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(record))
        _write_case_manifest(case, self.snapshot, record)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))
```

`tests/test_decrypt_verify.py`:

```py
import plistlib
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile

from copyapp.decrypt_verify import inspect_decrypted_ipa


def candidate_ipa(path: Path, cryptid: int, embedded_cryptid=None):
    binary = bytearray(56)
    struct.pack_into("<IiiIIIII", binary, 0, 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C, 0, 2,
                     1, 24, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<IIIIII", binary, 32, 0x2C, 24, 0, 0, cryptid, 0)
    info = {"CFBundleIdentifier": "com.example.test", "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
            "CFBundleVersion": "1", "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0"}
    with ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist", plistlib.dumps(info))
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Example", binary)
        if embedded_cryptid is not None:
            nested = bytearray(binary)
            struct.pack_into("<I", nested, 48, embedded_cryptid)
            archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Frameworks/Utility.framework/RuntimeCore", nested)


class DecryptionCheckTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rejects_nonzero_cryptid(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "candidate.ipa"
            candidate_ipa(path, 1)
            result = inspect_decrypted_ipa(path, "com.example.test")
            self.assertFalse(result["header_check_passed"])
            self.assertIn("still_encrypted:Payload/Example.app/Example", result["failures"])

    def test_accepts_zero_cryptid_but_keeps_scope_narrow(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "candidate.ipa"
            candidate_ipa(path, 0)
            result = inspect_decrypted_ipa(path, "com.example.test")
            self.assertTrue(result["header_check_passed"])
            self.assertEqual(result["checked_binaries"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(result["sc_info_file_count"], 0)

    def test_discovers_embedded_binary_with_nonmatching_framework_name(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "candidate.ipa"
            candidate_ipa(path, 0, embedded_cryptid=1)
            result = inspect_decrypted_ipa(path, "com.example.test")
            self.assertEqual(result["checked_binaries"], 2)
            self.assertIn("still_encrypted:Payload/Example.app/Frameworks/Utility.framework/RuntimeCore",
                          result["failures"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_discover_check.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.discover_check import check_discovered_flows, inspect_playbook
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value) + '\n')


class DiscoveryCheckTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.output = self.root / 'discovery'
        self.scripts = []
        for n in range(3):
            path = self.root / f'flow-{n}.json'
            write(path, {'schema_version': 1, 'bundle_id': 'com.example.app',
                         'scenario_id': f'flow-{n}', 'fresh_launch': True,
                         'steps': [
                             {'action': 'observe', 'contains': ['Home']},
                             {'action': 'tap_label', 'label': f'Action {n}'},
                             {'action': 'screenshot', 'stable': True,
                              'ready_contains': f'Result {n}'}]})
            self.scripts.append(path)
        self.calls = []
        self.fail_first = False

    def replay(self, udid, backend, script, output, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(script.name)
        plan = json.loads(script.read_text())
        output.mkdir(parents=True)
        (output / 'playbook.json').write_bytes(script.read_bytes())
        write(output / 'step-01-observe.json', {'elements': [{'text': 'Home'}]})
        Image.new('RGB', (20, 30), '#303030').save(output / 'step-03-screenshot.jpg')
        evidence = [{'path': name, 'sha256': sha256_file(output / name)}
                    for name in ('playbook.json', 'step-01-observe.json',
                                 'step-03-screenshot.jpg')]
        complete = not self.fail_first or len(self.calls) > 1
        steps = [
            {'action': 'observe', 'frontmost': 'com.example.app',
             'evidence_path': 'step-01-observe.json'},
            {'action': 'tap_label', 'frontmost': 'com.example.app',
             'result': {'ok': True}},
            {'action': 'screenshot', 'frontmost': 'com.example.app',
             'evidence_path': 'step-03-screenshot.jpg',
             'sha256': sha256_file(output / 'step-03-screenshot.jpg'),
             'stability': {'stable': True}, 'ready_found': True}]
        write(output / 'manifest.json', {
            **({'execution_mode': kwargs['mode']} if kwargs.get('mode') else {}),
            'status': 'complete' if complete else 'failed',
            'bundle_id': 'com.example.app', 'ui_backend': backend,
            'device_id_sha256_prefix': hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
            'scenario_id': plan['scenario_id'], 'steps': steps,
            'evidence': evidence})
        return output / 'manifest.json', complete

    def run_check(self, resume=False):
        with patch('copyapp.discover_check.run_playbook', side_effect=self.replay):
            return check_discovered_flows(
                '00008020-1111111111111111', 'com.example.app',
                self.scripts, self.output, resume=resume)

    def test_accepts_distinct_device_replayed_flows_and_reuses_on_resume(self):
        manifest, complete = self.run_check()
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.output))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 3)
        manifest, complete = self.run_check(resume=True)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 3)

    def test_duplicate_actions_stop_before_phone(self):
        write(self.scripts[1], json.loads(self.scripts[0].read_text()) |
              {'scenario_id': 'unique-name'})
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'duplicate scenario or action'):
            self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])

    def test_unready_final_screenshot_is_rejected_before_phone(self):
        plan = json.loads(self.scripts[0].read_text())
        plan['steps'][-1].pop('ready_contains')
        write(self.scripts[0], plan)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ready final screenshot'):
            self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])

    def test_failed_tap_flow_is_not_replayed_on_resume(self):
        self.fail_first = True
        manifest, complete = self.run_check()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(manifest.read_text())['status'], 'needs_review')
        self.fail_first = False
        manifest, complete = self.run_check(resume=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)

    def test_saved_success_rejects_mutated_source_script(self):
        self.run_check()
        plan = json.loads(self.scripts[0].read_text())
        plan['steps'][1]['label'] = 'Changed'
        write(self.scripts[0], plan)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(self.output))

    def test_standard_mode_is_bound_to_replay_and_cannot_change_on_resume(self):
        with patch('copyapp.discover_check.run_playbook', side_effect=self.replay) as replay:
            _, complete = check_discovered_flows(
                '00008020-1111111111111111', 'com.example.app', self.scripts,
                self.output, backend='ictrl', mode='standard')
            self.assertTrue(complete)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.output))
            self.assertEqual(replay.call_args.kwargs, {'mode': 'standard'})
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'execution mode'):
                check_discovered_flows('00008020-1111111111111111', 'com.example.app',
                                       self.scripts, self.output, backend='ictrl', resume=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'iCTRL'):
```

`tests/test_discovery_agent.py`:

```py
import io
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.discovery_agent import run_discovery_agent, validate_discovery_agent


class DiscoveryAgentTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.workspace = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.output = self.workspace / 'cases/agent-discovery'
        self.executable = self.workspace / 'fake-codex'
        self.executable.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n')
        self.scripts = []
        for index in range(3):
            script = self.output / 'discovery/playbooks' / f'flow-{index}.json'
            self.scripts.append(script)

    def launch(self, *, exit_code=0):
        owner = self

        class Process:
            stdin = io.BytesIO()
            returncode = exit_code

            def wait(self, timeout=None):
                if exit_code == 0:
                    manifest = owner.output / 'discovery/manifest.json'
                    manifest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    manifest.write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'complete'}) + '\n')
                    for index, script in enumerate(owner.scripts):
                        script.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        script.write_text(json.dumps({'flow': index}) + '\n')
                return exit_code

            def poll(self):
                return exit_code

        with patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.subprocess.Popen', return_value=Process()), \
             patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.accepted_playbooks',
                   return_value=self.scripts), \
             patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.verify_case', return_value=True):
            return run_discovery_agent(
                'device-1', 'com.example.original', 'ios-mcp', self.output,
                workspace=self.workspace, executable=self.executable,
                timeout_seconds=30)

    def test_complete_case_pins_discovery_and_script_hashes(self):
        path, ready = self.launch()
        self.assertTrue(ready)
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'complete')
        self.assertEqual(len(record['scripts']), 3)
        with patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.accepted_playbooks',
                   return_value=self.scripts), \
             patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.verify_case', return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(validate_discovery_agent(self.output, record))
            self.scripts[0].write_text('{"flow": "changed"}\n')
            self.assertFalse(validate_discovery_agent(self.output, record))
            self.scripts[0].write_text('{"flow": 0}\n')
            (self.output / 'prompt.txt').write_text('changed prompt')
            self.assertFalse(validate_discovery_agent(self.output, record))

    def test_failed_run_is_not_replayed_on_resume(self):
        path, ready = self.launch(exit_code=1)
        self.assertFalse(ready)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text())['status'], 'needs_review')
        with patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.subprocess.Popen',
                   side_effect=AssertionError('must not replay')), \
             patch('copyapp.discovery_agent.verify_case', return_value=False):
            resumed_path, resumed = run_discovery_agent(
                'device-1', 'com.example.original', 'ios-mcp', self.output,
                workspace=self.workspace, executable=self.executable,
                timeout_seconds=30, resume=True)
        self.assertEqual(resumed_path, path)
        self.assertFalse(resumed)

    def test_zero_exit_without_device_discovery_is_rejected(self):
        self.executable.chmod(0o755)
        path, ready = run_discovery_agent(
            'device-1', 'com.example.original', 'ios-mcp', self.output,
            workspace=self.workspace, executable=self.executable,
            timeout_seconds=30)
        self.assertFalse(ready)
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record['exit_code'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'needs_review')
        self.assertIn('verified discovery missing', record['error'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_fidelity.py`:

```py
import copy
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.fidelity import (create_plan, create_check, evaluate, policy, review_template,
                             visual_context, verify_fidelity)
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value) + '\n')


class FidelityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.context = {'pairs': [{'id': 'r01.search.step-1', 'verdict': 'major_difference'}],
                        'core_behavior_passed': True, 'guard_issues': []}
        self.review = review_template(self.context)
        self.review['reviewer'] = 'test reviewer'
        self.review['dimensions']['layout'].update(score=85, notes='The main layout and navigation match the selected task.')
        self.review['dimensions']['details'].update(score=40, notes='Offline cards and font details remain visibly different.')
        self.review['differences'][0].update(impact='non_blocking', reason='Offline example content is an explicit remaining difference.')

    def test_default_80_stops_with_acknowledged_differences(self):
        result = evaluate(policy(), self.context, self.review, 1)
        self.assertEqual(result['grade'], 82)
        self.assertEqual(result['decision'], 'target_met')
        self.assertIsNone(result['similarity_percent'])
        self.assertIsNone(result['known_capability_coverage'])
        self.assertFalse(result['strict_delivery_certified'])
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(policy(90), self.context, self.review, 1)['decision'], 'continue')
        limited = evaluate(policy(90), self.context, self.review, 3)
        self.assertEqual(limited['decision'], 'iteration_limit')
        self.assertFalse(limited['target_met'])

    def test_threshold_cannot_bypass_core_or_blocking_issues(self):
        for changed in [dict(self.context, core_behavior_passed=False),
                        dict(self.context, guard_issues=['unknown starting state'])]:
            self.assertFalse(evaluate(policy(0), changed, self.review, 1)['target_met'])
        self.review['differences'][0]['impact'] = 'blocking'
        self.assertFalse(evaluate(policy(0), self.context, self.review, 1)['target_met'])

    def test_every_difference_and_real_image_citation_is_required(self):
        for mutate in [lambda r: r.update(differences=[]),
                       lambda r: r['dimensions']['layout'].update(pair_ids=['invented']),
                       lambda r: r['dimensions']['layout'].update(score=True),
                       lambda r: r['differences'][0].update(impact=None)]:
            changed = copy.deepcopy(self.review)
            mutate(changed)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                evaluate(policy(), self.context, changed, 1)

    def test_100_does_not_hide_minor_differences(self):
        self.context['pairs'][0]['verdict'] = 'minor_difference'
        for row in self.review['dimensions'].values():
            row['score'] = 100
        self.assertFalse(evaluate(policy(100), self.context, self.review, 1)['target_met'])

    def test_invalid_targets_and_iteration_ranges(self):
        for target in [-1, 101, True, 80.5]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                policy(target)
        for count in [0, 21, False]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                policy(80, count)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            evaluate(policy(), self.context, self.review, 4)

    def test_failed_attempts_consume_budget_and_cannot_get_visual_points(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            write(root / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'mac_rebuild_check', 'status': 'failed'})
            context = visual_context(root, {'platform': 'macos'})
            review = review_template(context)
            review['reviewer'] = 'test reviewer'
            for row in review['dimensions'].values():
                row.update(score=0, notes='The failed run has no complete image review.')
            self.assertEqual(evaluate(policy(), context, review, 3)['decision'], 'iteration_limit')
            review['dimensions']['layout']['score'] = 100
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                evaluate(policy(), context, review, 1)

    def test_frozen_plan_and_iteration_chain_reject_rehash_tampering(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            task = root / 'task'
            write(task / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'agent_implementation_task'})
            write(task / 'task.json', {'status': 'ready_for_agent', 'report_index_sha256': 'a' * 64,
                  'project_dir': str(root / 'project'), 'rebuilt_bundle_id': 'test.clone',
                  'flows': [{'id': 'search'}], 'device_udid': 'test-device'})
            # Only the external task is stubbed here. Fidelity cases exercise
            # their real dispatch, chain and semantic verifier.
            real_verify = verify_case
            def external(path):
                return True if path.resolve() == task.resolve() else real_verify(path)
            with patch('copyapp.fidelity.verify_case', side_effect=external):
                plan = create_plan(task, root / 'plan', max_iterations=2)
                self.assertTrue(verify_case(plan))
                previous = None
                for index in (1, 2):
                    failed = root / ('failed-' + str(index))
                    write(failed / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'rebuild_check', 'status': 'failed', 'attempt': index})
                    context = visual_context(failed, {'platform': 'ios'})
                    review = review_template(context)
                    review['reviewer'] = 'test reviewer'
                    for row in review['dimensions'].values():
                        row.update(score=0, notes='Failed replay; no completed image review is available.')
                    review_path = root / 'review.json'
                    write(review_path, review)
                    current = create_check(plan, failed, review_path, root / ('cycle-' + str(index)), previous)
                    self.assertTrue(verify_case(current))
                    if previous:
                        data = json.loads((current / 'fidelity-check.json').read_text())
                        self.assertEqual(data['result']['decision'], 'iteration_limit')
                    previous = current
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    create_check(plan, failed, review_path, root / 'cycle-3', previous)
                saved = json.loads((current / 'fidelity-check.json').read_text())
                saved['result'].update(target_met=True, decision='target_met')
                write(current / 'fidelity-check.json', saved)
                manifest = json.loads((current / 'manifest.json').read_text())
                for row in manifest['evidence']:
                    if row['path'] == 'fidelity-check.json':
                        row['sha256'] = sha256_file(current / row['path'])
                write(current / 'manifest.json', manifest)
                self.assertFalse(verify_fidelity(current))

    def test_ios_adapter_requires_reviewed_selected_delivery(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            evidence = root / 'delivery'
            review = root / 'visual'
            write(evidence / 'manifest.json', {'kind': 'agent_delivery'})
            write(evidence / 'delivery.json', {'task_case': str(root / 'task'),
                  'visual_review_case': str(review), 'visual_unreviewed_flow_count': 0,
                  'asserted_flow_count': 1, 'source_project_sha256': 'a' * 64,
                  'ipa_snapshot_sha256': 'b' * 64})
            write(review / 'review.json', {'pairs': [{'flow_id': 'search', 'step': 2, 'verdict': 'major_difference'},
                                                   {'flow_id': 'omitted', 'step': 3, 'verdict': 'match'}]})
            frozen = {'platform': 'ios', 'flow_ids': ['search'], 'project': str(root / 'project')}
            with patch('copyapp.fidelity.require'), patch('copyapp.fidelity.contract', return_value=frozen):
                context = visual_context(evidence, frozen)
                self.assertTrue(context['core_behavior_passed'])
                self.assertEqual(context['pairs'], [{'id': 'search.step-2', 'verdict': 'major_difference'}])
                data = json.loads((evidence / 'delivery.json').read_text())
                data['visual_review_case'] = None
                write(evidence / 'delivery.json', data)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    visual_context(evidence, frozen)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.flow_capture import (ObserverGroup, capture_flow, validate_flow_pair,
                                  validate_flow_trace_pair)
from copyapp.flow_trace import FlowTrace
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


class FlowCaptureTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_observer_group_finishes_all_children_after_one_cleanup_error(self):
        calls = []

        class Observer:
            def __init__(self, name, fail=False):
                self.name = name
                self.fail = fail

            def start(self, udid, bundle):
                calls.append((self.name, "start", udid, bundle))

            def begin_step(self, index, action):
                calls.append((self.name, "begin", index, action))

            def end_step(self):
                calls.append((self.name, "end"))
                if self.fail:
                    raise RuntimeError("first end failed")

            def finish(self):
                calls.append((self.name, "finish"))

        group = ObserverGroup([Observer("methods", True), Observer("network")])
        group.start("device", "com.example.app")
        group.begin_step(3, "tap_label")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "first end failed"):
            group.end_step()
        group.finish()
        self.assertIn(("network", "end"), calls)
        self.assertIn(("network", "finish"), calls)

    def test_network_capture_preserves_child_and_status_in_parent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            script = root / "script.json"
            script.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                                          "schema_version": 1}))

            def play(_udid, _backend, _script, target, **kwargs):
                self.assertIsNotNone(kwargs["trace_observer"])
                target.mkdir()
                (target / "playbook.json").write_bytes(script.read_bytes())
                path = target / "manifest.json"
                path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete",
                                            "finished_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:00+00:00"}))
                network = target.parent / "network"
                network.mkdir()
                (network / "hook.js").write_text("hook")
                (network / "network.json").write_text("{}")
                (network / "manifest.json").write_text("{}")
                return path, True

            def view(_udid, _bundle, target, **_kwargs):
                target.mkdir()
                path = target / "manifest.json"
                path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete", "node_count": 1,
                                            "window_count": 1,
                                            "started_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:01+00:00"}))
                return path, True

            with patch("copyapp.flow_capture.run_playbook", side_effect=play), \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.capture_view_tree", side_effect=view), \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.verify_case", return_value=True), \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.validate_flow_pair"), \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.validate_network_trace_files",
                       return_value={"events": [{}]}) as validate:
                path, complete = capture_flow("device", "ios-mcp", script,
                                              root / "flow", network=True)
            self.assertTrue(complete)
            parent = json.loads(path.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(parent["network_status"], "complete")
            self.assertEqual(parent["network_event_count"], 1)
            self.assertIn("network/network.json",
                          {item["path"] for item in parent["evidence"]})
            validate.assert_called_once()

    def test_trace_counts_follow_action_steps_and_reject_wrong_static_binary(self):
        play = {"steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "observe"},
                          {"index": 2, "action": "tap"},
                          {"index": 3, "action": "swipe"}]}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.flow_trace.time.sleep"):
            recorder = FlowTrace(Path(directory) / "trace", ["Demo::pressed:"])
            recorder.record.update({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                                    "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "attached_at": "now",
                                    "methods": [{"class": "Demo", "selector": "pressed:",
                                                 "status": "hooked"}]})
            for index, action in ((2, "tap"), (3, "swipe")):
                recorder.begin_step(index, action)
                recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "method_hit", "index": 0}}, None)
                recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "static_hit", "index": 0}}, None)
                recorder.end_step()
            recorder.finish()
            trace = json.loads((recorder.output / "trace.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual([step["call_counts"] for step in trace["steps"]], [[1], [1]])
            validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][1]["index"] = 4
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "action steps"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][1]["index"] = 3
            trace["static_binary_sha256"] = "f" * 64
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "another binary"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device", {"a" * 64})

    def test_selected_raw_argument_is_bound_to_same_tap_and_both_hooks(self):
        play = {"steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap_label"}]}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.flow_trace.time.sleep"):
            recorder = FlowTrace(Path(directory) / "trace", ["Demo::buttonPressed:"],
                                 arg2_u32_methods=["Demo::buttonPressed:"])
            recorder.record.update({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                                    "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "attached_at": "now",
                                    "methods": [{"class": "Demo", "selector": "buttonPressed:",
                                                 "status": "hooked"}]})
            recorder.begin_step(1, "tap_label")
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "method_hit", "index": 0,
                                              "arg2_u32": 18}}, None)
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "static_hit", "index": 0,
                                              "arg2_u32": 18}}, None)
            recorder.end_step()
            recorder.finish()
            trace = json.loads((recorder.output / "trace.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual([hit["value"] for hit in trace["steps"][0]["arg2_u32_hits"]],
                             [18, 18])
            validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][0]["arg2_u32_hits"].pop()
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "raw argument count"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")

    def test_branch_hit_counts_are_bound_to_selected_step(self):
        play = {"steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap"}]}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.flow_trace.time.sleep"):
            recorder = FlowTrace(Path(directory) / "trace", ["Demo::pressed:"])
            recorder.branch_offsets = [0xeb5c]
            recorder.branch_counts = [0]
            recorder.record.update({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "attached_at": "now",
                "methods": [{"class": "Demo", "selector": "pressed:", "status": "hooked"}],
                "branch_requested_offsets": ["0xeb5c"],
                "static_entries": [{"module_path": "/App.app/App"}],
                "branch_entries": [{"index": 0, "module_offset": "0xeb5c",
                                    "module_path": "/App.app/App"}]})
            recorder.begin_step(1, "tap")
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "branch_hit", "index": 0}}, None)
            recorder.end_step()
            recorder.finish()
            trace = json.loads((recorder.output / "trace.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(trace["steps"][0]["branch_call_counts"], [1])
            validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][0]["branch_call_counts"] = [2]
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "branch step counts"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")

    def test_branch_return_is_bound_to_selected_offset_and_tap(self):
        play = {"steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap"}]}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.flow_trace.time.sleep"):
            recorder = FlowTrace(Path(directory) / "trace", ["Demo::pressed:"])
            recorder.branch_offsets = [0x200, 0x300]
            recorder.branch_return_u32_offsets = [0x300]
            recorder.branch_counts = [0, 0]
            recorder.record.update({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "attached_at": "now",
                "methods": [{"class": "Demo", "selector": "pressed:", "status": "hooked"}],
                "branch_requested_offsets": ["0x200", "0x300"],
                "branch_return_u32_offsets": ["0x300"],
                "static_entries": [{"module_path": "/Demo.app/Demo"}],
                "branch_entries": [
                    {"index": 0, "module_offset": "0x200", "module_path": "/Demo.app/Demo"},
                    {"index": 1, "module_offset": "0x300", "module_path": "/Demo.app/Demo"}]})
            recorder.begin_step(1, "tap")
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "branch_hit", "index": 1}}, None)
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "branch_return_u32",
                                              "index": 1, "value": 0}}, None)
            recorder.end_step()
            recorder.finish()
            trace = json.loads((recorder.output / "trace.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(trace["steps"][0]["branch_return_u32_hits"],
                             [{"index": 1, "value": 0}])
            validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][0]["branch_return_u32_hits"][0]["index"] = 0
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "raw branch returns"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")

    def test_branch_register_records_only_selected_app_pointer_offsets(self):
        play = {"steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap"}]}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.flow_trace.time.sleep"):
            recorder = FlowTrace(Path(directory) / "trace", ["Demo::pressed:"])
            recorder.branch_offsets = [0x400]
            recorder.branch_registers = [(0x400, "x19")]
            recorder.branch_counts = [0]
            recorder.record.update({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "attached_at": "now",
                "methods": [{"class": "Demo", "selector": "pressed:", "status": "hooked"}],
                "static_entries": [{"module_path": "/Demo.app/Demo"}],
                "branch_requested_offsets": ["0x400"],
                "branch_registers": [{"offset": "0x400", "register": "x19"}],
                "branch_entries": [{"index": 0, "module_offset": "0x400",
                                    "module_path": "/Demo.app/Demo"}]})
            recorder.begin_step(1, "tap")
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "branch_hit", "index": 0}}, None)
            recorder._on_message({"payload": {"type": "branch_register", "index": 0,
                                              "register": "x19", "status": "app_image",
                                              "target_offset": "0x2ff218"}}, None)
            recorder.end_step()
            recorder.finish()
            trace = json.loads((recorder.output / "trace.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(trace["steps"][0]["branch_register_hits"],
                             [{"index": 0, "register": "x19", "status": "app_image",
                               "target_offset": "0x2ff218"}])
            validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
            trace["steps"][0]["branch_register_hits"][0]["register"] = "x20"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "register pointer bindings"):
                validate_flow_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")

    def test_pair_requires_same_identity_and_prompt_no_launch_scan(self):
        play = {"status": "complete", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
                "finished_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:00+00:00"}
        views = {"status": "complete", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                 "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
                 "launch_requested": False, "frontmost_before": "com.example.app",
                 "frontmost_after": "com.example.app",
                 "started_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:08+00:00"}
        validate_flow_pair(play, views, "com.example.app", "device", "ios-mcp")
        views["started_at"] = "2026-10-15T12:02:00+00:00"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "within 60 seconds"):
            validate_flow_pair(play, views, "com.example.app", "device", "ios-mcp")
        views["started_at"] = "2026-10-15T12:00:08+00:00"
        views["launch_requested"] = True
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "identity"):
            validate_flow_pair(play, views, "com.example.app", "device", "ios-mcp")

    def test_failed_playbook_is_retained_and_view_scan_is_not_attempted(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            script = root / "script.json"
            script.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                                          "scenario_id": "tap", "schema_version": 1}))
            output = root / "flow"

            def failed_playbook(_udid, _backend, _script, target, **_kwargs):
                target.mkdir()
                (target / "playbook.json").write_text(script.read_text())
                manifest = target / "manifest.json"
                manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "failed",
                                                "error": {"message": "target left foreground"},
                                                "evidence": []}))
                return manifest, False

            with patch("copyapp.flow_capture.run_playbook", side_effect=failed_playbook), \
                    patch("copyapp.flow_capture.capture_view_tree") as scan:
                manifest, complete = capture_flow("device", "ios-mcp", script, output)
            self.assertFalse(complete)
            scan.assert_not_called()
            record = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(record["error"]["stage"], "playbook")
            self.assertTrue((output / "playbook/manifest.json").is_file())
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_ictrl_keeps_one_tunnel_for_playbook_and_view_scan(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            script = root / "script.json"
            script.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                                          "scenario_id": "tap", "schema_version": 1}))

            def play(_udid, _backend, _script, target, **_kwargs):
                target.mkdir()
                (target / "playbook.json").write_bytes(script.read_bytes())
                path = target / "manifest.json"
                path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete",
                                            "finished_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:00+00:00"}))
                return path, True

            def view(_udid, _bundle, target, **_kwargs):
                target.mkdir()
                path = target / "manifest.json"
                path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete", "node_count": 1,
                                            "window_count": 1,
                                            "started_at": "2026-10-15T12:00:01+00:00"}))
                return path, True

            with patch("copyapp.flow_capture.ictrl_tunnel", return_value=nullcontext(22224)) as tunnel, \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.run_playbook", side_effect=play) as replay, \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.capture_view_tree", side_effect=view) as scan, \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.validate_flow_pair"), \
                 patch("copyapp.flow_capture.verify_case", return_value=True):
                _, complete = capture_flow("device", "ictrl", script, root / "flow")
                _, shared_complete = capture_flow("device", "ictrl", script,
                                                   root / "shared-flow", port=22225)
            self.assertTrue(complete)
            self.assertTrue(shared_complete)
            tunnel.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual([call.kwargs["port"] for call in replay.call_args_list], [22224, 22225])
            self.assertEqual([call.kwargs["port"] for call in scan.call_args_list], [22224, 22225])
            self.assertFalse(scan.call_args.kwargs["launch"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_frida_device.py`:

```py
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.frida_device import get_usb_device


class FridaDeviceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_selects_requested_usb_device_by_id(self):
        phone = SimpleNamespace(id="requested-udid", type="usb")
        with patch("frida.get_device", return_value=phone) as lookup:
            self.assertIs(get_usb_device("requested-udid"), phone)
        lookup.assert_called_once_with("requested-udid", timeout=5)

    def test_rejects_non_usb_or_wrong_device(self):
        for device in (SimpleNamespace(id="requested-udid", type="remote"),
                       SimpleNamespace(id="other-udid", type="usb")):
            with self.subTest(device=device), patch("frida.get_device", return_value=device):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "requested USB device"):
                    get_usb_device("requested-udid")

    def test_configured_roothide_phone_uses_exact_device_sidecar(self):
        sidecar = SimpleNamespace(id="socket@127.0.0.1:12345", type="remote")
        with patch("copyapp.frida_sidecar.configured_sidecar", return_value={"version": "17.23.3"}), \
                patch("copyapp.frida_sidecar.sidecar_device", return_value=sidecar) as connect, \
                patch("frida.get_device") as direct:
            self.assertIs(get_usb_device("requested-udid"), sidecar)
        connect.assert_called_once_with("requested-udid")
        direct.assert_not_called()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.frida_sidecar import _package_bytes, _pinned_alias


class FridaSidecarTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pinned_alias_requires_a_loopback_usb_host_entry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            known_hosts = Path(root) / "known_hosts"
            known_hosts.write_text("[127.0.0.1]:22222 ssh-ed25519 AAAA\n")
            self.assertEqual(_pinned_alias(known_hosts), "[127.0.0.1]:22222")
            known_hosts.write_text("example.com ssh-ed25519 AAAA\n")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "pinned known-hosts"):
                _pinned_alias(known_hosts)

    def test_unpinned_package_is_rejected_before_phone_transfer(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            package = Path(root) / "frida.deb"
            package.write_bytes(b"untrusted package")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SHA-256 mismatch"):
                _package_bytes(package)
```

`tests/test_ghidra_direct.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.ghidra_direct import (decompile_ghidra_batch,
                                  decompile_ghidra_function,
                                  validate_function_facts)
from copyapp.report import _validate_ghidra_direct
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class GhidraDirectTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.binary = self.root / "App"
        self.binary.write_bytes(b"fixed test binary")
        self.digest = hashlib.sha256(self.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.ghidra = self.root / "ghidra/support"
        self.ghidra.mkdir(parents=True)
        launcher = self.ghidra / "analyzeHeadless"
        launcher.write_text("""#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, pathlib, sys
args = sys.argv
address = args[9]
output = pathlib.Path(args[10])
(output / 'address.txt').write_text(address[2:] + '\\n')
(output / 'name.txt').write_text('buttonPressed:\\n')
(output / 'language.txt').write_text('AARCH64:LE:64:AppleSilicon\\n')
(output / 'pseudocode.txt').write_text('void buttonPressed(void) {}\\n')
(output / 'function-facts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version': 2,
    'address': address, 'name': 'buttonPressed:', 'signature': 'void buttonPressed(void)',
    'is_thunk': False, 'is_external': False, 'callers': [], 'callers_truncated': False,
    'callees': [], 'callees_truncated': False,
    'basic_blocks': [], 'basic_blocks_truncated': False,
    'instruction_references': [], 'instruction_references_truncated': False,
    'instructions_scanned': 0,
    'limitation': 'Ghidra static FunctionManager observations.'}))
(output / 'ghidra.log').write_text('fake provider\\n')
""")
        launcher.chmod(0o755)

    def test_direct_case_is_importable_without_rea(self):
        output = self.root / "decompilation"
        result = decompile_ghidra_function(self.binary, self.digest,
                                           "0x100001000", output,
                                           self.ghidra.parent)
        self.assertEqual(result.name, "summary.json")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        checked = _validate_ghidra_direct(output, {self.digest})
        self.assertEqual(checked["summary"]["function_name"], "buttonPressed:")
        self.assertIn("CopyAppDecompile.java", checked["files"])
        self.assertIn("function-facts.json", checked["files"])
        (output / "function-facts.json").write_text("{}")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "hash mismatch"):
            _validate_ghidra_direct(output, {self.digest})
        output.joinpath("function-facts.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "address": "0x100001000", "name": "buttonPressed:",
            "signature": "void buttonPressed(void)", "is_thunk": False,
            "is_external": False, "callers": [], "callers_truncated": False,
            "callees": [], "callees_truncated": False,
            "limitation": "Ghidra static FunctionManager observations."}))
        (output / "pseudocode.txt").write_text("tampered")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "hash mismatch"):
            _validate_ghidra_direct(output, {self.digest})

    def test_rejects_wrong_binary_before_launch(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SHA-256"):
            decompile_ghidra_function(self.binary, "0" * 64, "0x100001000",
                                      self.root / "rejected", self.ghidra.parent)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "rejected").exists())

    def test_rejects_old_fact_schema_from_new_script(self):
        launcher = self.ghidra / "analyzeHeadless"
        launcher.write_text(launcher.read_text().replace("'schema_version': 2",
                                                       "'schema_version': 1"))
        output = self.root / "old-facts-from-new-script"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "direct Ghidra decompilation failed"):
            decompile_ghidra_function(self.binary, self.digest, "0x100001000",
                                      output, self.ghidra.parent)
        failure = json.loads((output / "failure.json").read_text())
        self.assertIn("schema differs", failure["message"])

    def test_rejects_rehashed_oversized_string_reference(self):
        output = self.root / "reference-facts"
        decompile_ghidra_function(self.binary, self.digest, "0x100001000",
                                  output, self.ghidra.parent)
        facts_path = output / "function-facts.json"
        facts = json.loads(facts_path.read_text())
        facts["instruction_references"] = [{
            "from": "0x100001010", "to": "0x100002000", "type": "DATA",
            "string_preview": "x" * 257}]
        facts_path.write_text(json.dumps(facts))
        summary_path = output / "summary.json"
        summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
        summary["facts_sha256"] = sha256_file(facts_path)
        summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary))
        manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        for item in manifest["evidence"]:
            if item["path"] in ("function-facts.json", "summary.json"):
                item["sha256"] = sha256_file(output / item["path"])
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "instruction reference"):
            _validate_ghidra_direct(output, {self.digest})

    def test_accepts_saved_v1_facts(self):
        path = self.root / "legacy-facts.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "address": "0x100001000", "name": "older",
            "signature": "void older(void)", "is_thunk": False,
            "is_external": False, "callers": [], "callers_truncated": False,
            "callees": [], "callees_truncated": False,
            "limitation": "Ghidra static FunctionManager observations."}))
        self.assertEqual(validate_function_facts(path, "0x100001000", "older")
                         ["schema_version"], 1)

    def test_rejects_rehashed_function_facts_for_another_address(self):

        summary_path.write_text(json.dumps(summary))

        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())

            if item["path"] in ("function-facts.json", "summary.json"):
                item["sha256"] = sha256_file(output / item["path"])
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "function facts identity"):
            _validate_ghidra_direct(output, {self.digest})
```

```py
    def test_queue_keeps_ranked_source_and_rejects_semantic_tamper(self):

                         ["0x100001000", "0x100001100"])

        altered["batch_index"] = 1

        target_manifest = output / "targets/function-02/manifest.json"

            if item["path"] == "summary.json":

        for item in outer["evidence"]:
            if item["path"] == "targets/function-02/summary.json":

        binary = self.root / "indirect-app"

        (target / "assembly.txt").write_text(f"{ENTRY + 4:x}: d63f0260 blr x19\n")

                                "summary": "function-01/summary.json"}], "followed": []}
        observed = [{"static_address": hex(ENTRY), "class": "Screen", "selector": "tap:"}]
        trace = {"static_entries": [{"index": 0, "status": "hooked",
                                     "module_offset": hex(ENTRY - BASE),
                                     "class": "Screen", "selector": "tap:"}],
                 "branch_requested_offsets": [hex(ENTRY + 4 - BASE)],
                 "branch_registers": [{"offset": hex(ENTRY + 4 - BASE), "register": "x19"}],
                 "steps": [{"index": 3, "static_call_counts": [1],
                            "branch_call_counts": [1], "branch_register_hits": [
                                {"index": 0, "register": "x19", "status": "app_image",
                                 "target_offset": hex(ENTRY + 0x10 - BASE)}]}]}
        chosen = verified_indirect_targets({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native,
                                           record, trace, observed)
        self.assertEqual(chosen[0]["address"], hex(ENTRY + 0x10))
        self.assertEqual(chosen[0]["origin"], "runtime_indirect_target")
        trace["steps"][0]["branch_register_hits"][0]["target_offset"] = hex(ENTRY + 8 - BASE)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "exact Mach-O function start"):
            verified_indirect_targets({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native,
                                      record, trace, observed)
        trace["steps"][0]["branch_register_hits"][0]["target_offset"] = hex(ENTRY + 0x10 - BASE)
        (target / "assembly.txt").write_text(f"{ENTRY + 4:x}: d61f0260 br x19\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "BLR instruction"):
            verified_indirect_targets({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native,
                                      record, trace, observed)
```

```py
import ast
import json
import plistlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.hopper_direct import decompile_hopper_function
from copyapp.hopper_queue import decompile_hopper_queue
from copyapp.report import _validate_hopper_direct, _validate_hopper_direct_queue
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case
from tests.test_native_disasm import ENTRY, sample_macho


class HopperDirectTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.binary = self.root / "App"
        self.binary.write_bytes(sample_macho())
        self.digest = sha256_file(self.binary)
        self.app = self.root / "Hopper.app"
        launcher = self.app / "Contents/MacOS/hopper"
        launcher.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        launcher.write_text("#!/bin/sh\n")
        launcher.chmod(0o755)
        (self.app / "Contents/Info.plist").write_bytes(
            plistlib.dumps({"CFBundleShortVersionString": "test"}))

    @staticmethod
    def _launcher(command, **_kwargs):
        config = ast.literal_eval(Path(command[command.index("-Y") + 1])
                                  .read_text().splitlines()[0].removeprefix("CONFIG = "))
        Path(config["pseudocode"]).write_text("void tapped(void) {}\n")
        Path(config["result"]).write_text(json.dumps({
            "status": "complete", "address": config["address"],
            "binary_path": config["target"], "slice_sha256": config["slice_sha256"],
            "name": "tapped", "signature": "void tapped(void)"}))

        class Finished:
            @staticmethod
            def poll():
                return 0

        return Finished()

    def test_single_function_is_source_bound_and_rejects_semantic_tamper(self):
        output = self.root / "function"
        with patch("copyapp.hopper_direct.subprocess.Popen", side_effect=self._launcher):
            decompile_hopper_function(self.binary, self.digest, hex(ENTRY), output,
                                      self.app, timeout=60)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        self.assertEqual(_validate_hopper_direct(output, {self.digest})["summary"]["address"],
                         hex(ENTRY))
        summary = output / "summary.json"
        changed = json.loads(summary.read_text())
        changed["address"] = "0x100001200"
        summary.write_text(json.dumps(changed))
        manifest = output / "manifest.json"
        record = json.loads(manifest.read_text())
        record["address"] = changed["address"]
        for item in record["evidence"]:
            if item["path"] == "summary.json":
                item["sha256"] = sha256_file(summary)
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps(record))
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "identity"):
            _validate_hopper_direct(output, {self.digest})

    def test_queue_selects_verified_candidate_and_retains_function(self):
        candidates = self.root / "candidates"
        candidates.mkdir()
        source = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "runtime_static_candidates",
                  "bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.fixture",
                  "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device1234567890",
                  "binary_path": str(self.binary), "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                  "candidates": [{"static_address": hex(ENTRY),
                                  "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                                  "class": "Fixture", "selector": "tapped:",
                                  "observations": [{"calls": 1,
                                                    "static_entry": {"calls": 1}}]}]}
        (candidates / "candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(source))
        (candidates / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "kind": "runtime_static_candidates",
            "status": "complete", "evidence": [{"path": "candidates.json",
                                                  "sha256": sha256_file(candidates / "candidates.json")}]}))
        output = self.root / "queue"
        with patch("copyapp.hopper_direct.subprocess.Popen", side_effect=self._launcher):
            _, ready = decompile_hopper_queue(candidates, output, self.app, limit=1,
                                              timeout=60)
        self.assertTrue(ready)
        self.assertEqual(_validate_hopper_direct_queue(
            output, "dev.copyapp.fixture", "device1234567890", {self.digest})
            ["record"]["selected"][0]["address"], hex(ENTRY))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ictrl.py`:

```py
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.ictrl import ICtrlClient, ICtrlError


class ICtrlClientTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_passes_only_allowed_json_rpc_through_localhost(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            log = root / "args.json"
            fake = root / "ictrl"
            fake.write_text(
                "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
                "import json, sys\n"
                f"open({str(log)!r}, 'w').write(json.dumps(sys.argv[1:]))\n"
                "print(json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'result':{'ok':True}}))\n"
            )
            os.chmod(fake, 0o700)
            client = ICtrlClient(port=22224, client=fake)
            self.assertEqual(client.call_ui("tap", {"ref": "abc"}), {"ok": True})
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(log.read_text()), [
                "--host", "127.0.0.1:22224", "call", "tap", '{"ref":"abc"}',
            ])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                client.call_ui("config", {"stop_server": True})

    def test_rejects_json_rpc_error(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            fake = Path(directory) / "ictrl"
            fake.write_text("#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
                            "print('{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"error\":{\"code\":401}}')\n")
            os.chmod(fake, 0o700)
            with self.assertRaises(ICtrlError):
                ICtrlClient(client=fake).call_ui("logs")

    def test_dropped_reply_is_unknown_completion_and_never_replayed(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            client = Path(directory) / "ictrl"
            client.touch()
            for error in ("malformed HTTP response", "empty HTTP response", "read failed: reset"):
                with self.subTest(error=error), \
                     patch("copyapp.ictrl.subprocess.run", return_value=
                           subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 1, "", "ictrl: " + error)) as run:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ICtrlError, "completion is unknown"):
                        ICtrlClient(client=client).call_ui("tap", {"x": 10, "y": 20})
                    run.assert_called_once()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
@contextmanager
def fake_xcuitest(*args, **kwargs):
    class Process:
        def poll(self):
            return None

    yield Process()


def make_ipa(path: Path, minimum: str) -> None:
    with ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("Payload/iCTRLUITests-Runner.app/Info.plist",
                         plistlib.dumps({"CFBundleIdentifier": BUNDLE,
                                         "MinimumOSVersion": minimum}))


class ICtrlSetupTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_usb_only_runner_failure_never_falls_back_to_trollstore(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:

             patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.run", return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0)):

             patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.run", return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0)):

    def test_owned_runner_stops_before_testmanager_disconnect_even_on_failure(self):
        events = []
        process = MagicMock()
        process.poll.return_value = None
        process.terminate.side_effect = lambda: events.append("disconnect")

        def stop(command, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(command[-3:], ["copyapp.ictrl_runner_stop", UDID, BUNDLE])
            events.append("stop runner")
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0)

        with patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.Popen", return_value=process), \
             patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.run", side_effect=stop):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "capture failed"):
                with ictrl_xcuitest_session(UDID, BUNDLE, ios_version="17.3.1"):
                    raise RuntimeError("capture failed")
        self.assertEqual(events, ["stop runner", "disconnect"])

    def test_runner_stop_failure_still_closes_host_and_is_reported(self):
        process = MagicMock()
        process.poll.return_value = None
        with patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.Popen", return_value=process), \
             patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.subprocess.run", return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 1)):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "could not stop the owned"):
                with ictrl_xcuitest_session(UDID, BUNDLE, ios_version="17.3.1"):
                    pass
        process.terminate.assert_called_once()

    def test_pair_shows_only_fingerprint(self):

                            "echo 'key fingerprint: ab12cd34  (verify it matches the on-device prompt)' >&2\n"
                            "echo 'waiting for Allow on the device…' >&2\n"
                            "echo 'paired — tok=SECRET123 (key cached)'\n")

                 redirect_stdout(display):
```
