`tests/test_indirect_follow.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.indirect_follow import _files, discover_blr_sites, follow_indirect
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file
from tests.test_native_disasm import BASE, ENTRY, sample_macho


class IndirectFollowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_resume_reuses_verified_branch_flow_after_ghidra_failure(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            investigation = root / "investigation"
            for name in ("flow/playbook", "candidates", "native"):
                (investigation / name).mkdir(parents=True)
            binary = root / "App"
            binary.write_bytes(sample_macho())
            digest = sha256_file(binary)
            udid = "selected-test-device"
            prefix = hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
            script = investigation / "flow/playbook/playbook.json"
            script.write_text('{"bundle_id":"com.example.app"}\n')
            source = {"kind": "runtime_static_candidates", "binary_path": str(binary),
                      "binary_sha256": digest, "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                      "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix, "candidates": []}
            (investigation / "candidates/candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps(source))
            (investigation / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "investigated_ui_flow", "status": "complete",
                "bundle_id": "com.example.app", "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
                "binary_sha256": digest, "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(script),
                "selected_methods": ["Screen::tap:"], "ui_backend": "ios-mcp"}))
            objc_index = root / "objc-index.json"
            objc_index.write_text(json.dumps({"binary_sha256": digest}))
            output = root / "follow"
            for name in ("sources", "branch-flow", "queue"):
                (output / name).mkdir(parents=True)
            (output / "sources/objc-index.json").write_bytes(objc_index.read_bytes())
            (output / "sources/investigation-manifest.json").write_bytes(
                (investigation / "manifest.json").read_bytes())
            (output / "branch-flow/manifest.json").write_text("{}\n")
            (output / "queue/failed.json").write_text("{}\n")
            sites = [{"address": hex(ENTRY + 4), "offset": ENTRY + 4 - BASE,
                      "register": "x19", "source_address": hex(ENTRY)}]
            run = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "ghidra_indirect_follow",
                   "status": "failed", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                   "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix, "binary_sha256": digest,
                   "source_investigation_manifest_sha256":
                       sha256_file(investigation / "manifest.json"),
                   "objc_index_sha256": sha256_file(objc_index),
                   "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(script),
                   "function_limit": 1, "branch_limit": 8,
                   "selected_sites": sites, "disabled_analyzer": None,
                   "error": {"stage": "direct_ghidra_queue", "type": "TimeoutError",
                             "message": "provider timed out"}}
            (output / "run.json").write_text(json.dumps(run))
            (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "ghidra_indirect_follow", "status": "failed",
                "evidence": _files(output)}))
            trace = {"requested_methods": ["Screen::tap:"],
                     "static_binary_sha256": digest,
                     "branch_requested_offsets": [hex(ENTRY + 4 - BASE)],
                     "branch_registers": [{"offset": hex(ENTRY + 4 - BASE),
                                           "register": "x19"}]}

            def fake_decompile(_candidate, destination, *_args):
                destination.mkdir()
                (destination / "manifest.json").write_text("{}\n")
                return destination / "manifest.json", True

            with patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.check_direct_ghidra"), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.verify_case", return_value=True), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow._validate_native_candidate_queue",
                       return_value={"record": {}}), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.rank_native_candidates",
                       return_value=[{"static_address": hex(ENTRY)}]), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.discover_blr_sites", return_value=sites), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow._validate_flow_capture",
                       return_value={"trace": trace}), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow._validate_ghidra_direct_queue",
                       return_value={"record": {"selected": [
                           {"origin": "runtime_indirect_target"}]}}), \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.capture_flow") as capture, \
                 patch("copyapp.indirect_follow.decompile_candidate_queue",
                       side_effect=fake_decompile) as decompile:
                _, complete = follow_indirect(
                    udid, investigation, objc_index, output, root, root,
                    function_limit=1, resume=True)
            self.assertTrue(complete)
            capture.assert_not_called()
            decompile.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(len(list((output / "attempts").iterdir())), 1)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((output / "run.json").read_text())["status"],
                             "complete")

    def test_discovers_only_blr_sites_belonging_to_selected_root(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            binary = root / "App"
            blob = bytearray(sample_macho())
            struct.pack_into("<I", blob, 0x104, 0xd63f0260)
            struct.pack_into("<I", blob, 0x114, 0xd63f0280)
            binary.write_bytes(blob)
            native = root / "native"
            for name, address, instruction in (
                    ("selected", ENTRY, f"{ENTRY + 4:x}: d63f0260 blr x19\n"),
                    ("other", ENTRY + 0x10,
                     f"{ENTRY + 0x14:x}: d63f0280 blr x20\n")):
                folder = native / name
                folder.mkdir(parents=True)
                (folder / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                    "address": hex(address), "stop_address": hex(address + 0x10)}))
                (folder / "assembly.txt").write_text(instruction)
            record = {"results": [
                {"status": "complete", "address": hex(ENTRY),
                 "summary": "selected/summary.json"},
                {"status": "complete", "address": hex(ENTRY + 0x10),
                 "summary": "other/summary.json"}], "followed": []}
            observed = [{"static_address": hex(ENTRY)}]
            sites = discover_blr_sites({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native, record,
                                       observed)
            self.assertEqual(sites, [{"address": hex(ENTRY + 4),
                                      "offset": ENTRY + 4 - BASE,
                                      "register": "x19",
                                      "source_address": hex(ENTRY)}])
            (native / "selected/assembly.txt").write_text(
                f"{ENTRY + 4:x}: d63f0280 blr x20\n")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "differs from acquired Mach-O"):
                discover_blr_sites({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native, record,
                                   observed)
            (native / "selected/assembly.txt").write_text(
                f"{ENTRY + 0x10:x}: d63f0260 blr x19\n")
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "outside its verified function"):
                discover_blr_sites({"binary_path": str(binary)}, native, record,
                                   observed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_install_verification.py`:

```py
import asyncio
import json
import plistlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

from copyapp.install import (_install_trollstore_ipa_via_ssh,
                             _run_trollstore_helper_direct,
                             _stop_stale_mobile_processes, install_trollstore_ipa,
                             install_usb_ipa)
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class InstallationVerificationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_trollstore_timeout_records_observed_old_version_without_retry(self):
        udid = "00008020-000D650434B8003A"
        bundle = "com.copyapp.example"
        helper = ("/var/containers/Bundle/Application/"
                  "AAAAAAAA-AAAA-AAAA-AAAA-AAAAAAAAAAAA/TrollStore.app/trollstorehelper")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            ipa = root / "app.ipa"
            ipa.write_bytes(b"new package")
            package = {"ipa_sha256": sha256_file(ipa), "bundle_id": bundle,
                       "version": "2.0", "build": "2", "executable": "Example"}

            def run(argv, **_kwargs):
                command = argv[-1]
                if command == "deviceinfo uniqueid":
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, (udid + "\n").encode())
                if command.startswith("find "):
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, (helper + "\n").encode())
                if command.startswith("sha256sum "):
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0,
                                                       (package["ipa_sha256"] + "  app.ipa\n").encode())
                if command.startswith("rm -f ") or argv[0] == "scp":
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, b"")
                raise AssertionError(command)

            with patch("copyapp.install.analyze_ipa", return_value=package), \
                 patch("copyapp.install._ssh_argv", return_value=["ssh"]), \
                 patch("copyapp.install._stop_running_app", return_value={"status": "requested"}), \
                 patch("copyapp.install._stop_stale_mobile_processes",
                       return_value={"status": "clear", "count": 0}), \
                 patch("copyapp.install.subprocess.run", side_effect=run), \
                 patch("copyapp.install._run_trollstore_helper_direct",
                       side_effect=TimeoutError("helper uncertain")) as helper_run, \
                 patch("copyapp.install._installed_app", new=AsyncMock(return_value={
                     "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0", "CFBundleVersion": "1",
                     "Path": "/Applications/Example.app"})):
                with self.assertRaises(TimeoutError):

    def test_usb_install_checks_exact_device_and_profile(self):

                result.write_text(json.dumps(record))
                self.assertFalse(verify_case(result.parent))
```

`tests/test_investigate_app.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.investigate_app import _files, _verified_resume_evidence, investigate_app
from copyapp.report import _validate_app_investigation
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class InvestigateAppTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.udid = "exact-device"
        self.bundle = "com.example.app"
        self.prefix = hashlib.sha256(self.udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.analysis = self.root / "analysis"
        (self.analysis / "survey").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.analysis / "survey/manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "bundle_id": self.bundle,
            "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix}))
        (self.analysis / "analysis-index.json").write_text("{}")
        self.scripts = []
        for index in (1, 2):
            path = self.root / f"flow-{index}.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": self.bundle,
                                        "steps": [{"action": "tap", "x": index}]}))
            self.scripts.append(path)

    def test_stops_then_resumes_without_repeating_completed_flow(self):
        output = self.root / "investigation"

        def first_pass(udid, analysis, script, child, **kwargs):
            child.mkdir(parents=True)
            status = "complete" if script == self.scripts[0] else "needs_review"
            path = child / "manifest.json"
            path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": status, "bundle_id": self.bundle,
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix,
                "ui_backend": "ios-mcp", "provider": "none",
                "selected_methods": [],
                "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(script)}))
            return path, status == "complete"

        with patch("copyapp.investigate_app.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_app.investigate_flow", side_effect=first_pass) as worker:
            parent, complete = investigate_app(self.udid, self.analysis,
                                               self.scripts, output, provider="none")
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(worker.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(parent.read_text())["status"], "needs_review")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

        def second_pass(udid, analysis, script, child, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(script, self.scripts[1])
            self.assertTrue(kwargs["resume"])
            path = child / "manifest.json"
            data = json.loads(path.read_text())
            data["status"] = "complete"
            path.write_text(json.dumps(data))
            return path, True

        with patch("copyapp.investigate_app.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.report._validate_investigation"), \
             patch("copyapp.report._main_and_embedded_hashes", return_value=set()), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_app.investigate_flow", side_effect=second_pass) as worker:
            parent, complete = investigate_app(self.udid, self.analysis,
                                               self.scripts, output, provider="none", resume=True)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        worker.assert_called_once()
        record = json.loads(parent.read_text())
        self.assertEqual([item["status"] for item in record["flows"]],
                         ["complete", "complete"])
        self.assertEqual(record["history"][0]["previous_status"], "needs_review")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        with patch("copyapp.report._validate_investigation", side_effect=lambda child, *_: {
                "manifest": json.loads((child / "manifest.json").read_text()),
                "files": ["manifest.json"]}):
            validated = _validate_app_investigation(
                output, self.bundle, self.prefix, set(),
                sha256_file(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json"))
        self.assertEqual(len(validated["manifest"]["flows"]), 2)

    def test_rejects_script_from_another_bundle_before_touch(self):
        self.scripts[1].write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": "com.other"}))
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_app.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_app.investigate_flow") as worker:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "another app"):
                investigate_app(self.udid, self.analysis, self.scripts,
                                self.root / "invalid")
        worker.assert_not_called()

    def test_separately_completed_child_can_refresh_only_its_own_evidence(self):
        output = self.root / "promoted"
        child = output / "flows/flow-01"
        child.mkdir(parents=True)
        manifest = child / "manifest.json"
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "needs_review",
                                        "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(self.scripts[0])}))
        (output / "other.txt").write_text("unchanged")
        previous = {"flows": [{"index": 1, "status": "needs_review",
                               "manifest": "flows/flow-01/manifest.json"}],
                    "evidence": _files(output)}
        (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(previous))
        manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete",
                                        "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(self.scripts[0])}))
        (child / "new-result.json").write_text("{}")
        records = [{"sha256": sha256_file(self.scripts[0])}]
        with patch("copyapp.report._main_and_embedded_hashes", return_value=set()), \
             patch("copyapp.report._validate_investigation") as validated:
            self.assertTrue(_verified_resume_evidence(output, previous, self.bundle,
                                                      self.prefix, self.analysis, records))
            validated.assert_called_once()
            (output / "other.txt").write_text("tampered")
            self.assertFalse(_verified_resume_evidence(output, previous, self.bundle,
                                                       self.prefix, self.analysis, records))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_investigate_flow.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.investigate_flow import _resolve_target, investigate_flow
from copyapp.report import _validate_investigation
from copyapp.experiment import _static_targets
from copyapp.trace import trace_script
from copyapp.method_scout import refine_scout_with_view_tree, scout_methods
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


def minimal_macho():
    data = bytearray(104)
    data[:4] = b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe"
    struct.pack_into("<II", data, 16, 1, 72)
    struct.pack_into("<II", data, 32, 0x19, 72)
    struct.pack_into("<QQQQ", data, 56, 0x100000000, 0x1000, 0, len(data))
    return bytes(data)


class InvestigateFlowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_hopper_preflight_precedes_device_capture(self):
        with patch("copyapp.hopper_direct.check_direct_hopper",
                   side_effect=FileNotFoundError("Hopper unavailable")), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow") as capture:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(FileNotFoundError, "Hopper unavailable"):
                investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script,
                                 self.root / "hopper-preflight",
                                 provider="hopper-direct")
        capture.assert_not_called()

    def test_removed_rea_provider_is_rejected_before_device_work(self):
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow") as capture:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "unsupported analysis provider"):
                investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script,
                                 self.root / "removed-rea", provider="ghidra")
        capture.assert_not_called()

    def test_network_option_reaches_flow_and_is_pinned_for_resume(self):
        output = self.root / "network-option"
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow",
                   side_effect=RuntimeError("stop before device touch")) as flow:
            manifest, complete = investigate_flow(
                self.udid, self.analysis, self.script, output,
                methods=["View::buttonPressed:"], network=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(flow.call_args.kwargs["network"])
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(manifest.read_text())["network_requested"])
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.verify_case", return_value=True):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "identity differs"):
                investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script, output,
                                 methods=["View::buttonPressed:"], resume=True)

    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.analysis = self.root / "analysis"
        for part in ("survey", "acquired/bundle/App.app", "acquired/static"):
            (self.analysis / part).mkdir(parents=True)
        self.udid = "exact-device"
        self.prefix = hashlib.sha256(self.udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.bundle = "com.example.app"
        self.binary = self.analysis / "acquired/bundle/App.app/App"
        self.binary.write_bytes(minimal_macho())
        self.digest = sha256_file(self.binary)
        self.index = self.analysis / "acquired/static/objc-index.json"
        self.save_index([("View", "buttonPressed:", "0x100001000")])
        (self.analysis / "acquired/static/ipa-index.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "binaries": [{"path": "Payload/App.app/App", "sha256": self.digest,
                          "encrypted_on_disk": False}]}))
        (self.analysis / "survey/manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "bundle_id": self.bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix}))
        (self.analysis / "survey/app.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "CFBundleIdentifier": self.bundle, "CFBundleExecutable": "App"}))
        (self.analysis / "acquired/acquisition.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "bundle_id": self.bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix,
            "remote_bundle_path": "/Applications/App.app"}))
        (self.analysis / "analysis-index.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "steps": {"survey": {"ok": True}, "bundle": {"ok": True}}}))
        self.script = self.root / "flow.json"
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1,
                                           "bundle_id": self.bundle,
                                           "steps": [{"action": "tap", "x": 1, "y": 1}]}))

    def save_index(self, methods):
        classes = {}
        for cls, selector, imp in methods:
            classes.setdefault(cls, []).append({"selector": selector, "imp": imp})
        self.index.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1,
            "binary_sha256": self.digest, "image_base": "0x100000000",
            "classes": [{"name": name, "instance_methods": values}
                        for name, values in classes.items()]}))

    def test_scout_selects_unique_action_and_stops_on_ambiguity(self):
        selected = scout_methods(self.index)
        self.assertEqual(selected["selected_method"], "View::buttonPressed:")
        self.save_index([("View", "tappedOne:", "0x100001000"),
                         ("View", "tappedTwo:", "0x100001004")])
        ambiguous = scout_methods(self.index)
        self.assertEqual(ambiguous["status"], "needs_review")
        self.assertIsNone(ambiguous["selected_method"])
        self.save_index([("HomeViewController", "showCounter", "0x100001000"),
                         ("HomeViewController", "showNotes", "0x100001004")])
        fallback = scout_methods(self.index)
        self.assertEqual(fallback["status"], "needs_review")
        self.assertEqual({item["selector"] for item in fallback["ranked"]},
                         {"showCounter", "showNotes"})
        by_label = scout_methods(self.index, tap_labels=["Counter · UserDefaults",
                                                        "Increment counter"])
        self.assertEqual(by_label["selected_method"], "HomeViewController::showCounter")
        self.assertEqual(by_label["selection_basis"], "unique_exact_tap_labels")
        self.assertIsNone(scout_methods(self.index, tap_labels=["Increment counter"])
                          ["selected_method"])
        self.save_index([("HomeViewController", "showNotes", "0x100001000"),
                         ("NotesViewController", "addNote", "0x100001004")])
        two = scout_methods(self.index, tap_labels=["Notes · SQLite", "Add sample note"])
        self.assertEqual(two["selected_methods"],
                         ["HomeViewController::showNotes", "NotesViewController::addNote"])

    def test_playbook_label_selects_unique_navigation_entry(self):
        self.save_index([("HomeViewController", "showCounter", "0x100001000"),
                         ("HomeViewController", "showNotes", "0x100001004")])
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": self.bundle,
            "steps": [{"action": "tap_label", "label": "Counter · UserDefaults"}]}))
        output = self.root / "label-selected"
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow", side_effect=RuntimeError("stop")) as flow:
            path, complete = investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script, output,
                                              provider="none")
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(flow.call_args.kwargs["methods"],
                         ["HomeViewController::showCounter"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(path.read_text())["error"]["stage"], "flow_capture")

    def test_runtime_button_class_refines_ambiguous_method_scout(self):
        self.save_index([("_TtC13DeepSeek_Chat8DSButton", "objcOnTap", "0x100001000"),
                         ("OtherView", "didTap:", "0x100001004")])
        tree = self.root / "entry-tree.json"
        tree.write_text(json.dumps({"type": "view_tree", "nodes": [
            {"id": 0, "parent": None, "class_name": "UIWindow"},
            {"id": 1, "parent": 0, "class_name": "DeepSeek_Chat.DSButton"},
            {"id": 2, "parent": 1, "class_name": "UILabel",
             "text": "Continue with Password"}]}))
        scout = scout_methods(self.index, tap_labels=["Continue with Password"])
        self.assertEqual(scout["selected_methods"], [])
        refined = refine_scout_with_view_tree(scout, self.index, tree,
                                              ["Continue with Password"])
        self.assertEqual(refined["selected_methods"],
                         ["_TtC13DeepSeek_Chat8DSButton::objcOnTap"])
        self.assertEqual(refined["runtime_view_sha256"], sha256_file(tree))
        self.assertEqual(refine_scout_with_view_tree(scout, self.index, tree,
                         ["Missing button"])["selected_methods"], [])

    def test_failed_flow_retry_archives_original_before_new_device_touch(self):
        self.save_index([("View", "firstAction:", "0x100001000"),
                         ("View", "secondAction:", "0x100001004")])
        output = self.root / "flow-retry"
        calls = []

        def flow_stage(*args, **kwargs):
            target = args[3]
            target.mkdir(parents=True)
            calls.append(target)
            status = "failed" if len(calls) == 1 else "complete"
            manifest = target / "manifest.json"
            manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"status": status, "evidence": []}))
            return manifest, status == "complete"

        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow", side_effect=flow_stage), \
             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.write_review_brief"):
            _, complete = investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script, output,
                                           provider="none")
            self.assertFalse(complete)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((output / "manifest.json").read_text())
                             ["error"]["stage"], "flow_capture")
            _, complete = investigate_flow(self.udid, self.analysis, self.script, output,
                                           provider="none", resume=True)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)
        archives = list((output / "attempts").glob("flow-*/manifest.json"))
        self.assertEqual(len(archives), 1)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(archives[0].read_text())["status"], "failed")
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((output / "flow/manifest.json").read_text())["status"],
                         "complete")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_resolves_decrypted_main_from_verified_ipa_member(self):
        decrypted = self.analysis / "decrypted"
        (decrypted / "static").mkdir(parents=True)
        (decrypted / "static/objc-index.json").write_bytes(self.index.read_bytes())
        (decrypted / "static/ipa-index.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "binaries": [{"path": "Payload/App.app/App", "sha256": self.digest}]}))
        (decrypted / "decryption.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "all_macho_headers_decrypted": True}))
        with zipfile.ZipFile(decrypted / "analysis.ipa", "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr("Payload/App.app/App", self.binary.read_bytes())
        analysis_index = json.loads((self.analysis / "analysis-index.json").read_text())
        analysis_index["steps"]["decryption"] = {"ok": True}
        (self.analysis / "analysis-index.json").write_text(json.dumps(analysis_index))
        with patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.verify_case", return_value=True):
            target, index, kind = _resolve_target(self.analysis, self.udid, self.bundle,
                                                  self.root / "extracted")
        self.assertEqual(kind, "decrypted_ipa_member")
        self.assertEqual(sha256_file(target), self.digest)
        self.assertEqual(index, decrypted / "static/objc-index.json")

    def test_rejects_encrypted_acquired_main_before_device_actions(self):

             patch("copyapp.investigate_flow.capture_flow") as flow:

                                           self.root / "encrypted")

        flow.assert_not_called()

    def test_legacy_index_without_image_base_uses_pinned_macho_base(self):
        index = json.loads(self.index.read_text())
        index.pop("image_base")

                                          [("View", "buttonPressed:")])

        self.assertEqual(targets[0]["offset"], 0x1000)

    def test_embedded_framework_method_binds_to_full_app_relative_path(self):
        framework = self.binary.parent / "Frameworks" / "StoreUI.framework" / "StoreUI"
        framework.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        framework.write_bytes(minimal_macho())
        index = self.root / "storeui-objc-index.json"
        index.write_text(json.dumps({

            "image_base": "0x100000000", "classes": [{
                "name": "SearchCell", "instance_methods": [{
                    "selector": "initWithFrame:", "imp": "0x100001000"}]}],
        }))

                         "Frameworks/StoreUI.framework/StoreUI")

                              static_targets=targets)

    def test_unrelated_duplicate_index_method_does_not_block_selected_target(self):
```

`tests/test_investigation_report.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.report import _validate_investigation
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


class InvestigationReportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parent_import_checks_methods_script_candidate_and_rea_chain(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            for name in ("flow/playbook", "candidates/sources/flow-01", "rea"):
                (root / name).mkdir(parents=True)
            digest = "a" * 64
            methods = ["View::buttonPressed:"]
            script = root / "flow/playbook/playbook.json"
            script.write_text('{"bundle_id":"com.example.app"}')
            flow_manifest = root / "flow/manifest.json"
            flow_manifest.write_text('{"status":"complete"}')
            (root / "candidates/sources/flow-01/manifest.json").write_bytes(
                flow_manifest.read_bytes())
            candidate = root / "candidates/candidates.json"
            candidate.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "binary_sha256": digest,
                "candidates": [{"class": "View", "selector": "buttonPressed:"}]}))
            (root / "candidates/manifest.json").write_text("{}")
            (root / "rea/manifest.json").write_text("{}")
            (root / "rea/queue.json").write_text("{}")
            (root / "review-brief.md").write_text("# Review\n")
            scout = root / "method-scout.json"
            scout.write_text(json.dumps({"binary_sha256": digest,
                                         "used_methods": methods}))
            required = ["method-scout.json", "review-brief.md", "flow/manifest.json",
                        "candidates/manifest.json", "candidates/candidates.json",
                        "rea/manifest.json", "rea/queue.json"]
            record = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "investigated_ui_flow",
                      "status": "complete", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                      "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device", "binary_sha256": digest,
                      "ui_backend": "ios-mcp", "provider": "ghidra",
                      "flow_status": "complete", "candidate_status": "complete",
                      "rea_status": "complete", "selected_methods": methods,
                      "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(script),
                      "evidence": [{"path": name} for name in required]}
            (root / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(record))
            flow = {"manifest": {"ui_backend": "ios-mcp"},
                    "trace": {"requested_methods": methods}}
            queue = {"record": {"binary_sha256": digest, "provider": "ghidra",
                                "candidate_case_sha256": sha256_file(candidate),
                                "results": [{}]}}
            with patch("copyapp.report.verify_case", return_value=True), \
                 patch("copyapp.report._validate_flow_capture", return_value=flow), \
                 patch("copyapp.report._validate_rea_queue", return_value=queue):
                result = _validate_investigation(root, "com.example.app", "device", {digest})
                self.assertEqual(result["manifest"]["status"], "complete")
                scout.write_text(json.dumps({"binary_sha256": digest,
                                             "used_methods": ["Other::pressed:"]}))
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "source chain differs"):
                    _validate_investigation(root, "com.example.app", "device", {digest})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
def capabilities(_udid, root, mode, *_args):
    data = {"device": IDENTITY["device"],
            "probes": {name: {"status": "available"} for name in
                       ("usb_lockdown", "usb_screenshot", "ictrl")},

    seal_case(root, "ios_capabilities", status="complete", requested_mode=mode,
              selected_mode=capability_plan(data, mode)["selected_mode"], device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)

class IosAnalysisTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.script = self.root / "flow.json"
        write_json(self.script, {"schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": BUNDLE,
                                "scenario_id": "counter", "fresh_launch": True, "steps": [
                                    {"action": "tap_label", "label": "Add"},
                                    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Count 1"]},
                                    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True, "ready_contains": "Count"}]})
        for target, replacement in (("collect_capabilities", capabilities), ("run_playbook", player),
                                    ("target_identity", AsyncMock(return_value=IDENTITY))):
            patcher = patch("copyapp.ios_analysis." + target, side_effect=replacement) if target != "target_identity" else patch(
                "copyapp.ios_analysis.target_identity", new=replacement)
            patcher.start()
            self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
        self.display = redirect_stdout(io.StringIO())
        self.display.__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.display.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def collect(self, **kwargs):
        return collect_ios_analysis(UDID, BUNDLE, [self.script], self.root / "analysis", **kwargs)

    def legacy_collection(self, output, bundle=BUNDLE, version="1", build="1", system="26.0.1"):
        app = {"CFBundleIdentifier": bundle, "CFBundleShortVersionString": version,
               "CFBundleVersion": build, "CFBundleExecutable": "Counter"}
        write_json(output / "survey/app.json", app)
        write_json(output / "survey/manifest.json", {"schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": bundle,
                   "device_id_sha256_prefix": PREFIX,
                   "ui_backend": "usb",
                   "device": {**IDENTITY["device"], "ProductVersion": system},
                   "evidence": [{"path": "app.json", "sha256": sha256_file(output / "survey/app.json")}]})
        acquired = output / "acquired"
        primary = acquired / "bundle/Counter.app"
        primary.mkdir(parents=True)
        (primary / "Info.plist").write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(app))
        (primary / "Counter").write_bytes(binary(False))
        with ZipFile(acquired / "bundle-snapshot.ipa", "w") as archive:
            for file in primary.iterdir():
                archive.write(file, "Payload/Counter.app/" + file.name)
        common = {"bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": PREFIX,
                  "installed_version": version, "installed_build": build}
        write_json(acquired / "acquisition.json", {**common, "remote_bundle_path": "/apps/Counter.app",
                   "snapshot_sha256": sha256_file(acquired / "bundle-snapshot.ipa"),
                   "files": [{"relative": file.name, "sha256": sha256_file(file)} for file in primary.iterdir()]})
        write_json(output / "sandbox-index.json", {**common, "entries": []})
        keys = {"survey": "survey/manifest.json", "bundle": "acquired/acquisition.json",
                "sandbox": "sandbox-index.json"}
        write_json(output / "analysis-index.json", {
            "steps": {key: {"ok": True, "key_sha256": sha256_file(output / path)} for key, path in keys.items()},
            "artifacts": {key: {"path": path, "sha256": sha256_file(output / path)} for key, path in keys.items()}})
        return True

    def review(self, analysis, output):
        write_json(self.root / "findings.json", {"schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": BUNDLE,
                   "review_status": "reviewed", "reviewer": "test reviewer", "sections": [{
                       "title": "Counter", "findings": [{"claim": "Add displays Count 1.",
                           "confidence": "observed", "evidence": ["counter"]}]}]})
        write_json(self.root / "spec.json", {"schema_version": 1, "target_bundle_id": BUNDLE,
                   "rebuilt_bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.counter", "review_status": "reviewed",
                   "scope": "One local counter flow", "unknowns": ["Other states"], "flows": [{
                       "id": "counter", "entry": "Counter", "expected": ["Count 1"],
                       "verification": "Replay and inspect screenshots", "evidence": ["counter"],
                       "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(self.script)}]})
        compose_behavior_report(analysis, self.root / "findings.json", self.root / "spec.json", output)

    def package(self, version="1", bundle=BUNDLE):
        source = self.root / f"{len(list(self.root.iterdir()))}.ipa"
        with ZipFile(source, "w") as archive:
            archive.writestr("Payload/Counter.app/Info.plist", plistlib.dumps({
                "CFBundleIdentifier": bundle, "CFBundleExecutable": "Counter",
                "CFBundleShortVersionString": version, "CFBundleVersion": "1",
                "CFBundleSupportedPlatforms": ["iPhoneOS"]}))
            archive.writestr("Payload/Counter.app/Counter", binary(False))
        output = source.with_suffix("")
        import_package(source, output)
        return output

    def test_external_package_association_is_metadata_only_and_is_recomputed(self):
        matching, older = self.package(), self.package(version="0.9")
        self.assertTrue(self.collect(package_cases=[matching, older])[1])
        analysis = self.root / "analysis"
        state = read_json(analysis / "analysis.json")
        self.assertEqual([row["association"]["relation"] for row in state["packages"]],
                         ["metadata_match", "bundle_only"])
        self.assertTrue(all(row["association"]["runtime_binary_identity"] == "not_verified"
                            for row in state["packages"]))
        self.review(analysis, self.root / "report")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "report"))
        self.assertEqual(read_json(self.root / "report/report-index.json")["evidence"]["package.2"]
                         ["association"]["relation"], "bundle_only")
        state["packages"][1]["association"]["relation"] = "metadata_match"
        write_json(analysis / "analysis.json", state)
        seal_case(analysis, "ios_analysis", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE,
                  device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(analysis))

    def test_static_package_claim_cannot_cite_an_unrelated_ui_flow(self):
        self.collect(package_cases=[self.package()])
        self.review(self.root / "analysis", self.root / "report")
        findings = read_json(self.root / "findings.json")
        row = findings["sections"][0]["findings"][0]
        row.update(basis="package", claim="Package metadata declares this Bundle ID.", evidence=["package.1"])
        write_json(self.root / "findings.json", findings)
        compose_behavior_report(self.root / "analysis", self.root / "findings.json",
                                self.root / "spec.json", self.root / "static-report")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "static-report"))
        row["evidence"] = ["counter"]
        write_json(self.root / "findings.json", findings)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "basis"):
            compose_behavior_report(self.root / "analysis", self.root / "findings.json",
                                    self.root / "spec.json", self.root / "wrong-report")

    def test_ui_delivery_rechecks_full_source_identity_even_after_rehash(self):
        self.collect()
        report, delivery = self.root / "report", self.root / "delivery"
        self.review(self.root / "analysis", report)
        create_analysis_delivery(self.root / "analysis", report, delivery)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(delivery))
        saved = read_json(delivery / "delivery.json")
        saved["flow_coverage"][0]["source_script_sha256"] = "0" * 64
        write_json(delivery / "delivery.json", saved)
        seal_case(delivery, "ios_behavior_delivery", status="source_linked_report_ready_for_review", bundle_id=BUNDLE)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(delivery))
        self.collect(resume=True)
        other = self.root / "different-source"
        shutil.copytree(self.root / "analysis", other)
        # Even an exact copied source is a separate collection identity for delivery.
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "different UI analysis"):
            create_analysis_delivery(other, report, self.root / "wrong-delivery")

    def test_current_workflow_waits_for_review_then_implementation_and_never_launches_agent(self):
        workflow, project = self.root / "workflow", self.root / "project"

        def run(**kwargs):
            return copy_ios(UDID, BUNDLE, [self.script], project, "dev.copyapp.counter",
                            workflow, **kwargs)

        with patch("copyapp.ios_workflow.collect_capabilities", side_effect=capabilities), \
                patch("copyapp.agent_run.run_agent_task") as external:
            self.assertFalse(run()[1])
            self.assertEqual(read_json(workflow / "workflow.json")["status"], "needs_behavior_review")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(workflow))
            with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook") as replay:
                self.assertFalse(run(resume=True)[1])
                replay.assert_not_called()
            report = workflow / "analysis-agent/reviewed-report"
            self.review(workflow / "analysis", report)
            create_analysis_delivery(workflow / "analysis", report,
                                     workflow / "analysis-agent/analysis-delivery")
            self.assertFalse(run(resume=True)[1])
            self.assertEqual(read_json(workflow / "workflow.json")["status"], "needs_implementation")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(workflow))
            external.assert_not_called()
        # Rehashing a success flag cannot replace a real device delivery.
        state = read_json(workflow / "workflow.json")
        state["status"] = "complete"
        write_json(workflow / "workflow.json", state)
        seal_case(workflow, "ios_copy_workflow", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE,
                  device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(workflow))

    def test_retry_success_exit_cannot_hide_a_still_wrong_enhancement_build(self):
        output = self.root / "wrong-build"
        calls = []

        def wrong(root):
            calls.append(root)
            return self.legacy_collection(root, build="2")

        self.assertFalse(collect_ios_analysis(UDID, BUNDLE, [self.script], output, mode="enhanced",
                                             enhanced_collector=wrong)[1])
        # A retry collector which merely exits true must not promote the stale build.
        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook") as replay:
            self.assertFalse(collect_ios_analysis(UDID, BUNDLE, [self.script], output, mode="enhanced",
                resume=True, retry_failed=True, enhanced_collector=lambda root: True)[1])
            replay.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_requested_decryption_checks_root_before_identity_collection_or_actions(self):
        def mobile_caps(udid, output, mode, *args):
            capabilities(udid, output, mode, *args)
            baseline = read_json(output / "baseline/device.json")
            probe = {"status": "unavailable", "device_id": udid, "effective_uid": 501,
                     "identity_verified": True, "suspended_child_stopped": True}
            write_json(output / "root-spawn.json", probe)
            baseline["probes"]["package_recovery_route"] = read_json(output / "package-recovery-route.json")
            baseline["probes"]["frida_root_spawn"] = probe
            write_json(output / "capabilities.json", {**baseline, **capability_plan(baseline, mode)})
            seal_case(output, "ios_capabilities", status="complete", requested_mode=mode,
                      selected_mode="enhanced", device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)

        request = enhancement_settings(True, "usb", 22222, "mobile", self.root / "key",
                                        self.root / "known-hosts", self.root / "helper")
        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.collect_capabilities", side_effect=mobile_caps), \
                patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.target_identity") as identity, \
                patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook") as replay:
            collector = Mock()
            self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=collector,
                                          enhancement_request=request)[1])
            self.assertIn("frida_root_spawn", read_json(self.root / "analysis/analysis.json")["error"]["message"])
            self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=collector,
                                          enhancement_request=request, resume=True, retry_failed=True)[1])
            identity.assert_not_called()
            collector.assert_not_called()
            replay.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(read_json(self.root / "analysis/analysis.json")["capability_checks"][-1]["accepted_for_resume"])
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "analysis"))
        # When root is subsequently available, use the fresh accepted probe,
        # retaining the original unavailable snapshot. Reach collection rather
        # than blocking forever on the old missing root result.
        collector = Mock(return_value=False)
        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.target_identity", new=AsyncMock(return_value=IDENTITY)) as identity:
            self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=collector,
                                          enhancement_request=request, resume=True, retry_failed=True)[1])
            identity.assert_awaited_once()
        collector.assert_called_once()
        state = read_json(self.root / "analysis/analysis.json")
        self.assertTrue(state["capability_checks"][-1]["accepted_for_resume"])
        self.assertIn("enhanced device collection failed", state["error"]["message"])
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "analysis"))

    def test_resume_repairs_old_blanket_root_gate_with_verified_roothide_route(self):
        def mobile_caps(udid, output, mode, *args, old=False):
            capabilities(udid, output, mode, *args)
            data = read_json(output / "baseline/device.json")
            probe = {"status": "unavailable", "device_id": udid, "effective_uid": 501,
                     "identity_verified": True, "suspended_child_stopped": True}
            write_json(output / "root-spawn.json", probe)
            data["probes"]["frida_root_spawn"] = probe
            if old:
                (output / "package-recovery-route.json").unlink()
            else:
                route = {"status": "available", "device_id": udid, "identity_verified": True,
                         "route": "roothide_mobile_ssh"}
                write_json(output / "package-recovery-route.json", route)
                data["probes"]["package_recovery_route"] = route
            write_json(output / "capabilities.json", {**data, **capability_plan(data, mode, version=2 if old else 3)})
            seal_case(output, "ios_capabilities", status="complete", requested_mode=mode,
                      selected_mode="enhanced", device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)

        request = enhancement_settings(True, "usb", 22222, "mobile", self.root / "key",
                                        self.root / "known-hosts", self.root / "helper")
        collector = Mock(return_value=False)
        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.collect_capabilities",
                   side_effect=lambda *args: mobile_caps(*args, old=True)):
            self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=collector,
                                          enhancement_request=request)[1])
        collector.assert_not_called()
        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.collect_capabilities", side_effect=mobile_caps):
            self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=collector,
                                          enhancement_request=request, resume=True, retry_failed=True)[1])
        collector.assert_called_once()
        state = read_json(self.root / "analysis/analysis.json")
        self.assertTrue(state["capability_checks"][-1]["accepted_for_resume"])
        self.assertEqual(read_json(self.root / "analysis/capabilities/capabilities.json")["capability_model_version"], 2)
        self.assertIn("enhanced device collection failed", state["error"]["message"])
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "analysis"))

    def test_snapshot_version_is_checked_even_when_stage_metadata_claims_current_build(self):
        def old_snapshot(root):
            self.legacy_collection(root)
            package = root / "acquired"
            path = package / "bundle/Counter.app/Info.plist"
            app = plistlib.loads(path.read_bytes())
            app["CFBundleVersion"] = "old"
            path.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(app))
            with ZipFile(package / "bundle-snapshot.ipa", "w") as archive:
                for file in path.parent.iterdir():
                    archive.write(file, "Payload/Counter.app/" + file.name)
            record = read_json(package / "acquisition.json")
            record["snapshot_sha256"] = sha256_file(package / "bundle-snapshot.ipa")
            record["files"] = [{"relative": file.name, "sha256": sha256_file(file)} for file in path.parent.iterdir()]
            write_json(package / "acquisition.json", record)
            index = read_json(root / "analysis-index.json")
            digest = sha256_file(package / "acquisition.json")
            index["steps"]["bundle"]["key_sha256"] = digest
            index["artifacts"]["bundle"]["sha256"] = digest
            write_json(root / "analysis-index.json", index)
            return True

        self.assertFalse(self.collect(mode="enhanced", enhanced_collector=old_snapshot)[1])
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "analysis"))

    def test_failed_resume_reprobes_required_capabilities_before_any_replay(self):
        def failed(*args, **kwargs):
            path, _ = player(*args, **kwargs)
            record = read_json(path)
            record.update(status="failed", error={"message": "reply lost; completion unknown"})
            write_json(path, record)
            return path, False

        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook", side_effect=failed):
            self.assertFalse(self.collect()[1])

        def unavailable(udid, output, mode, *args):
```

```py
import io
import json

from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from copyapp.verify import verify_case


UDID = "00008030-000E45AE0C42402E"


def baseline():
    return {"device": {"UniqueDeviceID": UDID, "ProductVersion": "26.0.1"},
            "probes": {name: {"status": "available"} for name in
                       ("usb_lockdown", "usb_screenshot", "ictrl")},
            "host": {name: {"status": "available"} for name in
                     ("xcode", "development_signing")}}


class IosCapabilitiesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_standard_analysis_and_rebuild_do_not_require_a_package_or_jailbreak(self):
        result = capability_plan(baseline(), "standard")
        self.assertEqual(result["ui_backend"], "ictrl")
        self.assertTrue(result["operations"]["analyze"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertTrue(result["operations"]["rebuild"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertFalse(result["operations"]["trace"]["ready_for_attempt"])

    def test_explicit_deep_operation_cannot_silently_become_ui_success(self):
        result = capability_plan(baseline(), "enhanced")
        self.assertFalse(result["operations"]["analyze"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertIn("ssh_mobile", result["operations"]["analyze"]["missing"])
        self.assertIn("frida_usb", result["operations"]["trace"]["missing"])

    def test_auto_uses_observed_services_not_a_jailbreak_marker(self):
        record = baseline()
        record["probes"]["rootless_marker"] = {"status": "observed", "roothide_namespace": True}
        self.assertEqual(capability_plan(record, "auto")["selected_mode"], "standard")
        for name in ("ssh_mobile", "ios_mcp"):
            record["probes"][name] = {"status": "available"}
        result = capability_plan(record, "auto")
        self.assertEqual(result["selected_mode"], "enhanced")
        self.assertEqual(result["ui_backend"], "ios-mcp")
        self.assertFalse(result["operations"]["trace"]["ready_for_attempt"])

    def test_standard_rebuild_needs_development_signing_not_just_ldid(self):
        record = baseline()
        record["host"] = {"xcode": {"status": "available"}, "ldid": {"status": "available"}}
        result = capability_plan(record, "standard")
        self.assertTrue(result["operations"]["analyze"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertEqual(result["operations"]["rebuild"]["missing"], ["development_signing"])

    def test_mobile_full_frida_allows_tracing_but_not_device_decryption(self):
        data = baseline()
        for name in ("ssh_mobile", "frida_usb", "ios_mcp"):
            data["probes"][name] = {"status": "available"}
        data["probes"]["frida_root_spawn"] = {"status": "unavailable", "effective_uid": 501}
        result = capability_plan(data, "auto", version=2)
        self.assertEqual(result["selected_mode"], "enhanced")
        for name in ("analyze", "trace", "sandbox"):
            self.assertTrue(result["operations"][name]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertEqual(result["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["missing"], ["frida_root_spawn"])
        # Historical cases retain their original readiness meaning.
        old = capability_plan(data, "auto", version=1)
        self.assertNotIn("capability_model_version", old)
        self.assertTrue(old["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["ready_for_attempt"])

    def test_recovery_readiness_uses_the_actual_helper_route(self):
        data = baseline()
        data["probes"]["ssh_mobile"] = {"status": "available"}
        data["probes"]["frida_root_spawn"] = {"status": "unavailable", "effective_uid": 501}
        # A namespace marker alone must never grant helper readiness.
        data["probes"]["rootless_marker"] = {"roothide_namespace": True}
        self.assertEqual(capability_plan(data, "enhanced")["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["missing"],
                         ["package_recovery_route"])
        data["probes"]["package_recovery_route"] = {
            "status": "available", "device_id": UDID, "identity_verified": True,
            "route": "roothide_mobile_ssh"}
        self.assertTrue(capability_plan(data, "enhanced")["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        self.assertFalse(capability_plan(data, "standard")["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["ready_for_attempt"])
        data["probes"]["package_recovery_route"]["route"] = "rootless_frida_root"
        self.assertEqual(capability_plan(data, "enhanced")["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["missing"],
                         ["frida_usb", "frida_root_spawn"])
        data["probes"]["frida_usb"] = {"status": "available"}
        data["probes"]["frida_root_spawn"] = {"status": "available", "effective_uid": 0}
        self.assertTrue(capability_plan(data, "enhanced")["operations"]["decrypt-device"]["ready_for_attempt"])

    def test_recovery_probe_authenticates_exact_usb_and_matches_helper_dispatch(self):
        from contextlib import nullcontext
        from copyapp.ios_capabilities import _package_recovery_probe
        with patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.exact_ssh_tunnel", return_value=nullcontext(1234)) as tunnel, \
                patch("copyapp.ssh_acquire._ssh_argv", return_value=["pinned-ssh"]) as ssh, \
                patch("copyapp.decrypt_package._is_roothide_ssh", return_value=True) as detect:
            result = _package_recovery_probe(UDID, 1234, Path("key"), Path("hosts"))
        tunnel.assert_called_once_with(UDID, 1234, Path("key"), Path("hosts"))
        ssh.assert_called_once_with(1234, Path("key"), Path("hosts"), "mobile")
        detect.assert_called_once_with(["pinned-ssh"])
        self.assertEqual(result["route"], "roothide_mobile_ssh")
        with patch("copyapp.usb_tunnel.exact_ssh_tunnel", side_effect=RuntimeError("wrong phone")), \
                patch("copyapp.decrypt_package._is_roothide_ssh") as detect:
            self.assertEqual(_package_recovery_probe(UDID, 1234, Path("key"), Path("hosts"))["status"],
                             "unavailable")
            detect.assert_not_called()

    def test_root_readiness_rejects_wrong_device_or_missing_stop_and_retains_v1_cases(self):
```

```py
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
import subprocess
import tempfile
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from copyapp import ios_credentials as credentials
from copyapp.ios_cases import read_json, seal_case, write_json
from copyapp.ios_packages import import_package
from copyapp.ssh_profile import save_ssh_profile
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case
from tests.test_ios_packages import BUNDLE, ipa


UDID = "00008110-001650202E81401E"
SECRET = b"test-credential!"
LICENSE = b"fake-supported-license"
APP = {"CFBundleIdentifier": BUNDLE, "CFBundleVersion": "1",
       "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0", "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
       "Path": "/var/containers/Bundle/Application/SAMPLE/Example.app"}


class FakeDevice:
    instances = []
    roothide = True
    native_id = b"verified-device"
    def __init__(self, command):
        self.command = command
        self.trigger_directory = "/private/var/tmp/fp-trigger-example"
        self.cleaned = False
        self.instances.append(self)
    def path(self, name):
        return "/private/var/tmp/fp-retrieve-example/" + name
    def write(self, name, data, executable=False):
        return self.path(name)
    def run(self, command):
        return b""
    def read(self, path):
        if path.endswith("device-udid.bin"):
            return self.native_id
        if path.endswith("Info.plist"):
            return plistlib.dumps(APP)
        if path.endswith(".sinf"):
            return LICENSE
        if path.endswith("credential.bin"):
            return SECRET
        raise AssertionError("unexpected remote read")
    def cleanup(self):
        self.cleaned = True


class CredentialRetrievalTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.out = self.root / "case"
        self.store = self.root / "private-store"
        self.key = self.root / "identity"
        self.hosts = self.root / "known-hosts"
        self.key.write_text("fake SSH identity")
        self.hosts.write_text("fake pinned host")
        self.sources = {"core.py": hashlib.sha256(b"public source").hexdigest()}
        self.stack = contextlib.ExitStack()
        self.addCleanup(self.stack.close)
        self.stack.enter_context(contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()))
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "CREDENTIAL_SOURCES", self.sources))
        self.target = self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "_target", new=AsyncMock(
            return_value=({"ProductType": "iPhone14,7", "ProductVersion": "17.3.1", "BuildVersion": "21D61"}, dict(APP)))))
        self.tunnel = self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "exact_ssh_tunnel"))
        self.tunnel.return_value.__enter__.return_value = 22317
        self.prepare = self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "_prepare_tool", side_effect=self.prepare_tool))
        self.device = self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "CredentialDevice", FakeDevice))
        FakeDevice.native_id = b"verified-device"
        FakeDevice.instances = []
        self.retriever = SimpleNamespace(
            BUNDLE=self.root, MAX_SINF_BYTES=1048576,
            fairplay_device_id=Mock(return_value=b"verified-device"),
            supported_sinf=Mock(return_value=True), sinf_field=Mock(return_value=b"account"),
            license_sinf=Mock(return_value=LICENSE), restart_fairplayd=Mock(return_value=123),
            observe_uid_layer=Mock())
        self.core = SimpleNamespace(derive_work16=Mock(return_value=b"work"))
        modules = self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(credentials, "_modules"))
        modules.return_value.__enter__.return_value = (self.retriever, self.core)

    def prepare_tool(self, source, output):
        output.mkdir()
        (output / "core.py").write_bytes(b"public source")
        bundle = output / "credential-retrieval/build/bundle"
        bundle.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name in credentials.DEVICE_FILES:
            (bundle / name).write_bytes(b"public helper " + name.encode())
        return {"revision": credentials.FAIRPLAY_REVISION, "sources": self.sources,
                "helpers": {name: sha256_file(bundle / name) for name in credentials.DEVICE_FILES}}

    def run_retrieval(self, **kwargs):
        options = dict(store=self.store, ssh_identity=self.key, ssh_known_hosts=self.hosts)
        options.update(kwargs)
        return credentials.retrieve_credential(UDID, BUNDLE, "account-a", self.out, **options)

    def record(self):
        return read_json(self.out / "retrieval.json")

    def reseal(self):
        record = self.record()
        seal_case(self.out, "ios_fairplay_credential", status=record["status"], bundle_id=BUNDLE)

    def test_success_uses_exact_route_and_keeps_secret_outside_verifiable_case(self):
        _, success = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertTrue(success)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))
        self.assertTrue(FakeDevice.instances[0].cleaned)
        saved = self.store / "account-a.bin"
        self.assertEqual(saved.read_bytes(), SECRET)
        self.assertEqual(saved.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o600)
        self.assertEqual(self.store.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o700)
        self.tunnel.assert_called_once_with(UDID, 22222, self.key, self.hosts, "mobile")
        for path in self.out.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                self.assertNotIn(SECRET, path.read_bytes())
                self.assertNotIn(hashlib.sha256(SECRET).hexdigest().encode(), path.read_bytes())
                self.assertNotIn(str(saved).encode(), path.read_bytes())
        saved.unlink()
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))  # verification never needs the credential

    def test_collision_and_evidence_store_overlap_fail_before_device_work(self):
        for index, overlap in enumerate((False, True)):
            self.out = self.root / ("case" + str(index))
            if overlap:
                selected = self.out / "credentials"
            else:
                selected = self.store
                selected.mkdir()
                (selected / "account-a.bin").write_bytes(SECRET)
            _, complete = self.run_retrieval(store=selected)
            self.assertFalse(complete)
            self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "credential_store_unavailable")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))
        self.target.assert_not_called()
        self.prepare.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual((self.store / "account-a.bin").read_bytes(), SECRET)

    def test_native_identity_mismatch_cleans_and_never_restarts_daemon(self):
        FakeDevice.native_id = b"another-device"
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "device_identity_mismatch")
        self.retriever.restart_fairplayd.assert_not_called()
        self.assertTrue(FakeDevice.instances[0].cleaned)
        self.assertFalse(self.store.exists())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_unsupported_license_does_not_restart_daemon(self):
        self.retriever.supported_sinf.return_value = False
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "unsupported_license")
        self.retriever.restart_fairplayd.assert_not_called()
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_observer_failure_omits_raw_error_and_preserves_failed_case(self):
        self.retriever.observe_uid_layer.side_effect = RuntimeError("private account/session output")
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "observation_failed")
        self.assertTrue(FakeDevice.instances[0].cleaned)
        self.assertFalse(self.store.exists())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))
        self.assertNotIn("private account/session", (self.out / "retrieval.json").read_text())

    def test_interrupted_observation_is_cleaned_and_retained(self):
        self.retriever.observe_uid_layer.side_effect = KeyboardInterrupt()
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "interrupted")
        self.assertTrue(FakeDevice.instances[0].cleaned)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_invalid_credential_is_never_saved(self):
        self.core.derive_work16.side_effect = ValueError("credential does not decode this SINF")
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "credential_validation_failed")
        self.assertFalse(self.store.exists())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_cleanup_failure_does_not_publish_credential(self):
        with patch.object(FakeDevice, "cleanup", side_effect=RuntimeError("SSH cleanup unavailable")):
            _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "cleanup_failed")
        self.assertFalse(self.store.exists())
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def package(self):
        source = self.root / "source.ipa"
        ipa(source)
        package = self.root / "source-package"
        import_package(source, package, BUNDLE)
        return package

    def test_package_account_mismatch_refuses_before_observation(self):
        self.retriever.sinf_field.side_effect = [b"one-account", b"another-account"]
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval(package=self.package())
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "package_account_mismatch")
        self.retriever.restart_fairplayd.assert_not_called()
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_selected_package_requires_two_license_checks_and_detects_rehashed_tampering(self):
        _, complete = self.run_retrieval(package=self.package(), sinf_member="selected.sinf")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.core.derive_work16.call_count, 2)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))
        record = self.record()
        record["stages"]["credential_matches_package_license"] = False
        write_json(self.out / "retrieval.json", record)

        self.assertFalse(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_source_hashes_are_checked_again_even_after_manifest_reseal(self):
        self.run_retrieval()
        (self.out / "tool/core.py").write_bytes(b"modified public source")
        self.reseal()
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_new_reference_and_trusted_host_are_required(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            credentials.retrieve_credential(UDID, BUNDLE, "../escape", self.out)
        self.assertFalse(self.out.exists())
        with patch.object(credentials, "exact_ssh_tunnel", side_effect=RuntimeError("host key mismatch")):
            _, complete = self.run_retrieval()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.record()["error"], "ssh_unavailable")
        self.assertFalse(FakeDevice.instances)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.out))

    def test_alias_create_race_never_overwrites_existing_secret(self):
        self.store.mkdir()
        target = self.store / "account-a.bin"
        target.write_bytes(SECRET)
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            credentials._save_credential(self.store, "account-a", bytes(16))
        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), SECRET)


class PinnedCredentialToolTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_installed_wheel_route_defaults_follow_checkout_and_explicit_flags_win(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            key, hosts = root / "key", root / "hosts"
            key.touch(); hosts.touch()
            save_ssh_profile(UDID, 22317, key, hosts, root / "cases/ssh/profiles.json")
            args = SimpleNamespace(udid=UDID, ssh_port=22222,
                ssh_identity=Path("cases/ssh/id_ed25519"), ssh_known_hosts=Path("cases/ssh-known-hosts"))
            with patch.object(credentials, "source_root", return_value=root):
                credentials.apply_credential_ssh_profile(args, [])
                self.assertEqual(args.ssh_port, 22317)
                self.assertEqual(args.ssh_identity, key.resolve())
                self.assertEqual(args.ssh_known_hosts, hosts.resolve())
                args.ssh_identity = Path("explicit-key")
                credentials.apply_credential_ssh_profile(args, ["--ssh-identity", "explicit-key"])
                self.assertEqual(args.ssh_identity, Path("explicit-key"))

    def test_modified_source_is_rejected_before_build(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            source = root / "source"
            source.mkdir()
            (source / "core.py").write_bytes(b"unreviewed code")
            pins = {"core.py": hashlib.sha256(b"reviewed code").hexdigest()}
            with patch.object(credentials, "CREDENTIAL_SOURCES", pins), \
                    patch.object(credentials.subprocess, "run") as build:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(credentials.RetrievalError, "tool_unavailable_or_modified"):
                    credentials._prepare_tool(source, root / "output")
                build.assert_not_called()

    def test_remote_commands_enforce_strict_pinned_ssh_without_auto_auth_fallback(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            identity, hosts = root / "identity", root / "known-hosts"
            identity.touch(); hosts.touch()
            command = credentials._ssh_argv(22317, identity, hosts, "mobile")
            self.assertIn("StrictHostKeyChecking=yes", command)
            self.assertIn("BatchMode=yes", command)
            self.assertIn("IdentitiesOnly=yes", command)
            self.assertIn("mobile@127.0.0.1", command)
```

`tests/test_ios_cross_check.py`:

```py
"""Cross-check policy fixtures are not real FairPlay decryption evidence."""

import copy
import unittest

from copyapp.ios_cross_check import compare_recoveries


class OfflineCrossCheckTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.rows = [{"path": name, "uuid": uuid, "cryptoff": 64, "cryptsize": 8,
                      "encrypted_sha256": "1" * 64, "decrypted_sha256": "2" * 64,
                      "only_cryptid_and_encrypted_region_changed": True}
                     for name, uuid in (("Payload/App.app/Main", "3" * 32),
                                        ("Payload/App.app/PlugIns/Share.appex/Share", "4" * 32))]
        self.offline = {"status": "complete", "strategy": "fairplay_offline", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                        "plaintext_validation": "structural_only", "recovered_binaries": self.rows}
        self.device = {"bundle_id": "com.example.app", "installed_version": "1.0", "installed_build": "1",
                       "recovered_binaries": copy.deepcopy(self.rows)}
        self.package = {"bundle_id": "com.example.app", "version": "1.0", "build": "1"}

    def test_all_programs_must_match_in_source_and_recovered_bytes(self):
        result = compare_recoveries(self.offline, self.device, self.package)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["uuid"], "4" * 32)

    def test_an_unencrypted_passthrough_cannot_supply_positive_decryption_evidence(self):
        self.offline["strategy"] = "source_already_unencrypted"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "genuine recovery"):
            compare_recoveries(self.offline, self.device, self.package)

    def test_different_build_or_partial_extension_inventory_is_rejected(self):
        changed = dict(self.package, build="2")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            compare_recoveries(self.offline, self.device, changed)
        self.device["recovered_binaries"].pop()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "extension coverage"):
            compare_recoveries(self.offline, self.device, self.package)

    def test_matching_decrypted_hash_does_not_hide_wrong_encrypted_source_or_uuid(self):
        for key, value in (("encrypted_sha256", "5" * 64), ("uuid", "6" * 32),
                           ("decrypted_sha256", "7" * 64), ("cryptoff", 80)):
            with self.subTest(key=key):
                device = copy.deepcopy(self.device)
                device["recovered_binaries"][0][key] = value
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "binary identity"):
                    compare_recoveries(self.offline, device, self.package)
```
