`tests/test_ios_mcp.py`:

```py
import base64
import json
import threading
import unittest
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from copyapp.ios_mcp import IOSMCPClient, IOSMCPError


class FakeIOSMCP(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    calls = []
    server_name = "copyapp-ios-mcp"

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass

    def _respond(self, value):
        data = json.dumps(value).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Mcp-Session-Id", "test-session")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._respond({"status": "ok", "server": self.server_name,
                       "supportedProtocolVersions": ["2025-06-18"]})

    def do_POST(self):
        packet = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
        self.calls.append((packet, self.headers.get("Mcp-Session-Id")))
        if packet["method"] == "initialize":
            result = {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18"}
        elif packet["params"]["name"] == "screenshot":
            result = {"content": [{"type": "image", "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
                                   "data": base64.b64encode(b"\xff\xd8\xff\xd9").decode()}]}
        else:
            result = {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": '{"tapped":true}'}]}
        self._respond({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": packet["id"], "result": result})


class IOSMCPClientTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeIOSMCP)
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.thread.join()

    def setUp(self):
        FakeIOSMCP.calls = []
        FakeIOSMCP.server_name = "copyapp-ios-mcp"
        self.client = IOSMCPClient(port=self.server.server_port)

    def test_ui_call_uses_session_and_rejects_shell(self):
        self.client.initialize()
        result = self.client.call_ui("tap_screen", {"x": 20, "y": 30})
        self.assertEqual(self.client.text_json(result), {"tapped": True})
        self.assertEqual(FakeIOSMCP.calls[-1][1], "test-session")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.client.call_ui("run_command", {"command": "id"})
        self.assertEqual(len(FakeIOSMCP.calls), 2)

    def test_device_ocr_is_blocked_before_rpc(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.client.call_ui("ocr_screen")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.client.call_ui("describe_screen", {"include_ocr": True})
        self.assertEqual(FakeIOSMCP.calls, [])

    def test_screenshot_bytes(self):
        self.client.initialize()
        image = self.client.image_bytes(self.client.call_ui("screenshot"))
        self.assertEqual(image, b"\xff\xd8\xff\xd9")

    def test_bad_port(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            IOSMCPClient(port=0)

    def test_rejects_unmodified_upstream_server(self):
        FakeIOSMCP.server_name = "ios-mcp"
        with self.assertRaises(IOSMCPError):
            self.client.initialize()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ios_packages.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import io
import plistlib
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from zipfile import ZipFile

from tests.test_decrypt_package import binary
from copyapp.ios_cases import read_json, seal_case, write_json
from copyapp.ios_offline import FAIRPLAY_REVISION, decrypt_offline
from copyapp.ios_packages import download_package, import_package
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


BUNDLE = "com.example.test"
MAIN = "Payload/Example.app/Example"
EXTENSION = "Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Share.appex/Share"
SECRET = b"0123456789abcdef"


def ipa(path, encrypted=True, fat=False):
    executable = binary(encrypted)
    if fat:
        header = struct.pack(">IIiiIII", 0xCAFEBABE, 1, 0x0100000C, 0, 32, len(executable), 0)
        executable = header.ljust(32, b"\0") + executable
    with ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/Info.plist", plistlib.dumps({
            "CFBundleIdentifier": BUNDLE, "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
            "CFBundleVersion": "1", "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0",
            "CFBundleSupportedPlatforms": ["iPhoneOS"]}))
        archive.writestr(MAIN, executable)
        archive.writestr(EXTENSION, binary(encrypted))
        archive.writestr("Payload/Example.app/resource.txt", b"resource")


class IosPackageTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.source = self.root / "source.ipa"
        ipa(self.source)
        self.package = self.root / "package"
        import_package(self.source, self.package, BUNDLE)
        self.credentials = self.root / "credentials"
        self.credentials.mkdir()
        (self.credentials / "main.bin").write_bytes(SECRET)
        self.tool = self.root / "ipatool"
        self.tool.write_bytes(b"fake ipatool executable")
        self.console = redirect_stdout(io.StringIO())
        self.console.__enter__()
        self.addCleanup(self.console.__exit__, None, None, None)

    def test_import_retains_exact_source_and_survives_copying(self):
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.package))
        self.assertEqual(sha256_file(self.source), sha256_file(self.package / "input.ipa"))
        copied = self.root / "copied"
        shutil.copytree(self.package, copied)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(copied))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Bundle ID"):
            import_package(self.source, self.root / "wrong", "com.another.app")

    def test_unencrypted_input_is_unchanged_and_never_claims_a_decrypt(self):
        plain = self.root / "plain.ipa"
        ipa(plain, encrypted=False)
        imported = self.root / "plain-package"
        import_package(plain, imported)
        with patch("copyapp.ios_offline._prepare_tool") as prepare:
            _, complete = decrypt_offline(imported, self.root / "offline")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "offline"))
        prepare.assert_not_called()
        record = read_json(self.root / "offline/offline.json")
        self.assertEqual(record["strategy"], "source_already_unencrypted")
        self.assertEqual(record["recovered_binaries"], [])
        self.assertIsNone(record["credential_ref"])

    def test_missing_and_invalid_credentials_are_verified_failed_attempts(self):
        for reference in [None, "../../escape", "absent"]:
            out = self.root / ("missing-" + str(len(list(self.root.iterdir()))))
            with patch("copyapp.ios_offline._prepare_tool") as prepare:
                _, complete = decrypt_offline(self.package, out, credential_ref=reference,
                                               credential_store=self.credentials)
            self.assertFalse(complete)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
            self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "offline.json")["error"], "credential_unavailable")
            prepare.assert_not_called()

    def _offline_fixture(self, mutation=None, checkout_defaults=False):
        # Adapter fixture: this tests byte audits, not FairPlay cryptography.
        sources = {"decrypt.py": b"fixture", "core.py": b"fixture core", "transform.c": b"fixture c",
                   "transform_const_data.bin": b"fixture constants"}
        hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, data in sources.items()}

        def prepare(_source, out):
            self.last_prepared_source = _source
            out.mkdir()
            for name, data in sources.items():
                (out / name).write_bytes(data)
            (out / "transform").write_bytes(b"fixture executable")
            return {"name": "EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt", "revision": FAIRPLAY_REVISION,
                    "sources": hashes, "transform_sha256": sha256_file(out / "transform"),
                    "python_version": "fixture"}

        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            with ZipFile(command[4]) as before, ZipFile(command[5], "w") as after:
                for info in before.infolist():
                    value = before.read(info.filename)
                    if info.filename in (MAIN, EXTENSION):
                        value = binary(False)
                    if mutation:
                        value = mutation(info.filename, value)
                    after.writestr(info, value)
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, SECRET + b" session=token", SECRET)

        from contextlib import ExitStack
        stack = ExitStack()
        stack.enter_context(patch("copyapp.ios_offline.FAIRPLAY_FILES", hashes))
        stack.enter_context(patch("copyapp.ios_offline._prepare_tool", side_effect=prepare))
        stack.enter_context(patch("copyapp.ios_offline.subprocess.run", side_effect=run))
        self.addCleanup(stack.close)
        out = self.root / "offline"
        _, complete = decrypt_offline(self.package, out, None if checkout_defaults else Path("fixture"),
                                       "main", None if checkout_defaults else self.credentials)
        return out, complete

    def test_offline_defaults_use_explicit_checkout_without_copying_credential_contents(self):
        store = self.root / "cases/credentials/fairplay"
        store.mkdir(parents=True)
        shutil.copyfile(self.credentials / "main.bin", store / "main.bin")
        with patch("copyapp.ios_offline.source_root", return_value=self.root):
            output, complete = self._offline_fixture(checkout_defaults=True)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(self.last_prepared_source, self.root / "toolchains/fairplay-decrypt-src")
        self.assertNotIn(str(store), (output / "offline.json").read_text())

    def test_all_binaries_and_resources_audited_without_claiming_plaintext_correctness(self):
        out, complete = self._offline_fixture()
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
        record = read_json(out / "offline.json")
        self.assertEqual(len(record["recovered_binaries"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(record["plaintext_validation"], "structural_only")
        for path in out.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file() and path.suffix in (".json", ".md", ".txt", ".log"):
                self.assertNotIn(SECRET, path.read_bytes())
                self.assertNotIn(b"session=token", path.read_bytes())

    def test_partial_decoder_success_cannot_hide_an_encrypted_extension(self):
        out, complete = self._offline_fixture(lambda name, value: binary(True) if name == EXTENSION else value)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
        self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "offline.json")["error"], "package_audit_failed")

    def test_thin_x86_64_magic_is_not_accepted_as_arm64(self):
        source = self.root / "x86.ipa"
        with ZipFile(self.source) as before, ZipFile(source, "w") as after:
            for info in before.infolist():
                value = before.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename == MAIN:
                    value = bytearray(value)
                    struct.pack_into("<I", value, 4, 0x01000007)
                after.writestr(info, value)
        package = self.root / "x86-package"
        import_package(source, package)
        with patch("copyapp.ios_offline._prepare_tool") as tool:
            _, complete = decrypt_offline(package, self.root / "x86-offline")
            tool.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(read_json(self.root / "x86-offline/offline.json")["error"], "unsupported_binary_inventory")

    def test_unsupported_embedded_macho_is_indexed_and_blocks_false_package_success(self):
        source = self.root / "embedded32.ipa"
        ipa(source, encrypted=False)
        hidden = "Payload/Example.app/PlugIns/Other.appex/Other"
        with ZipFile(source, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr(hidden, b"\xce\xfa\xed\xfe" + bytes(60))
        package = self.root / "embedded32-package"
        import_package(source, package)
        self.assertEqual(read_json(package / "package-index.json")["unsupported_binaries"][0]["path"], hidden)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(package))
        with patch("copyapp.ios_offline._prepare_tool") as decoder:
            _, complete = decrypt_offline(package, self.root / "embedded32-offline")
            decoder.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.root / "embedded32-offline"))

    def test_unencrypted_selected_fat_slice_does_not_prove_other_slices_are_clear(self):
        source = self.root / "fat-clear-selected.ipa"
        ipa(source, encrypted=False, fat=True)
        package = self.root / "fat-clear-package"
        import_package(source, package)
        _, complete = decrypt_offline(package, self.root / "fat-clear-offline")
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(read_json(self.root / "fat-clear-offline/offline.json")["error"], "unsupported_binary_inventory")

    def test_macho_outside_primary_app_is_not_silently_omitted(self):
        source = self.root / "extra-program.ipa"
        ipa(source, encrypted=False)
        with ZipFile(source, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr("Payload/UnindexedProgram", binary(True))
        package = self.root / "extra-package"
        import_package(source, package)
        row = read_json(package / "package-index.json")["unsupported_binaries"][0]
        self.assertEqual(row["path"], "Payload/UnindexedProgram")
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "unsupported_macho_location")
        self.assertFalse(decrypt_offline(package, self.root / "extra-offline")[1])

    def test_resource_or_out_of_range_changes_fail_independent_audit(self):
        def mutation(name, value):
            if name == MAIN:
                changed = bytearray(value)
                changed[60] = 7
                return bytes(changed)
            return value
        out, complete = self._offline_fixture(mutation)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))

    def test_cryptid_zero_without_changed_code_is_not_recovery(self):
        def mutation(name, value):
            if name == MAIN:
                original = bytearray(binary(True))
                struct.pack_into("<I", original, 48, 0)
                return bytes(original)
            return value
        out, complete = self._offline_fixture(mutation)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))

    def test_rehashed_recovered_resource_mutation_is_rejected(self):
        out, complete = self._offline_fixture()
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        recovered = out / "analysis.ipa"
        with ZipFile(recovered) as archive:
            members = [(item, archive.read(item.filename)) for item in archive.infolist()]
        with ZipFile(recovered, "w") as archive:
            for info, value in members:
                archive.writestr(info, b"changed" if info.filename.endswith("resource.txt") else value)
        record = read_json(out / "offline.json")
        record["analysis_ipa_sha256"] = sha256_file(recovered)
        write_json(out / "offline.json", record)
        seal_case(out, "ios_offline_package", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(out))

    def test_fat_input_is_explicitly_rejected_until_all_slice_audits_exist(self):
        source = self.root / "fat.ipa"
        ipa(source, fat=True)
        package = self.root / "fat-package"
        import_package(source, package)
        out = self.root / "fat-offline"
        _, complete = decrypt_offline(package, out)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "offline.json")["error"], "unsupported_binary_inventory")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))

    def test_download_pins_tool_and_version_without_retaining_account_output(self):
        calls = []
        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            calls.append(command)
            if "--version" in command:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"ipatool version 2.7.0", b"")
            shutil.copyfile(self.source, Path(command[command.index("--output") + 1]))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b'email=private@example.test token=SECRET', SECRET)
        out = self.root / "download"
        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            _, complete = download_package(BUNDLE, out, self.tool, "12345")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
        self.assertIn("--non-interactive", calls[-1])
        self.assertNotIn("--purchase", calls[-1])
        for path in out.glob("*.json"):
            self.assertNotIn(b"private@example.test", path.read_bytes())
            self.assertNotIn(SECRET, path.read_bytes())

    def _download_with_metadata(self, metadata, name):
        source = self.root / (name + ".ipa")
        shutil.copyfile(self.source, source)
        with ZipFile(source, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr("iTunesMetadata.plist", plistlib.dumps(metadata))

        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            if "--version" in command:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"ipatool version 2.7.0", b"")
            shutil.copyfile(source, Path(command[command.index("--output") + 1]))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"private account output", b"")

        out = self.root / name
        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            _, complete = download_package(BUNDLE, out, self.tool)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
        return out

    def test_download_records_only_storefront_id_with_explicit_package_basis(self):
        out = self._download_with_metadata({"s": 143465, "apple-id": "private@example.test",
                                            "userName": "private person", "token": "private token"}, "storefront")
        record = read_json(out / "package.json")
        self.assertEqual(record["download_provenance_version"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(record["storefront"], {"id": "143465", "basis": "downloaded_package_metadata",
                                               "source": "input.ipa:iTunesMetadata.plist:s",
                                               "account_region_verified": False})
        for path in out.iterdir():
            if path.suffix in (".json", ".md"):
                for secret in ("private@example.test", "private person", "private token"):
                    self.assertNotIn(secret, path.read_text())
        original = read_json(out / "package.json")
        for field, forged in (("id", "143441"), ("account_region_verified", True),
                              ("basis", "account_region_independently_verified")):
            record = {**original, "storefront": {**original["storefront"], field: forged}}
            write_json(out / "package.json", record)
            seal_case(out, "ios_package", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE, source_type="appstore_download")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(out))
        original.pop("download_provenance_version")
        write_json(out / "package.json", original)
        seal_case(out, "ios_package", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE, source_type="appstore_download")
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(out))

    def test_missing_or_nonpublic_storefront_remains_explicitly_unknown(self):
        for number, value in enumerate([None, True, "private@example.test", "143465-token", 123456789]):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                out = self._download_with_metadata({} if value is None else {"s": value}, f"unknown-{number}")
                self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "package.json")["storefront"],
                                 {"id": None, "basis": "unavailable", "account_region_verified": False})
        out = self._download_with_metadata({"s": "143465"}, "string-storefront")
        self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "package.json")["storefront"]["id"], "143465")

    def test_historical_download_provenance_is_not_reinterpreted(self):
        out = self._download_with_metadata({"s": 143465}, "legacy-download")
        record = read_json(out / "package.json")
        record.pop("download_provenance_version")
        record["storefront"] = "account_selected_not_independently_verified"
        write_json(out / "package.json", record)
        seal_case(out, "ios_package", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE, source_type="appstore_download")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))

    def test_malformed_store_metadata_is_a_retained_failed_download(self):
        source = self.root / "malformed.ipa"
        shutil.copyfile(self.source, source)
        with ZipFile(source, "a") as archive:
            archive.writestr("iTunesMetadata.plist", plistlib.dumps(["not a metadata dictionary"]))

        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            if "--version" in command:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"ipatool version 2.7.0", b"")
            shutil.copyfile(source, Path(command[command.index("--output") + 1]))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"", b"")

        out = self.root / "malformed-download"
        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            _, complete = download_package(BUNDLE, out, self.tool)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "package.json")["error"], "invalid_download_or_package")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))

    def test_unreviewed_tool_version_is_rejected_before_account_download(self):
        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess(
                [], 0, b"ipatool version 9.9.9", b"")) as runner:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "reviewed 2.7.0"):
                download_package(BUNDLE, self.root / "unsupported-tool", self.tool)
            self.assertEqual(runner.call_count, 1)

    def test_default_ipatool_comes_from_configured_source_checkout(self):
        tool = self.root / "toolchains/bin/ipatool"
        tool.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        shutil.copyfile(self.tool, tool)

        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(command[0], str(tool.resolve()))
            if "--version" in command:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"2.7.0", b"")
            shutil.copyfile(self.source, Path(command[command.index("--output") + 1]))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"", b"")

        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.source_root", return_value=self.root), \
                patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            _, complete = download_package(BUNDLE, self.root / "default-download")
        self.assertTrue(complete)

    def test_wrong_app_download_and_account_failure_never_become_success(self):
        def run(command, **_kwargs):
            if "--version" in command:
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"2.7.0", b"")
            shutil.copyfile(self.source, Path(command[command.index("--output") + 1]))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, b"", b"")
        out = self.root / "wrong-download"
        with patch("copyapp.ios_packages.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            _, complete = download_package("com.other.app", out, self.tool)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(out))
        self.assertEqual(read_json(out / "package.json")["error"], "package_identity_or_structure_mismatch")
```

`tests/test_ipa_assets.py`:

```py
import json
import plistlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
from zipfile import ZipFile

from copyapp.ipa import analyze_ipa, write_ipa_report
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


class IPAAssetCatalogTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_catalog_names_bind_to_source_ipa_and_variants(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            ipa = root / "Target.ipa"
            with ZipFile(ipa, "w") as archive:
                archive.writestr("Payload/Target.app/Info.plist", plistlib.dumps({
                    "CFBundleIdentifier": "example.target", "CFBundleExecutable": "Target",
                }))
                archive.writestr("Payload/Target.app/Target", b"ordinary-file")
                archive.writestr("Payload/Target.app/Assets.car", b"catalog-bytes")

            rows = [{"SchemaVersion": 2},
                    {"Name": "Login/lock", "AssetType": "Image", "Scale": 1,
                     "PixelWidth": 28, "PixelHeight": 28},
                    {"Name": "Login/lock", "AssetType": "Vector", "Scale": 2,
                     "PixelWidth": 56, "PixelHeight": 56},
                    {"Name": "Auth/google", "AssetType": "Image", "RenditionName": "google.svg"}]

            def fake_assetutil(command, *, stdout, stderr, timeout, check):
                self.assertEqual(command[:3], ["xcrun", "assetutil", "--info"])
                self.assertEqual(timeout, 45)
                stdout.write(json.dumps(rows).encode())
                return SimpleNamespace(returncode=0)

            with patch("copyapp.ipa.shutil.which", return_value="/usr/bin/xcrun"), \
                    patch("copyapp.ipa.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_assetutil):
                index = analyze_ipa(ipa)
            catalog = index["asset_catalogs"][0]
            self.assertEqual(catalog["status"], "indexed")
            self.assertEqual(catalog["asset_count"], 2)
            self.assertEqual(catalog["assets"][1]["name"], "Login/lock")
            self.assertEqual(catalog["assets"][1]["pixel_sizes"], [[28, 28], [56, 56]])
            self.assertEqual(catalog["assets"][1]["variant_count"], 2)

            output = root / "index"
            write_ipa_report(index, output)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
            ipa.write_bytes(ipa.read_bytes() + b"changed")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(output))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_macos.py`:

```py
"""Mac provenance and failure-mode checks alongside the unchanged iOS suite."""

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import plistlib
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.macos.case import Case, canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import ChatComputer, ChatComputerError, UnknownCompletion
from copyapp.macos.doctor import doctor
from copyapp.macos.package import app_facts, index_app
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


def make_app(root, *, platform=1, cpu=0x0100000C):
    app = root / "Example.app"
    (app / "Contents/MacOS").mkdir(parents=True)
    (app / "Contents/Info.plist").write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({
        "CFBundleIdentifier": "test.copyapp.example", "CFBundleExecutable": "Example",
        "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL", "CFBundleVersion": "1",
        "CFBundleShortVersionString": "1.0"}))
    header = struct.pack("<8I", 0xFEEDFACF, cpu, 0, 2, 1, 24, 0, 0)
    command = struct.pack("<6I", 0x32, 24, platform, 0x0e0000, 0x0e0000, 0)
    (app / "Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(header + command)
    (app / "Contents/MacOS/Example").chmod(0o755)
    return app


def make_server(root: Path, *, behavior="normal"):
    """A real child process, testing framing/deadlines rather than mocking reads."""
    image = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new("RGB", (16, 12), "blue").save(image, format="PNG")
    encoded = base64.b64encode(image.getvalue()).decode()
    script = root / "chatcomputer"
    log = root / "calls.jsonl"
    source = '''import json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
log=Path(LOG)
for line in sys.stdin:
    request=json.loads(line)
    if 'id' not in request: continue
    method=request['method']
    if method=='initialize': result={'serverInfo':{'name':'chatcomputer','version':'0.9.11'}}
    elif method=='tools/list': result={'tools':[{'name':s} for s in ['status','screenshot','release','click']]}
    else:
        name=request['params']['name']
        with log.open('a') as out: out.write(json.dumps(request)+'\\n')
        if name=='click' and BEHAVIOR=='disconnect': sys.exit(0)
        if name=='click' and BEHAVIOR=='timeout': time.sleep(5)
        if name=='screenshot': result={'isError':False,'content':[{'type':'image','mimeType':'image/png','data':IMAGE}]}
        else: result={'isError':False,'content':[{'type':'text','text':'Virtual Mac: running, desktop ready'}]}
        if BEHAVIOR=='tool-error': result={'isError':True,'content':[{'type':'text','text':'Guest channel failed after dispatch'}]}
    ident=request['id']+1 if BEHAVIOR=='wrong-id' else request['id']
    print(json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':ident,'result':result}),flush=True)
'''
    # Source literals are Python literals, not shell fragments.
    source = (source.replace("LOG", repr(str(log))).replace("BEHAVIOR", repr(behavior))
              .replace("IMAGE", repr(encoded)))
    script.write_text("#!" + sys.executable + "\n" + source)
    script.chmod(0o755)
    return str(script), log


class MacPackageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_snapshot_is_portable_and_source_changes_do_not_mutate_it(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            app = make_app(root)
            (app / "Contents/Resources").mkdir()
            (app / "Contents/Resources/alias").symlink_to("../Info.plist")
            case = index_app(app, root / "case")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            (app / "Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(b"updated on source")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            (case / "app/Example.app/Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(b"tampered")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_complete_inventory_detects_added_file_and_link_changes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            case = index_app(make_app(root), root / "case")
            extra = case / "app/Example.app/Contents/extra"
            extra.write_bytes(b"injected")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))
            extra.unlink()
            extra.symlink_to("Info.plist")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_snapshot_does_not_copy_protected_system_flags(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            app = make_app(root)
            with patch("shutil.copystat", side_effect=PermissionError("restricted system flags")):
                case = index_app(app, root / "case")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))

    def test_rejects_ios_and_intel_as_native_mac(self):
        for platform, cpu in ((2, 0x0100000C), (7, 0x0100000C),
                              (0, 0x0100000C), (1, 0x01000007)):
            with self.subTest(platform=platform, cpu=cpu), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    app_facts(make_app(Path(folder), platform=platform, cpu=cpu))

    def test_catalyst_runtime_is_bound_to_binary_even_after_rehash(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            case = index_app(make_app(root, platform=6), root / "case")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            index_path = case / "app-index.json"
            index = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(index["app"]["runtime"], "mac_catalyst")
            self.assertEqual(index["app"]["macho_platform"], 6)
            del index["app"]["runtime"]
            del index["app"]["macho_platform"]
            index_path.write_bytes(canonical(index))
            manifest_path = case / "manifest.json"
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
            for item in manifest["evidence"]:
                if item["path"] == "app-index.json":
                    item["sha256"] = digest(index_path)
            manifest_path.write_bytes(canonical(manifest))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_conflicting_mac_and_catalyst_platforms_are_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            app = make_app(Path(folder), platform=6)
            binary = app / "Contents/MacOS/Example"
            data = bytearray(binary.read_bytes())
            struct.pack_into("<II", data, 16, 2, 48)
            data.extend(struct.pack("<6I", 0x32, 24, 1, 0x0e0000, 0x0e0000, 0))
            binary.write_bytes(data)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                app_facts(app)

    def test_rejects_external_bundle_symlink_and_nested_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            app = make_app(root)
            (root / "outside").write_text("outside")
            link = app / "Contents/link"
            link.symlink_to("../../outside")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                index_app(app, root / "case")
            link.unlink()
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                index_app(app, app / "case")

    def test_legacy_looking_file_cannot_bypass_mac_validation(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            case = index_app(make_app(root), root / "case")
            (case / "report-index.json").write_text('{"artifacts":{}}')
            (case / "app/Example.app/Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(b"wrong")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_rejects_kind_platform_scope_and_app_identity_changes(self):
        for key, value in (("kind", "mac_unknown"), ("platform", "ios"),
                           ("scope", "installed"), ("bundle_id", "other.app")):
            with self.subTest(key=key), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                root = Path(folder)
                case = index_app(make_app(root), root / "case")
                manifest = json.loads((case / "manifest.json").read_text())
                manifest[key] = value
                (case / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical(manifest))
                self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_records_full_and_arm64_slice_hashes_for_universal(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            app = make_app(Path(folder))
            executable = app / "Contents/MacOS/Example"
            arm64 = executable.read_bytes()
            offset = 4096
            fat = struct.pack(">7I", 0xCAFEBABE, 1, 0x0100000C, 0, offset, len(arm64), 12)
            executable.write_bytes(fat.ljust(offset, b"\0") + arm64)
            facts = app_facts(app)
            self.assertNotEqual(facts["binary_sha256"], facts["arm64_sha256"])


class MacMCPTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_stdio_session_image_and_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            executable, log = make_server(Path(folder))
            with ChatComputer(executable, timeout=2) as client:
                self.assertIn("desktop ready", client.text(client.call("status")))
                data, mime = client.image(client.call("screenshot"))
                self.assertEqual(mime, "image/png")
                self.assertTrue(data.startswith(b"\x89PNG"))
                client.call("click", {"x": 2, "y": 3})
                client.call("release")
            calls = [json.loads(line)["params"]["name"] for line in log.read_text().splitlines()]
            self.assertEqual(calls, ["status", "screenshot", "click", "release"])

    def test_dropped_or_late_action_response_is_unknown_and_never_retried(self):
        for behavior in ("disconnect", "timeout"):
            with self.subTest(behavior=behavior), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                executable, log = make_server(Path(folder), behavior=behavior)
                # The short bound tests the action reply, not Python process
                # startup/initialize under concurrent native build load.
                with ChatComputer(executable, timeout=2) as client:
                    client.timeout = 0.3
                    with self.assertRaises(UnknownCompletion):
                        client.call("click", {"x": 1, "y": 1})
                    with self.assertRaises(ChatComputerError):
                        client.call("click", {"x": 1, "y": 1})
                self.assertEqual(len(log.read_text().splitlines()), 1)

    def test_rejects_wrong_response_id(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            executable, _ = make_server(Path(folder), behavior="wrong-id")
            with self.assertRaises(ChatComputerError):
                with ChatComputer(executable, timeout=2):
                    self.fail("must not admit a mismatched JSON-RPC response")

    def test_mutating_error_reply_retains_envelope_and_closes_without_retry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            executable, log = make_server(Path(folder), behavior="tool-error")
            with ChatComputer(executable, timeout=2) as client:
                with self.assertRaises(UnknownCompletion) as caught:
                    client.call("click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})
                evidence = caught.exception.chatcomputer_evidence
                self.assertEqual(evidence["request"]["params"], {"name": "click", "arguments": {"x": 1, "y": 2}})
                self.assertEqual(evidence["request"]["id"], evidence["response"]["id"])
                self.assertTrue(evidence["response"]["result"]["isError"])
                self.assertEqual(evidence["transport_id"], client.transport_id)
                self.assertIsNone(client.process)
                with self.assertRaises(ChatComputerError): client.call("click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})
            self.assertEqual(len(log.read_text().splitlines()), 1)

    def test_read_only_error_reply_is_not_unknown_mutation(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            executable, log = make_server(Path(folder), behavior="tool-error")
            with ChatComputer(executable, timeout=2) as client:
                with self.assertRaises(ChatComputerError) as caught:
                    client.call("status")
                self.assertNotIsInstance(caught.exception, UnknownCompletion)
                self.assertEqual(caught.exception.chatcomputer_evidence["request"]["params"]["name"], "status")
                self.assertIsNotNone(client.process)
            self.assertEqual(len(log.read_text().splitlines()), 1)

    def test_doctor_ready_is_only_transport_and_image_tampering_fails(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            executable, _ = make_server(root)
            with patch("copyapp.macos.doctor.sys.platform", "darwin"):
                case, ready = doctor(root / "doctor", executable, timeout=2)
            self.assertTrue(ready)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            record = json.loads((case / "doctor.json").read_text())
            self.assertFalse(record["exact_app_identity_ready"])
            (case / "screen.png").write_bytes(b"not the captured screen")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_unavailable_tooling_is_a_verifiable_needs_setup_case(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            case, ready = doctor(Path(folder) / "doctor", "/does/not/exist")
            self.assertFalse(ready)
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((case / "manifest.json").read_text())["status"], "needs_setup")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import plistlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from uuid import uuid4

from copyapp.macos.bridge import Collector, atomic_json
from copyapp.macos.case import canonical
from copyapp.macos.chatcomputer import UnknownCompletion
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


def answer(client, *, change=None):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 2
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        files = list(client.requests.glob("*.json"))
        if files:
            request = json.loads(files[0].read_text())
            response = {"protocol_version": 2, "session_id": client.session,
                        "request_id": request["request_id"],
                        "request_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(request)).hexdigest(),
                        "collector_sha256": client.hash, "collector_instance": str(uuid4()),
                        "status": "complete", "result": {"ready": True}}
            if change:
                response.update(change)
            atomic_json(client.responses / files[0].name, response)
            return
        time.sleep(0.01)
    raise AssertionError("no collector request was written")


class BridgeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_invalid_quiesce_never_writes_a_request(self):
        for params in ({"seconds": 0}, {"seconds": 61}, {"seconds": True},
                       {"seconds": 1.5}, {"seconds": "1"}, {"seconds": 1, "extra": 2}):
            with self.subTest(params=params), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                with Collector(Path(folder), "a" * 64) as client:
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError): client.call("quiesce", params)
                    self.assertIsNone(client.last_request)
                    self.assertEqual(list(client.requests.glob("*.json")), [])

    def test_new_epoch_keeps_lock_and_rejects_old_reply(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            with Collector(Path(folder), "a" * 64, timeout=2) as client:
                worker = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=(client,))
                worker.start(); client.call("health"); worker.join()
                old_session, old_responses = client.session, client.responses
                old_files = list(old_responses.glob("*.json"))
                client.new_session()
                self.assertNotEqual(client.session, old_session)
                self.assertIsNone(client.instance)
                self.assertTrue(all(path.exists() for path in old_files))
                with self.assertRaises(BlockingIOError): Collector(Path(folder), "a" * 64)
                worker = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=(client,), kwargs={"change": {"session_id": old_session}})
                worker.start()
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): client.call("health")
                worker.join()
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError): client.new_session()

    def test_bound_response_and_exclusive_session(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            with Collector(root, "a" * 64, timeout=2) as client:
                with self.assertRaises(BlockingIOError):
                    Collector(root, "a" * 64)
                worker = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=(client,))
                worker.start()
                result = client.call("health")
                worker.join()
                self.assertTrue(result["response"]["result"]["ready"])
            with Collector(root, "a" * 64) as second:
                self.assertNotEqual(client.session, second.session)

    def test_rejects_stale_session_modified_request_and_wrong_build(self):
        for change in ({"session_id": str(uuid4())}, {"request_sha256": "b" * 64},
                       {"collector_sha256": "b" * 64}):
            with self.subTest(change=change), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                with Collector(Path(folder), "a" * 64, timeout=2) as client:
                    worker = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=(client,), kwargs={"change": change})
                    worker.start()
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        client.call("health")
                    worker.join()
                    self.assertTrue(client.closed)

    def test_timeout_preserves_request_and_does_not_reissue(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            with Collector(Path(folder), "a" * 64, timeout=0.1) as client:
                with self.assertRaises(UnknownCompletion) as caught:
                    client.call("health")
                self.assertEqual(caught.exception.collector_evidence["request"]["method"], "health")
                self.assertIsNone(caught.exception.collector_evidence["response"])
                self.assertEqual(len(list(client.requests.glob("*.json"))), 1)
                with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                    client.call("health")
                self.assertEqual(len(list(client.requests.glob("*.json"))), 1)

    def test_rejects_linked_outbox_reply(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            outside = root / "other"
            outside.mkdir()
            (root / "outbox").symlink_to(outside, target_is_directory=True)
            with Collector(root, "a" * 64, timeout=2) as client:
                worker = threading.Thread(target=answer, args=(client,))
                worker.start()
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    client.call("health")
                worker.join()

                    value = json.loads(old_bytes)
                    change(value)
                    artifact.write_bytes(canonical(value))
                    updated = json.loads(old_manifest)
                    for record in updated["evidence"]:
                        if record["path"] == relative:
                            record["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    (case_root / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical(updated))
                    try:
                        self.assertFalse(verify_case(case_root), relative)
                    finally:
                        artifact.write_bytes(old_bytes)
                        (case_root / "manifest.json").write_bytes(old_manifest)

                for item in manifest["evidence"]:

                        item["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

                self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))
            finally:
                process.terminate()
                process.communicate(timeout=5)

    def test_build_artifact_real_swift_protocol_and_tamper_rejection(self):
        # This is explicitly a local filesystem probe, not guest/VM acceptance.
        from copyapp.macos.setup import build_collector
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            app = build_collector(root / "build")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root / "build"))
            binary = app / "Contents/MacOS/CopyAppMacCollector"
            metadata = json.loads((root / "build/collector-build.json").read_text())
            shared = root / "shared"
            shared.mkdir()
            process = subprocess.Popen([str(binary), "--shared-root", str(shared)],
                                       stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
            try:
                with Collector(shared, metadata["executable_sha256"], timeout=10) as client:
                    health = client.call("health")["response"]["result"]
                    self.assertIn("app_identity", health["capabilities"])
                    identity = client.call("app_identity", {
                        "app_path": str(app), "bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.MacCollector",
                        "binary_sha256": metadata["executable_sha256"]})["response"]["result"]
                    self.assertEqual(identity["binary_sha256"], metadata["executable_sha256"])
                    self.assertIn("quiesce", health["capabilities"])
                    paused = client.call("quiesce", {"seconds": 1})
                    self.assertEqual(paused["response"]["result"]["scope"], "collector_polling_only")
                    old_session = client.session
                    started = time.monotonic()
                    client.new_session()
                    resumed = client.call("health")
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(time.monotonic() - started, 0.5)
                    self.assertNotEqual(resumed["request"]["session_id"], old_session)
                    self.assertEqual(resumed["response"]["collector_instance"], paused["response"]["collector_instance"])
            finally:
                process.terminate()
                process.communicate(timeout=5)
            (app / "Contents/Info.plist").write_bytes(b"tampered metadata")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(root / "build"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.macos.build import generated_directories, recipe_for, run_command


class MacBuildInputTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_xcode_metadata_does_not_allow_source_rewrites_or_new_inputs(self):
        recipe = recipe_for(xcode_project="Editor.xcodeproj", scheme="Editor")
        before = [{"path": "Main.swift", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "sha256": "a" * 64, "size": 1}]
        directory = {"path": "Editor.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace", "kind": "directory", "mode": 493}
        self.assertEqual(generated_directories(before, before + [directory], recipe), [directory])
        for added in ({"path": "New.swift", "kind": "file"}, {"path": "arbitrary", "kind": "directory"}):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                generated_directories(before, before + [added], recipe)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            generated_directories(before, [dict(before[0], sha256="b" * 64)], recipe)

    def test_recipe_separates_xcode_and_swift_inputs(self):
        swift = recipe_for(swift_sources=["Main.swift"], info_plist="Info.plist")
        self.assertEqual(swift["mode"], "swift")
        self.assertEqual(recipe_for(xcode_project="Editor.xcodeproj", scheme="Editor")["mode"], "xcode")
        invalid = [
            {}, {"swift_sources": ["../Main.swift"], "info_plist": "Info.plist"},
            {"swift_sources": ["Main.swift", "Main.swift"], "info_plist": "Info.plist"},
            {"swift_sources": ["Main.swift"], "info_plist": "Info.plist", "deployment_target": "14;anything"},
            {"swift_sources": ["Main.swift"], "info_plist": "Info.plist", "xcode_project": "Editor.xcodeproj", "scheme": "Editor"},
            {"xcode_project": "Editor.xcodeproj"},
            {"xcode_project": "../Editor.xcodeproj", "scheme": "Editor"},
            {"xcode_project": "Editor.xcodeproj", "scheme": "Editor", "resources": "Resources"},
            {"xcode_project": "Editor.xcodeproj", "scheme": "Editor", "deployment_target": "15.0"},
            {"swift_sources": ["Main.swift"], "info_plist": "Info.plist", "configuration": "UnimplementedConfiguration"},
        ]
        for args in invalid:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                recipe_for(**args)

    def test_failed_build_keeps_output_and_return_code(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            logs = []
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                run_command([sys.executable, "-c", "import sys; print('compiler diagnostic', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(7)"],
                            Path(folder), logs, 5)
            self.assertEqual(logs[0]["returncode"], 7)
            self.assertIn("compiler diagnostic", logs[0]["stderr"])

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "posix", "owned process-group cleanup uses POSIX signals")
    def test_build_timeout_keeps_a_terminal_failure_log(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            logs = []
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                run_command([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(30)"], Path(folder), logs, 0.1)
            self.assertIs(logs[0]["timed_out"], True)
            self.assertIsNotNone(logs[0]["returncode"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import copy
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.macos.checks import captures, has_start_assertion, measure
from copyapp.macos.ui import check_ui, check_window
from macos_fakes import UI, WINDOW


class MacComparisonTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_metrics_count_only_predeclared_unmasked_pixels(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            original, rebuilt = root / "original.png", root / "rebuilt.png"
            Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), "black").save(original)
            image = Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), "black")
            image.putpixel((0, 0), (255, 0, 0)); image.save(rebuilt)
            result = measure(original, rebuilt, [])
            self.assertEqual(result["unmasked_pixels"], 16)
            self.assertEqual(result["changed_pixel_fraction"], 0.0625)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(result["mean_absolute_error"], 1 / 48, places=7)
            masked = measure(original, rebuilt, [[0, 0, 1, 1]])
            self.assertEqual(masked["unmasked_pixels"], 15)
            self.assertEqual(masked["mean_absolute_error"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(masked["changed_pixel_fraction"], 0)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                measure(original, rebuilt, [[0, 0, 4, 4]])
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                measure(original, rebuilt, [[3, 3, 2, 2]])
            Image.new("RGB", (3, 3), "black").save(rebuilt)
            mismatch = measure(original, rebuilt, [])
            self.assertFalse(mismatch["dimensions_match"])
            self.assertIsNone(mismatch["mean_absolute_error"])

    def test_initial_state_guard_and_capture_inventory(self):
        launch, edit = {"action": "launch"}, {"action": "type", "text": "hello"}
        assertion = {"action": "expect_text", "text": ""}
        script = {"steps": [launch, assertion, edit, {"action": "expect_file"}, {"action": "quit"}, {"action": "expect_stopped"}]}
        self.assertTrue(has_start_assertion(script))
        self.assertFalse(has_start_assertion({"steps": [launch, edit, assertion]}))
        self.assertFalse(has_start_assertion({"steps": [launch, dict(assertion, match="contains"), edit]}))
        self.assertEqual(captures(script), ["steps/01/after", "steps/02/before", "steps/03/before", "steps/03/after", "steps/05/before"])

    def test_ui_settings_and_initial_window_are_measured_guards(self):
        check_ui(UI, {"response": {"result": {"ui_environment": UI}}})
        changed = copy.deepcopy(UI)
        changed["appearance"] = "dark"
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_ui(UI, {"response": {"result": {"ui_environment": changed}}})
        tree = {"source_channel": "ax", "truncated": False, "focused_window_node": 0,
                "nodes": [{"role": "AXWindow", "frame": WINDOW}]}
        check_window(tree, WINDOW)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_window(tree, dict(WINDOW, x=2))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            check_window(dict(tree, truncated=True), WINDOW)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import json
import os
import platform
import plistlib
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.macos.case import canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.distribution import attached, import_app, mount_image
from copyapp.verify import verify_case
from test_macos import make_app


def zip_tree(source, archive):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipped:
        for path in sorted(source.rglob("*")):
            relative = path.relative_to(source).as_posix()
            if path.is_symlink():
                info = zipfile.ZipInfo(relative)
                info.create_system = 3
                info.external_attr = path.lstat().st_mode << 16
                zipped.writestr(info, os.readlink(path).encode())
            else:
                zipped.write(path, relative + ("/" if path.is_dir() else ""))


class MacDistributionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unicode_names_and_internal_links_are_preserved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            source = root / "input"
            app = make_app(source)
            app = app.rename(source / "Café.app")
            (app / "Contents/Resources").mkdir()
            (app / "Contents/Resources/résumé.txt").write_text("selected resource")
            (app / "Contents/resource-link").symlink_to("Resources/résumé.txt")
            archive = root / "input.zip"
            zip_tree(source, archive)
            case = import_app(archive, root / "imported")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            self.assertEqual((case / "package/app/Café.app/Contents/Resources/résumé.txt").read_text(), "selected resource")

    def test_zip_selected_package_is_bound_to_archived_bytes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            source = root / "input"
            app = make_app(source)
            (app / "Contents/alias").symlink_to("Info.plist")
            archive = root / "input.zip"
            zip_tree(source, archive)
            case = import_app(archive, root / "imported")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            facts = json.loads((case / "import.json").read_text())
            self.assertFalse(facts["launched"])
            self.assertFalse(facts["installed"])
            archive.write_bytes(b"later upstream change")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            # Refreshing both the artifact hash and the claimed archive hash
            # still cannot conceal an App that differs inside the ZIP.
            (app / "Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(b"different executable")
            zip_tree(source, case / "source.zip")
            facts["source_sha256"] = digest(case / "source.zip")
            (case / "import.json").write_bytes(canonical(facts))
            manifest = json.loads((case / "manifest.json").read_text())
            for record in manifest["evidence"]:
                if record["path"] in {"source.zip", "import.json"}:
                    record["sha256"] = digest(case / record["path"])
            (case / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical(manifest))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))

    def test_multiple_apps_require_selection(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            source = root / "input"
            app = make_app(source)
            shutil.copytree(app, source / "Other.app")
            archive = root / "input.zip"
            zip_tree(source, archive)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "app-relative"):
                import_app(archive, root / "ambiguous")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(root / "ambiguous"))
            accepted = import_app(archive, root / "selected", "Other.app")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(accepted))

    def test_zip_traversal_collisions_and_link_ancestors_are_rejected(self):
        variants = [
            [("../escape", None, b"bad")],
            [("/absolute", None, b"bad")],
            [("Example.app/file", None, b"a"), ("example.app/other", None, b"b")],
            [("Café.app/file", None, b"a"), ("Cafe\u0301.app/other", None, b"b")],
            [("duplicate", None, b"a"), ("duplicate", None, b"b")],
            [("link", stat.S_IFLNK | 0o777, b"/outside")],
            [("link", stat.S_IFLNK | 0o777, b"target"), ("link/file", None, b"bad")],
            [("special", stat.S_IFIFO | 0o600, b"")],
        ]
        for members in variants:
            with self.subTest(members=members), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                root = Path(folder)
                archive = root / "input.zip"
                with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w") as zipped:
                    for name, mode, data in members:
                        info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name)
                        if mode is not None:
                            info.create_system = 3; info.external_attr = mode << 16
                        zipped.writestr(info, data)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_app(archive, root / "rejected")
                self.assertFalse((root.parent / "escape").exists())

    def test_encryption_or_license_policy_refuses_before_attach(self):
        for properties in ({"Encrypted": True, "Software License Agreement": False},
                           {"Encrypted": False, "Software License Agreement": True}):
            with self.subTest(properties=properties), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                logs = []
                with patch("copyapp.macos.distribution.platform.system", return_value="Darwin"), \
                     patch("copyapp.macos.distribution.platform.mac_ver", return_value=("27.0", (), "")), \
                     patch("copyapp.macos.distribution.attached", return_value=[]), \
                     patch("copyapp.macos.distribution.native", return_value=plistlib.dumps({"Properties": properties})) as command:
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        with mount_image(Path(folder) / "input.dmg", Path(folder) / "mount", logs):
                            self.fail("must not attach a password/license-interactive image")
                    self.assertEqual(command.call_count, 1)


@unittest.skipUnless(platform.system() == "Darwin" and int((platform.mac_ver()[0] or "0").split(".")[0]) >= 27,
                     "real read-only DMG import currently uses the macOS 27 diskutil image interface")
class NativeDMGTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_readonly_import_reverification_and_cleanup(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder).resolve()
            source = root / "input"
            make_app(source)
            (source / "Applications").symlink_to("/Applications")
            image = root / "input.dmg"
            subprocess.run(["/usr/sbin/diskutil", "image", "create", "from", "--format", "UDZO", "--volumeName",
                            "CopyAppTest", str(source), str(image)], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=60)
            original_hash = digest(image)
            case = import_app(image, root / "imported")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(case))
            self.assertEqual(original_hash, digest(image))
            self.assertFalse(attached(case / "source.dmg"))
            self.assertFalse(os.path.ismount(case / "mount"))
            logs = json.loads((case / "native-log.json").read_text())
            self.assertTrue(any("noexec" in row.get("mount_policy", "") for row in logs))
            (case / "package/app/Example.app/Contents/MacOS/Example").write_bytes(b"changed")
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(case))
```

```py
import hashlib

from copyapp.macos.ui import check_ui, validate_ui


class MacReviewContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_review_requires_exact_script_and_recorded_citations(self):
        # This tests review input validation only, not environment/flow acceptance.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder)
            artifact = root / "steps/02/output.bin"
            artifact.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            artifact.write_bytes(b"expected output")
            (root / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical({"evidence": [{"path": "steps/02/output.bin"}]}))
            sources = {"save": {"source_script_sha256": "a" * 64}}
            review = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "scope": "behavior_analysis",
                      "reviewer": "contract-test", "summary": "Observed output only.",
                      "inventory_note": "Known selected inventory, with unknown behavior retained.",
                      "unknowns": ["Other behavior is unobserved."],
                      "findings": [{"id": "output", "certainty": "observed", "statement": "The file has the expected bytes.",
                                    "evidence": [{"flow_id": "save", "path": "steps/02/output.bin"}]}],
                      "flows": [{"id": "save", "source_script_sha256": "a" * 64,
                                 "expected_behavior": "Save the selected output.", "findings": ["output"]}],
                      "capabilities": [{"id": "saving", "title": "Save", "flow_ids": ["save"],
                                        "disposition": "available", "reason": "Selected asserted output."}]}
            citations = validate_review(review, sources, {"save": root})
            self.assertEqual(citations[0]["sha256"], hashlib.sha256(b"expected output").hexdigest())
            mutations = [
                lambda value: value.update(scope="deep_function_analysis"),
                lambda value: value.update(schema_version=2.0),
                lambda value: value.update(unknowns=[]),
                lambda value: value["flows"][0].update(source_script_sha256="b" * 64),
                lambda value: value["findings"][0]["evidence"][0].update(path="steps/99/missing.json"),
                lambda value: value["findings"][0]["evidence"][0].update(path="../output.bin"),
                lambda value: value["capabilities"][0].update(flow_ids=[]),
                lambda value: value["capabilities"].append(value["capabilities"][0]),
            ]
            for mutate in mutations:
                changed = json.loads(canonical(review))
                mutate(changed)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    validate_review(changed, sources, {"save": root})


class MacReplayInputTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_graceful_shutdown_can_exceed_five_seconds_without_another_input(self):
        alive = {"response": {"result": {"processes": [{"active": False, "terminated": False}]}}}
        stopped = {"response": {"result": {"processes": []}}}
        collector, case = Mock(), Mock()
        collector.call.side_effect = [alive, alive, stopped]
        params = {"bundle_id": "example.original", "binary_sha256": "a" * 64}
        with patch("copyapp.macos.playbook.time.monotonic", side_effect=[0, 6, 12]), \
                patch("copyapp.macos.playbook.time.sleep"):
            self.assertEqual(wait_for_stopped(case, "steps/11", collector, params), stopped)
        self.assertEqual([call.args for call in collector.call.call_args_list], [("app_identity", params)] * 3)
        self.assertEqual(case.add.call_count, 2)

    def test_inactive_process_is_not_accepted_as_stopped_and_timeout_retains_poll(self):
        alive = {"response": {"result": {"processes": [{"active": False, "terminated": False}]}}}
        collector, case = Mock(), Mock()
        collector.call.return_value = alive
        with patch("copyapp.macos.playbook.time.monotonic", side_effect=[0, 31]), \
                self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "did not stop"):
            wait_for_stopped(case, "steps/11", collector, {})
        collector.call.assert_called_once_with("app_identity", {})
        case.add.assert_called_once_with("steps/11/poll-1.json", alive)

    def test_actual_guest_language_list_is_retained_and_order_remains_pinned(self):
        from macos_fakes import UI
        languages = ["en", "fr", "de", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "ja", "es", "it", "nl", "ko", "pt-BR", "pt-PT",
                     "da", "fi", "nb", "sv", "ru", "pl", "tr", "ar", "th", "cs", "hu", "ca", "hr", "el",
                     "he", "ro", "sk", "uk", "id", "ms", "vi", "es-419"]
        expected = dict(UI, preferred_languages=languages)
        check_ui(expected, {"response": {"result": {"ui_environment": expected}}})
        for changed in (languages[::-1], languages[:32]):
            with self.subTest(changed=changed), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                check_ui(expected, {"response": {"result": {"ui_environment": dict(expected, preferred_languages=changed)}}})
        for invalid in (["en"] * 129, [True]):
            with self.subTest(invalid=invalid), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_ui(dict(expected, preferred_languages=invalid))

    def test_catalyst_description_selector_requires_a_unique_exact_match(self):
        selector = {"role": "AXButton", "description": "Continue"}
        validate_script({"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "bundle_id": "example.catalyst",
                         "app_path": "/Applications/Example.app", "scenario_id": "welcome",
                         "steps": [{"action": "launch"}, {"action": "click_element", "selector": selector}]})
        node = {"id": 0, "parent": None, "role": "AXButton", "description": "Continue"}
        tree = {"source_channel": "ax", "truncated": False, "nodes": [node]}
        self.assertEqual(select_node(tree, selector), node)
        for nodes in ([], [dict(node, description="Continue Later")], [node, dict(node, id=1)]):
            with self.subTest(nodes=nodes), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                select_node(dict(tree, nodes=nodes), selector)

    def test_script_rejects_unsafe_inputs_before_replay(self):
        base = {"schema_version": 2, "platform": "macos", "bundle_id": "example.original",
                "app_path": "/Applications/Original.app", "scenario_id": "bounded", "steps": [{"action": "launch"}]}
        bad_steps = [
            {"action": "click", "x": 1, "y": 2, "modifiers": [{}]},
            {"action": "click", "x": 1, "y": 2, "modifiers": ["cmd", "cmd"]},
            {"action": "click", "x": True, "y": 2},
            {"action": "expect_file", "path": "../elsewhere", "text_equals": "hello"},
            {"action": "expect_file", "path": "output", "text_equals": 12},
            {"action": "expect_file", "path": "output", "sha256": "x" * 64},
            {"action": "wait", "seconds": 30},
            {"action": "shell", "command": "anything"},
        ]
        for step in bad_steps:
            with self.subTest(step=step), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_script(dict(base, steps=base["steps"] + [step]))

    def test_ambiguous_or_truncated_ax_does_not_select_first_match(self):
        tree = {"source_channel": "ax", "truncated": False, "nodes": [
            {"id": 0, "parent": None, "role": "AXApplication"},
            {"id": 1, "parent": 0, "role": "AXWindow", "title": "A"},
            {"id": 2, "parent": 1, "role": "AXButton", "title": "Save"},
            {"id": 3, "parent": 0, "role": "AXWindow", "title": "B"},
            {"id": 4, "parent": 3, "role": "AXButton", "title": "Save"}]}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_node(tree, {"title": "Save", "role": "AXButton"})
        self.assertEqual(select_node(tree, {"title": "Save", "window": "B"})["id"], 4)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_node(dict(tree, truncated=True), {"title": "Save", "window": "B"})

    def test_output_capture_rejects_links_and_special_files(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder).resolve()
            run = root / "run"
            run.mkdir()
            output = run / "output"
            output.write_bytes(b"saved bytes")
            self.assertEqual(output_bytes(output, run), b"saved bytes")
            outside = root / "outside"
            outside.write_bytes(b"unrelated")
            (run / "link").symlink_to(outside)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                output_bytes(run / "link", run)
            os.mkfifo(run / "fifo")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                output_bytes(run / "fifo", run)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                output_bytes(outside, run)
            (run / "large").write_bytes(b"x" * ((8 << 20) + 1))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                output_bytes(run / "large", run)

    unittest.main()
```

```py
import json
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from copyapp.macos.case import canonical, digest
from copyapp.macos.share import share_request, share_result
from copyapp.verify import verify_case


def vm_fixture(root):
    vm = root / "Test.vm"
    (vm / "Shared/inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
    (vm / "Shared/outbox").mkdir()
    (vm / "spec.json").write_bytes(canonical({"id": str(uuid4()), "stage": "agentInstalled"}))
    (vm / "MachineIdentifier.bin").write_bytes(b"simulated public machine identifier")
    (vm / "HardwareModel.bin").write_bytes(b"simulated public hardware model")
    return vm


class MacShareProbeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_request_and_simulated_reply_do_not_claim_runtime_identity(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder).resolve()
            vm = vm_fixture(root)
            request = share_request(vm, root / "request")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(request))
            record = json.loads((request / "request.json").read_text())
            shutil.copyfile(vm / "Shared/inbox" / record["filename"], vm / "Shared/outbox" / record["filename"])
            result = share_result(request, root / "result", "contract-test", "Simulated host filesystem copy only; no live guest claim.")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(result))
            data = json.loads((result / "result.json").read_text())
            self.assertFalse(data["guest_runtime_identity_verified"])
            self.assertFalse(data["complete_environment_acceptance"])
            data["guest_runtime_identity_verified"] = True
            (result / "result.json").write_bytes(canonical(data))
            manifest = json.loads((result / "manifest.json").read_text())
            for item in manifest["evidence"]:
                if item["path"] == "result.json": item["sha256"] = digest(result / "result.json")
            (result / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical(manifest))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(result))

    def test_absent_wrong_linked_reply_or_changed_vm_is_not_accepted(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder).resolve()
            vm = vm_fixture(root)
            request = share_request(vm, root / "request")
            record = json.loads((request / "request.json").read_text())
            reply = vm / "Shared/outbox" / record["filename"]
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                share_result(request, root / "absent", "test", "No reply.")
            reply.write_bytes(b"another nonce")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                share_result(request, root / "wrong", "test", "Wrong reply.")
            reply.unlink()
            reply.symlink_to(request / "payload.txt")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                share_result(request, root / "linked", "test", "Linked reply.")
            reply.unlink()
            reply.write_bytes((request / "payload.txt").read_bytes())
            (vm / "MachineIdentifier.bin").write_bytes(b"changed identity")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                share_result(request, root / "changed", "test", "VM identity changed.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
class SnapshotMetadataTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def vm(self, root):
        vm = root / "ChatComputer.vm"
        vm.mkdir()
        (vm / "spec.json").write_bytes(canonical({"id": str(uuid4()), "stage": "agentInstalled"}))
        (vm / "MachineIdentifier.bin").write_bytes(b"simulated-machine")
        (vm / "HardwareModel.bin").write_bytes(b"simulated-hardware")
        return vm

    def test_readonly_inventory_preserves_incomplete_state_without_claiming_readiness(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            root = Path(folder).resolve(); vm = self.vm(root)
            empty = snapshot_inventory(vm, root / "empty")
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(empty))

            (vm / "Snapshots/.restore").mkdir(parents=True)

            self.assertTrue(value["restore_in_progress"])

            manifest = json.loads((incomplete / "manifest.json").read_text())
            for row in manifest["evidence"]:
                if row["path"] == "inventory.json": row["sha256"] = digest(path)
            (incomplete / "manifest.json").write_bytes(canonical(manifest))
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(incomplete))

    def test_inventory_rejects_linked_roots_and_mismatched_snapshot_ids(self):

            root = Path(folder).resolve(); vm = self.vm(root)

            (vm / "Snapshots").unlink()
            selected = vm / "Snapshots" / str(uuid4()); selected.mkdir(parents=True)
            (selected / "snapshot.json").write_bytes(canonical({"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "wrong ID", "kind": "manual",
                "createdAt": "2026-10-21T00:00:00.000Z", "overlayCount": 1, "hasThumbnail": False, "isProtected": False}))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "IDs differ"): snapshot_inventory(vm, root / "failed")
            self.assertTrue((root / "failed/failure.json").exists())
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(root / "failed"))
```
