`tests/test_native_disasm.py`:

```py
import json
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import CompletedProcess
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.native_disasm import (direct_branches, direct_calls, disassemble_native_candidates,
                                   disassemble_native_function)
from copyapp.report import _validate_native_candidate_queue, _validate_native_disassembly
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


BASE = 0x100000000
ENTRY = BASE + 0x100


def sample_macho() -> bytes:
    blob = bytearray(0x200)
    blob[:4] = b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe"
    struct.pack_into("<II", blob, 16, 2, 168)
    struct.pack_into("<II", blob, 32, 0x19, 152)
    blob[40:46] = b"__TEXT"
    struct.pack_into("<QQQQ", blob, 56, BASE, len(blob), 0, len(blob))
    struct.pack_into("<I", blob, 96, 1)
    blob[104:110] = b"__text"
    blob[120:126] = b"__TEXT"
    struct.pack_into("<QQI", blob, 136, ENTRY, 0x40, 0x100)
    struct.pack_into("<II", blob, 184, 0x26, 16)
    struct.pack_into("<II", blob, 192, 0x180, 4)
    blob[0x180:0x184] = bytes((0x80, 0x02, 0x10, 0))
    return bytes(blob)


class NativeDisassemblyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_direct_call_parser_does_not_infer_indirect_dispatch(self):
        assembly = ("1000: 94000001 bl 0x2000 <_objc_msgSend$pushViewController:animated:>\n"
                    "1004: d63f0000 blr x0\n")
        calls, truncated = direct_calls(assembly)
        self.assertFalse(truncated)
        self.assertEqual(calls[0]["objc_selector_stub"], "pushViewController:animated:")
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertEqual(direct_branches("1008: 14000001 b 0x2000\n"
                                         "100c: d61f0000 br x0\n"),
                         [{"site": "0x1008", "mnemonic": "b", "target": "0x2000"}])

    def setUp(self):
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temp.name)
        self.binary = self.root / "app"
        self.binary.write_bytes(sample_macho())
        self.digest = sha256_file(self.binary)
        self.assembly = (f"{ENTRY:x}: d65f03c0 ret\n"
                         f"{ENTRY + 4:x}: d65f03c0 ret\n")

    def _run(self, command, **kwargs):
        if "--find" in command:
            return CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=sys.executable, stderr="")
        return CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=self.assembly, stderr="")

    def test_exact_hash_and_next_function_boundary(self):
        output = self.root / "function"
        with patch("copyapp.native_disasm.shutil.which", return_value=sys.executable), \
             patch("copyapp.native_disasm.subprocess.run", side_effect=self._run):
            summary = disassemble_native_function(self.binary, self.digest,
                                                  hex(ENTRY), output)
        record = json.loads(summary.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record["stop_address"], hex(ENTRY + 0x10))
        self.assertEqual(record["boundary"], "next_function_start")
        self.assertFalse(record["truncated"])
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        self.assertEqual(_validate_native_disassembly(output, {self.digest})["summary"],
                         record)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SHA-256"):
            disassemble_native_function(self.binary, "0" * 64, hex(ENTRY),
                                        self.root / "invalid")

    def test_candidate_queue_retains_source_and_unavailable_tool(self):
        candidates = self.root / "candidates"
        candidates.mkdir()
        source = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "runtime_static_candidates",
                  "binary_path": str(self.binary), "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                  "candidates": [{"class": "Screen", "selector": "tap:",
                                  "static_address": hex(ENTRY),
                                  "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                                  "observations": [{"calls": 1}]}]}
        source_path = candidates / "candidates.json"
        source_path.write_text(json.dumps(source))
        (candidates / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "evidence": [{"path": "candidates.json",
                          "sha256": sha256_file(source_path)}]}))
        output = self.root / "queue"
        with patch("copyapp.native_disasm.shutil.which", return_value=sys.executable), \
             patch("copyapp.native_disasm.subprocess.run", side_effect=self._run):
            index = disassemble_native_candidates(candidates, output)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(index.read_text())["status"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(_validate_native_candidate_queue(
            output, source, source_path, {self.digest})["complete_count"], 1)
        failed = self.root / "no-tool"
        with patch("copyapp.native_disasm.shutil.which", return_value=None):
            index = disassemble_native_candidates(candidates, failed)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(index.read_text())["status"], "unavailable")
        self.assertEqual(_validate_native_candidate_queue(
            failed, source, source_path, {self.digest})["complete_count"], 0)

    def test_unique_local_call_is_followed_and_rechecked(self):
        candidates = self.root / "candidates-follow"
        candidates.mkdir()
        source = {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "runtime_static_candidates",
                  "binary_path": str(self.binary), "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                  "candidates": [{"class": "Screen", "selector": "tap:",
                                  "static_address": hex(ENTRY),
                                  "binary_sha256": self.digest,
                                  "observations": [{"calls": 1}]}]}
        source_path = candidates / "candidates.json"
        source_path.write_text(json.dumps(source))
        (candidates / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "evidence": [{"path": "candidates.json",
                          "sha256": sha256_file(source_path)}]}))

        def run(command, **kwargs):
            if "--find" in command:
                return CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=sys.executable, stderr="")
            address = next(arg for arg in command if arg.startswith("--start-address="))
            if address.endswith(hex(ENTRY)):
                output = f"{ENTRY:x}: 94000004 bl 0x{ENTRY + 0x10:x} <__text+0x10>\n"
            else:
                output = f"{ENTRY + 0x10:x}: d65f03c0 ret\n"
            return CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=output, stderr="")

        output = self.root / "follow"
        with patch("copyapp.native_disasm.shutil.which", return_value=sys.executable), \
             patch("copyapp.native_disasm.subprocess.run", side_effect=run):
            index = disassemble_native_candidates(candidates, output)
        record = json.loads(index.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record["followed"][0]["address"], hex(ENTRY + 0x10))
        self.assertEqual(record["decisions"][0]["status"], "followed")
        self.assertEqual(_validate_native_candidate_queue(
            output, source, source_path, {self.digest})["complete_count"], 2)
        record["decisions"][0]["eligible_targets"] = []
        index.write_text(json.dumps(record))
        with patch("copyapp.report.verify_case", return_value=True):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "decision differs"):
                _validate_native_candidate_queue(output, source, source_path,
                                                 {self.digest})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.network_flow import (NetworkObserver, _event, network_hook_source,
                                  validate_network_trace_pair)
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class NetworkFlowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gesture_window_is_validated_as_action(self):
        play = {"status": "complete", "bundle_id": "com.example.app",
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device",
                "steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "swipe"}]}
        trace = {"status": "complete", "kind": "ui_network_flow_trace",
                 "bundle_id": "com.example.app", "device_id_sha256_prefix": "device",
                 "hook_count": 1, "dropped_events": 0, "events": [],
                 "steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "swipe", "event_count": 0}]}
        validate_network_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")
        trace["steps"][0]["action"] = "tap"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "playbook actions"):
            validate_network_trace_pair(play, trace, "com.example.app", "device")

    def test_observer_attributes_only_valid_metadata_to_active_tap(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory, patch("copyapp.network_flow.time.sleep"):
            observer = NetworkObserver(Path(directory))
            event = {"type": "network_task_resume", "scheme": "https",
                     "host": "example.com", "method": "POST",
                     "path_fingerprint": "12345678", "path_depth": 2,
                     "query": "secret-value"}
            observer.begin_step(3, "tap_label")
            observer._on_message({"type": "send", "payload": event}, None)
            observer.end_step()
            observer._on_message({"type": "send", "payload": {**event, "host": "bad/host"}}, None)
            self.assertEqual(observer.events[0]["step_index"], 3)
            self.assertNotIn("secret-value", json.dumps(observer.events))
            self.assertEqual(observer.record["steps"][0]["event_count"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(len(observer.errors), 1)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _event({**event, "path_fingerprint": "/private/path"})

    def test_verified_parent_rejects_rehashed_cross_app_and_step_tampering(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            play = root / "playbook"
            network = root / "network"
            play.mkdir()
            network.mkdir()
            bundle = "com.example.app"
            prefix = hashlib.sha256(b"device").hexdigest()[:16]

            def write(path, data):
                path.write_text(json.dumps(data) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

            def evidence(parent, files):
                return [{"path": name, "sha256": sha256_file(parent / name)}
                        for name in files]

            write(play / "playbook.json", {"bundle_id": bundle, "steps": []})
            write(play / "manifest.json", {
                "status": "complete", "bundle_id": bundle,
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix, "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
                "steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap_label"}],
                "evidence": evidence(play, ["playbook.json"]),
            })
            (network / "hook.js").write_text(network_hook_source(), encoding="utf-8")
            event = {"scheme": "https", "host": "example.com", "method": "GET",
                     "path_fingerprint": "12345678", "path_depth": 1,
                     "observed_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "step_index": 1}
            trace = {"kind": "ui_network_flow_trace", "status": "complete",
                     "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
                     "hook_count": 1, "dropped_events": 0,
                     "steps": [{"index": 1, "action": "tap_label", "event_count": 1}],
                     "events": [event]}
            write(network / "network.json", trace)

            def seal():
                write(network / "manifest.json", {
                    "kind": "ui_network_flow_trace", "status": "complete",
                    "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
                    "evidence": evidence(network, ["hook.js", "network.json"]),
                })
                child_files = sorted(str(path.relative_to(root)) for child in (play, network)
                                     for path in child.iterdir() if path.is_file())
                write(root / "manifest.json", {
                    "schema_version": 1, "kind": "ui_network_flow", "status": "complete",
                    "bundle_id": bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": prefix,
                    "ui_backend": "ios-mcp",
                    "event_count": len(trace["events"]),
                    "source_script_sha256": sha256_file(play / "playbook.json"),
                    "evidence": evidence(root, child_files),
                })

            seal()
            self.assertTrue(verify_case(root))
            trace["events"][0]["step_index"] = 9
            write(network / "network.json", trace)
            seal()
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))
            trace["events"][0]["step_index"] = 1
            trace["bundle_id"] = "com.other.app"
            write(network / "network.json", trace)
            seal()
            self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_objc.py`:

```py
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.objc import index_objc


BASE = 0x100000000


def authenticated(offset):
    return 0x8000000000000000 | offset


def fixture_image():
    blob = bytearray(0x500)
    command_size = 72 + 2 * 80
    struct.pack_into("<IiiIIIII", blob, 0, 0xFEEDFACF, 0x0100000C, 0, 2, 1,
                     command_size, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<II16sQQQQiiII", blob, 32, 0x19, command_size, b"__DATA",
                     BASE, len(blob), 0, len(blob), 3, 3, 2, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<16s16sQQIIIIIIII", blob, 32 + 72,
                     b"__objc_classlist", b"__DATA", BASE + 0x200, 8, 0x200,
                     3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<16s16sQQIIIIIIII", blob, 32 + 72 + 80,
                     b"__objc_data", b"__DATA", BASE + 0x208, 0x200, 0x208,
                     3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<Q", blob, 0x200, authenticated(0x220))
    struct.pack_into("<Q", blob, 0x220 + 32, authenticated(0x280))
    struct.pack_into("<Q", blob, 0x280 + 24, authenticated(0x3A0))
    struct.pack_into("<Q", blob, 0x280 + 32, authenticated(0x340))
    struct.pack_into("<IIiii", blob, 0x340, 0x8000000C, 1,
                     0x380 - 0x348, 0x3C0 - 0x34C, 0x420 - 0x350)
    struct.pack_into("<Q", blob, 0x380, authenticated(0x3B0))
    blob[0x3A0:0x3A7] = b"Sample\0"
    blob[0x3B0:0x3B6] = b"tick:\0"
    blob[0x3C0:0x3C8] = b"v16@0:8\0"
    return bytes(blob)


class ObjCIndexTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_authenticated_class_pointer_and_relative_method(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "fixture"
            path.write_bytes(fixture_image())
            index = index_objc(path)
        self.assertEqual(index["class_count"], 1)
        item = index["classes"][0]
        self.assertEqual(item["name"], "Sample")
        self.assertEqual(item["instance_methods"], [{
            "selector": "tick:", "types": "v16@0:8", "imp": "0x100000420",
        }])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_ocr_file.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.ocr_file import ocr_file, verify_ocr_source
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


class SavedOCRTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cropped_result_pins_original_image_and_input(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            screenshot = root / "screen.jpg"
            Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), "black").save(screenshot)
            destination = root / "ocr.json"
            with patch("copyapp.ocr_file.recognize_screenshot",
                       return_value={"engine": "macos-vision", "texts": [{"text": "15"}]}) as recognize:
                ocr_file(screenshot, destination, [5, 10, 30, 40])
            record = json.loads(destination.read_text())
            self.assertEqual(record["source_sha256"], sha256_file(screenshot))
            self.assertEqual(record["result"]["texts"][0]["text"], "15")
            self.assertEqual(record["roi"], [5, 10, 30, 40])
            self.assertTrue(recognize.call_args.args[0].startswith(b"\x89PNG"))
            self.assertTrue(verify_ocr_source(record, screenshot))
            record["ocr_input_sha256"] = "0" * 64
            self.assertFalse(verify_ocr_source(record, screenshot))
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                ocr_file(screenshot, destination)

    def test_rejects_roi_outside_image_before_output(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            screenshot = root / "screen.jpg"
            Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), "black").save(screenshot)
            destination = root / "ocr.json"
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "ROI"):
                ocr_file(screenshot, destination, [0, 0, 41, 20])
            self.assertFalse(destination.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
    def test_multiple_devices_require_an_exact_udid(self):
        devices = [SimpleNamespace(serial=UDID, connection_type="USB"),
                   SimpleNamespace(serial=OTHER, connection_type="USB")]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "multiple USB devices"):
            _choose_device(devices, None)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not connected"):
            _choose_device(devices, "wrong")

    def test_key_creation_never_overwrites_an_existing_identity(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "ssh" / "id_ed25519"
            self.assertTrue(_prepare_ssh_key(path))
            original = path.read_bytes()
            self.assertTrue((path.parent / "id_ed25519.pub").is_file())
            self.assertFalse(_prepare_ssh_key(path))
            self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes(), original)
            existing_parent = Path(directory) / "existing"
            existing_parent.mkdir(mode=0o755)
            before = os.stat(existing_parent).st_mode & 0o777
            _prepare_ssh_key(existing_parent / "id")
            self.assertEqual(os.stat(existing_parent).st_mode & 0o777, before)

            host = {name: {"status": "not_configured"} for name in
                    ("xcode", "xcodegen", "ldid", "codex_cli", "claude_cli", "theos")}
            with patch("copyapp.doctor._usb_probes", side_effect=fake_usb), \
                 patch("copyapp.doctor._host_probes", return_value=host), \
                 patch("copyapp.doctor.ssh_tunnel") as ssh_tunnel, \
                 patch("copyapp.doctor._frida_probe") as frida_probe, \
                 patch("copyapp.doctor._ios_mcp_probe") as ios_mcp_probe:
                report, connected = run_doctor(UDID, output, survey_only=True)
            self.assertTrue(connected)
            self.assertTrue(report.is_file())
            ssh_tunnel.assert_not_called()
            frida_probe.assert_not_called()
            ios_mcp_probe.assert_not_called()
            record = json.loads((output / "device.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual(record["next_steps"], [])
            self.assertEqual(record["probes"]["ssh_mobile"]["status"], "not_probed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_output_paths.py`:

```py
import asyncio
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.copy_workflow import copy_app
from copyapp.output_paths import copy_paths


class OutputPathsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()

    def test_default_jobs_are_distinct_contained_and_do_not_create_files(self):
        first = copy_paths("../../com.example/app", workspace=self.root)
        second = copy_paths("../../com.example/app", workspace=self.root)
        workspace, evidence, project = first
        self.assertEqual(workspace, self.root)
        self.assertEqual(evidence.parent, project.parent)
        self.assertEqual(evidence.name, "evidence")
        self.assertEqual(project.name, "project")
        self.assertEqual(evidence.parent.parent, self.root / "output")
        self.assertNotEqual(first, second)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.iterdir()), [])

    def test_custom_and_legacy_overrides_preserved(self):
        job = self.root / "My job"
        self.assertEqual(copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, output_dir=job),
                         (self.root, job / "evidence", job / "project"))
        evidence, project = self.root / "cases/old", self.root / "rebuild/Old"
        self.assertEqual(copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, output=evidence,
                                    project=project, resume=True),
                         (self.root, evidence, project))
        self.assertEqual(copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, output_dir=job,
                                    project=project)[2], project)

    def test_resume_requires_explicit_previous_job_and_reuses_paths(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "previous"):
            copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, resume=True)
        job = self.root / "output/job"
        self.assertEqual(copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, output_dir=job),
                         copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, output_dir=job, resume=True))

    def test_invalid_overrides_rejected_without_mutation(self):
        for settings in (
            {"output": self.root / "case"},
            {"output": self.root / "case", "output_dir": self.root / "job"},
            {"output_dir": self.root.parent / "outside"},
            {"output_dir": self.root / "job", "project": self.root / "job/evidence/source"},
        ):
            with self.subTest(settings=settings), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                copy_paths("app", workspace=self.root, **settings)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.iterdir()), [])

    def test_current_agent_default_handoff_and_resume_preserve_existing_evidence(self):
        workspace, evidence, project = copy_paths("com.example.app", workspace=self.root)

        async def no_survey(*args):
            self.fail("discovery handoff must not touch the device")

        def run(resume=False):
            return asyncio.run(copy_app("device", "com.example.app", [], project,
                "com.example.clone", evidence, no_survey, workspace=workspace,
                agent_provider="current", auto_discover=True, resume=resume))

        task, complete = run()
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(task, evidence / "discovery-agent/TASK.md")
        before = task.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(run(True), (task, False))
        self.assertEqual(task.read_bytes(), before)
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            run()
        self.assertEqual(task.read_bytes(), before)
```

`tests/test_playbook_auto.py`:

```py
import json
import hashlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.playbook_auto import run_playbook_auto
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class PlaybookAutoTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.script = self.root / "script.json"
        self.script.write_text('{"schema_version":1,"bundle_id":"dev.example","steps":[]}')

    @staticmethod
    def fake_run(udid, backend, script, output, ictrl_client=None):
        output.mkdir()
        (output / "playbook.json").write_bytes(script.read_bytes())
        first = backend == "ictrl"
        manifest = {"status": "failed" if first else "complete",
                    "bundle_id": "dev.example",
                    "device_id_sha256_prefix": hashlib.sha256(udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],
                    "ui_backend": backend,
                    "steps": [] if first else [{"action": "observe"}],
                    "evidence": [{"path": "playbook.json",
                                  "sha256": sha256_file(output / "playbook.json")}],
                    "error": {"type": "ConnectionError"} if first else None}
        path = output / "manifest.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        return path, not first

    def test_falls_back_after_connection_failure_and_retains_both(self):
        output = self.root / "auto"
        with patch("copyapp.playbook_auto.run_playbook", side_effect=self.fake_run) as mocked:
            _, complete = run_playbook_auto("device-1", "ictrl", "ios-mcp",
                                            self.script, output)
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(mocked.call_count, 2)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        record = json.loads((output / "manifest.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(record["selected_backend"], "ios-mcp")
        self.assertEqual([item["status"] for item in record["attempts"]],
                         ["failed", "complete"])

    def test_stops_after_touch_attempt_even_if_backend_errors(self):
        output = self.root / "auto"

        def touched(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client=None):
            path, _ = self.fake_run(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client)
            record = json.loads(path.read_text())
            record["steps"] = [{"action": "tap_label"}]
            path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
            return path, False

        with patch("copyapp.playbook_auto.run_playbook", side_effect=touched) as mocked:
            _, complete = run_playbook_auto("device-1", "ictrl", "ios-mcp",
                                            self.script, output)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(mocked.call_count, 1)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))
        self.assertTrue(json.loads((output / "manifest.json").read_text())[
            "fallback_skipped_after_touch"])

    def test_stops_after_gesture_attempt_even_if_backend_errors(self):
        output = self.root / "gesture-auto"

        def touched(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client=None):
            path, _ = self.fake_run(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client)
            record = json.loads(path.read_text())
            record["steps"] = [{"action": "swipe"}]
            path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
            return path, False

        with patch("copyapp.playbook_auto.run_playbook", side_effect=touched) as mocked:
            _, complete = run_playbook_auto("device-1", "ictrl", "ios-mcp",
                                            self.script, output)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(mocked.call_count, 1)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads((output / "manifest.json").read_text())[
            "fallback_skipped_after_touch"])

    def test_stops_after_text_input_attempt_even_if_backend_errors(self):
        output = self.root / "text-auto"

        def touched(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client=None):
            path, _ = self.fake_run(udid, backend, script, root, ictrl_client)
            record = json.loads(path.read_text())
            record["steps"] = [{"action": "type_text"}]
            path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
            return path, False

        with patch("copyapp.playbook_auto.run_playbook", side_effect=touched) as mocked:
            _, complete = run_playbook_auto("device-1", "ictrl", "ios-mcp",
                                            self.script, output)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(mocked.call_count, 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_playbook_exact_labels.py`:

```py
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.playbook import _check_fresh_launch_frame, _exact_labels, _fresh_launch, run_playbook


@contextmanager
def fake_tunnel(_udid, *_args):
    yield 22222


class FakeUI:
    elements = [{"text": "Stopwatch", "clickable": True}]

    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
        pass

    def bounds(self):
        return 414, 896

    def frontmost(self):
        return "com.apple.mobiletimer"

    def observe(self):
        return {"elements": list(self.elements), "element_count": len(self.elements)}


class PlaybookExactLabelsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.script = self.root / "script.json"
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.apple.mobiletimer",
            "steps": [{"action": "observe", "contains": ["Stop"],
                       "exact_labels": ["Stop"]}],
        }))

    def run_fake(self, elements, name):
        with patch.object(FakeUI, "elements", elements), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", FakeUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            path, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                          self.root / name)
        return json.loads(path.read_text()), complete

    def test_stopwatch_does_not_satisfy_exact_stop(self):
        record, complete = self.run_fake([{"text": "Stopwatch"}], "missing")
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["missing"], [])
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["missing_exact_labels"], ["Stop"])
        self.assertIn("missing exact accessibility labels", record["error"]["message"])

    def test_exact_stop_element_passes(self):
        record, complete = self.run_fake([{"text": "Stopwatch"}, {"text": "Stop"}], "matched")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["missing_exact_labels"], [])

    def test_ictrl_requires_ax_label_boundary(self):
        source = "Application, label: 'Clock'\n  Button, label: 'Stopwatch'\n"
        self.assertNotIn("Stop", _exact_labels({"source_channel": "ax", "source": source}, "ictrl"))
        source += "  Button, label: 'Stop'\n"
        self.assertIn("Stop", _exact_labels({"source_channel": "ax", "source": source}, "ictrl"))
        self.assertEqual(_exact_labels({"source_channel": "ocr", "source": source}, "ictrl"), set())

    def test_ictrl_fresh_launch_refreshes_frontmost_cache(self):
        class CachedUI:
            opened = []
            terminated = []

            def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
                self.app = ""
                self.client = Mock()
                self.client.call_ui.side_effect = lambda method, params: self.terminated.append((method, params))

            def bounds(self):
                return 414, 896

            def frontmost(self):
                return self.app

            def launch(self, bundle):
                self.opened.append(bundle)
                self.app = bundle

            def observe(self):
                return {"source_channel": "ax", "source": "Button, label: 'Start'"}

        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.clockclone",
            "fresh_launch": True,
            "steps": [{"action": "observe", "exact_labels": ["Start"]}],
        }))
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", CachedUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook._fresh_launch", new_callable=AsyncMock), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            record_path, complete = run_playbook("device", "ictrl", self.script,
                                                 self.root / "ictrl-cache", port=22224)
        record = json.loads(record_path.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(complete, record.get("error"))
        self.assertEqual(record["frontmost_backend"], "ios-mcp")
        self.assertEqual(CachedUI.opened, ["dev.copyapp.clockclone"])
        self.assertEqual(CachedUI.terminated, [
            ("terminate_app", {"bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.clockclone"})])

    def test_instruments_launch_is_bounded(self):
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.subprocess.run", side_effect=subprocess.TimeoutExpired(
                cmd="dvt", timeout=20)) as run:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(TimeoutError, "exceeded 20 seconds"):
                import asyncio
                asyncio.run(_fresh_launch("00008020-000D650434B8003A", "dev.copyapp.fixture"))
        self.assertEqual(run.call_args.kwargs["timeout"], 20)

    def test_ios_mcp_fresh_launch_falls_back_to_ictrl_lifecycle(self):
        class FallbackClient:
            calls = []

            def __init__(self, **_kwargs):
                pass

            def call_ui(self, method, params):
                self.calls.append((method, params))

        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.apple.mobiletimer",
            "fresh_launch": True,
            "steps": [{"action": "observe", "exact_labels": ["Stopwatch"]}],
        }))
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", FakeUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ictrl_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ICtrlClient", FallbackClient), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook._fresh_launch", new_callable=AsyncMock,
                   side_effect=TimeoutError("timed out")), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            path, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                          self.root / "fallback")
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertTrue(complete, record.get("error"))
        self.assertEqual(record["fresh_launch_backend"], "ictrl_lifecycle_fallback")
        self.assertIn("TimeoutError: timed out", record["fresh_launch_primary_error"])
        self.assertEqual(FallbackClient.calls, [
            ("terminate_app", {"bundle_id": "com.apple.mobiletimer"}),
            ("launch_app", {"bundle_id": "com.apple.mobiletimer"}),
        ])

    def test_black_dvt_launch_reactivates_and_retains_frame_provenance(self):
        class BlackLaunchUI:
            def __init__(self):
                self.client = Mock()
                self.reactivated = False
                self.last_screenshot_source = "getScreenDataWithQuantity"

            def screenshot(self, path):
                image = Image.new("RGB", (100, 100),
                                  "#303030" if self.reactivated else "black")
                image.save(path, format="JPEG")

            def launch(self, bundle):
                self.reactivated = True

            def frontmost(self):
                return "com.apple.mobiletimer"

        ui = BlackLaunchUI()
        record = {"evidence": []}
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            _check_fresh_launch_frame(ui, "com.apple.mobiletimer", self.root, record)
        self.assertEqual(record["fresh_launch_render_recovery"],
                         "home_then_ios_mcp_launch")
        self.assertEqual(len(record["fresh_launch_frames"]), 4)
        self.assertTrue(record["fresh_launch_frames"][0]["near_uniform_black"])
        self.assertFalse(record["fresh_launch_frames"][-1]["near_uniform_black"])
        self.assertEqual(len(record["evidence"]), 4)
        ui.client.call_ui.assert_called_once_with("press_home")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_playbook_gestures.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch

from copyapp.compare_playbooks import _load_run
from copyapp.discover_check import inspect_playbook
from copyapp.gestures import gesture_params
from copyapp.playbook import run_playbook


@contextmanager
def fake_tunnel(_udid, *_args):
    yield 22223


class GestureUI:
    calls = []

    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
        pass

    def bounds(self):
        return 414, 896

    def frontmost(self):
        return "com.example.target"

    def swipe(self, *args):
        self.calls.append(("swipe", args))
        return {"ok": True}

    def long_press(self, *args):
        self.calls.append(("long_press", args))
        return {"ok": True}

    def double_tap(self, *args):
        self.calls.append(("double_tap", args))
        return {"ok": True}


class PlaybookGestureTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.script = self.root / "flow.json"
        GestureUI.calls = []

    def replay(self, step, output="run", fresh_launch=False):
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.example.target",
            "scenario_id": "gesture", "fresh_launch": fresh_launch,
            "steps": [step],
        }))
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", GestureUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook._fresh_launch", new_callable=AsyncMock) as launch, \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            manifest, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                              self.root / output)
        return json.loads(manifest.read_text()), complete, launch

    def test_replays_and_binds_swipe_long_press_and_double_tap(self):
        steps = [
            {"action": "swipe", "from_x": 300, "from_y": 280,
             "to_x": 100, "to_y": 280, "duration_ms": 400},
            {"action": "long_press", "x": 205, "y": 280, "duration_ms": 900},
            {"action": "double_tap", "x": 205, "y": 280, "interval_ms": 120},
        ]
        for index, step in enumerate(steps):
            root = f"run-{index}"
            record, complete, _ = self.replay(step, root)
            self.assertTrue(complete, record.get("error"))
            self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["gesture"], gesture_params(step))
            _load_run(self.root / root, require_comparable=False)
        self.assertEqual([name for name, _ in GestureUI.calls],
                         ["swipe", "long_press", "double_tap"])

    def test_invalid_gesture_rejected_before_launch_or_touch(self):
        record, complete, launch = self.replay(
            {"action": "swipe", "from_x": 300, "from_y": 280,
             "to_x": 300, "to_y": 280}, "invalid", fresh_launch=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertIn("too short", record["error"]["message"])
        launch.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(GestureUI.calls, [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "horizontal or vertical"):
            gesture_params({"action": "swipe", "from_x": 300, "from_y": 280,
                            "to_x": 100, "to_y": 260})

    def test_discovery_accepts_gesture_and_rejects_out_of_bounds(self):
        plan = {"schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.example.target",
                "scenario_id": "gesture-discovery", "fresh_launch": True,
                "steps": [
                    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Calculator"]},
                    {"action": "swipe", "from_x": 300, "from_y": 280,
                     "to_x": 100, "to_y": 280},
                    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True,
                     "ready_contains": "Result"},
                ]}
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        inspected = inspect_playbook(self.script, "com.example.target")
        self.assertEqual(inspected["tap_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(inspected["tap_signature"][0][0], "swipe")
        plan["steps"][1]["from_x"] = 10001
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "invalid swipe coordinate"):
            inspect_playbook(self.script, "com.example.target")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_playbook_text.py`:

```py
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from copyapp.compare_playbooks import _load_run
from copyapp.discover_check import inspect_playbook
from copyapp.experiment import ExperimentUI
from copyapp.playbook import run_playbook
from copyapp.text_actions import type_params


@contextmanager
def fake_tunnel(_udid):
    yield 22223


class FakeUI:
    typed = []

    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
        pass

    def bounds(self):
        return 414, 896

    def frontmost(self):
        return "com.example.translate"

    def type_text(self, value):
        self.typed.append(value)
        return {"ok": True}


class PlaybookTextTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.script = self.root / "flow.json"
        FakeUI.typed = []

    def replay(self, step, name, fresh=False):
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.example.translate",
            "scenario_id": "synthetic-phrase", "fresh_launch": fresh,
            "steps": [step],
        }))
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", FakeUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook._fresh_launch", new_callable=AsyncMock) as launch:
            manifest, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                              self.root / name)
        return json.loads(manifest.read_text()), complete, launch

    def test_replay_binds_text_hash_without_copying_it_to_step_metadata(self):
        step = {"action": "type_text", "text": "hello"}
        record, complete, _ = self.replay(step, "valid")
        self.assertTrue(complete, record.get("error"))
        self.assertEqual(FakeUI.typed, ["hello"])
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["typed_text"], type_params(step))
        self.assertNotIn("hello", json.dumps(record["steps"][0]["typed_text"]))
        _load_run(self.root / "valid", require_comparable=False)

    def test_rejects_unbounded_or_control_text_before_launch(self):
        step = {"action": "type_text", "text": "hi\nthere"}
        record, complete, launch = self.replay(step, "invalid", fresh=True)
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertIn("printable", record["error"]["message"])
        launch.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(FakeUI.typed, [])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "128 printable"):
            type_params({"action": "type_text", "text": "x" * 129})

    def test_discovery_counts_synthetic_text_as_action(self):
        plan = {"schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": "com.example.translate",
                "scenario_id": "synthetic-phrase", "fresh_launch": True,
                "steps": [
                    {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Enter text"]},
                    {"action": "type_text", "text": "hello"},
                    {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True,
                     "ready_contains": "hello"},
                ]}
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        inspected = inspect_playbook(self.script, "com.example.translate")
        self.assertEqual(inspected["tap_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(inspected["tap_signature"][0][0], "type_text")

    def test_backend_mapping_preserves_short_text(self):
        ui = object.__new__(ExperimentUI)
        ui.backend = "ictrl"
        ui.client = Mock()
        ui.client.call_ui.return_value = {"ok": True}
        ui.type_text("hello")
        ui.client.call_ui.assert_called_once_with("type", {"text": "hello"})
        ui.backend = "ios-mcp"
        with patch("copyapp.experiment.IOSMCPClient.text_json", return_value={"ok": True}):
            ui.type_text("hello")
        ui.client.call_ui.assert_called_with("type_text", {"text": "hello"})
```

`tests/test_playbook_visual_labels.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import io
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.compare_playbooks import _load_run
from copyapp.playbook import run_playbook
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


@contextmanager
def fake_tunnel(_udid):
    yield 22222


class FakeUI:
    def __init__(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
        pass

    def bounds(self):
        return 414, 896

    def frontmost(self):
        return "com.apple.mobiletimer"

    def observe(self):
        return {"elements": [{"text": "Stop"}]}


class PlaybookVisualLabelsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temp.name)
        image = Image.new("RGB", (414, 896), "#303030")
        stream = io.BytesIO()
        image.save(stream, format="JPEG")
        self.image = stream.getvalue()
        self.script = self.root / "script.json"
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "scenario_id": "stopwatch-state",
            "bundle_id": "com.apple.mobiletimer",
            "steps": [{"action": "screenshot", "stable": True,
                       "ready_contains": "Stop", "ready_ocr_labels": ["Stop"]}],
        }))

    def run_with_painted_labels(self, painted, name):
        def fake_ocr(source, output):
            data = source.read_bytes()
            output.write_text(json.dumps({
                "schema_version": 1, "kind": "saved_screenshot_ocr",
                "source_path": str(source.resolve()),
                "source_sha256": sha256_file(source),
                "source_width": 414, "source_height": 896,
                "roi": None, "ocr_input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                "result": {"engine": "macos-vision",
                           "texts": [{"text": label} for label in painted]},
            }))
            return output

        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", FakeUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.capture_stable", return_value=(
                 self.image, {"stable": True, "samples": 5})), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ocr_file", fake_ocr), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            path, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                          self.root / name)
        return path, complete

    def test_invalid_visual_labels_rejected_before_device_access(self):
        plan = json.loads(self.script.read_text())
        plan["steps"][0]["ready_ocr_labels"] = "Stop"
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel") as tunnel:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "invalid ready_ocr_labels"):
                run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script, self.root / "invalid")
        tunnel.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "invalid").exists())

    def test_accessibility_stop_does_not_hide_missing_painted_stop(self):
        path, complete = self.run_with_painted_labels(["Stopwatch"], "missing")
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["ready_found"], True)
        self.assertEqual(record["steps"][0]["missing_ready_ocr_labels"], ["Stop"])
        self.assertIn("screenshot lacks visible labels", record["error"]["message"])

    def test_saved_visual_evidence_is_rechecked(self):
        path, complete = self.run_with_painted_labels(["Stop"], "matched")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        run = path.parent
        _load_run(run)
        ocr_path = run / "step-01-visual-ocr.json"
        value = json.loads(ocr_path.read_text())
        value["result"]["texts"] = [{"text": "Stopwatch"}]
        ocr_path.write_text(json.dumps(value))
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
        manifest["steps"][0]["ready_ocr_labels_sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
        manifest["evidence"][-1]["sha256"] = sha256_file(ocr_path)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "visual labels do not match image OCR"):
            _load_run(run)

    def test_black_frame_cannot_pass_accessibility_ready_check(self):
        image = io.BytesIO()
        Image.new("RGB", (414, 896), "black").save(image, format="JPEG")
        with patch("copyapp.playbook.ExperimentUI", FakeUI), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.ios_mcp_tunnel", fake_tunnel), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.capture_stable", return_value=(
                 image.getvalue(), {"stable": True, "samples": 5})), \
             patch("copyapp.playbook.time.sleep"):
            path, complete = run_playbook("device", "ios-mcp", self.script,
                                          self.root / "black")
        record = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertFalse(complete)
        self.assertIn("near-uniform black", record["error"]["message"])
        self.assertEqual(len(record["steps"][0]["frame_attempts"]), 3)
        self.assertNotIn("ready_found", record["steps"][0])
        self.assertTrue((path.parent / "step-01-black-attempt-1.jpg").exists())

    def test_verifier_rejects_black_pixels_even_with_updated_hashes(self):
        path, complete = self.run_with_painted_labels(["Stop"], "tampered")
        self.assertTrue(complete)
        image_path = path.parent / "step-01-screenshot.jpg"
        Image.new("RGB", (414, 896), "black").save(image_path, format="JPEG")
        manifest = json.loads(path.read_text())
        digest = sha256_file(image_path)
        manifest["steps"][0]["sha256"] = digest
        manifest["evidence"][1]["sha256"] = digest
        path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(path.parent))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_plist_schema.py`:

```py
import json
import plistlib
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from copyapp.plist_schema import create_plist_schema
from copyapp.report import _validate_plist_schema
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case


class PlistSchemaTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.source = self.root / "source"
        self.source.mkdir()
        self.file = self.source / "preferences.plist"
        self.file.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({
            "fixture.counter": 12,
            "privateToken": "never-export-this-value",
            "profiles": [{"name": "Alice", "enabled": True},
                         {"name": "Bob", "enabled": False}],
        }))
        (self.source / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "schema_version": 1, "kind": "captured_data",
            "evidence": [{"path": self.file.name, "sha256": sha256_file(self.file)}]}))

    def test_only_key_paths_and_types_are_exported(self):
        output = self.root / "schema"
        create_plist_schema(self.source, self.file.name, output)
        profile = json.loads((output / "profile.json").read_text())
        fields = {(item["path"], item["type"])
                  for item in profile["structure"]["fields"]}
        self.assertIn(("/fixture.counter", "integer"), fields)
        self.assertIn(("/profiles/*/enabled", "boolean"), fields)
        self.assertEqual(profile["structure"]["root_type"], "dictionary")
        for path in (output / "profile.json", output / "report.md"):
            text = path.read_text()
            self.assertNotIn("never-export-this-value", text)
            self.assertNotIn("Alice", text)
            self.assertNotIn("Bob", text)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_rehashed_structure_forgery_and_changed_source_are_rejected(self):
        output = self.root / "schema"
        create_plist_schema(self.source, self.file.name, output)
        profile_path = output / "profile.json"
        profile = json.loads(profile_path.read_text())
        profile["structure"]["fields"][0]["type"] = "forged"
        profile_path.write_text(json.dumps(profile))
        manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
        manifest["evidence"][0]["sha256"] = sha256_file(profile_path)
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(output))
        another = self.root / "another"
        create_plist_schema(self.source, self.file.name, another)
        self.file.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({"fixture.counter": 13}))
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(another))

    def test_unrecorded_file_is_rejected(self):
        extra = self.source / "unrecorded.plist"
        extra.write_bytes(plistlib.dumps({"x": "y"}))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "recorded source artifact"):
            create_plist_schema(self.source, extra.name, self.root / "schema")

    def test_report_import_requires_same_analysis_identity(self):
        report_source = self.root / "source-report"
        report_source.mkdir()
        captured = report_source / self.file.name
        captured.write_bytes(self.file.read_bytes())
        report_source.joinpath("report-index.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "target_bundle_id": "dev.copyapp.fixture",
            "source_case_index_sha256": "a" * 64,
            "artifacts": {"plist": {"path": self.file.name,
                                     "sha256": sha256_file(captured)}}}))
        output = self.root / "from-report"
        create_plist_schema(report_source, self.file.name, output)
        self.assertEqual(_validate_plist_schema(output, "dev.copyapp.fixture", "a" * 64)
                         ["record"]["structure"]["root_type"], "dictionary")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "another app or analysis"):
            _validate_plist_schema(output, "dev.copyapp.fixture", "b" * 64)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Regressions for PR #4 review: default routing, case paths and numeric evidence."""

import copy
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch

from PIL import Image

from copyapp.cli import main
from copyapp.ios_cases import read_json, seal_case, write_json
from copyapp.ios_credentials import retrieve_credential
from copyapp.ios_cross_check import cross_check_offline
from copyapp.ios_delivery import create_behavior_delivery
from copyapp.ios_offline import decrypt_offline
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file, verify_case
from tests import test_ios_analysis as analysis_fixtures
from tests.test_ios_analysis import BUNDLE, PREFIX, UDID, capabilities


class ReviewFixTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.fixture = analysis_fixtures.IosAnalysisTest()
        self.fixture.setUp()
        self.addCleanup(self.fixture.doCleanups)
        self.root = self.fixture.root

    def test_actual_copy_cli_auto_defaults_reach_standard_behavior_review(self):
        workflow = self.root / "workflow"
        argv = ["copyapp", "copy", "--mode", "auto", "--agent-provider", "current",
                "--udid", UDID, "--bundle", BUNDLE, "--script", str(self.fixture.script),
                "--rebuilt-bundle", "dev.copyapp.counter", "--workspace", str(self.root),
                "--out", str(workflow), "--project", str(self.root / "project"),
                "--decrypt-helper", str(self.root / "helper")]
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", argv), \
                patch("copyapp.cli.apply_ssh_profile"), \
                patch("copyapp.ios_workflow.collect_capabilities", side_effect=capabilities), \
                patch("copyapp.cli.analyze_case") as enhanced:
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as stopped:
                main()
        self.assertEqual(stopped.exception.code, 1)  # handoff, not completed rebuild
        enhanced.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(read_json(workflow / "workflow.json")["status"], "needs_behavior_review")
        self.assertEqual(read_json(workflow / "analysis/analysis.json")["selected_mode"], "standard")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(workflow))

    def test_explicit_auto_analyze_decrypt_still_requires_enhancement(self):
        output = self.root / "explicit-decryption"
        argv = ["copyapp", "analyze", "--mode", "auto", "--decrypt",
                "--udid", UDID, "--bundle", BUNDLE, "--script", str(self.fixture.script),
                "--out", str(output), "--decrypt-helper", str(self.root / "helper")]
        with patch.object(sys, "argv", argv), patch("copyapp.cli.apply_ssh_profile"), \
                patch("copyapp.cli.analyze_case", new=AsyncMock(return_value=False)) as enhanced, \
                patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook") as replay:
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                main()
        enhanced.assert_awaited_once()
        replay.assert_not_called()
        state = read_json(output / "analysis.json")
        self.assertEqual(state["selected_mode"], "enhanced")
        self.assertEqual(state["status"], "failed")
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(output))

    def test_offline_rejects_nested_output_before_copying_or_touching_source(self):
        package = self.fixture.package()
        output = package / "offline"
        original = sha256_file(package / "manifest.json")
        with patch("copyapp.ios_offline.shutil.copytree",
                   side_effect=AssertionError("copied before checking overlap")) as copy:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "separate|overlap"):
                decrypt_offline(package, output)
        copy.assert_not_called()
        self.assertFalse(output.exists())
        self.assertEqual(sha256_file(package / "manifest.json"), original)
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(package))

    def test_credential_retrieval_rejects_symlinked_nested_package_output(self):

    def test_behavior_report_rejects_output_inside_original_collection(self):

    def test_behavior_delivery_cannot_invalidate_either_source_case(self):

    def test_offline_cross_check_rejects_output_in_either_source_before_validation(self):
        offline, device = self.root / "offline", self.root / "device"
        offline.mkdir()
        device.mkdir()
        alias = self.root / "device-alias"
        alias.symlink_to(device, target_is_directory=True)
        for source in (offline, alias):
            with self.subTest(source=source.name):
                output = source / "comparison"
                with patch("copyapp.ios_cross_check.recovery_links") as validate:
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "separate|overlap"):
                        cross_check_offline(offline, device, output)
                    validate.assert_not_called()
                self.assertFalse(output.exists())

    def numeric_case(self, source="accessibility", before=1, after=2):
        script = read_json(self.fixture.script)
        script["steps"] = [
            {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Count"],
             "capture_number": {"name": "count", "pattern": r"Count (\d+)"}},
            {"action": "tap_label", "label": "Add"},
            {"action": "observe", "contains": ["Count"],
             "compare_number": {"to": "count", "pattern": r"Count (\d+)", "delta": after - before}},
            {"action": "screenshot", "stable": True, "ready_contains": "Count"}]
        write_json(self.fixture.script, script)

        def player(udid, backend, path, root, **kwargs):
            root.mkdir(parents=True)
            shutil.copyfile(path, root / "playbook.json")
            Image.new("RGB", (30, 30), "white").save(root / "screen.jpg")
            steps = []
            for index, value in ((1, before), (3, after)):
                write_json(root / f"observe-{index}.json", {"source": f"Count {value}"})
                item = {"index": index, "action": "observe", "frontmost": BUNDLE,
                        "observation_source": source, "missing": [],
                        "evidence_path": f"observe-{index}.json"}
                if source == "screenshot_ocr":
                    image = root / "screen.jpg"
                    write_json(root / f"ocr-{index}.json", {
                        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "saved_screenshot_ocr",
                        "source_sha256": sha256_file(image), "source_width": 30, "source_height": 30,
                        "roi": None, "ocr_input_sha256": sha256_file(image),
                        "result": {"engine": "macos-vision", "texts": [{"text": f"Count {value}"}]}})
                    item.update(observation_image_path=image.name, observation_image_sha256=sha256_file(image),
                                observation_ocr_path=f"ocr-{index}.json",
                                observation_ocr_sha256=sha256_file(root / f"ocr-{index}.json"))
                if index == 1:
                    item["captured_number"] = {"name": "count", "value": before}
                else:
                    item["number_comparison"] = {"before": before, "after": after, "delta": after - before}
                steps.append(item)
            steps.insert(1, {"index": 2, "action": "tap_label", "frontmost": BUNDLE, "result": {}})
            steps.append({"index": 4, "action": "screenshot", "frontmost": BUNDLE,
                          "evidence_path": "screen.jpg", "sha256": sha256_file(root / "screen.jpg"),
                          "stability": {"stable": True}, "ready_contains": "Count", "ready_found": True})
            write_json(root / "manifest.json", {
                "schema_version": 1, "bundle_id": BUNDLE, "ui_backend": backend,
                "scenario_id": script["scenario_id"], "device_id_sha256_prefix": PREFIX,
                "execution_mode": kwargs["mode"], "status": "complete", "steps": steps,
                "evidence": [{"path": p.name, "sha256": sha256_file(p)} for p in root.iterdir()]})
            return root / "manifest.json", True

        with patch("copyapp.ios_analysis.run_playbook", side_effect=player):
            self.fixture.collect()
        return self.root / "analysis"

    def reseal_numeric_case(self, root, flow):
        child = root / "flows/flow-01"
        for item in flow["evidence"]:
            item["sha256"] = sha256_file(child / item["path"])
        write_json(child / "manifest.json", flow)
        state = read_json(root / "analysis.json")
        state["flows"][0]["manifest_sha256"] = sha256_file(child / "manifest.json")
        write_json(root / "analysis.json", state)
        seal_case(root, "ios_analysis", status="complete", bundle_id=BUNDLE, device_id_sha256_prefix=PREFIX)

    def test_correct_ax_numeric_capture_and_delta_still_verify(self):
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.numeric_case(before=0, after=1)))

    def test_rehashed_ax_without_the_required_change_is_rejected(self):
        root = self.numeric_case()
        child = root / "flows/flow-01"
        flow = read_json(child / "manifest.json")
        write_json(child / "observe-3.json", {"source": "Count 1"})
        self.reseal_numeric_case(root, flow)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))

    def test_claimed_numeric_metadata_must_match_raw_ax_values(self):
        root = self.numeric_case()
        child = root / "flows/flow-01"
        original = read_json(child / "manifest.json")
        for field, replacement in (("captured_number", {"name": "count", "value": 9}),
                                   ("captured_number", {"name": "count", "value": True}),
                                   ("captured_number", None),
                                   ("number_comparison", {"before": 1, "after": 9, "delta": 1}),
                                   ("number_comparison", None),
                                   ("number_comparison", {"before": True, "after": 2, "delta": 1})):
            with self.subTest(field=field, replacement=replacement):
                flow = copy.deepcopy(original)
                flow["steps"][0 if field == "captured_number" else 2][field] = replacement
                self.reseal_numeric_case(root, flow)
                self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))

    def test_numeric_decrease_to_zero_is_valid(self):
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.numeric_case(before=2, after=0)))

    def test_malformed_pattern_or_missing_capture_reference_fails_closed(self):
        root = self.numeric_case()
        child = root / "flows/flow-01"
        original = read_json(child / "playbook.json")
        for changed in ({"pattern": "["}, {"pattern": "Count [0-9]+"}, {"to": "absent"}):
            with self.subTest(changed=changed):
                script = copy.deepcopy(original)
                script["steps"][2]["compare_number"].update(changed)
                write_json(self.fixture.script, script)
                write_json(child / "playbook.json", script)
                write_json(root / "scripts/flow-01.json", script)
                inputs = read_json(root / "inputs.json")
                inputs["flows"][0]["source_script_sha256"] = sha256_file(child / "playbook.json")
                write_json(root / "inputs.json", inputs)
                state = read_json(root / "analysis.json")
                state["flows"][0]["source_script_sha256"] = inputs["flows"][0]["source_script_sha256"]
                write_json(root / "analysis.json", state)
                flow = read_json(child / "manifest.json")
                self.reseal_numeric_case(root, flow)
                self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))

    def test_correct_ocr_numeric_capture_and_delta_still_verify(self):
        self.assertTrue(verify_case(self.numeric_case(source="screenshot_ocr")))

    def test_rehashed_ocr_numeric_change_is_recomputed(self):
        root = self.numeric_case(source="screenshot_ocr")
        child = root / "flows/flow-01"
        record = read_json(child / "ocr-3.json")
        record["result"]["texts"] = [{"text": "Count 1"}]
        write_json(child / "ocr-3.json", record)
        flow = read_json(child / "manifest.json")
        flow["steps"][2]["observation_ocr_sha256"] = sha256_file(child / "ocr-3.json")
        self.reseal_numeric_case(root, flow)
        self.assertFalse(verify_case(root))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_prepare_analysis.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from copyapp.prepare_analysis import prepare_analysis
from copyapp.verify import sha256_file


class PrepareAnalysisTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.udid = "exact-device"
        self.bundle = "com.example.app"
        self.prefix = hashlib.sha256(self.udid.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.analysis = self.root / "analysis"
        (self.analysis / "survey").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.analysis / "survey/manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "bundle_id": self.bundle, "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix}))
        (self.analysis / "analysis-index.json").write_text("{}")
        self.script = self.root / "flow.json"
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": self.bundle,
                                           "steps": [{"action": "observe"}]}))
        self.output = self.root / "prepared"

    def test_interrupted_investigation_resumes_then_prepares_review_task(self):
        attempts = []

        def investigate(udid, analysis, scripts, output, *args):
            attempts.append(args[-1])
            output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            complete = len(attempts) == 2
            (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "status": "complete" if complete else "needs_review",
                "bundle_id": self.bundle,
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix,
                "analysis_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json"),
                "scripts": [{"path": str(self.script.resolve()), "sha256": sha256_file(self.script)}],
                "ui_backend": "ios-mcp", "provider": "ghidra-direct"}))
            return output / "manifest.json", complete

        def draft(analysis, investigation, output, rebuilt_bundle):
            output.mkdir()
            (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status": "complete"}))
            (output / "task.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                "kind": "agent_semantic_review_task",
                "target_bundle_id": self.bundle,
                "device_id_sha256_prefix": self.prefix,
                "analysis_index_sha256": sha256_file(self.analysis / "analysis-index.json"),
                "app_investigation_sha256": sha256_file(investigation / "manifest.json")}))
            return output / "manifest.json", True

        with patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis._ghidra_ready"), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.investigate_app", side_effect=investigate), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.draft_analysis", side_effect=draft) as writer:
            _, ready = prepare_analysis(self.udid, self.analysis, [self.script], self.output,
                                        provider="ghidra-direct")
            self.assertFalse(ready)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.output / "manifest.json").read_text())["status"],
                             "investigation_incomplete")
            _, ready = prepare_analysis(self.udid, self.analysis, [self.script], self.output,
                                        provider="ghidra-direct", resume=True)
            self.assertTrue(ready, (self.output / "manifest.json").read_text())
            writer.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(attempts, [False, True])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.output / "manifest.json").read_text())["status"],
                         "needs_semantic_review")

    def test_changed_script_rejected_before_device_work_on_resume(self):
        self.output.mkdir()
        (self.output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "kind": "analysis_preparation", "analysis_case": str(self.analysis),
            "scripts": [{"path": str(self.script), "sha256": sha256_file(self.script)}]}))
        self.script.write_text(json.dumps({"bundle_id": self.bundle,
                                           "steps": [{"action": "tap", "x": 5}]}))
        with patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.investigate_app") as worker:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "resume target, scripts or settings differ"):
                prepare_analysis(self.udid, self.analysis, [self.script], self.output,
                                 resume=True)
        worker.assert_not_called()

    def test_missing_decompiler_stops_before_touching_phone(self):
        with patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis._ghidra_ready",
                   side_effect=FileNotFoundError("Ghidra not found")), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.investigate_app") as worker:
            manifest, ready = prepare_analysis(
                self.udid, self.analysis, [self.script], self.output, provider="ghidra-direct")
        self.assertFalse(ready)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(manifest.read_text())["error"]["type"],
                         "FileNotFoundError")
        worker.assert_not_called()

    def test_default_skips_rea_doctor(self):
        with patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.verify_case", return_value=True), \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis._ghidra_ready",
                   side_effect=AssertionError("Ghidra must not run")) as doctor, \
             patch("copyapp.prepare_analysis.investigate_app", return_value=(None, False)):
            manifest, ready = prepare_analysis(
                self.udid, self.analysis, [self.script], self.output)
        self.assertFalse(ready)
        doctor.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(manifest.read_text())["provider"], "none")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
