          <p id="setupAgent">Python 3.9+, CLI, exact USB phone/App identity, a development-signed iCTRL XCTest runner and USB installation. Collection needs no original IPA, FairPlay credential, SSH or Frida.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="terminal"><div class="terminal-top"><span data-i18n="startTaskLabel">PASTE INTO CODEX / CLAUDE CODE</span><button id="copyCommand" type="button" aria-label="Copy non-jailbroken iOS agent task" data-i18n="copy">COPY TASK</button></div><pre tabindex="0" aria-label="Agent task"><code id="agentPrompt">Use https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp to observe and independently rebuild selected behavior of “APP NAME” on my USB-connected non-jailbroken iPhone.
Use the latest main checkout. Read AGENTS.md, skills/copyapp-start/SKILL.md and docs/ios-standard-mode.md first. Prepare the CLI with sh scripts/bootstrap-macos.sh if needed.
Identify the exact USB phone and App. Use --mode standard; check Xcode, Developer Mode, device trust and development signing. Prepare the signed iCTRL XCTest runner and install over USB.
Discover representative UI flows, review screenshots and accessibility evidence, and deliver a reviewed UI behavior report. Standard collection needs no IPA or FairPlay credential. Implement an independent App with its own Bundle ID, sign and install it over USB, then compare the same flows and review every screenshot pair in the current agent session.
Use a unique output/ job with project/ and evidence/. Follow docs/fidelity.md: default grade 80/100, at most three implementation/check cycles including the first. Deliver source, runnable artifacts, verified scope and remaining differences. Keep native function and private sandbox claims outside the UI-only report.</code></pre></div>
        <p id="copyStatus" class="copy-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <p class="setup-check-only" id="setupCheckOnly">Only checking setup? Append: “Stop after a verified standard-mode capability check; list signing or runner setup still needed.”</p>
        <p class="start-defaults" data-i18n="startDefaults">Output: project/ + evidence/ inside a unique output/ job. Default reviewed grade 80/100, up to three implementation/check cycles. Selected scope and remaining gaps stay explicit.</p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="workflow" class="section-shell workflow-section">
      <div class="section-heading"><div><p class="kicker">// 01 — THE WORKFLOW</p><h2 data-i18n="workflowTitle">Two phases. One evidence trail.</h2></div><p data-i18n="workflowIntro">Go from observed behavior to a reviewed implementation. Each phase leaves inspectable cases behind.</p></div>
      <div class="phase-grid">
        <article class="phase-card"><div class="phase-head"><span class="phase-no">01</span><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="phaseOneTag">UNDERSTAND THE ORIGINAL</span></div><div class="phase-symbol">⌁</div><h3 data-i18n="phaseOneTitle">Understand the behavior</h3><p data-i18n="phaseOneText">Standard iOS observes UI and accessibility. Jailbroken iOS adds package, sandbox and runtime evidence. macOS collects App-package, AX and UI evidence. Review the corresponding report and specification.</p><div class="phase-rule"></div><ul><li data-i18n="phaseOneA">App evidence for the selected route</li><li data-i18n="phaseOneB">UI flows &amp; screenshots</li><li data-i18n="phaseOneC">Standard UI / enhanced runtime / Mac AX</li><li data-i18n="phaseOneD">Reviewed report &amp; feature spec</li></ul></article>
        <div class="phase-link" aria-hidden="true"><span>→</span></div>
        <article class="phase-card phase-card-second"><div class="phase-head"><span class="phase-no">02</span><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="phaseTwoTag">BUILD AN INDEPENDENT APP</span></div><div class="phase-symbol">◈</div><h3 data-i18n="phaseTwoTitle">Rebuild selectively</h3><p data-i18n="phaseTwoText">Build a separate iOS or macOS app. Compare the same selected flows, review every screenshot and stop at the reviewed grade target or cycle limit.</p><div class="phase-rule"></div><ul><li data-i18n="phaseTwoA">Capability inventory &amp; target</li><li data-i18n="phaseTwoB">Independent source, IPA or .app</li><li data-i18n="phaseTwoC">Paired behavior &amp; visual checks</li><li data-i18n="phaseTwoD">Verified delivery &amp; known gaps</li></ul></article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="principle-band"><div class="section-shell principle-inner"><span class="principle-index">CORE PRINCIPLE / 001</span><p data-i18n="principle">A passing screenshot is a data point. A trustworthy rebuild is a chain of observations, decisions, and repeatable checks.</p><span class="principle-star" aria-hidden="true">✳</span></div></section>

    <section id="architecture" class="section-shell architecture-section"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="kicker">// 02 — SYSTEM DESIGN</p><h2 data-i18n="architectureTitle">Built as a local instrument.</h2></div><p data-i18n="architectureIntro">Your current coding agent plans and implements. Copy APP records evidence and checks. A named iPhone or ChatComputer virtual Mac supplies observations.</p></div>
      <div class="architecture-grid"><div class="architecture-map"><div class="arch-rail"><span>AGENT</span><span>MAC</span><span>TARGET</span><span>OUTPUT</span></div><div class="arch-flow"><div class="arch-node arch-agent"><span class="node-icon">⌘</span><div><strong>Codex / Claude Code</strong><small data-i18n="archAgent">Planning &amp; interpretation</small></div></div><span class="arch-arrow">↓</span><div class="arch-node arch-mac"><span class="node-icon">▣</span><div><strong>Copy APP CLI</strong><small data-i18n="archMac">Orchestration, analysis, builds</small></div></div><span class="arch-arrow">↓ USB / SSH / ChatComputer</span><div class="arch-node arch-phone"><span class="node-icon">▤</span><div><strong data-i18n="archTarget">Standard iPhone / jailbroken iPhone / virtual Mac</strong><small>iOS MCP / iCTRL / ChatComputer / AX</small></div></div><span class="arch-arrow">↓</span><div class="arch-node arch-output"><span class="node-icon">◇</span><div><strong data-i18n="archOutputTitle">Verified artifacts</strong><small data-i18n="archOutput">Report / source / IPA or .app / comparison</small></div></div></div></div><div class="architecture-notes"><div class="note-card"><span>01 / COLLECT</span><h3 data-i18n="noteOneTitle">See what really happened.</h3><p data-i18n="noteOneText">Named device identity, package hashes, bounded actions, screenshots and runtime traces live in local evidence cases.</p></div><div class="note-card"><span>02 / INTERPRET</span><h3 data-i18n="noteTwoTitle">Trace claims back to proof.</h3><p data-i18n="noteTwoText">Standard iOS delivers UI behavior reports. Jailbroken iOS can add Ghidra or Hopper native investigation; Mac uses App-package, AX and UI evidence.</p></div><div class="note-card"><span>03 / VERIFY</span><h3 data-i18n="noteThreeTitle">Measure only the chosen scope.</h3><p data-i18n="noteThreeText">Original and rebuilt flows run separately in the same pinned environment. Deliveries name behavior passes, visible differences and unknowns.</p></div></div></div>
    </section>

    <section id="toolchain" class="section-shell toolchain-section" aria-labelledby="toolsTitle">
      <div class="section-heading"><div><p class="kicker">// REVERSE ENGINEERING</p><h2 id="toolsTitle" data-i18n="toolsTitle">Choose your analysis tools.</h2></div><p data-i18n="toolsIntro">Two directly integrated decompilers, plus runtime tracing and bounded assembly. Decompilation is optional; the default provider is none.</p></div>
      <div class="tool-grid">
        <article class="tool-card"><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="toolDecompiler">DECOMPILER / OPTIONAL</span><h3>Ghidra</h3><p data-i18n="ghidraToolText">Selected-function pseudocode, bounded call relationships, blocks and instruction references.</p><code>ghidra-direct</code><small data-i18n="ghidraToolSetup">Install Ghidra and a matching JDK. Supports function, queue and selected indirect-call investigation.</small></article>
        <article class="tool-card"><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="toolDecompiler">DECOMPILER / OPTIONAL</span><h3>Hopper</h3><p data-i18n="hopperToolText">Selected-function pseudocode and candidate queues through the local Python scripting interface.</p><code>hopper-direct</code><small data-i18n="hopperToolSetup">Requires a local Hopper license and a logged-in macOS GUI session. No REA runtime required.</small></article>
        <article class="tool-card"><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="toolRuntime">RUNTIME OBSERVATIONS</span><h3>Frida</h3><p data-i18n="fridaToolText">Trace named Objective-C methods and selected entries during bounded UI flows.</p><code>trace / flow-capture --method</code><small data-i18n="fridaToolSetup">Requires compatible host/device services. A temporal hit alone does not prove UI causality.</small></article>
        <article class="tool-card"><span class="phase-tag" data-i18n="toolAssembly">ARM64 DISASSEMBLY</span><h3>LLVM / Xcode</h3><p data-i18n="llvmToolText">Bounded assembly windows and unique local direct-call/branch followers with llvm-objdump.</p><code>native-disasm / native-queue</code><small data-i18n="llvmToolSetup">Uses the local Xcode toolchain. Assembly output is separate from decompiler pseudocode.</small></article>
      </div>
      <div class="tool-extras"><p><strong data-i18n="toolIndexTitle">Built-in package &amp; Objective-C indexes</strong><span data-i18n="toolIndexText">Inspect Mach-O load commands, classes, selectors and method addresses without a decompiler.</span></p><p><strong data-i18n="toolRecoveryTitle">Encrypted-package recovery</strong><span data-i18n="toolRecoveryText">Supported jailbreak routes recover device code. Mac offline recovery uses a local FairPlay credential matching the IPA account; first retrieval needs a supported jailbroken phone.</span></p></div>
      <div class="tool-scope"><p data-i18n="toolPlatformScope">Native-function investigation needs matching code and runtime evidence and primarily serves jailbroken iOS. Standard iOS focuses on UI; Mac uses App-package, AX and UI evidence.</p><p data-i18n="toolIntegrationScope">REA is not a runtime dependency. IDA Pro, Binary Ninja and radare2 currently have no direct adapters. Pseudocode is generated evidence, not original source.</p><a class="text-link" id="toolsGuideLink" href="https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/reverse-engineering-tools.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span data-i18n="toolsGuide">Tool setup, commands and agent tasks</span> ↗</a></div>
    </section>

    <section id="platforms" class="section-shell platforms-section">
      <div class="section-heading"><div><p class="kicker">// PLATFORM SUPPORT</p><h2 data-i18n="platformsTitle">Two ways for iOS. Plus Mac apps.</h2></div><p data-i18n="platformsIntro">Choose by device access and the evidence you need. Continue to independent implementation and flow comparison in each route.</p></div>
      <div class="platform-grid">
        <article class="platform-card platform-standard"><span class="phase-tag">STANDARD / USB + XCTEST</span><h3 data-i18n="standardPlatformTitle">Non-jailbroken iOS</h3><p data-i18n="standardPlatformText">Use signed XCTest, accessibility observations and exact USB screenshots to review behavior, build an independent signed App and compare the same flows. No original IPA, FairPlay credential, SSH or Frida required.</p><p class="platform-note" data-i18n="standardPlatformScope">Tested on an inactive-jailbreak iOS 26 sample and an explicit iOS 17 standard regression. A never-jailbroken device has not been separately tested.</p><a class="text-link" id="standardGuideLink" href="https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/ios-standard-mode.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span data-i18n="standardPlatformLink">Standard setup and agent task</span> ↗</a></article>
        <article class="platform-card platform-enhanced"><span class="phase-tag">ENHANCED / JAILBROKEN IPHONE</span><h3 data-i18n="iosPlatformTitle">Jailbroken iOS</h3><p data-i18n="iosPlatformText">Package and sandbox acquisition, UI replay, optional Frida tracing and supported device decryption. Enhanced evidence binds the exact phone, system and App build.</p><a class="text-link" href="#devices"><span data-i18n="iosPlatformLink">Named phone evidence and limits</span> &rarr;</a></article>
        <article class="platform-card platform-mac"><span class="phase-tag">CHATCOMPUTER / APPLE SILICON</span><h3 data-i18n="macPlatformTitle">macOS</h3><p data-i18n="macPlatformText">Computer use through ChatComputer, exact App and AX evidence, independent .app builds, paired checks and reviewed snapshots in a dedicated virtual Mac.</p><p class="platform-note" data-i18n="macPlatformScope">Owned editor: 9/9 selected comparisons and a named physical-Mac recheck. These results do not establish arbitrary-Mac or whole-App compatibility.</p><a class="text-link" id="macGuideLink" href="https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/macos-support.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span data-i18n="macPlatformLink">Mac setup and agent task</span> &#8599;</a></article>
      </div>

const languageButton = document.querySelector('#language');
const copyButton = document.querySelector('#copyCommand');
let activePlatform = 'standard';
let copyResetTimer;

function renderQuickstart() {
  const zh = document.documentElement.lang === 'zh-CN';
  const task = quickstarts[zh ? 'zh' : 'en'][activePlatform];
  document.querySelector('#setupRequirements').textContent = task.requirements;
  document.querySelector('#setupAgent').textContent = task.agent;
  document.querySelector('#setupCheckOnly').textContent = task.checkOnly;
  document.querySelector('#agentPrompt').textContent = task.prompt;
  const source = document.querySelector('#requirementsSource');
  source.textContent = task.source;
  source.href = task.sourceUrl;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-platform]').forEach(button => {
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.platform === activePlatform));
  });
  document.querySelector('.platform-picker').setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? '目标平台' : 'Target platform');
  document.querySelector('.terminal pre').setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? 'Agent 任务' : 'Agent task');
  const label = {standard: zh ? '非越狱 iOS' : 'non-jailbroken iOS', ios: zh ? '越狱 iOS' : 'jailbroken iOS', macos: 'macOS'}[activePlatform];
  copyButton.setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? '复制' + label + '任务' : 'Copy ' + label + ' agent task');
  copyButton.textContent = zh ? '复制任务' : 'COPY TASK';
  document.querySelector('#copyStatus').textContent = '';
  clearTimeout(copyResetTimer);
}

function setLanguage(language) {
  const zh = language === 'zh';
  document.documentElement.lang = zh ? 'zh-CN' : 'en';
  document.title = zh ? 'Copy APP — 观察、理解、复刻' : 'Copy APP — Observe. Understand. Rebuild.';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach((element) => {
    const key = element.dataset.i18n;
    if (zh && translations.zh[key]) element.textContent = translations.zh[key];
    else if (element.dataset.english) element.textContent = element.dataset.english;
  });
  const statusUrl = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/current-status' + (zh ? '.zh-CN' : '') + '.md';
  for (const id of ['statusLink', 'deviceStatusLink']) document.getElementById(id).href = statusUrl;
  document.getElementById('toolsGuideLink').href = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/reverse-engineering-tools' + (zh ? '.zh-CN' : '') + '.md';
  document.getElementById('macGuideLink').href = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/macos-support' + (zh ? '.zh-CN' : '') + '.md';
  document.getElementById('macSetupLink').href = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/macos-support' + (zh ? '.zh-CN.md#安装与首次使用' : '.md#install-and-first-use');
  document.getElementById('iosSetupLink').href = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/setup' + (zh ? '.zh-CN' : '') + '.md';
  for (const id of ['standardGuideLink', 'standardSetupLink']) document.getElementById(id).href = 'https://github.com/everettjf/copyapp/blob/main/docs/ios-standard-mode' + (zh ? '.zh-CN' : '') + '.md';
  languageButton.setAttribute('aria-label', zh ? 'Switch to English' : '切换到中文');
  renderQuickstart();
  try { localStorage.setItem('copyapp-language', language); } catch (_) { /* private mode */ }
}

document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach((element) => { element.dataset.english = element.textContent; });
let initialLanguage = 'en';
try { initialLanguage = localStorage.getItem('copyapp-language') === 'zh' ? 'zh' : 'en'; } catch (_) { /* private mode */ }
setLanguage(initialLanguage);
languageButton.addEventListener('click', () => setLanguage(document.documentElement.lang === 'en' ? 'zh' : 'en'));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-platform]').forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    activePlatform = button.dataset.platform;
    renderQuickstart();
  });
});
copyButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const prompt = document.querySelector('#agentPrompt');
  const text = prompt.textContent.trim();
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    if (prompt.textContent.trim() !== text) return;
    const zh = document.documentElement.lang === 'zh-CN';
    copyButton.textContent = zh ? '已复制' : 'COPIED';
    document.querySelector('#copyStatus').textContent = zh ? '已复制。粘贴到本地 Agent，并替换 App 名称。' : 'Copied. Paste into your local agent and replace APP NAME.';
    copyResetTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      copyButton.textContent = document.documentElement.lang === 'zh-CN' ? '复制任务' : 'COPY TASK';
    }, 1800);
  } catch (_) {
    if (prompt.textContent.trim() !== text) return;
    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(prompt);
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    selection.removeAllRanges();
    selection.addRange(range);
    document.querySelector('#copyStatus').textContent = document.documentElement.lang === 'zh-CN' ? '任务已选中，请手动复制。' : 'Task selected. Copy it manually.';
  }
});
